"‘They shall not shave their raash (head), neither shall they galach (shave) off the paah (corners) of their zaqan (beards), nor sharat (make) any sharat (cuttings) in their bashar (flesh).

They shall be qadash (set apart / make holy) to their Alahayam, and not chalal (profane) the sham (name) of their Alahayam; for they qarab (come close) the ashay (offerings) of Yahawah made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire), the lacham (bread) of their Alahayam; therefore they shall be qadawash (holy).

"‘They shall not marry a ayashah (woman / wife) who is a prostitute, or chalal (profane); neither shall they marry a ayashah (woman / wife) garash (divorced) from her ayash (man / husband): for he is qadawash (holy) to his Alahayam.

You shall qadash (set apart / make holy) him therefore; for he qarab (come close) the lacham (bread) of your Alahayam: he shall be qadawash (holy) to you: for I Yahawah, who qadash (set apart / make holy) you, am qadawash (holy).
"‘The banath (daughter) of any kahan (priest), if she chalal (profanes) herself by zanah (playing) the prostitute, she chalal (profanes) her ab (father): she shall be sharap (burned) with ash (fire).

"‘He who is the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) among his ach (brother/kinsman), upon whose raash (head) the mashachah (anointing) shaman (oil) is yatzaq (poured), and that is malaa (consecrated) to labash (put) on the bagadayam (garments), shall not let the hair of his raash (head) hang loose, nor tear his clothes;
Neither shall he bawaa (come) in to any mawath (death) napash (soul), nor tamaa (defile) himself for his ab (father), or for his am (mother);

Neither shall he yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the maqadash (sanctuary), nor chalal (profane) the maqadash (sanctuary) of his Alahayam; for the nazar (crown / consecrate) of the mashachah (anointing) shaman (oil) of his Alahayam is upon him. I am Yahawah.
"‘He shall laqach (take / seize) a ayashah (woman / wife) in her bathawalayam (virginity).

A alamanah (widow), or one garash (divorced), or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute, these he shall not marry: but a bathawalah (virgin) of his own im (nation / people) shall he take as a ayashah (woman / wife).
He shall not chalal (profane) his zarai (seed) among his im (nation / people): for I am Yahawah who qadash (set apart / make holy) him.'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to Aharawan (Aaron), ‘ayash (man / husband) of your zarai (seed) throughout their dawar (generation / age / period) who has a maawam (blemish), may qarab (come close) to qarab (come close) the lacham (bread) of his Alahayam.

For whatever ayash (man / husband) he is that has a maawam (blemish), he shall not qarab (come close) near: a iwar (blind) ayash (man / husband), or a pasach (lame), or he who charam (has) a flat nose, or any deformity,
Or a ayash (man / husband) who has an injured shabar (foot), or an injured shabar (hand),
Or hunchbacked, or a daq (dwarf), or thabalal (one) who has a defect in his iyan (eye), or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles;

No ayash (man / husband) of the zarai (seed) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) who has a maawam (blemish), shall nagash (come) near to qarab (come close) the ashay (offerings) of Yahawah made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire). Since he has a maawam (blemish), he shall not nagash (come) near to qarab (come close) the lacham (bread) of his Alahayam.
He shall akal (eat) the lacham (bread) of his Alahayam, both of the most qadash (set apart / make holy), and of the qadash (set apart / make holy).

He shall not bawaa (come) near to the parakath (veil), nor nagash (come) near to the mazabach (altar), because he has a maawam (blemish); that he may not chalal (profane) my maqadash (sanctuaries), for I am Yahawah who qadash (set apart / make holy) them.'"
So Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to Aharawan (Aaron), and to his banay (sons), and to all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) Aharawan (Aaron) and his banay (sons) to nazar (crown / consecrate) themselves from the qadash (set apart / make holy) things of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), which they make qadash (set apart / make holy) to me, and that they not chalal (profane) my qadash (set apart / make holy) sham (name). I am Yahawah.

"Amar (spoke) them, ‘If anyone of all your zarai (seed) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period) approaches the qadash (set apart / make holy) things, which the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) make qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah, having his tamaah (uncleanness) on him, that napash (soul) shall be karath (cut) off from before me. I am Yahawah.

"‘Whoever of the zarai (seed) of Aharawan (Aaron) is a tzarai (leper) or zawab (flow) an issue; he shall not akal (eat) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things, until he is tahar (clean). Whoever touches anything that is tamaa (unclean) by the napash (soul), or a ayash (man / husband) whose zarai (seed) yatzaa (go out / come out) from him;
Or ayash (man / husband) touches any sharatz (creeping) thing, whereby he may be made tamaa (unclean), or a adam (man) of whom he may take uncleanness, whatever tamaah (uncleanness) he has;

The napash (soul) that touches any such shall be tamaa (unclean) until the irab (evening), and shall not akal (eat) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things, am (mother) he rachatz (bathe) his bashar (flesh) in mayam (Waters).
When the shamash (sun) is down, he shall be tahar (clean); and afterward he shall akal (eat) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things, because it is his bread.
That which dies of nabalah (itself), or is tarapah (torn) by animals, he shall not akal (eat), defiling himself by it. I am Yahawah.

"‘They shall therefore follow my requirements, lest they nashaa (lift) chataa (sin) for it, and mawath (death) therein, if they chalal (profane) it. I am Yahawah who qadash (set apart / make holy) them.

"‘No stranger shall akal (eat) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) thing: a foreigner living with the kahan (priest), or a hired shakayar (servant), shall not akal (eat) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) thing.
But if a kahan (priest) qanah (buys) a slave, purchased by his kasap (money), he shall akal (eat) of it; and such as are yalayad (born) in his bayath (house), they shall akal (eat) of his bread.
If a kahan (priest) banath (daughter) is married to an outsider, she shall not akal (eat) of the heave tharawamah (offering) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things.

But if a kahan (priest) banath (daughter) is a alamanah (widow), or garash (divorced), and has no zarai (child), and has shawab (turn back / repent) to her ab (father) bayath (house), as in her naiwar (youth), she may akal (eat) of her ab (father) zawar (bread): but no stranger shall akal (eat) any of it.

"‘If a ayash (man / husband) akal (eat) something holy shagagah (unwittingly), then he shall yasap (add) the chamayashay (fifth) part of its value to it, and shall nathan (give) the qadash (set apart / make holy) thing to the kahan (priest).
The priests shall not chalal (profane) the qadash (set apart / make holy) things of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), which they rawam (will lift up) to Yahawah,

And so cause them to nashaa (lift) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) that brings ashamah (guilt), when they akal (eat) their qadash (set apart / make holy) things: for I am Yahawah who qadash (set apart / make holy) them.'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to Aharawan (Aaron), and to his banay (sons), and to all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) to them, ‘ayash (man / husband) is of the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel), or of the foreigners in Yashar-Al (Israel), who yaqarayabaw (offers) his qaraban (offering), whether it be any of their nadar (vow), or any of their freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering), which they qarab (come close) to Yahawah for a burnt ilah (offering);
That you may be accepted, you shall offer a zakar (remember) thamayam (complete / whole) blemish, of the baqar (morning), of the sheep, or of the izayam (goats).
But whatever has a maawam (blemish), that you shall not qarab (come close): for it shall not be ratzawan (acceptable) for you.

Ayash (man / husband) qarab (come close) a zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings to Yahawah to palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) a nadar (vow), or for a freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering), of the baqar (morning) or of the tzaan (flock), it shall be thamayam (complete / whole) to be accepted; no maawam (blemish) shall be therein.

Iwarawan (blind), injured, charatz (maimed), having a wart, festering, or having a running sore, you shall not qarab (come close) these to Yahawah, nor nathan (give) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) by fire of them on the mazabach (altar) to Yahawah.

Either a shawar (bull) or a shah (lamb) that has any deformity or qalat (lacking) in his parts, that you may ishah (make) for a freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering); but for a nadar (vow) it shall not be ratzah (accepted).

That which has its testicles maik (bruised), kathath (crushed), nathaq (broken), or karath (cut), you shall not qarab (come close) to Yahawah; neither shall you ishah (make) thus in your aratz (Earth/land).

Neither shall you qarab (come close) the lacham (bread) of your Alahayam from the yad (hand) of a foreigner of any of these; because their mashachath (corruption) is in them. There is a maawam (blemish) in them. They shall not be ratzah (accepted) for you.'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"When a shawar (bull), or a sheep, or a iz (goat), is born, then it shall remain shabai (seven) yamayam (days) with its am (mother); and from the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) and thenceforth it shall be ratzah (accepted) for the qaraban (offering) of an qaraban (offering) made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire) to Yahawah.
Whether it is a shawar (cow) or shah (ewe), you shall not shachat (kill) it and its ban (son) both in achad (one) yawam (day).
"When you zabach (sacrifice) a zabach (sacrifice) of thanksgiving to Yahawah, you shall zabach (sacrifice) it so that you may be accepted.
It shall be akal (eat) on the same yawam (day); you shall yathar (leave) none of it until the baqar (morning). I am Yahawah.
"Therefore you shall shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments), and ishah (make) them. I am Yahawah.

You shall not chalal (profane) my qadash (set apart / make holy) sham (name), but I will be made qadash (set apart / make holy) thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). I am Yahawah who makes you qadash (set apart / make holy),
Who yatzaa (go out / come out) you out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), to be your Alahayam. I am Yahawah."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘The mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts of Yahawah, which you shall qaraa (called) to be qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraay (convocations), even these are my mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts.

"‘shash (six) yamayam (days) shall malaakah (work) be ishah (make): but on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) is a shabath (shabath / rest) of solemn shabathawan (rest), a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no kind of malaakah (work). It is a shabath (shabath / rest) to Yahawah in all your mawashab (dwellings).
"‘These are the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts of Yahawah, even qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraay (convocations), which you shall qaraa (called) in their mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season.
In the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the fourteenth irab (evening) of the month in the evening, is Yahawah pasach (passover).

On the fifteenth yawam (day) of the same chadash (month) is the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) to Yahawah. Shabai (seven) yamayam (days) you shall akal (eat) unleavened matzah (bread).
In the raashawan (first) yawam (day) you shall have a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation). You shall ishah (make) no regular malaakah (work).

But you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah shabai (seven) yamayam (days). In the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) is a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation): you shall ishah (make) no regular malaakah (work).'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘When you bawaa (come) come into the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) to you, and shall qatzar (reap) its the qatzayar (harvest), then you shall bawaa (come) the imar (sheaf) of the raashayath (beginning) fruits of your qatzayar (harvest) to the kahan (priest):
And he shall nawap (wave) the imar (sheaf) panayam (face) Yahawah, to be accepted for you. On the next macharath (day) after the shabath (shabath / rest) the kahan (priest) shall nawap (wave) it.
On the yawam (day) when you nawap (wave) the imar (sheaf), you shall ishah (make) a male kabash (lamb) thamayam (complete / whole) blemish a shanah (year) old for a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah.

The meal manachah (offering) with it shall be shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah of fine salath (flour) balal (mingled) with shaman (oil), an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah for a pleasant aroma; and the drink nasak (offering) with it shall be of yayan (wine), the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin).

You shall akal (eat) neither lacham (bread), nor roasted grain, nor fresh grain, until this same yawam (day), id (until / as far as) you bawaa (come) brought the qaraban (offering) of your Alahayam. This is a chaqah (statute) iwalam (forever) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period) in all your mawashab (dwellings).

"‘You shall sapar (book) from the next macharath (day) after the shabath (shabath / rest), from the macharath (day) that you bawaa (come) the imar (sheaf) of the wave thanawapah (offering); shabai (seven) shabathawath (sabbaths) shall be thamayam (complete / whole):

Even to the next macharath (day) after the shabayaiy (seventh) shabath (shabath / rest) you shall sapar (book) chamashayam (fifty) yawam (day); and you shall qarab (come close) a chadash (new) meal manachah (offering) to Yahawah.

You shall bawaa (come) out of your habitations shanayam (two) loaves of bread for a thanawapah (wave) offering made of shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah of fine salath (flour). They shall be apah (baked) with yeast, for bakawar (first) fruits to Yahawah.

You shall qarab (come close) with the lacham (bread) shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs) thamayam (complete / whole) blemish a shanah (year) old, achad (one) young par (bull), and shanayam (two) ayalam (rams). They shall be a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah, with their meal ilah (offering), and their drink ilah (offerings), even an manachah (offering) made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire), of a nayachawach (sweet) aroma to Yahawah.
You shall ishah (make) achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, and shanayam (two) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old for a zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings.

The kahan (priest) shall nawap (wave) them with the lacham (bread) of the bakawar (first) fruits for a wave thanawapah (offering) panayam (face) Yahawah, with the shanayam (two) kabashayam (lambs). They shall be qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah for the kahan (priest).

You shall make proclamation on the same yawam (day): there shall be a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation) to you; you shall ishah (make) no regular malaakah (work). This is a chaqah (statute) iwalam (forever) in all your mawashab (dwellings) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period).

"‘When you qatzar (reap) the qatzayar (harvest) of your aratz (Earth/land), you shall not kalah (complete / finish) qatzar (reap) into the paah (corners) of your shadah (field), neither shall you laqat (gather) the laqat (gleanings) of your qatzayar (harvest): you shall izab (leave) them for the inay (poor), and for the foreigner. I am Yahawah your Alahayam.'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), ‘In the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), shall be a solemn shabathawan (rest) to you, a zakarawan (memorial) of tharawaih (blowing) of trumpets, a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation).
You shall ishah (make) no regular malaakah (work); and you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah.'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"However on the ishawar (tenth) day of this shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) is the yawam (day) of kapar (atonement): it shall be a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation) to you, and you shall inah (oppress / afflict) yourselves; and you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah.
You shall ishah (make) no kind of malaakah (work) in that same yawam (day); for it is a yawam (day) of kapar (atonement), to make kapar (atonement) for you panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam.
For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same yawam (day); shall be karath (cut) off from his im (nation / people).
Whoever it is who ishah (make) any kind of malaakah (work) in that same yawam (day), that napash (soul) I will abad (destroy / perish) from qarab (among / near) his im (nation / people).
You shall ishah (make) no kind of malaakah (work): it is a chaqah (statute) iwalam (forever) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period) in all your mawashab (dwellings).

It shall be a shabath (shabath / rest) of solemn shabathawan (rest) for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the thashai (nine) day of the chadash (month) at irab (evening), from irab (evening) to irab (evening), you shall shabath (shabath / rest) your shabath (shabath / rest)."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke), ‘On the fifteenth yawam (day) of this shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) is the chag (feast/festival) of sakawath (tents) for shabai (seven) yamayam (days) to Yahawah.
On the raashawan (first) yawam (day) shall be a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation): you shall ishah (make) no regular malaakah (work).

Shabai (seven) yamayam (days) you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah. On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) shall be a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation) to you; and you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah. It is a solemn itzarah (assembly); you shall ishah (make) no regular malaakah (work).

"‘These are the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts of Yahawah, which you shall qaraa (called) to be qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraay (convocations), to qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah, a burnt ilah (offering), and a meal ilah (offering), a zabach (sacrifice), and drink manachah (offerings), each on its own yawam (day);

Besides the shabathath (sabbaths) of Yahawah, and besides your mathanah (gifts), and besides all your nadar (vow), and besides all your freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering), which you nathan (give) to Yahawah.

"‘So on the fifteenth yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), when you have asap (gathered) in the thabawaah (fruits) of the aratz (Earth/land), you shall chagag (keep) the chag (feast/festival) of Yahawah shabai (seven) yamayam (days): on the raashawan (first) yawam (day) shall be a solemn shabathawan (rest), and on the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) shall be a solemn shabathawan (rest).

You shall laqach (take / seize) on the raashawan (first) yawam (day) the paray (fruit) of hadar (glory / majesty / splendor) itz (trees), branches of thamar (palm) trees, and inap (boughs) of ibath (thick) itz (trees), and irabay (willows) of the nachal (stream / river); and you shall shamach (rejoice) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam shabai (seven) yamayam (days).

You shall chagag (keep) it a chag (feast/festival) to Yahawah shabai (seven) yamayam (days) in the shanah (year): it is a chaqah (statute) iwalam (forever) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period); you shall chagag (keep) it in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).
You shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in sakath (booths) shabai (seven) yamayam (days). All who are native-born in Yashar-Al (Israel) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in sakath (booths),

That your dawar (generation / age / period) may yadai (know) that I made the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in sakawath (booths), when I yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt). I am Yahawah your Alahayam.'"
Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts of Yahawah.
Yahawah spoke to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Tzawah (command) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that they laqach (take / seize) to you zak (pure) zayath (olive) shaman (oil) kathayath (beaten) for the maawar (Maawar / Luminary), to cause a nayar (lamp) to ilah (go up / offer) continually.

Outside of the parakath (veil) of the idawath (testimony), in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, shall Aharawan (Aaron) keep it in irak (order) from irab (evening) to baqar (morning) panayam (face) Yahawah continually: it shall be a chaqah (statute) iwalam (forever) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period).
He shall keep in irak (order) the narawath (lamps) on the tahawar (pure) gold lampstand panayam (face) Yahawah continually.
"You shall laqach (take / seize) fine salath (flour), and apah (bake) ishar (-teen) chalawath (cakes) of it: shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah shall be in achad (one) chalah (cake).
You shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) them in shanayam (two) mairakawath (rows), shash (six) on a mairakath (row), on the tahawar (pure) gold shalachan (table) panayam (face) Yahawah.

You shall nathan (give) zak (pure) labawanah (frankincense) on each mairakath (row), that it may be to the lacham (bread) for a azakarah (memorial), even an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah.

Every shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day) he shall set it in irak (order) panayam (face) Yahawah continually. It is on the behalf of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) an iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant).

It shall be for Aharawan (Aaron) and his ban (son); and they shall akal (eat) it in a qadawash (holy) maqawam (place): for it is most qadash (set apart / make holy) to him of the ashay (offerings) of Yahawah made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire) by a iwalam (forever) chaq (statute)."

The ban (son) of an Yasharaalayath (Israelite) ayashah (woman / wife), whose ban (son) was an Egyptian, yatzaa (go out / come out) out thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and the ban (son) of the Yasharaalayath (Israelite) woman and a ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel) natzah (strove) together in the machanah (camp).

The ban (son) of the Yasharaalayath (Israelite) ayashah (woman / wife) naqab (blasphemed) the sham (name), and qalal (cursed); and they bawaa (come) him to Mashah (Moses). His am (mother) sham (name) was Shalamayath (Shelomith), the banath (daughter) of Dabaray (Dibri), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Dan (Dan).
They yanach (put) him in custody, until the will of Yahawah should be parash (declared) to them.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the machanah (camp) him who qalal (cursed); and shamai (hearken / hear) all who heard him samak (lay) their yad (hand) on his raash (head), and let all the idah (congregation) ragam (stone) him.
You shall dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), ‘ayash (man / husband) kay (surely) his Alahayam shall nashaa (lift) his chataa (sin).

He who naqab (blasphemes) the sham (name) of Yahawah, he shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death); all the idah (congregation) shall ragam (certainly) ragam (stone) him: the foreigner as well as the native-born, when he naqab (blasphemes) the sham (name), shall be put to mawath (death).
"‘He who strikes any adam (man) mortally shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).
He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it shalam (good), napash (soul) for napash (soul).
If anyone injures his neighbor; as he ishah (make) done, so shall it be ishah (make) to him:
Fracture for fracture, iyan (eye) for iyan (eye), shan (tooth) for shan (tooth); as he nathan (give) injured someone, so shall it be nathan (give) to him.
He who nakah (kills) an animal shall make it shalam (good); and he who nakah (kills) a adam (man) shall be put to mawath (death).
You shall have achad (one) kind of mashapat (law), for the foreigner as well as the native-born: for I am Yahawah your Alahayam.'"

Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and they yatzaa (go out / come out) out him who had qalal (cursed) out of the machanah (camp), and ragam (stoned) him with yaragamaw (stones). The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘When you bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) you, then the aratz (Earth/land) shall shabath (shabath / rest) a shabath (shabath / rest) to Yahawah.
Shash (six) shanayam (years) you shall zarai (sow) your shadah (field), and shash (six) shanayam (years) you shall zamar (prune) your karam (vineyard), and asap (gather) in its thabawaah (fruits);

But in the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year) there shall be a shabath (shabath / rest) of solemn shabathawan (rest) for the aratz (Earth/land), a shabath (shabath / rest) to Yahawah. You shall not zarai (sow) your shadah (field) or zamar (prune) your karam (vineyard).

What sapayach (grows) of itself in your qatzayar (harvest) you shall not qatzar (reap), and the inabay (grapes) of your nazayar (Nazarite) vine you shall not batzar (gather). It shall be a shanah (year) of solemn shabathawan (rest) for the aratz (Earth/land).

The shabath (shabath / rest) of the aratz (Earth/land) shall be for akalah (food) for you; for yourself, for your ibad (servant), for your amah (maid), for your hired ibad (servant), and for your thawashab (stranger), who lives as a thawashab (foreigner) with you.
For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your aratz (Earth/land), shall all its thabawaah (increase) be for akal (eat).

"'You shall sapar (book) off shabai (seven) shabathath (sabbaths) of shanayam (years), shabai (seven) paimayam (times) shabai (seven) shanayam (years); and there shall be to you the yamay (days) of shabai (seven) shabathath (sabbaths) of shanayam (years), even forty - nine shanayam (years).

Then you shall ibar (pass over/through) the tharawaih (loud) shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) on the ishawar (tenth) day of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month). On the yawam (day) of kapar (atonement) you shall ibar (pass over/through) the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) throughout all your aratz (Earth/land).

You shall make the fiftieth shanah (year) qadash (set apart / make holy), and qaraa (called) darawar (liberty) throughout the aratz (Earth/land) to all its yashab (inhabit/dwell). It shall be a yawabal (jubilee) to you; and ayash (man / husband) of you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his own property, and ayash (man / husband) of you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

That fiftieth shanah (year) shall be a yawabal (jubilee) to you. In it you shall not zarai (sow), neither qatzar (reap) that which sapayach (grows) of itself, nor batzar (gather) from the nazayar (Nazarite) vines.
For it is a yawabal (jubilee); it shall be qadash (set apart / make holy) to you. You shall akal (eat) of its thabawaah (increase) out of the shadah (field).
"‘In this shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee) ayash (man / husband) of you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his property.
"‘If you makar (sell) anything to your neighbor, or qanah (buy) from your neighbor, you shall not wrong ayash (man / husband) ach (brother/kinsman).

According to the masapar (number) of shanayam (years) achar (other) the yawabal (jubilee) you shall qanah (buy) from your neighbor. According to the masapar (number) of shanayam (years) of the crops he shall makar (sell) to you.

Pah (according) to the length of the shanayam (years) you shall rabah (increase) its price, and pah (according) to the shortness of the shanayam (years) you shall mait (diminish) its price; for he is makar (selling) the masapar (number) of the crops to you.
You shall not wrong ayash (man / husband) imayath (another); but you shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) your Alahayam: for I am Yahawah your Alahayam.

"‘Therefore you shall ishah (make) my chaqah (statutes), and shamar (keep/guard) my mashapat (ordinances) and ishah (make) them; and you shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) in safety.
The aratz (Earth/land) shall nathan (give) its paray (fruit), and you shall akal (eat) your shabai (fill), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein in safety.
If you amar (spoke), "What shall we akal (eat) the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year)? Behold, we shall not zarai (sow), nor asap (gather) in our thabawaah (increase);"
Then I will tzawah (command) my barakah (blessing) on you in the shashay (sixth) shanah (year), and it shall ishah (make) forth thabawaah (fruit) for the shalawash (three) shanayam (years).

You shall zarai (sow) the shamayanay (eighth) shanah (year), and akal (eat) of the thabawaah (fruits), the yashan (old) store; until the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year), until its thabawaah (fruits) bawaa (come) in, you shall akal (eat) the yashan (old) store.
"‘The aratz (Earth/land) shall not be makar (sold) in perpetuity, for the aratz (Earth/land) is mine; for you are garayam (strangers) and live as thawashabayam (foreigners) with me.
In all the aratz (Earth/land) of your achazah (possession) you shall nathan (give) a gaalah (redemption) for the aratz (Earth/land).

"‘If your ach (brother/kinsman) becomes mawak (poor), and makar (sells) some of his achazah (possessions), then his kinsman who is next to him shall bawaa (come), and gaal (redeem) that which his ach (brother/kinsman) has mamakar (sold).
If a ayash (man / husband) has no one to gaal (redeem) it, and he becomes prosperous and matzaa (finds) sufficient means to redeem it;

Then let him chashab (reckon) the shanay (years) since its mamakar (sale), and shawab (turn back / repent) the surplus to the ayash (man / husband) to whom he makar (sold) it; and he shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his property.

But if he isn't day (able) to matzaa (get) it back for himself, then what he has mamakar (sold) shall remain in the yad (hand) of him who has bought it until the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee): and in the yawabal (jubilee) it shall be released, and he shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his property.

"‘If a ayash (man / husband) makar (sells) a mawashab (dwelling) bayath (house) in a chawamah (walled) iyar (city), then he may gaalah (redeem) it within a shanah (whole) shanah (year) after it has been mamakar (sold). For a yawam (day) year he shall have the right of gaalah (redemption).

If it isn't gaal (redeemed) within the malaa (space) of a thamayam (complete / whole) shanah (year), then the bayath (house) that is in the chawamah (walled) iyar (city) shall be qawam (rise up) sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his dawar (generation / age / period). It shall not be released in the yawabal (jubilee).

But the bathay (houses) of the chatzarayam (villages) which have no chawamah (wall) around them shall be chashab (reckoned) with the shadah (fields) of the aratz (Earth/land): they may be gaalah (redeemed), and they shall be released in the yawabal (jubilee).
"‘Nevertheless the iray (cities) of the Lawayay (Levites), the bathay (houses) in the iray (cities) of their achazah (possession), the Lawayay (Levites) may gaalah (redeem) at any iwalam (forever).

The Lawayay (Levites) may gaal (redeem) the bayath (house) that was mamakar (sold), and the iyar (city) of his achazah (possession), and it shall be released in the yawabal (jubilee); for the bathay (houses) of the iray (cities) of the Lawayay (Levites) are their achazah (possession) thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
But the shadah (field) of the magarash (suburbs) of their iyar (cities) may not be makar (sold); for it is their iwalam (forever) achazah (possession).

"‘If your ach (brother/kinsman) has become mawak (poor), and his mawat (hand) can't support him among you; then you shall uphold him. He shall chayah (live) with you like an gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) and a temporary resident.
Laqach (take / seize) no interest from him or profit, but yaraa (fear / be afraid) your Alahayam; that your ach (brother/kinsman) may chayah (live) among you.
You shall not nathan (give) him your kasap (money) at interest, nor nathan (give) him your akal (food) for profit.

I am Yahawah your Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), to nathan (give) you the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and to be your Alahayam.
"‘If your ach (brother/kinsman) has grown mawak (poor) among you, and makar (sells) himself to you; you shall not ibad (servant) him to ibadah (serve) as a ibad (servant).
As a hired shakayar (servant), and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall ibad (servant) with you until the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee):

Then he shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out from you, he and his ban (son) with him, and shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his own mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), and to the achazah (possession) of his ab (father).
For they are my ibad (servant), whom I yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt). They shall not be makar (sold) as ibad (servant).
You shall not radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) over him with harshness, but shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) your Alahayam.
"‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have; of the gawayam (nations) that are around you, from them you may qanah (buy) male and female amah (slaves).

Moreover of the banay (children) of the aliens who live among you, of them you may qanah (buy), and of their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) who are with you, which they have conceived in your aratz (Earth/land); and they will be your property.

You may make them an nachal (inheritance) for your banay (children) achar (other) you, to hold for a achazah (possession); of them may you take your thaibadaw (slaves) iwalam (forever): but over your ach (brother/kinsman) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) you shall not radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue), ayash (man / husband) over ach (brother/kinsman), with harshness.

"‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes nashag (rich), and your ach (brother/kinsman) beside him has grown mawak (poor), and makar (sells) himself to the gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) mashapachah (tribe / clan / family);
Achar (other) he is makar (sold) he may be redeemed. Achad (one) of his ach (brother/kinsman) may gaal (redeem) him;

Or his dawad (uncle), or his dawad (uncle's) ban (son), may gaal (redeem) him, or any who is a close relative to him of his mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) may gaal (redeem) him; or if he has grown nashag (rich), he may gaal (redeem) yad (hand).

He shall chashab (reckon) with him who bought him from the shanah (year) that he makar (sold) himself to him to the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee): and the kasap (price) of his mamakar (sale) shall be according to the masapar (number) of shanayam (years); according to the yawam (day) of a hired shakayar (servant) shall he be with him.

If there are yet many shanayam (years), pah (according) to them he shall shawab (turn back / repent) back the price of his gaalah (redemption) out of the kasap (money) that he was maqanah (bought) for.

If there shaar (remain) but a mait (few) shanayam (years) to the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee), then he shall chashab (reckon) with him; pah (according) to his shanayam (years) of service he shall shawab (turn back / repent) back the price of his gaalah (redemption).
As a shakayar (servant) hired shanah (year) by year shall he be with him: he shall not radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) with harshness over him in your iyan (eye).
If he isn't gaal (redeemed) by these means, then he shall be released in the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee), he, and his ban (son) with him.

For to me the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) are ibadayam (servants); they are my ibadayam (servants) whom I yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt). I am Yahawah your Alahayam.

"‘You shall ishah (make) for yourselves no alayalam (idols), neither shall you qawam (rise up) up an engraved pasal (image) or a matzabah (pillar), neither shall you nathan (give) any figured aban (stone) in your aratz (Earth/land), to shachah (bow) down to it: for I am Yahawah your Alahayam.
"‘You shall shamar (keep/guard) my shabath (shabath / rest), and have yaraa (fear / be afraid) for my maqadash (sanctuary). I am Yahawah.
"‘If you yalak (walk) in my chaqah (statutes), and shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments), and ishah (make) them;

Then I will nathan (give) you your gasham (rains) in their ith (season), and the aratz (Earth/land) shall nathan (give) its yabawal (increase), and the itz (trees) of the shadah (field) shall nathan (give) their paray (fruit).

Your dayash (threshing) shall nashag (reach) to the batzayar (vintage), and the batzayar (vintage) shall nashag (reach) to the zarai (sowing) time; and you shall akal (eat) your lacham (bread) to the shabai (full), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your aratz (Earth/land) safely.

"‘I will nathan (give) shalawam (peace / safety) in the aratz (Earth/land), and you shall shakab (lie) down, and no one will make you charad (afraid); and I will remove rai (evil) animals out of the aratz (Earth/land), neither shall the charab (sword) ibar (pass over/through) through your aratz (Earth/land).
You shall radap (chase) your ayab (enemy), and they shall napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (face) you by the charab (sword).

Chamash (five) of you shall radap (chase) a maah (hundred), and a maah (hundred) of you shall radap (chase) rababah (ten) thousand; and your ayab (enemy) shall napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (face) you by the charab (sword).
"‘I will have panah (turn) for you, and parah (make) you fruitful, and rabah (multiply) you, and will qawam (rise up) my barayath (covenant) with you.
You shall akal (eat) yashan (old) store long kept, and you shall move out the yashan (old) panayam (face) of the chadash (new).
I will nathan (give) my mashakan (tent) thawak (midst) you: and my napash (soul) won't gail (abhor) you.
I will halak (move) thawak (midst) you, and will be your Alahayam, and you will be my im (nation / people).

I am Yahawah your Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), that you should not be their ibadayam (slaves); and I have shabar (broken) the bars of your il (over), and yalak (made) you go qawamamayawath (upright).
"‘But if you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, and will not ishah (make) all these matzawath (commandments);

And if you shall maas (reject) my chaqah (statutes), and if your napash (soul) gail (abhors) my mashapat (ordinances), so that you will not ishah (make) all my matzawah (commandments), but parar (break) my barayath (covenant);

I also will ishah (make) this to you: I will paqad (visit) bahalah (terror) over you, even shachapath (consumption) and qadachath (fever), that shall kalah (complete / finish) the iyanayam (eyes), and make the napash (soul) to pine away; and you will zarai (sow) your zarai (seed) in rayaq (vain), for your ayab (enemy) will akal (eat) it.

I will nathan (give) my panayam (face) against you, and you will be nagap (struck) panayam (face) your ayab (enemy). Those who shanaa (hate) you will radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) over you; and you will nawas (flee) when no one radap (pursues) you.
"‘If you in spite of these things will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, then I will yasar (chastise) you shabai (seven) times more for your chataah (sin).
I will shabar (break) the gaawan (pride) of your iz (strength / might / refuge), and I will nathan (give) your sky like barazal (iron), and your soil like nachawashah (brass);

And your kach (strength / mighty / power) will be thamam (spent) in rayaq (vain); for your aratz (Earth/land) won't nathan (give) its yabawal (increase), neither will the itz (trees) of the aratz (Earth/land) nathan (give) their paray (fruit).

"‘If you yalak (walk) qaray (contrary) to me, and won't shamai (hearken / hear) to me, then I abah (be willing / desire) yasap (bring) shabai (seven) times more makah (plagues) on you according to your chataah (sin).

I will shalach (send) the shadah (wild) animals among you, which will shakal (rob) you of your children, karath (cut) your livestock, and mait (make) you few in number; and your roads will become shamam (desolate).
"‘If by these things you won't be yasar (reformed) to me, but will halak (move) qaray (contrary) to me;
Then I will also halak (move) qaray (contrary) to you; and I will nakah (strike) you, even I, shabai (seven) times for your chataah (sin).

I will bawaa (come) a charab (sword) upon you, that will execute the naqam (vengeance) of the barayath (covenant); and you will be asap (gathered) together al (toward) your iyar (cities): and I will shalach (send) the dabar (word / matter) thawak (midst) you; and you will be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the ayab (enemy).

When I shabar (break) your matah (staff / rod / tribe) of lacham (bread), ishar (ten) nashayam (women) shall apah (bake) your lacham (bread) in achad (one) thanawar (oven), and they shall shawab (turn back / repent) your lacham (bread) again by mashaqal (weight): and you shall akal (eat), and not be shabai (satisfied).
"‘If you in spite of zaath (this) won't shamai (hearken / hear) to me, but halak (move) qaray (contrary) to me;
Then I will halak (move) qaray (contrary) to you in chamah (wrath); and I also will yasar (chastise) you shabai (seven) times for your chataah (sin).
You will akal (eat) the bashar (flesh) of your ban (son), and you will akal (eat) the bashar (flesh) of your banath (daughter).

I will shamad (destroy) your bamah (high) places, and karath (cut) down your incense chaman (altars), and nathan (give) your pagar (dead) bodies upon the pagaray (bodies) of your galawal (idols); and my napash (soul) will gail (abhor) you.

I will nathan (give) your iyar (cities) charabah (waste), and will shamam (bring) your maqadash (sanctuaries) to desolation, and I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your nayachawach (offerings).
I will shamam (bring) the aratz (Earth/land) into desolation; and your ayab (enemy) that yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein will be shamam (astonished) at it.

I will zarah (scatter) you among the gawayam (nations), and I will rawaq (draw) out the charab (sword) achar (other) you: and your aratz (Earth/land) will be a shamamah (desolation), and your iyar (cities) shall be a charabah (waste).

Then the aratz (Earth/land) will ratzah (enjoy) its shabath (shabath / rest) as yawam (day) as it shamam (lies) desolate and you are in your ayab (enemy)' aratz (Earth/land). Even then the aratz (Earth/land) will shabath (shabath / rest) and ratzah (enjoy) its shabath (shabath / rest).
As yawam (day) as it shamam (lies) desolate it shall have shabath (shabath / rest), even the shabath (shabath / rest) which it didn't have in your shabath (shabath / rest), when you lived on it.

"‘As for those of you who are shaar (left), I will bawaa (come) a marak (faintness) into their labab (hearts) in the aratzath (lands) of their ayab (enemy): and the qawal (sound / voice) of a nadap (driven) ilah (leaf) will radap (put) them to flight; and they shall nawas (flee), as one nasaw (flees) from the charab (sword); and they will napal (fall / be cast down) when no one radap (pursues).

They will kashal (stumble / stagger) over ayash (man / husband) ach (brother/kinsman), as it were panayam (face) the charab (sword), when no one radap (pursues): and you will have no thaqawamah (power) to stand panayam (face) your ayab (enemy).
You will abad (destroy / perish) among the gawayam (nations), and the aratz (Earth/land) of your ayab (enemy) will akal (eat) you up.

Those of you who are shaar (left) will maqaq (pine) away in their iwan (guilt/iniquity) in your ayab (enemy)' aratzath (lands); and also in the iwanath (iniquities) of their ab (father) shall they maqaq (pine) away with them.

"‘If they yadah (confess) their iwan (guilt/iniquity), and the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of their ab (father), in their mail (top/above) which they mail (top/above) against me, and also that, because they halak (move) qaray (contrary) to me,

I also yalak (walked) qaray (contrary) to them, and bawaa (come) them into the aratz (Earth/land) of their ayab (enemy): if then their iral (uncircumcised) labab (heart) is kanai (humbled), and they then ratzah (accept) the punishment of their iwan (guilt/iniquity);

Then I will zakar (remember) my barayath (covenant) with Yaiqab (Jacob); and also my barayath (covenant) with Yatzachaq (Isaac), and also my barayath (covenant) with Abaraham (Abraham); and I will zakar (remember) the aratz (Earth/land).

The aratz (Earth/land) also will be izab (left) by them, and will ratzah (enjoy) its shabath (shabath / rest) while it shamam (lies) desolate without them: and they will ratzah (accept) the punishment of their iwan (guilt/iniquity); yain (because), even yain (because) they maas (rejected) my mashapat (ordinances), and their napash (soul) gail (abhorred) my chaqah (statutes).

Yet for all that, when they are in the aratz (Earth/land) of their ayab (enemy), I will not maas (reject) them, neither will I gail (abhor) them, to kalah (complete / finish) them utterly, and to parar (break) my barayath (covenant) with them; for I am Yahawah their Alahayam;

But I will for their sake zakar (remember) the barayath (covenant) of their raashanayam (ancestors), whom I yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) in the iyan (eye) of the gawayam (nations), that I might be their Alahayam. I am Yahawah.'"

These are the chaqayam (statutes), mashapatayam (ordinances) and thawarath (laws), which Yahawah nathan (give) between him and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai) by Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) to them, ‘When a ayash (man / husband) palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) a nadar (vow), the napashath (persons) shall be for Yahawah by your valuation.

Your valuation shall be of a zakar (remember) from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) even to shashayam (sixty) shanah (years) ban (son), even your valuation shall be chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels) of kasap (silver), after the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy).
If it is a naqabah (female), then your valuation shall be shalawashayam (thirty) shaqal (shekels).

If the person is from chamash (five) shanayam (years) ban (son) even to isharayam (twenty) shanayam (years) ban (son), then your valuation shall be for a zakar (remember) isharayam (twenty) shaqalayam (shekels), and for a naqabah (female) ishar (ten) shaqalayam (shekels).

If the person is from a chadash (month) ban (son) even to chamash (five) shanayam (years) ban (son), then your valuation shall be for a zakar (remember) chamash (five) shaqalayam (shekels) of kasap (silver), and for a naqabah (female) your valuation shall be shalawash (three) shaqalayam (shekels) of kasap (silver).

If the person is from shashayam (sixty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward; if it is a zakar (remember), then your valuation shall be chamash (fifteen) shaqalayam (shekels), and for a naqabah (female) ishar (ten) shaqalayam (shekels).

But if he is mawak (poorer) than your valuation, then he shall be imad (set) panayam (face) the kahan (priest), and the kahan (priest) shall irak (value) him; pah (according) to the ability of him who nadar (make vow) shall the kahan (priest) irak (value) him.
"‘If it is an animal, of which men qarab (come close) an qaraban (offering) to Yahawah, all that any man nathan (give) of such to Yahawah becomes qadash (set apart / make holy).

He shall not chalap (alter) it, nor mawar (change) it, a tawab (good / proper function) for a rai (bad), or a rai (bad) for a tawab (good / proper function): and if he shall at mawar (all) mawar (change) animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is thamawarah (changed) shall be qadash (set apart / make holy).
If it is any tamaa (unclean) animal, of which they do not qarab (come close) as an qaraban (offering) to Yahawah, then he shall imad (set) the animal panayam (face) the kahan (priest);
And the kahan (priest) shall irak (value) it, bayan (between) it is tawab (good / proper function) or rai (bad). As you the kahan (priest) values it, so shall it be.
But if he will indeed gaal (redeem) it, then he shall yasap (add) the chamayashay (fifth) part of it to its valuation.

"‘When a ayash (man / husband) qadash (set apart / make holy) his bayath (house) to be qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah, then the kahan (priest) shall evaluate it, whether it is tawab (good / proper function) or rai (bad): as the kahan (priest) shall evaluate it, so shall it qawam (rise up).

If he who qadash (set apart / make holy) it will gaal (redeem) his bayath (house), then he shall yasap (add) the chamayashay (fifth) part of the kasap (money) of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

"‘If a ayash (man / husband) qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah part of the shadah (field) of his achazah (possession), then your valuation shall be pah (according) to the zarai (seed) for it: the zarai (sowing) of a chamar (homer) of shairah (barley) shall be valued at chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels) of kasap (silver).
If he qadash (set apart / make holy) his shadah (field) from the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee), according to your valuation it shall qawam (rise up).

But if he qadash (set apart / make holy) his shadah (field) achar (other) the yawabal (jubilee), then the kahan (priest) shall chashab (reckon) to him the kasap (money) pah (according) to the shanayam (years) that yathar (remain) to the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee); and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

If he who qadash (set apart / make holy) the shadah (field) will indeed gaal (redeem) it, then he shall yasap (add) the chamayashay (fifth) part of the kasap (money) of your valuation to it, and it shall qawam (rise up) his.
If he will not gaal (redeem) the shadah (field), or if he has makar (sold) the shadah (field) to achar (other) ayash (man / husband), it shall not be gaal (redeemed) any more;

But the shadah (field), when it yatzaa (go out / come out) out in the yawabal (jubilee), shall be qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah, as a shadah (field) charam (devoted); it shall be owned by the kahan (priest).
"‘If he qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah a shadah (field) which he has maqanah (bought), which is not of the shadah (field) of his achazah (possession),

Then the kahan (priest) shall chashab (reckon) to him the makasah (worth) of your valuation up to the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee); and he shall nathan (give) your valuation on that yawam (day), as a qadash (set apart / make holy) thing to Yahawah.

In the shanah (year) of yawabal (jubilee) the shadah (field) shall shawab (turn back / repent) to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the achazah (possession) of the aratz (Earth/land) belongs.
All your valuations shall be according to the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy): isharayam (twenty) garah (gerahs) to the shaqal (shekel).

"‘Only the bakawar (firstborn) among animals, which is bakar (made) a firstborn to Yahawah, no ayash (man / husband) may qadash (set apart / make holy) it; whether an shawar (ox) or shah (sheep), it is Yahawah.

If it is an tamaa (unclean) animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall yasap (add) to it the chamayashay (fifth) gaal (part) of it: or if it isn't redeemed, then it shall be makar (sold) according to your valuation.

"‘Notwithstanding, no charam (devoted) thing, that a ayash (man / husband) shall charam (devote) to Yahawah of all that he has, whether of adam (man) or animal, or of the shadah (field) of his achazah (possession), shall be makar (sold) or gaal (redeemed): every charam (devoted) thing is most qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah.
"‘No one charam (devoted), who shall be charam (devoted) from among adam (men), shall be padah (ransomed); he shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).

"‘All the maishar (tithe) of the aratz (Earth/land), whether of the zarai (seed) of the aratz (Earth/land) or of the paray (fruit) of the itz (trees), is Yahawah. It is qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah.
If a ayash (man / husband) gaal (redeems) anything of his maishar (tithe), he shall yasap (add) a chamayashay (fifth) part to it.
All the maishar (tithe) of the baqar (morning) or the tzaan (flocks), whatever passes under the shabat (rod), the ishayaray (tenth) shall be qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah.

He shall not baqar (morning) whether it is tawab (good / proper function) or rai (bad), neither shall he mawar (change) it: and if he mawar (changes) it at mawar (all), then both it and that for which it is thamawarah (changed) shall be qadash (set apart / make holy). It shall not be gaal (redeemed).'"
These are the matzawath (commandments) which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) on har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai).

Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai), in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, on the achad (one) day of the shanay (second) chadash (month), in the shanay (second) shanah (year) yatzaa (go out / come out) they had come out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), amar (spoke),

"Nashaa (lift) a census of all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamawath (names), every zakar (remember), one by one;

From isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who are yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop) in Yashar-Al (Israel). You and Aharawan (Aaron) shall paqad (visit) them by their divisions.
With you there shall be a ayash (man / husband) of ayash (man / husband) matah (staff / rod / tribe); everyone raash (head) of his ab (father)' bayath (house).
These are the shamawath (names) of the anashayam (men) who shall imad (stand) with you: Of Raawaban (Reuben): Alayatzawar (Elizur) the ban (son) of Shadayaawar (Shedeur).
Of Shamaiwan (Simeon): Shalamayaal (Shelumiel) the ban (son) of Tzawarayashaday (Zurishaddai).
Of Yahawadah (Judah): Nachashawan (Nahshon) the ban (son) of Imayanadab (Amminadab).
Of Yashashakar (Issachar): Nathanaal (Nethanel) the ban (son) of Tzawair (Zuar).
Of Zabawalawan (Zebulun): Alayaab (Eliab) the ban (son) of Chalan (Helon).

Of the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph): Of Aparayam (Ephraim): Alayashamai (Elishama) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud). Of Manashah (Manasseh): Gamalayaal (Gamaliel) the ban (son) of Padahatzawar (Pedahzur).
Of Banayamayan (Benjamin): Abay-Dan (Abidan) the ban (son) of Gadainay (Gideoni).
Of Dan (Dan): Achayaizar (Ahiezer) the ban (son) of Imayashaday (Ammishaddai).
Of Ashar (Asher): Pagaiyaal (Pagiel) the ban (son) of Ikaran (Ochran).
Of Gad (Gad): Alayasap (Eliasaph) the ban (son) of Daiwaal (Deuel).
Of Napathalay (Naphtali): Achayarai (Ahira) the ban (son) of Iyanan (Enan)."

These are those who were called of the idah (congregation), the nashayaay (princes) of the matawath (tribes) of their ab (father); they were the raashay (heads) of the alapay (thousands) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) laqach (take / seize) these anashayam (men) who are mentioned by sham (name).

They qahal (assembled) all the idah (congregation) together on the achad (one) day of the shanay (second) chadash (month); and they yalad (birth / begot) their ancestry by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamawath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, one by one.
As Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses), so he paqad (visit) them in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai).

The banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), Yashar-Al (Israel's) bakawar (firstborn), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamawath (names), one by one, every zakar (remember) from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), were arabaiyam (forty) - shash (six) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), those who were paqad (visit) of it, according to the masapar (number) of the shamawath (names), one by one, every zakar (remember) from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), were chamashayam (fifty) - thashai (nine) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamawath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), were arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty).

Of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), were shabaiyam (seventy) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Yashashakar (Issachar), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), were chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), were chamashayam (fifty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph), of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Aparayam (Ephraim), were arabaiyam (forty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamawath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), were shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), were shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Dan (Dan), were shashayam (sixty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), were arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

Of the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali), their thawaladah (generation), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), according to the masapar (number) of the shamath (names), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop);
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), were chamashayam (fifty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

These are those who were paqad (visit), whom Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) paqad (visit), and the nashayaay (princes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), being ishar (-teen) ayash (man / husband): they were ayash (man / husband) achad (one) for his ab (father)' bayath (house).

So paqad (visit) those who were numbered of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) by their ab (father)' bayath (house), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, all who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go out to tzabaa (troop) in Yashar-Al (Israel);
Even paqad (visit) those who were numbered were shash (six) maah (hundred) shalawash (three) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty).
But the Lawayay (Levites) after the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of their ab (father) were not paqad (visit) thawak (midst) them.
For Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"Only the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Laway (Levi) you shall not paqad (visit), neither shall you nashaa (lift) a census of them thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel);

But paqad (visit) the Lawayay (Levites) over the mashakan (tabernacle) of the idawath (testimony), and over all its kalay (furnishings), and over all that belongs to it. They shall nashaa (lift) the mashakan (tabernacle), and all its kalay (furnishings); and they shall take care of it, and shall chanah (encamp) around it.

When the mashakan (tabernacle) is to move, the Lawayay (Levites) shall yarad (take) it down; and when the mashakan (tabernacle) is to be set up, the Lawayay (Levites) shall qawam (rise up) it up. The stranger who yawarayadaw (comes) near shall be put to mawath (death).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall pitch their chanaw (tents), every ayash (man / husband) by his own machanah (camp), and every ayash (man / husband) by his own dagal (standard), according to their divisions.

But the Lawayay (Levites) shall chanah (encamp) around the mashakan (tabernacle) of the idawath (testimony), that there may be no qatzap (wrath) on the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): and the Lawayay (Levites) shall be responsible for the mashakan (tabernacle) of the idawath (testimony)."
Thus the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make). According to all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses), so they ishah (make).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) and to Aharawan (Aaron), amar (spoke),

"The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall chanah (encamp) every ayash (man / husband) by his own dagal (standard), with the banners of their ab (father)' bayath (house): at a distance from the ahal (tent) of Meeting shall they chanah (encamp) around it."

Those who chanah (encamp) on the qadam (east) side toward the sunrise shall be of the dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of Yahawadah (Judah), according to their divisions: and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) shall be Nachashawan (Nahshon) the ban (son) of Imayanadab (Amminadab).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were seventy-four alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

Those who chanah (encamp) next to him shall be the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Yashashakar (Issachar) shall be Nathanaal (Nethanel) the ban (son) of Tzawair (Zuar).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of it, were chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).
The matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) shall be Alayaab (Eliab) the ban (son) of Chalan (Helon).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of it, were chamashayam (fifty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

Paqad (visit) who were numbered of the machanah (camp) of Yahawadah (Judah) were one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - shash (six) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred), according to their divisions. They shall nasai (set) out raashawan (first).

"On the thayaman (south) side shall be the dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of Raawaban (Reuben) according to their divisions. The nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) shall be Alayatzawar (Elizur) the ban (son) of Shadayaawar (Shedeur).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of it, were arabaiyam (forty) - shash (six) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

"Those who chanah (encamp) next to him shall be the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Shamaiwan (Simeon). The nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) shall be Shalamayaal (Shelumiel) the ban (son) of Tzawarayashaday (Zurishaddai).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were chamashayam (fifty) - thashai (nine) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred).
"The matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) shall be Alayasap (Eliasaph) the ban (son) of Raiwaal (Reuel).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty).

"Paqad (visit) who were numbered of the machanah (camp) of Raawaban (Reuben) were achad (one) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - achad (one) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty), according to their tzabaa (troop). They shall nasai (set) out shanay (second).

"Then the ahal (tent) of Meeting shall nasai (set) out, with the machanah (camp) of the Lawayay (Levites) in the thawak (midst) of the machanath (camps). As they chanah (encamp), so shall they nasai (set) out, every ayash (man / husband) in his place, by their dagal (standards).

"On the yam (sea/waters) side shall be the dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to their divisions: and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim) shall be Alayashamai (Elishama) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were arabaiyam (forty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

"Next to him shall be the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) shall be Gamalayaal (Gamaliel) the ban (son) of Padahatzawar (Pedahzur).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were shalawashayam (thirty) - two alap (thousand) shanayam (two) maah (hundred).
"The matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) shall be Abay-Dan (Abidan) the ban (son) of Gadainay (Gideoni).
His tzabaa (troop), and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five) thirty-five alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

"Paqad (visit) who were numbered of the machanah (camp) of Aparayam (Ephraim) were one maah (hundred) shamanah (eight) alap (thousand) one maah (hundred), according to their divisions. They shall nasai (set) out shalayashay (third).

"On the tzapawan (north) side shall be the dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of Dan (Dan) according to their divisions: and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan) shall be Achayaizar (Ahiezer) the ban (son) of Imayashaday (Ammishaddai).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were shashayam (sixty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred).

"Those who chanah (encamp) next to him shall be the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher) shall be Pagaiyaal (Pagiel) the ban (son) of Ikaran (Ochran).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) alap (thousand) and chamash (five) maah (hundred).
"The matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali): and the nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali) shall be Achayarai (Ahira) the ban (son) of Iyanan (Enan).
His division, and those who were paqad (visit) of them, were chamashayam (fifty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

"Paqad (visit) who were numbered of the machanah (camp) of Dan (Dan) were one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred). They shall nasai (set) out acharawan (last) by their dagal (standards)."

These are those who were paqad (visit) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) by their ab (father)' bayath (house). Paqad (visit) who were numbered of the machanath (camps) according to their tzabaa (troop) were shash (six) maah (hundred) shalawash (three) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty).
But the Lawayay (Levites) were not paqad (visit) thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

Thus the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make). According to all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses), so they chanah (encamped) by their dagal (standards), and so they nasai (set) out, everyone by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), according to their ab (father)' bayath (house).

Now this is the history of the thawaladath (generations) of Aharawan (Aaron) and Mashah (Moses) in the yawam (day) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) with Mashah (Moses) in har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai).
These are the shamawath (names) of the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron): Nadab (Nadab) the bakawar (firstborn), and Abayahawaa (Abihu), Alaizar (Eleazar), and Ayathamar (Ithamar).
These are the shamawath (names) of the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron), the kahanayam (priests) who were mashach (anointed), whom he malaa (consecrated) to kahan (priest) in the priest's office.

Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu) mawath (death) panayam (face) Yahawah, when they qarab (come close) zawar (strange) ash (fire) panayam (face) Yahawah, in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai), and they had no banayam (children). Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar) ministered in the kahan (priest) office in the panayam (face) of Aharawan (Aaron) their ab (father).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Qarab (come close) the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Laway (Levi) qarab (come close), and imad (set) them panayam (face) Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), that they may sharath (minister) to him.

They shall shamar (keep/guard) his requirements, and the requirements of the whole idah (congregation) panayam (face) the ahal (tent) of Meeting, to ibad (servant) the ibadah (service) of the mashakan (tabernacle).

They shall shamar (keep/guard) all the kalay (furnishings) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and the obligations of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to ibad (servant) the ibadah (service) of the mashakan (tabernacle).
You shall nathan (give) the Lawayay (Levites) to Aharawan (Aaron) and to his banay (sons). They are wholly nathan (give) to him on the behalf of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
You shall paqad (visit) Aharawan (Aaron) and his ban (son), and they shall shamar (keep/guard) their kahanah (priesthood). The stranger who ban (son) near shall be put to mawath (death)."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Behold, I have laqach (take / seize) the Lawayay (Levites) from thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) instead of all the bakawar (firstborn) who patar (open) the racham (womb) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and the Lawayay (Levites) shall be mine:

For all the bakawar (firstborn) are mine. On the yawam (day) that I nakah (struck) down all the bakawar (firstborn) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) I made qadash (set apart / make holy) to me all the bakawar (firstborn) in Yashar-Al (Israel), both adam (man) and animal. They shall be mine. I am Yahawah."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai), amar (spoke),

"Paqad (visit) the banay (children) of Laway (Levi) by their ab (father)' bayath (house), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family). You shall paqad (visit) every zakar (remember) from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward."
Mashah (Moses) paqad (visit) them according to the pah (word) of Yahawah, as he was tzawah (commanded).
These were the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi) by their sham (name): Garashawan (Gershon), and Qahath (Kohath), and Mararay (Merari).
These are the shamawath (names) of the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon) by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): Labanay (Libni) and Shamaiy (Shimei).
The banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): Imaram (Amram), and Yatzahar (Izhar), Chabarawan (Hebron), and Izayaal (Uzziel).

The banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari) by their mashapachath (families): Machalay (Mahli) and Mawashay (Mushi). These are the mashapachath (families) of the Lawayay (Levites) according to their ab (father)' bayath (house).

Of Garashawan (Gershon) was the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the labanay (libnites), and the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Shimeites: these are the mashapachath (families) of the garashanay (gershonites).

Those who were paqad (visit) of them, according to the masapar (number) of all the zakar (remember), from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward, even those who were paqad (visit) of them were shabai (seven) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).
The mashapachath (families) of the garashanay (gershonites) shall chanah (encamp) achar (other) the mashakan (tabernacle) westward.
The nashayaa (prince) of the ab (father)' bayath (house) of the garashanay (gershonites) shall be Alayasap (Eliasaph) the ban (son) of Laal (Lael).

The duty of the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting shall be the ahal (tabernacle), and the mashakan (tent), its ahal (covering), and the screen for the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting,

And the qalaiy (hangings) of the chatzar (court), and the screen for the pathach (door) of the chatzar (court), which is by the mashakan (tabernacle), and around the mazabach (altar), and its mayathar (cords) for all of its ibadah (service).
