Of Qahath (Kohath) was the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the imaramay (amramites), and the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yatzaharay (izharites), and the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chabarawanay (hebronites), and the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the izayaalay (uzzielites): these are the mashapachath (families) of the Qahathay (Kohathites).

According to the masapar (number) of all the zakar (remember), from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward, there were shamanah (eight) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred), shamar (keep/guard) the requirements of the qadash (set apart / make holy).
The mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) shall chanah (encamp) on the thayaman (south) yarak (side) of the mashakan (tabernacle).
The nashayaa (prince) of the ab (father)' bayath (house) of the mashapachath (families) of the Qahathay (Kohathites) shall be Alayatzapan (Elizaphan) the ban (son) of Izayaal (Uzziel).

Their duty shall be the arawan (ark), the shalachan (table), the manawarah (lamp) stand, the mazabachath (altars), the kalay (vessels) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) with which they sharath (minister), and the screen, and all its ibadah (service).

Alaizar (Eleazar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) shall be nashayaa (prince) of the nashayaay (princes) of the Lawayay (Levites), with the paqadah (oversight) of those who shamar (keep/guard) the requirements of the qadash (set apart / make holy).

Of Mararay (Merari) was the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the machalay (mahlites), and the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the mawashay (mushites). These are the mashapachath (families) of Mararay (Merari).
Those who were paqad (visit) of them, according to the masapar (number) of all the zakar (remember), from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward, were shash (six) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred).

The nashayaa (prince) of the ab (father)' bayath (house) of the mashapachath (families) of Mararay (Merari) was Tzawarayaal (Zuriel) the ban (son) of Abayahayal (Abihail). They shall chanah (encamp) on the tzapawan (north) yarak (side) of the mashakan (tabernacle).

The appointed duty of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari) shall be the mashakan (tabernacle's) qarashay (boards), its barayach (bars), its imawad (pillar), its adan (sockets), all its kalay (instruments), all its ibadah (service),
The imaday (pillars) of the chatzar (court) around it, their adan (sockets), their yathad (pins), and their mayathar (cords).

Those who chanah (encamp) panayam (face) the mashakan (tabernacle) eastward, in panayam (face) of the mashakan (tent) of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Mashah (Moses), and Aharawan (Aaron) and his banay (sons), shamar (keep/guard) the requirements of the maqadash (sanctuary) for the duty of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). The stranger who banay (comes) near shall be put to mawath (death).
All who were numbered of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the commandment of Yahweh, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty - two thousand.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "paqad (visit) all the bakawar (firstborn) zakar (remember) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward, and nashaa (lift) the masapar (number) of their sham (name).

You shall laqach (take / seize) the Lawayay (Levites) for me (I am Yahawah) instead of all the bakawar (firstborn) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and the livestock of the Lawayay (Levites) instead of all the bakawar (firstborn) among the livestock of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)."
Mashah (Moses) paqad (visit), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) him, all the bakawar (firstborn) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

All the bakawar (firstborn) zakar (remember) according to the masapar (number) of shamawath (names), from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward, of those who were paqad (visit) of them, were isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - three.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Laqach (take / seize) the Lawayay (Levites) instead of all the bakawar (firstborn) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the livestock of the Lawayay (Levites) instead of their livestock; and the Lawayay (Levites) shall be mine. I am Yahawah.
For the padaway (redemption) of the two maah (hundred) seventy - three of the ban (son) of the children of Yashar-Al (Israel), who exceed the number of the Lawayay (Levites),

You shall laqach (take / seize) chamash (five) shaqalayam (shekels) apiece for each galagalath (one); after the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) you shall laqach (take / seize) them (the shaqal (shekel) is isharayam (twenty) garah (gerahs)):
And you shall nathan (give) the kasap (money), with which their remainder is padaway (redeemed), to Aharawan (Aaron) and to his ban (son)."
Mashah (Moses) laqach (take / seize) the padayawam (redemption) kasap (money) from those who exceeded the number of those who were padaway (redeemed) by the Lawayay (Levites);

From the bakawar (firstborn) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) he laqach (take / seize) the kasap (money), one alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - chamash (five) shaqal (shekels), after the shekel of the qadash (set apart / make holy):
And Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) the padaway (redemption) kasap (money) to Aharawan (Aaron) and to his ban (son), according to the pah (word) of Yahawah, as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) and to Aharawan (Aaron), amar (spoke),

"Nashaa (lift) a census of the banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) from thawak (midst) the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house),

From shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward even until chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son), all who bawaa (come) into the tzabaa (troop), to ishah (make) the malaakah (work) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting.
"This is the ibadah (service) of the banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, the most qadash (set apart / make holy) things.

When the machanah (camp) moves nasai (forward), Aharawan (Aaron) shall bawaa (come) in, and his ban (son), and they shall yarad (take) down the parakath (veil) of the screen, and kasah (cover) the arawan (ark) of the idawath (testimony) with it,

And shall nathan (give) a kasaway (covering) of sealskin on it, and shall parash (spread) over it a bagad (cloth) kalayal (all) of thakalath (blue), and shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) in its poles.

"On the shalachan (table) of show panayam (face) they shall parash (spread) a thakalath (blue) bagad (cloth), and nathan (give) on it the dishes, the kapath (spoons), the manaqayath (bowls), and the qashawath (cups) with which to pour out; and the thamayad (continual) lacham (bread) shall be on it.
They shall parash (spread) on them a thawalai (scarlet) bagad (cloth), and kasah (cover) the same with a makasah (covering) of sealskin, and shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) in its poles.

"They shall laqach (take / seize) a thakalath (blue) bagad (cloth), and kasah (cover) the lampstand of the maawar (Maawar / Luminary), and its nayar (lamps), and its malaqach (snuffers), and its snuff dishes, and all its shaman (oil) kalay (vessels), with which they sharath (minister) to it.
They shall nathan (give) it and all its kalay (vessels) within a makasah (covering) of sealskin, and shall nathan (give) it on the frame.

"On the zahab (gold) mazabach (altar) they shall parash (spread) a thakalath (blue) bagad (cloth), and kasah (cover) it with a makasah (covering) of sealskin, and shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) in its poles.

"They shall laqach (take / seize) all the kalay (vessels) of sharath (ministry), with which they sharath (minister) in the qadash (set apart / make holy), and nathan (give) them in a thakalath (blue) bagad (cloth), and kasah (cover) them with a makasah (covering) of sealskin, and shall nathan (give) them on the frame.
"They shall dashan (take) away the ashes from the mazabach (altar), and parash (spread) a aragaman (purple) bagad (cloth) on it.

They shall nathan (give) on it all its kalay (vessels), with which they sharath (minister) about it, the machathah (fire) pans, the flesh hooks, the yaiyam (shovels), and the basins; all the kalay (vessels) of the mazabach (altar); and they shall parash (spread) on it a kasaway (covering) of sealskin, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) in its poles.

"When Aharawan (Aaron) and his banay (sons) kalah (complete / finish) finished kasah (covering) the qadash (set apart / make holy), and all the kalay (furniture) of the qadash (set apart / make holy), as the machanah (camp) moves nasai (forward); achar (other) that, the banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) shall bawaa (come) to nashaa (lift) it: but they shall not nagai (touch) the qadash (set apart / make holy), lest they mawath (death). These things are the mashaa (burden) of the banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting.

"The duty of Alaizar (Eleazar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) shall be the shaman (oil) for the maawar (Maawar / Luminary), the sam (sweet) qatarath (incense), the thamayad (continual) meal manachah (offering), and the mashachah (anointing) shaman (oil), the requirements of all the mashakan (tabernacle), and of all that is in it, the qadash (set apart / make holy), and its kalay (furnishings)."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) and to Aharawan (Aaron), amar (spoke),
"Don't karath (cut) off the shabat (tribe) of the mashapachath (families) of the Qahathay (Kohathites) from thawak (midst) the Lawayay (Levites);

But thus ishah (make) to them, that they may chayah (live), and not mawath (death), when they nagash (approach) to the most qadash (set apart / make holy) things: Aharawan (Aaron) and his ban (son) shall bawaa (come) in, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them everyone to his ibadah (service) and to his mashaa (burden);
But they shall not bawaa (come) in to raah (see) the qadash (set apart / make holy) even for a moment, lest they mawath (death)."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"Nashaa (lift) a census of the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon) also, by their ab (father)' bayath (house), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family);

You shall paqad (visit) them from shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward until chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son); all who bawaa (come) in to tzabaa (troop) on the tzabaa (troop), to ibad (servant) the ibadah (work) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting.
"This is the ibadah (service) of the mashapachath (families) of the garashanay (gershonites), in serving and in bearing mashaa (burdens):

They shall nashaa (lift) the yarayaith (curtains) of the mashakan (tabernacle), and the mashakan (tent) of Meeting, its makasah (covering), and the makasah (covering) of sealskin that is mail (top/above) on it, and the screen for the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting,

And the qalaiy (hangings) of the chatzar (court), and the screen for the pathach (door) of the shair (gate) of the chatzar (court), which is by the mashakan (tabernacle) and around the mazabach (altar), and their mayathar (cords), and all the kalay (instruments) of their ibadah (service), and whatever shall be ishah (make) with them. Therein shall they ibad (servant).

At the commandment of Aharawan (Aaron) and his banay (sons) shall be all the ibadah (service) of the banay (sons) of the garashanay (gershonites), in all their mashaa (burden), and in all their ibadah (service); and you shall paqad (visit) their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

This is the ibadah (service) of the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of the garashanay (gershonites) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting: and their duty shall be under the yad (hand) of Ayathamar (Ithamar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest).
"As for the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), you shall paqad (visit) them by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house);

You shall paqad (visit) them from shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward even to chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son), everyone who bawaa (come) on the tzabaa (troop), to ibad (servant) the ibadah (work) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting.

This is the duty of their mashaa (burden), according to all their ibadah (service) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting: the ahal (tabernacle's) qarashay (boards), its barayach (bars), its imawad (pillar), its adan (sockets),

And the imawaday (pillars) of the chatzar (court) around it, and their adan (sockets), and their yathad (pins), and their mayathar (cords), with all their kalay (instruments), and with all their ibadah (service): and by sham (name) you shall paqad (visit) the kalay (instruments) of the duty of their mashaa (burden).

This is the ibadah (service) of the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), according to all their ibadah (service), in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, under the yad (hand) of Ayathamar (Ithamar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest)."

Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) and the nashayaay (princes) of the idah (congregation) paqad (visit) the banay (sons) of the Qahathay (Kohathites) by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), and by their ab (father)' bayath (house),

From shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward even to chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son), everyone who bawaa (come) into the tzabaa (troop), for ibadah (work) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting.
Those who were paqad (visit) of them by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) were two alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty).

These are those who were paqad (visit) of the mashapachath (families) of the Qahathay (Kohathites), all who ibad (servant) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, whom Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) paqad (visit) pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).
Those who were paqad (visit) of the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon), their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), and by their ab (father)' bayath (house),

From shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward even to chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son), everyone who bawaa (come) into the tzabaa (troop), for ibadah (work) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting,

Even those who were paqad (visit) of them, by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), by their ab (father)' bayath (house), were two alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).

These are those who were paqad (visit) of the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon), all who ibad (servant) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, whom Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) paqad (visit) pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah.
Those who were paqad (visit) of the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), by their mashapachath (families), by their ab (father)' bayath (house),

From shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward even to chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son), everyone who bawaa (come) into the tzabaa (troop), for ibadah (work) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting,
Even those who were paqad (visit) of them by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), were shalawash (three) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred).

These are those who were paqad (visit) of the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), whom Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) paqad (visit) pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).

Paqad (visit) those who were numbered of the Lawayay (Levites), whom Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) and the nashayaay (princes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) paqad (visit), by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), and by their ab (father)' bayath (house),

From shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward even to chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) ban (son), everyone who bawaa (come) in to ibad (servant) the ibadah (work) of ibadah (service), and the work of bearing mashaa (burdens) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting,
Even those who were paqad (visit) of them, were shamanah (eight) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty).

Pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah they were paqad (visit) by Mashah (Moses), everyone according to his ibadah (service), and according to his mashaa (burden). Thus were they paqad (visit) by him, as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Tzawah (command) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) that they shalach (send) out of the machanah (camp) every tzarai (leper), and everyone who zawab (flow) an issue, and whoever is tamaa (unclean) by the napash (soul).

Both you shall shalach (send) zakar (remember) and naqabah (female) outside of the machanah (camp); that they not tamaa (defile) their machanah (camp), in the thawak (midst) of which I shakan (place)."

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) so, and shalach (send) them out outside of the machanah (camp); as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), so ishah (make) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): ‘When a ayash (man / husband) or ayashah (woman / wife) yaishaw (commits) any chataah (sin) that adam (men) ishah (make), so as to mail (top/above) against Yahawah, and that napash (soul) is asham (guilty);

Then he shall yadah (confess) his chataah (sin) which he ishah (make) done, and he shall shawab (turn back / repent) restitution for his asham (guilt) in full, and yasap (add) to it the chamayashay (fifth) part of it, and nathan (give) it to him in respect of whom he has been asham (guilty).

But if the ayash (man / husband) has no gaal (kinsman) to whom restitution may be made for the asham (guilt), the restitution for asham (guilt) which is made to Yahawah shall be the kahan (priest); besides the ayal (ram) of the kapar (atonement), by which kapar (atonement) shall be made for him.
Every heave tharawamah (offering) of all the qadash (set apart / make holy) things of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), which they qarab (come close) to the kahan (priest), shall be his.
Every ayash (man / husband) qadash (set apart / make holy) things shall be his: whatever any ayash (man / husband) nathan (give) the kahan (priest), it shall be his.'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them: ‘If any ayash (man / husband) ayashah (woman / wife) shatah (goes) astray, and is unfaithful to him,

And a ayash (man / husband) shakab (lies) with her shakabah (carnally), and it is ilam (hidden) from the iyanay (eyes) of her ayash (man / husband), and is sathar (kept) close, and she is tamaa (defiled), and there is no id (until / as far as) against her, and she isn't thapash (taken) in the act;

And the rawach (spirit / wind) of qanaah (jealousy) ibar (pass over/through) on him, and he is qanaa (jealous) of his ayashah (woman / wife), and she is tamaa (defiled): or if the rawach (spirit / wind) of qanaah (jealousy) ibar (pass over/through) on him, and he is qanaa (jealous) of his ayashah (woman / wife), and she isn't tamaa (defiled):

Then the ayash (man / husband) shall bawaa (come) his ayashah (woman / wife) to the kahan (priest), and shall bawaa (come) her qaraban (offering) for her: the ishayaray (tenth) part of an ayapah (ephah) of shairah (barley) qamach (meal). He shall yatzaq (pour) no shaman (oil) on it, nor nathan (give) labawanah (frankincense) on it, for it is a meal manachah (offering) of qanaah (jealousy), a meal manachah (offering) of zakarawan (memorial), zakar (remember) iwan (guilt/iniquity) to memory.
The kahan (priest) shall qarab (come close) her near, and imad (set) her panayam (face) Yahawah;

And the kahan (priest) shall laqach (take / seize) qadawash (holy) mayam (Waters) in an charash (earthen) kalay (vessel); and of the ipar (dust) that is on the qaraqai (floor) of the mashakan (tabernacle) the kahan (priest) shall laqach (take / seize), and nathan (give) it into the mayam (Waters).

The kahan (priest) shall imad (set) the ayashah (woman / wife) panayam (face) Yahawah, and let the hair of the ayashah (woman / wife) raash (head) parai (go) loose, and nathan (give) the meal manachah (offering) of zakarawan (memorial) in her kap (hands), which is the meal manachah (offering) of qanaah (jealousy). The kahan (priest) shall have in his yad (hand) the mayam (Waters) of bitterness that brings a arar (curse).

The kahan (priest) shall cause her to shabai (swear / take oath), and shall amar (spoke) the ayashah (woman / wife), "If no ayash (man / husband) has shakab (lain) with you, and if you haven't shatah (gone) aside to tamaah (uncleanness), being under your ayash (man / husband), be naqah (clean/innocent) from this mayam (Waters) of bitterness that brings a arar (curse).

But if you have shatah (gone) astray, being under your ayash (man / husband), and if you are tamaa (defiled), and some ayash (man / husband) nathan (give) shakabath (lain) with you balaiday (besides) your ayash (man / husband):"

Then the kahan (priest) shall shabai (swear / take oath) the ayashah (woman / wife) to shabawaih (swear) with the oath of alah (curse / oath), and the kahan (priest) shall amar (spoke) the ayashah (woman / wife), "Yahawah nathan (give) you a alah (curse / oath) and an shabawaih (oath) thawak (midst) your im (nation / people), when Yahawah allows your yarak (thigh) to napal (fall / be cast down) away, and your batan (body) to tzabah (swell);

And this mayam (Waters) that brings a arar (curse) will bawaa (come) into your maih (bowels), and make your batan (body) tzabah (swell), and your yarak (thigh) napal (fall / be cast down) away." The ayashah (woman / wife) shall amar (spoke), "aman (believe / have faith), aman (believe / have faith)."
"‘The kahan (priest) shall kathab (write) these alath (curses) in a sapar (book / scribed document), and he shall machah (blot) them out into the mayam (Waters) of bitterness.

He shall make the ayashah (woman / wife) shaqah (drink) the mayam (Waters) of bitterness that causes the arar (curse); and the mayam (Waters) that causes the arar (curse) shall bawaa (come) into her and become mar (bitter).

The kahan (priest) shall laqach (take / seize) the meal manachah (offering) of qanaah (jealousy) out of the ayashah (woman / wife) yad (hand), and shall nawap (wave) the meal manachah (offering) panayam (face) Yahawah, and qarab (come close) it to the mazabach (altar).

The kahan (priest) shall qamatz (take) a handful of the meal manachah (offering), as its azakarah (memorial), and qatar (burn) it on the mazabach (altar), and afterward shall make the ayashah (woman / wife) shaqah (drink) the mayam (Waters).

When he has shaqah (made) her drink the mayam (Waters), then it shall happen, if she is tamaa (defiled), and has mail (top/above) a mail (top/above) against her ayash (man / husband), that the mayam (Waters) that causes the arar (curse) will bawaa (come) into her and become mar (bitter), and her batan (body) will tzabah (swell), and her yarak (thigh) will napal (fall / be cast down) away: and the ayashah (woman / wife) will be a alah (curse / oath) qarab (among / near) her im (nation / people).
If the ayashah (woman / wife) isn't tamaa (defiled), but is tahawar (clean); then she shall be naqah (clean/innocent), and shall zarai (conceive) zarai (seed).
"‘This is the thawarah (instruction) of qanaah (jealousy), when a ayashah (woman / wife), being under her ayash (man / husband), shatah (goes) astray, and is tamaa (defiled);

Or when the rawach (spirit / wind) of qanaah (jealousy) ibar (pass over/through) on a ayash (man / husband), and he is qanaa (jealous) of his ayashah (woman / wife); then he shall imad (set) the ayashah (woman / wife) panayam (face) Yahawah, and the kahan (priest) shall ishah (make) on her all this thawarah (instruction).
The ayash (man / husband) shall be naqah (clean/innocent) from iwan (guilt/iniquity), and that ayashah (woman / wife) shall nashaa (lift) her iwan (guilt/iniquity).'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them: ‘When either ayash (man / husband) or ayashah (woman / wife) shall palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) a special nadar (make vow), the nadar (make vow) of a Nazirite, to nazar (crown / consecrate) himself to Yahawah,

He shall nazar (crown / consecrate) himself from yayan (wine) and shakar (strong) drink. He shall shathah (drinks) no chamatz (vinegar) of yayan (wine), or chamatz (vinegar) of fermented shakar (drink), neither shall he shathah (drinks) any juice of inabayam (grapes), nor akal (eat) fresh inabayam (grapes) or yabash (dry land).
All the yamay (days) of his nazar (crown / consecrate) he shall akal (eat) nothing that is ishah (make) of the grapevine, from the charatzanayam (seeds) even to the skins.

"‘All the yamay (days) of his nadar (vow) of nazar (crown / consecrate) no thair (razor) shall ibar (pass over/through) on his raash (head), until the yamay (days) are malaa (fulfilled), in which he nazar (crown / consecrate) himself to Yahawah. He shall be qadawash (holy). He shall let the parai (freegrowing locks) of the shair (hair) of his raash (head) gadal (grow) long.
"‘All the yamay (days) that he nazar (crown / consecrate) himself to Yahawah he shall not bawaa (come) near a mawath (death) napash (soul).

He shall not make himself tamaa (unclean) for his ab (father), or for his am (mother), for his ach (brother/kinsman), or for his achawath (sister), when they mawath (death); because his nazar (crown / consecrate) to Alahayam is on his raash (head).
All the yamay (days) of his nazar (crown / consecrate) he is qadawash (holy) to Yahawah.

"‘If any mawath (death) mawath (death) very pathaawam (suddenly) beside him, and he defiles the raash (head) of his nazar (crown / consecrate); then he shall galach (shave) his raash (head) in the yawam (day) of his taharah (cleansing). On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) he shall galach (shave) it.

On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) he shall bawaa (come) shanayam (two) turtledoves or shanayam (two) ban (son) yawanah (pigeons) to the kahan (priest), to the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting.

The kahan (priest) shall ishah (make) achad (one) for a chataah (sin) offering, and the other for a burnt ilah (offering), and make kapar (atonement) for him, ashar (who/that) he chataa (sinned) by reason of the napash (soul), and shall make his raash (head) qadash (set apart / make holy) that same yawam (day).

He shall nazar (crown / consecrate) to Yahawah the yamay (days) of his nazar (crown / consecrate), and shall bawaa (come) a male kabash (lamb) a shanah (year) old for a asham (trespass) offering; but the raashawan (former) yamay (days) shall be void, because his nazar (crown / consecrate) was tamaa (defiled).

"‘This is the thawarah (instruction) of the Nazirite: when the yamay (days) of his nazar (crown / consecrate) are malaa (fulfilled), he shall be bawaa (come) to the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting,

And he shall qarab (come close) his qaraban (offering) to Yahawah, achad (one) male kabash (lamb) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish for a burnt ilah (offering), and achad (one) ewe kabashah (lamb) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish for a chataah (sin) offering, and achad (one) ayal (ram) thamayam (complete / whole) blemish for shalam (peace) offerings,

And a sal (basket) of unleavened matzah (bread), chalath (cakes) of fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), and unleavened raqayaqay (wafers) mashach (anointed) with shaman (oil), and their meal manachah (offering), and their drink nasak (offerings).
The kahan (priest) shall qarab (come close) them panayam (face) Yahawah, and shall qarab (come close) his chataah (sin) offering, and his burnt chataah (sin).

He shall ishah (make) the ayal (ram) for a zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings to Yahawah, with the sal (basket) of unleavened matzah (bread). The kahan (priest) shall ishah (make) also its meal manachah (offering), and its drink nasak (offering).

The Nazirite shall galach (shave) the raash (head) of his nazar (crown / consecrate) at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and shall laqach (take / seize) the shair (hair) of the raash (head) of his nazar (crown / consecrate), and nathan (give) it on the ash (fire) which is under the zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings.

The kahan (priest) shall laqach (take / seize) the boiled zarawai (shoulder) of the ayal (ram), and achad (one) unleavened chalah (cake) out of the sal (basket), and achad (one) unleavened raqayaq (wafer), and shall nathan (give) them on the kapay (hands) of the Nazirite, achar (other) he has galach (shaved) the head of his nazar (crown / consecrate);

And the kahan (priest) shall nawap (wave) them for a wave thanawapah (offering) panayam (face) Yahawah. This is qadash (set apart / make holy) for the kahan (priest), together with the chazah (breast) that is thanawapah (waved) and the shawaq (thigh) that is tharawamah (offered). Achar (other) that the Nazirite may shathah (drinks) yayan (wine).

"‘This is the thawarah (instruction) of the Nazirite who nadar (make vow), and of his qaraban (offering) to Yahawah for his nazar (crown / consecrate), yad (hand) that which he is able to nashag (get). Pah (according) to his nadar (vow) which he nadar (vow), so he must ishah (make) after the thawarah (instruction) of his nazar (crown / consecrate).'"
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to Aharawan (Aaron) and to his banay (sons), amar (spoke), ‘kah (this) is how you shall barak (blessed) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).' You shall amar (spoke) them,
‘Yahawah barak (blessed) you, and shamar (keep/guard) you.
Yahawah make his panayam (face) to awar (light) on you, and be gracious to you.
Yahawah nashaa (lift) up his panayam (face) toward you, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) you shalawam (peace / safety).'
"So they shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) on the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and I will barak (blessed) them."

It happened on the yawam (day) that Mashah (Moses) had finished qawam (rise up) up the mashakan (tabernacle), and had mashach (anointed) it and qadash (set apart / make holy) it, with all its kalay (furniture), and the mazabach (altar) with all its kalay (vessels), and had mashach (anointed) and qadash (set apart / make holy) them;

That the nashayaay (princes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), the raashay (heads) of their ab (father)' bayath (house), qarab (come close). These were the nashayaay (princes) of the matath (tribes). These are they who were over those who were paqad (visit):

And they bawaa (come) their qaraban (offering) panayam (face) Yahawah, shash (six) tzab (covered) igalath (wagons), and ishar (-teen) oxen; a igalah (wagon) for every shanayam (two) of the nashaayam (princes), and for achad (one) one an shawar (ox): and they qarab (come close) them panayam (face) the mashakan (tabernacle).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Laqach (take / seize) these from them, that they may be used in ibad (servant) the ibadah (service) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting; and you shall nathan (give) them to the Lawayay (Levites), to every ayash (man / husband) pah (according) to his ibadah (service)."
Mashah (Moses) laqach (take / seize) the igalath (wagons) and the oxen, and nathan (give) them to the Lawayay (Levites).
He nathan (give) shanayam (two) igalath (wagons) and arabai (four) oxen to the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon), pah (according) to their ibadah (service):

And he nathan (give) arabai (four) igalath (wagons) and shamanah (eight) oxen to the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), pah (according) to their ibadah (service), under the direction of Ayathamar (Ithamar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest).

But to the banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath) he nathan (give) laa (NOT), because the ibadah (service) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) belonged to them; they nashaa (lift) it on their kathap (shoulders).

The nashaayam (princes) gave yaqarayabaw (offerings) for the chanakah (dedication) of the mazabach (altar) in the yawam (day) that it was mashach (anointed), even the nashaayam (princes) gave their qaraban (offerings) panayam (face) the mazabach (altar).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "They shall qarab (come close) their qaraban (offering), achad (one) nashayaa (prince) on his yawam (day), for the chanakah (dedication) of the mazabach (altar)."

He who qarab (come close) his qaraban (offering) the raashawan (first) yawam (day) was Nachashawan (Nahshon) the ban (son) of Imayanadab (Amminadab), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah),

And his qaraban (offering) was: achad (one) kasap (silver) platter, the mashaqal (weight) of which was one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shekels, achad (one) kasap (silver) mazaraq (bowl) of shabaiyam (seventy) shaqal (shekels), after the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy); shanayam (two) of them malaa (full) of fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil) for a meal manachah (offering);
Achad (one) zahab (gold) ladle of ishar (ten) shekels, malaa (full) of qatarath (incense);
Achad (one) young par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), achad (one) male kabash (lamb) a shanah (year) old, for a burnt ilah (offering);
Achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering;

And for the zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings, shanayam (two) baqar (morning) of cattle, chamash (five) ayalam (rams), chamash (five) male ithawadayam (goats), and chamash (five) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old. This was the qaraban (offering) of Nachashawan (Nahshon) the ban (son) of Imayanadab (Amminadab).
On the shanay (second) yawam (day) Nathanaal (Nethanel) the ban (son) of Tzawair (Zuar), nashayaa (prince) of Yashashakar (Issachar), gave his qarab (come close).

He qarab (come close) for his qaraban (offering): achad (one) kasap (silver) platter, the mashaqal (weight) of which was one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shekels, achad (one) kasap (silver) mazaraq (bowl) of shabaiyam (seventy) shaqal (shekels), after the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy); shanayam (two) of them malaa (full) of fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil) for a meal manachah (offering);
Achad (one) zahab (gold) ladle of ishar (ten) shekels, malaa (full) of qatarath (incense);
Achad (one) young par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), achad (one) male kabash (lamb) a shanah (year) old, for a burnt ilah (offering);
Achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering;

And for the zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings, shanayam (two) baqar (morning) of cattle, chamash (five) ayalam (rams), chamash (five) male ithawadayam (goats), chamash (five) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old. This was the qaraban (offering) of Nathanaal (Nethanel) the ban (son) of Tzawair (Zuar).
On the shalayashay (third) yawam (day) Alayaab (Eliab) the ban (son) of Chalan (Helon), nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun)

Gave his qaraban (offering): achad (one) kasap (silver) platter, the mashaqal (weight) of which was a maah (hundred) and shalawashayam (thirty) shekels, achad (one) kasap (silver) mazaraq (bowl) of shabaiyam (seventy) shaqal (shekels), after the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy); shanayam (two) of them malaa (full) of fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil) for a meal manachah (offering);
Achad (one) zahab (gold) ladle of ishar (ten) shekels, malaa (full) of qatarath (incense);

Achad (one) kasap (silver) platter weighing one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shekels, and achad (one) mazaraq (bowl) shabaiyam (seventy); all the kasap (silver) of the kalayam (vessels) two alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred) shaqal (shekels), after the shekel of the qadash (set apart / make holy);

The ishar (-teen) zahab (gold) ladles, malaa (full) of qatarath (incense), weighing ishar (ten) shekels apiece, after the shaqal (shekel) of the qadash (set apart / make holy); all the zahab (gold) of the ladles weighed one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) shekels;

All the cattle for the burnt ilah (offering) shanayam (two) parayam (bulls), the ayalam (rams) shanayam (two), the male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old shanayam (two), and their meal manachah (offering); and the male izayam (goats) for a chataah (sin) offering shanayam (two);

And all the cattle for the zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) parayam (bulls), the ayalam (rams) shashayam (sixty), the male ithadayam (goats) shashayam (sixty), the male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old shashayam (sixty). This was the chanakah (dedication) of the mazabach (altar), achar (other) it was mashach (anointed).

When Mashah (Moses) bawaa (come) into the ahal (tent) of Meeting to dabar (word / matter) with Yahawah, he heard his qawal (sound / voice) dabar (word / matter) to him from above the kaparath (mercy) seat that was on the arawan (ark) of the idawath (testimony), from between the shanayam (two) karawab (cherubim): and he dabar (word / matter) to him.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to Aharawan (Aaron), and amar (spoke) him, ‘When you ilah (go up / offer) the narath (lamps), the shabai (seven) narath (lamps) shall give awar (light) in panayam (face) of the lampstand.'"
Aharawan (Aaron) ishah (make) so. He ilah (go up / offer) its nayar (lamps) to light the area in mawal (front) of the lampstand, as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

This was the workmanship of the lampstand, maqashah (beaten) maishah (work) of zahab (gold). From its base to its parach (flowers), it was beaten maqashah (work): according to the maraah (pattern) which Yahawah raah (see) shown Mashah (Moses), so he ishah (make) the lampstand.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"Laqach (take / seize) the Lawayay (Levites) from thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and tahar (cleanse) them.

You shall ishah (make) this to them, to tahar (cleanse) them: nazah (sprinkle) the mayam (Waters) of cleansing on them, let them thair (razor) their whole bashar (flesh) with a razor, and let them kabas (wash) their clothes, and tahar (cleanse) themselves.

Then let them laqach (take / seize) a ban (son) par (bull), and its meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil); and shanay (second) ban (son) par (bull) you shall laqach (take / seize) for a chataah (sin) offering.

You shall qarab (come close) the Lawayay (Levites) panayam (face) the ahal (tent) of Meeting. You shall qahal (assemble) the whole mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
You shall qarab (come close) the Lawayay (Levites) panayam (face) Yahawah. The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall samak (lay) their yad (hand) on the Lawayay (Levites),

And Aharawan (Aaron) shall nawap (offer) the Lawayay (Levites) panayam (face) Yahawah for a wave thanawapah (offering), on the behalf of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that it may be theirs to ibad (servant) the ibadah (service) of Yahawah.

"The Lawayay (Levites) shall samak (lay) their yad (hand) on the raash (head) of the parayam (bulls), and you shall ishah (make) the achad (one) for a chataah (sin) offering, and the other for a burnt chataah (sin) to Yahawah, to make kapar (atonement) for the Lawayay (Levites).
You shall imad (set) the Lawayay (Levites) panayam (face) Aharawan (Aaron), and panayam (face) his ban (son), and nawap (offer) them as a wave thanawapah (offering) to Yahawah.
Thus you shall badal (separated) the Lawayay (Levites) from thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the Lawayay (Levites) shall be mine.

"Achar (other) that, the Lawayay (Levites) shall bawaa (come) in to ibad (servant) the service of the ahal (tent) of Meeting: and you shall tahar (cleanse) them, and nawap (offer) them as a wave thanawapah (offering).

For they are wholly nathan (give) to me from thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); instead of all who patar (open) the racham (womb), even the bakawar (firstborn) of all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), I have laqach (take / seize) them to me.

For all the bakawar (firstborn) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) are mine, both adam (man) and animal. On the yawam (day) that I nakah (struck) all the bakawar (firstborn) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), I qadash (set apart / make holy) them for myself.
I have laqach (take / seize) the Lawayay (Levites) instead of all the bakawar (firstborn) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

I nathan (give) given the Lawayay (Levites) as a nathan (give) to Aharawan (Aaron) and to his banay (sons) from thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to ibad (servant) the ibadah (service) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and to make kapar (atonement) for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); that there be no nagap (plague) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), when the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nagash (come) near to the qadash (set apart / make holy)."

Mashah (Moses), and Aharawan (Aaron), and all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) so to the Lawayay (Levites). According to all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) concerning the Lawayay (Levites), so the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) to them.

The Lawayay (Levites) chataa (purified) themselves from sin, and they kabas (washed) their clothes; and Aharawan (Aaron) nawap (offered) them for a wave thanawapah (offering) panayam (face) Yahawah; and Aharawan (Aaron) made kapar (atonement) for them to tahar (cleanse) them.

Achar (other) that, the Lawayay (Levites) bawaa (come) in to ibad (servant) their ibadah (service) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting panayam (face) Aharawan (Aaron), and panayam (face) his ban (son): as Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) concerning the Lawayay (Levites), so they ishah (make) to them.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"This is that which belongs to the Lawayay (Levites): from isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward they shall bawaa (come) in to tzabaa (troop) on the ibadah (service) in the work of the ahal (tent) of Meeting;
And from the ban (son) of chamashayam (fifty) shanah (years) they shall shawab (turn back / repent) tzabaa (troop) on the ibadah (work), and shall ibad (servant) no more,

But shall sharath (minister) with their ach (brother/kinsman) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall ibad (servant) no ibadah (service). You shall ibad (servant) thus to the Lawayay (Levites) concerning their duties."

Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai), in the raashawan (first) chadash (month) of the shanay (second) shanah (year) yatzaa (go out / come out) they had come out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), amar (spoke),
"Moreover let the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) the pasach (passover) in its mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season.

On the fourteenth yawam (day) of this chadash (month), at irab (evening), you shall ishah (make) it in its mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season—according to all its chaqah (statutes), and according to all its mashapat (ordinances), you shall ishah (make) it."
Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that they should ishah (make) the pasach (passover).

They ishah (make) the pasach (passover) in the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the fourteenth yawam (day) of the month, at irab (evening), in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai). According to all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses), so the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make).

There were ayash (man / husband) men, who were tamaa (unclean) because of the napash (soul) body of a adam (man), so that they yakal (could) not ishah (make) the pasach (passover) on that yawam (day), and they qarab (come close) panayam (face) Mashah (Moses) and panayam (face) Aharawan (Aaron) on that yawam (day).

Ham (they / them) anashayam (men) amar (spoke) to him, "We are tamaa (unclean) because of the napash (soul) body of a adam (man). Why are we garai (kept) back, that we may not qarab (come close) the qaraban (offering) of Yahawah in its mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?"
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) them, "Wait, that I may shamai (hearken / hear) what Yahawah will tzawah (command) concerning you."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), ‘If any ayash (man / husband) of you or of your dawar (generation / age / period) is tamaa (unclean) by reason of a napash (soul) body, or is on a darak (journey) rachawaq (far) away, he shall still ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah.
In the shanay (second) chadash (month), on the fourteenth yawam (day) at irab (evening) they shall ishah (make) it; they shall akal (eat) it with unleavened matzah (bread) and marar (bitter) herbs.
They shall shaar (leave) none of it until the baqar (morning), nor shabar (break) a itzam (bone) of it. According to all the chaqah (statute) of the pasach (passover) they shall ishah (make) it.

But the ayash (man / husband) who is tahawar (clean), and is not on a darak (journey), and fails to ishah (make) the pasach (passover), that napash (soul) shall be karath (cut) off from his im (nation / people). Because he didn't qarab (come close) the qaraban (offering) of Yahawah in its mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season, that ayash (man / husband) shall nashaa (lift) his chataa (sin).

"‘If a foreigner lives among you, and desires to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah; according to the chaqah (statute) of the pasach (passover), and according to its chaqah (ordinance), so shall he ishah (make). You shall have achad (one) chaqah (statute), both for the foreigner, and for him who is azarach (born) in the aratz (Earth/land).'"

On the yawam (day) that the mashakan (tabernacle) was qawam (rise up) up, the inan (cloud) kasah (covered) the mashakan (tabernacle), even the mashakan (tent) of the idawath (testimony): and at irab (evening) it was over the mashakan (tabernacle) as it were the maraah (appearance) of ash (fire), until baqar (morning).
So it was continually. The inan (cloud) kasah (covered) it, and the maraah (appearance) of ash (fire) by layal (night).

Whenever the inan (cloud) was ilah (go up / offer) up from over the ahal (tent), then achar (other) that the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) traveled; and in the maqawam (place) where the inan (cloud) shakan (place), there the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chanah (encamped).

At the commandment of Yahawah, the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) traveled, and at the commandment of Yahawah they chanah (encamped). As yawam (day) as the inan (cloud) shakan (place) on the mashakan (tabernacle) they remained chanah (encamped).
When the inan (cloud) stayed on the mashakan (tabernacle) many yamayam (days), then the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shamar (keep/guard) Yahawah command, and didn't travel.

Sometimes the inan (cloud) was a masapar (few) yamayam (days) on the mashakan (tabernacle); then pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah they remained chanah (encamped), and pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah they traveled.

Sometimes the inan (cloud) was from irab (evening) until baqar (morning); and when the inan (cloud) was ilah (go up / offer) up in the baqar (morning), they traveled: or by yawamam (by day) and by layal (night), when the inan (cloud) was ilah (go up / offer) up, they traveled.

Whether it was yawam (day) days, or a chadash (month), or a yawam (day) that the inan (cloud) stayed on the mashakan (tabernacle), shakan (place) on it, the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) remained chanah (encamped), and didn't travel; but when it was ilah (go up / offer) up, they traveled.
At the commandment of Yahawah they chanah (encamped), and at the commandment of Yahawah they traveled. They shamar (keep/guard) Yahawah command, at the commandment of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Ishah (make) shanayam (two) chatzawatzarath (trumpets) of kasap (silver). You shall ishah (make) them of beaten maqashah (work). You shall use them for the maqaraa (calling) of the idah (congregation), and for the masai (journeying) of the machanawath (camps).
When they thaqai (blow / sound alarm) them, all the idah (congregation) shall yaid (gather) themselves to you at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting.
If they thaqai (blow / sound alarm) just achad (one), then the nashayaayam (princes), the raashay (heads) of the alapay (thousands) of Yashar-Al (Israel), shall yaid (gather) themselves to you.
When you thaqai (blow / sound alarm) an tharawaih (alarm), the machanawath (camps) that chanah (lie) on the qadam (east) side shall nasai (go) forward.

When you thaqai (blow / sound alarm) an tharawaih (alarm) the shanay (second) time, the machanawath (camps) that chanah (lie) on the thayaman (south) side shall nasai (go) forward. They shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm) an tharawaih (alarm) for their nasaiw (journeys).
But when the qahal (assembly) is to be qahal (gathered) together, you shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm), but you shall not rawai (sound) an alarm.

"The banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron), the kahanayam (priests), shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the chatzatzarawath (trumpets). This shall be to you for a chaqah (statute) iwalam (forever) throughout your dawar (generation / age / period).

When you bawaa (come) to malachamah (war) in your aratz (Earth/land) against the tzarar (adversary) who oppresses you, then you shall rawai (sound) an alarm with the chatzatzarawath (trumpets). Then you will be zakar (remember) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam, and you will be yashai (salvation) from your ayab (enemy).

"Also in the yawam (day) of your shamachah (gladness), and in your mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, and in the raashay (beginnings) of your chadash (month), you shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the chatzatzarath (trumpets) over your burnt ilah (offerings), and over the zabachay (sacrifices) of your shalam (peace) offerings; and they shall be to you for a zakarawan (memorial) panayam (face) your Alahayam. I am Yahawah your Alahayam."

It happened in the shanay (second) shanah (year), in the shanay (second) chadash (month), on the isharayam (twenty) day of the month, that the inan (cloud) was ilah (go up / offer) up from over the mashakan (tabernacle) of the idawath (testimony).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nasai (went) forward according to their masai (journeys) out of the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai); and the inan (cloud) stayed in the madabar (wilderness) of Paaran (Paran).
They raashawan (first) nasai (went) forward pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).

Raashawan (first), the dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) nasai (went) forward according to their tzabaa (troop). Nachashawan (Nahshon) the ban (son) of Imayanadab (Amminadab) was over his army.
Nathanaal (Nethanel) the ban (son) of Tzawair (Zuar) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yashashakar (Issachar).
Alayaab (Eliab) the ban (son) of Chalan (Helon) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun).

The mashakan (tabernacle) was yarad (taken) down; and the banay (sons) of Garashawan (Gershon) and the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), who nashaa (lift) the mashakan (tabernacle), nasai (went) forward.

The dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of Raawaban (Reuben) nasai (went) forward according to their tzabaa (troop). Alayatzawar (Elizur) the ban (son) of Shadayaawar (Shedeur) was over his tzabaa (troop).
Shalamayaal (Shelumiel) the ban (son) of Tzawarayashaday (Zurishaddai) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon).
Alayasap (Eliasaph) the ban (son) of Daiwaal (Deuel) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Gad (Gad).
The Qahathay (Kohathites) nasai (set) forward, nashaa (lift) the maqadash (sanctuary). The others qawam (rise up) up the mashakan (tabernacle) before they arrived.

The dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim) nasai (set) forward according to their tzabaa (troop). Alayashamai (Elishama) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud) was over his tzabaa (troop).
Gamalayaal (Gamaliel) the ban (son) of Padahatzawar (Pedahzur) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh).
Abay-Dan (Abidan) the ban (son) of Gadainay (Gideoni) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin).

The dagal (standard) of the machanah (camp) of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan), which was the rear guard of all the machanath (camps), nasai (set) forward according to their tzabaa (troop). Achayaizar (Ahiezer) the ban (son) of Imayashaday (Ammishaddai) was over his tzabaa (troop).
Pagaiyaal (Pagiel) the ban (son) of Ikaran (Ochran) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher).
Achayarai (Ahira) the ban (son) of Iyanan (Enan) was over the tzabaa (troop) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali).
Alah (these) were the travels of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) according to their tzabaa (troop); and they nasai (went) forward.

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to Chabab (Hobab), the ban (son) of Raiwaal (Reuel) the Madayanay (Midianite), Mashah (Moses)' father-in-law, "We are nasai (journeying) to the maqawam (place) of which Yahawah amar (spoke), ‘I will nathan (give) it to you.' Yalak (come) with us, and we will treat you yatab (well); for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) yatab (good) concerning Yashar-Al (Israel)."
He amar (spoke) to him, "I will not yalak (go); but I will depart to my own aratz (Earth/land), and to my relatives."
He amar (spoke), "Don't izab (leave) us, please; because you know how we are to chanah (encamp) in the madabar (wilderness), and you can be our iyanayam (eyes).
It shall be, if you yalak (go) with us, yes, it shall be, that whatever tawab (good / proper function) Yahawah hatabanaw (does) to us, we will yatab (do) the same to you."

They nasai (set) forward from the har (mountain) of Yahawah shalawash (three) yamayam (days)' darak (journey). The arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah nasai (went) panayam (face) them shalawash (three) yamayam (days)' darak (journey), to thawar (seek) out a manawachah (resting) place for them.
The inan (cloud) of Yahawah was over them by yawamam (by day), when they nasai (set) forward from the machanah (camp).

It happened, when the arawan (ark) nasai (went) forward, that Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke), "qawam (rise up) up, Yahawah, and let your ayab (enemy) be pawatz (scattered)! Let those who shanaa (hate) you nawas (flee) panayam (face) you!"
When it nawach (rested), he amar (spoke), "shawab (turn back / repent), Yahawah, to the rababah (ten) alapay (thousands) of the thousands of Yashar-Al (Israel)."

The im (nation / people) were anan (complaining) in the ears of Yahawah. When Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) it, his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger); and Yahawah ash (fire) burnt among them, and akal (eat) some of the outskirts of the machanah (camp).
The im (nation / people) tzaiq (cried) to Mashah (Moses); and Mashah (Moses) palal (prayed) to Yahawah, and the ash (fire) abated.
The sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) Thabairah (Taberah), because Yahawah ash (fire) burnt among them.

The mixed asapasap (multitude) that was qarab (among / near) them awah (lusted) exceedingly: and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) also bakah (wept) again, and amar (spoke), "Who will give us bashar (flesh) to akal (eat)?

We zakar (remember) the dagah (fish), which we akal (eat) in Matzarayam (Egypt) for chanam (nothing); the qashaayam (cucumbers), and the abatachayam (melons), and the chatzayar (leeks), and the batzalayam (onions), and the shawam (place / establish / appoint);
But now we have lost our appetite. There is balathay (without) at all except this man (from) to iyan (eye) at."
The man (from) was like gad (coriander) zarai (seed), and its iyan (eye) like the iyan (eye) of badalach (Bdellium).

The im (nation / people) shawat (went) around, laqat (gathered) it, and tachan (ground) it in rachayam (mills), or dawak (beat) it in madakah (mortars), and bashal (boiled) it in parawar (pots), and ishah (make) igawath (cakes) of it. Its taim (taste) was like the taim (taste) of lashad (fresh) shaman (oil).
When the tal (dew) yarad (fell) on the machanah (camp) in the layal (night), the man (from) yarad (fell) on it.

Mashah (Moses) shamai (hearken / hear) the im (nation / people) bakah (weeping) throughout their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), every ayash (man / husband) at the pathach (door) of his ahal (tent); and the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) maad (greatly); and Mashah (Moses) was raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil).

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to Yahawah, "Why have you treated with your ibad (servant) so badly? Why haven't I matzaa (found) favor in your iyan (eye), that you shawam (place / establish / appoint) the mashaa (burden) of all this im (nation / people) on me?

Have I harah (conceived) all this im (nation / people)? Have I yalad (birth / begot) them forth, that you should amar (spoke) me, ‘nashaa (lift) them in your chayaq (bosom), as a aman (believe / have faith) nashaa (lift) a yanaq (nursing) infant, to the adamah (land) which you shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father)?'
Ayan (NO ONE) could I get meat to nathan (give) to all this im (nation / people)? For they bakah (weep) to me, amar (spoke), ‘nathan (give) us meat, that we may akal (eat).'
I am not yakal (able) to nashaa (lift) all this im (nation / people) bad (alone), because it is too kabad (heavy) for me.
If you treat me this way, please harag (kill) me right now, if I matzaa (have) found favor in your iyan (eye); and don't raah (see) me see my rai (wretchedness)."

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "asap (gather) to me shabaiyam (seventy) ayash (man / husband) of the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel), whom you yadai (know) to be the zaqanay (elders) of the im (nation / people), and shatar (officers) over them; and laqach (take / seize) them to the ahal (tent) of Meeting, that they may yatzab (stand) there with you.

I will yarad (come) down and dabar (word / matter) with you there. I will atzal (take) of the rawach (spirit / wind) which is on you, and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) it on them; and they shall nashaa (lift) the mashaa (burden) of the im (nation / people) with you, that you not nashaa (lift) it yourself alone.

"Amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), ‘qadash (set apart / make holy) yourselves against machar (tomorrow), and you will akal (eat) bashar (flesh); for you have bakah (wept) in the azanay (ears) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), "Who will give us bashar (flesh) to akal (eat)? For it was tawab (good / proper function) with us in Matzarayam (Egypt)." Therefore Yahawah will nathan (give) you bashar (flesh), and you will akal (eat).
You will not akal (eat) achad (one) yawam (day), nor yawam (day) days, nor chamash (five) yawamayam (days), neither ishar (ten) yawamayam (days), nor isharayam (twenty) yawamayam (days),

But a whole chadash (month), until it yatzaa (go out / come out) out at your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and it is zaraa (loathsome) to you; yain (because) that you have maas (rejected) Yahawah who is qarab (among / near) you, and have bakah (wept) panayam (face) him, amar (spoke), "Why did we yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt)?"'"

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke), "The im (nation / people), qarab (among / near) whom I am, are shash (six) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) men on foot; and you have amar (spoke), ‘I will nathan (give) them bashar (flesh), that they may akal (eat) a yawam (day) chadash (month).'

Shall tzaan (flocks) and baqar (morning) be shachat (slaughtered) for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters) be asap (gathered) together for them, to be sufficient for them?"
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "Has Yahawah yad (hand) grown qatzar (short)? Now you will raah (see) whether my dabar (word / matter) will qarah (happen) to you or not."

Mashah (Moses) yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and dabar (word / matter) the im (nation / people) the dabaray (words) of Yahawah; and he asap (gathered) shabaiyam (seventy) ayash (man / husband) of the zaqanay (elders) of the im (nation / people), and imad (set) them around the ahal (tent).

Yahawah yarad (came) down in the inan (cloud), and dabar (word / matter) to him, and atzal (took) of the rawach (spirit / wind) that was on him, and nathan (give) it on the shabaiyam (seventy) zaqanayam (elders): and it happened that when the rawach (spirit / wind) nawach (rested) on them, they nabaa (prophesied), but they yasap (did) so no more.

But shanayam (two) anashayam (men) shaar (remained) in the machanah (camp). The sham (name) of achad (one) was Aladad (Eldad), and the sham (name) of the other Mayadad (Medad): and the rawach (spirit / wind) nawach (rested) on them; and they were of those who were kathab (write), but yatzaa (go out / come out) not gone out to the ahal (tent); and they nabaa (prophesied) in the machanah (camp).
A nair (young) man rawatz (ran), and nagad (told) Mashah (Moses), and said, "Aladad (Eldad) and Mayadad (Medad) are nabaa (prophesying) in the machanah (camp)!"

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), the sharath (servant) of Mashah (Moses), one of his chosen bacharawath (men), inah (answer / respond), "My Adawan Mashah (Moses), kalaa (forbid) them!"

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to him, "Are you qanaa (jealous) for my sake? I wish that all Yahawah im (nation / people) were nabayaayam (prophets), that Yahawah nathan (give) put his rawach (spirit / wind) on them!"
Mashah (Moses) went into the machanah (camp), he and the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

A rawach (spirit / wind) from Yahawah nasai (went) out and gawaz (brought) shalawayam (quails) from the yam (sea/waters), and natash (let) them fall by the machanah (camp), about a yawam (day) darak (journey) on kah (this) side, and a yawam (day) darak (journey) on the other kah (side), around the machanah (camp), and about two amathayam (cubits) above the surface of the aratz (Earth/land).

The im (nation / people) qawam (rise up) up all that yawam (day), and all the layal (night), and all the macharath (next) yawam (day), and asap (gathered) the shalaw (quails). He who mait (gathered) least asap (gathered) ishar (ten) chamarayam (homers); and they shatach (spread) them shatach (all) abroad for themselves around the machanah (camp).

While the bashar (flesh) was yet between their shan (teeth), before it was karath (cut), the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) against the im (nation / people), and Yahawah nakah (struck) the im (nation / people) with a very rab (great) makah (plague).
The sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth) Hattaavah, because there they qabar (bury) the im (nation / people) who awah (lusted).
From Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth) Hattaavah the im (nation / people) traveled to Chatzarawath (Hazeroth); and they stayed at Chatzarawath (Hazeroth).

Marayam (Miriam) and Aharawan (Aaron) dabar (word / matter) against Mashah (Moses) awadawath (because) of the Kawashayath (Cushite) ayashah (woman / wife) whom he had married; for he had married a Kawashayath (Cushite) ayashah (woman / wife).
They amar (spoke), "Has Yahawah amar (spoke) spoken only with Mashah (Moses)? Hasn't he dabar (word / matter) also with us?" And Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) it.
Now the ayash (man / husband) Mashah (Moses) was very inaw (humble), above all the adam (men) who were on the surface of the adamah (earth).

Yahawah amar (spoke) pathaawam (suddenly) to Mashah (Moses), to Aharawan (Aaron), and to Marayam (Miriam), "You shalawash (three) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the ahal (tent) of Meeting!" The shalawash (three) of them yatzaa (go out / come out) out.

Yahawah yarad (came) down in a imawad (pillar) of inan (cloud), and imad (stood) at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent), and qaraa (called) Aharawan (Aaron) and Marayam (Miriam); and they shanayam (two) yatzaa (go out / come out) forward.

He amar (spoke), "shamai (hearken / hear) now my dabar (word / matter). If there is a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) among you, I Yahawah yadai (will) make myself known to him in a maraah (vision). I will dabar (word / matter) with him in a chalawam (dream).
My ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses) is not so. He is aman (believe / have faith) in all my bayath (house).

With him I will dabar (word / matter) pah (mouth) to pah (mouth), even plainly, and not in chayadath (riddles); and he shall nabat (see) Yahawah form. Why then were you not yaraa (fear / be afraid) to dabar (word / matter) against my ibad (servant), against Mashah (Moses)?"
The ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) against them; and he departed.

The inan (cloud) sawar (departed) from over the ahal (tent); and behold, Marayam (Miriam) was tzarai (leprous), as white as shalag (snow). Aharawan (Aaron) panah (turn) at Marayam (Miriam), and behold, she was tzarai (leprous).
Aharawan (Aaron) amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "Oh, my Adawan, please don't count this chataah (sin) against us, in which we have yaal (done) foolishly, and in which we have chataa (sinned).
Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the bashar (flesh) is chatzay (half) akal (eat) when he yatzaa (go out / come out) out of his am (mother) racham (womb)."
Mashah (Moses) tzaiq (cried) to Yahawah, amar (spoke), "rapaa (heal) her, Al, I beg you!"

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "If her ab (father) had but yaraq (spit) in her panayam (face), shouldn't she be kalam (ashamed) shabai (seven) yamayam (days)? Let her be sagar (shut) up outside of the machanah (camp) shabai (seven) yamayam (days), and achar (other) that she shall be asap (brought) in again."
Marayam (Miriam) was sagar (shut) up outside of the machanah (camp) shabai (seven) yamayam (days), and the im (nation / people) didn't travel until Marayam (Miriam) was asap (brought) in again.
Afterward the im (nation / people) traveled from Chatzarawath (Hazeroth), and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of Paaran (Paran).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Shalach (send) anashayam (men), that they may thawar (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), which I nathan (give) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). Of ayash (man / husband) matah (staff / rod / tribe) of their ab (father), you shall shalach (send) a achad (one), every one a nashayaa (prince) among them."

Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) them from the madabar (wilderness) of Paaran (Paran) pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah: all of them anashayam (men) who were raashay (heads) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
These were their sham (name): Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), Shamawai (Shammua) the ban (son) of Zakawar (Zaccur).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), Shapat (Shaphat) the ban (son) of Charay (Hori).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), Yagaal (Igal) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Aparayam (Ephraim), Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Palatay (Palti) the ban (son) of Rapawaa (Raphu).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Gadayaal (Gaddiel) the ban (son) of Sawaday (Sodi).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yawasap (Joseph), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), Gaday (Gaddi) the ban (son) of Sawasay (Susi).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Dan (Dan), Imayaal (Ammiel) the ban (son) of Gamalay (Gemalli).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), Sathawar (Sethur) the ban (son) of Mayakaal (Michael).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), Nachabay (Nahbi) the ban (son) of Wapasay (Vophsi).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), Gaawaal (Geuel) the ban (son) of Makay (Machi).

These are the shamawath (names) of the anashayam (men) who Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) to thawar (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land). Mashah (Moses) qaraa (called) Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) Yahawashawai (Joshua).

Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) them to thawar (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and amar (spoke) to them, "ilah (go up / offer) up this way by the nagab (south), and ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country:

And raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), what it is; and the im (nation / people) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein, whether they are chazaq (strong) or rapah (weak), whether they are mait (few) or many;

And what the aratz (Earth/land) is that they yashab (inhabit/dwell) in, whether it is tawab (good / proper function) or rai (bad); and what irayam (cities) they are that they yashab (inhabit/dwell) in, whether in machanayam (camps), or in strongholds;

And what the aratz (Earth/land) is, whether it is shaman (fat) or razah (lean), whether there is itz (wood) therein, or not. Be courageous, and laqach (take / seize) of the paray (fruit) of the aratz (Earth/land). Yawam (day) the time was the yawam (day) of the first-ripe inabayam (grapes)."
So they ilah (go up / offer) up, and thawar (spied) out the aratz (Earth/land) from the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) to Rachab (Rehob), to the entrance of Chamath (Hamath).

They ilah (go up / offer) up by the nagab (south), and bawaa (come) to Chabarawan (Hebron); and Achayaman (Ahiman), Shashay (Sheshai), and Thalamay (Talmai), the yalayaday (children) of Inaq (Anak), were there. (Now Chabarawan (Hebron) was banah (build) shabai (seven) shanayam (years) panayam (face) Tzain (Zoan) in Matzarayam (Egypt).)

They bawaa (come) to the nachal (stream / river) of Ashakal (Eshcol), and karath (cut) down from there a zamawarah (branch) with achad (one) ashakawal (cluster) of inabayam (grapes), and they nashaa (lift) it on a mawat (staff) between shanayam (two). They also brought some of the ramanayam (pomegranates) and thaanayam (figs).
That maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) the valley of Ashakal (Eshcol), awadawath (because) of the ashakawal (cluster) which the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) karath (cut) down from there.
They shawab (turn back / repent) from thawar (spying) out the aratz (Earth/land) at the qatz (end) of arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day).

They yalak (went) and bawaa (come) to Mashah (Moses), and to Aharawan (Aaron), and to all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to the madabar (wilderness) of Paaran (Paran), to Qadash (Kadesh); and shawab (turn back / repent) back dabar (word / matter) to them, and to all the idah (congregation), and showed them the paray (fruit) of the aratz (Earth/land).

They sapar (book) him, and said, "We bawaa (come) to the aratz (Earth/land) where you shalach (send) us; and surely it zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey); and this is its paray (fruit).

However the im (nation / people) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) are iz (strong), and the irayam (cities) are batzar (fortified) and very large. Moreover, we raah (see) the yaladay (children) of Inaq (Anak) there.

Imalaq (Amalek) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the nagab (south): and the Chathay (Hittite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite), and the Amaray (Amorite), yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the har (mountain) country; and the Kanainay (Canaanite) yashab (inhabit/dwell) by the yam (sea/waters), and along by the yad (hand) of the Yaradan (Jordan)."

Kalab (Caleb) hasah (stilled) the im (nation / people) before Mashah (Moses), and amar (spoke), "Let us ilah (go up / offer) up at ilah (go up / offer), and yarash (possess) it; for we are well yakal (able) to yakal (overcome) it."

But the anashayam (men) who ilah (go up / offer) up with him amar (spoke), "We aren't yakal (able) to ilah (go up / offer) up against the im (nation / people); for they are chazaq (stronger) than we."

They yatzaa (go out / come out) up an dabah (evil) report of the aratz (Earth/land) which they had thawar (spied) out to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "The aratz (Earth/land), ibar (pass over/through) which we have gone to thawar (spy) it out, is a aratz (Earth/land) that akal (eat) up its yashab (inhabit/dwell); and all the im (nation / people) who we raah (see) in it are banay (men) of great madah (stature).
There we raah (see) the Nephilim, the banay (sons) of Inaq (Anak), who come of the Nephilim: and we were in our own iyan (eye) as grasshoppers, and so we were in their iyan (eye)."
All the idah (congregation) nashaa (lift) up their qawal (sound / voice), and nathan (give); and the im (nation / people) bakah (wept) that layal (night).

All the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) lawan (murmured) against Mashah (Moses) and against Aharawan (Aaron): and the whole idah (congregation) amar (spoke) to them, "lawaa (do not) that we had mawath (death) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt)! Or lawaa (do not) that we had mawath (death) in this madabar (wilderness)!

Why does Yahawah bawaa (come) us to this aratz (Earth/land), to napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword)? Our wives and our little tap (ones) will be a baz (prey): wouldn't it be tawab (good / proper function) for us to shawab (turn back / repent) into Matzarayam (Egypt)?"
They amar (spoke) ayash (man / husband) to ach (brother/kinsman), "nathan (give) us make a raash (head), and let us shawab (turn back / repent) into Matzarayam (Egypt)."

Then Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) napal (fall / be cast down) on their panay (faces) panayam (face) all the qahal (assembly) of the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) and Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh), who were of those who thawar (spied) out the aratz (Earth/land), qarai (tore) their clothes:

And they amar (spoke) to all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "The aratz (Earth/land), which we ibar (pass over/through) through to thawar (spy) it out, is an maad (exceeding) tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land).

If Yahawah chapatz (delights) in us, then he will bawaa (come) us into this aratz (Earth/land), and nathan (give) it to us; a aratz (Earth/land) which zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey).

Only don't marad (rebel) against Yahawah, neither yaraa (fear / be afraid) the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land); for they are lacham (bread) for us: their defense is sawar (removed) from over them, and Yahawah is with us. Don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) them."

But all the idah (congregation) threatened to ragam (stone) them with ragam (stones). The kabawad (glory) of Yahawah raah (see) in the ahal (tent) of Meeting to all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "How long will this im (nation / people) naatz (despise) me? And how long will they not aman (believe / have faith) in me, for all the athawath (signs) which I ishah (make) worked qarab (among / near) them?
I will nakah (strike) them with the dabar (word / matter), and yarash (disinherit) them, and will ishah (make) of you a gaway (heathen / nation) greater and mightier than they."

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to Yahawah, "Then the Matzaray (Egyptians) will shamai (hearken / hear) it; for you ilah (go up / offer) up this im (nation / people) in your kach (strength / mighty / power) from qarab (among / near) them;

And they will amar (spoke) it to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of this aratz (Earth/land). They have shamai (hearken / hear) that you Yahawah are in the qarab (among / near) of this im (nation / people); for you Yahawah are raah (see) iyan (eye) to iyan (eye), and your inan (cloud) imad (stands) over them, and you halak (move) panayam (face) them, in a imawad (pillar) of inan (cloud) by yawamam (by day), and in a imawad (pillar) of ash (fire) by layal (night).

Now if you mawath (death) this im (nation / people) as achad (one) ayash (man / husband), then the gawayam (nations) which have shamai (hearken / hear) the shamai (fame) of you will amar (spoke), amar (spoke),

‘Because Yahawah was not yakal (able) to bawaa (come) this im (nation / people) into the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to them, therefore he has shachat (slain) them in the madabar (wilderness).'
Now please let the kach (strength / mighty / power) of the Adanay be gadal (great), according as you have dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke),

‘Yahawah is arak (slow) to anger, and abundant in loving chasad (grace), nashaa (lift) iwan (guilt/iniquity) and disobedience; and that will by no naqah (clean/innocent) naqah (clean/innocent) the guilty, paqad (visit) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of the abawath (fathers) on the banayam (children), on the shalash (three) and on the rabai (fourth) generation.'
