Behold, ayash (man / husband) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) and qarab (come close) to his ach (brother/kinsman) a Madayanay (Midianite) woman in the iyan (eye) of Mashah (Moses), and in the iyan (eye) of all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), while they were bakah (weeping) at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting.

When Payanachas (Phinehas), the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), raah (see) it, he qawam (rise up) up from the thawak (midst) of the idah (congregation), and laqach (take / seize) a ramach (spear) in his yad (hand);

And he bawaa (come) achar (other) the ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel) into the pavilion, and thrust shanayam (two) of them through, the ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the ayashah (woman / wife) al (toward) her body. So the magapah (plague) was itzar (stayed) from the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Those who mawath (death) by the magapah (plague) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Payanachas (Phinehas), the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), has shawab (turn back / repent) my chamah (wrath) shawab (turn back / repent) from the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), in that he was qanaa (jealous) with my qanaah (jealousy) thawak (midst) them, so that I didn't kalah (complete / finish) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in my qanaah (jealousy).
Therefore amar (spoke), ‘Behold, I nathan (give) to him my barayath (covenant) of shalawam (peace / safety):

And it shall be to him, and to his zarai (seed) achar (other) him, the barayath (covenant) of an iwalam (forever) kahanah (priesthood); ashar (who/that) he was qanaa (jealous) for his Alahayam, and made kapar (atonement) for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).'"

Now the sham (name) of the ayash (man / husband) of Israel that was nakah (slain), who was nakah (slain) with the Madayanay (Midianite) woman, was Zamaray (Zimri), the ban (son) of Salaw (Salu), a nashayaa (prince) of a ab (father)' bayath (house) among the Shamainay (Simeonites).

The sham (name) of the Madayanay (Midianite) ayashah (woman / wife) who was nakah (slain) was Kazabay (Cozbi), the banath (daughter) of Tzawar (Zur); he was raash (head) of the amawath (people) of a ab (father)' bayath (house) in Madayan (Midian).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"Harass the Madayanay (Midianites), and nakah (strike) them;

For they harassed you with their nakal (wiles), with which they have deceived you in the dabar (word / matter) of Paiwar (Peor), and in the dabar (word / matter) of Kazabay (Cozbi), the banath (daughter) of the nashayaa (prince) of Madayan (Midian), their achawath (sister), who was nakah (slain) on the yawam (day) of the magapah (plague) in the dabar (word / matter) of Paiwar (Peor)."
It happened al (toward) the plague, that Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses) and to Alaizar (Eleazar) the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), amar (spoke),

"Nashaa (lift) a census of all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, by their ab (father)' bayath (house), all who are yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop) in Yashar-Al (Israel)."
Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) dabar (word / matter) with them in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), amar (spoke),

"Take a census, from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward; as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)." These are those that yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Raawaban (Reuben), the bakawar (firstborn) of Yashar-Al (Israel); the banay (sons) of Raawaban (Reuben): of Chanawak (Hanoch), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chanakay (hanochites); of Palawaa (Pallu), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the palaay (palluites);
Of Chatzarawan (Hezron), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chatzarawanay (hezronites); of Karamay (Carmi), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the karamay (carmites).

These are the mashapachath (families) of the Raawabanay (Reubenites); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were arabaiyam (forty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
The banay (sons) of Palawaa (Pallu): Alayaab (Eliab).

The banay (sons) of Alayaab (Eliab): Namawaal (Nemuel), and Dathan (Dathan), and Abayaram (Abiram). These are that Dathan (Dathan) and Abayaram (Abiram), who were called of the idah (congregation), who natzah (strove) against Mashah (Moses) and against Aharawan (Aaron) in the idah (company) of Qarach (Korah), when they natzah (strove) against Yahawah,

And the aratz (Earth/land) pathach (opened) its pah (mouth), and balai (swallowed) them up together with Qarach (Korah), when that idah (company) mawath (death); what time the ash (fire) akal (eat) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) ayash (man / husband), and they became a nas (sign).
Notwithstanding, the banay (sons) of Qarach (Korah) didn't mawath (death).

The banay (sons) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Namawaal (Nemuel), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the namawaalay (nemuelites); of Yamayan (Jamin), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yamayanay (jaminites); of Yakayan (Jachin), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yakayanay (jachinites);
Of Zarach (Zerah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Zerahites; of Shaawal (Shaul), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shaawalay (shaulites).
These are the mashapachath (families) of the Shamainay (Simeonites), isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Gad (Gad) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Tzapawan (Zephon), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the tzapawanay (zephonites); of Chagay (Haggi), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Chagay (Haggites); of Shawanay (Shuni), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shawanay (shunites);
Of azanay (ozni), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the azanay (oznites); of Iray (Eri), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the iray (erites);
Of Arawad (Arod), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the arawaday (arodites); of Araalay (Areli), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Araalay (Arelites).
These are the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Gad (Gad) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, arabaiyam (forty) alap (thousand) and chamash (five) maah (hundred).
The banay (sons) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er) and Awanan (Onan); and Ir (Er) and Awanan (Onan) mawath (death) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan).

The banay (sons) of Yahawadah (Judah) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) were: of Shalah (Shelah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shalanay (shelanites); of Paratz (Perez), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Perezites; of Zarach (Zerah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Zerahites.

The banay (sons) of Paratz (Perez) were: of Chatzarawan (Hezron), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chatzarawanay (hezronites); of Chamawal (Hamul), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chamawalay (hamulites).
These are the mashapachath (families) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shabaiyam (seventy) - six alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Yashashakar (Issachar) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Thawalai (Tola), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the thawalaiy (tolaites); of Pawaah (Puvah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the pawanay (punites);
Of Yashawab (Jashub), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yashabay (jashubites); of Shamarawan (Shimron), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shamaranay (shimronites).
These are the mashapachath (families) of Yashashakar (Issachar) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shashayam (sixty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Sarad (Sered), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Seredites; of Ayalawan (Elon), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the alawanay (elonites); of Yachalaal (Jahleel), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yachalaalay (jahleelites).
These are the mashapachath (families) of the Zabawalanay (Zebulunites) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shashayam (sixty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred).
The banay (sons) of Yawasap (Joseph) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim).

The banay (sons) of Manashah (Manasseh): of Makayar (Machir), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Machirites; and Makayar (Machir) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Galaid (Gilead); of Galaid (Gilead), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Galaiday (Gileadites).

These are the banay (sons) of Galaid (Gilead): of Ayaizar (Iezer), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Iezerites; of Chalaq (Helek), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Helekites;
And Asharayaal (Asriel), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the asharaalay (asrielites); and Shakam (Shechem), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Shakamay (Shechemites);
And Shamayadai (Shemida), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shamayadaiy (shemidaites); and Chapar (Hepher), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chaparay (hepherites).

Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher) had no banayam (sons), but banawath (daughters): and the sham (name) of the banawath (daughters) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) were Machalah (Mahlah), and Naih (Noah), Chagalah (Hoglah), Malakah (Milcah), and Tharatzah (Tirzah).
These are the mashapachath (families) of Manashah (Manasseh); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred).

These are the banay (sons) of Aparayam (Ephraim) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Shawathalach (Shuthelah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Shuthelahites; of Bakar (Becher), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Becherites; of Thachan (Tahan), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the thachanay (tahanites).
These are the banay (sons) of Shawathalach (Shuthelah): of Iran (Eran), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the iranay (eranites).

These are the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred). These are the banay (sons) of Yawasap (Joseph) after their mashapachath (families).

The banay (sons) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Balai (Bela), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the balaiy (belaites); of Ashabal (Ashbel), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the ashabalay (ashbelites); of Achayaram (Ahiram), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the achayaramay (ahiramites);
Of Shapawapam (Shephupham), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shawapamay (shuphamites); of Chawapam (Hupham), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chawapamay (huphamites).

The banay (sons) of Balai (Bela) were Arad (Ard) and Naiman (Naaman): the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the araday (ardites); of Naiman (Naaman), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the naimay (naamites).

These are the banay (sons) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

These are the banay (sons) of Dan (Dan) after their mashapachath (families): of Shawacham (Shuham), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shawachamay (shuhamites). These are the mashapachath (families) of Dan (Dan) after their mashapachath (families).

All the mashapachath (families) of the shawachamay (shuhamites), according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, were shashayam (sixty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Ashar (Asher) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Yamanah (Imnah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Yamanah (Imnites); of Ishvi, the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Ishvites; of Barayaih (Beriah), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Berites.

Of the banay (sons) of Barayaih (Beriah): of Chabar (Heber), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chabaray (heberites); of Malakayaal (Malchiel), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the malakayaalay (malchielites).
The sham (name) of the banath (daughter) of Ashar (Asher) was Sharach (Serah).

These are the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Ashar (Asher) according to those who were paqad (visit) of them, chamashayam (fifty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) and arabai (four) maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Napathalay (Naphtali) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Yachatzaal (Jahzeel), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yachatzaalay (jahzeelites); of Gawanay (Guni), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the gawanay (gunites);
Of Yatzar (Jezer), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the yatzaray (jezerites); of Shalam (Shillem), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the shalamay (shillemites).

These are the mashapachath (families) of Napathalay (Naphtali) according to their mashapachath (families); and those who were paqad (visit) of them were arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred).
These are those who were paqad (visit) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), shash (six) maah (hundred) alap (one) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"To these the aratz (Earth/land) shall be chalaq (divided) for an nachalah (inheritance) according to the masapar (number) of shamawath (names).

To the more you shall rabah (give) the more nachalah (inheritance), and to the fewer you shall mait (give) the less nachalah (inheritance): to everyone pah (according) to those who were paqad (visit) of him shall his nachalah (inheritance) be nathan (give).
Notwithstanding, the aratz (Earth/land) shall be chalaq (divided) by gawaral (lot): according to the shamawath (names) of the matawath (tribes) of their ab (father) they shall nachal (inherit).
Pah (according) to the gawaral (lot) shall their nachalah (inheritance) be chalaq (divided) between the more and the fewer."

These are those who were paqad (visit) of the Lawayay (Levites) after their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): of Garashawan (Gershon), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the garashanay (gershonites); of Qahath (Kohath), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Qahathay (Kohathites); of Mararay (Merari), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Mararay (Merarites).

These are the mashapachath (families) of Levi: the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the labanay (libnites), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the chabarawanay (hebronites), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the machalay (mahlites), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the mawashay (mushites), the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the qarachay (korahites). Qahath (Kohath) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Imaram (Amram).

The sham (name) of Imaram (Amram's) ayashah (woman / wife) was Yawakabad (Jochebed), the banath (daughter) of Laway (Levi), who was yalad (birth / begot) to Laway (Levi) in Matzarayam (Egypt): and she yalad (birth / begot) to Imaram (Amram) Aharawan (Aaron) and Mashah (Moses), and Marayam (Miriam) their achawath (sister).
To Aharawan (Aaron) were yalad (birth / begot) Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu), Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar).
Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu) mawath (death), when they qarab (come close) zawar (strange) ash (fire) panayam (face) Yahawah.

Those who were paqad (visit) of them were isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) alap (thousand), every zakar (remember) from a chadash (month) ban (son) and upward: for they were not paqad (visit) thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), because there was no nachalah (inheritance) nathan (give) them thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

These are those who were paqad (visit) by Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), who paqad (visit) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).

But among these there was not a ayash (man / husband) of them who were paqad (visit) by Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), who paqad (visit) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai).

For Yahawah had amar (spoke) of them, They shall mawath (death) mawath (death) in the madabar (wilderness). There was not yathar (left) a ayash (man / husband) of them, except Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh), and Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun).

Then qarab (come close) near the banawath (daughters) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher), the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), of the mashapachath (families) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph); and these are the shamawath (names) of his banawath (daughters): Machalah (Mahlah), Naih (Noah), and Chagalah (Hoglah), and Malakah (Milcah), and Tharatzah (Tirzah).

They imad (stood) panayam (face) Mashah (Moses), and panayam (face) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (face) the nashayaam (princes) and all the idah (congregation), at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting, amar (spoke),

"Our ab (father) mawath (death) in the madabar (wilderness), and he was not thawak (midst) the idah (company) of those who yaid (gathered) themselves together against Yahawah in the idah (company) of Qarach (Korah): but he mawath (death) in his own chataa (sin); and he had no banayam (sons).

Why should the sham (name) of our ab (father) be taken garai (away) from thawak (midst) his mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), because he had no ban (son)? Nathan (give) to us a achazah (possession) thawak (midst) the achay (brothers) of our ab (father)."
Mashah (Moses) qarab (come close) their cause panayam (face) Yahawah.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"The banawath (daughters) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) dabar (word / matter) kan (for sure): you shall nathan (give) nathan (give) them a achazah (possession) of an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) their ab (father) achay (brothers); and you shall cause the nachalah (inheritance) of their ab (father) to ibar (pass over/through) to them.

You shall dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), ‘If a ayash (man / husband) mawath (death), and has no ban (son), then you shall cause his nachalah (inheritance) to ibar (pass over/through) to his banath (daughter).
If he has no banath (daughter), then you shall nathan (give) his nachalah (inheritance) to his ach (brother/kinsman).
If he has no achayam (brothers), then you shall nathan (give) his nachalah (inheritance) to his ab (father) achayam (brothers).

If his ab (father) has no achayam (brothers), then you shall nathan (give) his nachalah (inheritance) to his kinsman who is qarawab (next) to him of his mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), and he shall yarash (possess) it: and it shall be to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) a chaqah (statute) and mashapat (ordinance), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).'"

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "ilah (go up / offer) up into this har (mountain) of Ibarayam (Abarim), and raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) given to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
When you raah (see) seen it, you also shall be asap (gathered) to your im (nation / people), as Aharawan (Aaron) your ach (brother/kinsman) was asap (gathered);

Because you marah (rebelled) against my pah (word) in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin), in the marayabah (strife) of the idah (congregation), to qadash (set apart / make holy) me at the may (waters) before their iyan (eye)." (These are the may (waters) of Marayabah (Meribah) of Qadash (Kadesh) in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin).)
Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),
"Let Yahawah, the Alahayam of the rawachath (spirits) of all bashar (flesh), paqad (visit) a ayash (man / husband) over the idah (congregation),

Who may yatzaa (go out / come out) out panayam (face) them, and who may bawaa (come) in panayam (face) them, and who may yatzaa (go out / come out) them out, and who may bawaa (come) them in; that the idah (congregation) of Yahawah not be as tzaan (sheep) which have no raih (shepherd)."

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "laqach (take / seize) Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), a ayash (man / husband) in whom is the rawach (spirit / wind), and samak (lay) your yad (hand) on him;
And imad (set) him panayam (face) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (face) all the idah (congregation); and commission him in their iyan (eye).
You shall nathan (give) of your honor on him, that all the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) may shamai (hearken / hear).

He shall imad (stand) panayam (face) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), who shall inquire for him by the mashapat (judgment) of the awarayam (urim) panayam (face) Yahawah: at his pah (word) shall they yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and at his pah (word) they shall bawaa (come) in, both he, and all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, even all the idah (congregation)."

Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) him; and he laqach (take / seize) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and imad (set) him panayam (face) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (face) all the idah (congregation):
And he samak (laid) his yad (hand) on him, and commissioned him, as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Tzawah (command) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘My qaraban (offering), my food for my qaraban (offerings) made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire), of a pleasant aroma to me, you shall shamar (keep/guard) to qarab (come close) to me in their mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) season.'

You shall amar (spoke) them, ‘This is the ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire which you shall qarab (come close) to Yahawah: male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish, shanayam (two) yawam (day) by day, for a thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering).
You shall ishah (make) the achad (one) kabash (lamb) in the baqar (morning), and you shall ishah (make) the other kabash (lamb) at irab (evening);

With the ishayaray (tenth) part of an ayapah (ephah) of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin) of kathayath (beaten) shaman (oil).
It is a thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), which was ordained in har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai) for a pleasant aroma, an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah.

Its drink nasak (offering) shall be the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin) for the achad (one) kabash (lamb). You shall nasak (pour) out a drink nasak (offering) of shakar (strong) drink to Yahawah in the qadash (set apart / make holy) place.

The other kabash (lamb) you shall ishah (make) at irab (evening): as the meal manachah (offering) of the baqar (morning), and as the drink nasak (offering) of it, you shall ishah (make) it, an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah.

"‘On the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day) shanayam (two) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish, and shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), and the drink nasak (offering) of it:
This is the burnt ilah (offering) of every shabath (shabath / rest), besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the drink nasak (offering) of it.

"‘In the raashay (beginnings) of your chadash (month) you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah: shanayam (two) young parayam (bulls), and achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts of an ephah of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), for achad (one) par (bull); and shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts of fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), for the achad (one) ayal (ram);

And a isharawan (tenth) part of fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil) for a meal manachah (offering) to achad (one) kabash (lamb); for a burnt ilah (offering) of a pleasant aroma, an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah.

Their drink nasak (offerings) shall be chatzay (half) a hayan (hin) of yayan (wine) for a par (bull), and the shalayashay (third) part of a hayan (hin) for the ayal (ram), and the rabayaiy (fourth) part of a hayan (hin) for a kabash (lamb): this is the burnt ilah (offering) of every chadash (month) throughout the chadashay (months) of the shanah (year).
Achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering to Yahawah; it shall be ishah (make) besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the drink ilah (offering) of it.
"‘In the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the fourteenth yawam (day) of the month, is Yahawah pasach (passover).
On the fifteenth yawam (day) of this chadash (month) shall be a chag (feast/festival): shabai (seven) yamayam (days) shall unleavened matzah (bread) be akal (eat).
In the raashawan (first) yawam (day) shall be a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation): you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire, a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah: shanayam (two) young parayam (bulls), and achad (one) ayal (ram), and shabai (seven) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old; they shall be to you thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil): you shall ishah (make) shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for a par (bull), and shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the ayal (ram).
You shall ishah (make) a isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, to make kapar (atonement) for you.
You shall ishah (make) these besides the burnt ilah (offering) of the baqar (morning), which is for a thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering).

In this way you shall ishah (make) yawam (day), for shabai (seven) yamayam (days), the lacham (food) of the ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: it shall be ishah (make) besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the drink ilah (offering) of it.
On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) you shall have a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation): you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work).

"‘Also in the yawam (day) of the bakawar (first) fruits, when you qarab (come close) a chadash (new) meal manachah (offering) to Yahawah in your feast of shabawai (weeks), you shall have a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering) for a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: shanayam (two) young parayam (bulls), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for achad (one) par (bull), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the achad (one) ayal (ram),
A isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs);
Achad (one) male shaiyar (goat), to make kapar (atonement) for you.

Besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, you shall ishah (make) them (they shall be to you thamayam (complete / whole) blemish), and their drink nasak (offerings).

"‘In the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), you shall have a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work): it is a yawam (day) of tharawaih (blowing) of trumpets to you.

You shall ishah (make) a burnt ilah (offering) for a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: achad (one) young par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for the par (bull), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the ayal (ram),
And achad (one) isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, to make kapar (atonement) for you;

Besides the burnt ilah (offering) of the new chadash (month), and the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering) and the meal manachah (offering) of it, and their drink nasak (offerings), according to their mashapat (ordinance), for a pleasant aroma, an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire to Yahawah.

"‘On the ishawar (tenth) day of this shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) you shall have a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation); and you shall inah (oppress / afflict) your napash (soul): you shall ishah (make) no kind of malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah for a pleasant aroma: achad (one) young par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old; they shall be to you thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for the par (bull), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for the achad (one) ayal (ram),
A isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs):

Achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the chataah (sin) offering of kapar (atonement), and the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and their drink manachah (offerings).

"‘On the fifteenth yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) you shall have a qadash (set apart / make holy) maqaraa (convocation); you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work), and you shall chagag (keep) a chag (feast/festival) to Yahawah shabai (seven) yamayam (days):

And you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering), an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah; thirteen young parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old; they shall be thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering), fine salath (flour) balal (mixed) with shaman (oil), shalawash (three) isharawan (tenth) parts for achad (one) par (bull) of the thirteen parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) isharawan (tenth) parts for achad (one) ayal (ram) of the shanayam (two) ayalam (rams),
And a isharawan (tenth) part for achad (one) kabash (lamb) of the fourteen kabashayam (lambs);
And achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), the meal chataah (sin) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.

"‘On the shanay (second) yawam (day) you shall offer shanayam (two) ban (son) parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the parayam (bulls), for the ayalam (rams), and for the kabashayam (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and their drink manachah (offerings).
"‘On the shalayashay (third) yawam (day) ishathay (eleven) parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the parayam (bulls), for the ayalam (rams), and for the kabashayam (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
"‘On the rabayaiy (fourth) yawam (day) ishar (ten) parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

Their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the parayam (bulls), for the ayalam (rams), and for the kabashayam (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male iz (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), the meal chataah (sin) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
"‘On the chamayashay (fifth) yawam (day) thashai (nine) parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the parayam (bulls), for the ayalam (rams), and for the kabashayam (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
"‘On the shashay (sixth) yawam (day) shamanah (eight) parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the parayam (bulls), for the ayalam (rams), and for the kabashayam (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offerings) of it.
"‘On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) shabai (seven) parayam (bulls), shanayam (two) ayalam (rams), fourteen male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

And their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the parayam (bulls), for the ayalam (rams), and for the kabashayam (lambs), according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance);
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering; besides the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), the meal manachah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.
"‘On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) you shall have a solemn itzarah (assembly): you shall ishah (make) no servile malaakah (work);

But you shall qarab (come close) a burnt ilah (offering), an ashah (fire / offering made by fire) made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahawah: achad (one) par (bull), achad (one) ayal (ram), shabai (seven) male kabashayam (lambs) a shanah (year) old thamayam (complete / whole) blemish;

Their meal manachah (offering) and their drink nasak (offerings) for the par (bull), for the ayal (ram), and for the kabashayam (lambs), shall be according to their masapar (number), after the mashapat (ordinance):
And achad (one) male shaiyar (goat) for a chataah (sin) offering, besides the thamayad (continual) burnt chataah (sin), and the meal ilah (offering) of it, and the drink nasak (offering) of it.

"‘You shall ishah (make) these to Yahawah in your mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, besides your nadar (vow), and your freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering), for your burnt ilah (offerings), and for your meal manachah (offerings), and for your drink nasak (offerings), and for your shalam (peace) offerings.'"
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) the ban (son) of Yashar-Al (Israel) according to all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to the heads of the tribes of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "This is the thing which Yahawah has tzawah (commanded).

When a raash (head) vows a vow to Yahawah, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his dabar (word / matter); he shall dabar (word / matter) according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
"Also when a woman nadar (make vow) a nadar (vow) to Yahawah, and asar (binds) herself by a asar (bond), being in her father's house, in her youth,

And her ab (father) hears her nadar (vow), and her asar (bond) with which she has asar (bound) her soul, and her ab (father) holds his peace at her; then all her nadar (vow) shall stand, and every asar (bond) with which she has asar (bound) her soul shall stand.

But if her ab (father) disallow her in the day that he shamai (hearken / hear), none of her nadar (vow), or of her asar (bonds) with which she has asar (bound) her napash (soul), shall qawam (rise up): and Yahawah will forgive her, because her ab (father) disallowed her.
"If she has a husband, while her nadar (vow) are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has asar (bound) her napash (soul),

And her ayash (man / husband) hears it, and hold his peace at her in the hayah (came to pass) that he hears it; then her nadar (vow) shall stand, and her asar (bonds) with which she has asar (bound) her napash (soul) shall stand.

But if her ayash (man / husband) forbids her in the yawam (day) that he shamai (hearken / hear) it, then he shall make void her nadar (vow) which is on her, and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has asar (bound) her napash (soul): and Yahawah will forgive her.
"But the nadar (vow) of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has asar (bound) her napash (soul), shall stand against her.
"If she nadar (vow) in her husband's alamanah (house), or asar (bound) her napash (soul) by a asar (bond) with an oath,

And her ayash (man / husband) heard it, and held his peace at her, and didn't disallow her; then all her nadar (make vow) shall stand, and every asar (bond) with which she asar (bound) her napash (soul) shall stand.

But if her ayash (man / husband) shamai (hearken / hear) them null and void in the day that he shamai (hearken / hear) them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her nadar (vow), or concerning the asar (bond) of her napash (soul), shall not qawam (rise up): her ayash (man / husband) has shamai (hearken / hear) them void; and Yahawah will forgive her.
Every nadar (vow), and every asar (binding) oath to afflict the napash (soul), her ayash (man / husband) may qawam (rise up) it, or her ayash (man / husband) may parar (make) it void.

But if her ayash (man / husband) kal (every) hold his peace at her from shabawaih (day) to shabawaih (day), then he establishes all her nadar (vow), or all her asar (bonds), which are on her: he has qawam (rise up) them, because he held his peace at her in the shabawaih (day) that he heard them.
But if he shall qawam (rise up) them null and void al (toward) that he has shamai (hearken / hear) them, then he shall bear her iniquity."
These are the statutes, which Yahawah commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father's house.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),
"Naqam (avenge) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) for the Madayanay (Midianites). Afterward you shall be asap (gathered) to your im (nation / people)."

Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "chalatz (arm) im (nation / people) from among you for the tzabaa (troop), that they may go against Madayan (Midian), to execute Yahawah vengeance on Madayan (Midian).
Of every matah (staff / rod / tribe) one alap (thousand), throughout all the matawath (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), you shall shalach (send) to the tzabaa (troop)."

So there were masar (delivered), out of the alapay (thousands) of Yashar-Al (Israel), a alap (thousand) of every matah (staff / rod / tribe), shanayam (two) alap (thousand) chalatz (armed) for tzabaa (troop).

Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) them, one alap (thousand) of every matah (staff / rod / tribe), to the tzabaa (troop), them and Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), to the tzabaa (troop), with the kalay (vessels) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) and the chatzatzarawath (trumpets) for the tharawaih (alarm) in his yad (hand).
They tzabaa (troop) against Madayan (Midian), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses); and they harag (kill) every zakar (remember).

They harag (kill) the malakay (kings) of Madayan (Midian) with the rest of their chalal (slain): Away (Evi), and Raqam (Rekem), and Tzawar (Zur), and Chawar (Hur), and Rabai (Reba), the chamash (five) malakay (kings) of Madayan (Midian): Balaim (Balaam) also the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor) they harag (kill) with the charab (sword).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shabah (took) captive the nashay (women) of Madayan (Midian) and their little tap (ones); and all their livestock, and all their maqanah (flocks), and all their chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), they bazaz (took) for a prey.
All their iyar (cities) in the mawashab (places) in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burnt with ash (fire).
They laqach (take / seize) all the shalal (spoil), and all the malaqawach (prey), both of adam (man) and of animal.

They bawaa (come) the shabay (captives), and the malaqawach (prey), and the shalal (spoil), to Mashah (Moses), and to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to the idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to the machanah (camp) at the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab), which are by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).

Mashah (Moses), and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and all the nashayaay (princes) of the idah (congregation), yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to qaraah (meet) them outside of the machanah (camp).

Mashah (Moses) was qatzap (angry) with the paqawaday (officers) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands) and the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), who bawaa (come) from the service of the malachamah (war).
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to them, "Have you chayah (saved) all the women chayah (alive)?

Behold, these hayah (came to pass) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), through the dabar (word / matter) of Balaim (Balaam), to masar (commit) mail (top/above) against Yahawah in the dabar (word / matter) of Paiwar (Peor), and so the magapah (plague) was among the idah (congregation) of Yahawah.
Now therefore harag (kill) every zakar (remember) among the little tap (ones), and harag (kill) every ayashah (woman / wife) who yadai (has) known ayash (man / husband) by lying with him.
But all the girls, who yadai (have) not known zakar (remember) by lying with him, chayah (keep) alive for yourselves.

"Chanah (encamp) outside of the machanah (camp) shabai (seven) yamayam (days): whoever has harag (kill) any napash (soul), and whoever has nagai (touched) any chalal (slain), chataa (purify) yourselves on the shalayashay (third) yawam (day) and on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), you and your shabay (captives).

As to every bagad (garment), and all that is kalay (made) of iwar (skin), and all maishah (work) of izayam (goats)' hair, and all things kalay (made) of itz (wood), you shall chataa (purify) yourselves."

Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) amar (spoke) to the anashay (men) of tzabaa (troop) who bawaa (come) to the malachamah (battle), "This is the chaqah (statute) of the thawarah (instruction) which Yahawah has tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses):
However the zahab (gold), and the kasap (silver), the nachashath (brass), the barazal (iron), the badayal (divide), and the iwaparath (lead),

Everything that may withstand the ash (fire), you shall ibar (pass over/through) to go through the ash (fire), and it shall be tahar (clean); nevertheless it shall be chataa (purified) with the mayam (Waters) for impurity: and all that doesn't withstand the ash (fire) you shall ibar (pass over/through) to go through the mayam (Waters).
You shall kabas (wash) your clothes on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), and you shall be tahar (clean); and afterward you shall bawaa (come) into the machanah (camp)."
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Nashaa (lift) the raash (head) of the malaqawach (prey) that shabay (was) taken, both of adam (man) and of animal, you, and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the idah (congregation);

And chatzah (divide) the malaqawach (prey) into chatzah (two) parts: between the men skilled in malachamah (war), who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop), and all the idah (congregation).

Rawam (will lift up) a makas (tribute) to Yahawah of the anashay (men) of malachamah (war) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop): achad (one) napash (soul) of chamash (five) maah (hundred); of the adam (persons), of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the tzaan (flocks).
Laqach (take / seize) it of their machatzayath (half), and nathan (give) it to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), for Yahawah wave tharawamah (offering).

Of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel's) machatzayath (half), you shall laqach (take / seize) achad (one) drawn out of every chamashayam (fifty), of the adam (persons), of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the tzaan (flocks), of all the livestock, and nathan (give) them to the Lawayay (Levites), who perform the duty of the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah."
Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

Now the baz (prey), over and above the malaqawach (booty) which the im (nation / people) of tzabaa (troop) bazaz (took), was shash (six) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep),
And shabaiyam (seventy) - two alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle,
And shashayam (sixty) - achad (one) alap (thousand) donkeys,
And shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) napash (soul) in kal (every), of the nashayam (women) who yadai (had) not known zakar (remember) by lying with him.

The machatzah (half), which was the chalaq (portion) of those who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop), was in masapar (number) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) tzaan (sheep):
And Yahawah makas (tribute) of the tzaan (sheep) was shash (six) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - five.
The cattle were shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) alap (thousand); of which Yahawah makas (tribute) was shabaiyam (seventy) - two.
The donkeys were shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred); of which Yahawah makas (tribute) was shashayam (sixty) - achad (one).
The adam (persons) were sixteen alap (thousand); of whom Yahawah makas (tribute) was shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) napash (soul).
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) the makas (tribute), which was Yahawah wave tharawamah (offering), to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel's) machatzayath (half), which Mashah (Moses) chatzah (divided) off from the banay (men) who tzabaa (troop)
(Now the idah (congregation's) machatzah (half) was shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) tzaan (sheep),
And shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle,
And shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand) chamash (five) maah (hundred) donkeys,
And sixteen alap (thousand) napash (soul)),

Even of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel's) machatzayath (half), Mashah (Moses) laqach (take / seize) achad (one) drawn out of every chamashayam (fifty), both of adam (man) and of animal, and nathan (give) them to the Lawayay (Levites), who performed the duty of the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah; as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

The paqadayam (officers) who were over the alapay (thousands) of the tzabaa (troop), the sharay (captains) of alapay (thousands), and the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), qarab (come close) near to Mashah (Moses);

And they amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "Your ibad (servant) have nashaa (lift) the raash (head) of the raash (head) of malachamah (war) who are under our command, and there paqad (visit) not one ayash (man / husband) of us.

We have qarab (come close) Yahawah qaraban (offering), what every ayash (man / husband) matzaa (has) gotten, of kalay (jewels) of zahab (gold), armlets, and tzamayad (bracelets), signet tabaith (rings), igayal (earrings), and necklaces, to make kapar (atonement) for our napash (soul) panayam (face) Yahawah."
Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) laqach (take / seize) their zahab (gold), even all maishah (worked) kalay (jewels).

All the zahab (gold) of the wave tharawamah (offering) that they rawam (will lift up) up to Yahawah, of the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands), and of the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), was sixteen alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) shaqal (shekels).
(The anashay (men) of tzabaa (troop) had bazaz (taken) booty, every ayash (man / husband) for himself.)

Mashah (Moses) and Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) laqach (take / seize) the zahab (gold) of the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands) and of maawath (hundreds), and bawaa (come) it into the ahal (tent) of Meeting, for a zakarawan (memorial) for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) panayam (face) Yahawah.

Now the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) had a very itzawam (great) rab (multitude) of livestock: and when they raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land) of Yaizayar (Jazer), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), that behold, the maqawam (place) was a maqawam (place) for livestock;

The banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) bawaa (come) and amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), and to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to the nashayaay (princes) of the idah (congregation), amar (spoke),
"Itarawath (Ataroth), and Dayabawan (Dibon), and Yaizayar (Jazer), and Namarah (Nimrah), and Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Alailaa (Elealeh), and Shabam (Sebam), and Nabaw (Nebo), and Bain (Beon),
The aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah nakah (struck) panayam (face) the idah (congregation) of Yashar-Al (Israel), is a aratz (Earth/land) for livestock; and your ibad (servant) have livestock."

They amar (spoke), "If we matzaa (have) found favor in your iyan (eye), let this aratz (Earth/land) be nathan (give) to your ibad (servant) for a achazah (possession); don't ibar (pass over/through) us over the Yaradan (Jordan)."

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), and to the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), "Shall your ach (brother/kinsman) bawaa (come) to the malachamah (war), and shall you yashab (inhabit/dwell) here?
Why do you discourage the lab (heart) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) from ibar (pass over/through) over into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah nathan (give) given them?
Your ab (father) ishah (make) so when I shalach (send) them from Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh) Barnea to raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land).

For when they ilah (go up / offer) up to the nachal (stream / river) of Ashakal (Eshcol), and raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), they nawaa (discouraged) the lab (heart) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that they should not bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah nathan (give) given them.
Yahawah ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) in that yawam (day), and he shabai (swear / take oath), amar (spoke),

‘Am (mother) none of the anashayam (men) who ilah (go up / offer) up out of Matzarayam (Egypt), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, shall raah (see) the adamah (land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob); because they malaa (have) not wholly achar (other) me:
Except Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) the Qanazay (Kenizzite), and Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun); because they have achar (other) Yahawah completely.'

Yahawah ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against Yashar-Al (Israel), and he nawai (made) them wander back and forth in the madabar (wilderness) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years), until all the dawar (generation / age / period), who ishah (make) done rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, was thamam (consumed).

"Behold, you have qawam (rise up) up in your ab (father)' place, an tharabawath (increase) of chataa (sinful) anashayam (men), to sapah (augment) yet the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah toward Yashar-Al (Israel).
For if you shawab (turn back / repent) away from achar (other) him, he will yet again yanach (leave) them in the madabar (wilderness); and you will shachath (destroy) all this im (nation / people)."
They nagash (came) near to him, and amar (spoke), "We will banah (build) sheepfolds here for our livestock, and irayam (cities) for our little tap (ones):

But we anachanaw (we) will be chawash (ready) chalatz (armed) to go panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), until we bawaa (come) brought them to their maqawam (place): and our little tap (ones) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the fortified iray (cities) panayam (face) of the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land).
We will not shawab (turn back / repent) to our bayath (house), until the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nachal (have) inherited every ayash (man / husband) his nachalah (inheritance).

For we will not nachal (inherit) with them on the other ibar (side) of the Yaradan (Jordan), and halaah (forward); because our nachalah (inheritance) is bawaa (come) to us on ibar (this) side of the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward."
Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to them, "If you will ishah (make) this thing, if you will chalatz (arm) yourselves to go panayam (face) Yahawah to the malachamah (war),
And every chalatz (armed) ibar (pass over/through) of you will pass over the Yaradan (Jordan) panayam (face) Yahawah, until he has yarash (driven) out his ayab (enemy) from panayam (face) him,

And the aratz (Earth/land) is kabash (subdued) panayam (face) Yahawah; then afterward you shall shawab (turn back / repent), and be naqay (guiltless) towards Yahawah, and towards Yashar-Al (Israel); and this aratz (Earth/land) shall be to you for a achazah (possession) panayam (face) Yahawah.
"But if you will not ishah (make) so, behold, you have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah; and be yadai (sure) your chataah (sin) will matzaa (find) you out.
Banah (build) irayam (cities) for your little tap (ones), and folds for your tzanaa (sheep); and ishah (make) that which yatzaa (go out / come out) proceeded out of your pah (mouth)."
The banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke), "Your ibad (servant) will ishah (make) as my Adawan tzawah (commands).
Our little tap (ones), our wives, our maqanah (flocks), and all our livestock, shall be there in the iray (cities) of Galaid (Gilead);
But your ibad (servant) will ibar (pass over/through) over, every chalatz (man) who is armed for tzabaa (troop), panayam (face) Yahawah to malachamah (battle), as my Adawan dabar (word / matter)."

So Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) concerning them to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and to the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the matawath (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Mashah (Moses) amar (spoke) to them, "If the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) will ibar (pass over/through) with you over the Yaradan (Jordan), every chalatz (man) who is armed to malachamah (battle), panayam (face) Yahawah, and the aratz (Earth/land) shall be kabash (subdued) panayam (face) you; then you shall nathan (give) them the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) for a achazah (possession):
But if they will not ibar (pass over/through) over with you chalatz (armed), they shall have naachazaw (possessions) thawak (midst) you in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan)."

The banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) inah (answer / respond), amar (spoke), "As Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant), so will we ishah (make).

We will ibar (pass over/through) over chalatz (armed) panayam (face) Yahawah into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and the achazah (possession) of our nachalah (inheritance) shall remain with us ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan)."

Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) to them, even to the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), and to the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), and to the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph), the mamalakah (kingdom) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), and the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), the aratz (Earth/land), according to its iray (cities) and gabalath (borders), even the iray (cities) of the surrounding aratz (Earth/land).
The banay (children) of Gad (Gad) banah (build) Dayabawan (Dibon), and Itarawath (Ataroth), and Irawair (Aroer),
And Itarawathashawapan (Atrothshophan), and Yaizayar (Jazer), and Yagabahah (Jogbehah),
And Bayathanamarah (Beth Nimrah), and Bayathaharan (Beth Haran): fortified iray (cities), and folds for tzaan (sheep).
The banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) banah (build) Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Alailaa (Elealeh), and Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim),
And Nabaw (Nebo), and Bailamaiwan (Baal Meon), (their shamath (names) being changed), and Shabam (Sibmah): and they gave other shamath (names) to the irayam (cities) which they banah (build).
The banay (children) of Makayar (Machir) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) yalak (went) to Galaid (Gilead), and lakad (took) it, and yarash (dispossessed) the Amaray (Amorites) who were therein.
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) Galaid (Gilead) to Makayar (Machir) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh); and he lived therein.
Yaayar (Jair) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) halak (move) and lakad (took) its chawah (town/named location), and qaraa (called) them Havvoth chawawathayaiyar (jair).
Nabach (Nobah) halak (move) and lakad (took) Qanath (Kenath), and its banath (daughter), and qaraa (called) it Nabach (Nobah), after his own sham (name).

These are the masaiy (journeys) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) by their tzabaa (troop) under the yad (hand) of Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron).

Mashah (Moses) kathab (write) their mawatzaa (goings) out according to their masai (journeys) by the commandment of Yahawah: and these are their masai (journeys) according to their mawatzaa (goings) out.

They traveled from Raimasas (Rameses) in the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the fifteenth yawam (day) of the raashawan (first) chadash (month); on the next macharath (day) after the pasach (passover) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) yatzaa (go out / come out) out with a rawam (will lift up) yad (hand) in the iyan (eye) of all the Ban (Egyptians),
While the Matzaray (Egyptians) were qabar (bury) all their bakawar (firstborn), whom Yahawah had nakah (struck) among them: on their Alahayam also Yahawah ishah (make) shapatayam (judgments).
The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) traveled from Raimasas (Rameses), and chanah (encamped) in Sakawath (Succoth).
They traveled from Sakawath (Succoth), and chanah (encamped) in Atham (Etham), which is in the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the madabar (wilderness).

They traveled from Atham (Etham), and shawab (turn back / repent) back to Payahachayarath (Pihahiroth), which is before Bailatzapawan (Baal Zephon): and they chanah (encamped) panayam (face) Magadawal (Migdol).

They traveled from panayam (face) Hahiroth, and passed ibar (pass over/through) the thawak (midst) of the yam (sea/waters) into the madabar (wilderness): and they yalak (went) shalawash (three) yamayam (days)' darak (journey) in the madabar (wilderness) of Atham (Etham), and chanah (encamped) in Marah (Marah).

They traveled from Marah (Marah), and bawaa (come) to Ayalam (Elim): and in Ayalam (Elim) were shanayam (two) springs of mayam (Waters), and shabaiyam (seventy) thamar (palm) trees; and they chanah (encamped) there.
They traveled from Ayalam (Elim), and chanah (encamped) by the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).
They traveled from the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of sayan (sin).
They traveled from the madabar (wilderness) of sayan (sin), and chanah (encamped) in Dapaqah (Dophkah).
They traveled from Dapaqah (Dophkah), and chanah (encamped) in Alawash (Alush).
They traveled from Alawash (Alush), and chanah (encamped) in Rapayadayam (Rephidim), where there was no mayam (Waters) for the im (nation / people) to shathah (drinks).
They traveled from Rapayadayam (Rephidim), and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai).
They traveled from the madabar (wilderness) of Sayanay (Sinai), and chanah (encamped) in Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth Hattaavah).
They traveled from Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth Hattaavah), and chanah (encamped) in Chatzarawath (Hazeroth).
They traveled from Chatzarawath (Hazeroth), and chanah (encamped) in Rathamah (Rithmah).
They traveled from Rathamah (Rithmah), and chanah (encamped) in Ramanaparatz (Rimmon Perez).
They traveled from Ramanaparatz (Rimmon Perez), and chanah (encamped) in Labanah (Libnah).
They traveled from Labanah (Libnah), and chanah (encamped) in Rasah (Rissah).
They traveled from Rasah (Rissah), and chanah (encamped) in Qahalathah (Kehelathah).
They traveled from Qahalathah (Kehelathah), and chanah (encamped) in har (mountain) Shapar (Shepher).
They traveled from har (mountain) Shapar (Shepher), and chanah (encamped) in Charadah (Haradah).
They traveled from Charadah (Haradah), and chanah (encamped) in Maqahalath (Makheloth).
They traveled from Maqahalath (Makheloth), and chanah (encamped) in Thachath (Tahath).
They traveled from Thachath (Tahath), and chanah (encamped) in Tharach (Terah).
They traveled from Tharach (Terah), and chanah (encamped) in Mathaqah (Mithkah).
They traveled from Mathaqah (Mithkah), and chanah (encamped) in Chashamanah (Hashmonah).
They traveled from Chashamanah (Hashmonah), and chanah (encamped) in Mawasarah (Moseroth).
They traveled from Mawasarah (Moseroth), and chanah (encamped) in Banayayaiqan (Bene Jaakan).
They traveled from Banayayaiqan (Bene Jaakan), and chanah (encamped) in Charahagadagad (Hor Haggidgad).
They traveled from Charahagadagad (Hor Haggidgad), and chanah (encamped) in Yatabathah (Jotbathah).
They traveled from Yatabathah (Jotbathah), and chanah (encamped) in Ibaranah (Abronah).
They traveled from Ibaranah (Abronah), and chanah (encamped) in Itzayawanagabar (Ezion Geber).
They traveled from Itzayawanagabar (Ezion Geber), and chanah (encamped) in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) (the same is Qadash (Kadesh)).
They traveled from Qadash (Kadesh), and chanah (encamped) in har (mountain) Har (Hor), in the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Adawam (Edom).

Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) ilah (go up / offer) up into har (mountain) Har (Hor) at the commandment of Yahawah, and mawath (death) there, in the fortieth shanah (year) after the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) yatzaa (go out / come out) come out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the month.
Aharawan (Aaron) was one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) when he mawath (death) in har (mountain) Har (Hor).

The Kanainay (Canaanite), the malak (king) of Irad (Arad), who lived in the nagab (south) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), shamai (hearken / hear) of the bawaa (come) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
They traveled from har (mountain) Har (Hor), and chanah (encamped) in Tzalamanah (Zalmonah).
They traveled from Tzalamanah (Zalmonah), and chanah (encamped) in Pawanan (Punon).
They traveled from Pawanan (Punon), and chanah (encamped) in Abath (Oboth).
They traveled from Abath (Oboth), and chanah (encamped) in Iye Iyayahaibarayam (Abarim), in the gabawal (border/boundary) of Mawaab (Moab).
They traveled from Iyayam (Iyim), and chanah (encamped) in Dayabawan (Dibon Gad).
They traveled from Dayabawan (Dibon Gad), and chanah (encamped) in Ilamanadabalathayamah (Almon Diblathaim).
They traveled from Ilamanadabalathayamah (Almon Diblathaim), and chanah (encamped) in the haray (mountains) of Ibarayam (Abarim), panayam (face) Nabaw (Nebo).
They traveled from the haray (mountains) of Ibarayam (Abarim), and chanah (encamped) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).
They chanah (encamped) by the Yaradan (Jordan), from Bayathahayashayamawath (Beth Jeshimoth) even to Abalahashatayam (Abel Shittim) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), amar (spoke),

Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, "When you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan),

Then you shall yarash (drive) out all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) from panayam (face) you, abad (destroy / perish) all their mashakayath (idol / carved image) idols, abad (destroy / perish) all their masakah (molten) tzalamay (images), and demolish all their bamah (high) places.
You shall take yarash (possession) of the aratz (Earth/land), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein; for I nathan (give) given the aratz (Earth/land) to you to yarash (possess) it.

You shall nachal (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land) by gawaral (lot) according to your mashapachah (tribe / clan / family); to the more you shall give the more nachalah (inheritance), and to the fewer you shall mait (give) the less nachalah (inheritance): wherever the gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) to any man, that shall be his. You shall nachal (inherit) according to the matawath (tribes) of your ab (father).

"But if you do not yarash (drive) out the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) from panayam (face) you, then those you yathar (let) remain of them will be as shakayam (pricks) in your iyan (eye) and as tzanayanam (thorns) in your tzad (sides), and they will harass you in the aratz (Earth/land) in which you yashab (inhabit/dwell).
It shall happen that as I damah (thought) to ishah (make) to them, so will I ishah (make) to you."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Tzawah (command) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘When you bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) (this is the aratz (Earth/land) that shall napal (fall / be cast down) to you for an nachalah (inheritance), even the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) according to its gabawalah (borders)),

Then your nagab (south) paah (quarter) shall be from the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) along by the yad (hand) of Adawam (Edom), and your nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary) shall be from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters) eastward;

And your gabawal (border/boundary) shall sabab (turn) about southward of the mailahaiqarabayam (ascent) of mailahaiqarabayam (akrabbim), and ibar (pass over/through) along to Tzan (Zin); and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be southward of Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea); and it shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to Chatzaraadar (Hazar Addar), and ibar (pass over/through) along to Itzamawan (Azmon);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall sabab (turn) about from Itzamawan (Azmon) to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be at the yam (sea/waters).

"‘For the western gabawal (border/boundary), you shall have the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) and its gabawal (border/boundary): this shall be your yam (sea/waters) gabawal (border/boundary).
"‘This shall be your tzapawan (north) gabawal (border/boundary): from the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) you shall mark out for you har (mountain) Har (Hor);
From har (mountain) Har (Hor) you shall mark out to the entrance of Chamath (Hamath); and the thawatzaath (goings) out of the gabawal (border/boundary) shall be at Tzadad (Zedad);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to Zaparan (Ziphron), and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be at Chatzar-Iyanan (Hazar Enan): this shall be your tzapawan (north) gabawal (border/boundary).
"‘You shall mark out your qadam (east) gabawal (border/boundary) from Chatzar-Iyanan (Hazar Enan) to Shapam (Shepham);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yarad (go) down from Shapam (Shepham) to Rabalah (Riblah), on the qadam (east) side of Iyan (Ain); and the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yarad (go) down, and shall machah (reach) to the kathap (side) of the yam (sea/waters) of Kanarawath (Chinnereth) eastward;

And the gabawal (border/boundary) shall yarad (go) down to the Yaradan (Jordan), and the thawatzaah (goings) out of it shall be at the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters). This shall be your aratz (Earth/land) according to its gabawalah (borders) around it.'"

Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "This is the aratz (Earth/land) which you shall nachal (inherit) by gawaral (lot), which Yahawah has tzawah (commanded) to nathan (give) to the thashai (nine) matawath (tribes), and to the chatzay (half) - matah (staff / rod / tribe);

For the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of raawabanay (reuben) according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), and the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of gaday (gad) according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), have laqach (take / seize), and the chatzay (half) - matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh) have laqach (take / seize), their nachalah (inheritance):

The shanayam (two) matawath (tribes) and the chatzay (half) - matah (staff / rod / tribe) have laqach (take / seize) their nachalah (inheritance) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho) eastward, toward the sunrise."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"These are the shamawath (names) of the anashayam (men) who shall nachal (divide) the aratz (Earth/land) to you for inheritance: Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun).
You shall laqach (take / seize) achad (one) nashayaa (prince) of every matah (staff / rod / tribe), to nachal (divide) the aratz (Earth/land) for nachal (inheritance).
These are the shamawath (names) of the anashayam (men): Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), Shamawaal (Shemuel) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Alayadad (Elidad) the ban (son) of Kasalawan (Chislon).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan) a nashayaa (prince), Baqay (Bukki) the ban (son) of Yagalay (Jogli).
Of the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph): of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) a nashayaa (prince), Chanayaal (Hanniel) the ban (son) of apad (ephod).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim) a nashayaa (prince), Qamawaal (Kemuel) the ban (son) of Shapatan (Shiphtan).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) a nashayaa (prince), Alayatzapan (Elizaphan) the ban (son) of Paranak (Parnach).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yashashakar (Issachar) a nashayaa (prince), Palatayaal (Paltiel) the ban (son) of Izan (Azzan).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher) a nashayaa (prince), Achayahawad (Ahihud) the ban (son) of Shalamay (Shelomi).
Of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali) a nashayaa (prince), Padahaal (Pedahel) the ban (son) of Imayahawad (Ammihud)."
These are they whom Yahawah tzawah (commanded) to divide the nachal (inheritance) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), amar (spoke),

"Tzawah (command) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) that they nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites) of the nachalah (inheritance) of their achazah (possession) irayam (cities) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in; and you shall nathan (give) magarash (suburbs) for the irayam (cities) around them to the Lawayay (Levites).

The irayam (cities) shall they have to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in; and their magarash (suburbs) shall be for their livestock, and for their rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and for all their animals.

"The magarashay (suburbs) of the irayam (cities), which you shall nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites), shall be from the qayar (wall) of the iyar (city) and outward one alap (thousand) amah (cubits) around it.

You shall madad (measure) outside of the iyar (city) for the qadam (east) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), and for the nagab (south) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), and for the yam (sea/waters) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), and for the tzapawan (north) paah (side) two alap (thousand) amah (cubits), the iyar (city) being in the thawak (midst). This shall be to them the magarashay (suburbs) of the irayam (cities).

"The irayam (cities) which you shall nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites), they shall be the shash (six) irayam (cities) of maqalat (refuge), which you shall nathan (give) for the manslayer to nawas (flee) to: and besides them you shall nathan (give) arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two) irayam (cities).
All the irayam (cities) which you shall nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites) shall be arabaiyam (forty) - shamanah (eight) irayam (cities) together with their magarash (suburbs).

Concerning the irayam (cities) which you shall nathan (give) of the achazah (possession) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), from the many you shall take many; and from the mait (few) you shall take mait (few): everyone pah (according) to his nachalah (inheritance) which he yanachalaw (inherits) shall nathan (give) of his irayam (cities) to the Lawayay (Levites)."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke),

"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) them, ‘When you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan),

Then you shall qarah (appoint) you irayam (cities) to be irayam (cities) of maqalat (refuge) for you, that the manslayer who nakah (kills) any napash (soul) shagagah (unwittingly) may nawas (flee) there.

The irayam (cities) shall be to you for maqalat (refuge) from the gaal (avenger), that the manslayer not mawath (death), until he imad (stands) panayam (face) the idah (congregation) for mashapat (judgment).
The irayam (cities) which you shall nathan (give) shall be for you shash (six) irayam (cities) of maqalat (refuge).

You shall nathan (give) shalawash (three) irayam (cities) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), and you shall nathan (give) shalawash (three) irayam (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan); they shall be irayam (cities) of maqalat (refuge).

For the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and for the gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) and for the foreigner living thawak (midst) them, shall these shash (six) irayam (cities) be for maqalat (refuge); that everyone who nakah (kills) any napash (soul) shagagah (unwittingly) may nawas (flee) there.

"‘But if he nakah (struck) him with an kalay (instrument) of barazal (iron), so that he mawath (death), he is a ratzach (murderer): the ratzach (murderer) shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).

If he nakah (struck) him with a aban (stone) in the yad (hand), by which a mawath (death) may die, and he mawath (death), he is a ratzach (murderer): the ratzach (murderer) shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).
