Or if he nakah (struck) him with a kalay (weapon) of itz (wood) in the yad (hand), by which a mawath (death) may die, and he mawath (death), he is a ratzach (murderer): the ratzach (murderer) shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).
The avenger of dam (blood) shall himself ratzach (put) the murderer to mawath (death): when he pagai (meets) him, he shall put him to mawath (death).
If he hadap (thrust) him of hatred, or shalak (hurled) at him, tzadayah (lying) in wait, so that he mawath (death),

Or in enmity nakah (struck) him with his yad (hand), so that he mawath (death); he who nakah (struck) him shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death); he is a ratzach (murderer): the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) shall ratzach (put) the murderer to mawath (death), when he pagai (meets) him.
"‘But if he hadap (thrust) him pathai (suddenly) laa (NOT) enmity, or shalak (hurled) on him anything without tzadayah (lying) in wait,

Or with any aban (stone), by which a mawath (death) may die, not seeing him, and napal (fall / be cast down) it on him, so that he mawath (death), and he was not his ayab (enemy), neither baqash (sought) his rai (harm);
Then the idah (congregation) shall shapat (judge / judgement) between the striker and the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) according to these mashapatayam (ordinances);

And the idah (congregation) shall natzal (deliver) the manslayer out of the yad (hand) of the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood), and the idah (congregation) shall shawab (turn back / repent) him to his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), where he was nawas (fled): and he shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein until the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), who was mashach (anointed) with the qadash (set apart / make holy) shaman (oil).
"‘But if the manslayer shall at any yatzaa (go out / come out) yatzaa (go out / come out) beyond the gabawal (border/boundary) of his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), where he nawas (flees),

And the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) matzaa (find) him outside of the gabawal (border/boundary) of his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), and the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) ratzach (kill) the manslayer; he shall not be guilty of dam (blood),

Because he should have yashab (inhabit/dwell) in his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) until the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest): but achar (other) the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) the manslayer shall shawab (turn back / repent) into the aratz (Earth/land) of his achazah (possession).
"‘These things shall be for a chaqah (statute) and mashapat (ordinance) to you throughout your dawar (generation / age / period) in all your mawashab (dwellings).

"‘Whoever nakah (kills) any napash (soul), the ratzach (murderer) shall be ratzach (slain) at the pah (mouth) of witnesses: but achad (one) id (until / as far as) shall not inah (answer / respond) against any napash (soul) that he mawath (death).

"‘Moreover you shall laqach (take / seize) no kapar (ransom) for the napash (soul) of a ratzach (murderer) who is rashai (guilty) of mawath (death); but he shall mawath (death) be put to mawath (death).

"‘You shall laqach (take / seize) no kapar (ransom) for him who is nawas (fled) to his iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge), that he may shawab (turn back / repent) again to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land), until the mawath (death) of the kahan (priest).

"‘So you shall not chanap (pollute) the aratz (Earth/land) in which you are: for dam (blood), it thachanayapaw (pollutes) the aratz (Earth/land); and no expiation can be made for the aratz (Earth/land) for the dam (blood) that is shapak (shed) therein, but by the dam (blood) of him who shapak (shed) it.

You shall not tamaa (defile) the aratz (Earth/land) which you yashab (inhabit/dwell), in the thawak (midst) of which I shakan (place): for I, Yahawah, shakan (place) in the midst of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).'"

The raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the banay (children) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), of the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Yawasap (Joseph), qarab (come close) near, and dabar (word / matter) panayam (face) Mashah (Moses), and panayam (face) the nashaayam (princes), the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel):

And they amar (spoke), "Yahawah tzawah (commanded) my Adawan to nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) for nachalah (inheritance) by gawaral (lot) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): and my Adawan was tzawah (commanded) by Yahawah to nathan (give) the nachalah (inheritance) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) our ach (brother/kinsman) to his banath (daughter).

If they are married to any of the banay (sons) of the other shabatay (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), then will their nachalah (inheritance) be taken away from the nachalah (inheritance) of our ab (father), and will be yasap (added) to the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) whereunto they shall belong: so will it be taken away from the gawaral (lot) of our nachalah (inheritance).

When the yawabal (jubilee) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall be, then will their nachalah (inheritance) be yasap (added) to the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) whereunto they shall belong: so will their nachalah (inheritance) be taken garai (away) from the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of our ab (father)."

Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) according to the pah (word) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), "The matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (sons) of Yawasap (Joseph) dabarayam (speaks) right.

This is the thing which Yahawah does tzawah (command) concerning the banawath (daughters) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), amar (spoke), Let them be married to whom they iyan (eye) tawab (good / proper function); only into the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of their ab (father) shall they be married.

So shall no nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) sabab (remove) from matah (staff / rod / tribe) to matah (staff / rod / tribe); for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall all dabaq (keep) the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of his ab (father).

Every banath (daughter) who possesses an nachalah (inheritance) in any matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall be ayashah (woman / wife) to achad (one) of the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of her ab (father), that the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) may yarash (possess) every ayash (man / husband) the nachalah (inheritance) of his ab (father).

So shall no nachalah (inheritance) sabab (remove) from one matah (staff / rod / tribe) to achar (other) matah (staff / rod / tribe); for the matawath (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shall ayash (man / husband) dabaq (keep) his own nachalah (inheritance)."
The banawath (daughters) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses):

For Machalah (Mahlah), Tharatzah (Tirzah), and Chagalah (Hoglah), and Malakah (Milcah), and Naih (Noah), the banawath (daughters) of Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), were married to their dawad (father's) brothers' banay (sons).

They were married into the mashapachath (families) of the banay (sons) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph); and their nachalah (inheritance) remained in the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of their ab (father).

These are the matzawath (commandments) and the mashapatayam (ordinances) which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) by the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho).

These are the dabarayam (words) which Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to all Yashar-Al (Israel) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) in the madabar (wilderness), in the irabah (arabah) over mawal (against) Suph, between Paaran (Paran), and Thapal (Tophel), and Laban (Laban), and Chatzarawath (Hazeroth), and Dayazahab (Dizahab).
It is achad (one) yawam (day)' journey from Charab (Horeb) by the darak (way) of har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir) to Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea).

It happened in the fortieth shanah (year), in the ishathay (eleven) chadash (month), on the achad (one) day of the chadash (month), that Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), according to all that Yahawah had tzawah (given) him in commandment to them;

Achar (other) he had nakah (struck) Sayachawan (Sihon) the malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived in Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Iwag (Og) the malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), who lived in Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth), at Adaraiy (Edrei).
Ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), yaal (began) Mashah (Moses) to baar (declare) this thawarah (instruction), amar (spoke),
"Yahawah our Alahayam dabar (word / matter) to us in Charab (Horeb), amar (spoke), You have lived rab (long) enough in this har (mountain):

Panah (turn), and take your nasai (journey), and bawaa (come) to the har (mountain) country of the Amaray (Amorites), and to all the places near there, in the irabah (arabah), in the har (mountain) shapalah (country), and in the lowland, and in the nagab (south), and by the seashore, the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kanainay (Canaanites), and Labanawan (Lebanon), as gadawal (very great/important/mighty) as the great nahar (river), the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates).

Raah (see), I nathan (give) set the aratz (Earth/land) panayam (face) you: bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), to nathan (give) to them and to their zarai (seed) achar (other) them."
I amar (spoke) to you at that ith (time), amar (spoke), "I am not yakal (able) to nashaa (lift) you myself bad (alone):
Yahawah your Alahayam rabah (has) multiplied you, and behold, you are this yawam (day) as the kawakabay (stars) of the sky for rab (multitude).
Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), make you a alap (thousand) paimayam (times) as many as you are, and barak (blessed) you, as he has dabar (word / matter) you!
Ayak (how) can I myself alone nashaa (lift) your encumbrance, and your mashaa (burden), and your rayab (strife)?
Yahab (take) chakam (wise) anashayam (men) of bayan (between) and well yadai (known) according to your shabat (tribes), and I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them raash (head) over you."
You inah (answer / respond) me, and amar (spoke), "The thing which you have amar (spoke) is tawab (good / proper function) to ishah (make)."

So I laqach (take / seize) the raashay (heads) of your shabat (tribes), chakam (wise) raashay (men), and yadai (known), and nathan (give) them raashay (heads) over you, sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands), and sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), and sharay (captains) of chamashayam (fifties), and sharay (captains) of isharath (tens), and shatarayam (officers), according to your shabat (tribes).

I tzawah (commanded) your shapatatham (judges) at that ith (time), amar (spoke), "shamai (hearken / hear) cases between your ach (brother/kinsman), and shapat (judge / judgement) righteously between a ayash (man / husband) and his ach (brother/kinsman), and the foreigner who is living with him.

You shall not show partiality in mashapat (judgment); you shall shamai (hearken / hear) the qatan (small / young / least) and the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) alike; you shall not be gawar (afraid) of the panayam (face) of ayash (man / husband); for the mashapat (judgment) is Alahayam. The dabar (word / matter) that is too qashah (rough / hard) for you, you shall qarab (come close) to me, and I will shamai (hearken / hear) it."
I tzawah (commanded) you at that ith (time) all the things which you should ishah (make).

We traveled from Charab (Horeb), and yalak (went) through all that gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and yaraa (fear / be afraid) madabar (wilderness) which you raah (see), by the darak (way) to the har (mountain) country of the Amaray (Amorites), as Yahawah our Alahayam tzawah (commanded) us; and we bawaa (come) to Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea).
I amar (spoke) to you, "You bawaa (come) come to the har (mountain) country of the Amaray (Amorites), which Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) to us.

Raah (see), Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) set the aratz (Earth/land) panayam (face) you: ilah (go up / offer) up, take yarash (possession), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), has dabar (word / matter) to you; don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed)."

You qarab (come close) near to me everyone of you, and amar (spoke), "shalach (send) us send anashayam (men) panayam (face) us, that they may chapar (search) the aratz (Earth/land) for us, and shawab (turn back / repent) us dabar (word / matter) again of the darak (way) by which we must ilah (go up / offer) up, and the irayam (cities) to which we shall bawaa (come)."
The thing yatab (pleased) me well; and I laqach (take / seize) shanayam (two) anashayam (men) of you, achad (one) ayash (man / husband) for ayash (man / husband) tribe:
And they panah (turn) and ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country, and bawaa (come) to the nachal (stream / river) of Ashakal (Eshcol), and ragal (spied) it out.

They laqach (take / seize) of the paray (fruit) of the aratz (Earth/land) in their yad (hand), and yarad (brought) it down to us, and shawab (turn back / repent) us dabar (word / matter) again, and amar (spoke), "It is a tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) to us."
Yet you wouldn't ilah (go up / offer) up, but marah (rebelled) against the commandment of Yahawah your Alahayam:

And you ragan (murmured) in your ahal (tents), and amar (spoke), "Because Yahawah shanaah (hated) us, he yatzaa (go out / come out) brought us forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), to nathan (give) us into the yad (hand) of the Amaray (Amorites), to shamad (destroy) us.

Where are we ilah (go up / offer) up? Our ach (brother/kinsman) have made our labab (heart) to masas (melt), amar (spoke), ‘The im (nation / people) are greater and rawam (will lift up) than we; the irayam (cities) are gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and batzar (fortified) up to the sky; and moreover we raah (see) seen the banay (sons) of the inaqay (anakim) there.'"
Then I amar (spoke) to you, "Don't iratz (dread), neither be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them.
Yahawah your Alahayam who halak (move) panayam (face) you, he will lacham (fight) for you, according to all that he ishah (make) for you in Matzarayam (Egypt) before your iyan (eye),

And in the madabar (wilderness), where you raah (see) seen how that Yahawah your Alahayam nashaa (lift) you, as a ayash (man / husband) does nashaa (lift) his ban (son), in all the darak (way) that you halak (move), until you bawaa (come) to this maqawam (place)."
Yet in this thing you didn't aman (believe / have faith) Yahawah your Alahayam,

Who halak (move) panayam (face) you in the darak (way), to thawar (seek) you out a maqawam (place) to pitch your chanah (tents) in, in ash (fire) by layal (night), to show you by what darak (way) you should yalak (go), and in the inan (cloud) by yawamam (by day).
Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of your dabar (word / matter), and was qatzap (angry), and shabai (swear / take oath), amar (spoke),

"Surely not ayash (man / husband) of these anashayam (men) of this rai (evil) dawar (generation / age / period) shall raah (see) the tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land), which I shabai (swear / take oath) to nathan (give) to your ab (father),

Except Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh): he shall raah (see) it; and to him will I nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) that he has darak (trodden) on, and to his ban (son), because he malaa (has) wholly achar (other) Yahawah."
Also Yahawah was anap (angry) with me for your sakes, amar (spoke), "You also shall not bawaa (come) in there:

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), who imad (stands) panayam (face) you, he shall bawaa (come) in there: chazaq (encourage) you him; for he shall cause Yashar-Al (Israel) to nachal (inherit) it.

Moreover your little tap (ones), whom you amar (spoke) should be a baz (prey), and your ban (son), who this yawam (day) have no yadai (knowledge) of tawab (good / proper function) or rai (evil), they shall bawaa (come) in there, and to them will I nathan (give) it, and they shall yarash (possess) it.
But as for you, panah (turn), and take your nasai (journey) into the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way) to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters)."

Then you inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to me, "We have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, we will ilah (go up / offer) up and lacham (fight), according to all that Yahawah our Alahayam tzawah (commanded) us." Every ayash (man / husband) of you chagar (put) on his kalay (weapons) of malachamah (war), and presumed to ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "amar (spoke) them, ‘Don't ilah (go up / offer) up, neither lacham (fight); for I am not qarab (among / near) you; lest you be nagap (struck) panayam (face) your ayab (enemy).'"

So I dabar (word / matter) to you, and you didn't shamai (hearken / hear); but you marah (rebelled) against the commandment of Yahawah, and were presumptuous, and ilah (go up / offer) up into the har (mountain) country.

The Amaray (Amorites), who lived in that har (mountain) country, yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) you, and radap (chased) you, as dabarayam (bees) ishah (make), and kathath (beat) you down in Shaiyar (Seir), even to Charamah (Hormah).
You shawab (turn back / repent) and bakah (wept) panayam (face) Yahawah; but Yahawah didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to your qawal (sound / voice), nor azan (ear) ear to you.
So you stayed in Qadash (Kadesh) many yamayam (days), according to the yamayam (days) that you yashab (inhabit/dwell).

Then we panah (turn), and took our nasai (journey) into the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way) to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me; and we encircled har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir) many yamayam (days).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, amar (spoke),
"You have encircled this har (mountain) rab (long) enough. Panah (turn) northward.

Tzawah (command) the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), ‘You are to ibar (pass over/through) through the gabawal (border/boundary) of your ach (brother/kinsman) the banay (children) of Ishaw (Esau), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir); and they will be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of you: take maad (good) shamar (keep/guard) to yourselves therefore;

Don't garah (contend) with them; for I will not nathan (give) you of their aratz (Earth/land), no, not so much as for the sole of the ragal (feet / foot) to tread on; because I nathan (give) given har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir) to Ishaw (Esau) for a yarashah (possession).
You shall purchase akal (food) of them for kasap (money), that you may akal (eat); and you shall also karah (buy) mayam (Waters) of them for kasap (money), that you may shathah (drinks).'"

For Yahawah your Alahayam has barak (blessed) you in all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand); he yadai (has) known your yalak (walking) through this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) madabar (wilderness): these arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) Yahawah your Alahayam has been with you; you have chasar (lacked) nothing.

So we ibar (pass over/through) by from our ach (brother/kinsman) the banay (children) of Ishaw (Esau), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir), from the darak (way) of the irabah (arabah) from Ayalawath (Elath) and from Itzayawanagabar (Ezion Geber). We panah (turn) and ibar (pass over/through) by the darak (way) of the madabar (wilderness) of Mawaab (Moab).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Don't bother Mawaab (Moab), neither garah (contend) with them in malachamah (battle); for I will not nathan (give) you of his aratz (Earth/land) for a yarashah (possession); because I nathan (give) given Ir (Ar) to the banay (children) of Lawat (Lot) for a yarashah (possession)."
(The Ayamayam (Emim) lived therein panayam (face), a im (nation / people) gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and many, and rawam (will lift up), as the inaqay (anakim):
These also are chashab (accounted) Rapaa (Rephaim), as the inaqay (anakim); but the Mawaabay (Moabites) qaraa (called) them Ayamayam (Emim).

The Charay (Horites) also lived in Shaiyar (Seir) panayam (face), but the banay (children) of Ishaw (Esau) yarash (succeeded) them; and they destroyed them from panayam (face) them, and lived in their place; as Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) to the aratz (Earth/land) of his yarashah (possession), which Yahawah nathan (give) to them.)
"Now qawam (rise up) up, and cross over the nachal (stream / river) Zarad (Zered)." We ibar (pass over/through) over the nachal (stream / river) Zarad (Zered).

The yamayam (days) in which we halak (move) from Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea), until we had halak (move) over the nachal (stream / river) Zarad (Zered), were shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eight) shanah (years); until all the dawar (generation / age / period) of the halakanaw (men) of malachamah (war) were thamam (consumed) from the qarab (among / near) of the machanah (camp), as Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to them.
Moreover the yad (hand) of Yahawah was against them, to hamam (destroy) them from the qarab (among / near) of the machanah (camp), until they were thamam (consumed).
So it happened, when all the anashay (men) of malachamah (war) were thamam (consumed) and mawath (death) from qarab (among / near) the im (nation / people),
That Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke),
"You are this day to ibar (pass over/through) over Ir (Ar), the gabawal (border/boundary) of Mawaab (Moab):

And when you qarab (come close) near over mawal (against) the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon), don't bother them, nor garah (contend) with them; for I will not nathan (give) you of the aratz (Earth/land) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon) for a yarashah (possession); because I nathan (give) given it to the banay (children) of Lawat (Lot) for a yarashah (possession)."
(That also is chashab (accounted) a aratz (Earth/land) of Rapaa (Rephaim): Rapaa (Rephaim) lived therein panayam (face); but the Imawanay (Ammonites) qaraa (called) them Zamazam (Zamzummim),

A im (nation / people) gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and many, and rawam (will lift up), as the inaqay (anakim); but Yahawah destroyed them panayam (face) them; and they yarash (succeeded) them, and lived in their yashab (inhabit/dwell);

As he ishah (make) for the banay (children) of Ishaw (Esau), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir), when he destroyed the Charay (Horites) from panayam (face) them; and they yarash (succeeded) them, and lived in their place even to this yawam (day):

And the Iwayam (Avvim), who lived in villages as far as Izah (Gaza), the Kapatharay (Caphtorim), who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Kapathar (Caphtor), destroyed them, and lived in their yashab (inhabit/dwell).)

"Qawam (rise up) up, take your nasai (journey), and ibar (pass over/through) over the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon): raah (see), I nathan (give) given into your yad (hand) Sayachawan (Sihon) the Amaray (Amorite), malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), and his aratz (Earth/land); chalal (begin) to yarash (possess) it, and garah (contend) with him in malachamah (battle).

This yawam (day) will I chalal (begin) to nathan (give) the pachad (fear / dread) of you and the yaraah (fear) of you on the panay (peoples) who are under the whole sky, who shall shamai (hearken / hear) the shamai (report) of you, and shall ragaz (tremble), and be in anguish panayam (face) of you."

I shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers) out of the madabar (wilderness) of Qadamawath (Kedemoth) to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) with dabaray (words) of shalawam (peace / safety), amar (spoke),

"Let me ibar (pass over/through) through your aratz (Earth/land): I will yalak (go) darak (along) by the highway, I will sawar (turn) neither to the right yamayan (right hand) nor to the shamaawal (left hand).

You shall shabar (sell) me akal (food) for kasap (money), that I may akal (eat); and nathan (give) me mayam (Waters) for kasap (money), that I may shathah (drinks): only let me ibar (pass over/through) through on my ragal (feet / foot),

As the banay (children) of Ishaw (Esau) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Shaiyar (Seir), and the Mawaabay (Moabites) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Ir (Ar), ishah (make) to me; until I shall ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) us."

But Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) would not let us ibar (pass over/through) by him; for Yahawah your Alahayam hardened his rawach (spirit / wind), and made his labab (heart) amatz (obstinate), that he might nathan (give) him into your yad (hand), as at this yawam (day).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "raah (see), I have chalal (begun) to nathan (give) up Sayachawan (Sihon) and his aratz (Earth/land) panayam (face) you: chalal (begin) to yarash (possess), that you may yarash (inherit) his aratz (Earth/land)."
Then Sayachawan (Sihon) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) us, he and all his im (nation / people), to malachamah (battle) at Yahatz (Jahaz).
Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) him up panayam (face) us; and we nakah (struck) him, and his ban (son), and all his im (nation / people).

We lakad (took) all his iyar (cities) at that ith (time), and charam (utterly) destroyed every inhabited iyar (city), with the nashayam (women) and the little tap (ones); we shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining):
Only the livestock we bazaz (took) for a prey to ourselves, with the shalal (spoil) of the irayam (cities) which we had lakad (taken).

From Irawair (Aroer), which is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the iyar (city) that is in the nachal (stream / river), even to Galaid (Gilead), there was not a qarayah (city / town) shagab (too) high for us; Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) up all panayam (face) us:

Only to the aratz (Earth/land) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon) you didn't qarab (come close) yad (hand); all the side of the nachal (stream / river) Yabaq (Jabbok), and the iray (cities) of the har (mountain) country, and wherever Yahawah our Alahayam forbade us.

Then we panah (turn), and ilah (go up / offer) up the darak (way) to Bashan (Bashan): and Iwag (Og) the malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) us, he and all his im (nation / people), to malachamah (battle) at Adaraiy (Edrei).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) him; for I nathan (give) delivered him, and all his im (nation / people), and his aratz (Earth/land), into your yad (hand); and you shall ishah (make) to him as you ishah (make) to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived at Chashabawan (Heshbon)."

So Yahawah our Alahayam nathan (give) into our yad (hand) Iwag (Og) also, the malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), and all his im (nation / people): and we nakah (struck) him until none was shaar (left) to him sharayad (remaining).

We lakad (took) all his iyar (cities) at that ith (time); there was not a qarayah (city / town) which we didn't laqach (take / seize) from them; shashayam (sixty) iyar (cities), all the chabal (region) of Aragab (Argob), the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan).
All these were irayam (cities) batzar (fortified) with gabah (high) chawamah (walls), dalathayam (gates), and barayach (bars); besides the unwalled irayam (towns) a maad (great) many.

We charam (utterly) destroyed them, as we ishah (make) to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), charam (utterly) destroying every inhabited iyar (city), with the nashayam (women) and the little tap (ones).
But all the livestock, and the shalal (spoil) of the irayam (cities), we bazaz (took) for a prey to ourselves.

We laqach (take / seize) the aratz (Earth/land) at that ith (time) out of the yad (hand) of the shanayam (two) malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites) who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), from the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon) to har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon).
(The Tzayadanay (Sidonians) qaraa (called) Charamawan (Hermon) Sharayawan (Sirion), and the Amaray (Amorites) qaraa (called) it Shanayar (Senir).)

We took all the iray (cities) of the mayashawar (plain), and all Galaid (Gilead), and all Bashan (Bashan), to Salakah (Salecah) and Adaraiy (Edrei), iray (cities) of the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan).

(For only Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan) shaar (remained) of the yathar (remnant) of the Rapaa (Rephaim); behold, his irash (bedstead) was a irash (bedstead) of barazal (iron); isn't it in Rabah (Rabbah) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon)? Thashai (nine) amawath (cubits) was its arak (length), and arabai (four) amawath (cubits) its rachab (breadth), after the amah (cubit) of a ayash (man / husband).)

This aratz (Earth/land) we took in yarash (possession) at that ith (time): from Irawair (Aroer), which is by the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and chatzay (half) the har (mountain) country of Galaid (Gilead), and its iyar (cities), nathan (give) I to the Raawabanay (Reubenites) and to the Gaday (Gadites):

And the yathar (rest) of Galaid (Gilead), and all Bashan (Bashan), the mamalakah (kingdom) of Iwag (Og), nathan (give) I to the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh); all the chabal (region) of Aragab (Argob), even all Bashan (Bashan). (The same is qaraa (called) the aratz (Earth/land) of Rapaa (Rephaim).

Yaayar (Jair) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh) laqach (take / seize) all the chabal (region) of Aragab (Argob), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Gashawaray (Geshurites) and the Maikathay (Maacathites), and qaraa (called) them, even Bashan (Bashan), after his own sham (name), Havvoth Jair, to this yawam (day).)
I nathan (give) Galaid (Gilead) to Makayar (Machir).

To the Raawabanay (Reubenites) and to the Gaday (Gadites) I nathan (give) from Galaid (Gilead) even to the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and its gabawal (border/boundary), even to the nachal (stream / river) Yabaq (Jabbok), which is the gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon);

The irabah (arabah) also, and the Yaradan (Jordan) and its gabawal (border/boundary), from Kanarawath (Chinnereth) even to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), under the slopes of pasagah (pisgah) eastward.

I tzawah (commanded) you at that ith (time), amar (spoke), "Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given you this aratz (Earth/land) to yarash (possess) it: you shall ibar (pass over/through) over chalatz (armed) panayam (face) your ach (brother/kinsman) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), all the banay (men) of valor.
But your wives, and your little tap (ones), and your livestock, (I yadai (know) that you rab (have) much livestock), shall live in your iyar (cities) which I nathan (give) given you,

Until Yahawah gives nawach (rest) to your ach (brother/kinsman), as to you, and they also yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) them ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan): then you shall shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (man / husband) to his yarashah (possession), which I nathan (give) given you."

I tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua) at that ith (time), amar (spoke), "Your iyan (eye) raah (see) seen all that Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) done to these shanayam (two) malakayam (kings): so shall Yahawah ishah (make) to all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) where you ibar (pass over/through) over.
You shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) them; for Yahawah your Alahayam, he it is who lacham (fights) for you."
I begged Yahawah at that ith (time), amar (spoke),

"Adanay Yahawah, you have chalal (begun) to show your ibad (servant) your gadal (greatness), and your chazaq (strong) yad (hand): for what Al is there in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) or in aratz (Earth/land), that can ishah (make) according to your maishah (works), and according to your gabawarah (mighty) acts?

Please let me ibar (pass over/through) over and raah (see) the tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land) that is ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), that goodly har (mountain), and Labanawan (Lebanon)."

But Yahawah was angry with me for your sakes, and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to me; and Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Let it rab (suffice) you; dabar (word / matter) no more to me of this dabar (word / matter).

Ilah (go up / offer) up to the raash (head) of Pasagah (Pisgah), and nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and raah (see) with your iyan (eye): for you shall not ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan).

But commission Yahawashawai (Joshua), and chazaq (encourage) him, and amatz (strengthen) him; for he shall ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) this im (nation / people), and he shall nachal (cause) them to inherit the aratz (Earth/land) which you shall raah (see)."
So we stayed in the gayaa (valley) over mawal (against) Bayathapaiwar (Beth Peor).

Now, Yashar-Al (Israel), shamai (hearken / hear) to the chaqayam (statutes) and to the mashapatayam (ordinances), which I lamad (teach / instruct) you, to ishah (make) them; that you may chayah (live), and bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), nathan (give) you.

You shall not yasap (add) to the dabar (word / matter) which I tzawah (command) you, neither shall you garai (diminish) from it, that you may shamar (keep/guard) the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam which I tzawah (command) you.

Your iyan (eye) raah (see) seen what Yahawah ishah (make) because of Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor; for all the ayash (man / husband) who achar (other) Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor, Yahawah your Alahayam has destroyed them from the qarab (among / near) of you.
But you who were dabaq (faithful) to Yahawah your Alahayam are all chay (life) this yawam (day).

Raah (see), I have lamad (teach / instruct) you chaqayam (statutes) and mashapatayam (ordinances), even as Yahawah my Alahayam tzawah (commanded) me, that you should ishah (make) so in the midst of the aratz (Earth/land) where you bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.

Shamar (keep/guard) therefore and ishah (make) them; for this is your chakamah (wisdom) and your bayanah (understanding) in the iyan (eye) of the imayam (peoples), who shall shamai (hearken / hear) all these chaqayam (statutes), and amar (spoke), "Surely this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (heathen / nation) is a chakam (wise) and bayan (between) imayam (people)."
For what gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (heathen / nation) is there, that has a Alahayam so qarawab (near) to them, as Yahawah our Alahayam is whenever we qaraa (called) on him?

What gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (heathen / nation) is there, that has chaqayam (statutes) and mashapatayam (ordinances) so tzadayaq (righteous) as all this thawarah (instruction), which I nathan (give) panayam (face) you this yawam (day)?

Only shamar (keep/guard) heed to yourself, and shamar (keep/guard) your napash (soul) maad (diligently), lest you shakach (forget) the things which your iyan (eye) raah (see), and lest they sawar (depart) from your labab (heart) all the yamay (days) of your chay (life); but yadai (make) them known to your banay (children) and your banay (childrens) banay (children);

The yawam (day) that you imad (stood) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam in Charab (Horeb), when Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "qahal (assemble) me the im (nation / people), and I will shamai (hearken / hear) them hear my dabar (word / matter), that they may lamad (teach / instruct) to yaraa (fear / be afraid) me all the yamayam (days) that they chay (life) on the adamah (earth), and that they may lamad (teach / instruct) their ban (son)."

You qarab (come close) near and imad (stood) under the har (mountain); and the har (mountain) bair (burned) with ash (fire) to the lab (heart) of the sky, with irapal (darkness), cloud, and thick chashak (darkness).

Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to you out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire): you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of dabarayam (words), but you raah (see) no form; you only heard a qawal (sound / voice).

He nagad (declared) to you his barayath (covenant), which he tzawah (commanded) you to ishah (make), even the ishar (ten) commandments; and he kathab (write) them on shanayam (two) lachawath (tables) of aban (stone).

Yahawah tzawah (commanded) me at that ith (time) to lamad (teach / instruct) you chaqayam (statutes) and mashapatayam (ordinances), that you might ishah (make) them in the aratz (Earth/land) where you ibar (pass over/through) over to yarash (possess) it.

Take therefore maad (good) shamar (keep/guard) to yourselves; for you raah (see) no kind of form on the yawam (day) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to you in Charab (Horeb) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire).
Lest you shachath (corrupt) yourselves, and ishah (make) yourself an engraved pasal (image) in the form of any samal (figure), the thabanayath (likeness) of zakar (remember) or naqabah (female),
The thabanayath (likeness) of any animal that is on the aratz (Earth/land), the thabanayath (likeness) of any kanap (winged) tzapawar (bird) that flies in the sky,
The thabanayath (likeness) of anything that ramash (creeps) on the adamah (ground), the thabanayath (likeness) of any dagah (fish) that is in the mayam (Waters) under the aratz (Earth/land);

And lest you nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) to the sky, and when you raah (see) the shamash (sun) and the yarach (moon) and the kawakabayam (stars), even all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, you are nadach (drawn) away and shachah (worship) them, and ibad (servant) them, which Yahawah your Alahayam chalaq (has) allotted to all the imayam (peoples) under the whole sky.

But Yahawah has laqach (take / seize) you, and yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the barazal (iron) kawar (furnace), out of Matzarayam (Egypt), to be to him a im (nation / people) of nachalah (inheritance), as at this yawam (day).

Furthermore Yahawah was anap (angry) with me for your dabar (word / matter), and shabai (swear / take oath) that I should not ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), and that I should not bawaa (come) in to that tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you for an nachalah (inheritance):

But I must mawath (death) in this aratz (Earth/land), I must not ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan); but you shall ibar (pass over/through) over, and yarash (possess) that tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land).

Shamar (keep/guard) heed to yourselves, lest you shakach (forget) the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah your Alahayam, which he karath (cut) with you, and ishah (make) you an engraved pasal (image) in the form of anything which Yahawah your Alahayam has forbidden you.
For Yahawah your Alahayam is a akal (eat) ash (fire), a qanaa (jealous) Alahayam.

When you shall yalad (birth / begot) banayam (children), and banayam (childrens) banayam (children), and you shall have been yashan (long) in the aratz (Earth/land), and shall shachath (corrupt) yourselves, and ishah (make) an engraved pasal (image) in the form of anything, and shall ishah (make) that which is rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to provoke him to kais (anger);

I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land) to iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against you this yawam (day), that you shall mahar (soon) abad (destroy / perish) abad (destroy / perish) from off the aratz (Earth/land) whereunto you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) to yarash (possess) it; you shall not prolong your yamayam (days) on it, but shall shamad (utterly) be destroyed.
Yahawah will pawatz (scatter) you among the imayam (peoples), and you shall be shaar (left) math (few) in masapar (number) among the gawayam (nations), where Yahawah shall nahag (lead) you away.

There you shall ibad (servant) Alahayam, the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yaday (hands), itz (wood) and aban (stone), which neither raah (see), nor shamai (hearken / hear), nor akal (eat), nor rawach (spirit / wind).
But from there you shall baqash (seek) Yahawah your Alahayam, and you shall matzaa (find) him, when you darash (search) after him with all your labab (heart) and with all your napash (soul).

When you are in oppression, and all these things matzaa (have) come on you, in the acharayath (latter) yamayam (days) you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah your Alahayam, and shamai (hearken / hear) to his qawal (sound / voice):

For Yahawah your Alahayam is a rachawam (merciful) Alahayam; he will not rapah (fail) you, neither shachath (destroy) you, nor shakach (forget) the barayath (covenant) of your ab (father) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to them.

For shaal (ask) now of the yamayam (days) that are raashawan (past), which were panayam (face) you, since the yawam (day) that Alahayam baraa (created) adam (man) on the aratz (Earth/land), and from the one qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) thing is, or has been shamai (hearken / hear) like it?

Did a im (nation / people) ever shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Alahayam dabar (word / matter) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire), as you have shamai (hearken / hear), and chayah (live)?

Or has Alahayam nasah (tried) to bawaa (come) and laqach (take / seize) a gaway (heathen / nation) for himself from the qarab (among / near) of another gaway (heathen / nation), by masath (trials), by athath (signs), and by mawapathayam (wonders), and by malachamah (war), and by a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and by an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), and by gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraayam (terrors), according to all that Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) for you in Matzarayam (Egypt) before your iyan (eye)?
It was shown to you so that you might yadai (know) that Yahawah is Alahayam. There is no one iwad (more/again) bad (besides) him.

Out of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) he shamai (hearken / hear) you to hear his qawal (sound / voice), that he might yasar (instruct) you: and on aratz (Earth/land) he made you to raah (see) his gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ash (fire); and you shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire).

Because he ahab (love) your ab (father), therefore he bachar (chose) their zarai (seed) achar (other) them, and yatzaa (go out / come out) you out with his panayam (face), with his gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power), out of Matzarayam (Egypt);

To yarash (drive) out gawayam (nations) from panayam (face) you greater and mightier than you, to bawaa (come) you in, to nathan (give) you their aratz (Earth/land) for an nachalah (inheritance), as at this yawam (day).

Yadai (know) therefore this yawam (day), and shawab (turn back / repent) it to your labab (heart), that Yahawah he is Alahayam in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mail (top/above) and on the aratz (Earth/land) beneath; there is none else.

You shall shamar (keep/guard) his chaq (statute), and his matzawah (commandments), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), that it may yatab (go) well with you, and with your ban (son) achar (other) you, and that you may prolong your yamayam (days) in the adamah (land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you, forever.
Then Mashah (Moses) set apart shalawash (three) irayam (cities) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise;

That the manslayer might nawas (flee) there, who ratzach (kills) his neighbor unawares, and didn't shanaa (hate) him in thamawal (time) shalashawam (past); and that fleeing to achad (one) of these irayam (cities) he might chayay (life):

Batzar (Bezer) in the madabar (wilderness), in the mayashawar (plain) aratz (Earth/land), for the Raawabanay (Reubenites); and Raamawath (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead), for the Gaday (Gadites); and Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan), for the Manashay (Manassites).
This is the thawarah (instruction) which Mashah (Moses) shawam (place / establish / appoint) panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel):

These are the idath (testimonies), and the chaqayam (statutes), and the mashapatayam (ordinances), which Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt),

Ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), in the gayaa (valley) over mawal (against) Bayathapaiwar (Beth Peor), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived at Chashabawan (Heshbon), whom Mashah (Moses) and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nakah (struck), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt).

They took his aratz (Earth/land) in yarash (possession), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), the shanayam (two) malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites), who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise;
From Irawair (Aroer), which is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), even to har (mountain) Shayaan (Sion) (the same is Charamawan (Hermon)),
And all the irabah (arabah) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward, even to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), under the slopes of Pasagah (Pisgah).

Mashah (Moses) qaraa (called) to all Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) to them, shamai (hearken / hear), Yashar-Al (Israel), the chaqayam (statutes) and the mashapatayam (ordinances) which I dabar (word / matter) in your azan (ear) this yawam (day), that you may lamad (teach / instruct) them, and shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) them.
Yahawah our Alahayam karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with us in Charab (Horeb).
Yahawah didn't karath (cut) this barayath (covenant) with our ab (father), but with us, even us, who are all of us here chay (life) this yawam (day).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) with you panayam (face) to panayam (face) on the har (mountain) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire),

(I imad (stood) between Yahawah and you at that ith (time), to show you the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah: for you were yaraa (fear / be afraid) panayam (face) of the ash (fire), and didn't ilah (go up / offer) up onto the har (mountain);) amar (spoke),
"I am Yahawah your Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant).
"You shall have no other Alahayam panayam (face) me.

"You shall not ishah (make) an engraved pasal (image) for yourself, any thamawanah (form) of what is in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mail (top/above), or what is in the aratz (Earth/land) beneath, or that is in the mayam (Waters) under the aratz (Earth/land):

You shall not shachah (bow) down yourself to them, nor ibad (servant) them; for I, Yahawah, your Alahayam, am a qanaa (jealous) Alahayam, paqad (visit) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of the abawath (fathers) on the banayam (children), and on the shalash (three) and on the rabai (fourth) generation of those who shanaa (hate) me;
And showing loving chasad (grace) to alapayam (thousands) of those who ahab (love) me and shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments).
"You shall not nashaa (lift) the sham (name) of Yahawah your Alahayam in shawaa (vanity): for Yahawah will not hold him naqah (clean/innocent) who nashaa (lift) his sham (name) in shawaa (vanity).
"Shamar (keep/guard) the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day), to shamar (keep/guard) it holy, as Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you.
You shall ibad (servant) shash (six) yamayam (days), and ishah (make) all your malaakah (work);

But the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day) is a shabath (shabath / rest) to Yahawah your Alahayam, in which you shall not ishah (make) any malaakah (work), you, nor your ban (son), nor your banath (daughter), nor your male ibad (servant), nor your female amah (servant), nor your shawar (ox), nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) who is within your shair (gates); that your male ibad (servant) and your female amah (servant) may nawach (rest) as well as you.

You shall zakar (remember) that you were a ibad (servant) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and Yahawah your Alahayam yatzaa (go out / come out) you out of there by a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand) and by an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm): therefore Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you to ishah (make) the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day).

"Honor your ab (father) and your am (mother), as Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you; that your yawam (day) may be arak (long), and that it may yatab (go) well with you, in the adamah (land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you.
"You shall not ratzach (murder).
"Neither shall you naap (commit) adultery.
"Neither shall you ganab (steal).
"Neither shall you inah (answer / respond) shawaa (vanity) id (until / as far as) against your neighbor.

"Neither shall you chamad (covet) your neighbor's ayashah (woman / wife); neither shall you awah (desire) your neighbor's bayath (house), his shadah (field), or his male ibad (servant), or his female amah (servant), his shawar (ox), or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor's."

These dabarayam (words) Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to all your qahal (assembly) on the har (mountain) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire), of the inan (cloud), and of the irapal (thick) darkness, with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice): and he yasap (added) no more. He kathab (write) them on shanayam (two) lachath (tables) of aban (stone), and nathan (give) them to me.

It happened, when you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) out of the thawak (midst) of the chashak (darkness), while the har (mountain) was bair (burning) with ash (fire), that you qarab (come close) near to me, even all the raashay (heads) of your shabat (tribes), and your zaqan (elders);

And you amar (spoke), "Behold, Yahawah our Alahayam raah (see) shown us his kabawad (glory) and his gadal (greatness), and we have shamai (hearken / hear) his qawal (sound / voice) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire): we raah (see) seen this yawam (day) that Alahayam does dabar (word / matter) with adam (man), and he chayay (life).

Now therefore why should we mawath (death)? For this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ash (fire) will akal (eat) us: if we shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam any more, then we shall mawath (death).

For who is there of all bashar (flesh), that has shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the chay (life) Alahayam dabar (word / matter) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire), as we have, and chayah (lived)?

Qarab (come close) near, and shamai (hearken / hear) all that Yahawah our Alahayam shall amar (spoke): and amar (spoke) us all that Yahawah our Alahayam shall dabar (word / matter) you; and we will shamai (hearken / hear) it, and ishah (make) it."

Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of your dabaray (words), when you dabar (word / matter) to me; and Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to me, "I have shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the dabaray (words) of this im (nation / people), which they have dabar (word / matter) to you: they yatab (have) well dabar (word / matter) all that they have spoken.

Oh that there were such a labab (heart) in them, that they would yaraa (fear / be afraid) me, and shamar (keep/guard) all my matzawah (commandments) yamayam (always), that it might be yatab (well) with them, and with their ban (son) iwalam (forever)!
"Yalak (go) amar (spoke) them, shawab (turn back / repent) to your ahal (tents).

But as for you, imad (stand) here by me, and I will dabar (word / matter) you all the matzawah (commandment), and the chaqayam (statutes), and the mashapatayam (ordinances), which you shall lamad (teach / instruct) them, that they may ishah (make) them in the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) them to yarash (possess) it."

You shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) therefore as Yahawah your Alahayam has tzawah (commanded) you: you shall not sawar (turn) aside to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand).

You shall yalak (walk) in all the darak (way) which Yahawah your Alahayam has tzawah (commanded) you, that you may chayah (live), and that it may be tawab (good / proper function) with you, and that you may prolong your yamayam (days) in the aratz (Earth/land) which you shall yarash (possess).

Now this is the matzawah (commandment), the chaqayam (statutes), and the mashapatayam (ordinances), which Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) to lamad (teach / instruct) you, that you might ishah (make) them in the aratz (Earth/land) where you ibar (pass over/through) over to yarash (possess) it;

That you might yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamar (keep/guard) all his chaqah (statutes) and his matzawah (commandments), which I tzawah (command) you, you, and your ban (son), and your ban (son) ban (son), all the yamay (days) of your chay (life); and that your yamay (days) may be prolonged.

Shamai (hearken / hear) therefore, Yashar-Al (Israel), and shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) it; that it may be yatab (well) with you, and that you may rabah (increase) mightily, as Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), has dabar (word / matter) to you, in a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey).
Shamai (hearken / hear), Yashar-Al (Israel): Yahawah is our Alahayam; Yahawah is achad (one):
And you shall ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam with all your labab (heart), and with all your napash (soul), and with all your maad (might).
These dabarayam (words), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), shall be on your labab (heart);

And you shall shanan (teach) them diligently to your ban (son), and shall dabar (word / matter) of them when you yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your bayath (house), and when you yalak (walk) by the darak (way), and when you shakab (lie) down, and when you qawam (rise up) up.
You shall qashar (bind) them for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) on your yad (hand), and they shall be for symbols between your iyan (eye).
You shall kathab (write) them on the mazawazah (door) posts of your bayath (house), and on your shair (gates).

It shall be, when Yahawah your Alahayam shall bawaa (come) you into the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), to nathan (give) you, gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and goodly irayam (cities), which you didn't banah (build),

And bathayam (houses) malaa (full) of all tawab (good / proper function) things, which you didn't malaa (fill), and barath (cisterns) chatzab (dug) out, which you didn't chatzab (dig), karamayam (vineyards) and zayath (olive) trees, which you didn't natai (plant), and you shall akal (eat) and be shabai (full);
Then beware lest you shakach (forget) Yahawah, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant).
You shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam; and you shall ibad (servant) him, and shall shabai (swear / take oath) by his sham (name).
You shall not yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam, of the Alahayam of the imayam (peoples) who are around you;

For Yahawah your Alahayam in the qarab (among / near) of you is a qanaa (jealous) Al; lest the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah your Alahayam be charah (hot with anger) against you, and he shamad (destroy) you from off the panayam (face) of the adamah (earth).
You shall not nasah (tempt) Yahawah your Alahayam, as you nasah (tempted) him in Masah (Massah).
You shall diligently shamar (keep/guard) the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam, and his idah (testimonies), and his chaq (statute), which he has tzawah (commanded) you.

You shall ishah (make) that which is yashar (upright) and tawab (good / proper function) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah; that it may be yatab (well) with you, and that you may bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father),
To hadap (thrust) out all your ayab (enemy) from panayam (face) you, as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter).

When your ban (son) shaal (asks) you in machar (time) to come, amar (spoke), "What do the idath (testimonies), the chaqayam (statutes), and the mashapatayam (ordinances), which Yahawah our Alahayam has tzawah (commanded) you mean?"

Then you shall amar (spoke) your ban (son), "We were Paraih (Pharaoh's) ibadayam (bondservants) in Matzarayam (Egypt): and Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) us out of Matzarayam (Egypt) with a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand);

And Yahawah showed gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and awesome awathath (signs) and mapathayam (wonders) on Matzarayam (Egypt), on Paraih (Pharaoh), and on all his bayath (house), before our iyan (eye);
And he yatzaa (go out / come out) us out from there, that he might bawaa (come) us in, to nathan (give) us the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to our ab (father).

Yahawah tzawah (commanded) us to ishah (make) all these chaqayam (statutes), to yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah our Alahayam, for our tawab (good / proper function) yamayam (always), that he might chayah (preserve) us alive, as at this yawam (day).
It shall be tzadaqah (righteousness) to us, if we shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all zaath (this) matzawah (commandment) panayam (face) Yahawah our Alahayam, as he has tzawah (commanded) us."

When Yahawah your Alahayam shall bawaa (come) you into the aratz (Earth/land) where you bawaa (come) to yarash (possess) it, and shall nashal (cast) out many gawayam (nations) panayam (face) you, the Chathay (Hittite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Kanainay (Canaanite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite), shabai (seven) gawayam (nations) greater and mightier than you;

And when Yahawah your Alahayam shall nathan (give) them up panayam (face) you, and you shall nakah (strike) them; then you shall charam (utterly) charam (destroy) them: you shall karath (cut) no barayath (covenant) with them, nor show chanan (showing favor) to them;

Neither shall you chathan (make) marriages with them; your banath (daughter) you shall not nathan (give) to his ban (son), nor shall you laqach (take / seize) his banath (daughter) for your ban (son).

For he will sawar (turn) away your ban (son) from achar (other) me, that they may ibad (servant) other Alahayam: so the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah would be charah (hot with anger) against you, and he would shamad (destroy) you mahar (quickly).

But you shall ishah (make) with them like this: you shall shabar (break) down their mazabach (altars), and dash their matzabah (pillars) in pieces, and gadai (cut) down their Asharah (Asherim), and sharap (burn) their engraved pasayal (images) with ash (fire).

For you are a qadawash (holy) imayam (people) to Yahawah your Alahayam: Yahawah your Alahayam has bachar (chosen) you to be a imayam (people) for his own sagalah (possession), above all imayam (peoples) who are on the panayam (face) of the adamah (earth).
Yahawah didn't set his chashaq (love) on you, nor bachar (choose) you, because you were more in number than any imayam (people); for you were the fewest of all imayam (peoples):

But because Yahawah loves you, and because he would shamar (keep/guard) the shabawaih (oath) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), has Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) you out with a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and padah (redeemed) you out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant), from the yad (hand) of Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Yadai (know) therefore that Yahawah your Alahayam, he is Alahayam, the aman (believe / have faith) Alahayam, who shamaray (keeps) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with them who ahab (love) him and shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments) to a alap (thousand) dawar (generation / age / period),

And shalam (repays) those who shanaa (hate) him to their panayam (face), to abad (destroy / perish) them: he will not be slack to him who shanaa (hate) him, he will shalam (repay) him to his panayam (face).

You shall therefore shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandment), and the chaqayam (statutes), and the mashapatayam (ordinances), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), to ishah (make) them.

It shall happen, iqab (award / effect after the cause) you shamai (hearken / hear) to these mashapatayam (ordinances), and shamar (keep/guard) and ishah (make) them, that Yahawah your Alahayam will shamar (keep/guard) with you the barayath (covenant) and the loving chasad (grace) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father):

And he will ahab (love) you, and barak (blessed) you, and rabah (multiply) you; he will also barak (blessed) the paray (fruit) of your batan (body) and the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), your grain and your new thayarawash (wine) and your yatzahar (fresh oil), the shagar (increase) of your livestock and the Ishatharah (young) of your tzaan (flock), in the adamah (land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father) to nathan (give) you.
You shall be barak (blessed) above all imayam (peoples): there shall not be male or female iqar (barren) among you, or among your livestock.

Yahawah will sawar (take) away from you all chalay (sickness); and none of the rai (evil) madaway (diseases) of Matzarayam (Egypt), which you yadai (know), he will shawam (place / establish / appoint) on you, but will nathan (give) them on all those who shanaa (hate) you.

You shall akal (eat) all the imayam (peoples) whom Yahawah your Alahayam shall nathan (give) to you; your iyan (eye) shall not chawas (pity) them: neither shall you ibad (servant) their Alahayam; for that will be a mawaqash (snare) to you.
If you shall amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), "These gawayam (nations) are more than I; ayak (how) yakal (can) I yarash (dispossess) them?"
You shall not be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them: you shall zakar (remember) zakar (remember) what Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to Paraih (Pharaoh), and to all Matzarayam (Egypt);

The gadawal (very great/important/mighty) masath (trials) which your iyan (eye) raah (see), and the athath (signs), and the mapathayam (wonders), and the chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and the natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), by which Yahawah your Alahayam yatzaa (go out / come out) you out: so shall Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to all the imayam (peoples) of whom you are yaraa (afraid).
Moreover Yahawah your Alahayam will shalach (send) the tzaraih (hornet) among them, until those who are shaar (left), and sathar (hide) themselves, abad (destroy / perish) from panayam (face) you.
You shall not be scared of them; for Yahawah your Alahayam is in the qarab (among / near) of you, a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and awesome Al.

Yahawah your Alahayam will nashal (cast) out al (toward) gawayam (nations) panayam (face) you by mait (little) and mait (little): you may not kalah (complete / finish) them at mahar (once), lest the animals of the shadah (field) rabah (increase) on you.
But Yahawah your Alahayam will nathan (give) them up panayam (face) you, and will confuse them with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mahawamah (confusion), until they be destroyed.

He will nathan (give) their malak (king) into your yad (hand), and you shall make their sham (name) to abad (destroy / perish) from under the sky: no ayash (man / husband) shall be yatzab (able) to stand panayam (face) you, until you have destroyed them.

You shall sharap (burn) the engraved pasayalay (images) of their Alahayam with ash (fire). You shall not chamad (covet) the kasap (silver) or the zahab (gold) that is on them, nor laqach (take / seize) it for yourself, lest you be yaqash (snared) in it; for it is an thawaibah (abomination) to Yahawah your Alahayam.

You shall not bawaa (come) an thawaibah (abomination) into your bayath (house), and become a charam (devoted) thing like it. You shall shaqatz (utterly) shaqatz (detest) it, and you shall shaqatz (utterly) thaib (abhor) it; for it is a charam (devoted) thing.

You shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all the matzawah (commandment) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), that you may chayah (live), and rabah (multiply), and bawaa (come) in and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father).

You shall zakar (remember) all the darak (way) which Yahawah your Alahayam has yalak (led) you these arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) in the madabar (wilderness), that he might inah (oppress / afflict) you, to nasah (prove) you, to yadai (know) what was in your labab (heart), whether you would shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), or not.

He inah (oppress / afflict) you, and allowed you to be raib (hungry), and akal (eat) you with man (from), which you didn't yadai (know), neither did your ab (father) yadai (know); that he might yadai (make) you know that adam (man) does not chayah (live) by lacham (bread) only, but adam (man) chayah (lives) by everything that proceeds out of the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.
Your shamalah (clothing) didn't grow balah (old) on you, neither did your ragal (feet / foot) batzaq (swell), these arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years).
You shall yadai (consider) in your labab (heart) that as a ayash (man / husband) yasar (chastens) his ban (son), so Yahawah your Alahayam yasar (chastens) you.
You shall shamar (keep/guard) the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in his darak (ways), and to yaraa (fear / be afraid) him.

For Yahawah your Alahayam bawaa (come) you into a tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land), a aratz (Earth/land) of nachalay (brooks) of mayam (Waters), of springs, and underground mayam (Waters) flowing into baqaih (valleys) and har (mountain);
A aratz (Earth/land) of chatah (wheat) and shairah (barley), and gapan (vines) and thaan (fig) trees and ramawan (pomegranates); a aratz (Earth/land) of zayath (olive) trees and dabash (honey);

A aratz (Earth/land) in which you shall akal (eat) lacham (bread) laa (NOT) masakanath (scarceness), you shall not chasar (lack) anything in it; a aratz (Earth/land) whose aban (stone) are barazal (iron), and out of whose harar (hills) you may chatzab (dig) nachashath (copper).
You shall akal (eat) and be shabai (full), and you shall barak (blessed) Yahawah your Alahayam for the tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land) which he nathan (give) given you.

Beware lest you shakach (forget) Yahawah your Alahayam, in not shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his mashapat (ordinances), and his chaqah (statutes), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day):
Lest, when you have akal (eat) and are shabai (full), and have banah (build) goodly bathayam (houses), and lived therein;
And when your baqar (morning) and your tzaan (flocks) rabah (multiply), and your kasap (silver) and your zahab (gold) is rabah (multiplied), and all that you rabah (have) is multiplied;

Then your labab (heart) be rawam (will lift up) up, and you shakach (forget) Yahawah your Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant);

Who yalak (led) you through the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and yaraa (fear / be afraid) madabar (wilderness), with sharap (fiery) nachash (serpents) and iqarab (scorpions), and tzamaawan (thirsty) ground where there was no mayam (Waters); who yatzaa (go out / come out) you forth mayam (Waters) out of the tzawar (rock) of chalamayash (flint);

Who akal (eat) you in the madabar (wilderness) with man (from), which your ab (father) didn't yadai (know); that he might inah (oppress / afflict) you, and that he might nasah (prove) you, to do you yatab (good) at your acharayath (latter) end:
And lest you amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), "My kach (strength / mighty / power) and the itzam (might) of my yad (hand) ishah (make) gotten me this wealth."

But you shall zakar (remember) Yahawah your Alahayam, for it is he who nathan (give) you kach (strength / mighty / power) to ishah (make) wealth; that he may qawam (rise up) his barayath (covenant) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), as at this yawam (day).

It shall be, if you shall shakach (forget) Yahawah your Alahayam, and halak (move) achar (other) other Alahayam, and ibad (servant) them, and shachah (worship) them, I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against you this yawam (day) that you shall abad (destroy / perish) abad (destroy / perish).

As the gawayam (nations) that Yahawah makes to abad (destroy / perish) panayam (face) you, so you shall abad (destroy / perish); iqab (award / effect after the cause) you wouldn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

Shamai (hearken / hear), Yashar-Al (Israel): you are to ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) this yawam (day), to bawaa (come) in to yarash (dispossess) gawayam (nations) greater and mightier than yourself, irayam (cities) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and batzar (fortified) up to the sky,

A im (nation / people) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and rawam (will lift up), the banay (sons) of the inaqay (anakim), whom you yadai (know), and of whom you have shamai (hearken / hear) say, "Who yatzab (can) stand panayam (face) the banay (sons) of Inaq (Anak)?"

Yadai (know) therefore this yawam (day), that Yahawah your Alahayam is he who ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) you as a akal (eat) ash (fire); he will shamad (destroy) them, and he will kanai (bring) them down panayam (face) you: so you shall yarash (drive) them out, and make them to abad (destroy / perish) mahar (quickly), as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) to you.

Don't amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), after Yahawah your Alahayam has hadap (thrust) them out from panayam (face) you, amar (spoke), "For my tzadaqah (righteousness) Yahawah bawaa (come) brought me in to yarash (possess) this aratz (Earth/land);" because Yahawah yarash (drives) them out panayam (face) you because of the rashaih (wickedness) of these gawayam (nations).

Not for your tzadaqah (righteousness), or for the yashar (upright) of your labab (heart), do you bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) their aratz (Earth/land); but for the rashaih (wickedness) of these gawayam (nations) Yahawah your Alahayam does yarash (drive) them out from panayam (face) you, and that he may qawam (rise up) the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob).

Yadai (know) therefore, that Yahawah your Alahayam doesn't nathan (give) you this tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land) to yarash (possess) it for your tzadaqah (righteousness); for you are a irap (neck) im (nation / people).

Zakar (remember), don't shakach (forget), how you provoked Yahawah your Alahayam to qatzap (wrath) in the madabar (wilderness): from the yawam (day) that you yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), until you bawaa (come) to this maqawam (place), you have been rebellious im (with) Yahawah.
Also in Charab (Horeb) you provoked Yahawah to qatzap (wrath), and Yahawah was anap (angry) with you to shamad (destroy) you.

When I was ilah (go up / offer) up onto the har (mountain) to laqach (take / seize) the lawachath (tables) of aban (stone), even the lawachath (tables) of the barayath (covenant) which Yahawah karath (cut) with you, then I stayed on the har (mountain) arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) and arabaiyam (forty) layal (nights); I neither akal (eat) lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters).

Yahawah nathan (give) to me the shanayam (two) lawachath (tables) of aban (stone) kathab (write) with the atzabai (finger) of Alahayam; and on them were all the dabarayam (words) which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) with you on the har (mountain) out of the thawak (midst) of the ash (fire) in the yawam (day) of the qahal (assembly).

It came to pass at the qatz (end) of arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) and arabaiyam (forty) layal (nights), that Yahawah nathan (give) me the shanayam (two) lachath (tables) of aban (stone), even the lachath (tables) of the barayath (covenant).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "qawam (rise up), yarad (get) down mahar (quickly) from here; for your im (nation / people) whom you yatzaa (go out / come out) brought out of Matzarayam (Egypt) have shachath (corrupted) themselves; they have mahar (quickly) sawar (turned) aside out of the darak (way) which I tzawah (commanded) them; they ishah (make) made them a masakah (molten) image."
Furthermore Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, amar (spoke), "I raah (see) seen this im (nation / people), and behold, it is a irap (neck) im (nation / people):

Let me rapah (alone), that I may shamad (destroy) them, and machah (blot) out their sham (name) from under the sky; and I will ishah (make) of you a gaway (heathen / nation) mightier and greater than they."

So I panah (turn) and yarad (came) down from the har (mountain), and the har (mountain) was bair (burning) with ash (fire): and the shanayam (two) lachath (tables) of the barayath (covenant) were in my shanayam (two) yad (hand).

I raah (see), and behold, you had chataa (sinned) against Yahawah your Alahayam; you ishah (make) made yourselves a masakah (molten) igal (calf): you had sawar (turned) aside mahar (quickly) out of the darak (way) which Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) you.
I thapash (took) hold of the shanayam (two) lachath (tables), and shalak (cast) them out of my shanayam (two) yad (hand), and shabar (broke) them before your iyan (eye).

I napal (fall / be cast down) down panayam (face) Yahawah, as at the raashawan (first), arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) and arabaiyam (forty) layal (nights); I neither akal (eat) lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters); because of all your chataah (sin) which you chataa (sinned), in ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).

For I was yagar (afraid) of the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and chamah (hot) displeasure, with which Yahawah was qatzap (angry) against you to shamad (destroy) you. But Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) to me that paim (time) also.
Yahawah was very anap (angry) with Aharawan (Aaron) to shamad (destroy) him: and I palal (prayed) for Aharawan (Aaron) also at the same ith (time).

I laqach (take / seize) your chataah (sin), the igal (calf) which you ishah (make) made, and burnt it with ash (fire), and kathath (stamped) it, tachan (grinding) it very yatab (small), until it was as fine as ipar (dust): and I shalak (cast) its ipar (dust) into the nachal (stream / river) that descended out of the har (mountain).
At Thabairah (Taberah), and at Masah (Massah), and at Qabarawathahathaawah (Kibroth Hattaavah), you provoked Yahawah to qatzap (wrath).

When Yahawah shalach (send) you from Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea), amar (spoke), "ilah (go up / offer) up and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) given you;" then you marah (rebelled) against the commandment of Yahawah your Alahayam, and you didn't aman (believe / have faith) him, nor shamai (hearken / hear) to his qawal (sound / voice).
You have been rebellious against Yahawah from the yawam (day) that I yadai (knew) you.

So I napal (fall / be cast down) down panayam (face) Yahawah the arabaiyam (forty) yawam (day) and arabaiyam (forty) layal (nights) that I napal (fall / be cast down) down, because Yahawah had amar (spoke) he would shamad (destroy) you.

I palal (prayed) to Yahawah, and amar (spoke), "Adawan Yahawah, don't shachath (destroy) your im (nation / people) and your nachalah (inheritance), that you have padah (redeemed) through your gadal (greatness), that you yatzaa (go out / come out) brought out of Matzarayam (Egypt) with a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand).

Zakar (remember) your ibad (servant), Abaraham (Abraham), Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yaiqab (Jacob); don't panah (turn) to the qashay (stubbornness) of this im (nation / people), nor to their rashai (wickedness), nor to their chataah (sin),

Lest the aratz (Earth/land) you yatzaa (go out / come out) us out from amar (spoke), ‘Because Yahawah was not yakal (able) to bawaa (come) them into the aratz (Earth/land) which he dabar (word / matter) to them, and because he shanaah (hated) them, he yatzaa (go out / come out) brought them out to mawath (death) them in the madabar (wilderness).'

Yet they are your im (nation / people) and your nachalah (inheritance), which you yatzaa (go out / come out) out by your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and by your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm)."

At that ith (time) Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Cut shanayam (two) lawachath (tables) of aban (stone) like the raashawan (first), and ilah (go up / offer) up to me onto the har (mountain), and ishah (make) an arawan (ark) of itz (wood).

I will kathab (write) on the lachath (tables) the dabarayam (words) that were on the raashawan (first) lachath (tables) which you shabar (broke), and you shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) them in the arawan (ark)."
