When a ayash (man / husband) laqach (take / seize) a chadash (new) ayashah (woman / wife), he shall not yatzaa (go out / come out) out in the tzabaa (troop), neither shall he be assigned any dabar (word / matter): he shall be naqay (free) at bayath (house) achad (one) shanah (year), and shall shamach (cheer) his ayashah (woman / wife) whom he has laqach (take / seize).
No chabal (man) shall take the rachah (mill) or the upper rakab (millstone) to chabal (pledge); for he takes a napash (soul) in chabal (pledge).

If a ayash (man / husband) be matzaa (found) ganab (stealing) any of his ach (brother/kinsman) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and he deal with him as a slave, or makar (sell) him; then that ganab (thief) shall mawath (death): so you shall bair (put) bair (away) the rai (evil) from the qarab (among / near) of you.

Shamar (keep/guard) heed in the nagai (plague) of tzaraith (leprosy), that you shamar (keep/guard) maad (diligently), and ishah (make) according to all that the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites) shall yarah (teach) you: as I tzawah (commanded) them, so you shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make).
Zakar (remember) what Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to Marayam (Miriam), by the darak (way) as you yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt).
When you do nashah (lend) your neighbor any kind of loan, you shall not bawaa (come) into his bayath (house) to get his ibawat (pledge).
You shall imad (stand) outside, and the ayash (man / husband) to whom you do nashah (lend) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the ibawat (pledge) outside to you.
If he be a inay (poor) ayash (man / husband), you shall not sleep with his ibawat (pledge);

You shall shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) to him the ibawat (pledge) when the shamash (sun) bawaa (come) down, that he may sleep in his shalamah (dress / garment), and barak (blessed) you: and it shall be tzadaqah (righteousness) to you panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam.

You shall not ishaq (oppress) a hired shakayar (servant) who is inay (poor) and abayawan (needy), whether he be of your ach (brother/kinsman), or of your foreigners who are in your aratz (Earth/land) within your shair (gates):

In his yawam (day) you shall nathan (give) him his shakar (hire), neither shall the shamash (sun) bawaa (come) down on it; for he is inay (poor), and nashaa (lift) his napash (soul) on it: lest he qaraa (called) against you to Yahawah, and it be chataa (sin) to you.

The abawath (fathers) shall not be put to mawath (death) for the banayam (children), neither shall the banayam (children) be put to mawath (death) for the abawath (fathers): every ayash (man / husband) shall be put to mawath (death) for his own chataa (sin).
You shall not deprive the foreigner, or the yathawam (fatherless) of mashapat (justice), nor take a alamanah (widow's) bagad (clothing) in chabal (pledge);
But you shall zakar (remember) that you were a ibad (servant) in Matzarayam (Egypt), and Yahawah your Alahayam padah (redeemed) you there: therefore I tzawah (command) you to ishah (make) this thing.

When you qatzar (reap) your qatzayar (harvest) in your shadah (field), and have shakach (forgot) a imar (sheaf) in the shadah (field), you shall not shawab (turn back / repent) again to laqach (take / seize) it: it shall be for the foreigner, for the yathawam (fatherless), and for the alamanah (widow); that Yahawah your Alahayam may barak (blessed) you in all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand).
When you chabat (beat) your zayath (olive) tree, you shall not paar (go) over the boughs again: it shall be for the foreigner, for the yathawam (fatherless), and for the alamanah (widow).
When you harvest your karam (vineyard), you shall not ilal (glean) it achar (other) yourselves: it shall be for the foreigner, for the yathawam (fatherless), and for the alamanah (widow).
You shall zakar (remember) that you were a ibad (servant) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt): therefore I tzawah (command) you to ishah (make) this thing.

If there is a rayab (controversy) between anashayam (men), and they nagash (come) to mashapat (judgment), and the shapat (judge / judgement) judge them; then they shall justify the tzadayaq (righteous), and rashai (condemn) the rashai (wicked);

And it shall be, if the rashai (wicked) man be ban (son) to be nakah (beaten), that the shapat (judge / judgement) shall napal (fall / be cast down) him to lie down, and to be nakah (beaten) before his panayam (face), day (according) to his rashaih (wickedness), by masapar (number).

Arabaiyam (forty) nakah (stripes) he may yasap (give) him, he shall not exceed; lest, if he should yasap (exceed), and nakah (beat) him above these with many makah (stripes), then your ach (brother/kinsman) should qalah (seem) vile to you.
You shall not chasam (muzzle) the shawar (ox) when he treads out the grain.

If achayam (brothers) yashab (inhabit/dwell) yachad (together), and achad (one) of them mawath (death), and have no ban (son), the ayashah (woman / wife) of the mawath (death) shall not be married outside to a stranger: her yabam (husband's) brother shall bawaa (come) in to her, and laqach (take / seize) her to him as ayashah (woman / wife), and perform the duty of a yabam (husband's) brother to her.

It shall be, that the bakawar (firstborn) whom she bears shall qawam (rise up) in the sham (name) of his ach (brother/kinsman) who is mawath (death), that his sham (name) not be machah (blotted) out of Yashar-Al (Israel).

If the ayash (man / husband) doesn't want to laqach (take / seize) his yabamath (brother's) wife, then his yabamath (brother's) wife shall ilah (go up / offer) up to the shair (gate) to the zaqanayam (elders), and amar (spoke), "My yabam (husband's) brother maan (refuses) to qawam (rise up) up to his yabam (brother) a sham (name) in Yashar-Al (Israel); he abah (be willing / desire) not perform the duty of a yabam (husband's) brother to me."
Then the zaqanay (elders) of his iyar (city) shall qaraa (called) him, and dabar (word / matter) to him: and if he imad (stand), and amar (spoke), "I don't want to laqach (take / seize) her;"

Then his yabamath (brother's) wife shall nagash (come) to him in the iyan (eye) of the zaqanayam (elders), and chalatz (loose) his nail (shoe) from off his ragal (feet / foot), and yaraq (spit) in his panayam (face); and she shall inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke), "So shall it be ishah (make) to the ayash (man / husband) who does not banah (build) up his ach (brother/kinsman) bayath (house)."
His sham (name) shall be qaraa (called) in Yashar-Al (Israel), The bayath (house) of him who has his nail (shoe) untied.

When anashayam (men) natzah (strive) yachad (together) one with ach (brother/kinsman), and the ayashah (woman / wife) of the achad (one) qarab (come close) near to natzal (deliver) her ayash (man / husband) out of the yad (hand) of him who nakah (strikes) him, and shalach (send) forth her yad (hand), and chazaq (takes) him by the mabash (secrets);
Then you shall qatzatz (cut) off her kap (hand), your iyan (eye) shall have no chawas (pity).
You shall not have in your kayas (bag) diverse aban (stone), a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and a qatan (small / young / least).
You shall not have in your bayath (house) diverse ayapah (measures), a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and a qatan (small / young / least).

You shall have a shalam (full / whole / complete) and tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) aban (stone). You shall have a shalam (full / whole / complete) and tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) ayapah (measure), that your yawam (day) may be arak (long) in the adamah (land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you.
For all who ishah (make) such things, all who ishah (make) iwal (unrighteously), are an thawaibah (abomination) to Yahawah your Alahayam.
Zakar (remember) what Imalaq (Amalek) ishah (make) to you by the darak (way) as you yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt);

How he qarah (met) you by the darak (way), and struck the zanab (hindmost) of you, all who were chashal (feeble) achar (other) you, when you were iyap (faint) and yagai (weary); and he didn't yaraa (fear) Alahayam.

Therefore it shall be, when Yahawah your Alahayam has given you nawach (rest) from all your ayab (enemy) all around, in the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you for an nachalah (inheritance) to yarash (possess) it, that you shall machah (blot) out the zakar (remember) of Imalaq (Amalek) from under the sky; you shall not shakach (forget).

It shall be, when you bawaa (come) come in to the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you for an nachalah (inheritance), and yarash (possess) it, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein,

That you shall laqach (take / seize) of the raashayath (beginning) of all the paray (fruit) of the adamah (ground), which you shall bawaa (come) in from your aratz (Earth/land) that Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you; and you shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) it in a tanaa (basket), and shall halak (move) to the maqawam (place) which Yahawah your Alahayam shall bachar (choose), to cause his sham (name) to shakan (place) there.

You shall bawaa (come) to the kahan (priest) who shall be in those yamayam (days), and amar (spoke) him, "I nagad (profess) this yawam (day) to Yahawah your Alahayam, that I am bawaa (come) to the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to our ab (father) to nathan (give) us."
The kahan (priest) shall laqach (take / seize) the tanaa (basket) out of your yad (hand), and yanach (set) it down panayam (face) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

You shall inah (answer / respond) and inah (answer / respond) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam, "A Aramay (Syrian) ready to abad (destroy / perish) was my ab (father); and he yarad (went) down into Matzarayam (Egypt), and lived there, mait (few) in number; and he became there a gaway (heathen / nation), gadawal (very great/important/mighty), itzawam (mighty), and rab (populous).
The Matzaray (Egyptians) dealt ill with us, and inah (oppress / afflict) us, and nathan (give) on us qashah (rough / hard) ibadah (bondage):

And we tzaiq (cried) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of our ab (father), and Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) our qawal (sound / voice), and raah (see) our inay (affliction), and our imal (toil), and our lachatz (oppression);

And Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) us forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt) with a chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and with an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), and with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraa (terror), and with athawath (signs), and with mapathayam (wonders);
And he bawaa (come) brought us into this maqawam (place), and nathan (give) given us this aratz (Earth/land), a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey).

Now, behold, I bawaa (come) brought the paray (first) of the fruit of the adamah (ground), which you, Yahawah, nathan (give) given me." You shall yanach (set) it down panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam, and shachah (worship) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam.

You shall shamach (rejoice) in all the tawab (good / proper function) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given to you, and to your bayath (house), you, and the Lawayay (Levite), and the foreigner who is in the qarab (among / near) of you.

When you kalah (complete / finish) made an end of ishar (tithing) all the maishar (tithe) of your thabawaah (increase) in the shalayashay (third) shanah (year), which is the shanah (year) of maishar (tithing), then you shall nathan (give) it to the Lawayay (Levite), to the foreigner, to the yathawam (fatherless), and to the alamanah (widow), that they may akal (eat) within your shair (gates), and be shabai (filled).

You shall amar (spoke) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam, "I have bair (put) away the qadash (set apart / make holy) things out of my bayath (house), and also nathan (give) given them to the Lawayay (Levite), and to the foreigner, to the yathawam (fatherless), and to the alamanah (widow), according to all your matzawah (commandment) which you have tzawah (commanded) me: I ibar (pass over/through) not transgressed any of your matzawah (commandments), neither have I shakach (forgotten) them:

I have not akal (eat) of it in my awan (mourning), neither have I bair (put) away of it, being tamaa (unclean), nor nathan (give) of it for the mawath (death): I have shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah my Alahayam; I ishah (make) done according to all that you have tzawah (commanded) me.

Shaqap (look) down from your qadash (set apart / make holy) maiwan (habitation), from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and barak (blessed) your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), and the adamah (ground) which you nathan (give) given us, as you shabai (swear / take oath) to our ab (father), a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey)."

This yawam (day) Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commands) you to ishah (make) these chaqayam (statutes) and mashapatayam (ordinances): you shall therefore shamar (keep/guard) and ishah (make) them with all your labab (heart), and with all your napash (soul).

You have amar (spoke) Yahawah this yawam (day) to be your Alahayam, and that you would yalak (walk) in his darak (ways), and shamar (keep/guard) his chaq (statute), and his matzawah (commandments), and his mashapat (ordinances), and shamai (hearken / hear) to his qawal (sound / voice):

And Yahawah has amar (spoke) you this yawam (day) to be a im (nation / people) for his own sagalah (possession), as he has dabar (word / matter) you, and that you should shamar (keep/guard) all his matzawah (commandments);

And to nathan (give) you ilayawan (Ilayawan) above all gawayam (nations) that he ishah (make) made, in thahalah (praise), and in sham (name), and in honor; and that you may be a qadawash (holy) im (nation / people) to Yahawah your Alahayam, as he has dabar (word / matter).

Mashah (Moses) and the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel) tzawah (commanded) the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "shamar (keep/guard) all the matzawah (commandment) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day).

It shall be on the yawam (day) when you shall ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) to the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you, that you shall qawam (rise up) yourself up gadawal (very great/important/mighty) abanayam (stones), and plaster them with plaster:

And you shall kathab (write) on them all the dabaray (words) of this thawarah (instruction), when you ibar (pass over/through) passed over; that you may bawaa (come) in to the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you, a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), has dabar (word / matter) you.

It shall be, when you ibar (pass over/through) passed over the Yaradan (Jordan), that you shall qawam (rise up) up these abanayam (stones), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), in har (mountain) Iyabal (Ebal), and you shall plaster them with plaster.
There you shall banah (build) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah your Alahayam, an mazabach (altar) of abanayam (stones): you shall nawap (lift) up no barazal (iron) on them.
You shall banah (build) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah your Alahayam of uncut abanayam (stones); and you shall ilah (go up / offer) burnt iwalath (offerings) thereon to Yahawah your Alahayam:
And you shall zabach (sacrifice) shalam (peace) offerings, and shall akal (eat) there; and you shall shamach (rejoice) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam.
You shall kathab (write) on the abanayam (stones) all the dabaray (words) of this thawarah (instruction) very baar (plainly)."

Mashah (Moses) and the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites) dabar (word / matter) to all Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "Keep silence, and shamai (hearken / hear), Yashar-Al (Israel): this yawam (day) you hayah (came to pass) become the im (nation / people) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

You shall therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam, and ishah (make) his matzawah (commandments) and his chaq (statute), which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day)."
Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) the im (nation / people) the same yawam (day), amar (spoke),

"These shall imad (stand) on har (mountain) Garazayam (Gerizim) to barak (blessed) the im (nation / people), when you ibar (pass over/through) passed over the Yaradan (Jordan): Shamaiwan (Simeon), and Laway (Levi), and Yahawadah (Judah), and Yashashakar (Issachar), and Yawasap (Joseph), and Banayamayan (Benjamin).
These shall imad (stand) on har (mountain) Iyabal (Ebal) for the qalalah (curse): Raawaban (Reuben), Gad (Gad), and Ashar (Asher), and Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Dan (Dan), and Napathalay (Naphtali).
The Lawayay (Levites) shall inah (answer / respond), and tell all the ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel) with a rawam (will lift up) qawal (sound / voice),

‘Arar (cursed) is the ayash (man / husband) who ishah (make) an engraved or masakah (molten) image, an thawaibah (abomination) to Yahawah, the maishah (work) of the yaday (hands) of the charash (craftsman), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it up in sathar (secret / hidden).' All the im (nation / people) shall inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who sets qalah (light) by his ab (father) or his am (mother).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who nasag (removes) his neighbor's gabawal (border/boundary).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who makes the iwar (blind) to shagah (wander) out of the darak (way).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
'Arar (cursed) is he who deprives the foreigner, yathawam (fatherless), and alamanah (widow) of mashapat (justice).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'

‘Arar (cursed) is he who shakab (lies) with his ab (father) ayashah (woman / wife), because he has galah (uncovered) his ab (father) kanap (skirt).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who shakab (lies) with any kind of animal.' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'

‘Arar (cursed) is he who shakab (lies) with his achawath (sister), the banath (daughter) of his ab (father), or the banath (daughter) of his am (mother).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who shakab (lies) with his mother-in-law.' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who nakah (strikes) his neighbor in sathar (secret / hidden).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'
‘Arar (cursed) is he who laqach (take / seize) a shachad (bribe) to nakah (kill) an naqay (innocent) napash (soul).' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'

‘Arar (cursed) is he who doesn't qawam (rise up) the dabaray (words) of this thawarah (instruction) to ishah (make) them.' All the im (nation / people) shall amar (spoke), ‘aman (believe / have faith).'"

It shall happen, if you shall shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all his matzawah (commandments) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), that Yahawah your Alahayam will nathan (give) you on ilayawan (Ilayawan) above all the gawayay (nations) of the aratz (Earth/land):
And all these barakawath (blessings) shall bawaa (come) on you, and nashag (overtake) you, if you shall shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam.
You shall be barak (blessed) in the iyar (city), and you shall be barak (blessed) in the shadah (field).

You shall be barak (blessed) in the paray (fruit) of your batan (body), the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), the paray (fruit) of your animals, the shagar (increase) of your livestock, and the Ishatharah (young) of your tzaan (flock).
Your tanaa (basket) and your mashaarath (kneading) trough shall be barak (blessed).
You shall be barak (blessed) when you bawaa (come) in, and you shall be barak (blessed) when you yatzaa (go out / come out) out.

Yahawah will nathan (give) your ayab (enemy) who qawam (rise up) up against you to be nagap (struck) panayam (face) you. They will yatzaa (go out / come out) out against you achad (one) darak (way), and will nawas (flee) panayam (face) you shabai (seven) darakayam (ways).

Yahawah will tzawah (command) the barakah (blessing) on you in your asam (barns), and in all that you mashalawach (put) your yad (hand) to; and he will barak (blessed) you in the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you.

Yahawah will qawam (rise up) you for a qadawash (holy) im (nation / people) to himself, as he has shabai (swear / take oath) to you; if you shall shamar (keep/guard) the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam, and halak (move) in his darak (ways).
All the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) shall raah (see) that you are qaraa (called) by the sham (name) of Yahawah; and they shall be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of you.

Yahawah will yathar (make) you plenteous for tawab (good / proper function), in the paray (fruit) of your batan (body), and in the paray (fruit) of your livestock, and in the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), in the adamah (land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father) to nathan (give) you.

Yahawah will pathach (open) to you his tawab (good / proper function) awatzar (treasure) in the sky, to nathan (give) the matar (rain) of your aratz (Earth/land) in its ith (season), and to barak (blessed) all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand): and you shall lawah (lend) to many gawayam (nations), and you shall not lawah (borrow).

Yahawah will nathan (give) you the raash (head), and not the zanab (tail); and you shall be mail (top/above) only, and you shall not be matah (beneath); if you shall shamai (hearken / hear) to the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam, which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), to shamar (keep/guard) and to ishah (make),

And shall not sawar (turn) aside from any of the dabarayam (words) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), to the right yamayan (right hand), or to the shamaawal (left hand), to yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them.

But it shall come to pass, if you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all his matzawah (commandments) and his chaqah (statutes) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), that all these qalalawath (curses) shall bawaa (come) on you, and nashag (overtake) you.
You shall be arar (cursed) in the iyar (city), and you shall be arar (cursed) in the shadah (field).
Your tanaa (basket) and your mashaarath (kneading) trough shall be arar (cursed).
The paray (fruit) of your batan (body), the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), the shagar (increase) of your livestock, and the Ishatharah (young) of your tzaan (flock) shall be arar (cursed).
You shall be arar (cursed) when you bawaa (come) in, and you shall be arar (cursed) when you yatzaa (go out / come out) out.

Yahawah will shalach (send) on you maarah (cursing), mahawamah (confusion), and magairath (rebuke), in all that you mashalawach (put) your yad (hand) to ishah (make), until you are destroyed, and until you abad (destroy / perish) mahar (quickly); panayam (face) of the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings), by which you have forsaken me.
Yahawah will make the dabar (word / matter) cling to you, until he kalah (complete / finish) consumed you from off the adamah (land), where you bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.

Yahawah will nakah (strike) you with shachapath (consumption), and with qadachath (fever), and with dalaqath (inflammation), and with fiery heat, and with the charab (sword), and with blight, and with mildew; and they shall radap (pursue) you until you abad (destroy / perish).
Your sky that is over your raash (head) shall be nachashath (brass), and the aratz (Earth/land) that is under you shall be barazal (iron).
Yahawah will nathan (give) the matar (rain) of your aratz (Earth/land) abaq (powder) and ipar (dust): from the sky shall it yarad (come) down on you, until you are destroyed.

Yahawah will nathan (give) you to be nagap (struck) panayam (face) your ayab (enemy); you shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out achad (one) darak (way) against them, and shall nawas (flee) shabai (seven) darakayam (ways) panayam (face) them: and you shall be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land).
Your nabalah (dead) body shall be maakal (food) to all iwap (flying) of the sky, and to the animals of the aratz (Earth/land); and there shall be none to frighten them away.

Yahawah will nakah (strike) you with the shachayan (boil) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and with the tumors, and with the garab (scurvy), and with the charas (itch), of which you yakal (can) not be rapaa (healed).
Yahawah will nakah (strike) you with shagaiwan (madness), and with iwarawan (blindness), and with thamahawan (astonishment) of labab (heart);

And you shall mashash (grope) at noonday, as the iwar (blind) mashash (gropes) in apalah (darkness), and you shall not tzalach (prosper) in your darak (ways): and you shall be only ishaq (oppressed) and gazal (robbed) yamayam (always), and there shall be none to yashai (salvation) you.

You shall arash (betroth) a ayashah (woman / wife), and achar (other) ayash (man / husband) shall shagal (lie) with her: you shall banah (build) a bayath (house), and you shall not yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein: you shall natai (plant) a karam (vineyard), and shall not use its fruit.

Your shawar (ox) shall be tabach (slain) before your iyan (eye), and you shall not akal (eat) of it: your donkey shall be violently gazal (taken) away from before your panayam (face), and shall not be shawab (turn back / repent) to you: your tzaan (sheep) shall be nathan (give) to your ayab (enemy), and you shall have none to yashai (salvation) you.

Your ban (son) and your banath (daughter) shall be nathan (give) to achar (other) im (nation / people); and your iyan (eye) shall raah (see), and kalah (complete / finish) with longing for them all the yawam (day): and there shall be nothing in the al (Alahayam) of your yad (hand).

The paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), and all your yagayai (labors), shall a im (nation / people) which you don't yadai (know) akal (eat) up; and you shall be only ishaq (oppressed) and ratzatz (crushed) yamayam (always);
So that you shall be shagai (mad) for the maraah (sight) of your iyan (eye) which you shall raah (see).

Yahawah will nakah (strike) you in the barakayam (knees), and in the shaqayam (legs), with a rai (sore) shachayan (boil), of which you yakal (can) not be rapaa (healed), from the kap (sole) of your ragal (feet / foot) to the qadaqad (crown) of your head.

Yahawah will yalak (bring) you, and your malak (king) whom you shall qawam (rise up) over you, to a gaway (heathen / nation) that you yadai (have) not known, you nor your ab (father); and there you shall ibad (servant) other Alahayam, itz (wood) and aban (stone).
You shall become an shamah (astonishment), a mashal (proverb), and a shanayanah (byword), among all the imayam (peoples) where Yahawah shall nahag (lead) you away.
You shall yatzaa (go out / come out) much zarai (seed) out into the shadah (field), and shall asap (gather) mait (little) in; for the arabah (locust) shall chasal (consume) it.
You shall natai (plant) karamayam (vineyards) and ibad (servant) them, but you shall neither shathah (drinks) of the yayan (wine), nor harvest; for the thawalai (worm) shall akal (eat) them.
You shall have zayath (olive) trees throughout all your gabawal (border/boundary), but you shall not sawak (anoint) yourself with the shaman (oil); for your zayathayam (olives) shall drop off.
You shall yalad (birth / begot) banayam (sons) and banawath (daughters), but they shall not be yours; for they shall yalak (go) into shabay (captivity).
All your itz (trees) and the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground) shall the tzalatzal (locust) yarash (possess).
The foreigner who is in the qarab (among / near) of you shall ilah (go up / offer) up mail (top/above) you higher and higher; and you shall yarad (come) down lower and lower.
He shall lawah (lend) to you, and you shall not lawah (lend) to him: he shall be the raash (head), and you shall be the zanab (tail).

All these qalalawath (curses) shall bawaa (come) on you, and shall radap (pursue) you, and nashag (overtake) you, until you are destroyed; because you didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments) and his chaqah (statutes) which he tzawah (commanded) you:
And they shall be on you for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) and for a mawapath (wonder), and on your zarai (seed) iwalam (forever).
Because you didn't ibad (servant) Yahawah your Alahayam with shamachah (joyfulness), and with tawab (good / proper function) of labab (heart), by reason of the rab (abundance) of all things;

Therefore you shall ibad (servant) your ayab (enemy) whom Yahawah shall shalach (send) against you, in raib (hunger), and in tzamaa (thirst), and in iyaram (nakedness), and in chasar (want) of all things: and he shall nathan (give) a il (over) of barazal (iron) on your tzawaar (neck), until he has destroyed you.

Yahawah will nashaa (lift) a gaway (heathen / nation) against you from rachawaq (far), from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land), as the nashar (eagle) daah (flies); a gaway (heathen / nation) whose lashawan (tongue / language) you shall not shamai (hearken / hear);
A gaway (heathen / nation) of iz (fierce) facial expressions, that shall not nashaa (lift) the panayam (face) of the zaqan (old), nor show favor to the nair (young),

And shall akal (eat) the paray (fruit) of your livestock, and the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), until you are destroyed; that also shall not shaar (leave) you grain, new thayarawash (wine), or yatzahar (fresh oil), the shagar (increase) of your livestock, or the Ishatharah (young) of your tzaan (flock), until they have caused you to abad (destroy / perish).

They shall besiege you in all your shair (gates), until your gabah (high) and batzar (fortified) chawamah (walls) yarad (come) down, in which you batach (trusted), throughout all your aratz (Earth/land); and they shall besiege you in all your shair (gates) throughout all your aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given you.

You shall akal (eat) the paray (fruit) of your own batan (body), the bashar (flesh) of your ban (son) and of your banath (daughter), whom Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given you, in the matzawar (siege) and in the matzawaq (distress) with which your ayab (enemy) shall tzawaq (distress) you.

The ayash (man / husband) who is rak (tender) among you, and very inag (delicate), his iyan (eye) shall be raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) toward his ach (brother/kinsman), and toward the ayashah (woman / wife) of his chayaq (bosom), and toward the yathar (remnant) of his ban (son) whom he has yathar (remaining);

So that he will not nathan (give) to any of them of the bashar (flesh) of his ban (son) whom he shall akal (eat), because he has nothing shaar (left) him, in the matzawar (siege) and in the matzawaq (distress) with which your ayab (enemy) shall tzawaq (distress) you in all your shair (gates).

The rak (tender) and inag (delicate) woman among you, who would not nasah (adventure) to yatzag (set) the kap (sole) of her ragal (feet / foot) on the aratz (Earth/land) for inag (delicateness) and rak (tenderness), her iyan (eye) shall be raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) toward the ayash (man / husband) of her chayaq (bosom), and toward her ban (son), and toward her banath (daughter),

And toward her shalayah (young) one who yatzaa (go out / come out) out from between her ragal (feet / foot), and toward her ban (son) whom she shall yalad (birth / begot); for she shall akal (eat) them for chasar (want) of all things secretly, in the matzawar (siege) and in the tzawaq (distress) with which your ayab (enemy) shall tzawaq (distress) you in your shair (gates).

If you will not shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all the dabaray (words) of this thawarah (instruction) that are kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document), that you may yaraa (fear / be afraid) this kabad (glorious) and fearful sham (name), Yahawah YOUR Alahayam;

Then Yahawah will palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) your makawath (plagues) palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous), and the makawath (plagues) of your zarai (seed), even gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makawath (plagues), and of aman (believe / have faith) continuance, and severe sicknesses, and of aman (believe / have faith) continuance.
He will shawab (turn back / repent) on you again all the madawah (diseases) of Matzarayam (Egypt), which you were yagar (afraid) of; and they shall cling to you.

Also every chalay (sickness), and every makah (plague), which is not kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of this thawarah (instruction), Yahawah will ilah (go up / offer) them on you, until you are destroyed.

You shall be shaar (left) mait (few) in number, whereas you were as the kawakabay (stars) of the sky for rab (multitude); because you didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

It shall happen that as Yahawah shawash (rejoiced) over you to do you yatab (good), and to rabah (multiply) you, so Yahawah will shawash (rejoice) over you to cause you to abad (destroy / perish), and to abad (destroy / perish) you; and you shall be nasach (plucked) from off the adamah (land) where you bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.

Yahawah will pawatz (scatter) you among all imayam (peoples), from the one qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land) even to the other end of the earth; and there you shall ibad (servant) other Alahayam, which you yadai (have) not known, you nor your ab (father), even itz (wood) and aban (stone).

Among these gawayam (nations) you shall ragai (find) no ease, and there shall be no manawach (rest) for the kap (sole) of your ragal (feet / foot): but Yahawah will nathan (give) you there a ragaz (trembling) lab (heart), and kalayawan (failing) of iyanayam (eyes), and pining of napash (soul);

And your chay (life) shall thalaa (hang) in doubt before you; and you shall pachad (fear / dread) layal (night) and yawamam (by day), and shall have no aman (believe / have faith) of your chay (life).

In the baqar (morning) you shall amar (spoke), "I wish it were irab (evening)!" And at irab (evening) you shall amar (spoke), "I wish it were baqar (morning)!" For the pachad (fear / dread) of your labab (heart) which you shall pachad (fear / dread), and for the maraah (sight) of your iyan (eye) which you shall raah (see).

Yahawah will shawab (turn back / repent) you into Matzarayam (Egypt) again with anayawath (ships), by the darak (way) of which I amar (spoke) to you, You shall raah (see) it no more again: and there you shall makar (sell) yourselves to your ayab (enemy) for ibadayam (bondservants) and for bondmaids, and no man shall qanah (buy) you.

These are the words of the covenant which Yahawah amar (spoke) Mashah (Moses) to ishah (make) with the children of Yashar-Al (Israel) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Moab, besides the covenant which he ishah (make) with them in Horeb.
Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, You raah (see) seen all that Yahawah did before your iyan (eye) in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
The great trials which your iyanayam (eyes) raah (see), the signs, and those great wonders:
But Yahawah il (over) not given you a heart to know, and eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this arabaiyam (forty).
I have led you forty years in the wilderness: your clothes have not grown old on you, and your shoes have not grown old on your feet.
You have not bawaa (come) bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink; that you may know that I am Yahawah your Alahayam.
When you nathan (give) to this laqach (take / seize), Sihon the shabat (king) of Heshbon, and Og the shabat (king) of Bashan, nathan (give) out against us to battle, and we nathan (give) them:
And we shamar (keep/guard) their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half - tribe of the Manassites.
Keep therefore the words of this covenant, and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
You stand this day all of you qarab (among / near) Yahawah your Alahayam; your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
Your little ones, your wives, and your foreigner who is in the midst of your camps, from the one who karath (cut) your wood to the one who draws your water;
That you may enter into the covenant of Yahawah your Alahayam, and into his shabai (swear / take oath), which Yahawah your Alahayam qawam (rise up) with you this yawam (day);
That he may establish you this day to himself for a people, and that he may be to you a Alahayam, as he spoke to you, and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
Neither with you only do I imad (make) this covenant and this oath,
But with him who stands here with us this day qarab (among / near) Yahawah our Alahayam, and also with him who is not here with us this day
(For you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the midst of the nations through which you passed;
And you yash (have) seen their abominations, and their idols, wood and stone, silver and gold, which were among them);

Lest there should be among you man, or woman, or family, or tribe, whose labab (heart) turns away this hayah (came to pass) from Yahawah our Alahayam, to yalak (go) to serve the Alahayam of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that yalak (bears) gall and wormwood;

And it happen, when he hears the words of this alah (curse / oath), that he bless himself in his heart, saying, "I shall have peace, kay (surely) I walk in the stubbornness of my heart, to machah (destroy) the moist with the dry."

Yahawah will not pardon him, but then the anger of Yahawah and his jealousy will smoke against that rai (man), and all the alah (curse / oath) that is kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document) shall lie on him, and Yahawah will blot out his name from under the sky.
Yahawah will set him apart to evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant that is written in this book of the law.

The generation to ilah (go up / offer), your children who shall ilah (go up / offer) up ashar (who/that) you, and the foreigner who shall ilah (go up / offer) from a far aratz (Earth/land), shall say, when they chamah (see) the plagues of that aratz (Earth/land), and the sicknesses with which Yahawah has tzamach (made) it sick;

And that the whole aratz (Earth/land) of it is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, nor ishah (make), nor any grass grows therein, like the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, Admah and Zeboiim, which Yahawah overthrew in his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and in his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting):
Even all the nations shall amar (spoke), "Why has Yahawah done thus to this aratz (Earth/land)? What does the heat of this alahayam (God) anger mean?"
Then men shall say, "Because they forsook the covenant of Yahawah, the Alahayam of their fathers, which he yalak (made) with them when he yalak (brought) them forth out of the land of Egypt,
And bawaa (come) and served other Alahayam, and worshiped them, Alahayam that they didn't know, and that he bawaa (come) not given to them:
Therefore the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was kindled against this aratz (Earth/land), to bring on it all the curse that is written in this book;
And Yahawah rooted them out of their land in anger, and in wrath, and in alahayam (God) indignation, and cast them into another land, as at this day."

The sathar (secret) things belong to Yahawah our Alahayam; but the things that are galah (revealed) belong to us and to our ban (son) iwalam (forever), that we may ishah (make) all the dabar (word / matter) of this thawarah (instruction).

It shall happen, when all these things bawaa (come) come on you, the barakah (blessing) and the qalalah (curse), which I nathan (give) set panayam (face) you, and you shall shawab (turn back / repent) them to labab (mind) among all the gawayam (nations), where Yahawah your Alahayam has nadach (driven) you,

And shall shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah your Alahayam, and shall shamai (hearken / hear) his qawal (sound / voice) according to all that I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), you and your ban (son), with all your labab (heart), and with all your napash (soul);

That then Yahawah your Alahayam will shawab (turn back / repent) your shabawath (captivity), and racham (show mercy / love) compassion on you, and will shawab (turn back / repent) and qabatz (gather) you from all the imayam (peoples), where Yahawah your Alahayam has pawatz (scattered) you.

If your nadach (outcasts) are in the uttermost parts of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), from there will Yahawah your Alahayam qabatz (gather) you, and from there he will laqach (take / seize) you back:

And Yahawah your Alahayam will bawaa (come) you into the aratz (Earth/land) which your ab (father) yarash (possessed), and you shall yarash (possess) it; and he will do you yatab (good), and rabah (multiply) you above your ab (father).

Yahawah your Alahayam will mawal (circumcise) your labab (heart), and the labab (heart) of your zarai (seed), to ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam with all your labab (heart), and with all your napash (soul), that you may chay (life).
Yahawah your Alahayam will nathan (give) all these alawath (curses) on your ayab (enemy), and on those who shanaa (hate) you, who radap (persecuted) you.
You shall shawab (turn back / repent) and shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, and ishah (make) all his matzawah (commandments) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day).

Yahawah your Alahayam will yathar (make) you plenteous in all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand), in the paray (fruit) of your batan (body), and in the paray (fruit) of your livestock, and in the paray (fruit) of your adamah (ground), for tawab (good / proper function): for Yahawah will again shawash (rejoice) over you for tawab (good / proper function), as he shawash (rejoiced) over your ab (father);

If you shall shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments) and his chaqah (statutes) which are kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction); if you shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah your Alahayam with all your labab (heart), and with all your napash (soul).
For this matzawah (commandment) which I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day), it is not palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) hard for you, neither is it rachawaq (far) off.

It is not in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), that you should amar (spoke), "Who shall ilah (go up / offer) up for us to shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and laqach (take / seize) it to us, and shamai (hearken / hear) us to hear it, that we may ishah (make) it?"

Neither is it ibar (beyond) the yam (sea/waters), that you should amar (spoke), "Who shall ibar (pass over/through) over the yam (sea/waters) for us, and laqach (take / seize) it to us, and shamai (hearken / hear) us to hear it, that we may ishah (make) it?"
But the dabar (word / matter) is very qarawab (near) to you, in your pah (mouth), and in your labab (heart), that you may ishah (make) it.
Raah (see), I nathan (give) set panayam (face) you this yawam (day) chay (life) and tawab (good / proper function), and mawath (death) and rai (evil);

In that I tzawah (command) you this yawam (day) to ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in his darak (ways), and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments) and his chaqah (statutes) and his mashapat (ordinances), that you may chayah (live) and rabah (multiply), and that Yahawah your Alahayam may barak (blessed) you in the aratz (Earth/land) where you bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.
But if your labab (heart) panah (turn) away, and you will not shamai (hearken / hear), but shall be nadach (drawn) away, and shachah (worship) other Alahayam, and ibad (servant) them;

I nagad (denounce) to you this yawam (day), that you shall abad (destroy / perish) abad (destroy / perish); you shall not prolong your yamayam (days) in the adamah (land), where you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) to bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.

I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land) to iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against you this yawam (day), that I nathan (give) set panayam (face) you chay (life) and mawath (death), the barakah (blessing) and the qalalah (curse): therefore bachar (choose) chay (life), that you may chayah (live), you and your zarai (seed);

To ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam, to shamai (hearken / hear) his qawal (sound / voice), and to cling to him; for he is your chay (life), and the arak (length) of your yawam (day); that you may yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the adamah (land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), to nathan (give) them.
Mashah (Moses) yalak (went) and dabar (word / matter) these dabarayam (words) to all Yashar-Al (Israel).

He amar (spoke) to them, "I am one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) this yawam (day); I yakal (can) no more yatzaa (go out / come out) out and bawaa (come) in: and Yahawah has amar (spoke) to me, ‘You shall not ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan).'

Yahawah your Alahayam, he will ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) you; he will shamad (destroy) these gawayam (nations) from panayam (face) you, and you shall yarash (dispossess) them. Yahawashawai (Joshua) shall ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) you, as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter).
Yahawah will ishah (make) to them as he ishah (make) to Sayachawan (Sihon) and to Iwag (Og), the malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites), and to their aratz (Earth/land); whom he destroyed.
Yahawah will nathan (give) them up panayam (face) you, and you shall ishah (make) to them according to all the matzawah (commandment) which I have tzawah (commanded) you.

Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor be scared of them: for Yahawah your Alahayam, he it is who does halak (move) with you; he will not rapah (fail) you, nor izab (forsake) you."

Mashah (Moses) qaraa (called) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke) to him in the iyan (eye) of all Yashar-Al (Israel), "Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous): for you shall bawaa (come) with this im (nation / people) into the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah has shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) to nathan (give) them; and you shall nachal (cause) them to inherit it.

Yahawah, he it is who does halak (move) panayam (face) you; he will be with you, he will not rapah (fail) you, neither izab (forsake) you: don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed)."

Mashah (Moses) kathab (write) this thawarah (instruction), and nathan (give) it to the kahanayam (priests) the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi), who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and to all the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), "At the qatz (end) of every shabai (seven) shanayam (years), in the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) time of the shanah (year) of shamatah (release), in the chag (feast/festival) of sakawath (tents),

When all Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) come to raah (see) panayam (face) Yahawah your Alahayam in the maqawam (place) which he shall bachar (choose), you shall qaraa (called) this thawarah (instruction) before all Yashar-Al (Israel) in their azan (ear).

Qahal (assemble) the im (nation / people), the im (nation / people) and the nashayam (women) and the little tap (ones), and your foreigner who is within your shair (gates), that they may shamai (hearken / hear), and that they may lamad (teach / instruct), and yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam, and shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all the dabaray (words) of this thawarah (instruction);

And that their ban (son), who yadai (have) not known, may shamai (hearken / hear), and lamad (teach / instruct) to yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam, as yawam (day) as you chay (life) in the adamah (land) where you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) to yarash (possess) it."

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "Behold, your yawam (day) qarab (come close) that you must mawath (death): qaraa (called) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and yatzab (present) yourselves in the ahal (tent) of Meeting, that I may commission him." Mashah (Moses) and Yahawashawai (Joshua) yalak (went), and yatzab (presented) themselves in the ahal (tent) of Meeting.
Yahawah raah (see) in the ahal (tent) in a imawad (pillar) of inan (cloud): and the imawad (pillar) of inan (cloud) imad (stood) over the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Mashah (Moses), "Behold, you shall sleep with your ab (father); and this im (nation / people) will qawam (rise up) up, and zanah (play) the prostitute achar (other) the nakar (strange) Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land), where they bawaa (come) to be qarab (among / near) them, and will izab (forsake) me, and parar (break) my barayath (covenant) which I have karath (cut) with them.

Then my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) shall be charah (hot with anger) against them in that yawam (day), and I will izab (forsake) them, and I will sathar (hide) my panayam (face) from them, and they shall be akal (eat), and many raiwath (evils) and tzarawath (troubles) shall matzaa (come) on them; so that they will amar (spoke) in that yawam (day), ‘Haven't these raiwath (evils) matzaa (come) on us because our Alahayam is not qarab (among / near) us?'
I will sathar (surely) sathar (hide) my panayam (face) in that yawam (day) for all the rai (evil) which they shall ishah (make) worked, in that they are panah (turn) to other Alahayam.

"Now therefore kathab (write) this shayar (song) for yourselves, and lamad (teach / instruct) it to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): shawam (place / establish / appoint) it in their pah (mouths), that this shayar (song) may be a id (until / as far as) for me against the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

For when I shall bawaa (come) brought them into the adamah (land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father), zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey), and they shall have akal (eat) and shabai (filled) themselves, and grown dashan (fat); then will they panah (turn) to other Alahayam, and ibad (servant) them, and naatz (despise) me, and parar (break) my barayath (covenant).

It shall happen, when many raiwath (evils) and tzarawath (troubles) matzaa (have) come on them, that this shayar (song) shall inah (answer / respond) panayam (face) them as a id (until / as far as); for it shall not be shakach (forgotten) out of the pah (mouths) of their zarai (seed): for I yadai (know) their yatzar (imagination) which they frame this yawam (day), before I bawaa (come) brought them into the aratz (Earth/land) which I shabai (swear / take oath)."
So Mashah (Moses) kathab (write) this shayar (song) the same yawam (day), and lamad (teach / instruct) it the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

He commissioned Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and amar (spoke), "Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous); for you shall bawaa (come) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) into the aratz (Earth/land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to them: and I will be with you."

It happened, when Mashah (Moses) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of kathab (write) the dabaray (words) of this thawarah (instruction) in a sapar (book / scribed document), until they were finished,
That Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) the Lawayay (Levites), who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, amar (spoke),

"Laqach (take / seize) this sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it by the tzad (side) of the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah your Alahayam, that it may be there for a id (until / as far as) against you.

For I yadai (know) your rebellion, and your qashah (rough / hard) irap (neck): behold, while I am yet chay (life) with you this yawam (day), you have been rebellious against Yahawah; and how much more achar (other) my mawath (death)?

Qahal (assemble) to me all the zaqanay (elders) of your shabat (tribes), and your shatar (officers), that I may dabar (word / matter) these dabarayam (words) in their azan (ear), and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land) to iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them.

For I yadai (know) that achar (other) my mawath (death) you will shachath (utterly) shachath (corrupt) yourselves, and sawar (turn) aside from the darak (way) which I have tzawah (commanded) you; and rai (evil) will qaraa (called) to you in the acharayath (latter) yamayam (days); because you will ishah (make) that which is rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger) through the maishah (work) of your yad (hand)."
Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) in the azanay (ears) of all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel) the dabaray (words) of this shayar (song), until they were finished.
Azan (ear) ear, you shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and I will dabar (word / matter). Let the aratz (Earth/land) shamai (hearken / hear) the amaray (words) of my pah (mouth).

My laqach (doctrine) shall irap (drop) as the matar (rain). My amarah (sayings) shall condense as the tal (dew), as the shaiyar (small) rain on the tender ishab (grass), as the rabayabayam (showers) on the ishab (herb).
For I will qaraa (called) the sham (name) of Yahawah. Yahab (ascribe) gadal (greatness) to our Alahayam!

The tzawar (rock), his pail (work) is thamayam (complete / whole), for all his darak (ways) are mashapat (justice): a Al of amawanah (faithfulness) and without iwal (iniquity), tzadayaq (righteous) and yashar (upright) is he.
They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his ban (son), because of their defect. They are a iqash (perverse) and pathalathal (crooked) dawar (generation / age / period).
Gamal (do) you thus requite Yahawah, foolish im (nation / people) and unwise? Isn't he your ab (father) who has bought you? He ishah (make) made you, and kawan (established) you.

Zakar (remember) the yamawath (days) of iwalam (forever). Bayan (between) the shanawath (years) of many dawar (generation / age / period). Shaal (ask) your ab (father), and he will show you; your zaqan (elders), and they will amar (spoke) you.

When the Most ilayawan (Ilayawan) nachal (gave) to the gawayam (nations) their nachal (inheritance), when he parad (separated) the banay (children) of adam (men), he natzab (set) the gabalath (bounds) of the imayam (peoples) according to the masapar (number) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
For Yahawah chalaq (portion) is his im (nation / people). Yaiqab (Jacob) is the chabal (lot) of his nachalah (inheritance).

He matzaa (found) him in a madabar (desert) aratz (Earth/land), in the thahaw (formless) yalal (howling) yashayamawan (wilderness). He surrounded him. He cared for him. He natzar (kept) him as the ayashawan (apple) of his iyan (eye).

As an nashar (eagle) that iwar (rouse / awaken) up her qan (nest), that rachap (hover) over her gawazal (young), he parash (spread) abroad his abarah (wings), he laqach (take / seize) them, he nashaa (lift) them on his abarah (feathers).
Yahawah badad (alone) nachah (led) him. There was no foreign Al with him.

He rakab (made) him ride on the bamah (high) places of the aratz (Earth/land). He akal (eat) the thanawabah (increase) of the shadah (field). He caused him to yanaq (suck) dabash (honey) out of the salai (rock), shaman (oil) out of the chalamayash (flinty) tzawar (rock);

Chamaah (butter) of the baqar (morning), and chalab (milk) of the tzaan (flock), with chalab (fat) of karayam (lambs), ayalayam (rams) of the ban (son) of Bashan (Bashan), and ithawadayam (goats), with the finest of the chatah (wheat). Of the dam (blood) of the inab (grape) you shathah (drinks) wine.

But Yasharawan (Jeshurun) grew shaman (fat), and bait (kicked). You have grown shaman (fat). You have grown ibah (thick). You have become sleek. Then he forsook Alawah who ishah (make) him, and nabal (lightly) esteemed the tzawar (rock) of his yashawaih (salvation).
They qanaa (jealous) him to jealousy with zawar (strange) Alahayam. They provoked him to anger with thawaibath (abominations).
They zabach (sacrificed) to demons, not Alawah, to Alahayam that they didn't yadai (know), to chadash (new) Alahayam that came up recently, which your ab (father) didn't dread.
Of the tzawar (rock) who became your yalad (birth / begot), you are shayah (unmindful), and have shakach (forgotten) Al who gave you birth.
Yahawah raah (see) and naatz (abhorred), because of the kais (provocation) of his ban (son) and his banath (daughter).

He amar (spoke), "I will sathar (hide) my panayam (face) from them. I will raah (see) what their acharayath (end) shall be; for they are a very thahapakah (perverse) dawar (generation / age / period), banayam (children) in whom is no amawan (faithfulness).

They have qanaa (jealous) me to jealousy with that which is not Al. They have provoked me to kais (anger) with their habal (vanities). I will qanaa (jealous) them to jealousy with those who are not a im (nation / people). I will provoke them to kais (anger) with a foolish gaway (heathen / nation).

For a ash (fire) is qadach (kindled) in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), yaqad (burns) to the lowest shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), akal (eat) the aratz (Earth/land) with its yabawal (increase), and sets the mawasaday (foundations) of the harayam (mountains) on lahat (fire).
"I will sapah (heap) raiwath (evils) on them. I will kalah (complete / finish) my chatz (arrows) on them.

They shall be wasted with raib (hunger), and lacham (devoured) with rashap (burning) heat and marayaray (bitter) qatab (destruction). I will shalach (send) the shan (teeth) of animals on them, With the chamah (poison) of crawling things of the ipar (dust).

Outside the charab (sword) shall shakal (bereave), and in the rooms, ayamah (terror); on both bachawar (young) man and bathawalah (virgin), The yanaq (nursing) infant with the gray-haired ayash (man / husband).
I amar (spoke), I would paah (scatter) them afar. I would make their zakar (remember) to shabath (shabath / rest) from among anawash (men);

Were it not that I gawar (feared) the kais (provocation) of the ayab (enemy), lest their tzar (oppressor / distressor) should nakar (judge) wrongly, lest they should amar (spoke), ‘Our yad (hand) is rawam (will lift up), Yahawah has not pail (done) all this.'"
For they are a gaway (heathen / nation) abad (destroy / perish) of itzah (counsel). There is no thabawan (understanding) in them.
Oh that they were chakam (wise), that they shakal (understood) this, that they would bayan (between) their acharayath (latter) end!

How could achad (one) radap (chase) a alap (thousand), and shanayam (two) put rababah (ten) alap (thousand) to nawas (flight), unless their tzawar (rock) had makar (sold) them, and Yahawah had sagar (delivered) them up?
For their tzawar (rock) is not as our tzawar (rock), even our ayab (enemy) themselves being palayalayam (judges).

For their gapan (vine) is of the gapan (vine) of Sadam (Sodom), of the shadamath (fields) of Imarah (Gomorrah). Their inabay (grapes) are inabay (grapes) of raash (head), Their ashakalath (clusters) are mararah (bitter).
Their yayan (wine) is the chamah (poison) of thanayanam (serpents), The akazar (cruel) raash (head) of asps.
"Isn't this kamas (laid) up in store with me, chatham (sealed) up among my awatzar (treasures)?

Naqam (vengeance) is mine, and shalam (recompense), at the ith (time) when their ragal (feet / foot) mawat (slides); for the yawam (day) of their ayad (calamity) is at qarawab (hand). The things that are to ithayad (come) on them shall make chawash (haste)."

For Yahawah will dayan (judge) his im (nation / people), and have compassion on his ibad (servant), when he raah (see) that their yad (hand) is azal (gone), There is apas (none) remaining, itzar (shut) up or izab (left) at large.
He will amar (spoke), "Where are their Alahayam, The tzawar (rock) in which they took chasah (refuge);

Which akal (eat) the chalab (fat) of their zabach (sacrifices), And shathah (drinks) the yayan (wine) of their drink nasayak (offering)? Let them qawam (rise up) up and izar (help) you! Let them be your sathar (secret / hidden).

"Raah (see) now that I, even I, am he, There is no Alahayam with me. I mawath (death), and I chayah (make) alive. I machatz (crush / shatter), and I rapaa (heal). There is no one who can natzal (deliver) out of my yad (hand).
For I nashaa (lift) up my yad (hand) to shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), And amar (spoke), As I chay (life) iwalam (forever),

If I shanan (whet) my baraq (glittering) charab (sword), My yad (hand) achaz (take) hold on mashapat (judgment); I will shawab (turn back / repent) naqam (vengeance) to my tzar (oppressor / distressor), and will shalam (recompense) those who shanaa (hate) me.

I will make my chatz (arrows) shakar (drunk) with dam (blood). My charab (sword) shall akal (eat) bashar (flesh) with the dam (blood) of the chalal (slain) and the shabayah (captives), from the raash (head) of the leaders of the ayab (enemy)."

Ranan (rejoice), you gawayam (nations), with his im (nation / people), for he will naqam (avenge) the dam (blood) of his ibad (servant). He will shawab (turn back / repent) naqam (vengeance) to his tzar (oppressor / distressor), And will kapar (make) expiation for his adamah (land), for his im (nation / people).

Mashah (Moses) bawaa (come) and dabar (word / matter) all the dabaray (words) of this shayar (song) in the azanay (ears) of the im (nation / people), he and Hawashai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun).
Mashah (Moses) kalah (complete / finish) an end of dabar (word / matter) all these dabarayam (words) to all Yashar-Al (Israel);

He amar (spoke) to them, "shawam (place / establish / appoint) your labab (heart) to all the dabarayam (words) which I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to you this yawam (day), which you shall tzawah (command) your ban (son) to shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make), all the dabarayam (words) of this thawarah (instruction).

For it is no rayaq (vain) thing for you; because it is your chay (life), and through this thing you shall prolong your yamayam (days) in the adamah (land), where you ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan) to yarash (possess) it."
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) that same yawam (day), amar (spoke),

"Ilah (go up / offer) up into this har (mountain) of Ibarayam (Abarim), to har (mountain) Nabaw (Nebo), which is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), that is over panayam (face) Yarayachaw (Jericho); and raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), which I nathan (give) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) for a achazah (possession);

And mawath (death) on the har (mountain) where you ilah (go up / offer) up, and be asap (gathered) to your im (nation / people), as Aharawan (Aaron) your ach (brother/kinsman) mawath (death) on har (mountain) Har (Hor), and was asap (gathered) to his im (nation / people):

Because you mail (top/above) against me in the thawak (midst) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) at the may (waters) of marayabah (meribah) of Kadesh, in the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin); because you didn't qadash (set apart / make holy) me in the thawak (midst) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
For you shall raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land) before you; but you shall not bawaa (come) there into the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)."
This is the barakah (blessing), with which Mashah (Moses) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam barak (blessed) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) panayam (face) his mawath (death).

He amar (spoke), "Yahawah bawaa (come) from Sayanay (Sinai), And zarach (rose) from Shaiyar (Seir) to them. He yapai (shone) forth from har (mountain) Paaran (Paran). He athah (you (masc)) from the rababah (ten) thousands of qadash (set apart / make holy) ones. At his right yamayan (right hand) was a ashadath (fiery) ashadath (law) for them.
Yes, he chabab (loves) the imayam (people). All his qadawash (saints) are in your yad (hand). They thakah (sat) down at your ragal (feet / foot); each nashaa (lift) your dabarah (words).
Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) us a thawarah (instruction), An mawarashah (inheritance) for the qahalah (assembly) of Yaiqab (Jacob).
He was malak (king) in Yasharawan (Jeshurun), When the raashay (heads) of the im (nation / people) were asap (gathered), All the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) yachad (together).
"Let Raawaban (Reuben) chayah (live), and not mawath (death); Nor let his math (men) be masapar (few)."

This is for Yahawadah (Judah). He amar (spoke), "shamai (hearken / hear), Yahawah, the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawadah (Judah). Bawaa (come) him in to his im (nation / people). With his yad (hand) he contended for himself. You shall be a izar (help) against his tzar (oppressor / distressor)."

Of Laway (Levi) he amar (spoke), "Your thamayam (complete / whole) and your awarayam (urim) are with your chasayad (godly) ayash (man / husband), whom you nasah (proved) at Masah (Massah), with whom you rayab (strove) at the may (waters) of Marayabah (Meribah);

Who amar (spoke) of his ab (father), and of his am (mother), ‘I raah (see) not seen him;' Neither did he nakar (acknowledge) his ach (brother/kinsman), Nor did he yadai (know) his own ban (son): For they have shamar (keep/guard) your amarah (sayings), and natzar (keep) your barayath (covenant).

They shall yarah (teach) Yaiqab (Jacob) your mashapat (ordinances), and Yashar-Al (Israel) your thawarah (instruction). They shall shawam (place / establish / appoint) qatawarah (incense) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) you, and whole burnt kalayal (offering) on your mazabach (altar).

Yahawah, barak (blessed) his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor). Ratzah (accept) the pail (work) of his yad (hand). Machatz (crush / shatter) through the hips of those who qawam (rise up) up against him, of those who shanaa (hate) him, that they not qawam (rise up) again."

Of Banayamayan (Benjamin) he amar (spoke), "The yadayad (beloved) of Yahawah shall shakan (place) in safety by him. He chapap (covers) him all the yawam (day) long. He shakan (place) between his kathap (shoulders)."

Of Yawasap (Joseph) he amar (spoke), "His aratz (Earth/land) is barak (blessed) by Yahawah, for the magad (precious) things of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), for the tal (dew), for the thahawam (depths) that couches beneath,
For the magad (precious) things of the thabawaath (fruits) of the shamash (sun), for the magad (precious) things of the growth of the yarachayam (moons),
For the raash (head) things of the qadam (ancient) hararay (mountains), for the magad (precious) things of the iwalam (forever) gabaiwath (hills),

For the magad (precious) things of the aratz (Earth/land) and its fullness, the good ratzawan (will) of him who lived in the sanah (bush). Bawaa (come) this come on the raash (head) of Yawasap (Joseph), on the qadaqad (crown) of the head of him who was nazayar (Nazarite) from his ach (brother/kinsman).

The bakawar (firstborn) of his herd, hadar (glory / majesty / splendor) is his. His qaranay (horns) are the qaranay (horns) of the wild ox. With them he shall nagach (push) yachad (all) of the imayam (peoples), to the apasay (ends) of the aratz (Earth/land): They are the rababah (ten) thousands of Aparayam (Ephraim). They are the alapay (thousands) of Manashah (Manasseh)."
Of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) he amar (spoke), "shamach (rejoice), Zabawalawan (Zebulun), in your yatzaa (go out / come out) out; and Yashashakar (Issachar), in your ahal (tents).

They shall qaraa (called) the imayam (peoples) to the har (mountain). There they will zabach (offer) zabachay (sacrifices) of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), for they shall draw out the shapai (abundance) of the yamayam (seas), the taman (hidden) shapawanay (treasures) of the chawal (sand)."
Of Gad (Gad) he amar (spoke), "He who enlarges Gad (Gad) is barak (blessed). He shakan (place) as a labayaa (lioness), and tarap (tears) the zarawai (arm), yes, the qadaqad (crown) of the head.

He raah (see) the raashayath (beginning) part for himself, for there was the chaqaq (lawgiver) chalaqah (portion) reserved. He athah (you (masc)) with the raashay (heads) of the im (nation / people). He ishah (make) the tzadaqah (righteousness) of Yahawah, His mashapat (ordinances) with Yashar-Al (Israel)."
Of Dan (Dan) he amar (spoke), "Dan (Dan) is a aray (lion's) cub that zanaq (leaps) out of Bashan (Bashan)."

Of Napathalay (Naphtali) he amar (spoke), "Napathalay (Naphtali), shabai (satisfied) with favor, malaa (full) of the barakah (blessing) of Yahawah, yarash (possess) the yam (sea/waters) and the darawam (south)."

Of Ashar (Asher) he amar (spoke), "Ashar (Asher) is barak (blessed) with banayam (children). Let him be ratzah (acceptable) to his ach (brother/kinsman). Let him tabal (dip) his ragal (feet / foot) in shaman (oil).
Your bars shall be barazal (iron) and nachashath (brass). As your yawam (day), so your dabaa (strength) will be.
"There is none like Al, Yasharawan (Jeshurun), who rakab (rides) on the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) for your izar (help), In his gaawah (excellency) on the shachaqayam (skies).

The qadam (eternal) Alahayam is your dwelling place. Underneath are the iwalam (forever) zaraith (arms). He garash (thrust) out the ayab (enemy) from panayam (face) you, and amar (spoke), ‘shamad (destroy)!'

Yashar-Al (Israel) shakan (place) in safety; the iyan (eye) of Yaiqab (Jacob) badad (alone), In a aratz (Earth/land) of grain and new thayarawash (wine). Yes, his shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) irap (drop) down tal (dew).

You are ashar (who/that), Yashar-Al (Israel). Who is like you, a im (nation / people) yashai (salvation) by Yahawah, the magan (shield) of your izar (help), the charab (sword) of your gaawah (excellency)! Your ayab (enemy) shall kachash (submit) themselves to you. You shall darak (tread) on their bamah (high) places."

Mashah (Moses) ilah (go up / offer) up from the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) to har (mountain) Nabaw (Nebo), to the raash (head) of Pasagah (Pisgah), that is over panayam (face) Yarayachaw (Jericho). Yahawah showed him all the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), to Dan (Dan),
And all Napathalay (Naphtali), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), and all the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), to the hinder yam (sea/waters),
And the nagab (south), and the kakar (plain) of the baqaih (valley) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) the iyar (city) of thamar (palm) trees, to Tzair (Zoar).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, "This is the aratz (Earth/land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to Abaraham (Abraham), to Yatzachaq (Isaac), and to Yaiqab (Jacob), amar (spoke), ‘I will nathan (give) it to your zarai (seed).' I raah (see) caused you to see it with your iyan (eye), but you shall not ibar (pass over/through) over there."
So Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah mawath (death) there in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), according to the pah (word) of Yahawah.

He qabar (bury) him in the gayaa (valley) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab) over mawal (against) Bayathapaiwar (Beth Peor): but no ayash (man / husband) yadai (knows) of his tomb to this yawam (day).
Mashah (Moses) was one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) when he mawath (death): his iyan (eye) was not kahah (dim), nor his lach (natural) force nawas (abated).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bakah (wept) for Mashah (Moses) in the irabath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab) shalawashayam (thirty) yamay (days): so the yamay (days) of bakay (weeping) in the abal (mourning) for Mashah (Moses) were thamam (ended).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) malaa (was) full of the rawach (spirit / wind) of chakamah (wisdom); for Mashah (Moses) had samak (laid) his yad (hand) on him: and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) to him, and ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
There has not arisen a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) iwad (more/again) in Yashar-Al (Israel) like Mashah (Moses), whom Yahawah yadai (knew) panayam (face) to panayam (face),

In all the athawath (signs) and the mawapathayam (wonders), which Yahawah shalach (send) him to ishah (make) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), to Paraih (Pharaoh), and to all his ibad (servant), and to all his aratz (Earth/land),
And in all the chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and in all the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraa (terror), which Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) in the iyan (eye) of all Yashar-Al (Israel).

Now it happened achar (other) the mawath (death) of Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah, that Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), Mashah (Moses)' sharath (servant), amar (spoke),

"Mashah (Moses) my ibad (servant) is mawath (death); now therefore qawam (rise up), ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan), you, and all this im (nation / people), to the aratz (Earth/land) which I nathan (give) to them, even to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
I nathan (give) given you every maqawam (place) that the kap (sole) of your ragal (feet / foot) will darak (tread) on, as I dabar (word / matter) Mashah (Moses).

From the madabar (wilderness), and this Labanawan (Lebanon), even to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) nahar (river), the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates), all the aratz (Earth/land) of the Chathay (Hittites), and to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) toward the mabawaa (going) down of the shamash (sun), shall be your gabawal (border/boundary).

No ayash (man / husband) will be yatzab (able) to stand panayam (face) you all the yamay (days) of your chay (life). As I was with Mashah (Moses), so I will be with you. I will not rapah (fail) you nor izab (forsake) you.

"Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous); for you shall cause this im (nation / people) to nachal (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) to nathan (give) them.

Only be chazaq (strong) and very amatz (courageous), to shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) according to all the thawarah (instruction), which Mashah (Moses) my ibad (servant) tzawah (commanded) you. Don't sawar (turn) from it to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand), that you may have shakal (good) success wherever you yalak (go).

This sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) shall not depart out of your pah (mouth), but you shall hagah (meditate) on it yawamam (by day) and layal (night), that you may shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) according to all that is kathab (write) therein: for then you shall tzalach (make) your darak (way) prosperous, and then you shall have shakal (good) success.
Haven't I tzawah (commanded) you? Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous). Don't be iratz (afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed): for Yahawah your Alahayam is with you wherever you yalak (go)."
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded) the shataray (officers) of the im (nation / people), amar (spoke),

"Ibar (pass over/through) qarab (among / near) the midst of the machanah (camp), and tzawah (command) the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), ‘kawan (prepare) food; for within shalawash (three) yamayam (days) you are to ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan), to bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) you to yarash (possess) it.'"
Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and to the Gaday (Gadites), and to the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), amar (spoke),

"Zakar (remember) the dabar (word / matter) which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) you, amar (spoke), ‘Yahawah your Alahayam gives you nawach (rest), and will nathan (give) you this aratz (Earth/land).

Your wives, your little tap (ones), and your livestock, shall live in the aratz (Earth/land) which Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) you ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan); but you shall ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) your ach (brother/kinsman) chamash (armed), all the gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of valor, and shall izar (help) them

Until Yahawah nawach (has) given your ach (brother/kinsman) nawach (rest), as he nawach (has) given you, and they have also yarash (possessed) the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) them. Then you shall shawab (turn back / repent) to the aratz (Earth/land) of your yarashah (possession), and possess it, which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) you ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise.'"
They inah (answer / respond) Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke), "All that you have tzawah (commanded) us we will ishah (make), and wherever you shalach (send) us we will yalak (go).
Just as we shamai (hearken / hear) to Mashah (Moses) in all things, so will we shamai (hearken / hear) to you. Only may Yahawah your Alahayam be with you, as he was with Mashah (Moses).

Ayash (man / husband) marah (rebels) against your commandment, and doesn't shamai (hearken / hear) to your dabar (word / matter) in all that you tzawah (command) him, he shall be put to mawath (death). Only be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous)."
