Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) charash (secretly) shalach (send) shanayam (two) ban (son) out of Shatayam (Shittim) as maragalayam (spies), amar (spoke), "yalak (go), raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), including Yarayachaw (Jericho)." They yalak (went) and bawaa (come) into the ayashah (woman / wife) of a prostitute whose sham (name) was Rachab (Rahab), and shakab (slept) there.
The malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) was amar (spoke), "Behold, anashayam (men) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) in here tonight to spy out the aratz (Earth/land)."

The malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) shalach (send) to Rachab (Rahab), amar (spoke), "yatzaa (go out / come out) out the anashayam (men) who bawaa (come) come to you, who bawaa (come) entered into your bayath (house); for they bawaa (come) come to spy out all the aratz (Earth/land)."

The ayashah (woman / wife) laqach (take / seize) the shanayam (two) anashayam (men) and tzapan (hid) them. Then she amar (spoke), "Yes, the anashayam (men) bawaa (come) to me, but I didn't yadai (know) ayan (NO ONE) they came from.

It happened about the time of the sagar (shutting) of the shair (gate), when it was chashak (darkness), that the anashayam (men) yatzaa (go out / come out) out. Where the anashayam (men) halak (move), I don't yadai (know). Radap (pursue) them mahar (quickly); for you will nashag (overtake) them."
But she had ilah (go up / offer) them up to the gag (roof), and taman (hid) them with the itz (stalks) of pashathah (flax), which she had irak (laid) in order on the gag (roof).

The anashayam (men) radap (pursued) them the darak (way) to the Yaradan (Jordan) to the maibarawath (fords): and as soon as those who radap (pursued) them yatzaa (go out / come out) gone out, they sagar (shut) the shair (gate).
Before they had shakab (laid) down, she ilah (go up / offer) up to them on the gag (roof);

And she amar (spoke) to the anashayam (men), "I yadai (know) that Yahawah nathan (give) given you the aratz (Earth/land), and that the ayamah (fear) of you napal (fall / be cast down) fallen on us, and that all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) mawag (melt) away panayam (face) you.

For we have shamai (hearken / hear) how Yahawah yabash (dry land) up the mayam (Waters) of the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters) panayam (face) you, when you yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt); and what you ishah (make) to the shanayam (two) malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites), who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), to Sayachawan (Sihon) and to Iwag (Og), whom you charam (utterly) destroyed.

As soon as we had shamai (hearken / hear) it, our labab (hearts) masas (melted), neither did there qawam (rise up) any more rawach (spirit / wind) in any ayash (man / husband), panayam (face) of you: for Yahawah your Alahayam, he is Alahayam in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mail (top/above), and on aratz (Earth/land) beneath.

Now therefore, please shabai (swear / take oath) to me by Yahawah, kay (surely) I ishah (make) dealt chasad (grace) with you, that you also will ishah (make) chasad (grace) with my ab (father) bayath (house), and nathan (give) me a amath (truth) awath (sign / mark / miracle);

And that you will chayah (save) alive my ab (father), my am (mother), my ach (brother/kinsman), and my achawath (sisters), and natzal (all) that they have, and will deliver our lives from mawath (death)."

The anashayam (men) amar (spoke) to her, "Our napash (soul) for yours, if you don't talk about this dabar (word / matter) of ours; and it shall be, when Yahawah nathan (give) us the aratz (Earth/land), that we will ishah (make) chasad (grace) and truly with you."
Then she yarad (let) them down by a chabal (cord) baid (through) the chalawan (window); for her bayath (house) was on the qayar (side) of the chawamah (wall), and she lived on the chawamah (wall).

She amar (spoke) to them, "yalak (go) to the har (mountain), lest the radapayam (pursuers) find you; and chabah (hide) yourselves there shalawash (three) yamayam (days), until the radapayam (pursuers) have shawab (turn back / repent). Afterward, you may yalak (go) your darak (way)."
The anashayam (men) amar (spoke) to her, "We will be naqay (guiltless) of this your shabawaih (oath) which you have made us to shabai (swear / take oath).

Behold, when we bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land), you shall qashar (bind) this line of shanay (second) chawat (thread) in the chalawan (window) which you used to let us down. You shall asap (gather) to yourself into the bayath (house) your ab (father), your am (mother), your ach (brother/kinsman), and all your ab (father) bayath (house).

It shall be that whoever yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the dalathay (doors) of your bayath (house) into the chawatz (street), his dam (blood) will be on his raash (head), and we will be naqay (guiltless). Whoever is with you in the bayath (house), his dam (blood) shall be on our raash (head), if any yad (hand) is on him.
But if you talk about this dabar (word / matter) of ours, then we shall be naqay (guiltless) of your shabawaih (oath) which you have made us to shabai (swear / take oath)."
She amar (spoke), "According to your dabar (word / matter), so be it." She shalach (send) them away, and they departed. She tied the shanay (second) line in the chalawan (window).

They yalak (went), and bawaa (come) to the har (mountain), and stayed there shalawash (three) yamayam (days), until the radapayam (pursuers) had shawab (turn back / repent). The radapayam (pursuers) baqash (sought) them throughout all the darak (way), but didn't matzaa (find) them.

Then the shanayam (two) anashayam (men) shawab (turn back / repent), descended from the har (mountain), ibar (pass over/through) over, and bawaa (come) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun); and they sapar (book) him all that matzaa (had) happened to them.

They amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "kay (surely) Yahawah nathan (give) delivered into our yad (hand) all the aratz (Earth/land). Moreover, all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) mawag (melt) away panayam (face) us."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) up early in the baqar (morning); and they moved from Shatayam (Shittim), and bawaa (come) to the Yaradan (Jordan), he and all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). They lawan (lodged) there before they ibar (pass over/through) over.
It happened qatzah (end / extremity / border) shalawash (three) yamayam (days), that the shatarayam (officers) ibar (pass over/through) qarab (among / near) the midst of the machanah (camp);

And they tzawah (commanded) the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "When you raah (see) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah your Alahayam, and the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites) nashaa (lift) it, then you shall move from your maqawam (place), and halak (move) it.

Yet there shall be a rachawaq (space) between you and it, about two alap (thousand) amah (cubits) by madah (measure). Don't qarab (come close) near to it, that you may yadai (know) the darak (way) by which you must yalak (go); for you ibar (pass over/through) not passed this darak (way) thamawal (before)."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), "qadash (set apart / make holy) yourselves; for machar (tomorrow) Yahawah will ishah (make) napalaawath (wonders) qarab (among / near) you."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the kahanayam (priests), amar (spoke), "nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), and ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) the im (nation / people)." They nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), and yalak (went) panayam (face) the im (nation / people).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Today I will chalal (begin) to gadal (magnify) you in the iyan (eye) of all Yashar-Al (Israel), that they may yadai (know) that as I was with Mashah (Moses), so I will be with you.

You shall tzawah (command) the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), amar (spoke), ‘When you bawaa (come) to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the may (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan), you shall imad (stand) still in the Yaradan (Jordan).'"
Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), "nagash (come) here, and shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of Yahawah your Alahayam."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), "Hereby you shall yadai (know) that the chay (life) Al is qarab (among / near) you, and that he will yarash (without) fail drive the Kanainay (Canaanite), and the Chathay (Hittite), and the Chaway (Hivite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite) out from panayam (face) you.
Behold, the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of the Adawan of all the aratz (Earth/land) passes over panayam (face) you into the Yaradan (Jordan).
Now therefore laqach (take / seize) shanayam (two) ayash (man / husband) out of the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), for achad (one) shabat (tribe) a ayash (man / husband).

It shall come to pass, when the kapawath (soles) of the ragalay (feet) of the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah, the Adawan of all the aratz (Earth/land), nawach (rest) in the may (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan), that the may (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) will be karath (cut) off, even the may (waters) that yarad (come) down from mail (top/above); and they shall imad (stand) in achad (one) nad (heap)."

It happened, when the im (nation / people) moved from their ahal (tents) to ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) being panayam (face) the im (nation / people),

And when those who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) bawaa (come) come to the Yaradan (Jordan), and the ragalay (feet) of the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) had tabal (dipped) in the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the mayam (Waters) (for the Yaradan (Jordan) malaa (overflows) all its gadah (banks) all the yawam (day) of qatzayar (harvest)),

That the mayam (Waters) which yarad (came) down from mail (top/above) imad (stood), and qawam (rise up) up in achad (one) nad (heap), a maad (great) rachaq (way) off, at Adam (Adam), the iyar (city) that is tzad (beside) Tzarathan (Zarethan); and those that yarad (went) down toward the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), even the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), were wholly karath (cut) off. Then the im (nation / people) ibar (pass over/through) over right against Yarayachaw (Jericho).

The kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah imad (stood) kawan (firm) on dry charabah (ground) in the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan); and all Yashar-Al (Israel) ibar (pass over/through) over on dry charabah (ground), until all the gaway (heathen / nation) ibar (pass over/through) passed completely over the Yaradan (Jordan).
It happened, when all the gaway (heathen / nation) thamam (had) completely ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), that Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),
"Laqach (take / seize) shanayam (two) im (nation / people) out of the im (nation / people), out of achad (one) shabat (tribe) a ayash (man / husband),

And tzawah (command) them, amar (spoke), ‘nashaa (lift) from out of the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), out of the place where the kahanayam (priests)' ragalay (feet) matzab (stood) kawan (firm), shanayam (two) abanayam (stones), and ibar (pass over/through) them over with you, and yanach (lay) them down in the malawan (lodging) place, where you will lawan (lodge) tonight.'"

Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) the shanayam (two) ayash (man / husband), whom he had kawan (prepared) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), out of achad (one) shabat (tribe) a ayash (man / husband).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, "ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah your Alahayam into the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), and achad (one) of you pick up a aban (stone) and put it on your shakam (shoulder), according to the masapar (number) of the shabatay (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel);
That this may be a awath (sign / mark / miracle) qarab (among / near) you, that when your ban (son) shaal (ask) in machar (time) to come, amar (spoke), ‘What do you mean by these abanayam (stones)?'

Then you shall amar (spoke) them, ‘Because the mayamay (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) were karath (cut) off panayam (face) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah. When it ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), the mayamay (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) were karath (cut) off. These abanayam (stones) shall be for a zakarawan (memorial) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) iwalam (forever).'"

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) as Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded), and nashaa (lift) up shanayam (two) abanayam (stones) out of the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), according to the masapar (number) of the shabatay (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and they ibar (pass over/through) them over with them to the malawan (place) where they lodged, and yanach (laid) them down there.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) qawam (rise up) up shanayam (two) abanayam (stones) in the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), in the place where the ragalay (feet) of the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) matzab (stood); and they are there to this yawam (day).

For the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) imad (stood) in the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), until everything was finished that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua) to dabar (word / matter) to the im (nation / people), according to all that Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua); and the im (nation / people) hurried and ibar (pass over/through) over.

It happened, when all the im (nation / people) thamam (had) completely ibar (pass over/through) over, that the arawan (ark) of Yahawah ibar (pass over/through) over, with the kahanayam (priests), in the panayam (face) of the im (nation / people).

The banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), and the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), ibar (pass over/through) over chamash (armed) panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), as Mashah (Moses) dabar (word / matter) to them.

About arabaiyam (forty) alap (thousand) chalawatzay (men), ready and armed for tzabaa (troop) ibar (pass over/through) over panayam (face) Yahawah to malachamah (battle), to the irabawath (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).

On that yawam (day), Yahawah gadal (magnified) Yahawashawai (Joshua) in the iyan (eye) of all Yashar-Al (Israel); and they yaraa (fear / be afraid) him, as they yaraa (fear / be afraid) Mashah (Moses), all the yamay (days) of his chay (life).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),
"Tzawah (command) the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the idawath (testimony), that they ilah (go up / offer) up out of the Yaradan (Jordan)."
Yahawashawai (Joshua) therefore tzawah (commanded) the kahanayam (priests), amar (spoke), "ilah (go up / offer) up out of the Yaradan (Jordan)!"

It happened, when the kahanayam (priests) who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah had ilah (go up / offer) up out of the thawak (midst) of the Yaradan (Jordan), and the kapawath (soles) of the kahanayam (priests)' ragalay (feet) were nathaq (lifted) up to the dry charabah (ground), that the may (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) shawab (turn back / repent) to their maqawam (place), and yalak (went) over all its gadah (banks), as shalashawam (before).

The im (nation / people) ilah (go up / offer) up out of the Yaradan (Jordan) on the ishawar (tenth) day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month), and chanah (encamped) in Galagal (Gilgal), on the mazarach (east) qatzah (end / extremity / border) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) qawam (rise up) up those shanayam (two) abanayam (stones), which they laqach (take / seize) out of the Yaradan (Jordan), in Galagal (Gilgal).

He amar (spoke) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "When your banay (children) shaal (ask) their ab (father) in machar (time) to come, amar (spoke), ‘What do these abanayam (stones) mean?'
Then you shall let your ban (son) yadai (know), amar (spoke), ‘Yashar-Al (Israel) ibar (pass over/through) over this Yaradan (Jordan) on dry yabashah (dry land).

For Yahawah your Alahayam yabash (dry land) up the may (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) from panayam (face) you, until you ibar (pass over/through) passed over, as Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), which he yabash (dry land) up from panayam (face) us, until we ibar (pass over/through) passed over;

That all the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) the yad (hand) of Yahawah, that it is chazaq (mighty); that you may yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam yawam (day).'"

It happened, when all the malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites), who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward, and all the malakay (kings) of the Kanainay (Canaanites), who were by the yam (sea/waters), shamai (hearken / hear) how that Yahawah had yabash (dry land) up the may (waters) of the Yaradan (Jordan) from panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), until we ibar (pass over/through) passed over, that their labab (heart) masas (melted), neither was there rawach (spirit / wind) in them any more, panayam (face) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
At that ith (time), Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "ishah (make) flint knives, and mawal (circumcise) again the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) the shanay (second) time."
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) himself flint knives, and mawal (circumcised) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) at the gabaih (hill) of the iralawath (foreskins).

This is the dabar (word / matter) Yahawashawai (Joshua) mawal (circumcised): all the im (nation / people) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), who were zakarayam (males), even all the zah (this / that / these) of malachamah (war), mawath (death) in the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way), yatzaa (go out / come out) they came out of Matzarayam (Egypt).

For all the im (nation / people) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out were mawal (circumcised); but all the im (nation / people) who were yalawad (born) in the madabar (wilderness) by the darak (way) as they yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) had not been mawal (circumcised).

For the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) halak (move) arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) in the madabar (wilderness), until all the gaway (heathen / nation), even the halakaw (men) of malachamah (war) who yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), were thamam (consumed), because they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah. Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to them that he wouldn't raah (see) them see the aratz (Earth/land) which Yahawah shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) that he nathan (give) give us, a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey).

Their ban (son), whom he qawam (rise up) up in their place, were mawal (circumcised) by Yahawashawai (Joshua); for they were iral (uncircumcised), because they had not mawal (circumcised) them on the darak (way).
It happened, when they were thamam (done) mawal (circumcising) all the gaway (heathen / nation), that they stayed in their places in the machanah (camp) until they were healed.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Today I have galal (rolled) away the charapah (reproach) of Matzarayam (Egypt) from off you." Therefore the sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) Galagal (Gilgal), to this yawam (day).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chanah (encamped) in Galagal (Gilgal). They ishah (make) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month) at irab (evening) in the irabawath (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
They akal (eat) unleavened matzawath (cakes) and parched grain of the produce of the aratz (Earth/land) on the next macharath (day) after the pasach (passover), in the same yawam (day).

The man (from) shabath (shabath / rest) on the next macharath (day), after they had akal (eat) of the produce of the aratz (Earth/land). The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) didn't have man (from) any more; but they akal (eat) of the thabawaah (fruit) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan) that shanah (year).

It happened, when Yahawashawai (Joshua) was by Yarayachaw (Jericho), that he nashaa (lift) up his iyan (eye) and raah (see), and behold, a ayash (man / husband) imad (stood) in front of him with his charab (sword) shalap (drawn) in his yad (hand). Yahawashawai (Joshua) yalak (went) to him, and amar (spoke) to him, "Are you for us, or for our tzar (oppressor / distressor)?"

He amar (spoke), "No; but I bawaa (come) come now as commander of Yahawah tzabaa (troop)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) napal (fall / be cast down) on his panayam (face) to the aratz (Earth/land), and shachah (worshipped), and amar (spoke) to him, "What does my Adawan amar (spoke) to his ibad (servant)?"

The shar (prince / ruler) of Yahawah tzabaa (troop) amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Take your nail (shoes) off of your ragal (feet / foot); for the maqawam (place) on which you imad (stand) is qadash (set apart / make holy)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) so.
Now Yarayachaw (Jericho) was tightly sagar (shut) up panayam (face) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). No one yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and no one bawaa (come) in.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "raah (see), I nathan (give) given Yarayachaw (Jericho) into your yad (hand), with its malak (king) and the gabawar (mighty) men of valor.
All your anashay (men) of malachamah (war) shall march around the iyar (city), naqap (going) around the iyar (city) paim (once). You shall ishah (make) this shash (six) yamayam (days).

Shabai (seven) kahanayam (priests) shall nashaa (lift) shabai (seven) shawaparawath (trumpets) of rams' yawabalayam (horns) panayam (face) the arawan (ark). On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), you shall march around the iyar (city) shabai (seven) paimayam (times), and the kahanayam (priests) shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawaparawath (trumpets).

It shall be that when they mashak (make) a long blast with the yawabal (ram's) qaran (horn), and when you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn), all the im (nation / people) shall rawai (shout) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rawai (shout); and the chawamah (wall) of the iyar (city) shall napal (fall / be cast down) down thachath (under), and the im (nation / people) shall ilah (go up / offer) up every ayash (man / husband) straight before him."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) qaraa (called) the kahanayam (priests), and amar (spoke) to them, "nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant), and let shabai (seven) kahanayam (priests) nashaa (lift) shabai (seven) shawaparawath (trumpets) of rams' yawabalayam (horns) panayam (face) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah."
They amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), "Advance! March around the iyar (city), and let the chalatz (armed) ibaraw (men) pass on panayam (face) Yahawah arawan (ark)."

It was so, that when Yahawashawai (Joshua) had amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), the shabai (seven) kahanayam (priests) nashaa (lift) the shabai (seven) shawaparawath (trumpets) of rams' yawabalayam (horns) panayam (face) Yahawah advanced, and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawaparawath (trumpets); and the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah halak (move) them.

The chalatz (armed) halak (move) went panayam (face) the kahanayam (priests) who thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawaparawath (trumpets), and the arawan (ark) halak (move) achar (other) them. The shawaparawath (trumpets) thaqai (blow / sound alarm) as they halak (move).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded) the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "You shall not rawai (shout), nor let your qawal (sound / voice) be shamai (hearken / hear), neither shall any dabar (word / matter) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of your pah (mouth), until the yawam (day) I amar (spoke) you to rawai (shout). Then you shall rawai (shout)."

So he caused the arawan (ark) of Yahawah to sabab (go) around the iyar (city), naqap (going) about it paim (once). Then they bawaa (come) into the machanah (camp), and lawan (lodged) in the machanah (camp).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) early in the baqar (morning), and the kahanayam (priests) nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark) of Yahawah.

The shabai (seven) kahanayam (priests) nashaa (lift) the shabai (seven) shawaparawath (trumpets) of rams' yabalayam (horns) panayam (face) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah halak (move) on halak (move), and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawaparawath (trumpets): and the chalatz (armed) men halak (move) panayam (face) them. The rear guard halak (move) achar (other) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah. The shawaparawath (trumpets) thaqai (blow / sound alarm) as they halak (move).
The shanay (second) yawam (day) they marched around the iyar (city) paim (once), and shawab (turn back / repent) into the machanah (camp). They ishah (make) this shash (six) yamayam (days).

It happened on the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), that they shakam (rose) early at the ilah (go up / offer) of the shachar (day), and marched around the iyar (city) in the same mashapat (way) shabai (seven) paimayam (times). Only on this yawam (day) they marched around the iyar (city) shabai (seven) paimayam (times).

It happened at the shabayaiy (seventh) paim (time), when the kahanayam (priests) thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawaparawath (trumpets), Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), "rawai (shout), for Yahawah nathan (give) given you the iyar (city)!

The iyar (city) shall be charam (devoted), even it and all that is in it, to Yahawah. Only Rachab (Rahab) the prostitute shall chayah (live), she and all who are with her in the bayath (house), because she chabaa (hid) the malaakayam (messengers) that we shalach (send).

But as for you, only shamar (keep/guard) yourselves from the charam (devoted) thing, lest when you charam (have) devoted it, you laqach (take / seize) of the charam (devoted) thing; so would you shawam (place / establish / appoint) the machanah (camp) of Yashar-Al (Israel) charam (accursed), and ikar (trouble) it.

But all the kasap (silver), and zahab (gold), and kalay (vessels) of nachashath (brass) and barazal (iron), are qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah. They shall bawaa (come) into Yahawah awatzar (treasury)."

So the im (nation / people) rawai (shouted), and the priests thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shaparawath (trumpets). It happened, when the im (nation / people) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn), that the im (nation / people) rawai (shouted) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tharawaih (shout), and the chawamah (wall) napal (fall / be cast down) down flat, so that the im (nation / people) ilah (go up / offer) up into the iyar (city), every ayash (man / husband) straight before him, and they lakad (took) the iyar (city).

They charam (utterly) destroyed all that was in the iyar (city), both ayash (man / husband) and ayashah (woman / wife), both nair (young) and zaqan (old), and shawar (ox), and shah (sheep), and donkey, with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the shanayam (two) anashayam (men) who had ragal (spied) out the aratz (Earth/land), "bawaa (come) into the prostitute's bayath (house), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out from there the ayashah (woman / wife) and all that she has, as you shabai (swear / take oath) to her."

The nair (young) men who were maragalayam (spies) bawaa (come) in, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out Rachab (Rahab) with her ab (father), her am (mother), her ach (brother/kinsman), and all that she yatzaa (go out / come out). They also brought out all her relatives, and they yanach (set) them outside of the machanah (camp) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

They burnt the iyar (city) with ash (fire), and all that was in it. Only they nathan (give) the kasap (silver), the zahab (gold), and the kalay (vessels) of nachashath (brass) and of barazal (iron) into the awatzar (treasury) of Yahawah bayath (house).

But Rachab (Rahab) the prostitute, her ab (father) bayath (house), and all that she had, Yahawashawai (Joshua) chayah (saved) chayah (alive). She lived in the midst of Yashar-Al (Israel) to this yawam (day), because she chabaa (hid) the malaakayam (messengers), whom Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) to ragal (spy) out Yarayachaw (Jericho).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) commanded them with an oath at that ith (time), amar (spoke), "arar (cursed) is the ayash (man / husband) panayam (face) Yahawah, who qawam (rise up) up and banah (build) this iyar (city) Yarayachaw (Jericho). With the loss of his bakawar (firstborn) shall he yasad (lay) its foundation, and with the loss of his youngest son shall he natzab (set) up its dalath (gates)."
So Yahawah was with Yahawashawai (Joshua); and his shamai (fame) was in all the aratz (Earth/land).

But the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) mail (top/above) a mail (top/above) in the charam (devoted) things; for Ikan (Achan), the ban (son) of Karamay (Carmi), the ban (son) of Zabaday (Zabdi), the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), laqach (take / seize) some of the charam (devoted) things. Therefore Yahawah ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) charah (hot with anger) against the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) anashayam (men) from Yarayachaw (Jericho) to Iy (Ai), which is im (with) Bayathaawan (Beth Aven), on the qadam (east) side of Bayath-Al (Bethel), and amar (spoke) to them, amar (spoke), "ilah (go up / offer) up and ragal (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land)." The anashayam (men) ilah (go up / offer) up and ragal (spied) out Iy (Ai).

They shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke) to him, "Don't let all the im (nation / people) ilah (go up / offer) up; but let about two or shalawash (three) alap (thousand) ayash (man / husband) ilah (go up / offer) up and nakah (strike) Iy (Ai). Don't make all the im (nation / people) to toil there, for there are only a mait (few) of them."
So about shalawash (three) alap (thousand) anashay (men) of the im (nation / people) ilah (go up / offer) up there, and they nawas (fled) panayam (face) the anashay (men) of Iy (Ai).

The anashay (men) of Iy (Ai) nakah (struck) about shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) anashay (men) of them, and they radap (chased) them from panayam (face) the shair (gate) even to Shabarayam (Shebarim), and nakah (struck) them at the descent. The labab (hearts) of the im (nation / people) masas (melted), and became like mayam (Waters).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) qarai (tore) his clothes, and napal (fall / be cast down) to the aratz (Earth/land) on his panayam (face) panayam (face) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah until the irab (evening), he and the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and they ilah (go up / offer) ipar (dust) on their raash (head).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), "ahah (alas), Adanay Yahawah, why ibar (pass over/through) you brought this im (nation / people) over the Yaradan (Jordan) at ibar (pass over/through), to nathan (give) us into the yad (hand) of the Amaray (Amorites), to cause us to abad (destroy / perish)? I wish that we had been yaal (content) and lived ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan)!
Oh, Adanay, what shall I amar (spoke), achar (other) that Yashar-Al (Israel) has hapak (turned) their irap (neck) panayam (face) their ayab (enemy)!

For the Kanainay (Canaanites) and all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) will shamai (hearken / hear) of it, and will surround us, and karath (cut) off our sham (name) from the aratz (Earth/land). What will you ishah (make) for your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name)?"
Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "qawam (rise up) up! Why are you napal (fall / be cast down) on your panayam (face) like that?

Yashar-Al (Israel) has chataa (sinned). Yes, they ibar (pass over/through) even transgressed my barayath (covenant) which I tzawah (commanded) them. Yes, they have even laqach (take / seize) of the charam (devoted) things, and have also ganab (stolen), and also kachash (deceived). They have even shawam (place / establish / appoint) it among their own kalay (stuff).

Therefore the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) can't qawam (rise up) panayam (face) their ayab (enemy). They panah (turn) their irap (neck) panayam (face) their ayab (enemy), because they charam (have) become devoted for destruction. I will not be with you any more, unless you shamad (destroy) the charam (devoted) things from qarab (among / near) you.

"Qawam (rise up) up! Qadash (set apart / make holy) the im (nation / people), and amar (spoke), ‘qadash (set apart / make holy) yourselves for machar (tomorrow), for Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "There is a charam (devoted) thing in the qarab (among / near) of you, Yashar-Al (Israel). You cannot qawam (rise up) panayam (face) your ayab (enemy) until you sawar (take) away the charam (devoted) thing from qarab (among / near) you."

"‘In the baqar (morning) therefore you shall be qarab (come close) near by your shabat (tribes). It shall be that the shabat (tribe) which Yahawah selects shall qarab (come close) near by mashapachawath (families). The mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) which Yahawah selects shall qarab (come close) near by bathayam (households). The bayath (house) which Yahawah selects shall qarab (come close) near gabar (man) by gabar (man).

It shall be, that he who is lakad (taken) with the charam (devoted) thing shall be burnt with ash (fire), he and ibar (pass over/through) that he has, because he has transgressed the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and because he ishah (make) done a disgraceful thing in Yashar-Al (Israel).'"
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) up early in the baqar (morning) and qarab (come close) Yashar-Al (Israel) near by their shabat (tribes). The shabat (tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah) was selected.

He qarab (come close) near the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he selected the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Zerahites. He qarab (come close) near the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the Zerahites gabar (man) by gabar (man), and Zabaday (Zabdi) was selected.

He qarab (come close) near his bayath (house) gabar (man) by gabar (man), and Ikan (Achan), the ban (son) of Karamay (Carmi), the ban (son) of Zabaday (Zabdi), the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah), of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), was selected.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to Ikan (Achan), "My ban (son), please shawam (place / establish / appoint) kabawad (glory) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), and nathan (give) thawadah (confession) to him. Nagad (tell) me now what you ishah (make) done! Don't kachad (hide) it from me!"
Ikan (Achan) inah (answer / respond) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke), "I have truly chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), and this is what I ishah (make) done.

When I raah (see) among the shalal (spoil) a tawab (good / proper function) Shanair (Babylonian) adarath (robe), two maah (hundred) shaqalayam (shekels) of kasap (silver), and a lashawan (tongue / language) of zahab (gold) weighing chamashayam (fifty) shaqalayam (shekels), then I chamad (coveted) them and laqach (take / seize) them. Behold, they are taman (hidden) in the aratz (Earth/land) in the thawak (midst) of my ahal (tent), with the kasap (silver) under it."
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers), and they rawatz (ran) to the ahal (tent). Behold, it was taman (hidden) in his ahal (tent), with the kasap (silver) under it.

They laqach (take / seize) them from the thawak (midst) of the ahal (tent), and bawaa (come) them to Yahawashawai (Joshua) and to all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). They yatzaq (laid) them down panayam (face) Yahawah.

Yahawashawai (Joshua), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, laqach (take / seize) Ikan (Achan) the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah), the kasap (silver), the adarath (robe), the lashawan (tongue / language) of zahab (gold), his ban (son), his banath (daughter), his cattle, his donkeys, his tzaan (sheep), his ahal (tent), and all that he had; and they ilah (go up / offer) them up to the imaq (valley) of Ikawar (Achor).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), "mah (why) have you ikar (troubled) us? Yahawah will ikar (trouble) you this yawam (day)." All Yashar-Al (Israel) ragam (stoned) him with abanayam (stones), and they sharap (burned) them with ash (fire) and saqal (stoned) them with abanayam (stones).

They qawam (rise up) over him a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gal (heap) of abanayam (stones) that remains to this yawam (day). Yahawah shawab (turn back / repent) from the charawan (fierceness) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting). Therefore the sham (name) of that maqawam (place) was qaraa (called) "The imaq (valley) of Ikawar (Achor)" to this yawam (day).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), neither be chathath (dismayed). Laqach (take / seize) all the im (nation / people) of malachamah (war) with you, and qawam (rise up), ilah (go up / offer) up to Iy (Ai). Raah (see), I nathan (give) given into your yad (hand) the malak (king) of Iy (Ai), with his im (nation / people), his iyar (city), and his aratz (Earth/land).

You shall ishah (make) to Iy (Ai) and her malak (king) as you ishah (make) to Yarayachaw (Jericho) and her malak (king), except its shalal (spoil) and its livestock, you shall bazaz (take) for a plunder for yourselves. Shawam (place / establish / appoint) an arab (ambush) for the iyar (city) achar (other) it."

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) qawam (rise up), and all the im (nation / people) of malachamah (war), to ilah (go up / offer) up to Iy (Ai). Yahawashawai (Joshua) bachar (chose) shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand) men, the gabawar (mighty) ayash (man / husband) of valor, and shalach (send) them out by layal (night).

He tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), "raah (see), you shall lie in arab (ambush) against the iyar (city), achar (other) the iyar (city). Don't rachaq (go) very rachaq (far) from the iyar (city), but all of you be kawan (ready).

I, and all the im (nation / people) who are with me, will qarab (come close) to the iyar (city). It shall happen, when they yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) us, as at the raashawan (first), that we will nawas (flee) panayam (face) them.

They will yatzaa (go out / come out) out achar (other) us, until we have nathaq (drawn) them away from the iyar (city); for they will amar (spoke), ‘They nawas (flee) panayam (face) us, like the raashawan (first) time.' So we will nawas (flee) panayam (face) them,
And you shall qawam (rise up) up from the arab (ambush), and take yarash (possession) of the iyar (city); for Yahawah your Alahayam will nathan (give) it into your yad (hand).

It shall be, when you have seized on the iyar (city), that you shall yatzath (set) the iyar (city) on ash (fire). You shall ishah (make) this according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah. Raah (see), I have tzawah (commanded) you."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) them out; and they yalak (went) to set up the maarab (ambush), and stayed between Bayath-Al (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), on the yam (sea/waters) side of Iy (Ai); but Yahawashawai (Joshua) stayed thawak (midst) the im (nation / people) that layal (night).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shakam (rose) up early in the baqar (morning), mustered the im (nation / people), and ilah (go up / offer) up, he and the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel), panayam (face) the im (nation / people) to Iy (Ai).

All the im (nation / people), even the men of malachamah (war) who were with him, ilah (go up / offer) up, and nagash (drew) near, and bawaa (come) before the iyar (city), and chanah (encamped) on the tzapawan (north) side of Iy (Ai). Now there was a gayaa (valley) between him and Iy (Ai).

He laqach (take / seize) about chamash (five) alap (thousand) ayash (man / husband), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them in arab (ambush) between Bayath-Al (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), on the yam (sea/waters) side of the Iy (city).

So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) the im (nation / people), even all the machanah (army) who was on the tzapawan (north) of the iyar (city), and their ambush on the yam (sea/waters) of the iyar (city); and Yahawashawai (Joshua) yalak (went) that layal (night) into the thawak (midst) of the imaq (valley).

It happened, when the malak (king) of Iy (Ai) raah (see) it, that they hurried and shakam (rose) up early, and the anashay (men) of the iyar (city) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) Yashar-Al (Israel) to malachamah (battle), he and all his im (nation / people), at the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) appointed, panayam (face) the irabah (arabah); but he didn't yadai (know) that there was an arab (ambush) against him achar (other) the iyar (city).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) and all Yashar-Al (Israel) made as if they were nagai (beaten) panayam (face) them, and nawas (fled) by the darak (way) of the madabar (wilderness).

All the im (nation / people) who were in the Iyar (city) were zaiq (called) together to radap (pursue) achar (other) them. They radap (pursued) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and were nathaq (drawn) away from the iyar (city).

There was not a ayash (man / husband) shaar (left) in Iy (Ai) or Bayath-Al (Beth El) who didn't yatzaa (go out / come out) out achar (other) Yashar-Al (Israel). They izab (left) the iyar (city) pathach (open), and radap (pursued) Yashar-Al (Israel).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "natah (stretch) out the javelin that is in your yad (hand) toward Iy (Ai), for I will nathan (give) it into your yad (hand)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) natah (stretched) out the javelin that was in his yad (hand) toward the iyar (city).

The arab (ambush) qawam (rise up) maharah (quickly) out of their maqawam (place), and they rawatz (ran) as soon as he had natah (stretched) out his yad (hand), and bawaa (come) into the iyar (city), and lakad (took) it. They hurried and yatzath (set) the iyar (city) on ash (fire).

When the anashay (men) of Iy (Ai) panah (turn) achar (other) them, they saw, and behold, the ishan (smoke) of the iyar (city) ilah (go up / offer) up to shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and they had no yad (hand) to nawas (flee) this hanah (here) or that way. The im (nation / people) who nawas (fled) to the madabar (wilderness) hapak (turned) back on the radap (pursuers).

When Yahawashawai (Joshua) and all Yashar-Al (Israel) raah (see) that the arab (ambush) had lakad (taken) the iyar (city), and that the ishan (smoke) of the iyar (city) ilah (go up / offer), then they shawab (turn back / repent) again, and nakah (killed) the anashay (men) of Iy (Ai).

The others yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the iyar (city) qaraah (against) them, so they were in the thawak (midst) of Yashar-Al (Israel), some on this side, and some on that side. They nakah (struck) them, so that they shaar (let) none of them sharayad (remain) or palayat (escape).
They captured the malak (king) of Iy (Ai) chay (life), and qarab (come close) him to Yahawashawai (Joshua).

It happened, when Yashar-Al (Israel) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of harag (kill) all the yashabay (inhabitants) of Iy (Ai) in the shadah (field), in the madabar (wilderness) in which they radap (pursued) them, and they napal (fall / be cast down) all fallen by the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), until they were thamam (consumed), that all Yashar-Al (Israel) shawab (turn back / repent) to Iy (Ai), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword).
All that napal (fall / be cast down) that yawam (day), both of anashay (men) and ayashah (woman / wife), were shanayam (two) alap (thousand), even all the anashay (men) of Iy (Ai).

For Yahawashawai (Joshua) didn't shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) his yad (hand), with which he natah (stretched) out the javelin, until he charam (had) utterly destroyed all the yashabay (inhabitants) of Iy (Ai).

Only the livestock and the shalal (spoil) of that iyar (city) Yashar-Al (Israel) bazaz (took) for prey to themselves, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which he tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua).
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) burnt Iy (Ai), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a thal (heap) iwalam (forever), even a shamamah (desolation), to this yawam (day).

He hanged the malak (king) of Iy (Ai) on a itz (tree) until the ith (evening), and at the sundown Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded), and they yarad (took) his nabalah (body) down from the itz (tree), and shalak (threw) it at the pathach (entrance) of the shair (gate) of the iyar (city), and qawam (rise up) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gal (heap) of abanayam (stones) on it that remains to this yawam (day).
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) banah (build) an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), in har (mountain) Iyabal (Ebal),

As Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), as it is kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), an mazabach (altar) of uncut abanayam (stones), on which no man had nawap (lifted) up any barazal (iron). They ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) on it to Yahawah, and zabach (sacrificed) peace ilawath (offerings).

He kathab (write) there on the abanayam (stones) a mashanah (copy) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), which he kathab (write) in the panayam (face) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

All Yashar-Al (Israel), and their zaqan (elders) and shatarayam (officers), and their shapat (judge / judgement), imad (stood) on this side of the arawan (ark) and on that side before the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites), who nashaa (lift) the arawan (ark) of Yahawah barayath (covenant), the foreigner as well as the native; chatzay (half) of them in mawal (front) of har (mountain) Garazayam (Gerizim), and chatzay (half) of them in mawal (front) of har (mountain) Iyabal (Ebal), as Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) at the raashawan (first), that they should barak (blessed) the im (nation / people) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Afterward he qaraa (called) all the dabaray (words) of the thawarah (instruction), the barakah (blessing) and the qalalah (curse), according to all that is kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction).

There was not a dabar (word / matter) of all that Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded), which Yahawashawai (Joshua) didn't qaraa (called) before all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel), with the nashayam (women), the little tap (ones), and the foreigners who were qarab (among / near) them.

It happened, when all the malakayam (kings) who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), in the har (mountain) country, and in the lowland, and on all the chawap (shore) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) in mawal (front) of Labanawan (Lebanon), the Chathay (Hittite), the Amaray (Amorite), the Kanainay (Canaanite), the Parazay (Perizzite), the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite), shamai (hearken / hear) of it
That they qabatz (gathered) themselves yachad (together) to lacham (fight) with Yahawashawai (Joshua) and with Yashar-Al (Israel), with achad (one) pah (accord).
But when the yashabay (inhabitants) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon) shamai (hearken / hear) what Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) done to Yarayachaw (Jericho) and to Iy (Ai),

They also resorted to a ruse, and yalak (went) and tzayar (made) as if they had been ambassadors, and laqach (take / seize) balah (old) shaqayam (sacks) on their donkeys, and wineskins, balah (old) and baqai (torn) and tzarar (bound) up,
And balah (old) and patched nailawath (shoes) on their ragal (feet / foot), and wore balah (old) shalamawath (garments). All the lacham (bread) of their provision was yabash (dry land) and moldy.

They yalak (went) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) to the machanah (camp) at Galagal (Gilgal), and amar (spoke) to him, and to the ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel), "We bawaa (come) come from a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land). Now therefore karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with us."
The ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel) amar (spoke) to the Chaway (Hivites), "What if you live qarab (among / near) us. How could we karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with you?"
They amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "We are your ibad (servant)." Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, "Who are you? Ayan (NO ONE) do you bawaa (come) from?"

They amar (spoke) to him, "Your ibad (servant) bawaa (come) come from a very rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land) because of the sham (name) of Yahawah your Alahayam; for we have shamai (hearken / hear) of his shamai (fame), all that he ishah (make) in Matzarayam (Egypt),

And all that he ishah (make) to the shanayam (two) malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites) who were ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan), to Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) and to Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), who was at Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth).

Our zaqan (elders) and all the yashabay (inhabitants) of our aratz (Earth/land) amar (spoke) to us, amar (spoke), ‘laqach (take / seize) tzayadah (provision) in your hand for the darak (journey), and yalak (go) to qaraah (meet) them, and amar (spoke) them, "We are your ibad (servant). Now karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with us."'

This our lacham (bread) we took cham (hot) for our provision out of our bayath (house) on the yawam (day) we yatzaa (go out / come out) out to yalak (go) to you; but now, behold, it is yabash (dry land), and has become moldy.

These wineskins, which we malaa (filled), were chadash (new); and behold, they are baqai (torn). These our shalamah (dress / garment) and our nail (shoes) have balah (become) old because of the very rab (long) darak (journey)."
The anashayam (men) sampled their provisions, and didn't shaal (ask) counsel from the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) shalawam (peace / safety) with them, and ishah (make) a barayath (covenant) with them, to chayah (let) them live. The nashayaay (princes) of the idah (congregation) shabai (swear / take oath) to them.

It happened at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of shalawash (three) yamayam (days) achar (other) they had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with them, that they shamai (hearken / hear) that they were their neighbors, and that they lived qarab (among / near) them.

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) traveled and bawaa (come) to their iyar (cities) on the shalayashay (third) yawam (day). Now their iyar (cities) were Gabaiwan (Gibeon), Kapayarah (Chephirah), Baarawath (Beeroth), and Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) didn't nakah (strike) them, because the nashayaay (princes) of the idah (congregation) had shabai (swear / take oath) to them by Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel). All the idah (congregation) lawan (murmured) against the nashayaay (princes).

But all the nashayaayam (princes) amar (spoke) to all the idah (congregation), "We have shabai (swear / take oath) to them by Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): now therefore we may not nagai (touch) them.
This we will ishah (make) to them, and chayah (let) them live; lest qatzap (wrath) be on us, because of the shabawaih (oath) which we shabai (swear / take oath) to them."

The nashayaayam (princes) amar (spoke) to them, "chayah (let) them live, so they became itz (wood) cutters and drawers of mayam (Waters) for all the idah (congregation), as the nashayaayam (princes) had dabar (word / matter) to them."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) for them, and he dabar (word / matter) to them, amar (spoke), "Why have you ramah (deceived) us, amar (spoke), ‘We are very rachawaq (far) from you,' when you live qarab (among / near) us?
Now therefore you are arar (cursed), and some of you will never karath (cut) to be ibad (servant), both itz (wood) cutters and drawers of mayam (Waters) for the bayath (house) of my Alahayam."

They inah (answer / respond) Yahawashawai (Joshua), and amar (spoke), "Because your ibad (servant) were nagad (certainly) nagad (told) how Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) his ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses) to nathan (give) you all the aratz (Earth/land), and to shamad (destroy) all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) from panayam (face) you. Therefore we were very yaraa (fear / be afraid) for our lives panayam (face) of you, and ishah (make) done this thing.
Now, han (behold), we are in your yad (hand). Ishah (make) to us as it seems tawab (good / proper function) and yashar (upright) to you to ishah (make)."
He ishah (make) so to them, and natzal (delivered) them out of the yad (hand) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), so that they didn't harag (kill) them.

That yawam (day) Yahawashawai (Joshua) nathan (give) them itz (wood) cutters and drawers of mayam (Waters) for the idah (congregation) and for the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, to this yawam (day), in the maqawam (place) which he should bachar (choose).

Now it happened when Adanayatzadaq (Adoni-Zedek) malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shamai (hearken / hear) kay (surely) Yahawashawai (Joshua) had lakad (taken) Iy (Ai), and charam (had) utterly destroyed it; as he ishah (make) done to Yarayachaw (Jericho) and her malak (king), so he ishah (make) done to Iy (Ai) and her malak (king); and how the yashabay (inhabitants) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon) had made shalam (peace) with Yashar-Al (Israel), and were qarab (among / near) them;

That they were very yaraa (fear / be afraid), because Gabaiwan (Gibeon) was a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) iyar (city), as achad (one) of the mamalakah (royal) iray (cities), and because it was greater than Iy (Ai), and all its gadawal (very great/important/mighty) were gabawar (mighty).

Therefore Adanayatzadaq (Adoni-Zedek) malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shalach (send) to Hawaham (Hoham) malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), to Paraam (Piram) malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), to Yapayai (Japhia) malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), and to Dabayar (Debir) malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon), amar (spoke),

"Ilah (go up / offer) up to me, and izar (help) me, and let us nakah (strike) Gabaiwan (Gibeon); for it has made shalam (peace) with Yahawashawai (Joshua) and with the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)."

Therefore the chamash (five) malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites), the malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), the malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), the malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), the malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon), asap (gathered) themselves together, and ilah (go up / offer) up, they and all their machanah (armies), and chanah (encamped) against Gabaiwan (Gibeon), and made lacham (war) against it.

The anashay (men) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon) shalach (send) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) to the machanah (camp) to Galagal (Gilgal), amar (spoke), "Don't abandon your ibad (servant)! Ilah (go up / offer) up to us maharah (quickly), and yashai (salvation) us, and izar (help) us; for all the malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites) that yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the har (mountain) country have qabatz (gathered) together against us."

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) ilah (go up / offer) up from Galagal (Gilgal), he, and all the im (nation / people) of malachamah (war) with him, and all the gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of valor.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) them, for I nathan (give) delivered them into your yad (hand). Not a ayash (man / husband) of them will imad (stand) panayam (face) you."
Yahawashawai (Joshua) therefore bawaa (come) on them pathaawam (suddenly). He ilah (go up / offer) up from Galagal (Gilgal) all layal (night).

Yahawah confused them panayam (face) Yashar-Al (Israel), and he nakah (killed) them with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makah (slaughter) at Gabaiwan (Gibeon), and radap (chased) them by the darak (way) of the ascent of Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon), and nakah (struck) them to Izaqah (Azekah) and to Maqadah (Makkedah).

It happened, as they nawas (fled) from panayam (face) Yashar-Al (Israel), while they were at the descent of Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon), that Yahawah cast down gadawal (very great/important/mighty) abanayam (stones) from the sky on them to Izaqah (Azekah), and they mawath (death). There were more who mawath (death) from the hailstones than who the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) harag (kill) with the charab (sword).

Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) dabar (word / matter) to Yahawah in the yawam (day) when Yahawah nathan (give) up the Amaray (Amorites) panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and he amar (spoke) in the iyan (eye) of Yashar-Al (Israel), "shamash (sun), stand still on Gabaiwan (Gibeon)! You, yarach (moon), stop in the imaq (valley) of Ayalawan (Aijalon)!"

The shamash (sun) stood still, and the yarach (moon) imad (stayed), until the gaway (heathen / nation) had naqam (avenged) themselves of their ayab (enemy). Isn't hawaa (which/who/that is) kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Jashar? The shamash (sun) imad (stayed) in the chatzay (midst) of the sky, and didn't hurry to bawaa (come) down about a thamayam (complete / whole) yawam (day).

There was no yawam (day) like that panayam (face) it or achar (other) it, that Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of a ayash (man / husband); for Yahawah lacham (fought) for Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to the machanah (camp) to Galagal (Gilgal).
These chamash (five) malakayam (kings) nawas (fled), and chabaa (hid) themselves in the mairah (cave) at Maqadah (Makkedah).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) was nagad (told), amar (spoke), "The chamash (five) malakayam (kings) are matzaa (found), chabaa (hidden) in the mairah (cave) at Maqadah (Makkedah)."
Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), "galal (roll) large abanayam (stones) to the pah (mouth) of the mairah (cave), and paqad (visit) gadalawath (men) by it to guard them;

But don't imad (stay). Radap (pursue) your ayab (enemy), and strike them from the rear. Don't allow them to bawaa (come) into their iyar (cities); for Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) delivered them into your yad (hand)."

It happened, when Yahawashawai (Joshua) and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) kalah (complete / finish) finished nakah (killing) them with a very gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makah (slaughter) until they were thamam (consumed), and the sharayad (remnant) which sharad (remained) of them bawaa (come) entered into the fortified iray (cities),

That all the im (nation / people) shawab (turn back / repent) to the machanah (camp) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) at Maqadah (Makkedah) in shalawam (peace / safety). None charatz (moved) his lashawan (tongue / language) against any of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke), "pathach (open) the pah (mouth) of the mairah (cave), and bring those chamash (five) malakayam (kings) out of the mairah (cave) to me."

They ishah (make) so, and brought those chamash (five) malakayam (kings) out of the mairah (cave) to him: the malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), the malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), the malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), and the malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon).

It happened, when they brought those malakayam (kings) out to Yahawashawai (Joshua), that Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) for all the anashay (men) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and amar (spoke) to the chiefs of the anashay (men) of malachamah (war) who halak (move) with him, "qarab (come close) near, shawam (place / establish / appoint) your ragal (feet / foot) on the tzawaaray (necks) of these malakayam (kings)." They qarab (come close) near, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) their ragal (feet / foot) on their tzawaaray (necks).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor be chathath (dismayed). Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), for Yahawah will ishah (make) this to all your ayab (enemy) against whom you lacham (fight)."

Afterward Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) them, put them to mawath (death), and hanged them on chamash (five) itzayam (trees). They were thalah (hanging) on the itzayam (trees) until the irab (evening).

It happened at the ith (time) of the bawaa (come) down of the shamash (sun), that Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded), and they yarad (took) them down off the itzayam (trees), and shalak (cast) them into the mairah (cave) in which they had chabaa (hidden) themselves, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) abanayam (stones) on the pah (mouth) of the mairah (cave), which remain to this very yawam (day).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) lakad (took) Maqadah (Makkedah) on that yawam (day), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), with its malak (king). He charam (utterly) destroyed them and all the napash (soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining). He ishah (make) to the malak (king) of Maqadah (Makkedah) as he ishah (make) done to the malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ibar (pass over/through) from Maqadah (Makkedah), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to Labanah (Libnah), and lacham (fought) against Labanah (Libnah).

Yahawah nathan (give) it also, with its malak (king), into the yad (hand) of Yashar-Al (Israel). He nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and all the napash (soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining) in it. He ishah (make) to its malak (king) as he ishah (make) done to the malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ibar (pass over/through) from Labanah (Libnah), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to Lakayash (Lachish), and chanah (encamped) against it, and lacham (fought) against it.

Yahawah nathan (give) Lakayash (Lachish) into the yad (hand) of Yashar-Al (Israel). He lakad (took) it on the shanay (second) yawam (day), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), with all the napash (soul) who were in it, according to all that he ishah (make) done to Labanah (Libnah).

Then Haram (Horam) malak (king) of Gazar (Gezer) ilah (go up / offer) up to izar (help) Lakayash (Lachish); and Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) him and his im (nation / people), until he had shaar (left) him none sharayad (remaining).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ibar (pass over/through) from Lakayash (Lachish), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to Igalawan (Eglon); and they chanah (encamped) against it lacham (fought) against it.

They lakad (took) it on that yawam (day), and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword). He charam (utterly) destroyed all the napash (soul) who were in it that yawam (day), according to all that he ishah (make) done to Lakayash (Lachish).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ilah (go up / offer) up from Igalawan (Eglon), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to Chabarawan (Hebron); and they lacham (fought) against it.

They lakad (took) it, and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), with its malak (king) and all its iyar (cities), and all the napash (soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining), according to all that he ishah (make) done to Igalawan (Eglon); but he charam (utterly) destroyed it, and all the napash (soul) who were in it.
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to Dabayar (Debir), and lacham (fought) against it.

He lakad (took) it, with its malak (king) and all its iyar (cities). They nakah (struck) them with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and charam (utterly) destroyed all the napash (soul) who were in it. He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining). As he ishah (make) done to Chabarawan (Hebron), so he ishah (make) to Dabayar (Debir), and to its malak (king); as he ishah (make) done also to Labanah (Libnah), and to its malak (king).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) all the aratz (Earth/land), the hill aratz (Earth/land), and the nagab (south), and the lowland, and the slopes, and all their malak (king). He shaar (left) none sharayad (remaining), but he charam (utterly) destroyed all that nashamah (breathing thing), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), tzawah (commanded).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) nakah (struck) them from Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea) even to Izah (Gaza), and all the aratz (Earth/land) of Gashan (Goshen), even to Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) lakad (took) all these malakayam (kings) and their aratz (Earth/land) at achad (one) paim (time), because Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), lacham (fought) for Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, to the machanah (camp) to Galagal (Gilgal).

It happened, when Yabayan (Jabin) malak (king) of Chatzawar (Hazor) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, that he shalach (send) to Yawabab (Jobab) malak (king) of Madawan (Madon), to the malak (king) of Shamarawan (Shimron), to the malak (king) of Akashap (Achshaph),

And to the malakayam (kings) who were on the tzapawan (north), in the har (mountain) country, in the irabah (arabah) nagab (south) of Kanarawath (Chinneroth), in the lowland, and in the heights of Dawar (Dor) on the yam (sea/waters),

To the Kanainay (Canaanite) on the mazarach (east) and on the yam (sea/waters), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Chathay (Hittite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite) in the har (mountain) country, and the Chaway (Hivite) under Charamawan (Hermon) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzapah (Mizpah).

They yatzaa (go out / come out) out, they and all their machanah (armies) with them, many im (nation / people), even as the chawal (sand) that is on the shapah (seashore) in rab (multitude), with very many sawas (horses) and rakab (chariots).
All these malakayam (kings) yaid (met) together; and they bawaa (come) and chanah (encamped) yaid (together) at the may (waters) of Marawam (Merom), to lacham (fight) with Yashar-Al (Israel).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) panayam (face) of them; for machar (tomorrow) at this ith (time), I will nathan (give) them up all chalal (slain) panayam (face) Yashar-Al (Israel). You shall hamstring their sawas (horses) and sharap (burn) their marakabah (chariots) with ash (fire)."

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) bawaa (come), and all the im (nation / people) of malachamah (war) with him, against them by the may (waters) of Marawam (Merom) pathaawam (suddenly), and napal (fall / be cast down) on them.

Yahawah nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and they nakah (struck) them, and radap (chased) them to rab (great) Tzayadawan (Sidon), and to Masharapawathamayam (Misrephoth Maim), and to the baqaih (valley) of Matzapah (Mizpeh) eastward. They nakah (struck) them until they shaar (left) them none sharayad (remaining).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) to them as Yahawah amar (spoke) him. He hamstrung their sawas (horses) and burnt their marakabah (chariots) with ash (fire).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shawab (turn back / repent) back at that ith (time), and lakad (took) Chatzawar (Hazor), and nakah (struck) its malak (king) with the charab (sword): for Chatzawar (Hazor) used to be the raash (head) of all those mamalakawath (kingdoms).

They nakah (struck) all the napash (soul) who were in it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), charam (utterly) destroying them. There was no one yathar (left) who nashamah (breathing thing). He burnt Chatzawar (Hazor) with ash (fire).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) captured all the iray (cities) of those malakayam (kings), with their malakayam (kings), and he nakah (struck) them with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and charam (utterly) destroyed them; as Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded).
But as for the irayam (cities) that imad (stood) on their mounds, Yashar-Al (Israel) sharap (burned) none of them, except Chatzawar (Hazor) only. Yahawashawai (Joshua) sharap (burned) that.

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) took all the shalal (spoil) of these irayam (cities), with the livestock, as bazazaw (spoils) for themselves; but every adam (man) they nakah (struck) with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), until they had destroyed them. They didn't shaar (leave) any who nashamah (breathing thing).

As Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) his ibad (servant), so Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) Yahawashawai (Joshua). Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) so. He sawar (left) nothing sawar (undone) of all that Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) captured all that aratz (Earth/land), the hill nagab (country), all the nagab (south), all the nagab (land) of Gashan (Goshen), the lowland, the irabah (arabah), the har (mountain) country of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the lowland of the same;

From har (mountain) Chalaq (Halak), that ilah (go up / offer) up to Shaiyar (Seir), even to Bail-Gad (Baal Gad) in the baqaih (valley) of Labanawan (Lebanon) under har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon). He lakad (took) all their malak (king), nakah (struck) them, and put them to mawath (death).
Yahawashawai (Joshua) ishah (make) malachamah (war) a rab (long) yawam (day) with all those malakayam (kings).

There was not a iyar (city) that made shalam (peace) with the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), except the Chaway (Hivites), the yashabay (inhabitants) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon). They laqach (take / seize) all in malachamah (battle).

For it was of Yahawah to chazaq (harden) their lab (heart), to come qaraah (against) Yashar-Al (Israel) in malachamah (battle), that he might charam (utterly) destroy them, that they thachanah (might) have no favor, but that he might shamad (destroy) them, as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) bawaa (come) at that ith (time), and karath (cut) off the inaqay (anakim) from the har (mountain) country, from Chabarawan (Hebron), from Dabayar (Debir), from Inab (Anab), and from all the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah), and from all the har (mountain) country of Yashar-Al (Israel): Yahawashawai (Joshua) charam (utterly) destroyed them with their iyar (cities).

There were none of the inaqay (anakim) yathar (left) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). Only in Izah (Gaza), in gath (gath), and in Ashadawad (Ashdod), did some shaar (remain).

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) laqach (take / seize) the whole aratz (Earth/land), according to all that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses); and Yahawashawai (Joshua) nathan (give) it for an nachalah (inheritance) to Yashar-Al (Israel) according to their machalaqath (divisions) by their shabat (tribes). The aratz (Earth/land) had shaqat (rest) from malachamah (war).

Now these are the malakay (kings) of the aratz (Earth/land), whom the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nakah (struck), and yarash (possessed) their aratz (Earth/land) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise, from the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon) to har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon), and all the irabah (arabah) eastward:

Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who lived in Chashabawan (Heshbon), and mashal (rule/have dominion) from Irawair (Aroer), which is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and chatzay (half) Galaid (Gilead), even to the nachal (stream / river) Yabaq (Jabbok), the gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon);

And the irabah (arabah) to the yam (sea/waters) of Kanarawath (Chinneroth), eastward, and to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), even the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), eastward, the darak (way) to Bayathahayashayamawath (Beth Jeshimoth); and on the thayaman (south), under the slopes of pasagah (pisgah):
And the gabawal (border/boundary) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), of the yathar (remnant) of the Rapaa (Rephaim), who lived at Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth) and at Adaraiy (Edrei),

And mashal (rule/have dominion) in har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon), and in Salakah (Salecah), and in all Bashan (Bashan), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Gashawaray (Geshurites) and the Maikathay (Maacathites), and chatzay (half) Galaid (Gilead), the gabawal (border/boundary) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon).

Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nakah (struck) them. Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) it for a yarashah (possession) to the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh).

These are the malakay (kings) of the aratz (Earth/land) whom Yahawashawai (Joshua) and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nakah (struck) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward, from Bail-Gad (Baal Gad) in the baqaih (valley) of Labanawan (Lebanon) even to har (mountain) Chalaq (Halak), that ilah (go up / offer) up to Shaiyar (Seir). Yahawashawai (Joshua) nathan (give) it to the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) for a yarashah (possession) according to their machalaqath (divisions);

In the har (mountain) country, and in the lowland, and in the irabah (arabah), and in the slopes, and in the madabar (wilderness), and in the nagab (south); the Chathay (Hittite), the Amaray (Amorite), and the Kanainay (Canaanite), the Parazay (Perizzite), the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite):
The malak (king) of Yarayachaw (Jericho), achad (one); the malak (king) of Iy (Ai), which is tzad (beside) Bayath-Al (Bethel), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), achad (one); the malak (king) of Chabarawan (Hebron), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Yaramawath (Jarmuth), achad (one); the malak (king) of Lakayash (Lachish), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Igalawan (Eglon), achad (one); the malak (king) of Gazar (Gezer), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Dabayar (Debir), achad (one); the malak (king) of Gadar (Geder), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Charamah (Hormah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Irad (Arad), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Labanah (Libnah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Idalam (Adullam), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Maqadah (Makkedah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Bayath-Al (Bethel), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Thapawach (Tappuah), achad (one); the malak (king) of Chapar (Hepher), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Apaq (Aphek), achad (one); the malak (king) of Sharawan (Lassharon), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Madawan (Madon), achad (one); the malak (king) of Chatzawar (Hazor), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Shimron Shamarawanamaraawan (Meron), achad (one); the malak (king) of Akashap (Achshaph), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Thainak (Taanach), achad (one); the malak (king) of Magadawan (Megiddo), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Qadash (Kedesh), achad (one); the malak (king) of Yaqanaim (Jokneam) in Karamal (Carmel), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Dawar (Dor) in the height of Dawar (Dor), achad (one); the malak (king) of Goiim in Galagal (Gilgal), achad (one);
The malak (king) of Tharatzah (Tirzah), achad (one): all the malakayam (kings) thirty-one.

Now Yahawashawai (Joshua) was zaqan (old) and well advanced in yamayam (years). Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, "You are zaqan (old) and advanced in yamayam (years), and there shaar (remains) yet very much aratz (Earth/land) to be yarash (possessed).
"This is the aratz (Earth/land) that still shaar (remains): all the regions of the Palashathay (Philistines), and all the Gashawaray (Geshurites);

From the Shayachawar (Shihor), which is panayam (face) Matzarayam (Egypt), even to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Iqarawan (Ekron) northward, which is chashab (counted) as Kanainay (Canaanite); the chamash (five) saranay (lords) of the Palashathay (Philistines); the izathay (gazites), and the ashadawaday (ashdodites), the Ashkelonites, the Gathay (Gittites), and the iqarawanay (ekronites); also the Avvim,

On the thayaman (south); all the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kanainay (Canaanites), and Mairah (Mearah) that belongs to the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), to Apaq (Aphek), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Amaray (Amorites);
And the aratz (Earth/land) of the Gebalites, and all Labanawan (Lebanon), toward the sunrise, from Bail-Gad (Baal Gad) under har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon) to the entrance of Chamath (Hamath);

All the yashabay (inhabitants) of the har (mountain) country from Labanawan (Lebanon) to Masharapawathamayam (Misrephoth Maim), even all the Tzayadanay (Sidonians); them will I yarash (drive) out from panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): only allocate it to Yashar-Al (Israel) for an nachalah (inheritance), as I have tzawah (commanded) you.
Now therefore chalaq (divide) this aratz (Earth/land) for an nachalah (inheritance) to the thashai (nine) shabatayam (tribes) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh)."

With him the Raawabanay (Reubenites) and the Gaday (Gadites) laqach (take / seize) their nachalah (inheritance), which Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) them, ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward, even as Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) them:
