From Irawair (Aroer), that is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the iyar (city) that is in the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and all the mayashawar (plain) of May-Dabaa (Medeba) to Dayabawan (Dibon);

And all the iray (cities) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who malak (king) in Chashabawan (Heshbon), to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon);

And Galaid (Gilead), and the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Gashawaray (Geshurites) and Maikathay (Maacathites), and all har (mountain) Charamawan (Hermon), and all Bashan (Bashan) to Salakah (Salecah);

All the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan), who malak (king) in Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth) and in Adaraiy (Edrei) (the same was shaar (left) of the yathar (remnant) of the Rapaa (Rephaim)); for Mashah (Moses) attacked these, and yarash (drove) them out.

Nevertheless the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) didn't yarash (drive) out the Gashawaray (Geshurites), nor the Maikathay (Maacathites): but Geshur and Maacath yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the qarab (among / near) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to this yawam (day).

Only he nathan (give) no nachalah (inheritance) to the shabat (tribe) of Laway (Levi). The ashay (offerings) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), made by ashah (fire / offering made by fire) are his nachalah (inheritance), as he dabar (word / matter) to him.
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) to the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) was from Irawair (Aroer), that is on the shapah (edge) of the nachal (stream / river) of the Aranawan (Arnon), and the iyar (city) that is in the thawak (midst) of the nachal (stream / river), and all the mayashawar (plain) by May-Dabaa (Medeba);
Chashabawan (Heshbon), and all its iyar (cities) that are in the mayashawar (plain); Dayabawan (Dibon), Bamawath (Bamoth Baal), Bayathabailamaiwan (Beth Baal Meon),
Yahatz (Jahaz), Qadamawath (Kedemoth), Mawapaith (Mephaath),
Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim), Shabam (Sibmah), Zereth Tzarathahashachar (Shahar) in the har (mountain) of the imaq (valley),
Bayathapaiwar (Beth Peor), the slopes of pasagah (pisgah), Bayathahayashayamawath (Beth Jeshimoth),

All the iray (cities) of the mayashawar (plain), and all the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), who malak (king) in Chashabawan (Heshbon), whom Mashah (Moses) nakah (struck) with the nashayaay (chiefs) of Madayan (Midian), Away (Evi), Raqam (Rekem), Tzawar (Zur), Chawar (Hur), and Rabai (Reba), the nasayakay (princes) of Sayachawan (Sihon), who lived in the aratz (Earth/land).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) alse harag (kill) Balaim (Balaam) also the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor), the qasam (soothsayer), with the charab (sword), al (toward) the rest of their chalal (slain).

The gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) was the bank of the Yaradan (Jordan). This was the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), the irayam (cities) and its chatzar (villages).
Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) to the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), to the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) was Yaizayar (Jazer), and all the iray (cities) of Galaid (Gilead), and chatzay (half) the aratz (Earth/land) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon), to Irawair (Aroer) that is panayam (face) Rabah (Rabbah);
And from Chashabawan (Heshbon) to Ramathahamatzapah (Ramath Mizpeh), and Batanayam (Betonim); and from Machanayam (Mahanaim) to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Dabayar (Debir);

And in the imaq (valley), Bayathaharam (Beth Haram), Bayathanamarah (Beth Nimrah), Sakawath (Succoth), and Tzapawan (Zaphon), the yathar (rest) of the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), the Yaradan (Jordan's) bank, to the uttermost part of the yam (sea/waters) of Kanarawath (Chinnereth) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward.
This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), the irayam (cities) and its chatzar (villages).

Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) an chatzay (inheritance) to the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh). It was for the half-tribe of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) was from Machanayam (Mahanaim), all Bashan (Bashan), all the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), and all the chawath (towns) of Yaayar (Jair), which are in Bashan (Bashan), shashayam (sixty) iyar (cities).

Chatzay (half) Galaid (Gilead), Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth), and Adaraiy (Edrei), the iray (cities) of the mamalakawath (kingdom) of Iwag (Og) in Bashan (Bashan), were for the banay (children) of Makayar (Machir) the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), even for the chatzay (half) of the banay (children) of Makayar (Machir) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).
These are the nachal (inheritances) which Mashah (Moses) distributed in the irabawath (plains) of Mawaab (Moab), ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), eastward.

But to the shabat (tribe) of Laway (Levi) Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) no nachalah (inheritance). Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), is their nachalah (inheritance), as he dabar (word / matter) to them.

These are the inheritances which the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nachal (took) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), which Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' houses of the matawath (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), nachal (distributed) to them,
By the gawaral (lot) of their nachalah (inheritance), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses), for the thashai (nine) matawath (tribes), and for the half-tribe.

For Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) given the nachalah (inheritance) of the shanayam (two) matawath (tribes) and the half-tribe ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan); but to the Lawayay (Levites) he nathan (give) no nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) them.

For the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph) were shanayam (two) matawath (tribes), Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim): and they nathan (give) no chalaq (portion) to the Lawayay (Levites) in the aratz (Earth/land), except irayam (cities) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in, with their magarash (suburbs) for their livestock and for their property.
The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses), and they chalaq (divided) the aratz (Earth/land).

Then the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) nagash (drew) near to Yahawashawai (Joshua) in Galagal (Gilgal). Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) the Qanazay (Kenizzite) amar (spoke) to him, "You yadai (know) the thing that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam awadawath (concerning) me and awadawath (concerning) you in Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea).

I was arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) ban (son) when Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah shalach (send) me from Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea) to ragal (spy) out the aratz (Earth/land). I shawab (turn back / repent) him dabar (word / matter) again as it was in my labab (heart).
Nevertheless, my ach (brother/kinsman) who ilah (go up / offer) up with me made the lab (heart) of the im (nation / people) masah (melt); but I malaa (wholly) achar (other) Yahawah my Alahayam.

Mashah (Moses) shabai (swear / take oath) on that yawam (day), amar (spoke), ‘Surely the aratz (Earth/land) where you darak (walked) shall be an nachalah (inheritance) to you and to your ban (son) iwalam (forever), because you malaa (have) wholly achar (other) Yahawah my Alahayam.'

"Now, behold, Yahawah has chayah (kept) me alive, as he dabar (word / matter), these forty-five shanah (years), from the az (time) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) this dabar (word / matter) to Mashah (Moses), while Yashar-Al (Israel) halak (move) in the madabar (wilderness). Now, behold, I am eighty-five shanah (years) ban (son), today.

As yet I am as chazaq (strong) today as I was in the yawam (day) that Mashah (Moses) shalach (send) me: as my kach (strength / mighty / power) was then, even so is my kach (strength / mighty / power) now for malachamah (war), to yatzaa (go out / come out) out and to bawaa (come) in.

Now therefore nathan (give) me this har (mountain) country, of which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) in that yawam (day); for you shamai (hearken / hear) in that yawam (day) how the inaqay (anakim) were there, and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and batzar (fortified) irayam (cities). It awalay (perhaps) be that Yahawah will be with me, and I shall yarash (drive) them out, as Yahawah dabar (word / matter)."
Yahawashawai (Joshua) barak (blessed) him; and he nathan (give) Chabarawan (Hebron) to Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) for an nachalah (inheritance).

Therefore Chabarawan (Hebron) became the nachalah (inheritance) of Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) the Qanazay (Kenizzite) to this yawam (day); because he malaa (wholly) achar (other) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Now the sham (name) of Chabarawan (Hebron) panayam (face) was Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba), after the greatest adam (man) among the inaqay (anakim). The aratz (Earth/land) had shaqat (rest) from malachamah (war).

The gawaral (lot) for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) was to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Adawam (Edom), even to the madabar (wilderness) of Tzan (Zin) southward, at the uttermost part of the thayaman (south).
Their nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary) was from the uttermost part of the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), from the lashawan (tongue / language) that panah (turn) southward;

And it yatzaa (go out / come out) out southward of the ascent of mailahaiqarabayam (akrabbim), and ibar (pass over/through) along to Tzan (Zin), and ilah (go up / offer) up by the south of Qadash-Baranai (Kadesh Barnea), and ibar (pass over/through) along by Chatzarawan (Hezron), ilah (go up / offer) up to Adar (Addar), and sabab (turned) about to Qaraqai (Karka);

And it ibar (pass over/through) along to Itzamawan (Azmon), yatzaa (go out / come out) out at the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the gabawal (border/boundary) ended at the yam (sea/waters). This shall be your nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary).

The qadam (east) gabawal (border/boundary) was the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), even to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the Yaradan (Jordan). The gabawal (border/boundary) of the tzapawan (north) paah (quarter) was from the lashawan (tongue / language) of the yam (sea/waters) at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the Yaradan (Jordan).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to Bayathachagalah (Beth Hoglah), and ibar (pass over/through) along by the tzapawan (north) of Bayathahairabah (Beth Arabah); and the gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to the aban (stone) of Bahan (Bohan) the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to Dabayar (Debir) from the imaq (valley) of Ikawar (Achor), and so northward, panah (turn) toward Galagal (Gilgal), that is over nakach (against) the mailah (ascent) of Adamayam (Adummim), which is on the nagab (south) side of the nachal (stream / river). The gabawal (border/boundary) ibar (pass over/through) along to the may (waters) of Iyanashamash (En Shemesh), and ended at Iyanaragal (En Rogel).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up by the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom) to the kathap (side) of the Yabawasay (Jebusite) southward (the same is Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)); and the gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to the raash (head) of the har (mountain) that lies panayam (face) the gayaa (valley) of Hanam (Hinnom) westward, which is at the farthest part of the imaq (valley) of Rapaa (Rephaim) northward.

The gabawal (border/boundary) extended from the raash (head) of the har (mountain) to the maiyan (spring) of the may (waters) of Napathawach (Nephtoah), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the iray (cities) of har (mountain) Iparawan (Ephron); and the gabawal (border/boundary) extended to Bailah (Baalah) (the same is Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim));

And the gabawal (border/boundary) sabab (turned) about from Bailah (Baalah) westward to har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), and ibar (pass over/through) along to the kathap (side) of har (mountain) Yairayam (Jearim) on the tzapawan (north) (the same is Kasalawan (Chesalon)), and yarad (went) down to Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), and ibar (pass over/through) along by Thamanah (Timnah);

And the gabawal (border/boundary) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the kathap (side) of Iqarawan (Ekron) northward; and the gabawal (border/boundary) extended to Shakarawan (Shikkeron), and ibar (pass over/through) along to har (mountain) Bailah (Baalah), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out at Yaban-Al (Jabneel); and the yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the gabawal (border/boundary) were at the yam (sea/waters).

The yam (sea/waters) gabawal (border/boundary) was to the shore of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters). This is the gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

To Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) he nathan (give) a chalaq (portion) thawak (midst) the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah), al (toward) to the commandment of Yahawah to Yahawashawai (Joshua), even Kiriath qarayathaarabai (arba), named after the ab (father) of Inaq (Anak) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)).
Kalab (Caleb) yarash (drove) out the shalawash (three) banay (sons) of Inaq (Anak): Shashay (Sheshai), and Achayaman (Ahiman), and Thalamay (Talmai), the yalayaday (children) of Inaq (Anak).
He ilah (go up / offer) up against the yashabay (inhabitants) of Dabayar (Debir): now the sham (name) of Dabayar (Debir) panayam (face) was Kiriath Qarayathasanah (Sepher).
Kalab (Caleb) amar (spoke), "He who nakah (strikes) Kiriath Qarayathasanah (Sepher), and lakad (takes) it, to him will I nathan (give) Ikasah (Achsah) my banath (daughter) as ayashah (woman / wife)."

Ithanayaal (Othniel) the ban (son) of Qanaz (Kenaz), the ach (brother/kinsman) of Kalab (Caleb), lakad (took) it: and he nathan (give) him Ikasah (Achsah) his banath (daughter) as ayashah (woman / wife).
It happened, when she bawaa (come), that she had him shaal (ask) her ab (father) for a shadah (field). She got off of her donkey, and Kalab (Caleb) amar (spoke), "What do you want?"

She amar (spoke), "nathan (give) me a barakah (blessing). Because you nathan (give) set me in the aratz (Earth/land) of the nagab (south), nathan (give) me also galath (springs) of mayam (Waters)." He nathan (give) her the ilay (went up) galath (springs) and the lower galath (springs).
This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

The farthest irayam (cities) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) toward the gabawal (border/boundary) of Adawam (Edom) in the nagab (south) were Qabatzaal (Kabzeel), Idar (Eder), Yagawar (Jagur),
Qayanah (Kinah), Dayamawanah (Dimonah), Idaidah (Adadah),
Qadash (Kedesh), Chatzawar (Hazor), Yathanan (Ithnan),
Zayap (Ziph), Talam (Telem), Bailawath (Bealoth),
Chatzawar (Hazor) Chatzawarachadathah (Hadattah), Qarayawath (Kerioth) Chatzarawan (Hezron) (the same is Chatzawar (Hazor)),
Amam (Amam), Shamai (Shema), Mawaladah (Moladah),
Chatzaragadah (Hazar Gaddah), Chashamawan (Heshmon), Bayathapalat (Beth Pelet),
Chatzarashawail (Hazar Shual), Baar-Shabai (Beersheba), Bazayawathayah (Biziothiah),
Bailah (Baalah), Iyayam (Iim), Itzam (Ezem),
Alathawalad (Eltolad), Kasayal (Chesil), Charamah (Hormah),
Tzaqalag (Ziklag), Madamanah (Madmannah), Sanasanah (Sansannah),
Labaawath (Lebaoth), Shalachayam (Shilhim), Iyan (Ain), and Ramawan (Rimmon). All the irayam (cities) are twenty-nine, with their chatzar (villages).
In the lowland, Ashathaal (Eshtaol), Tzaraih (Zorah), Ashanah (Ashnah),
Zanawach (Zanoah), Iyanaganayam (En Gannim), Thapawach (Tappuah), Iyanayam (Enam),
Yaramawath (Jarmuth), Idalam (Adullam), Shawakah (Socoh), Izaqah (Azekah),
Shairayam (Shaaraim), Idayathayam (Adithaim) and Gadarah (Gederah) (or Gadarathayam (Gederothaim)); fourteen irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Tzanan (Zenan), Chadashah (Hadashah), Magadalagad (Migdal Gad),
Dalain (Dilean), Matzapah (Mizpeh), Yaqathaal (Joktheel),
Lakayash (Lachish), Batzaqath (Bozkath), Igalawan (Eglon),
Kabawan (Cabbon), Lachamas (Lahmam), Kathalayash (Chitlish),
Gadarawath (Gederoth), Bayathadagawan (Beth Dagon), Naimah (Naamah), and Maqadah (Makkedah); sixteen irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Labanah (Libnah), Ithar (Ether), Ishan (Ashan),
Yapathach (Iphtah), Ashanah (Ashnah), Natzayab (Nezib),
Qaiyalah (Keilah), Akazayab (Achzib), and Maraashah (Mareshah); thashai (nine) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Iqarawan (Ekron), with its banath (daughter) and its chatzar (villages);
From Iqarawan (Ekron) even to the yam (sea/waters), all that were by the side of Ashadawad (Ashdod), with their chatzar (villages).

Ashadawad (Ashdod), its banath (daughter) and its chatzar (villages); Izah (Gaza), its banath (daughter) and its chatzar (villages); to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and the gabawal (border/boundary) yam (sea/waters) with its coastline.
In the har (mountain) country, Shamayar (Shamir), Yathayar (Jattir), Shawakah (Socoh),
Danah (Dannah), Kiriath Qarayathasanah (Sannah) (which is Dabayar (Debir)),
Inab (Anab), Ashathamai (Eshtemoh), Inayam (Anim),
Gashan (Goshen), Chalawan (Holon), and Galah (Giloh); achad (one) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Arab (Arab), Dawamah (Dumah), Ashain (Eshan),
Yanayam (Janim), Bayathathapawach (Beth Tappuah), Apaqah (Aphekah),
Chamatah (Humtah), Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)), and Tzayair (Zior); thashai (nine) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Maiwan (maon), Karamal (Carmel), Zayap (Ziph), Yatah (Jutah),
Yazaraial (Jezreel), Yaqadaim (Jokdeam), Zanawach (Zanoah),
Qayan (Kain), Gabaih (Gibeah), and Thamanah (Timnah); ishar (ten) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Chalachawal (Halhul), Bayathatzawar (Beth Zur), Gadar (Gedor),
Mairath (Maarath), Bayathainawath (Beth Anoth), and Alathaqan (Eltekon); shash (six) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Qarayathabail (Kiriath Baal) (the same is Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim)), and Rabah (Rabbah); shanayam (two) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
In the madabar (wilderness), Bayathahairabah (Beth Arabah), Madayan (Middin), Sakakah (Secacah),
Nabashan (Nibshan), the Iyar-HaMalach (City of Salt), and Iyan-Gaday (En Gedi); shash (six) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

As for the Yabawasay (Jebusites), the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) couldn't yarash (drive) them out; but the Yabawasay (Jebusites) live with the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to this yawam (day).

The gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph) from the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), at the may (waters) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) on the mazarach (east), even the madabar (wilderness), ilah (go up / offer) up from Yarayachaw (Jericho) through the har (mountain) country to Bayath-Al (Bethel).
It yatzaa (go out / come out) out from Bayath-Al (Bethel) to Lawaz (Luz), and ibar (pass over/through) along to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the arakay (archites) to Itarawath (Ataroth);

And it yarad (went) down westward to the gabawal (border/boundary) of the Japhletites, to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) the thachathawan (lower), even to Gazar (Gezer); and ended at the yam (sea/waters).
The banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph), Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim), took their nachal (inheritance).

This was the gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family). The gabawal (border/boundary) of their nachalah (inheritance) eastward was Itarawathaadar (Ataroth Addar), to Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) the ilayawan (Ilayawan).

The gabawal (border/boundary) yatzaa (go out / come out) out westward at Makamathath (Michmethath) on the tzapawan (north). The gabawal (border/boundary) sabab (turned) about eastward to Thaanathashalah (Taanath Shiloh), and ibar (pass over/through) along it on the mazarach (east) of Yanawach (Janoah).
It yarad (went) down from Yanawach (Janoah) to Itarawath (Ataroth), to Nairah (Naarah), pagai (reached) to Yarayachaw (Jericho), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out at the Yaradan (Jordan).

From Thapawach (Tappuah) the gabawal (border/boundary) went along westward to the nachal (stream / river) of Qanah (Kanah); and ended at the yam (sea/waters). This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family);

Together with the irayam (cities) which were set apart for the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim) in the thawak (midst) of the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh), all the irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

They didn't yarash (drive) out the Kanainay (Canaanites) who lived in Gazar (Gezer); but the Kanainay (Canaanites) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the qarab (among / near) of Aparayam (Ephraim) to this yawam (day), and have become ibad (servant) to do forced mas (labor).

This was the gawaral (lot) for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), for he was the bakawar (firstborn) of Yawasap (Joseph). As for Makayar (Machir) the bakawar (firstborn) of Manashah (Manasseh), the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead), because he was a ayash (man / husband) of malachamah (war), therefore he had Galaid (Gilead) and Bashan (Bashan).

So this was for the yathar (rest) of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): for the banay (children) of Abayaizar (Abiezer), for the banay (children) of Chalaq (Helek), for the banay (children) of Asharayaal (Asriel), for the banay (children) of Shakam (Shechem), for the banay (children) of Chapar (Hepher), and for the banay (children) of Shamayadai (Shemida): these were the zakar (remember) banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) the ban (son) of Yawasap (Joseph) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

But Tzalapachad (Zelophehad), the ban (son) of Chapar (Hepher), the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh), had no banayam (sons), but banawath (daughters): and these are the shamawath (names) of his banawath (daughters): Machalah (Mahlah), Naih (Noah), Chagalah (Hoglah), Malakah (Milcah), and Tharatzah (Tirzah).

They qarab (come close) near panayam (face) Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and panayam (face) Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and panayam (face) the nashayaayam (princes), amar (spoke), "Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) to nathan (give) us an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) our achay (brothers)." Therefore pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah he nathan (give) them an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) the achay (brothers) of their ab (father).
Ishar (ten) parts napal (fall / be cast down) to Manashah (Manasseh), besides the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) and Bashan (Bashan), which is ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan);

Because the banawath (daughters) of Manashah (Manasseh) nachal (had) an nachalah (inheritance) thawak (midst) his banay (sons). The aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) belonged to the yathar (rest) of the banay (sons) of Manashah (Manasseh).

The gabawal (border/boundary) of Manashah (Manasseh) was from Ashar (Asher) to Makamathath (Michmethath), which is panayam (face) Shakam (Shechem). The gabawal (border/boundary) halak (move) along to the right yamayan (right hand), to the yashabay (inhabitants) of Iyanathapawach (En Tappuah).

The aratz (Earth/land) of Thapawach (Tappuah) belonged to Manashah (Manasseh); but Thapawach (Tappuah) on the gabawal (border/boundary) of Manashah (Manasseh) belonged to the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

The gabawal (border/boundary) yarad (went) down to the nachal (stream / river) of Qanah (Kanah), southward of the nachal (stream / river). These irayam (cities) belonged to Aparayam (Ephraim) thawak (midst) the irayam (cities) of Manashah (Manasseh). The gabawal (border/boundary) of Manashah (Manasseh) was on the tzapawan (north) side of the nachal (stream / river), and ended at the yam (sea/waters).

Southward it was Aparayam (Ephraim's), and northward it was Manashah (Manasseh's), and the yam (sea/waters) was his gabawal (border/boundary). They pagai (reached) to Ashar (Asher) on the tzapawan (north), and to Yashashakar (Issachar) on the mazarach (east).

Manashah (Manasseh) had shalawash (three) heights in Yashashakar (Issachar), in Ashar (Asher) Bayath-Shaan (Beth Shean) and its banath (daughter), and Yabalaim (Ibleam) and its banath (daughter), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Dawar (Dor) and its banath (daughter), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Iyan-Daar (Endor) and its banath (daughter), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Thainak (Taanach) and its banath (daughter), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Magadawan (Megiddo) and its banath (daughter).

Yet the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) couldn't yarash (drive) out the inhabitants of those irayam (cities); but the Kanainay (Canaanites) yaal (would) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in that aratz (Earth/land).

It happened, when the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) had grown chazaq (strong), that they nathan (give) the Kanainay (Canaanites) to forced mas (labor), and didn't yarash (utterly) yarash (drive) them out.

The banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph) dabar (word / matter) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke), "Why nathan (give) you given me just achad (one) gawaral (lot) and achad (one) part for an nachalah (inheritance), since I am a rab (great) im (nation / people), because Yahawah has barak (blessed) me so far?"

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to them, "If you are a rab (great) im (nation / people), ilah (go up / offer) up to the yair (forest), and clear aratz (Earth/land) for yourself there in the land of the Parazay (Perizzites) and of the Rapaa (Rephaim); since the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim) is too awatz (narrow) for you."

The banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph) amar (spoke), "The har (mountain) country is not matzaa (enough) for us. All the Kanainay (Canaanites) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the imaq (valley) have rakab (chariots) of barazal (iron), both those who are in Bayath-Shaan (Beth Shean) and its banath (daughter), and those who are in the imaq (valley) of Yazaraial (Jezreel)."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph), even to Aparayam (Ephraim) and to Manashah (Manasseh), amar (spoke), "You are a rab (great) im (nation / people), and rab (have) great kach (strength / mighty / power). You shall not have achad (one) gawaral (lot) only;

But the har (mountain) country shall be yours. Although it is a yair (forest), you shall baraa (created) it down, and it's farthest extent shall be yours; for you shall yarash (drive) out the Kanainay (Canaanites), though they have rakab (chariots) of barazal (iron), and though they are chazaq (strong)."

The whole idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) qahal (assembled) themselves together at Shayalah (Shiloh), and shakan (place) up the ahal (tent) of Meeting there. The aratz (Earth/land) was kabash (subdued) panayam (face) them.
Shabai (seven) shabatayam (tribes) yathar (remained) among the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), which chalaq (had) not yet divided their nachalah (inheritance).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), "How long will you neglect to bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land), which Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), nathan (give) given you?

Appoint for yourselves shalawash (three) anashayam (men) from each shabat (tribe). I will shalach (send) them, and they shall qawam (rise up), halak (move) through the aratz (Earth/land), and kathab (write) it pah (according) to their nachalah (inheritance); and they shall bawaa (come) to me.

They shall chalaq (divide) it into shabai (seven) chalaqayam (portions). Yahawadah (Judah) shall live in his gabawal (border/boundary) on the nagab (south), and the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph) shall live in their gabawal (border/boundary) on the tzapawan (north).

You shall survey the aratz (Earth/land) into shabai (seven) chalaqayam (parts), and bawaa (come) the description here to me; and I will yarah (cast) gawaral (lots) for you here panayam (face) Yahawah our Alahayam.

For the Lawayay (Levites) have no chalaq (portion) qarab (among / near) you; for the kahanah (priesthood) of Yahawah is their nachalah (inheritance). Gad (Gad), Raawaban (Reuben), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) have laqach (take / seize) their nachalah (inheritance) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) eastward, which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) them."

The anashayam (men) qawam (rise up) and yalak (went). Yahawashawai (Joshua) tzawah (commanded) those who halak (move) to survey the aratz (Earth/land), amar (spoke), "yalak (go) halak (move) through the aratz (Earth/land), survey it, and shawab (turn back / repent) again to me. I will shalak (cast) gawaral (lots) for you here panayam (face) Yahawah in Shayalah (Shiloh)."

The anashayam (men) yalak (went) and ibar (pass over/through) through the aratz (Earth/land), and surveyed it by irayam (cities) into shabai (seven) chalaqayam (portions) in a sapar (book / scribed document). They bawaa (come) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) to the machanah (camp) at Shayalah (Shiloh).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalak (cast) gawaral (lots) for them in Shayalah (Shiloh) panayam (face) Yahawah. There Yahawashawai (Joshua) chalaq (divided) the aratz (Earth/land) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) according to their machalaqath (divisions).

The gawaral (lot) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) ilah (go up / offer) up according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family). The gabawal (border/boundary) of their gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out between the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) on the tzapawan (north) paah (quarter) was from the Yaradan (Jordan). The gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up to the kathap (side) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) on the tzapawan (north), and ilah (go up / offer) up through the har (mountain) country westward. It ended at the madabar (wilderness) of Bayathaawan (Beth Aven).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ibar (pass over/through) along from there to Lawaz (Luz), to the kathap (side) of Lawaz (Luz) (the same is Bayath-Al (Bethel)), southward. The gabawal (border/boundary) yarad (went) down to Itarawathaadar (Ataroth Addar), by the har (mountain) that lies on the nagab (south) of Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) the thachathawan (lower).

The gabawal (border/boundary) extended, and sabab (turned) around on the yam (sea/waters) paah (quarter) southward, from the har (mountain) that lies panayam (face) Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) southward; and ended at Qarayathabail (Kiriath Baal) (the same is Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim)), a iyar (city) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah). This was the yam (sea/waters) paah (quarter).

The nagab (south) paah (quarter) was from the farthest part of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim). The gabawal (border/boundary) yatzaa (go out / come out) out westward, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the maiyan (spring) of the may (waters) of Napathawach (Nephtoah).

The gabawal (border/boundary) yarad (went) down to the farthest part of the har (mountain) that lies panayam (face) the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), which is in the imaq (valley) of Rapaa (Rephaim) northward. It yarad (went) down to the gayaa (valley) of Hanam (Hinnom), to the kathap (side) of the Yabawasay (Jebusite) southward, and yarad (went) down to Iyanaragal (En Rogel).

It extended northward, yatzaa (go out / come out) out at Iyanashamash (En Shemesh), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to Galayalawath (Geliloth), which is over nakach (against) the mailah (ascent) of Adamayam (Adummim). It yarad (went) down to the aban (stone) of Bahan (Bohan) the ban (son) of Raawaban (Reuben).
It ibar (pass over/through) along to the kathap (side) over mawal (against) the irabah (arabah) northward, and yarad (went) down to the irabah (arabah).

The gabawal (border/boundary) ibar (pass over/through) along to the kathap (side) of Bayathachagalah (Beth Hoglah) northward; and the gabawal (border/boundary) ended at the tzapawan (north) lashawan (tongue / language) of the malach (salt) yam (sea/waters), at the nagab (south) qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the Yaradan (Jordan). This was the nagab (south) gabawal (border/boundary).

The Yaradan (Jordan) was its gabal (border) on the qadam (east) paah (quarter). This was the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), by the gabawalah (borders) around it, according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

Now the irayam (cities) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) were Yarayachaw (Jericho), Bayathachagalah (Beth Hoglah), Emek Qatzayatz (Keziz),
Bayathahairabah (Beth Arabah), Tzamarayam (Zemaraim), Bayath-Al (Bethel),
Iwayam (Avvim), Parah (Parah), Iparah (Ophrah),
Kaparahaimawanay (Chephar Ammoni), Ipanay (Ophni), and Gabai (Geba); shanayam (two) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
Gabaiwan (Gibeon), Ramah (Ramah), Baarawath (Beeroth),
Matzapah (Mizpeh), Kapayarah (Chephirah), Matzah (Mozah),
Raqam (Rekem), Yarapaal (Irpeel), Tharaalah (Taralah),

Tzalai (Zelah), Alap (Eleph), the Yabawasay (Jebusite) (the same is Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)), Gabaith (Gibeath), and Qarayath-Yairayam (Kiriath); fourteen irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages). This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

The shanay (second) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for Shamaiwan (Simeon), even for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family). Their nachalah (inheritance) was in the thawak (midst) of the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah).
They had for their nachalah (inheritance) Baar-Shabai (Beersheba) (or shabai (sheba)), Mawaladah (Moladah),
Chatzarashawail (Hazar Shual), Balah (Balah), Itzam (Ezem),
Alathawalad (Eltolad), Bathawal (Bethul), Charamah (Hormah),
Tzaqalag (Ziklag), Bayathahamarakabawath (Beth Marcaboth), Chatzarasawasah (Hazar Susah),
Bayathalabaawath (Beth Lebaoth), and Sharawachan (Sharuhen); thirteen irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages);
Iyan (Ain), Ramawan (Rimmon), Ithar (Ether), and Ishan (Ashan); arabai (four) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages);

And all the chatzarayam (villages) that were around these irayam (cities) to Bailathabaar (Baalath Beer), Ramah (Ramah) of the nagab (south). This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).

Out of the part of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) was the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon); for the chalaq (portion) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) was rab (too) much for them. Therefore the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon) had nachal (inheritance) in the thawak (midst) of their nachal (inheritance).

The shalayashay (third) gawaral (lot) ilah (go up / offer) up for the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family). The gabawal (border/boundary) of their nachalah (inheritance) was to Sharayad (Sarid).

Their gabawal (border/boundary) ilah (go up / offer) up westward, even to Marailah (Maralah), and pagai (reached) to Dabashath (Dabbesheth). It pagai (reached) to the nachal (stream / river) that is panayam (face) Yaqanaim (Jokneam).

It shawab (turn back / repent) from Sharayad (Sarid) eastward toward the sunrise to the gabawal (border/boundary) of Kasalathathabar (Chisloth Tabor). It yatzaa (go out / come out) out to dabarath (daberath), and ilah (go up / offer) up to Yapayai (Japhia).

From there it ibar (pass over/through) along eastward to Gathahachapar (Gath Hepher), to Ithaqatzayan (Ethkazin); and it yatzaa (go out / come out) out at Ramawan (Rimmon) which stretches to Naih (Neah).
The gabawal (border/boundary) sabab (turned) around it on the tzapawan (north) to Chanathan (Hannathon); and it ended at the gayaa (valley) of Iphtah Yapathachaal (El);
Qatath (Kattath), Nahalal (Nahalal), Shamarawan (Shimron), Yadaalah (Idalah), and Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem): shanayam (two) irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the banay (children) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), these irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

The rabayaiy (fourth) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for Yashashakar (Issachar), even for the banay (children) of Yashashakar (Issachar) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).
Their gabawal (border/boundary) was to Yazaraial (Jezreel), Kasalawath (Chesulloth), Shawanam (Shunem),
Chaparayam (Hapharaim), Shayaawan (Shion), Anacharath (Anaharath),
Rabayath (Rabbith), Qashayawan (Kishion), Abatz (Ebez),
Ramath (Remeth), Iyanaganayam (Engannim), Iyanachadah (En Haddah), and Bayathapatzatz (Beth Pazzez).

The gabawal (border/boundary) pagai (reached) to Thabawar (Tabor), Shachatzawam (Shahazumah), and Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh). Their gabawal (border/boundary) ended at the Yaradan (Jordan): sixteen irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yashashakar (Issachar) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), the irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

The chamayashay (fifth) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).
Their gabawal (border/boundary) was Chalaqath (Helkath), Chalay (Hali), Batan (Beten), Akashap (Achshaph),
Alamalak (Allammelech), Imaid (Amad), Mashaal (Mishal). It pagai (reached) to Karamal (Carmel) westward, and to Shayachawaralabanath (Shihorlibnath).

It shawab (turn back / repent) toward the sunrise to Bayathadagawan (Beth Dagon), and pagai (reached) to Zabawalawan (Zebulun), and to the gayaa (valley) of Yapathachaal (Iphtah) El northward to Bayathahaimaq (Beth Emek) and Naiyaal (Neiel). It yatzaa (go out / come out) out to Kabawal (Cabul) on the left shamaawal (left hand),
And Ibaran (Ebron), Rachab (Rehob), Chamawan (Hammon), and Qanah (Kanah), even to rab (great) Tzayadawan (Sidon).

The gabawal (border/boundary) shawab (turn back / repent) to Ramah (Ramah), to the fortified iyar (city) of Tzar (Tyre); and the gabawal (border/boundary) shawab (turn back / repent) to Chasah (Hosah). It ended at the yam (sea/waters) by the chabal (region) of Akazayab (Achzib);
Imah (Ummah) also, and Apaq (Aphek), and Rachab (Rehob): twenty-two irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), these irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

The shashay (sixth) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali), even for the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).
Their gabawal (border/boundary) was from Chalap (Heleph), from the oak in Tzainanayam (Zaanannim), Adamay (Adaminekeb), and Yaban-Al (Jabneel), to Laqawam (Lakkum). It ended at the Yaradan (Jordan).

The gabawal (border/boundary) shawab (turn back / repent) westward to Azanawathathabawar (Aznoth Tabor), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out from there to chaqaq (lawgiver). It pagai (reached) to Zabawalawan (Zebulun) on the nagab (south), and pagai (reached) to Ashar (Asher) on the yam (sea/waters), and to Yahawadah (Judah) at the Yaradan (Jordan) toward the sunrise.
The fortified iray (cities) were Tzadayam (Ziddim), Tzar (Zer), Chamath (Hammath), Raqath (Rakkath), Kanarawath (Chinnereth),
Adamah (Adamah), Ramah (Ramah), Chatzawar (Hazor),
Qadash (Kedesh), Adaraiy (Edrei), Iyanachatzawar (En Hazor),
Yaraawan (Iron), Magadalaal (Migdal) El, Charam (Horem), Bayathainath (Beth Anath), and Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh); nineteen irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Napathalay (Naphtali) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), the irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).
The shabayaiy (seventh) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family).
The gabawal (border/boundary) of their nachalah (inheritance) was Tzaraih (Zorah), Ashathaal (Eshtaol), Iyarashamash (Irshemesh),
Shailabayam (Shaalabbin), Ayalawan (Aijalon), Yathalah (Ithlah),
Ayalawan (Elon), Thamanah (Timnah), Iqarawan (Ekron),
Alathaqaa (Eltekeh), Gabathawan (Gibbethon), Bailath (Baalath),
Yahad (Jehud), Banayabaraq (Bene Berak), Gatharamawan (Gath Rimmon),
Me Mayahayaraqawan (Jarkon), and Raqawan (Rakkon), with the gabawal (border/boundary) over mawal (against) Yapaw (Joppa).

The gabawal (border/boundary) of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan) yatzaa (go out / come out) out beyond them; for the banay (children) of Dan (Dan) ilah (go up / offer) up and lacham (fought) against Lasham (Leshem), and lakad (took) it, and nakah (struck) it with the pah (edge) of the charab (sword), and yarash (possessed) it, and lived therein, and qaraa (called) Lasham (Leshem), Dan (Dan), after the sham (name) of Dan (Dan) their ab (father).

This is the nachalah (inheritance) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Dan (Dan) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), these irayam (cities) with their chatzar (villages).

So they kalah (complete / finish) an end of distributing the aratz (Earth/land) for nachal (inheritance) by its gabawalah (borders). The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nathan (give) an nachalah (inheritance) to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) in their thawak (midst).

Pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah, they nathan (give) him the iyar (city) which he shaal (asked), even Thamanathacharas (Timnathserah) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim); and he banah (build) the iyar (city), and lived there.

These are the nachalath (inheritances), which Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' houses of the matawath (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), distributed for nachal (inheritance) by gawaral (lot) in Shayalah (Shiloh) panayam (face) Yahawah, at the pathach (door) of the ahal (tent) of Meeting. So they kalah (complete / finish) an end of chalaq (dividing) the aratz (Earth/land).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),
"Dabar (word / matter) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), ‘Assign the iray (cities) of maqalat (refuge), of which I dabar (word / matter) to you by Mashah (Moses),
That the manslayer who nakah (kills) any napash (soul) accidentally or unintentionally may nawas (flee) there. They shall be to you for a maqalat (refuge) from the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood).

He shall nawas (flee) to achad (one) of those irayam (cities), and shall imad (stand) at the pathach (entrance) of the shair (gate) of the iyar (city), and dabar (word / matter) his dabar (word / matter) in the azanay (ears) of the zaqanay (elders) of that iyar (city). They shall asap (take) him into the iyar (city) with them, and nathan (give) him a maqawam (place), that he may live among them.

If the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood) radap (pursue) achar (other) him, then they shall not sagar (deliver) up the manslayer into his yad (hand); because he nakah (struck) his neighbor unintentionally, and didn't shanaa (hate) him thamawal (before).

He shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in that iyar (city) until he imad (stands) panayam (face) the idah (congregation) for mashapat (judgment), until the mawath (death) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) that shall be in those yamayam (days). Then the manslayer shall shawab (turn back / repent), and bawaa (come) to his own iyar (city), and to his own bayath (house), to the iyar (city) he nawas (fled) from.'"

They set apart Qadash (Kedesh) in Galayal (Galilee) in the har (mountain) country of Napathalay (Naphtali), Shakam (Shechem) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), and Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)) in the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah).

Ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho) eastward, they nathan (give) Batzar (Bezer) in the madabar (wilderness) in the mayashawar (plain) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), Raamawath (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), and Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh).

These were the mawaidah (appointed) iray (cities) for all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and for the gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) who lives thawak (midst) them, that whoever nakah (kills) any napash (soul) unintentionally might nawas (flee) there, and not mawath (death) by the yad (hand) of the gaal (avenger) of dam (blood), until he imad (stands) panayam (face) the idah (congregation).

Then the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' houses of the Lawayay (Levites) nagash (came) near to Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun), and to the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' houses of the matawath (tribes) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

They dabar (word / matter) to them at Shayalah (Shiloh) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), amar (spoke), "Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses) to nathan (give) us irayam (cities) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in, with their magarash (suburbs) for our livestock."

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nathan (give) to the Lawayay (Levites) out of their nachalah (inheritance), pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah, these irayam (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).

The gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out for the mashapachath (families) of the Qahathay (Kohathites). The banay (children) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest), who were of the Lawayay (Levites), had thirteen irayam (cities) by gawaral (lot) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the Shamainay (Simeonites), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin).

The yathar (rest) of the banay (children) of Qahath (Kohath) had ishar (ten) irayam (cities) by gawaral (lot) out of the mashapachath (families) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Aparayam (Ephraim), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Dan (Dan), and out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh).

The banay (children) of Garashawan (Gershon) had thirteen irayam (cities) by gawaral (lot) out of the mashapachawath (families) of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), and out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) in Bashan (Bashan).

The banay (children) of Mararay (Merari) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) had shanayam (two) irayam (cities) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) nathan (give) these irayam (cities) with their magarash (suburbs) by gawaral (lot) to the Lawayay (Levites), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses).

They nathan (give) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the banay (children) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), these irayam (cities) which are qaraa (called) by sham (name):

And they were for the banay (children) of Aharawan (Aaron), of the mashapachawath (families) of the Qahathay (Kohathites), who were of the banay (children) of Laway (Levi); for theirs was the raashawan (first) gawaral (lot).

They nathan (give) them Kiriath qarayathaarabai (arba), named after the ab (father) of Inaq (Anak) (the same is Chabarawan (Hebron)), in the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah), with its magarash (suburbs) around it.
But they nathan (give) the shadah (fields) of the iyar (city) and its chatzar (villages) to Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh) for his achazah (possession).

To the banay (children) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahan (priest) they nathan (give) Chabarawan (Hebron) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, Labanah (Libnah) with its magarash (suburbs),
Yathayar (Jattir) with its magarash (suburbs), Ashathamai (Eshtemoa) with its magarash (suburbs),
Chalawan (Holon) with its magarash (suburbs), Dabayar (Debir) with its magarash (suburbs),

Iyan (Ain) with its magarash (suburbs), Yatah (Juttah) with its magarash (suburbs), and Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh) with its magarash (suburbs); thashai (nine) irayam (cities) out of those shanayam (two) shabatayam (tribes).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Gabaiwan (Gibeon) with its magarash (suburbs), Gabai (Geba) with its magarash (suburbs),
Inathawath (Anathoth) with its magarash (suburbs), and Ilamawan (Almon) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities).
All the iray (cities) of the banay (children) of Aharawan (Aaron), the kahanayam (priests), were thirteen iray (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).

The mashapachawath (families) of the banay (children) of Qahath (Kohath), the Lawayay (Levites), even the yathar (rest) of the banay (children) of Qahath (Kohath), had the iray (cities) of their gawaral (lot) out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

They nathan (give) them Shakam (Shechem) with its magarash (suburbs) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, and Gazar (Gezer) with its magarash (suburbs),
Qabatzayam (Kibzaim) with its magarash (suburbs), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Dan (Dan), Alathaqaa (Elteke) with its magarash (suburbs), Gabathawan (Gibbethon) with its magarash (suburbs),
Ayalawan (Aijalon) with its magarash (suburbs), Gatharamawan (Gath Rimmon) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities).
Out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), Thainak (Taanach) with its magarash (suburbs), and Gatharamawan (Gath Rimmon) with its magarash (suburbs); shanayam (two) irayam (cities).
All the irayam (cities) of the mashapachawath (families) of the yathar (rest) of the banay (children) of Qahath (Kohath) were ishar (ten) with their magarash (suburbs).

They gave to the banay (children) of Garashawan (Gershon), of the mashapachath (families) of the Lawayay (Levites), out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, and Be Baishatharah (Eshterah) with its magarash (suburbs); shanayam (two) irayam (cities).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), Qashayawan (Kishion) with its magarash (suburbs), dabarath (daberath) with its magarash (suburbs),
Yaramawath (Jarmuth) with its magarash (suburbs), Iyanaganayam (En Gannim) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities).
Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), Mashaal (Mishal) with its magarash (suburbs), Ibadawan (Abdon) with its magarash (suburbs),
Chalaqath (Helkath) with its magarash (suburbs), and Rachab (Rehob) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities).

Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), Qadash (Kedesh) in Galayal (Galilee) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, Chamathadaar (Hammothdor) with its magarash (suburbs), and Qarathan (Kartan) with its magarash (suburbs); shalawash (three) irayam (cities).
All the iray (cities) of the garashanay (gershonites) according to their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) were thirteen iray (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).

To the mashapachawath (families) of the banay (children) of Mararay (Merari), the yathar (rest) of the Lawayay (Levites), out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Yaqanaim (Jokneam) with its magarash (suburbs), Qarathah (Kartah) with its magarash (suburbs),
Damanah (Dimnah) with its magarash (suburbs), and Nahalal (Nahalal) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities).
Out of the tribe of Raawaban (Reuben), Batzar (Bezer) with its suburbs, Yahatz (Jahaz) with its suburbs,
Qadamawath (Kedemoth) with its suburbs, and Mawapaith (Mephaath) with its suburbs; arabai (four) irayam (cities).

Out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), Ramath-Galaid (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead) with its magarash (suburbs), the iyar (city) of maqalat (refuge) for the manslayer, and Machanayam (Mahanaim) with its magarash (suburbs),
Chashabawan (Heshbon) with its magarash (suburbs), Yaizayar (Jazer) with its magarash (suburbs); arabai (four) irayam (cities) in all.

All these were the irayam (cities) of the banay (children) of Mararay (Merari) according to their mashapachawath (families), even the yathar (rest) of the mashapachawath (families) of the Lawayay (Levites). Their gawaral (lot) was shanayam (two) irayam (cities).

All the iray (cities) of the Lawayay (Levites) in the midst of the achazah (possession) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) were arabaiyam (forty) - shamanah (eight) iray (cities) with their magarash (suburbs).
Each of these irayam (cities) included their magarash (suburbs) around them. It was this way with all these irayam (cities).
So Yahawah nathan (give) to Yashar-Al (Israel) all the aratz (Earth/land) which he shabai (swear / take oath) to nathan (give) to their ab (father). They yarash (possessed) it, and lived in it.

Yahawah gave them nawach (rest) all around, according to all that he shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father). Not a ayash (man / husband) of all their ayab (enemy) imad (stood) panayam (face) them. Yahawah nathan (give) all their ayab (enemy) into their yad (hand).
Nothing napal (fall / be cast down) of any tawab (good / proper function) thing which Yahawah had dabar (word / matter) to the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel). All bawaa (come) to pass.
Then Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) the Raawabanay (Reubenites), the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh),

And amar (spoke) to them, "You have shamar (keep/guard) all that Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) you, and have shamai (hearken / hear) to my qawal (sound / voice) in all that I tzawah (commanded) you.
You have not izab (left) your ach (brother/kinsman) these many yamayam (days) to this yawam (day), but have performed the duty of the matzawah (commandment) of Yahawah your Alahayam.

Now Yahawah your Alahayam has given nawach (rest) to your ach (brother/kinsman), as he dabar (word / matter) to them. Therefore now panah (turn) and yalak (go) to your ahal (tents), to the aratz (Earth/land) of your achazah (possession), which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah nathan (give) you ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan).

Only take diligent shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) the matzawah (commandment) and the thawarah (instruction) which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded) you, to ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in all his darak (ways), to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), to hold dabaq (fast) to him, and to ibad (servant) him with all your labab (heart) and with all your napash (soul)."
So Yahawashawai (Joshua) barak (blessed) them, and shalach (send) them away; and they yalak (went) to their ahal (tents).

Now to the chatzay (one) half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) given inheritance in Bashan (Bashan); but to the other chatzay (half) nathan (give) Yahawashawai (Joshua) im (with) their ach (brother/kinsman) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward. Moreover when Yahawashawai (Joshua) shalach (send) them away to their ahal (tents), he barak (blessed) them,

And amar (spoke) to them, amar (spoke), "shawab (turn back / repent) with much nakas (wealth) to your ahal (tents), with very much livestock, with kasap (silver), with zahab (gold), with nachashath (brass), with barazal (iron), and with very much clothing. Chalaq (divide) the shalal (spoil) of your ayab (enemy) with your ach (brother/kinsman)."

The banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) shawab (turn back / repent), and departed from the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) out of Shayalah (Shiloh), which is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), to yalak (go) to the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), to the aratz (Earth/land) of their achazah (possession), which they owned, pah (according) to the commandment of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses).

When they bawaa (come) to the region about the Yaradan (Jordan), that is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) banah (build) there an mazabach (altar) by the Yaradan (Jordan), a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mazabach (altar) to maraah (look) at.

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) this, "Behold, the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) have banah (build) an mazabach (altar) in the mawal (forefront) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), in the region about the Yaradan (Jordan), on the ibar (side) that pertains to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)."

When the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, the whole idah (congregation) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) qahal (gathered) themselves together at Shayalah (Shiloh), to ilah (go up / offer) up against them to tzabaa (troop).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shalach (send) to the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), and to the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), and to the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), into the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest),

And with him ishar (ten) nashaayam (princes), one nashayaa (prince) of a ab (father)' bayath (house) for achad (one) of the matawath (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and they were everyone of them raash (head) of their ab (father)' bayath (house) among the alapay (thousands) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

They bawaa (come) to the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), and to the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), and to the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), to the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), and they dabar (word / matter) with them, amar (spoke),

"Thus amaraw (says) the whole idah (congregation) of Yahawah, ‘What mail (top/above) is this that you have mail (top/above) against the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to shawab (turn back / repent) away this yawam (day) from achar (other) Yahawah, in that you have banah (build) yourselves an mazabach (altar), to marad (rebel) this yawam (day) against Yahawah?

Is the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of Paiwar (Peor) too mait (little) for us, from which we have not tahar (cleansed) ourselves to this yawam (day), although there came a nagap (plague) on the idah (congregation) of Yahawah,

That you must shawab (turn back / repent) away this yawam (day) from achar (other) Yahawah? It will be, since you marad (rebel) today against Yahawah, that machar (tomorrow) he will be qatzap (angry) with the whole idah (congregation) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

However, if the aratz (Earth/land) of your achazah (possession) is tamaa (unclean), then ibar (pass over/through) over to the aratz (Earth/land) of the achazah (possession) of Yahawah, in which Yahawah mashakan (tabernacle) shakan (place), and take achaz (possession) thawak (midst) us; but don't marad (rebel) against Yahawah, al (not) marad (rebel) against us, in banah (build) an mazabach (altar) other than the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah our Alahayam.

Didn't Ikan (Achan) the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah) mail (top/above) a mail (top/above) in the charam (devoted) thing, and qatzap (wrath) hayah (came to pass) on all the idah (congregation) of Yashar-Al (Israel)? That ayash (man / husband) didn't gawai (perish) achad (one) in his iwan (guilt/iniquity).'"

Then the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) inah (answer / respond), and dabar (word / matter) to the raashay (heads) of the alapay (thousands) of Yashar-Al (Israel),

"The Mighty One, Al, Yahawah, the Mighty One, Al, Yahawah, he yadai (knows); and Yashar-Al (Israel) shall yadai (know): if it was in marad (rebellion), or if in mail (top/above) against Yahawah (don't yashai (salvation) us this yawam (day)),

That we have banah (build) us an mazabach (altar) to shawab (turn back / repent) achar (other) from following Yahawah; or if to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offering) or meal ilah (offering), or if to ishah (make) sacrifices of shalam (peace) zabachay (offerings), let Yahawah himself baqash (require) it.

"If we have not out of concern ishah (make) this, and for a reason, amar (spoke), ‘In machar (time) to come your ban (son) might amar (spoke) to our ban (son), amar (spoke), "What have you to do with Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel)?

For Yahawah nathan (give) made the Yaradan (Jordan) a gabawal (border/boundary) between us and you, you banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and banay (children) of Gad (Gad). You have no chalaq (portion) in Yahawah."' So your banay (children) might shabath (shabath / rest) our banay (children) shabath (shabath / rest) from yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah.
"Therefore we amar (spoke), ‘Let's now ishah (make) to banah (build) ourselves an mazabach (altar), not for burnt ilah (offering), nor for zabach (sacrifice);

But it will be a id (until / as far as) between us and you, and between our dawar (generation / age / period) achar (other) us, that we may perform the ibadah (service) of Yahawah panayam (face) him with our burnt ilah (offerings), with our zabach (sacrifices), and with our shalam (peace) offerings;' that your ban (son) may not amar (spoke) our ban (son) in machar (time) to come, ‘You have no chalaq (portion) in Yahawah.'

"Therefore we amar (spoke), ‘It shall be, when they amar (spoke) us or our dawar (generation / age / period) this in machar (time) to come, that we shall amar (spoke), "raah (see) the thabanayath (pattern) of the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, which our ab (father) ishah (make), not for burnt ilah (offering), nor for zabach (sacrifice); but it is a id (until / as far as) between us and you."'

"Chalayalah (far) be it from us that we should marad (rebel) against Yahawah, and shawab (turn back / repent) away this yawam (day) from achar (other) Yahawah, to banah (build) an mazabach (altar) for burnt ilah (offering), for meal manachah (offering), or for zabach (sacrifice), besides the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah our Alahayam that is panayam (face) his mashakan (tabernacle)!"

When Payanachas (Phinehas) the kahan (priest), and the nashayaay (princes) of the idah (congregation), even the raashay (heads) of the alapay (thousands) of Yashar-Al (Israel) that were with him, shamai (hearken / hear) the dabarayam (words) that the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) and the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh) dabar (word / matter), it yatab (pleased) them well.

Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest) amar (spoke) to the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), to the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), and to the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh), "Today we yadai (know) that Yahawah is in the thawak (midst) of us, because you have not mail (top/above) this mail (top/above) against Yahawah. Az (now) you have natzal (delivered) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) out of the yad (hand) of Yahawah."

Payanachas (Phinehas) the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar) the kahan (priest), and the nashayaayam (princes), shawab (turn back / repent) from the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben), and from the banay (children) of Gad (Gad), out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead), to the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) them dabar (word / matter) again.

The thing yatab (pleased) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) barak (blessed) Alahayam, and amar (spoke) no more of ilah (go up / offer) up against them to tzabaa (troop), to shachath (destroy) the aratz (Earth/land) in which the banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the children of Gad (Gad) lived.
The banay (children) of Raawaban (Reuben) and the banay (children) of Gad (Gad) qaraa (called) the mazabach (altar) "A id (until / as far as) Between Us that Yahawah is Alahayam."

It happened achar (other) many yamayam (days), when Yahawah had given nawach (rest) to Yashar-Al (Israel) from their ayab (enemy) all around, and Yahawashawai (Joshua) was zaqan (old) and well advanced in yamayam (years),

That Yahawashawai (Joshua) qaraa (called) for all Yashar-Al (Israel), for their zaqan (elders) and for their raash (head), and for their shapat (judge / judgement) and for their shatar (officers), and amar (spoke) to them, "I am zaqan (old) and well advanced in yamayam (years).
You raah (see) seen all that Yahawah your Alahayam ishah (make) done to all these gawayam (nations) panayam (face) of you; for it is Yahawah your Alahayam who has lacham (fought) for you.

Raah (see), I napal (fall / be cast down) allotted to you these gawayam (nations) that shaar (remain), to be an nachalah (inheritance) for your shabat (tribes), from the Yaradan (Jordan), with all the gawayam (nations) that I have karath (cut) off, even to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yam (sea/waters) toward the mabawaa (going) down of the sun.

Yahawah your Alahayam will hadap (thrust) them out from panayam (face) you, and yarash (drive) them from out of your panayam (face). You shall yarash (possess) their aratz (Earth/land), as Yahawah your Alahayam dabar (word / matter) to you.

"Therefore be very courageous to shamar (keep/guard) and to ishah (make) all that is kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), that you not sawar (turn) aside from it to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand);

That you not bawaa (come) among these gawayam (nations), these that shaar (remain) among you; neither zakar (remember) mention of the sham (name) of their Alahayam, nor cause to shabai (swear / take oath) by them, neither ibad (servant) them, nor shachah (bow) down yourselves to them;
But hold fast to Yahawah your Alahayam, as you ishah (make) done to this yawam (day).

"For Yahawah has driven gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and itzawam (strong) gawayam (nations) out from panayam (face) you. But as for you, no ayash (man / husband) has imad (stood) panayam (face) you to this yawam (day).
Achad (one) ayash (man / husband) of you shall radap (chase) a alap (thousand); for it is Yahawah your Alahayam who lacham (fights) for you, as he dabar (word / matter) to you.
Take maad (good) shamar (keep/guard) therefore to yourselves, that you ahab (love) Yahawah your Alahayam.

"But if you shawab (turn back / repent) at all shawab (turn back / repent) back, and hold fast to the yathar (remnant) of these gawayam (nations), even these who shaar (remain) among you, and chathan (make) marriages with them, and bawaa (come) in to them, and they to you;

Yadai (know) for a certainty that Yahawah your Alahayam will no yasap (longer) drive these gawayam (nations) from out of your panayam (face); but they shall be a pach (snare / trap) and a mawaqash (trap) to you, a shatat (scourge) in your tzad (sides), and tzananayam (thorns) in your iyan (eye), until you abad (destroy / perish) from off this tawab (good / proper function) adamah (land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given you.

"Behold, today I am halak (move) the darak (way) of all the aratz (Earth/land). You yadai (know) in all your labab (hearts) and in all your napash (soul) that not achad (one) thing napal (fall / be cast down) failed of all the tawab (good / proper function) things which Yahawah your Alahayam dabar (word / matter) concerning you. All bawaa (come) happened to you. Not achad (one) thing napal (fall / be cast down) failed of it.

It shall happen that as all the tawab (good / proper function) things bawaa (come) come on you of which Yahawah your Alahayam dabar (word / matter) to you, so Yahawah will bawaa (come) on you all the rai (evil) things, until he has destroyed you from off this tawab (good / proper function) adamah (land) which Yahawah your Alahayam nathan (give) given you,

When you disobey the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah your Alahayam, which he tzawah (commanded) you, and halak (move) and ibad (servant) other Alahayam, and shachah (bow) down yourselves to them. Then the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah will be charah (hot with anger) against you, and you will abad (destroy / perish) maharah (quickly) from off the tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land) which he nathan (give) given to you."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) asap (gathered) all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to Shakam (Shechem), and qaraa (called) for the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel), for their raash (head), for their shapat (judge / judgement), and for their shatar (officers); and they yatzab (presented) panay (themselves) before Alahayam.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people), "Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), ‘Your ab (father) lived of iwalam (forever) time ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), even Tharach (Terah), the ab (father) of Abaraham (Abraham), and the ab (father) of Nachawar (Nahor): and they ibad (servant) other Alahayam.

I laqach (take / seize) your ab (father) Abaraham (Abraham) from ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and yalak (led) him throughout all the aratz (Earth/land) of Kanain (Canaan), and rabah (multiplied) his zarai (seed), and nathan (give) him Yatzachaq (Isaac).

I nathan (give) to Yatzachaq (Isaac) Yaiqab (Jacob) and Ishaw (Esau): and I nathan (give) to Ishaw (Esau) har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), to yarash (possess) it. Yaiqab (Jacob) and his ban (son) yarad (went) down into Matzarayam (Egypt).

"‘I shalach (send) Mashah (Moses) and Aharawan (Aaron), and I nagap (plagued) Matzarayam (Egypt), according to that which I ishah (make) in its qarab (among / near): and afterward I yatzaa (go out / come out) you out.

I yatzaa (go out / come out) your ab (father) out of Matzarayam (Egypt): and you bawaa (come) to the yam (sea/waters). The Matzarayam (Egyptians) radap (pursued) achar (other) your ab (father) with rakab (chariots) and with horsemen to the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).

When they tzaiq (cried) out to Yahawah, he shawam (place / establish / appoint) maapal (darkness) between you and the Matzaray (Egyptians), and bawaa (come) the yam (sea/waters) on them, and kasah (covered) them; and your iyan (eye) raah (see) what I ishah (make) in Matzarayam (Egypt): and you lived in the madabar (wilderness) many yamayam (days).

"‘I bawaa (come) you into the aratz (Earth/land) of the Amaray (Amorites), that lived ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan): and they lacham (fought) with you; and I nathan (give) them into your yad (hand). You yarash (possessed) their aratz (Earth/land); and I destroyed them from panayam (face) you.

Then Balaq (Balak) the ban (son) of Tzapawar (Zippor), malak (king) of Mawaab (Moab), qawam (rise up) and lacham (fought) against Yashar-Al (Israel). He shalach (send) and qaraa (called) Balaim (Balaam) the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor) to qalal (curse) you;
But I would not shamai (hearken / hear) to Balaim (Balaam); therefore he barak (blessed) you still. So I natzal (delivered) you out of his yad (hand).

"‘You ibar (pass over/through) over the Yaradan (Jordan), and bawaa (come) to Yarayachaw (Jericho). The bailay (men) of Yarayachaw (Jericho) lacham (fought) against you, the Amaray (Amorite), the Parazay (Perizzite), the Kanainay (Canaanite), the Chathay (Hittite), the Garagashay (Girgashite), the Chaway (Hivite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite); and I nathan (give) them into your yad (hand).

I shalach (send) the tzaraih (hornet) panayam (face) you, which garash (drove) them out from panayam (face) you, even the shanayam (two) malakay (kings) of the Amaray (Amorites); not with your charab (sword), nor with your qashath (bow).

I nathan (give) you a aratz (Earth/land) whereon you had not labored, and irayam (cities) which you didn't banah (build), and you live in them. You akal (eat) of karamayam (vineyards) and zayath (olive) groves which you didn't natai (plant).'

"Now therefore yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ibad (servant) him in thamayam (complete / whole) and in amath (truth). Sawar (put) away the Alahayam which your ab (father) ibad (servant) ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), in Matzarayam (Egypt); and ibad (servant) Yahawah.

If it seems rai (evil) to you to ibad (servant) Yahawah, bachar (choose) this yawam (day) whom you will ibad (servant); whether the Alahayam which your ab (father) ibad (servant) that were ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), or the Alahayam of the Amaray (Amorites), in whose aratz (Earth/land) you yashab (inhabit/dwell): but as for me and my bayath (house), we will ibad (servant) Yahawah."
The im (nation / people) inah (answer / respond), "chalayalah (far) be it from us that we should izab (forsake) Yahawah, to ibad (servant) other Alahayam;

For it is Yahawah our Alahayam who brought us and our ab (father) up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), from the bayath (house) of ibad (servant), and who ishah (make) those gadawal (very great/important/mighty) athawath (signs) in our iyan (eye), and shamar (keep/guard) us in all the darak (way) in which we halak (move), and among all the imayam (peoples) qarab (among / near) the midst of whom we ibar (pass over/through).

Yahawah garash (drove) out from panayam (face) us all the imayam (peoples), even the Amaray (Amorites) who lived in the aratz (Earth/land). Therefore we also will ibad (servant) Yahawah; for he is our Alahayam."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), "You can't ibad (servant) Yahawah; for he is a qadawash (holy) Alahayam. He is a qanawaa (jealous) Alahayam. He will not nashaa (lift) your disobedience nor your chataah (sin).

If you izab (forsake) Yahawah, and ibad (servant) foreign Alahayam, then he will shawab (turn back / repent) and do you raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), and kalah (complete / finish) you, achar (other) he has done you yatab (good)."
The im (nation / people) amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "No; but we will ibad (servant) Yahawah."

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to the im (nation / people), "You are witnesses against yourselves that you have bachar (chosen) Yahawah yourselves, to ibad (servant) him." They amar (spoke), "We are witnesses."
"Now therefore sawar (put) away the foreign Alahayam which are qarab (among / near) you, and natah (incline) your labab (heart) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel)."
The im (nation / people) amar (spoke) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), "We will ibad (servant) Yahawah our Alahayam, and we will shamai (hearken / hear) to his qawal (sound / voice)."

So Yahawashawai (Joshua) karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with the im (nation / people) that yawam (day), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) for them a chaq (statute) and an mashapat (ordinance) in Shakam (Shechem).

Yahawashawai (Joshua) kathab (write) these dabarayam (words) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Alahayam; and he laqach (take / seize) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) aban (stone), and qawam (rise up) it up there under the alah (oak / terebinth) that was by the maqadash (sanctuary) of Yahawah.

Yahawashawai (Joshua) amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people), "Behold, this aban (stone) shall be a idah (witness) against us; for it has shamai (hearken / hear) all the amaray (words) of Yahawah which he dabar (word / matter) to us. It shall be therefore a idah (witness) against you, lest you kachash (deny) your Alahayam."
