‘Since the yawam (day) that I brought my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), I bachar (chose) no iyar (city) out of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to banah (build) a bayath (house), that my sham (name) might be there; but I bachar (chose) Dawad (David) to be over my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel).'
"Now it was in the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) my ab (father) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

But Yahawah amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), ‘Whereas it was in your labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name), you tawab (good / proper function) well that it was in your labab (heart).

Raq (concept: what comes out / spittle), you shall not banah (build) the bayath (house); but your ban (son) who shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of your body, he shall banah (build) the bayath (house) for my sham (name).'

Yahawah has qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter) that he dabar (word / matter); for I have qawam (rise up) up in the place of Dawad (David) my ab (father), and I yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter), and have banah (build) the bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

There I have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a maqawam (place) for the arawan (ark), in which is the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, which he karath (cut) with our ab (father), when he yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt)."

Shalamah (Solomon) imad (stood) panayam (face) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah in the nagad (presence) of all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens);

And he amar (spoke), "Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), there is no Alahayam like you, in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mail (top/above), or on aratz (Earth/land) beneath; who shamar (keep/guard) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with your ibad (servant), who halak (move) panayam (face) you with all their lab (heart);

Who have shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you dabar (word / matter) him. Yes, you dabar (word / matter) with your pah (mouth), and malaa (have) fulfilled it with your yad (hand), as it is this yawam (day).

Now therefore, may Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you have dabar (word / matter) him, amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (man / husband) in my panayam (face) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel), if only your ban (son) shamar (keep/guard) heed to their darak (way), to yalak (walk) panayam (face) me as you have halak (move) panayam (face) me.'

"Now therefore, Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), please let your dabar (word / matter) be aman (believe / have faith), which you dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father).

But will Alahayam in very amanam (deed) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the aratz (Earth/land)? Behold, shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) of shamay (heavens) can't kawal (all) you; ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) much less this bayath (house) that I have banah (build)!

Yet have panah (turn) for the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), and for his thachanah (supplication), Yahawah my Alahayam, to shamai (hearken / hear) to the ranah (cry) and to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) palal (prays) panayam (face) you this yawam (day);

That your iyan (eye) may be pathach (open) toward this bayath (house) layal (night) and yawam (day), even toward the maqawam (place) of which you have amar (spoke), ‘My sham (name) shall be there;' to shamai (hearken / hear) to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place).

Shamai (hearken / hear) to the thachanah (supplication) of your ibad (servant), and of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), when they shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place). Yes, shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) maqawam (place); and when you shamai (hearken / hear), salach (forgive/pardon/make clean).

"If a ayash (man / husband) chataa (sins) against his neighbor, and an alah (curse / oath) is laid on him to cause him to alah (swear / adjure), and he bawaa (come) and alah (curse / oath) panayam (face) your mazabach (altar) in this bayath (house);

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and ishah (make), and shapat (judge / judgement) your ibad (servant), rashai (condemning) the rashai (wicked), to nathan (give) his darak (way) on his own raash (head), and justifying the tzadayaq (righteous), to nathan (give) him according to his tzadaqah (righteousness).

"When your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel) are nagap (struck) down panayam (face) the ayab (enemy), because they have chataa (sinned) against you; if they shawab (turn back / repent) again to you, and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and palal (pray) and chanan (showing favor) supplication to you in this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) them again to the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to their ab (father).

"When the sky is itzar (shut) up, and there is no matar (rain), because they have chataa (sinned) against you; if they palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place), and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and shawab (turn back / repent) from their chataah (sin), when you inah (oppress / afflict) them:

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your ibad (servant), and of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), when you yarah (teach) them the tawab (good / proper function) darak (way) in which they should yalak (walk); and nathan (give) matar (rain) on your aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) given to your im (nation / people) for an nachalah (inheritance).

"If there is raib (famine) in the aratz (Earth/land), if there is dabar (word / matter), if there is blight, mildew, arabah (locust) or chasayal (caterpillar); if their ayab (enemy) besieges them in the aratz (Earth/land) of their shair (cities); whatever nagai (plague), whatever machalah (sickness) there is;

Whatever thapalah (prayer) and thachanah (supplication) is made by any adam (man), or by all your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), who shall ayash (man / husband) yadai (know) the nagai (plague) of his own labab (heart), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean), and ishah (make), and nathan (give) to every ayash (man / husband) according to all his darak (ways), whose labab (heart) you yadai (know); (for you, even you only, yadai (know) the labab (hearts) of all the banay (children) of adam (men);)
That they may yaraa (fear / be afraid) you all the yamayam (days) that they chay (life) in the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to our ab (father).

"Moreover concerning the nakaray (foreigner), who is not of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), when he shall bawaa (come) out of a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land) for your sham (name) sake

(For they shall shamai (hearken / hear) of your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name), and of your chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and of your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm)); when he shall bawaa (come) and palal (pray) toward this bayath (house);

Shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and ishah (make) according to all that the nakaray (foreigner) qaraa (called) to you for; that all the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) your sham (name), to yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, as do your imay (people) Yashar-Al (Israel), and that they may yadai (know) that this bayath (house) which I have banah (build) is qaraa (called) by your sham (name).

"If your im (nation / people) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to malachamah (battle) against their ayab (enemy), by whatever way you shall shalach (send) them, and they palal (pray) to Yahawah darak (toward) the iyar (city) which you have bachar (chosen), and toward the bayath (house) which I have banah (build) for your sham (name);
Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) their thapalah (prayer) and their thachanah (supplication), and ishah (make) their cause.

If they chataa (sin) against you (for there is no adam (man) who doesn't chataa (sin)), and you are anap (angry) with them, and nathan (give) them to the ayab (enemy), so that they shabah (carry) them away shabah (captive) to the aratz (Earth/land) of the ayab (enemy), rachawaq (far) off or qarawab (near);

Yet if they shall shawab (turn back / repent) in the aratz (Earth/land) where they are shabah (carried) captive, and shawab (turn back / repent) again, and chanan (showing favor) supplication to you in the aratz (Earth/land) of those who shabah (carried) them captive, amar (spoke), ‘We have chataa (sinned), and have iwah (done) perversely; we have dealt wickedly;'

If they shawab (turn back / repent) to you with all their labab (heart) and with all their napash (soul) in the aratz (Earth/land) of their ayab (enemy), who shabah (carried) them captive, and palal (pray) to you darak (toward) their aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) to their ab (father), the iyar (city) which you have bachar (chosen), and the bayath (house) which I have banah (build) for your sham (name):
Then shamai (hearken / hear) their thapalah (prayer) and their thachanah (supplication) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and ishah (make) their cause;

And salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) your im (nation / people) who have chataa (sinned) against you, and all their pashai (transgressions) in which they have pashai (transgressed) against you; and nathan (give) them racham (show mercy / love) panayam (face) those who shabah (carried) them captive, that they may racham (show mercy / love) compassion on them

(For they are your im (nation / people), and your nachalah (inheritance), which you yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), from the thawak (midst) of the kawar (furnace) of barazal (iron));

That your iyan (eye) may be pathach (open) to the thachanah (supplication) of your ibad (servant), and to the thachanah (supplication) of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), to shamai (hearken / hear) to them whenever they qaraa (called) to you.

For you badal (separated) them from among all the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land), to be your nachalah (inheritance), as you dabar (word / matter) by Mashah (Moses) your ibad (servant), when you yatzaa (go out / come out) our ab (father) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), Adanay Yahawah."

It was so, that when Shalamah (Solomon) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of palal (praying) all this thapalah (prayer) and thachanah (supplication) to Yahawah, he qawam (rise up) from panayam (face) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, from karai (kneeling) on his barak (blessed) with his kap (hands) parash (spread) forth toward shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).
He imad (stood), and barak (blessed) all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice), amar (spoke),

"Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, who nathan (give) given manawachah (rest) to his im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), according to all that he dabar (word / matter). There napal (fall / be cast down) not failed achad (one) dabar (word / matter) of all his tawab (good / proper function) dabar (word / matter), which he dabar (word / matter) by Mashah (Moses) his ibad (servant).
May Yahawah our Alahayam be with us, as he was with our ab (father). Let him not izab (leave) us, nor natash (forsake) us;

That he may natah (incline) our labab (hearts) to him, to yalak (walk) in all his darak (ways), and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his chaq (statute), and his mashapat (ordinances), which he tzawah (commanded) our ab (father).

Let these my dabar (word / matter), with which I chanan (showing favor) made supplication panayam (face) Yahawah, be qarawab (near) to Yahawah our Alahayam yawamam (by day) and qarawab (night), that he may ishah (make) the cause of his ibad (servant), and the cause of his im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), as every yawam (day) shall require;
That all the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) that Yahawah, he is Alahayam. There is none else.

"Let your labab (heart) therefore be shalam (full / whole / complete) with Yahawah our Alahayam, to yalak (walk) in his chaq (statute), and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), as at this yawam (day)."
The malak (king), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, zabach (offered) zabach (sacrifice) panayam (face) Yahawah.

Shalamah (Solomon) zabach (offered) for the zabach (sacrifice) of shalam (peace) offerings, which he zabach (offered) to Yahawah, shanayam (two) and isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) baqar (morning) of cattle, and one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep). So the malak (king) and all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chanak (dedicated) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The same yawam (day) the malak (king) made the thawak (midst) of the chatzar (court) qadash (set apart / make holy) that panayam (face) before the bayath (house) of Yahawah; for there he ishah (make) the burnt ishah (make), and the meal ishah (make), and the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings, because the bronze mazabach (altar) that panayam (face) before Yahawah was too qatan (small / young / least) to kawal (all) the burnt ilah (offering), and the meal manachah (offering), and the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings.

So Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) at that ith (time), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) with him, a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (assembly), from the entrance of Chamath (Hamath) to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt), panayam (face) Yahawah our Alahayam, shabai (seven) yamayam (days) and shabai (seven) yamayam (days), even fourteen yamayam (days).

On the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) he shalach (send) the im (nation / people) shalach (send); and they barak (blessed) the malak (king), and yalak (went) to their ahal (tents) shamach (joyful) and tawab (good / proper function) of lab (heart) for all the goodness that Yahawah ishah (make) shown to Dawad (David) his ibad (servant), and to Yashar-Al (Israel) his im (nation / people).

It happened, when Shalamah (Solomon) kalah (complete / finish) finished the banah (build) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the malak (king) bayath (house), and all Shalamah (Solomon's) chashaq (desire) which he was chapatz (pleased) to ishah (make),
That Yahawah raah (see) to Shalamah (Solomon) the shanay (second) time, as he had raah (see) to him at Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to him, "I have shamai (hearken / hear) your thapalah (prayer) and your thachanah (supplication), that you chanan (showing favor) made panayam (face) me. I chanan (showing favor) made this bayath (house) qadash (set apart / make holy), which you have banah (build), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) there iwalam (forever); and my iyan (eye) and my lab (heart) shall be there yawam (day).

As for you, if you will yalak (walk) panayam (face) me, as Dawad (David) your ab (father) halak (move), in tham (integrity) of labab (heart), and in yashar (upright), to ishah (make) according to all that I have tzawah (commanded) you, and will shamar (keep/guard) my chaq (statute) and my mashapat (ordinances);

Then I will qawam (rise up) the kasaa (throne) of your mamalakah (kingdom) over Yashar-Al (Israel) iwalam (forever), according as I dabar (word / matter) to Dawad (David) your ab (father), amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (man / husband) on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel).'

But if you shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) from achar (other) me, you or your ban (son), and not shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and my chaqah (statutes) which I nathan (give) set panayam (face) you, but shall halak (move) and ibad (servant) other Alahayam, and shachah (worship) them;

Then will I karath (cut) off Yashar-Al (Israel) out of the adamah (land) which I nathan (give) given them; and this bayath (house), which I have made qadash (set apart / make holy) for my sham (name), will I shalach (send) out of my panayam (face); and Yashar-Al (Israel) shall be a mashal (proverb) and a shanayanah (byword) among all imayam (peoples).

Though this bayath (house) is so ilayawan (Ilayawan), yet shall everyone who passes by it be shamam (astonished), and shall sharaq (hiss); and they shall amar (spoke), ‘Why has Yahawah ishah (make) thus to this aratz (Earth/land), and to this bayath (house)?'

And they shall amar (spoke), ‘Because they forsook Yahawah their Alahayam, who yatzaa (go out / come out) their ab (father) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and laid chazaq (hold) of other Alahayam, and shachah (worshiped) them, and ibad (servant) them. Therefore Yahawah bawaa (come) brought all this rai (evil) on them.'"

It happened at the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of isharayam (twenty) shanah (years), in which Shalamah (Solomon) had banah (build) the shanayam (two) bathayam (houses), the bayath (house) of Yahawah and the malak (king) bayath (house)

(Now Chayaram (Hiram) the malak (king) of Tzar (Tyre) had nashaa (lift) Shalamah (Solomon) with araz (cedar) itzay (trees) and barawash (fir) itzay (trees), and with zahab (gold), according to all his chapatz (desire)), that then malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) Chayaram (Hiram) isharayam (twenty) iyar (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Galayal (Galilee).
Chayaram (Hiram) yatzaa (go out / come out) out from Tzar (Tyre) to raah (see) the irayam (cities) which Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) given him; and they didn't yashar (upright) him.
He amar (spoke), "What irayam (cities) are these which you nathan (give) given me, my ach (brother/kinsman)?" He qaraa (called) them the aratz (Earth/land) of Kabawal (Cabul) to this yawam (day).
Chayaram (Hiram) shalach (send) to the malak (king) one maah (hundred) twenty kakar (talents) of zahab (gold).

This is the dabar (word / matter) of the mas (levy) which malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer), to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and his own bayath (house), and Malawaa (Millo), and the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and Chatzawar (Hazor), and Magadawan (Megiddo), and Gazar (Gezer).

Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) had ilah (go up / offer) up, and lakad (taken) Gazar (Gezer), and burnt it with ash (fire), and harag (kill) the Kanainay (Canaanites) who lived in the iyar (city), and nathan (give) it for a portion to his banath (daughter), Shalamah (Solomon's) ayashah (woman / wife).
Shalamah (Solomon) banah (build) Gazar (Gezer), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) the thachathawan (lower),
And Bailath (Baalath), and Thamar (Tamar) in the madabar (wilderness), in the aratz (Earth/land),

And all the storage iray (cities) that Shalamah (Solomon) had, and the iray (cities) for his rakab (chariots), and the iray (cities) for his horsemen, and that which Shalamah (Solomon) chashaq (desired) to banah (build) for his pleasure in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in Labanawan (Lebanon), and in all the aratz (Earth/land) of his mamashalah (dominion).

As for all the im (nation / people) who were yathar (left) of the Amaray (Amorites), the Chathay (Hittites), the Parazay (Perizzites), the Chaway (Hivites), and the Yabawasay (Jebusites), who were not of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel);

Their banay (children) who were yathar (left) achar (other) them in the aratz (Earth/land), whom the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) were not yakal (able) utterly to charam (destroy), of them Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) a mas (levy) of bondservants to this yawam (day).

But of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) no ibad (servant); but they were the banay (men) of malachamah (war), and his ibad (servant), and his sharay (princes), and his shalayash (captains), and sharay (rulers) of his rakab (chariots) and of his horsemen.

These were the shar (prince / ruler) natzabayam (officers) who were over Shalamah (Solomon's) malaakah (work), chamash (five) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty), who radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) rule over the im (nation / people) who labored in the malaakah (work).

But Paraih (Pharaoh's) banath (daughter) ilah (go up / offer) up out of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) to her bayath (house) which Solomon had banah (build) for her: then he banah (build) Malawaa (Millo).

Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) and shalam (peace) offerings on the mazabach (altar) which he banah (build) to Yahawah shalawash (three) paimayam (times) a shanah (year), qatar (burning) incense with them, on the mazabach (altar) that panayam (face) before Yahawah. So he shalam (finished) the bayath (house).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) a anay (navy) of ships in Itzayawanagabar (Ezion Geber), which is beside Ayalawath (Eloth), on the shapah (shore) of the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Adawam (Edom).
Chayaram (Hiram) shalach (send) in the anay (navy) his ibaday (servants), sailors who had yadai (knowledge) of the yam (sea/waters), with the ibaday (servants) of Shalamah (Solomon).

They bawaa (come) to Awapayar (Ophir), and laqach (take / seize) from there zahab (gold), arabai (four) maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty) kakar (talents), and bawaa (come) it to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon).

When the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) shamai (hearken / hear) of the shamai (fame) of Shalamah (Solomon) concerning the sham (name) of Yahawah, she bawaa (come) to nasah (prove) him with chayadah (hard) questions.

She bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with a very kabad (great) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), with gamalayam (camels) that nashaa (lift) bashamayam (spices), and very much zahab (gold), and yaqar (precious) aban (stone); and when she bawaa (come) come to Shalamah (Solomon), she dabar (word / matter) with him of all that was in her labab (heart).
Shalamah (Solomon) nagad (told) her all her dabar (word / matter): there was not anything ilam (hidden) from the malak (king) which he didn't nagad (tell) her.
When the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) raah (see) seen all the chakamah (wisdom) of Shalamah (Solomon), and the bayath (house) that he had banah (build),

And the maakal (food) of his shalachan (table), and the mawashab (sitting) of his ibad (servant), and the maimad (attendance) of his sharath (ministers), and their clothing, and his cup bearers, and his ilah (ascent) by which he ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah; there was no more rawach (spirit / wind) in her.

She amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "It was a amath (truth) dabar (word / matter) that I shamai (hearken / hear) in my own aratz (Earth/land) of your dabar (word / matter), and of your chakamah (wisdom).

However I didn't aman (believe / have faith) the dabarayam (words), until I bawaa (come), and my iyan (eye) raah (see) seen it. Behold, the chatzay (half) was not nagad (told) me! Your chakamah (wisdom) and tawab (good / proper function) yasap (exceed) the shamawaih (fame) which I shamai (hearken / hear).
Ashar (who/that) are your ayash (man / husband), ashar (who/that) are these your ibad (servant), who imad (stand) continually panayam (face) you, who shamai (hearken / hear) your chakamah (wisdom).

Barak (blessed) is Yahawah your Alahayam, who chapatz (delighted) in you, to nathan (give) you on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel). Because Yahawah ahabah (loved) Yashar-Al (Israel) iwalam (forever), therefore shawam (place / establish / appoint) he you malak (king), to ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness)."

She nathan (give) the malak (king) one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold), and of bashamayam (spices) very rabah (great) store, and yaqar (precious) aban (stone). There bawaa (come) no more such rab (abundance) of bashamayam (spices) as these which the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) nathan (give) to malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon).

The anay (navy) also of Chayaram (Hiram), that nashaa (lift) zahab (gold) from Awapayar (Ophir), bawaa (come) in from Awapayar (Ophir) maad (great) rabah (plenty) of alamagayam (almug) itzay (trees) and yaqar (precious) aban (stone).

The malak (king) ishah (make) of the alamagayam (almug) itzay (trees) masaid (pillars) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for the malak (king) bayath (house), kanarawath (harps) also and stringed instruments for the singers: there bawaa (come) no such alamagayam (almug) itzay (trees), nor were raah (see), to this yawam (day).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) to the malakah (queen) of Shabaa (Sheba) all her chapatz (desire), whatever she shaal (asked), besides that which Shalamah (Solomon) nathan (give) her of his malak (king) yad (hand). So she panah (turn), and yalak (went) to her own aratz (Earth/land), she and her ibad (servant).

Now the mashaqal (weight) of zahab (gold) that bawaa (come) to Shalamah (Solomon) in achad (one) shanah (year) was shash (six) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - shash (six) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold),

Besides that which the traders brought, and the masachar (traffic) of the rakalayam (merchants), and of all the malakay (kings) of the mixed people, and of the pachawath (governors) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) two maah (hundred) tzanah (bucklers) of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold); shash (six) maah (hundred) shekels of zahab (gold) ilah (go up / offer) to achad (one) tzanah (buckler).

He made shalawash (three) maah (hundred) maganayam (shields) of shachat (beaten) zahab (gold); shalawash (three) minas of zahab (gold) ilah (go up / offer) to achad (one) magan (shield): and the malak (king) nathan (give) them in the bayath (house) of the yair (forest) of Labanawan (Lebanon).
Moreover the malak (king) ishah (make) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kasaa (throne) of shan (ivory), and overlaid it with the finest zahab (gold).

There were shash (six) mailawath (steps) to the kasaa (throne), and the raash (head) of the kasaa (throne) was igal (round) achar (other); and there were yadath (stays) on either side by the maqawam (place) of the shabath (shabath / rest), and shanayam (two) arayawath (lions) imad (standing) beside the yadath (stays).
Shanayam (two) arayayam (lions) imad (stood) there on the one side and on the other on the shash (six) mailawath (steps): there was nothing kan (for sure) it ishah (make) in any mamalakah (kingdom).

All malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon's) mashaqah (drinking) kalay (vessels) were of zahab (gold), and all the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of the yair (forest) of Labanawan (Lebanon) were of sagar (pure) zahab (gold): none were of kasap (silver); it was maawamah (nothing) chashab (accounted) of in the yamay (days) of Shalamah (Solomon).

For the malak (king) had at yam (sea/waters) a anay (navy) of Tharashayash (Tarshish) with the anay (navy) of Chayaram (Hiram): achad (one) every shalawash (three) shanayam (years) bawaa (come) the anay (navy) of Tharashayash (Tarshish), nashaa (lift) zahab (gold), and kasap (silver), shanahabayam (ivory), and qapayam (apes), and thakayayam (peacocks).
So malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) gadal (exceeded) all the malakay (kings) of the aratz (Earth/land) in riches and in chakamah (wisdom).
All the aratz (Earth/land) baqash (sought) the presence of Shalamah (Solomon), to shamai (hearken / hear) his chakamah (wisdom), which Alahayam nathan (give) put in his lab (heart).

They bawaa (come) every ayash (man / husband) his tribute, kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver), and kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold), and clothing, and armor, and bashamayam (spices), sawasayam (horses), and paradayam (mules), a dabar (word / matter) shanah (year) by shanah (year).

Shalamah (Solomon) asap (gathered) together rakab (chariots) and horsemen: and he had a alap (thousand) and arabai (four) maah (hundred) rakab (chariots), and shanayam (two) alap (thousand) horsemen, that he nachah (bestowed) in the rakab (chariot) iray (cities), and with the malak (king) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) nathan (give) kasap (silver) to be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as abanayam (stones), and arazayam (cedars) nathan (give) he to be as the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that are in the lowland, for rab (abundance).

The sawasayam (horses) which Shalamah (Solomon) had were mawatzaa (brought) out of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the malak (king) sacharay (merchants) laqach (take / seize) them in droves, each drove at a machayar (price).

A marakabah (chariot) ilah (go up / offer) up and yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) for shash (six) maah (hundred) shekels of kasap (silver), and a sawas (horse) for one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty); and so for all the malakay (kings) of the Chathay (Hittites), and for the malakay (kings) of Aram (Syria), they yatzaa (go out / come out) them out by their yad (hand).

Now malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) ahab (love) many foreign nashayam (women), together with the banath (daughter) of Paraih (Pharaoh), women of the Mawaabay (Moabites), Imawanay (Ammonites), Adawamay (Edomites), Tzayadanay (Sidonians), and Chathay (Hittites);

Of the gawayam (nations) concerning which Yahawah amar (spoke) to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), "You shall not bawaa (come) among them, neither shall they bawaa (come) among you; for akan (surely) they will natah (turn) away your labab (heart) achar (other) their Alahayam." Shalamah (Solomon) dabaq (joined) to these in ahabah (love).
He had shabai (seven) maah (hundred) wives, princesses, and shalawash (three) maah (hundred) palagashayam (concubines); and his wives natah (turned) away his lab (heart).

For it happened, when Shalamah (Solomon) was zaqanah (old), that his wives natah (turned) away his labab (heart) achar (other) other Alahayam; and his labab (heart) was not shalam (full / whole / complete) with Yahawah his Alahayam, as was the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) his ab (father).

For Shalamah (Solomon) yalak (went) achar (other) Ishatharath (Ashtoreth) the goddess of the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), and achar (other) Malakam (Milcom) the shaqawatz (abomination) of the Imawanay (Ammonites).
Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and didn't malaa (go) fully achar (other) Yahawah, as did Dawad (David) his ab (father).

Then Shalamah (Solomon) banah (build) a bamah (high) place for Kamawash (Chemosh) the shaqawatz (abomination) of Mawaab (Moab), on the har (mountain) that is panayam (face) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and for Malak (Molech) the shaqawatz (abomination) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon).
So he ishah (make) for all his foreign wives, who burnt qatar (incense) and zabach (sacrificed) to their Alahayam.
Yahawah was anap (angry) with Shalamah (Solomon), because his labab (heart) was natah (turned) away from Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), who had raah (see) to him paim (twice),
And had tzawah (commanded) him dabar (word / matter) this thing, that he should not yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam: but he didn't shamar (keep/guard) that which Yahawah tzawah (commanded).

Therefore Yahawah amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon), "Because this is done by you, and you have not shamar (keep/guard) my barayath (covenant) and my chaqah (statutes), which I have tzawah (commanded) you, I will qarai (surely) qarai (tear) the mamalakah (kingdom) from you, and will nathan (give) it to your ibad (servant).
Notwithstanding I will not ishah (make) it in your yawam (day), for Dawad (David) your ab (father) sake; but I will qarai (tear) it out of the yad (hand) of your ban (son).

However I will not qarai (tear) away all the mamalakah (kingdom); but I will nathan (give) achad (one) shabat (tribe) to your ban (son), for Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) sake, and for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem's) sake which I have bachar (chosen)."
Yahawah qawam (rise up) up an shatan (adversary) to Shalamah (Solomon), Hadad (Hadad) the Adawamay (Edomite): he was of the malak (king) zarai (seed) in Adawam (Edom).

For it happened, when Dawad (David) was in Adawam (Edom), and Yawaab (Joab) the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) was ilah (go up / offer) up to qabar (bury) the chalal (slain), and had struck every zakar (remember) in Adawam (Edom)
(For Yawaab (Joab) and all Yashar-Al (Israel) yashab (inhabit/dwell) there shash (six) chadashayam (months), until he had karath (cut) off every zakar (remember) in Adawam (Edom));

That Adad (Hadad) barach (fled), he and ayash (man / husband) Adawamay (Edomites) of his ab (father) ibaday (servants) with him, to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt), Hadad (Hadad) being yet a qatan (small / young / least) nair (child).

They qawam (rise up) out of Madayan (Midian), and bawaa (come) to Paaran (Paran); and they laqach (take / seize) anashayam (men) with them out of Paaran (Paran), and they bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt), to Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), who nathan (give) him a bayath (house), and amar (spoke) him lacham (food), and nathan (give) him aratz (Earth/land).

Hadad (Hadad) matzaa (found) maad (great) favor in the iyan (eye) of Paraih (Pharaoh), so that he nathan (give) him as ayashah (woman / wife) the achawath (sister) of his own ayashah (woman / wife), the achawath (sister) of Thachapanayas (Tahpenes) the gabayarah (queen).

The achawath (sister) of Thachapanayas (Tahpenes) yalad (birth / begot) him Ganabath (Genubath) his ban (son), whom Thachapanayas (Tahpenes) weaned in Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house); and Ganabath (Genubath) was in Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house) thawak (midst) the banay (sons) of Paraih (Pharaoh).

When Hadad (Hadad) shamai (hearken / hear) in Matzarayam (Egypt) that Dawad (David) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and that Yawaab (Joab) the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) was mawath (death), Hadad (Hadad) amar (spoke) to Paraih (Pharaoh), "shalach (send) me depart, that I may yalak (go) to my own aratz (Earth/land)."

Then Paraih (Pharaoh) amar (spoke) to him, "But what chasar (have) you lacked with me, that behold, you baqash (seek) to yalak (go) to your own aratz (Earth/land)?" He amar (spoke), "Nothing, however only shalach (send) me depart."

Alahayam qawam (rise up) up an shatan (adversary) to him, Razawan (Rezon) the ban (son) of Alayadai (Eliada), who had barach (fled) from his Adawan Hadadaizar (Hadadezer) malak (king) of Tzawabaa (Zobah).

He qabatz (gathered) anashayam (men) to him, and became shar (prince / ruler) over a gadawad (troop), when Dawad (David) harag (kill) them of Zobah: and they yalak (went) to Damashaq (Damascus), and lived therein, and malak (king) in Damashaq (Damascus).

He was an shatan (adversary) to Yashar-Al (Israel) all the yamay (days) of Shalamah (Solomon), besides the rai (mischief) of Hadad (Hadad): and he qawatz (abhorred) Yashar-Al (Israel), and malak (king) over Aram (Syria).

Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), an Aparathay (Ephraimite) of Tzaradah (Zeredah), a ibad (servant) of Shalamah (Solomon), whose am (mother) sham (name) was Tzarawaih (Zeruah), a alamanah (widow), he also rawam (will lift up) up his yad (hand) against the malak (king).

This was the dabar (word / matter) why he rawam (will lift up) up his yad (hand) against the malak (king): Shalamah (Solomon) banah (build) Malawaa (Millo), and sagar (repaired) the breach of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father).

The ayash (man / husband) Yarabaim (Jeroboam) was a ayash (man / husband) man of valor; and Shalamah (Solomon) raah (see) the nair (young) man that he was ishah (make), and he put him in paqad (visit) of all the sabal (labor) of the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph).

It happened at that ith (time), when Yarabaim (Jeroboam) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite) matzaa (found) him in the darak (way); now Ahijah had kasah (clad) himself with a chadash (new) shalamah (dress / garment); and they shanayam (two) were alone in the shadah (field).
Achayah (Ahijah) thapash (laid) hold of the chadash (new) shalamah (dress / garment) that was on him, and qarai (tore) it in shanayam (two) qaraiyam (pieces).

He amar (spoke) to Yarabaim (Jeroboam), "laqach (take / seize) ishar (ten) qaraiyam (pieces); for thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), ‘Behold, I will qarai (tear) the mamalakah (kingdom) out of the yad (hand) of Shalamah (Solomon), and will nathan (give) ishar (ten) shabatayam (tribes) to you

(But he shall have achad (one) shabat (tribe), for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake and for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem's) sake, the iyar (city) which I have bachar (chosen) out of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel));

Because that they have forsaken me, and have shachah (worshiped) Ishatharath (Ashtoreth) the goddess of the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), Kamawash (Chemosh) the Alahayam of Mawaab (Moab), and Malakam (Milcom) the Alahayam of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon). They have not halak (move) in my darak (ways), to ishah (make) that which is yashar (upright) in my iyan (eye), and to keep my chaqah (statutes) and my mashapat (ordinances), as Dawad (David) his ab (father) did.

"‘However I will not laqach (take / seize) the whole mamalakah (kingdom) out of his yad (hand); but I will shayath (put / appoint / make) him nashayaa (prince) all the yamay (days) of his chay (life), for Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) sake whom I bachar (chose), who shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and my chaqah (statutes);
But I will laqach (take / seize) the malawakah (kingdom) out of his ban (son) yad (hand), and will nathan (give) it to you, even ishar (ten) shabatayam (tribes).

To his ban (son) will I nathan (give) achad (one) shabat (tribe), that Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) may have a nayar (lamp) yamayam (always) panayam (face) me in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the iyar (city) which I have bachar (chosen) me to shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) there.
I will laqach (take / seize) you, and you shall malak (king) according to all that your napash (soul) awah (desires), and shall be malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel).

It shall be, if you will shamai (hearken / hear) to all that I tzawah (command) you, and will halak (move) in my darak (ways), and ishah (make) that which is yashar (upright) in my iyan (eye), to shamar (keep/guard) my chaqah (statutes) and my matzawah (commandments), as Dawad (David) my ibad (servant) ishah (make); that I will be with you, and will banah (build) you a aman (believe / have faith) bayath (house), as I banah (build) for Dawad (David), and will nathan (give) Yashar-Al (Israel) to you.
I will for this inah (oppress / afflict) the zarai (seed) of Dawad (David), but not yawam (day).'"

Shalamah (Solomon) baqash (sought) therefore to mawath (death) Yarabaim (Jeroboam); but Yarabaim (Jeroboam) qawam (rise up), and barach (fled) into Matzarayam (Egypt), to Shayashaq (Shishak) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and was in Matzarayam (Egypt) until the mawath (death) of Shalamah (Solomon).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Shalamah (Solomon), and all that he ishah (make), and his chakamah (wisdom), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (acts) of Shalamah (Solomon)?
The yawam (day) that Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) over all Yashar-Al (Israel) was arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years).
Shalamah (Solomon) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father): and Rachabaim (Rehoboam) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Rachabaim (Rehoboam) yalak (went) to Shakam (Shechem): for all Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) come to Shakam (Shechem) to make him malak (king).

It happened, when Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat) shamai (hearken / hear) of it (for he was yet in Matzarayam (Egypt), where he had barach (fled) from the panayam (face) of malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon), and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) lived in Matzarayam (Egypt),

And they shalach (send) and qaraa (called) him), that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come), and dabar (word / matter) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam), amar (spoke),

"Your ab (father) qashah (rough / hard) our il (over) qashah (rough / hard): now therefore make you the qashah (rough / hard) ibadah (service) of your ab (father), and his kabad (heavy) il (over) which he nathan (give) on us, lighter, and we will ibad (servant) you."
He amar (spoke) to them, "Depart for shalawash (three) yamayam (days), then shawab (turn back / repent) back to me." The im (nation / people) departed.

Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) took yaitz (counsel) with the zaqan (old) men, who had imad (stood) panayam (face) Shalamah (Solomon) his ab (father) while he yet chay (life), amar (spoke), "What yaitz (counsel) do you give me to shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to this im (nation / people)?"

They dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), "If you will be a ibad (servant) to this im (nation / people) this yawam (day), and will ibad (servant) them, and inah (answer / respond) them, and dabar (word / matter) tawab (good / proper function) dabarayam (words) to them, then they will be your ibadayam (servants) yawam (day)."

But he forsook the itzah (counsel) of the zaqan (old) men which they had yaitz (given) him, and took yaitz (counsel) with the yalad (birth / begot) men who had gadal (grown) up with him, who imad (stood) panayam (face) him.

He amar (spoke) to them, "What yaitz (counsel) do you give, that we may return dabar (word / matter) to this im (nation / people), who have dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke), ‘qalal (make) the il (over) that your ab (father) nathan (give) on us lighter?'"

The yalad (birth / begot) men who had gadal (grown) up with him dabar (word / matter) to him, amar (spoke), "Thus you shall amar (spoke) this im (nation / people) who amar (spoke) to you, amar (spoke), ‘Your ab (father) kabad (made) our il (over) kabad (heavy), but qalal (make) it lighter to us;' you shall dabar (word / matter) to them, ‘My qatan (small / young / least) finger is ibah (thicker) than my ab (father) waist.

Now whereas my ab (father) imas (burdened) you with a kabad (heavy) il (over), I will yasap (add) to your il (over): my ab (father) yasar (chastised) you with shawatayam (whips), but I will yasar (chastise) you with iqarabayam (scorpions).'"

So Yarabaim (Jeroboam) and all the im (nation / people) bawaa (come) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the shalayashay (third) yawam (day), as the malak (king) asked, amar (spoke), "shawab (turn back / repent) to me again the shalayashay (third) yawam (day)."
The malak (king) inah (answer / respond) the im (nation / people) qashah (rough / hard), and forsook the itzah (counsel) of the zaqan (old) men which they had yaitz (given) him,

And dabar (word / matter) to them according to the itzah (counsel) of the yalad (birth / begot) men, amar (spoke), "My ab (father) kabad (made) your il (over) kabad (heavy), but I will yasap (add) to your il (over). My ab (father) yasar (chastised) you with shawatayam (whips), but I will yasar (chastise) you with iqarabayam (scorpions)."

So the malak (king) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the im (nation / people); for it was a thing brought about of Yahawah, that he might qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter), which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite) to Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat).

When all Yashar-Al (Israel) raah (see) that the malak (king) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to them, the im (nation / people) dabar (word / matter) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "What chalaq (portion) have we in Dawad (David)? Neither do we have an nachalah (inheritance) in the ban (son) of Yashay (Jesse). To your ahal (tents), Yashar-Al (Israel)! Now raah (see) to your own bayath (house), Dawad (David)." So Yashar-Al (Israel) departed to their ahal (tents).
But as for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) who lived in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) over them.

Then malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) shalach (send) Adaram (Adoram), who was over the men subject to forced mas (labor); and all Yashar-Al (Israel) ragam (stoned) him to mawath (death) with aban (stone). Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) amatz (made) speed to ilah (go up / offer) him up to his marakabah (chariot), to nawas (flee) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
So Yashar-Al (Israel) pashai (rebelled) against the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) to this yawam (day).

It happened, when all Yashar-Al (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) was shawab (turn back / repent), that they shalach (send) and qaraa (called) him to the idah (congregation), and made him malak (king) over all Yashar-Al (Israel): there was none who achar (other) the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), but the shabat (tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah) only.

When Rachabaim (Rehoboam) bawaa (come) come to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), he qahal (assembled) all the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the shabat (tribe) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), a maah (hundred) and shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) men, who were ishah (make), to lacham (fight) against the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to shawab (turn back / repent) the malawakah (kingdom) again to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon).
But the dabar (word / matter) of Alahayam came to Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, amar (spoke),

"Amar (spoke) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to all the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and to the yathar (rest) of the im (nation / people), amar (spoke),

‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "You shall not ilah (go up / offer) up, nor lacham (fight) against your ach (brother/kinsman), the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel). Everyone shawab (turn back / repent) to his bayath (house); for this thing is of me."'" So they shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and shawab (turn back / repent) and went their yalak (way), according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

Then Yarabaim (Jeroboam) banah (build) Shakam (Shechem) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim), and lived in it; and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out from there, and banah (build) Panawaal (Penuel).
Yarabaim (Jeroboam) amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), "Now the mamalakah (kingdom) will shawab (turn back / repent) to the bayath (house) of Dawad (David).

If this im (nation / people) ilah (go up / offer) up to ishah (make) zabachayam (sacrifices) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), then the lab (heart) of this im (nation / people) will shawab (turn back / repent) again to their Adawan, even to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and they will harag (kill) me, and shawab (turn back / repent) to Rachabaim (Rehoboam) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)."

Whereupon the malak (king) took yaitz (counsel), and ishah (make) shanayam (two) calves of zahab (gold); and he amar (spoke) to them, "It is rab (too) much for you to ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Look and see your Alahayam, Yashar-Al (Israel), which ilah (go up / offer) you up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt)!"
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) the achad (one) in Bayath-Al (Bethel), and the other nathan (give) he in Dan (Dan).
This thing became a chataah (sin); for the im (nation / people) yalak (went) to worship panayam (face) the achad (one), even to Dan (Dan).
He ishah (make) bayath (house) of bamah (high) places, and ishah (make) kahanayam (priests) from among all the im (nation / people), who were not of the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi).

Yarabaim (Jeroboam) ordained a chag (feast/festival) in the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month), on the fifteenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month), like the chag (feast/festival) that is in Yahawadah (Judah), and he ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar); he ishah (make) so in Bayath-Al (Bethel), zabach (sacrificing) to the calves that he ishah (make) made: and he imad (placed) in Bayath-Al (Bethel) the kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places that he ishah (make) made.

He ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar) which he ishah (make) made in Bayath-Al (Bethel) on the fifteenth yawam (day) in the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month), even in the chadash (month) which he had badaa (devised) of his own heart: and he ordained a chag (feast/festival) for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar), to qatar (burn) incense.

Behold, there bawaa (come) a ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam out of Yahawadah (Judah) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Bayath-Al (Beth El): and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) was imad (standing) by the mazabach (altar) to qatar (burn) incense.

He qaraa (called) against the mazabach (altar) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and amar (spoke), "mazabach (altar), mazabach (altar), thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: ‘Behold, a ban (son) shall be yalad (birth / begot) to the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), Yaashayah (Josiah) by sham (name). On you he shall zabach (sacrifice) the kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places who qatar (burn) incense on you, and they will sharap (burn) adam (men's) itzamawath (bones) on you.'"

He nathan (give) a mawapath (sign) the same yawam (day), amar (spoke), "This is the mawapath (sign) which Yahawah has dabar (word / matter): Behold, the mazabach (altar) will be split apart, and the ashes that are on it will be shapak (poured) out."

It happened, when the malak (king) shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, which he qaraa (called) against the mazabach (altar) in Bayath-Al (Bethel), that Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shalach (send) out his yad (hand) from the mazabach (altar), amar (spoke), "Seize him!" His yad (hand), which he shalach (send) out against him, yabash (dry land) up, so that he yakal (could) not shawab (turn back / repent) it back again to himself.

The mazabach (altar) also was split apart, and the ashes shapak (poured) out from the mazabach (altar), according to the mawapath (sign) which the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam nathan (give) given by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

The malak (king) inah (answer / respond) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, "Now entreat the favor of Yahawah your Alahayam, and chalah (afflict) for me, that my yad (hand) may be shawab (turn back / repent) me again." The ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam entreated Yahawah, and the malak (king) yad (hand) was shawab (turn back / repent) him again, and became as it was raashawan (before).
The malak (king) dabar (word / matter) to the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, "bawaa (come) bayath (house) with me, and said (refresh) yourself, and I will nathan (give) you a reward."

The ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "Even if you nathan (give) me chatzay (half) of your bayath (house), I would not bawaa (come) in with you, neither would I akal (eat) lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) in this maqawam (place);

For so was it tzawah (commanded) me by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), ‘You shall akal (eat) no lacham (bread), nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters), neither shawab (turn back / repent) by the darak (way) that you halak (move).'"
So he yalak (went) achar (other) darak (way), and didn't shawab (turn back / repent) by the darak (way) that he bawaa (come) to Bayath-Al (Bethel).

Now there lived an zaqan (old) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) in Bayath-Al (Bethel); and one of his ban (son) bawaa (come) and sapar (book) him all the maishah (works) that the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam ishah (make) done that yawam (day) in Bayath-Al (Bethel). They also dabar (word / matter) their malak (king) the dabarayam (words) which he had sapar (book) to the ab (father).

Their ab (father) dabar (word / matter) to them, "Which darak (way) did he halak (move)?" Now his ban (son) raah (see) seen which darak (way) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam halak (move), who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah).
He amar (spoke) to his ban (son), "chabash (saddle) the donkey for me." So they chabash (saddled) the donkey for him; and he rakab (rode) on it.

He yalak (went) achar (other) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, and matzaa (found) him sitting under an alah (oak / terebinth). He amar (spoke) to him, "Are you the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah)?" He amar (spoke), "I am."
Then he amar (spoke) to him, "yalak (come) bayath (house) with me, and akal (eat) lacham (bread)."

He amar (spoke), "I may not shawab (turn back / repent) with you, nor bawaa (come) in with you; neither will I akal (eat) lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) with you in this maqawam (place).

For it was dabar (word / matter) to me by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, ‘You shall akal (eat) no lacham (bread) nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) there, nor shawab (turn back / repent) again to yalak (go) by the darak (way) that you halak (move).'"

He amar (spoke) to him, "I also am a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) as you are; and an malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) dabar (word / matter) to me by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), ‘shawab (turn back / repent) him back with you into your bayath (house), that he may akal (eat) lacham (bread) and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters).'" He lied to him.
So he shawab (turn back / repent) back with him, and akal (eat) lacham (bread) in his bayath (house), and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters).
It happened, as they yashab (inhabit/dwell) at the shalachan (table), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who shawab (turn back / repent) him back;

And he qaraa (called) to the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), "Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘yain (because) you have been marah (disobedient) to the pah (mouth) of Yahawah, and have not shamar (keep/guard) the matzawah (commandment) which Yahawah your Alahayam tzawah (commanded) you,

But shawab (turn back / repent) back, and have akal (eat) lacham (bread) and shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters) in the maqawam (place) of which he dabar (word / matter) to you, "akal (eat) no lacham (bread), and shathah (drinks) no mayam (Waters);" your nabalah (body) shall not bawaa (come) to the tomb of your ab (father).'"

It happened, achar (other) he had akal (eat) lacham (bread), and achar (other) he had shathah (drinks), that he chabash (saddled) the donkey for the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) whom he had shawab (turn back / repent) back.

When he had yalak (gone), a aray (lion) matzaa (met) him by the darak (way), and mawath (death) him. His nabalah (body) was shalak (cast) in the darak (way), and the donkey imad (stood) by it. The aray (lion) also imad (stood) by the nabalah (body).

Behold, anashayam (men) ibar (pass over/through) by, and raah (see) the nabalah (body) shalak (cast) in the darak (way), and the aray (lion) imad (standing) by the nabalah (body); and they bawaa (come) and dabar (word / matter) it in the iyar (city) where the zaqan (old) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) lived.

When the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who shawab (turn back / repent) him back from the darak (way) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, he amar (spoke), "It is the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam who was marah (disobedient) to the pah (mouth) of Yahawah. Therefore Yahawah nathan (give) delivered him to the aray (lion), which has mauled him and mawath (death) him, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) to him."
He dabar (word / matter) to his ban (son), amar (spoke), "chabash (saddle) the donkey for me." They chabash (saddled) it.

He yalak (went) and matzaa (found) his nabalah (body) shalak (cast) in the darak (way), and the donkey and the aray (lion) imad (standing) by the nabalah (body). The aray (lion) had not akal (eat) the nabalah (body), nor mauled the donkey.

The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) nashaa (lift) up the nabalah (body) of the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, and yanach (laid) it on the donkey, and shawab (turn back / repent) it back. He bawaa (come) to the iyar (city) of the zaqan (old) nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to sapad (mourn), and to qabar (bury) him.
He yanach (laid) his nabalah (body) in his own qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher); and they sapad (mourned) over him, saying, "haway (Alas/Woe!), my ach (brother/kinsman)!"

It happened, achar (other) he had qabar (bury) him, that he amar (spoke) to his ban (son), amar (spoke), "When I am mawath (death), then qabar (bury) me in the tomb in which the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam is qabar (bury). Yanach (lay) my itzam (bones) beside his itzam (bones).

For the dabar (word / matter) which he qaraa (called) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah against the mazabach (altar) in Bayath-Al (Bethel), and against all the bathay (houses) of the bamah (high) places which are in the iray (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria), will surely happen."

Achar (other) this thing Yarabaim (Jeroboam) didn't shawab (turn back / repent) from his rai (evil) darak (way), but again ishah (make) kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places from among all the im (nation / people). Whoever wanted to, he malaa (consecrated) him, that there might be kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places.
This thing became chataah (sin) to the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), even to kachad (cut) it off, and to shamad (destroy) it from off the surface of the adamah (earth).
At that ith (time) Abayah (Abijah) the ban (son) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) chalah (afflict) sick.

Yarabaim (Jeroboam) amar (spoke) to his ayashah (woman / wife), "Please qawam (rise up) up and shanah (disguise) yourself, that you won't be recognized as the ayashah (woman / wife) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam). Halak (move) to Shayalah (Shiloh). Behold, there is Achayah (Ahijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who dabar (word / matter) concerning me that I should be malak (king) over this im (nation / people).
Laqach (take / seize) with you ishar (ten) loaves, and cakes, and a jar of dabash (honey), and bawaa (come) to him. He will nagad (tell) you what will become of the nair (child)."

Yarabaim (Jeroboam's) ayashah (woman / wife) ishah (make) so, and qawam (rise up), and yalak (went) to Shayalah (Shiloh), and bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Achayah (Ahijah). Now Achayah (Ahijah) yakal (could) not raah (see); for his iyan (eye) were qawam (rise up) by reason of his shayab (age).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to Achayah (Ahijah), "Behold, the ayashah (woman / wife) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) bawaa (come) to darash (inquire) of you dabar (word / matter) her ban (son); for he is chalah (afflict). Zah (this / that / these) and thus you shall dabar (word / matter) her; for it will be, when she bawaa (come) in, that she will pretend to be nakar (another) woman."

It was so, when Achayah (Ahijah) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of her ragal (feet / foot), as she bawaa (come) in at the pathach (door), that he amar (spoke), "bawaa (come) in, you ayashah (woman / wife) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam)! Why do you pretend to be nakar (another)? For I am shalach (send) to you with qashah (rough / hard) news.

Yalak (go), amar (spoke) Yarabaim (Jeroboam), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): "yain (because) I rawam (will lift up) you from thawak (midst) the im (nation / people), and nathan (give) you nagayad (prince) over my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel),

And qarai (tore) the mamalakah (kingdom) away from the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), and nathan (give) it you; and yet you have not been as my ibad (servant) Dawad (David), who shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments), and who halak (move) me with all his labab (heart), to ishah (make) that only which was yashar (upright) in my iyan (eye),

But ishah (make) done raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) above all who were panayam (face) you, and have yalak (gone) and ishah (make) you other Alahayam, and masakah (molten) images, to provoke me to kais (anger), and have shalak (cast) me achar (other) your gaw (back):

Therefore, behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and will karath (cut) off from Yarabaim (Jeroboam) everyone who urinates on a qayar (wall), he who is itzar (shut) up and he who is izab (left) at large in Yashar-Al (Israel), and will utterly sweep bair (away) the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), as a man sweeps bair (away) galal (dung), until it is thamam (all) gone.

He who mawath (death) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) in the iyar (city) shall the kalabayam (dogs) akal (eat); and he who mawath (death) in the shadah (field) shall the iwap (flying) of the sky akal (eat): for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it."'
Qawam (rise up) therefore, and yalak (go) to your bayath (house). When your ragal (feet / foot) bawaa (come) into the iyar (city), the yalad (birth / begot) shall mawath (death).

All Yashar-Al (Israel) shall sapad (mourn) for him, and qabar (bury) him; for he only of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shall bawaa (come) to the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher), because in him there is matzaa (found) some tawab (good / proper function) thing toward Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), in the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam).
Moreover Yahawah will qawam (rise up) him up a malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel), who shall karath (cut) off the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam). This is yawam (day)! What? Even now.

For Yahawah will nakah (strike) Yashar-Al (Israel), as a qanah (reed) is nawad (shaken) in the mayam (Waters); and he will nathash (root) up Yashar-Al (Israel) out of this tawab (good / proper function) adamah (land) which he nathan (give) to their ab (father), and will zarah (scatter) them ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), because they ishah (make) made their Asharah (Asherim), provoking Yahawah to kais (anger).

He will nathan (give) Yashar-Al (Israel) up galal (because) of the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), which he has chataa (sinned), and with which he has made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin)."

Yarabaim (Jeroboam's) ayashah (woman / wife) qawam (rise up), and departed, and bawaa (come) to Tharatzah (Tirzah). As she bawaa (come) to the sap (threshold) of the bayath (house), the nair (child) mawath (death).

All Yashar-Al (Israel) qabar (bury) him, and sapad (mourned) for him, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) Achayah (Ahijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).

The yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), how he lacham (warred), and how he malak (king), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

The yamayam (days) which Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) were shanayam (two) and isharayam (twenty) shanah (years): and he shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and Nadab (Nadab) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Rachabaim (Rehoboam) the ban (son) of Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) in Yahawadah (Judah). Rachabaim (Rehoboam) was arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king), and he malak (king) seventeen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the iyar (city) which Yahawah had bachar (chosen) out of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) his sham (name) there: and his am (mother) sham (name) was Naimah (Naamah) the imawanayath (ammonitess).

Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and they qanaa (jealous) him to jealousy with their chataah (sin) which they chataa (committed), above all that their ab (father) ishah (make) done.
For they also banah (build) them bamah (high) places, and matzabawath (pillars), and Asharah (Asherim), on every gabah (high) gabaih (hill), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree);

And there were also qadash (set apart / make holy) in the aratz (Earth/land): they ishah (make) according to all the thawaibath (abominations) of the gawayam (nations) which Yahawah yarash (drove) out panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

It happened in the chamayashay (fifth) shanah (year) of malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam), that Shayashaq (Shishak) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And he laqach (take / seize) away the atzarawath (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the atzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house); he even laqach (take / seize) away all: and he laqach (take / seize) away all the maganay (shields) of zahab (gold) which Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made.

Malak (king) Rachabaim (Rehoboam) ishah (make) in their place maganay (shields) of nachashath (brass), and paqad (visit) them to the yad (hand) of the sharay (captains) of the rawatz (guard), who shamar (keep/guard) the pathach (door) of the malak (king) bayath (house).

It was so, that as often as the malak (king) bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the rawatz (guard) nashaa (lift) them, and shawab (turn back / repent) them back into the rawatz (guard) room.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Rachabaim (Rehoboam), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
There was malachamah (war) between Rachabaim (Rehoboam) and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) yawam (day).

Rachabaim (Rehoboam) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Naimah (Naamah) the imawanayath (ammonitess). Abayam (Abijam) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Now in the eighteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat) began Abayam (Abijam) to malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah).
He malak (king) shalawash (three) shanayam (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Maikah (Maacah) the banath (daughter) of Abayashalawam (Abishalom).

He yalak (walked) in all the chataawath (sins) of his ab (father), which he ishah (make) done panayam (face) him; and his labab (heart) was not shalam (full / whole / complete) with Yahawah his Alahayam, as the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) his ab (father).

Nevertheless for Dawad (David's) sake, Yahawah his Alahayam nathan (give) him a nayar (lamp) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to qawam (rise up) up his ban (son) achar (other) him, and to imad (establish) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

Because Dawad (David) ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, and didn't sawar (turn) aside from anything that he tzawah (commanded) him all the yamay (days) of his chay (life), except only in the dabar (word / matter) of Awarayah (Uriah) the Chathay (Hittite).
Now there was malachamah (war) between Rachabaim (Rehoboam) and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) all the yamay (days) of his chay (life).

The yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Abayam (Abijam), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)? There was malachamah (war) between Abayam (Abijam) and Yarabaim (Jeroboam).
Abayam (Abijam) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Asaa (Asa) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
In the isharayam (twenty) shanah (year) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) began Asaa (Asa) to malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah).
He malak (king) arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Maikah (Maacah) the banath (daughter) of Abayashalawam (Abishalom).
Asaa (Asa) ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, as did Dawad (David) his ab (father).
He ibar (pass over/through) away the qadashayam (sodomites) out of the aratz (Earth/land), and sawar (removed) all the galalayam (idols) that his ab (father) ishah (make) made.

Also Maikah (Maacah) his am (mother) he sawar (removed) from being gabayarah (queen), because she ishah (make) made an abominable mapalatzath (image) for an Asharah (Asherah); and Asaa (Asa) karath (cut) down her mapalatzath (image), and burnt it at the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).
But the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: nevertheless the labab (heart) of Asaa (Asa) was shalam (full / whole / complete) with Yahawah all his yawam (day).

He bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah the things that his ab (father) had qadash (set apart / make holy), and the things that himself had qadash (set apart / make holy), kasap (silver), and zahab (gold), and kalayam (vessels).
There was malachamah (war) between Asaa (Asa) and Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) all their yawam (day).

Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up against Yahawadah (Judah), and banah (build) Ramah (Ramah), that he might not allow anyone to yatzaa (go out / come out) out or bawaa (come) in to Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Then Asaa (Asa) laqach (take / seize) all the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) that were yathar (left) in the awatzarawath (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the awatzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), and nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of his ibad (servant); and malak (king) Asaa (Asa) shalach (send) them to Banahadad (Ben Hadad), the ban (son) of Tabaramawan (Tabrimmon), the ban (son) of Chazayawan (Hezion), malak (king) of Aram (Syria), who lived at Damashaq (Damascus), amar (spoke),

"There is a treaty between me and you, between my ab (father) and your ab (father). Behold, I have shalach (send) to you a shachad (present) of kasap (silver) and zahab (gold). Yalak (go), parar (break) your treaty with Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that he may depart from me."

Banahadad (Ben Hadad) shamai (hearken / hear) to malak (king) Asaa (Asa), and shalach (send) the sharay (captains) of his chayalayam (armies) against the iray (cities) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and nakah (struck) Iyawan (Ijon), and Dan (Dan), and Abalabayathamaikah (Abel Beth Maacah), and all Kanarawath (Chinneroth), with all the aratz (Earth/land) of Napathalay (Naphtali).
It happened, when Baishaa (Baasha) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, that he chadal (left) off banah (build) Ramah (Ramah), and lived in Tharatzah (Tirzah).

Then malak (king) Asaa (Asa) shamai (hearken / hear) a proclamation to all Yahawadah (Judah); none was naqay (exempted): and they nashaa (lift) away the abanay (stones) of Ramah (Ramah), and its itz (timber), with which Baishaa (Baasha) had banah (build); and malak (king) Asaa (Asa) banah (build) therewith Gabai (Geba) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), and Matzapah (Mizpah).

Now the yathar (rest) of all the dabaray (acts) of Asaa (Asa), and all his gabawarah (might), and all that he ishah (make), and the irayam (cities) which he banah (build), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)? But in the ith (time) of his zaqanah (old) age he was chalah (afflict) in his ragal (feet / foot).

Asaa (Asa) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father); and Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Nadab (Nadab) the ban (son) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) began to malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) shanayam (two) shanathayam (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of his ab (father), and in his chataah (sin) with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).

Baishaa (Baasha) the ban (son) of Achayah (Ahijah), of the bayath (house) of Yashashakar (Issachar), qashar (conspired) against him; and Baishaa (Baasha) nakah (struck) him at Gabathawan (Gibbethon), which belonged to the Palashathay (Philistines); for Nadab (Nadab) and all Yashar-Al (Israel) were tzawar (laying) siege to Gabathawan (Gibbethon).
Even in the shalawash (three) shanah (year) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Baishaa (Baasha) mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

It happened that, as soon as he was malak (king), he nakah (struck) all the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam): he didn't shaar (leave) to Yarabaim (Jeroboam) any who nashamah (breathing thing), until he had destroyed him; according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) Achayah (Ahijah) the Shayalawanay (Shilonite);

For the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) which he chataa (sinned), and with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin), because of his kais (provocation) with which he provoked Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to kais (anger).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Nadab (Nadab), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?
There was malachamah (war) between Asaa (Asa) and Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) all their yawam (day).

In the shalawash (three) shanah (year) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Baishaa (Baasha) the ban (son) of Achayah (Ahijah) began to malak (king) over all Yashar-Al (Israel) in Tharatzah (Tirzah) for isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, and yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and in his chataah (sin) with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Chananay (Hanani) against Baishaa (Baasha), amar (spoke),

"Because I rawam (will lift up) you out of the ipar (dust), and nathan (give) you nagayad (prince) over my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), and you have yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and have made my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin), to provoke me to kais (anger) with their chataah (sin);

Behold, I will utterly sweep bair (away) Baishaa (Baasha) and his bayath (house); and I will nathan (give) your bayath (house) like the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat).

The kalabayam (dogs) will akal (eat) Baishaa (Baasha's) descendants who mawath (death) in the iyar (city); and he who mawath (death) of his in the shadah (field) the iwap (flying) of the sky will akal (eat)."

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Baishaa (Baasha), and what he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?
Baishaa (Baasha) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in Tharatzah (Tirzah); and Alah (Elah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Moreover by the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Chananay (Hanani) came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah against Baishaa (Baasha), and against his bayath (house), both because of all the rai (evil) that he ishah (make) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger) with the maishah (work) of his yad (hand), in being like the bayath (house) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and because he nakah (struck) him.

In the isharayam (twenty) - shash (six) shanah (year) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Alah (Elah) the ban (son) of Baishaa (Baasha) began to malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) in Tharatzah (Tirzah) for two shanathayam (years).

His ibad (servant) Zamaray (Zimri), shar (prince / ruler) of machatzayath (half) his rakab (chariots), qashar (conspired) against him. Now he was in Tharatzah (Tirzah), shathah (drinks) himself shakawar (drunk) in the bayath (house) of Aratzaa (Arza), who was over the bayath (house) in Tharatzah (Tirzah):

And Zamaray (Zimri) bawaa (come) in and nakah (struck) him, and mawath (death) him, in the isharayam (twenty) - shabai (seven) shanah (year) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and malak (king) in his place.

It happened, when he began to malak (king), as soon as he yashab (inhabit/dwell) on his kasaa (throne), that he nakah (struck) all the bayath (house) of Baishaa (Baasha): he didn't shaar (leave) him a single shathan (one) who urinates on a qayar (wall), neither of his relatives, nor of his rai (neigbor/another person).

Thus Zamaray (Zimri) destroyed all the bayath (house) of Baishaa (Baasha), according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) against Baishaa (Baasha) by Yahawaa (Jehu) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy),

For all the chataawath (sins) of Baishaa (Baasha), and the chataawath (sins) of Alah (Elah) his ban (son), which they chataa (sinned), and with which they made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin), to provoke Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to kais (anger) with their habal (vanities).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Alah (Elah), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?
