The ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam was qatzap (angry) with him, and amar (spoke), "You should have nakah (struck) chamash (five) or shash (six) paimayam (times). Then you would have nakah (struck) Aram (Syria) until you kalah (complete / finish) consumed it, whereas now you shall nakah (strike) Aram (Syria) just shalawash (three) times."
Alayashai (Elisha) mawath (death), and they qabar (bury) him. Now the gadawaday (bands) of the Mawaab (Moabites) bawaa (come) the aratz (Earth/land) at the bawaa (come) in of the shanah (year).

It happened, as they were qabar (bury) a ayash (man / husband), that raah (see), they spied a gadawad (band); and they shalak (cast) the ayash (man / husband) into the tomb of Alayashai (Elisha): and as soon as the ayash (man / husband) nagai (touched) the itzamawath (bones) of Alayashai (Elisha), he chayah (revived), and qawam (rise up) up on his ragal (feet / foot).
Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) lachatz (oppressed) Yashar-Al (Israel) all the yamay (days) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz).

But Yahawah was gracious to them, and racham (show mercy / love) compassion on them, and had panah (turn) to them, main (because) of his barayath (covenant) with Abaraham (Abraham), Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yaiqab (Jacob), and would not shachath (destroy) them, neither shalak (cast) he them from his panayam (face) as yet.
Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) mawath (death); and Banahadad (Benhadad) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yahawaash (Jehoash) the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) laqach (take / seize) again out of the yad (hand) of Banahadad (Benhadad) the ban (son) of Chazaal (Hazael) the irayam (cities) which he had laqach (take / seize) out of the yad (hand) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) his ab (father) by malachamah (war). Yawaash (Joash) nakah (struck) him shalawash (three) paimayam (times), and shawab (turn back / repent) the irayam (cities) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Yawaash (Joash) ban (son) of Yawaachaz (Joahaz) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) began Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to malak (king).

He was twenty-five shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) twenty-nine shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yahawaidayan (Jehoaddin) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, yet not like Dawad (David) his ab (father): he ishah (make) according to all that Yawaash (Joash) his ab (father) ishah (make) done.
However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: the im (nation / people) still zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places.
It happened, as soon as the mamalakah (kingdom) was chazaq (established) in his yad (hand), that he nakah (killed) his ibad (servant) who had nakah (slain) the malak (king) his ab (father):

But the banay (children) of the makayam (murderers) he didn't put to mawath (death); according to that which is kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded), amar (spoke), "The abawath (fathers) shall not be put to mawath (death) for the banay (children), nor the banay (children) be put to mawath (death) for the abawath (fathers); but every ayash (man / husband) shall mawath (death) for his own chataa (sin)."

He nakah (killed) of Adawam (Edom) in the gayaa (valley) of malach (salt) ishar (ten) alap (thousand), and thapash (took) salai (sela) by malachamah (war), and qaraa (called) its sham (name) Yaqathaal (Joktheel), to this yawam (day).

Then Amatzayah (Amaziah) shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers) to Yahawaash (Jehoash), the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) ban (son) of Yahawaa (Jehu), malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "yalak (come), raah (see) us look one another in the panayam (face)."

Yahawaash (Jehoash) the malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shalach (send) to Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), "The chawach (thistle) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) shalach (send) to the araz (cedar) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon), amar (spoke), ‘nathan (give) your banath (daughter) to my ban (son) as ayashah (woman / wife). Then a shadah (wild) animal that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) ibar (pass over/through) by, and ramas (trampled) down the chawach (thistle).

You have nakah (indeed) nakah (struck) Adawam (Edom), and your lab (heart) has nashaa (lift) you up. Enjoy the glory of it, and stay at bayath (house); for why should you garah (meddle) to your rai (harm), that you should napal (fall / be cast down), even you, and Yahawadah (Judah) with you?'"

But Amatzayah (Amaziah) would not shamai (hearken / hear). So Yahawaash (Jehoash) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up; and he and Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) raah (see) one another in the panayam (face) at Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), which belongs to Yahawadah (Judah).
Yahawadah (Judah) was defeated by Yashar-Al (Israel); and they nawas (fled) every ayash (man / husband) to his ahal (tent).

Yahawaash (Jehoash) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) thapash (took) Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), the ban (son) of Yahawaash (Jehoash) the ban (son) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), at Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and paratz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the shair (gate) of Aparayam (Ephraim) to the panah (corner / cornerstone) shair (gate), arabai (four) maah (hundred) amah (cubits).

He laqach (take / seize) all the zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), and all the kalayam (vessels) that were matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the atzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), the hostages also, and shawab (turn back / repent) to Shamarawan (Samaria).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yahawaash (Jehoash) which he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might), and how he lacham (fought) with Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?

Yahawaash (Jehoash) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in Shamarawan (Samaria) with the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) chayah (lived) achar (other) the mawath (death) of Yahawaash (Jehoash) ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Amatzayah (Amaziah), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

They made a qashar (conspiracy) against him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and he nawas (fled) to Lakayash (Lachish): but they shalach (send) achar (other) him to Lakayash (Lachish), and mawath (death) him there.
They nashaa (lift) him on sawasayam (horses); and he was qabar (bury) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David).

All the im (nation / people) of Yahawadah (Judah) laqach (take / seize) Izarayah (Azariah), who was sixteen shanah (years) ban (son), and made him malak (king) in the place of his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah).
He banah (build) Ayalawath (Elath), and shawab (turn back / repent) it to Yahawadah (Judah), achar (other) that the malak (king) shakab (slept) with his ab (father).

In the fifteenth shanah (year) of Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) began to malak (king) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for arabaiyam (forty) - achad (one) shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) from all the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).

He shawab (turn back / repent) the gabawal (border/boundary) of Yashar-Al (Israel) from the entrance of Chamath (Hamath) to the yam (sea/waters) of the irabah (arabah), according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) Yawanah (Jonah) the ban (son) of Amathay (Amittai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who was of Gathahachapar (Gath Hepher).

For Yahawah raah (see) the inay (affliction) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that it was very marah (bitter); for there was apas (none) itzar (shut) up nor izab (left) at large, neither was there any helper for Yashar-Al (Israel).

Yahawah didn't dabar (word / matter) that he would machah (blot) out the sham (name) of Yashar-Al (Israel) from under the sky; but he yashai (salvation) them by the yad (hand) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam), and all that he ishah (make), and his gabawarah (might), how he lacham (warred), and how he shawab (turn back / repent) Damashaq (Damascus), and Chamath (Hamath), which had belonged to Yahawadah (Judah), for Yashar-Al (Israel), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?
Yarabaim (Jeroboam) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), even with the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and Zakarayah (Zechariah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the twenty - seventh shanah (year) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) began Izarayah (Azariah) ban (son) of Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to malak (king).

Sixteen shanah (years) ban (son) was he when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yakalayah (Jecoliah) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah) ishah (make) done.
However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: the im (nation / people) still zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places.

Yahawah nagai (struck) the malak (king), so that he was a tzarai (leper) to the yawam (day) of his mawath (death), and lived in a separate bayath (house). Yawatham (Jotham) the malak (king) ban (son) was over the bayath (house), shapat (judge / judgement) the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Izarayah (Azariah), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

Izarayah (Azariah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and they qabar (bury) him with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eighth) shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) shash (six) chadashayam (months).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as his ab (father) ishah (make) done: he didn't sawar (depart) from the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).

Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Yabash (Jabesh) qashar (conspired) against him, and nakah (struck) him qabal (before) the im (nation / people), and mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

This was the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which he dabar (word / matter) to Yahawaa (Jehu), amar (spoke), "Your banay (sons) to the rabayaiy (fourth) generation shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel)." So it came to pass.

Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Yabash (Jabesh) began to malak (king) in the shalawashayam (thirty) - thashai (nine) shanah (year) of Izayah (Uzziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he malak (king) for a yarach (month) in Shamarawan (Samaria).

Manacham (Menahem) the ban (son) of Gaday (Gadi) ilah (go up / offer) up from Tharatzah (Tirzah), and bawaa (come) to Shamarawan (Samaria), and nakah (struck) Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Yabash (Jabesh) in Shamarawan (Samaria), and mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Shalawam (Shallum), and his qashar (conspiracy) which he made, behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Then Manacham (Menahem) nakah (struck) Thapasach (Tiphsah), and all who were therein, and its gabawal (border/boundary), from Tharatzah (Tirzah): because they didn't pathach (open) to him, therefore he nakah (struck) it; and all the harah (women) therein who were with child he baqai (ripped) up.

In the shalawashayam (thirty) thashai (nine) shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Manacham (Menahem) the ban (son) of Gaday (Gadi) began to malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) for ishar (ten) shanayam (years) in Shamarawan (Samaria).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) all his yawam (day) from the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).

There bawaa (come) against the aratz (Earth/land) Pawal (Pul) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria); and Manacham (Menahem) nathan (give) Pawal (Pul) one alap (thousand) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), that his yad (hand) might be with him to chazaq (confirm) the mamalakah (kingdom) in his yad (hand).

Manacham (Menahem) yatzaa (go out / come out) the kasap (money) of Yashar-Al (Israel), even of all the gabawar (mighty) men of wealth, of achad (one) ayash (man / husband) chamashayam (fifty) shaqalayam (shekels) of kasap (silver), to nathan (give) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). So the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shawab (turn back / repent) back, and didn't imad (stay) there in the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Manacham (Menahem), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?
Manacham (Menahem) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Paqachayah (Pekahiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the fiftieth shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) Paqachayah (Pekahiah) the ban (son) of Manacham (Menahem) began to malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for two shanathayam (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) from the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).

Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah), his shalayash (captain), qashar (conspired) against him, and nakah (struck) him in Shamarawan (Samaria), in the aramawan (castle) of the malak (king) bayath (house), with Aragab (Argob) and Arayah (Arieh); and with him were chamashayam (fifty) ayash (man / husband) of the Gileadites: and he mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Paqachayah (Pekahiah), and all that he ishah (make), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

In the chamashayam (fifty)- shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Izarayah (Azariah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) began to malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) in Shamarawan (Samaria) for isharayam (twenty) shanah (years).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah: he didn't sawar (depart) from the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), with which he made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin).

In the yamay (days) of Paqach (Pekah) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) Thagalathapalaasar (Tiglath Pileser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and laqach (take / seize) Iyawan (Ijon), and Abalabayathamaikah (Abel Beth Maacah), and Yanawach (Janoah), and Qadash (Kedesh), and Chatzawar (Hazor), and Galaid (Gilead), and Galayal (Galilee), all the aratz (Earth/land) of Napathalay (Naphtali); and he galah (carried) them captive to Ashawar (Assyria).

Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Alah (Elah) made a qashar (conspiracy) against Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah), and nakah (struck) him, and mawath (death) him, and malak (king) in his place, in the isharayam (twenty) shanah (year) of Yawatham (Jotham) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Paqach (Pekah), and all that he ishah (make), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) began Yawatham (Jotham) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) to malak (king).

He was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yarawashaa (Jerusha) the banath (daughter) of Tzadawaq (Zadok).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah; he ishah (make) according to all that his ab (father) Izayah (Uzziah) ishah (make) done.

However the bamah (high) places were not sawar (taken) away: the im (nation / people) still zabach (sacrificed) and qatar (burned) incense in the bamah (high) places. He banah (build) the ilayawan (Ilayawan) shair (gate) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yawatham (Jotham), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

In those yamayam (days) Yahawah chalal (began) to shalach (send) against Yahawadah (Judah) Ratzayan (Rezin) the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah).

Yawatham (Jotham) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) his ab (father): and Achaz (Ahaz) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
In the seventeenth shanah (year) of Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) Achaz (Ahaz) the ban (son) of Yawatham (Jotham) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) began to malak (king).

Isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) was Achaz (Ahaz) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he didn't do that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah his Alahayam, like Dawad (David) his ab (father).

But he yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel), yes, and made his ban (son) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire), according to the thaibawath (abominations) of the gawayam (nations), whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out from panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
He zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places, and on the gabaiwath (hills), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree).

Then Ratzayan (Rezin) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) and Paqach (Pekah) ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to malachamah (war): and they tzawar (besieged) Achaz (Ahaz), but yakal (could) not lacham (overcome) him.

At that ith (time) Ratzayan (Rezin) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) shawab (turn back / repent) Ayalawath (Elath) to Aram (Syria), and nashal (drove) the Yahawaday (Jews) from Ayalawath (Elath); and the Arawamay (Syrians) bawaa (come) to Ayalawath (Elath), and lived there, to this yawam (day).

So Achaz (Ahaz) shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers) to Thagalathapalaasar (Tiglath Pileser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), amar (spoke), "I am your ibad (servant) and your ban (son). Ilah (go up / offer) up, and yashai (salvation) me out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Aram (Syria), and out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), who qawam (rise up) up against me."

Achaz (Ahaz) laqach (take / seize) the kasap (silver) and zahab (gold) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the atzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), and shalach (send) it for a shachad (present) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shamai (hearken / hear) to him; and the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up against Damashaq (Damascus), and thapash (took) it, and galah (carried) its people captive to Qayar (Kir), and mawath (death) Ratzayan (Rezin).

Malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) yalak (went) to Damashaq (Damascus) to qaraah (meet) Thagalathapalaasar (Tiglath Pileser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and raah (see) the mazabach (altar) that was at Damashaq (Damascus); and malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) shalach (send) to Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) the damawath (fashion) of the mazabach (altar), and its thabanayath (pattern), according to all its workmanship.

Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) banah (build) an mazabach (altar): according to all that malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) had shalach (send) from Damashaq (Damascus), so Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) ishah (make) it for the bawaa (come) of malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) from Damashaq (Damascus).

When the malak (king) bawaa (come) come from Damashaq (Damascus), the malak (king) raah (see) the mazabach (altar): and the malak (king) qarab (come close) near to the mazabach (altar), and ilah (go up / offer) on it.

He burnt his burnt ilah (offering) and his meal manachah (offering), and nasak (poured) his drink nasak (offering), and zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) of his shalam (peace) offerings, on the mazabach (altar).

The bronze mazabach (altar), which panayam (face) before Yahawah, he qarab (come close) from the panayam (face) of the bayath (house), from between his mazabach (altar) and the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nathan (give) it on the tzapawan (north) yarak (side) of his mazabach (altar).

Malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) tzawah (commanded) Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest), amar (spoke), "On the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mazabach (altar) qatar (burn) the baqar (morning) burnt ilah (offering), and the irab (evening) meal manachah (offering), and the malak (king) burnt ilah (offering), and his meal manachah (offering), with the burnt ilah (offering) of all the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), and their meal manachah (offering), and their drink nasak (offerings); and zaraq (sprinkle) on it all the dam (blood) of the burnt ilah (offering), and all the dam (blood) of the zabach (sacrifice); but the bronze mazabach (altar) shall be for me to baqar (morning) by."
Awarayah (Urijah) the kahan (priest) ishah (make) so, according to all that malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) tzawah (commanded).

Malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) qatzatz (cut) off the panels of the makanawath (bases), and sawar (removed) the basin from off them, and yarad (took) down the yam (sea/waters) from off the bronze oxen that were under it, and nathan (give) it on a maratzapath (pavement) of aban (stone).

The covered way for the shabath (shabath / rest) that they had banah (build) in the bayath (house), and the malak (king) mabawaa (entry) outside, sabab (turned) he to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, panayam (face) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Achaz (Ahaz) which he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
Achaz (Ahaz) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Achaz (Ahaz) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Alah (Elah) began to malak (king) in Shamarawan (Samaria) over Yashar-Al (Israel) for thashai (nine) shanayam (years).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, yet not as the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel) who were panayam (face) him.
Against him ilah (go up / offer) up Shalamanaasar (Shalmaneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria); and Hawashai (Hoshea) became his ibad (servant), and shawab (turn back / repent) him tribute.

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) matzaa (found) qashar (conspiracy) in Hawashai (Hoshea); for he had shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers) to So malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and ilah (go up / offer) no tribute to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), as he had done shanah (year) by shanah (year): therefore the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) itzar (shut) him up, and asar (bound) him in bayath (house).

Then the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up throughout all the aratz (Earth/land), and ilah (go up / offer) up to Shamarawan (Samaria), and tzawar (besieged) it shalawash (three) shanayam (years).

In the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) lakad (took) Shamarawan (Samaria), and galah (carried) Yashar-Al (Israel) away to Ashawar (Assyria), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) them in Chalach (Halah), and on the Chabawar (Habor), the nahar (river) of Gawazan (Gozan), and in the iray (cities) of the Maday (Medes).

It was so, because the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) had chataa (sinned) against Yahawah their Alahayam, who ilah (go up / offer) them up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) from under the yad (hand) of Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and had yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam,

And yalak (walked) in the chaqawath (statutes) of the gawayam (nations), whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out from panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel), which they ishah (make).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chapaa (did) secretly things that were not right against Yahawah their Alahayam: and they banah (build) them bamah (high) places in all their iyar (cities), from the magadal (tower) of the watchmen to the fortified iyar (city);
And they natzab (set) them up matzabawath (pillars) and Asharah (Asherim) on every gabah (high) gabaih (hill), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree);

And there they burnt qatar (incense) in all the bamah (high) places, as did the gawayam (nations) whom Yahawah galah (carried) away panayam (face) them; and they ishah (make) rai (wicked) things to provoke Yahawah to kais (anger);
And they ibad (servant) galalayam (idols), of which Yahawah had amar (spoke) to them, "You shall not ishah (make) this thing."

Yet Yahawah iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to Yashar-Al (Israel), and to Yahawadah (Judah), by every nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and every chazah (seer), amar (spoke), "shawab (turn back / repent) from your rai (evil) darak (ways), and shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and my chaqah (statutes), according to all the thawarah (instruction) which I tzawah (commanded) your ab (father), and which I shalach (send) to you by my ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets)."
Notwithstanding, they would not shamai (hearken / hear), but hardened their irap (neck), like the irap (neck) of their ab (father), who didn't aman (believe / have faith) in Yahawah their Alahayam.

They maas (rejected) his chaq (statute), and his barayath (covenant) that he karath (cut) with their ab (father), and his idawath (testimonies) which he iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to them; and they yalak (followed) habal (vanity), and habal (became) vain, and achar (other) the gawayam (nations) that were around them, concerning whom Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) them that they should not ishah (make) like them.

They forsook all the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah their Alahayam, and ishah (make) them masakah (molten) images, even shanayam (two) calves, and ishah (make) an Asharah (Asherah), and shachah (worshiped) all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and ibad (servant) Bail (Baal).

They caused their ban (son) and their banath (daughter) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire), and used qasam (divination) and yanachashaw (enchantments), and makar (sold) themselves to ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).
Therefore Yahawah was very anap (angry) with Yashar-Al (Israel), and sawar (removed) them out of his panayam (face): there was none shaar (left) but the shabat (tribe) of Yahawadah (Judah) only.
Also Yahawadah (Judah) didn't shamar (keep/guard) the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah their Alahayam, but yalak (walked) in the chaqawath (statutes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) which they ishah (make).

Yahawah maas (rejected) all the zarai (seed) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and inah (oppress / afflict) them, and nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of shasayam (spoilers), until he had shalak (cast) them out of his panayam (face).

For he qarai (tore) Yashar-Al (Israel) from the bayath (house) of Dawad (David); and they made Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat) malak (king): and Yarabaim (Jeroboam) nadah (drove) Yashar-Al (Israel) from achar (other) Yahawah, and made them chataa (sin) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) chataah (sin).
The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) yalak (walked) in all the chataawath (sins) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) which he ishah (make); they didn't sawar (depart) from them;

Until Yahawah sawar (removed) Yashar-Al (Israel) out of his panayam (face), as he dabar (word / matter) by all his ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets). So Yashar-Al (Israel) was galah (carried) away out of their own adamah (land) to Ashawar (Assyria) to this yawam (day).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come) men from Babal (Babylon), and from Kawath (Cuthah), and from Iwah (Avva), and from Chamath (Hamath) and Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) them in the iray (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria) instead of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and they yarash (possessed) Shamarawan (Samaria), and lived in the iray (cities) of it.

So it was, at the thachalah (beginning) of their yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, that they didn't yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah: therefore Yahawah shalach (send) arayawath (lions) among them, which harag (kill) some of them.

Therefore they amar (spoke) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), amar (spoke), "The gawayam (nations) which you have galah (carried) away, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the iray (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria), don't yadai (know) the mashapat (law) of the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land). Therefore he has shalach (send) arayawath (lions) among them, and behold, they mawath (death) them, because they don't yadai (know) the mashapat (law) of the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land)."

Then the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) tzawah (commanded), amar (spoke), "yalak (carry) there achad (one) of the kahanayam (priests) whom you galah (brought) from there; and yalak (let) them go and yashab (inhabit/dwell) there, and let him yarah (teach) them the mashapat (law) of the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land)."

So achad (one) of the kahanayam (priests) whom they had galah (carried) away from Shamarawan (Samaria) bawaa (come) and lived in Bayath-Al (Bethel), and yarah (taught) them how they should yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah.

However every gaway (heathen / nation) ishah (make) Alahayam of their own, and yanach (put) them in the bayath (house) of the bamah (high) places which the Shamaranay (Samaritans) ishah (make) made, every gaway (heathen / nation) in their iyar (cities) in which they lived.

The anashay (men) of Babal (Babylon) ishah (make) Sakawathabanawath (Succoth Benoth), and the anashay (men) of Kawath (Cuth) ishah (make) Naragal (Nergal), and the anashay (men) of Chamath (Hamath) ishah (make) Ashayamaa (Ashima),

And the Avvites ishah (make) Nabachaz (Nibhaz) and Tharathaq (Tartak); and the saparawayam (sepharvites) burnt their ban (son) in the ash (fire) to Adaramalak (Adrammelech) and Inamalak (Anammelech), the Alahayam of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim).

So they yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ishah (make) to them from among themselves kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places, who ishah (make) for them in the bayath (house) of the bamah (high) places.
They yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ibad (servant) their own Alahayam, after the mashapat (ways) of the gawayam (nations) from among whom they had been galah (carried) away.

To this yawam (day) they ishah (make) what they did raashawan (before): they don't yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, neither ishah (make) they follow their chaqah (statutes), or their mashapatayam (ordinances), or the thawarah (instruction) or the matzawah (commandment) which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) the banay (children) of Yaiqab (Jacob), whom he shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yashar-Al (Israel);

With whom Yahawah had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant), and tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), "You shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam, nor shachah (bow) yourselves to them, nor ibad (servant) them, nor zabach (sacrifice) to them;

But you shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, who ilah (go up / offer) you up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and with an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm), and you shall shachah (bow) yourselves to him, and you shall zabach (sacrifice) to him.

The chaqayam (statutes) and the mashapatayam (ordinances), and the thawarah (instruction) and the matzawah (commandment), which he kathab (write) for you, you shall shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) forevermore. You shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam.
You shall not shakach (forget) the barayath (covenant) that I have karath (cut) with you; neither shall you yaraa (fear / be afraid) other Alahayam.
But you shall yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah your Alahayam; and he will natzal (deliver) you out of the yad (hand) of all your ayab (enemy)."
However they did not shamai (hearken / hear), but they ishah (make) what they did raashawan (before).

So these gawayam (nations) yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, and ibad (servant) their engraved pasayal (images). Their banay (children) likewise, and their banay (childrens) banay (children), as their ab (father) ishah (make), so they ishah (make) to this yawam (day).

Now it happened in the shalawash (three) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) ban (son) of Alah (Elah) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the ban (son) of Achaz (Ahaz) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) began to malak (king).

He was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Abay (Abi) the banath (daughter) of Zakarayah (Zechariah).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, according to all that Dawad (David) his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

He sawar (removed) the bamah (high) places, and shabar (broke) the matzabath (pillars), and karath (cut) down the Asharah (Asherah): and he kathath (broke) in pieces the bronze nachash (serpent) that Mashah (Moses) ishah (make) made; for in those yamayam (days) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) qatar (burned) incense to it; and he qaraa (called) it Nachashathan (Nehushtan).

He batach (trusted) in Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel); so that achar (other) him was none like him among all the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah), nor among them that were panayam (face) him.
For he dabaq (joined) with Yahawah; he didn't sawar (depart) from achar (other) him, but shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), which Yahawah tzawah (commanded) Mashah (Moses).
Yahawah was with him; wherever he yatzaa (go out / come out) forth he shakal (prospered): and he marad (rebelled) against the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and didn't ibad (servant) him.
He nakah (struck) the Palashathay (Philistines) to Izah (Gaza) and its gabawal (border/boundary), from the magadal (tower) of the watchmen to the fortified iyar (city).

It happened in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), which was the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) ban (son) of Alah (Elah) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that Shalamanaasar (Shalmaneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up against Shamarawan (Samaria), and tzawar (besieged) it.

At the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of shalawash (three) shanayam (years) they lakad (took) it: in the shash (six) shanah (year) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), which was the thashai (nine) shanah (year) of Hawashai (Hoshea) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), Shamarawan (Samaria) was lakad (taken).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) carried Yashar-Al (Israel) away to Ashawar (Assyria), and nachah (put) them in Chalach (Halah), and on the Chabawar (Habor), the nahar (river) of Gawazan (Gozan), and in the iray (cities) of the Maday (Medes),

Because they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah their Alahayam, but ibar (pass over/through) his barayath (covenant), even all that Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah tzawah (commanded), and would not shamai (hearken / hear) it, nor ishah (make) it.

Now in the fourteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) ilah (go up / offer) up against all the batzar (fortified) iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and thapash (took) them.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shalach (send) to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) to Lakayash (Lachish), amar (spoke), "I have chataa (offended); shawab (turn back / repent) from me. That which you nathan (give) on me, I will nashaa (lift)." The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shawam (place / establish / appoint) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver) and shalawashayam (thirty) kakar (talents) of zahab (gold).
Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nathan (give) him all the kasap (silver) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the atzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house).

At that ith (time), Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) qatzatz (cut) off the gold from the dalathawath (doors) of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, and from the amanawath (pillars) which Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had overlaid, and nathan (give) it to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

The malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) tharathan (tartan) and rabasarayas (rabsaris) and Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) from Lakayash (Lachish) to malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) with a kabad (great) chayal (army) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). They ilah (go up / offer) up and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). When they had ilah (go up / offer) up, they bawaa (come) and imad (stood) by the thailah (conduit) of the ilayawan (Ilayawan) barakah (pool), which is in the masalah (highway) of the kabas (fuller's) shadah (field).

When they had qaraa (called) to the malak (king), there yatzaa (go out / come out) out to them Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebnah) the sapar (book), and Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph) the zakar (remember).

Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) amar (spoke) to them, "amar (spoke) now to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘Thus amaraw (says) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), "What batachawan (confidence) is this in which you batach (trust)?

You amar (spoke) (but they are but vain dabar (word / matter)), ‘There is itzah (counsel) and gabawarah (strength) for malachamah (war).' Now on whom do you batach (trust), that you have marad (rebelled) against me?

Now, behold, you batach (trust) in the mashainah (staff) of this ratzatz (bruised) qanah (reed), even in Matzarayam (Egypt). If a ayash (man / husband) samak (leans) on it, it will bawaa (come) into his kap (hand), and naqab (pierce) it. So is Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to all who batach (trust) on him.

But if you amar (spoke) me, ‘We batach (trust) in Yahawah our Alahayam;' isn't that he whose bamah (high) places and whose mazabach (altars) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) has sawar (taken) away, and has amar (spoke) to Yahawadah (Judah) and to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), ‘You shall shachah (worship) panayam (face) this mazabach (altar) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?'

Now therefore, please irab (evening) pledges to my adawan (master / lord) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and I will nathan (give) you two alap (thousand) sawasayam (horses), if you are yakal (able) on your part to nathan (give) riders on them.

How then can you shawab (turn back / repent) away the panayam (face) of achad (one) pachah (captain) of the qatan (small / young / least) of my adawan (master / lord) ibaday (servants), and batach (put) your trust on Matzarayam (Egypt) for rakab (chariots) and for horsemen?

Have I now ilah (go up / offer) up balaiday (without) Yahawah against this maqawam (place) to shachath (destroy) it? Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, ‘ilah (go up / offer) up against this aratz (Earth/land), and shachath (destroy) it.'"'"

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), and Shabanaa (Shebnah), and Yawaach (Joah), amar (spoke) to Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh), "Please dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) in the Aramayath (Syrian) language; for we shamai (hearken / hear) it. Don't dabar (word / matter) with us in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language, in the azan (ear) of the im (nation / people) who are on the chawamah (wall)."

But Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) amar (spoke) to them, "Has my adawan (master / lord) shalach (send) me to your adawan (master / lord), and to you, to dabar (word / matter) these dabarayam (words)? Hasn't he sent me to the anashayam (men) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the chawamah (wall), to akal (eat) their own charayayawanayam (dung), and to shathah (drinks) their own water with you?"

Then Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) imad (stood), and qaraa (called) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice) in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language, and dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), "shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malak (king), the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).
Thus amar (spoke) the malak (king), ‘Don't let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nashaa (lift) you; for he will not be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) you out of his yad (hand).

Neither let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) batach (make) you trust in Yahawah, amar (spoke), "Yahawah will natzal (surely) natzal (deliver) us, and this iyar (city) shall not be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)."

Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah).' For thus amar (spoke) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), ‘ishah (make) your barakah (peace) with me, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out to me; and everyone of you akal (eat) of his gapan (vine), and everyone of his thaan (fig) tree, and everyone shathah (drinks) the may (waters) of his own bawar (cistern);

Until I bawaa (come) and laqach (take / seize) you away to a aratz (Earth/land) like your own aratz (Earth/land), a aratz (Earth/land) of grain and new thayarawash (wine), a aratz (Earth/land) of lacham (bread) and karamayam (vineyards), a aratz (Earth/land) of zayath (olive) trees and of dabash (honey), that you may chayah (live), and not mawath (death). Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), when he sawath (persuades) you, amar (spoke), "Yahawah will natzal (deliver) us."
Has any of the Alahayam of the gawayam (nations) ever natzal (delivered) his aratz (Earth/land) out of the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)?

Where are the Alahayam of Chamath (Hamath), and of Arapad (Arpad)? Where are the Alahayam of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), of Hanai (Hena), and Iwah (Ivvah)? Have they natzal (delivered) Shamarawan (Samaria) out of my yad (hand)?

Who are they among all the Alahayam of the aratzawath (countries), that have natzal (delivered) their aratz (Earth/land) out of my yad (hand), that Yahawah should natzal (deliver) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) out of my yad (hand)?'"

But the im (nation / people) held their charash (peace), and inah (answer / respond) him not a dabar (word / matter); for the malak (king) matzawah (commandment) was, "Don't inah (answer / respond) him."

Then Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), who was over the bayath (house), bawaa (come) with Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph) the zakar (remember), to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) with their clothes qarai (torn), and nagad (told) him the dabaray (words) of Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh).

It happened, when malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamai (hearken / hear) it, that he qarai (tore) his clothes, and kasah (covered) himself with sackcloth, and bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He shalach (send) Alayaqayam (Eliakim), who was over the bayath (house), and Shabanaa (Shebna) the sapar (book), and the zaqanay (elders) of the kahanayam (priests), kasah (covered) with sackcloth, to Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz).

They amar (spoke) to him, "Thus yaamaraw (says) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), ‘This yawam (day) is a yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble), of thawakachah (rebuke), and of rejection; for the banayam (children) bawaa (come) come to the point of mashabar (birth), and there is no kach (strength / mighty / power) to deliver them.

It awalay (perhaps) be Yahawah your Alahayam will shamai (hearken / hear) all the dabaray (words) of Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh), whom the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) his adawan (master / lord) has shalach (send) to charap (defy) the chay (life) Alahayam, and will yakach (rebuke) the dabaray (words) which Yahawah your Alahayam has shamai (hearken / hear). Therefore nashaa (lift) up your thapalah (prayer) for the shaarayath (remnant) that is matzaa (left).'"
So the ibaday (servants) of malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) bawaa (come) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah).

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke) to them, "Thus you shall amar (spoke) your adawan (master / lord), ‘Thus thaamaraw (says) Yahawah, "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the dabarayam (words) that you have shamai (hearken / hear), with which the nairay (servants) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) have gadap (blasphemed) me.

Behold, I will nathan (give) a rawach (spirit / wind) in him, and he will shamai (hearken / hear) shamawaih (news), and will shawab (turn back / repent) to his own aratz (Earth/land). I will napal (fall / be cast down) him to fall by the charab (sword) in his own aratz (Earth/land)."'"

So Rabashaqah (Rabshakeh) shawab (turn back / repent), and matzaa (found) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) lacham (warring) against Labanah (Libnah); for he had shamai (hearken / hear) that he had departed from Lakayash (Lachish).

When he shamai (hearken / hear) it amar (spoke) of Tharahaqah (Tirhakah) malak (king) of Kawash (Ethiopia), "Behold, he yatzaa (go out / come out) come out to lacham (fight) against you, he shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers) again to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), amar (spoke),

‘Thus you shall amar (spoke) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), "Don't let your Alahayam in whom you batach (trust) nashaa (lift) you, amar (spoke), Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will not be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria).

Behold, you have shamai (hearken / hear) what the malakay (kings) of Ashawar (Assyria) ishah (make) done to all aratzawath (lands), by charam (destroying) them utterly. Will you be natzal (delivered)?

Have the Alahayam of the gawayam (nations) natzal (delivered) them, which my ab (father) have shachath (destroyed), Gawazan (Gozan), and Charan (Haran), and Ratzap (Rezeph), and the banay (children) of Idan (Eden) that were in Thalaashar (Telassar)?
Where is the malak (king) of Chamath (Hamath), and the malak (king) of Arapad (Arpad), and the malak (king) of the iyar (city) of Saparawayam (Sepharvaim), of Hanai (Hena), and Iwah (Ivvah)?"'"

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) laqach (take / seize) the sapar (book / scribed document) from the yad (hand) of the malaakayam (messengers), and qaraa (called) it. Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and parash (spread) it panayam (face) Yahawah.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) palal (prayed) panayam (face) Yahawah, and amar (spoke), "Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) above the karawab (cherubim), you are the Alahayam, even you alone, of all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land). You ishah (make) made shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land).

Natah (incline) your azan (ear), Yahawah, and shamai (hearken / hear). Paqach (open) your iyan (eye), Yahawah, and raah (see). Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of Sanacharayab (Sennacherib), with which he has shalach (send) to charap (defy) the chay (life) Alahayam.
Truly, Yahawah, the malakay (kings) of Ashawar (Assyria) have charab (laid) waste the gawayam (nations) and their aratz (Earth/land),

And nathan (give) cast their Alahayam into the ash (fire); for they were no Alahayam, but the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yaday (hands), itz (wood) and aban (stone). Therefore they abad (destroy / perish) destroyed them.

Now therefore, Yahawah our Alahayam, yashai (salvation) us, I beg you, out of his yad (hand), that all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) that you, Yahawah, are Alahayam alone."

Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz) shalach (send) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), amar (spoke), "Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), ‘Whereas you have palal (prayed) to me against Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), I have shamai (hearken / hear) you.

This is the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning him: "The bathawalah (virgin) banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion) has bazah (despised) you and ridiculed you. The banath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) has nawai (shaken) her raash (head) at you.

Whom have you charap (defied) and gadap (blasphemed)? Against whom have you rawam (will lift up) your qawal (sound / voice) and nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) on marawam (high)? Against the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel).

By your malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) you have charap (defied) the Adanay, and have amar (spoke), ‘With the rakab (multitude) of my rakab (chariots), I have ilah (go up / offer) up to the marawam (height) of the harayam (mountains), to the innermost yarakathay (parts) of Labanawan (Lebanon); and I will karath (cut) down its qawamah (tall) araz (cedars), and its mabachar (choice) barawash (fir) trees; and I will bawaa (come) into his farthest malawan (lodging) place, the yair (forest) of his Karamal (fruitful) field.
I have qawar (dug) and shathah (drinks) zawar (strange) mayam (Waters), and with the kap (sole) of my paim (feet) will I charab (dry) up all the yaaray (rivers) of Matzawar (Egypt).'

Haven't you shamai (hearken / hear) how I ishah (make) done it rachawaq (long) ago, and yatzar (formed) it of qadam (ancient) yamay (times)? Now bawaa (come) I brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay shaah (waste) batzar (fortified) irayam (cities) into ruinous galayam (heaps).

Therefore their yashab (inhabit/dwell) were of qatzar (small) yad (hand). They were chathath (dismayed) and bawash (confounded). They were like the ishab (grass) of the shadah (field), and like the yaraq (green) dashaa (herb), like the chatzayar (grass) on the housetops, and like grain shadapah (blasted) panayam (face) it has qamah (grown) up.
But I yadai (know) your sitting down, and your yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and your bawaa (come) in, and your ragaz (raging) against me.

Because of your ragaz (raging) against me, and because your arrogance has ilah (go up / offer) up into my azan (ear), therefore will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my chach (hook) in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and my mathag (bridle) in your shapah (lips), and I will shawab (turn back / repent) you back by the darak (way) by which you bawaa (come)."

"‘This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you: You shall akal (eat) this shanah (year) that which sapayach (grows) of itself, and in the shanay (second) shanah (year) that which springs of the same; and in the shalayashay (third) shanah (year) zarai (sow), and qatzar (reap), and natai (plant) karamayam (vineyards), and akal (eat) its paray (fruit).
The shaar (remnant) that has palayatah (escaped) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) shall again take sharash (root) matah (downward), and ishah (make) paray (fruit) upward.

For out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a shaarayath (remnant) will yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and out of har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) those who shall palayatah (escape). The qanaah (zeal) of Yahawah will ishah (make) this.'

"Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), ‘He shall not bawaa (come) to this iyar (city), nor yarah (shoot) an chatz (arrow) there, neither shall he qadam (come) before it with magan (shield), nor shapak (cast) up a mound against it.
By the darak (way) that he bawaa (come), by the same shall he shawab (turn back / repent), and he shall not bawaa (come) to this iyar (city),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
‘For I will ganan (defend) this iyar (city) to yashai (salvation) it, for my own sake, and for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake.'"

It happened that layal (night), that the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and nakah (struck) one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - chamash (five) alap (thousand) in the machanah (camp) of the Ashawar (Assyrians). When men arose shakam (early) in the shakam (morning), behold, these were all mawath (death) pagarayam (bodies).
So Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) departed, and yalak (went) and shawab (turn back / repent), and lived at Nayanawah (Nineveh).

It happened, as he was shachah (worshipping) in the bayath (house) of Nasarak (Nisroch) his Alahayam, that Adaramalak (Adrammelech) and Sharaatzar (Sharezer) nakah (struck) him with the charab (sword); and they malat (escaped) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Ararat (Ararat). Asarachadawan (Esar Haddon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

In those yamayam (days) was Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) chalah (afflict) to mawath (death). Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz) bawaa (come) to him, and amar (spoke) to him, "Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Set your bayath (house) in tzawah (order); for you shall mawath (death), and not chayah (live).'"
Then he sabab (turned) his panayam (face) to the qayar (wall), and palal (prayed) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),

"Zakar (remember) now, Yahawah, I beg you, how I have halak (move) panayam (face) you in amath (truth) and with a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart), and ishah (make) done that which is tawab (good / proper function) in your iyan (eye)." Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) bakah (wept) bitterly.
It happened, before Yashaiyah (Isaiah) yatzaa (go out / come out) gone out into the thayakawan (middle) part of the city, that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to him, amar (spoke),

"Shawab (turn back / repent) back, and amar (spoke) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the nagayad (prince) of my im (nation / people), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Dawad (David) your ab (father), "I have shamai (hearken / hear) your thapalah (prayer). I raah (see) seen your damaih (tears). Behold, I will rapaa (heal) you. On the shalayashay (third) yawam (day), you shall ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

I will yasap (add) to your yawam (day) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years). I will natzal (deliver) you and this iyar (city) out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). I will ganan (defend) this iyar (city) for my own sake, and for my ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake."'"

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke), "laqach (take / seize) a dabalah (fig cake) of thaanayam (figs)." They laqach (take / seize) and shawam (place / establish / appoint) it on the shachayan (boil), and he chayah (recovered).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), "What shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) that Yahawah will rapaa (heal) me, and that I shall ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah the shalayashay (third) yawam (day)?"

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke), "This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you from Yahawah, that Yahawah will ishah (make) the thing that he has dabar (word / matter): shall the tzal (shadow) halak (move) forward ishar (ten) mailawath (steps), or shawab (turn back / repent) back ishar (ten) mailawath (steps)?"

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), "It is a qalal (light) thing for the tzal (shadow) to natah (go) forward ishar (ten) mailawath (steps). Nay, but let the tzal (shadow) shawab (turn back / repent) backward ishar (ten) mailawath (steps)."

Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) qaraa (called) to Yahawah; and he shawab (turn back / repent) the tzal (shadow) ishar (ten) mailawath (steps) backward, by which it had yarad (gone) down on the dial of Achaz (Ahaz).

At that ith (time) Berodach Balaadan (Baladan) the ban (son) of Balaadan (Baladan), malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), shalach (send) saparayam (letters) and a manachah (present) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah); for he had shamai (hearken / hear) that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) had been chalah (afflict).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamai (hearken / hear) to them, and showed them all the bayath (house) of his nakath (precious) things, the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), and the bashamayam (spices), and the tawab (good / proper function) shaman (oil), and the bayath (house) of his armor, and all that was matzaa (found) in his awatzar (treasures): there was nothing in his bayath (house), nor in all his mamashal (authority), that Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) didn't show them.

Then Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) bawaa (come) to malak (king) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and amar (spoke) to him, "What did these anashayam (men) amar (spoke)? From ayan (NO ONE) did they bawaa (come) to you?" Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), "They bawaa (come) come from a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land), even from Babal (Babylon)."

He amar (spoke), "What raah (see) they seen in your bayath (house)?" Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke), "They raah (see) seen all that is in my bayath (house). There is nothing among my awatzar (treasures) that I raah (see) not shown them."
Yashaiyah (Isaiah) amar (spoke) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), "shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

‘Behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), that all that is in your bayath (house), and that which your ab (father) have laid up in atzar (store) to this yawam (day), shall be nashaa (lift) to Babal (Babylon). Nothing shall be yathar (left),' amar (spoke) Yahawah.

‘Of your ban (son) who shall yatzaa (go out / come out) from you, whom you shall yalad (birth / begot), shall they laqach (take / seize) away; and they shall be sarayasayam (eunuchs) in the hayakal (palace) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).'"

Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) amar (spoke) to Yashaiyah (Isaiah), "The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which you have dabar (word / matter) is tawab (good / proper function)." He amar (spoke) moreover, "Isn't it so, if shalawam (peace / safety) and amath (truth) shall be in my yawam (day)?"

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and all his gabawarah (might), and how he ishah (make) the barakah (pool), and the thailah (conduit), and bawaa (come) mayam (Waters) into the iyar (city), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Manashah (Manasseh) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Manashah (Manasseh) was shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chapatzayabah (Hephzibah).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, after the thawaibath (abominations) of the gawayam (nations) whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

For he banah (build) again the bamah (high) places which Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ab (father) abad (destroy / perish) destroyed; and he qawam (rise up) up mazabachath (altars) for Bail (Baal), and ishah (make) an Asharah (Asherah), as ishah (make) Achaab (Ahab) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and shachah (worshiped) all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and ibad (servant) them.
He banah (build) mazabachath (altars) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, of which Yahawah amar (spoke), "I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."
He banah (build) mazabachawath (altars) for all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky in the shanayam (two) chatzarawath (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He made his ban (son) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire), and practiced sorcery, and used nachash (enchantments), and dealt with those who had familiar awab (spirits), and with yadainayam (wizards): he ishah (make) much rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).

He shawam (place / establish / appoint) the engraved pasal (image) of Asharah (Asherah), that he ishah (make) made, in the bayath (house) of which Yahawah amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) and to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), "In this bayath (house), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which I have bachar (chosen) out of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) iwalam (forever);

Neither will I cause the ragal (feet / foot) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to wander any more out of the adamah (land) which I nathan (give) their ab (father), if only they will shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) according to all that I have tzawah (commanded) them, and according to all the thawarah (instruction) that my ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses) tzawah (commanded) them."

But they didn't shamai (hearken / hear): and Manashah (Manasseh) thaih (seduced) them to ishah (make) that which is rai (evil) more than the gawayam (nations) did whom Yahawah destroyed panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets), amar (spoke),

"Because Manashah (Manasseh) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) done these thaibawath (abominations), and has raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) wickedly above all that the Amaray (Amorites) ishah (make), who were panayam (face) him, and has made Yahawadah (Judah) also to chataa (sin) with his galawal (idols);

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), ‘Behold, I bawaa (come) such rai (evil) on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), that whoever shamai (hearken / hear) of it, shanayam (two) his azan (ear) shall tzalal (tingle).

I will natah (stretch) over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) the qaw (line) of Shamarawan (Samaria), and the mashaqalath (plummet) of the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); and I will machah (wipe) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as a man machah (wipes) a tzalachath (dish), machah (wiping) it and hapak (turning) it panayam (face) down.

I will natash (cast) off the shaarayath (remnant) of my nachalah (inheritance), and nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy). They will become a baz (prey) and a mashasah (spoil) to all their ayab (enemy);

Because they ishah (make) done that which is rai (evil) in my iyan (eye), and have provoked me to kais (anger), since the yawam (day) their ab (father) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt), even to this yawam (day).'"

Moreover Manashah (Manasseh) shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) very much, until he malaa (had) filled Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from one pah (end) to another; besides his chataah (sin) with which he made Yahawadah (Judah) to chataa (sin), in ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Manashah (Manasseh), and all that he ishah (make), and his chataah (sin) that he chataa (sinned), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

Manashah (Manasseh) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) in the gan (garden) of his own bayath (house), in the gan (garden) of Izaa (Uzza): and Amawan (Amon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Amawan (Amon) was isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) shanayam (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shanayam (two) shanayam (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Mashalamath (Meshullemeth) the banath (daughter) of Charawatz (Haruz) of Yatabah (Jotbah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father) ishah (make).
He yalak (walked) in all the darak (way) that his ab (father) halak (move) in, and ibad (servant) the galalayam (idols) that his ab (father) ibad (servant), and shachah (worshiped) them:
And he forsook Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father), and didn't halak (move) in the darak (way) of Yahawah.
The ibaday (servants) of Amawan (Amon) qashar (conspired) against him, and put the malak (king) to mawath (death) in his own bayath (house).

But the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) nakah (killed) all those who had qashar (conspired) against malak (king) Amawan (Amon); and the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) made Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Amawan (Amon) which he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
He was qabar (bury) in his tomb in the gan (garden) of Izaa (Uzza): and Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yaashayah (Josiah) was shamanah (eight) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yadayadah (Jedidah) the banath (daughter) of Idayah (Adaiah) of Batzaqath (Bozkath).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, and yalak (walked) in all the darak (way) of Dawad (David) his ab (father), and didn't sawar (turn) aside to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand).

It happened in the eighteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah), that the malak (king) shalach (send) Shapan (Shaphan), the ban (son) of Atzalayahaw (Azaliah) the ban (son) of Mashalam (Meshullam), the sapar (book), to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, amar (spoke),

"Ilah (go up / offer) up to Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), that he may thamam (sum) the kasap (money) which is bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, which the keepers of the sap (threshold) have asap (gathered) of the im (nation / people).

Nathan (give) them deliver it into the yad (hand) of the workmen who paqad (visit) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and nathan (give) them give it to the workmen who are in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, to chazaq (repair) the breaches of the bayath (house),
To the charashayam (carpenters), and to the banayam (builders), and to the gadarayam (masons), and for qanah (buying) itz (timber) and cut aban (stone) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house).
However there was no chashab (accounting) made with them of the kasap (money) that was nathan (give) into their yad (hand); for they dealt faithfully."

Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) amar (spoke) to Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), "I matzaa (have) found the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah." Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) nathan (give) the sapar (book / scribed document) to Shapan (Shaphan), and he qaraa (called) it.

Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book) bawaa (come) to the malak (king), and shawab (turn back / repent) the malak (king) dabar (word / matter) again, and amar (spoke), "Your ibad (servant) have emptied out the kasap (money) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house), and nathan (give) delivered it into the yad (hand) of the workmen who paqad (visit) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah."

Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book) nagad (told) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) nathan (give) delivered a sapar (book / scribed document) to me." Shapan (Shaphan) qaraa (called) it panayam (face) the malak (king).
It happened, when the malak (king) had shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction), that he qarai (tore) his clothes.

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest), and Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), and Ikabawar (Achbor) the ban (son) of Mayakayah (Micaiah), and Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), and Ishayah (Asaiah) the malak (king) ibad (servant), amar (spoke),

"Yalak (go) darash (inquire) of Yahawah for me, and for the im (nation / people), and for all Yahawadah (Judah), concerning the dabaray (words) of this sapar (book / scribed document) that is matzaa (found); for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah that is yatzath (kindled) against us, because our ab (father) have not shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabaray (words) of this sapar (book / scribed document), to ishah (make) according to all that which is kathab (write) concerning us."

So Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest), and Achayaqam (Ahikam), and Ikabawar (Achbor), and Shapan (Shaphan), and Ishayah (Asaiah), yalak (went) to Chaladah (Huldah) the nabayaah (prophetess), the ayashah (woman / wife) of Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Thaqawah (Tikvah), the ban (son) of Charachas (Harhas), keeper of the bagad (wardrobe) (now she lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the mashanah (second) quarter); and they dabar (word / matter) with her.
She amar (spoke) to them, "Thus amaraw (says) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): ‘amar (spoke) the ayash (man / husband) who shalach (send) you to me,

"Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this maqawam (place), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell), even all the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) which the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) has qaraa (called).

Because they have forsaken me, and have qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, that they might provoke me to kais (anger) with all the maishah (work) of their yad (hand), therefore my chamah (wrath) shall be yatzath (kindled) against this maqawam (place), and it shall not be kabah (quenched).'"

But to the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who shalach (send) you to darash (inquire) of Yahawah, thus you shall amar (spoke) him, "Thus thaamaraw (says) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): ‘Concerning the dabarayam (words) which you have shamai (hearken / hear),

Because your labab (heart) was rakak (tender), and you kanai (humbled) yourself panayam (face) Yahawah, when you shamai (hearken / hear) what I dabar (word / matter) against this maqawam (place), and against its yashab (inhabit/dwell), that they should become a shamah (desolation) and a qalalah (curse), and have qarai (torn) your clothes, and bakah (wept) panayam (face) me; I also have shamai (hearken / hear) you,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

‘Therefore, behold, I will asap (gather) you to your ab (father), and you shall be asap (gathered) to your qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) in shalawam (peace / safety), neither shall your iyan (eye) raah (see) all the rai (evil) which I will bawaa (come) on this maqawam (place).'"'" They shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) this dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king).
The malak (king) shalach (send), and they asap (gathered) to him all the zaqanay (elders) of Yahawadah (Judah) and of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and all the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) and all the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with him, and the kahanayam (priests), and the nabayaayam (prophets), and all the im (nation / people), both qatan (small / young / least) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty): and he qaraa (called) in their azan (ear) all the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the barayath (covenant) which was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The malak (king) imad (stood) by the imawad (pillar), and karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) panayam (face) Yahawah, to yalak (walk) achar (other) Yahawah, and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his idawath (testimonies), and his chaqah (statutes), with all his lab (heart), and all his napash (soul), to qawam (rise up) the dabaray (words) of this barayath (covenant) that were kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document): and all the im (nation / people) imad (stood) to the barayath (covenant).

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and the kahanay (priests) of the mashanah (second) order, and the keepers of the sap (threshold), to yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah all the kalayam (vessels) that were ishah (make) for Bail (Baal), and for the Asharah (Asherah), and for all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and he sharap (burned) them outside of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the shadamawath (fields) of the Qadarawan (Kidron), and nashaa (lift) their ashes to Bayath-Al (Bethel).

He shabath (shabath / rest) down the idolatrous kamarayam (priests), whom the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) nathan (give) ordained to qatar (burn) incense in the bamah (high) places in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the places around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); those also who qatar (burned) incense to Bail (Baal), to the shamash (sun), and to the yarach (moon), and to the mazalawath (planets), and to all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky.

He yatzaa (go out / come out) out the Asharah (Asherah) from the bayath (house) of Yahawah, outside of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron), and sharap (burned) it at the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron), and daqaq (beat) it to ipar (dust), and shalak (cast) its ipar (dust) on the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) of the ban (son) im (nation / people).
He nathatz (broke) down the bathay (houses) of the qadashayam (sodomites), that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, where the nashayam (women) wove bathay (hangings) for the Asharah (Asherah).

He bawaa (come) all the kahanayam (priests) out of the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and tamaa (defiled) the bamah (high) places where the kahanayam (priests) had qatar (burned) incense, from Gabai (Geba) to Baar-Shabai (Beersheba); and he nathatz (broke) down the bamah (high) places of the shairayam (gates) that were at the pathach (entrance) of the shair (gate) of Yahawashawai (Joshua) the shar (prince / ruler) of the iyar (city), which were on a ayash (man / husband) left shamaawal (left hand) at the shair (gate) of the iyar (city).

Nevertheless the kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places didn't ilah (go up / offer) up to the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), but they akal (eat) unleavened matzah (bread) thawak (midst) their ach (brother/kinsman).

He tamaa (defiled) Thapath (Topheth), which is in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), that no ayash (man / husband) might make his ban (son) or his banath (daughter) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire) to Malak (Molech).

He shabath (shabath / rest) away the sawasayam (horses) that the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) nathan (give) given to the shamash (sun), at the entrance of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, by the room of Nathanamalak (Nathan Melech) the sarayas (officer), who was in the court; and he sharap (burned) the marakabawath (chariots) of the shamash (sun) with ash (fire).

The malak (king) nathatz (broke) down the mazabachawath (altars) that were on the gag (roof) of the upper room of Achaz (Ahaz), which the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) made, and the mazabachawath (altars) which Manashah (Manasseh) ishah (make) made in the shanayam (two) chatzarawath (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nathatz (beat) them down from there, and shalak (cast) their ipar (dust) into the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).
