The the malak (king) tamaa (defiled) the bamah (high) places that were panayam (face) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which were on the right yamayan (right hand) of the har (mountain) of mashachayath (corruption), which Shalamah (Solomon) the malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) had banah (build) for Ishatharath (Ashtoreth) the shaqawatz (abomination) of the Tzayadanay (Sidonians), and for Kamawash (Chemosh) the shaqawatz (abomination) of Mawaab (Moab), and for Malakam (Milcom) the thawaibah (abomination) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon).
He shabar (broke) in pieces the matzabawath (pillars), and karath (cut) down the Asharah (Asherim), and malaa (filled) their maqawam (place) with the itzamawath (bones) of adam (men).

Moreover the mazabach (altar) that was at Bayath-Al (Bethel), and the bamah (high) place which Yarabaim (Jeroboam) the ban (son) of Nabat (Nebat), who made Yashar-Al (Israel) to chataa (sin), ishah (make) made, even that mazabach (altar) and the bamah (high) place he nathatz (broke) down; and he sharap (burned) the bamah (high) place and daqaq (beat) it to ipar (dust), and sharap (burned) the Asharah (Asherah).

As Yaashayah (Josiah) panah (turn) himself, he raah (see) the tombs that were there in the har (mountain); and he shalach (send), and laqach (take / seize) the itzamawath (bones) out of the tombs, and sharap (burned) them on the mazabach (altar), and tamaa (defiled) it, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam qaraa (called), who qaraa (called) these things.

Then he amar (spoke), "What monument is that which I raah (see)?" The anashay (men) of the iyar (city) amar (spoke) him, "It is the tomb of the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, who bawaa (come) from Yahawadah (Judah), and qaraa (called) these things that you ishah (make) done against the mazabach (altar) of Bayath-Al (Bethel)."

He amar (spoke), "yanach (let) him be! Let no ayash (man / husband) nawai (move) his itzamawath (bones)." So they let his itzamawath (bones) malat (alone), with the itzamawath (bones) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who bawaa (come) out of Shamarawan (Samaria).

All the bathay (houses) also of the bamah (high) places that were in the iray (cities) of Shamarawan (Samaria), which the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) made to provoke Yahawah to anger, Yaashayah (Josiah) sawar (took) away, and ishah (make) to them according to all the maishayam (acts) that he ishah (make) done in Bayath-Al (Bethel).

He zabach (killed) all the kahanay (priests) of the bamah (high) places that were there, on the mazabachawath (altars), and sharap (burned) adam (men's) itzamawath (bones) on them; and he shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah your Alahayam, as it is kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document) of the barayath (covenant)."

Ishah (make) there was not kept such a pasach (passover) from the yamay (days) of the shapatayam (judges) who shapat (judge / judgement) Yashar-Al (Israel), nor in all the yamay (days) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel), nor of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah);
But in the eighteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah) was this pasach (passover) ishah (make) to Yahawah in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Moreover Yaashayah (Josiah) removed those who had familiar abawath (spirits), and the yadainayam (wizards), and the tharapayam (teraphim), and the tharapayam (idols), and all the galalayam (abominations) that were raah (see) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that he might qawam (rise up) the dabaray (words) of the thawarah (instruction) which were kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) that Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Like him was there no malak (king) panayam (face) him, who shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah with all his labab (heart), and with all his napash (soul), and with all his maad (might), according to all the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses); neither achar (other) him qawam (rise up) there any like him.

Notwithstanding, Yahawah didn't shawab (turn back / repent) from the charawan (fierceness) of his gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), with which his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against Yahawadah (Judah), because of all the kais (provocation) with which Manashah (Manasseh) kais (had) provoked him.

Yahawah amar (spoke), "I will sawar (remove) Yahawadah (Judah) also out of my panayam (face), as I have sawar (removed) Yashar-Al (Israel), and I will maas (cast) off this iyar (city) which I have bachar (chosen), even Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the bayath (house) of which I amar (spoke), ‘My sham (name) shall be there.'"

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?

In his yawam (day) Paraihanakah (Pharaoh Necoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up against the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) to the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates): and malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah) yalak (went) qaraah (against) him; and Pharaoh Necoh mawath (death) him at Magadawan (Megiddo), when he raah (see) seen him.

His ibad (servant) rakab (carried) him in a chariot mawath (death) from Magadawan (Megiddo), and bawaa (come) him to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and qabar (bury) him in his own tomb. The im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) laqach (take / seize) Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and mashach (anointed) him, and made him malak (king) in his ab (father) place.

Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) was isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawash (three) chadashayam (months) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chamawatal (Hamutal) the banath (daughter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of Labanah (Libnah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

Paraihanakah (Pharaoh Necoh) asar (put) him in bonds at Rabalah (Riblah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Chamath (Hamath), that he might not malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) to a inash (tribute) of one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), and a kakar (talent) of zahab (gold).

Paraihanakah (Pharaoh Necoh) made Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah) malak (king) in the place of Yaashayah (Josiah) his ab (father), and sabab (changed) his sham (name) to Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim): but he laqach (take / seize) Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) laqach (take / seize); and he bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt), and mawath (death) there.

Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) nathan (give) the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) to Paraih (Pharaoh); but he irak (taxed) the aratz (Earth/land) to nathan (give) the kasap (money) pah (according) to the commandment of Paraih (Pharaoh): he nagash (exacted) the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) of the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), of everyone according to his irak (taxation), to nathan (give) it to Paraihanakah (Pharaoh Necoh).

Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Zabayadah (Zebidah) the banath (daughter) of Padayah (Pedaiah) of Rawamah (Rumah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

In his yawam (day) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) ilah (go up / offer) up, and Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) became his ibad (servant) shalawash (three) shanayam (years): then he shawab (turn back / repent) and marad (rebelled) against him.

Yahawah shalach (send) against him gadawaday (bands) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and gadawaday (bands) of the Aram (Syrians), and gadawaday (bands) of the Mawaab (Moabites), and gadawaday (bands) of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon), and shalach (send) them against Yahawadah (Judah) to abad (destroy / perish) it, according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by his ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets).

Surely at the commandment of Yahawah came this on Yahawadah (Judah), to sawar (remove) them out of his panayam (face), for the chataath (sins) of Manashah (Manasseh), according to all that he ishah (make),

And also for the naqay (innocent) dam (blood) that he shapak (shed); for he malaa (filled) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with naqay (innocent) dam (blood): and Yahawah would not salach (forgive/pardon/make clean).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), and all that he ishah (make), aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah)?
So Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

The malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) didn't yatzaa (go out / come out) again out of his aratz (Earth/land) any more; for the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had laqach (take / seize), from the brook of Matzarayam (Egypt) to the nachal (stream / river) Parath (Euphrates), all that pertained to the malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) was eighteen shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shalawash (three) chadashayam (months): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Nachashathaa (Nehushta) the banath (daughter) of Alanathan (Elnathan) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

At that ith (time) the ibaday (servants) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the iyar (city) was bawaa (come).
Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come) to the iyar (city), while his ibad (servant) were tzawar (besieging) it;

And Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), he, and his am (mother), and his ibad (servant), and his shar (prince / ruler), and his sarayas (officers): and the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) laqach (take / seize) him in the shamanah (eighth) shanah (year) of his malak (king).

He yatzaa (go out / come out) out there all the awatzarawath (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the awatzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), and qatzatz (cut) in pieces all the kalay (vessels) of zahab (gold), which Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) made in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, as Yahawah had dabar (word / matter).

He galah (carried) away all Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and all the sharayam (princes), and all the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, even ishar (ten) alap (thousand) galah (captives), and all the craftsmen and the masagar (smiths); none shaar (remained), except the poorest sort of the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land).

He galah (carried) away Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) to Babal (Babylon); and the malak (king) am (mother), and the malak (king) wives, and his sarayas (officers), and the chief men of the aratz (Earth/land), yalak (carried) he into gawalah (captivity) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon).

All the anashay (men) of chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), even shabai (seven) alap (thousand), and the craftsmen and the masagar (smiths) one alap (thousand), all of them gabawar (strong) and ishah (make) for malachamah (war), even them the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come) gawalah (captive) to Babal (Babylon).
The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) made Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Jehoiachin's dawad (father's) brother, malak (king) is his place, and sabab (changed) his sham (name) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) was isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Chamawatal (Hamutal) the banath (daughter) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of Labanah (Libnah).
He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, according to all that Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) ishah (make) done.

For through the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah, it happened in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), until he had shalak (cast) them out from his panayam (face). Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) marad (rebelled) against the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

It happened in the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year) of his malak (king), in the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month), in the ishawar (tenth) day of the chadash (month), that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come), he and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and chanah (encamped) against it; and they banah (build) dayaq (forts) against it around it.
So the iyar (city) was bawaa (come) to the ishathay (eleven) shanah (year) of malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah).
On the thashai (nine) day of the fourth chadash (month) the raib (famine) was severe in the iyar (city), so that there was no lacham (bread) for the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Then a baqai (breach) was made in the iyar (city), and all the anashay (men) of malachamah (war) fled by layal (night) by the darak (way) of the shair (gate) between the two chamathayam (walls), which was by the malak (king) gan (garden) (now the Kashaday (Chaldeans) were against the iyar (city) around it); and the king yalak (went) by the darak (way) of the irabah (arabah).

But the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) radap (pursued) achar (other) the malak (king), and overtook him in the irabawath (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho); and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) was pawatz (scattered) from him.
Then they thapash (took) the malak (king), and ilah (go up / offer) him up to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) to Rabalah (Riblah); and they dabar (word / matter) mashapat (judgment) on him.

They shachat (killed) the banay (sons) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) before his iyanay (eyes), and iwar (put) out the iyanay (eyes) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), and asar (bound) him in nachashathayam (fetters), and bawaa (come) him to Babal (Babylon).

Now in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), on the shabai (seven) day of the chadash (month), which was the nineteenth shanah (year) of malak (king) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar), malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), bawaa (come) Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard), a ibad (servant) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He burnt the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the malak (king) bayath (house); and all the bathay (houses) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), even every gadawal (very great/important/mighty) bayath (house), burnt he with ash (fire).

All the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), who were with the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard), nathatz (broke) down the chawamath (walls) around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) galah (carried) away captive the yathar (residue) of the im (nation / people) who were shaar (left) in the iyar (city), and those who napal (fall / be cast down) away, who fell to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and the yathar (residue) of the hamawan (multitude).
But the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) shaar (left) some of the poorest of the aratz (Earth/land) to karam (work) the vineyards and fields.

The Kashaday (Chaldeans) broke up the imawaday (pillars) of nachashath (brass) that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah and the makanawath (bases) and the bronze yam (sea/waters) that were in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nashaa (lift) the nachashath (brass) shabaraw (pieces) to Babal (Babylon).

They laqach (take / seize) away the sayarath (pots), the yaiyam (shovels), the mazamarawath (snuffers), the kapawath (spoons), and all the kalay (vessels) of nachashath (brass) with which they sharath (ministered).

The rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seize) away the machathah (fire) pans, the basins, that which was of zahab (gold), in zahab (gold), and that which was of kasap (silver), in kasap (silver).

The shanayam (two) imawadayam (pillars), the achad (one) yam (sea/waters), and the makanawath (bases), which Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the nachashath (brass) of all these kalayam (vessels) was laa (NOT) mashaqal (weight).

The qawamah (height) of the achad (one) imawad (pillar) was eighteen amah (cubits), and a capital of nachashath (brass) was on it; and the qawamah (height) of the capital was shalawash (three) amah (cubits), with shabakah (network) and ramanayam (pomegranates) on the capital around it, all of nachashath (brass): and like to these had the shanay (second) imawad (pillar) with shabakah (network).

The rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seize) Sharayah (Seraiah) the raash (head) kahan (priest), and Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the mashanah (second) kahan (priest), and the shalawash (three) keepers of the sap (threshold):

And out of the iyar (city) he laqach (take / seize) an sarayas (officer) who paqayad (was) set over the achad (one) of malachamah (war); and chamash (five) achad (one) of those who raah (see) the malak (king) raah (see), who were matzaa (found) in the iyar (city); and the sapar (book), the shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop), who tzabaa (troop) the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land); and shashayam (sixty) anashay (men) of the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), who were matzaa (found) in the iyar (city).
Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seize) them, and yalak (brought) them to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) to Rabalah (Riblah).

The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nakah (struck) them, and put them to mawath (death) at Rabalah (Riblah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Chamath (Hamath). So Yahawadah (Judah) was galah (carried) away captive out of his adamah (land).

As for the im (nation / people) who were shaar (left) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had shaar (left), even over them he made Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), governor.

Now when all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces), they and their chayalayam (men), shamai (hearken / hear) that the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had made Gadalayah (Gedaliah) governor, they bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) to Matzapah (Mizpah), even Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Thanachamath (Tanhumeth) the Natapathay (Netophathite), and Yaazanayah (Jaazaniah) the ban (son) of the Maikathay (Maacathite), they and their chayalayam (men).

Gadalayah (Gedaliah) shabai (swear / take oath) to them and to their ayash (man / husband), and amar (spoke) to them, "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) because of the ibaday (servants) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans). Yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land), and ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and it shall be yatab (well) with you."

But it happened in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), the ban (son) of Alayashamai (Elishama), of the malawakah (royal) zarai (seed) bawaa (come), and ishar (ten) ban (son) with him, and nakah (struck) Gadalayah (Gedaliah), so that he mawath (death), and the Yahawaday (Jews) and the Kashaday (Chaldeans) that were with him at Matzapah (Mizpah).

All the im (nation / people), both qatan (small / young / least) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces), qawam (rise up), and bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt); for they were yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

It happened in the shalawashayam (thirty) shabai (seven) shanah (year) of the galawath (captivity) of Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the shanayam (two) chadash (month), on the shabai (seven) and isharayam (twenty) day of the chadash (month), that awayalamaradak (evilmerodach) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), in the shanah (year) that he began to malak (king), nashaa (lift) up the raash (head) of Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) out of bayath (house);
And he dabar (word / matter) tawab (good / proper function) to him, and nathan (give) his kasaa (throne) above the kasaa (throne) of the malakayam (kings) who were with him in Babal (Babylon),
And shanaa (hate) his kalaa (prison) bagaday (garments). Jehoiachin akal (eat) lacham (bread) panayam (face) him continually all the yamay (days) of his chay (life):

And for his arachah (allowance), there was a thamayad (continual) arachah (allowance) nathan (give) him of the malak (king), every yawam (day) a dabar (word / matter), all the yamay (days) of his chay (life).
Adam (Adam), Shath (Seth), Anawash (Enosh),
Qayanan (Kenan), Mahalalaal (Mahalalel), Yarad (Jared),
Chanawak (Enoch), Mathawashalach (Methuselah), Lamak (Lamech),
Nach (Noah), Sham (Shem), Cham (Ham), and Yapath (Japheth).
The banay (sons) of Yapath (Japheth): Gamar (Gomer), and Magawag (Magog), and Maday (Madai), and Yawan (Javan), and Thawabal (Tubal), and Mashak (Meshech), and Thayaras (Tiras).
The banay (sons) of Gamar (Gomer): Ashakanaz (Ashkenaz), and Rayapath (Diphath), and Thawagaramah (Togarmah).
The banay (sons) of Yawan (Javan): Alayashah (Elishah), and Tharashayash (Tarshish), Kathay (Kittim), and Dadanayam (Rodanim).
The banay (sons) of Cham (Ham): Kawash (Cush), and Matzarayam (Mizraim), Pawat (Put), and Kanain (Canaan).

The banay (sons) of Kawash (Cush): Sabaa (Seba), and Chawayalah (Havilah), and Sabathaa (Sabta), and Raimah (Raama), and Sabathakaa (Sabteca). The banay (sons) of Raimah (Raamah): Shabaa (Sheba), and Dadan (Dedan).
Kawash (Cush) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Namarawad (Nimrod); he chalal (began) to be a gabawar (mighty) one in the aratz (Earth/land).
Matzarayam (Mizraim) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Lawaday (Ludim), and inamayam (anamim), and lahabayam (lehabim), and Naphtuhim,
And patharasay (pathrusim), and kasalachayam (casluhim) (where the Palashathay (Philistines) yatzaa (go out / come out) from), and Kapatharay (Caphtorim).
Kanain (Canaan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Tzayadawan (Sidon) his bakawar (firstborn), and Chath (Heth),
And the Yabawasay (Jebusite), and the Amaray (Amorite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite),
And the Chaway (Hivite), and the iraqay (arkite), and the sayanay (sinite),
And the arawaday (arvadite), and the tzamaray (zemarite), and the chamathay (hamathite).

The banay (sons) of Sham (Shem): Iyalam (Elam), and Ashawar (Asshur), and Arapakashad (Arpachshad), and Lawad (Lud), and Aram (Aram), and Iwatz (Uz), and Chawal (Hul), and Gathar (Gether), and Mashak (Meshech).
Arapakashad (Arpachshad) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalach (Shelah), and Shalach (Shelah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Ibar (Eber).

To Ibar (Eber) were yalad (birth / begot) shanayam (two) banayam (sons): the sham (name) of the achad (one) was Palag (Peleg); for in his yawam (day) the aratz (Earth/land) was palag (divided); and his ach (brother/kinsman) sham (name) was Yaqatan (Joktan).
Yaqatan (Joktan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alamawadad (Almodad), and Shalap (Sheleph), and Chatzaramawath (Hazarmaveth), and Yarach (Jerah),
And Hadawaram (Hadoram), and Awazal (Uzal), and Daqalah (Diklah),
And Iyabal (Ebal), and Abayamaal (Abimael), and Shabaa (Sheba),
And Awapayar (Ophir), and Chawayalah (Havilah), and Yawabab (Jobab). All these were the banay (sons) of Yaqatan (Joktan).
Sham (Shem), Arapakashad (Arpachshad), Shalach (Shelah),
Ibar (Eber), Palag (Peleg), Raiw (Reu),
Sharawag (Serug), Nachawar (Nahor), Tharach (Terah),
Abaram (Abram) (the same is Abaraham (Abraham)).
The banay (sons) of Abaraham (Abraham): Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yashamaial (Ishmael).
These are their thawaladah (generation): the bakawar (firstborn) of Yashamaial (Ishmael), Nabayawath (Nebaioth); then Qadar (Kedar), and Adabaal (Adbeel), and Mabasham (Mibsam),
Mashamai (Mishma), and Dawamah (Dumah), Mashaa (Massa), Chadad (Hadad), and Thayamaa (Tema),
Yatawar (Jetur), Napayash (Naphish), and Qadamah (Kedemah). These are the banay (sons) of Yashamaial (Ishmael).

The banay (sons) of Qatawarah (Keturah), Abaraham (Abraham's) payalagash (concubine): she yalad (birth / begot) Zamaran (Zimran), and Yaqashan (Jokshan), and Madan (Medan), and Madayan (Midian), and Yashabaq (Ishbak), and Shawach (Shuah). The banay (sons) of Yaqashan (Jokshan): Shabaa (Sheba), and Dadan (Dedan).
The banay (sons) of Madayan (Midian): Iyapah (Ephah), and Ipar (Epher), and Chanawak (Hanoch), and Abayadai (Abida), and Aladaih (Eldaah). All these were the banay (sons) of Qatawarah (Keturah).
Abaraham (Abraham) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yatzachaq (Isaac). The banay (sons) of Yatzachaq (Isaac): Ishaw (Esau), and Yashar-Al (Israel).
The banay (sons) of Ishaw (Esau): Alayapaz (Eliphaz), Raiwaal (Reuel), and Yaiwash (Jeush), and Yailam (Jalam), and Qarach (Korah).
The banay (sons) of Alayapaz (Eliphaz): Thayaman (Teman), and Awamar (Omar), Tzapaw (Zephi), and Gaitham (Gatam), Qanaz (Kenaz), and Thamanai (Timna), and Imalaq (Amalek).
The banay (sons) of Raiwaal (Reuel): Nachath (Nahath), Zarach (Zerah), Shamah (Shammah), and Mazah (Mizzah).
The banay (sons) of Shaiyar (Seir): Lawatan (Lotan), and Shawabal (Shobal), and Tzabaiwan (Zibeon), and Inah (Anah), and Dayashawan (Dishon), and Atzar (Ezer), and Dayashan (Dishan).
The banay (sons) of Lawatan (Lotan): Charay (Hori), and Hawamam (Homam); and Thamanai (Timna) was Lawatan (Lotan's) achawath (sister).

The banay (sons) of Shawabal (Shobal): Ilawan (Alian), and Manachath (Manahath), and Iyabal (Ebal), Shapaw (Shephi), and Awanam (Onam). The banay (sons) of Tzabaiwan (Zibeon): Ayah (Aiah), and Inah (Anah).
The banay (sons) of Inah (Anah): Dayashawan (Dishon). The banay (sons) of Dayashawan (Dishon): Chamaran (Hamran), and Ashaban (Eshban), and Yatharan (Ithran), and Karan (Cheran).
The banay (sons) of Atzar (Ezer): Balahan (Bilhan), and Zaiwan (Zaavan), Yaiqan (Jaakan). The banay (sons) of Dishan: Iwatz (Uz), and Aran (Aran).

Now these are the malakayam (kings) who malak (king) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Adawam (Edom), panayam (face) there malak (king) any malak (king) over the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel): Balai (Bela) the ban (son) of Baiwar (Beor); and the sham (name) of his iyar (city) was Danahabah (Dinhabah).
Balai (Bela) mawath (death), and Yawabab (Jobab) the ban (son) of Zarach (Zerah) of Batzarah (Bozrah) malak (king) in his place.
Yawabab (Jobab) mawath (death), and Chawasham (Husham) of the aratz (Earth/land) of the thayamanay (temanites) malak (king) in his place.

Chawasham (Husham) mawath (death), and Hadad (Hadad) the ban (son) of Badad (Bedad), who nakah (struck) Madayan (Midian) in the shadah (field) of Mawaab (Moab), malak (king) in his place; and the sham (name) of his iyar (city) was Iwayath (Avith).
Hadad (Hadad) mawath (death), and Shamalah (Samlah) of Masharaqah (Masrekah) malak (king) in his place.
Shamalah (Samlah) mawath (death), and Shaawal (Shaul) of Rachabawath (Rehoboth) by the nahar (river) malak (king) in his place.
Shaawal (Shaul) mawath (death), and Bailachanan (Baal Hanan) the ban (son) of Ikabawar (Achbor) malak (king) in his place.

Bailachanan (Baal Hanan) mawath (death), and Hadad (Hadad) malak (king) in his place; and the sham (name) of his iyar (city) was Paiw (Pai): and his ayashah (woman / wife) sham (name) was Mahayatabaal (Mehetabel), the banath (daughter) of Matarad (Matred), the banath (daughter) of Mayazahab (Mezahab).
Hadad (Hadad) mawath (death). The chiefs of Adawam (Edom) were: chief Thamanai (Timna), chief Ilawah (Aliah), chief Yathath (Jetheth),
Chief Ahalayabamah (Oholibamah), chief Alah (Elah), chief Payanan (Pinon),
Chief Qanaz (Kenaz), chief Thayaman (Teman), chief Mabatzar (Mibzar),
Chief Magadayaal (Magdiel), chief Iyaram (Iram). These are the chiefs of Adawam (Edom).
These are the banay (sons) of Yashar-Al (Israel): Raawaban (Reuben), Shamaiwan (Simeon), Laway (Levi), and Yahawadah (Judah), Yashashakar (Issachar), and Zabawalawan (Zebulun),
Dan (Dan), Yawasap (Joseph), and Banayamayan (Benjamin), Napathalay (Naphtali), Gad (Gad), and Ashar (Asher).

The banay (sons) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er), and Awanan (Onan), and Shalah (Shelah); which shalawash (three) were yalad (birth / begot) to him of Shawaia (Shua's) banath (daughter) the Canaanitess. Ir (Er), Yahawadah (Judah's) bakawar (firstborn), was rai (wicked) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah; and he mawath (death) him.
Thamar (Tamar) his kalah (complete / finish) yalad (birth / begot) him Paratz (Perez) and Zarach (Zerah). All the banay (sons) of Yahawadah (Judah) were chamash (five).
The banay (sons) of Paratz (Perez): Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Chamawal (Hamul).
The banay (sons) of Zarach (Zerah): Zamaray (Zimri), and Ayathan (Ethan), and Hayaman (Heman), and Kalakal (Calcol), and Darai (Dara); chamash (five) of them in all.
The banay (sons) of Karamay (Carmi): Ikar (Achar), the troubler of Yashar-Al (Israel), who mail (top/above) a trespass in the charam (devoted) thing.
The banay (sons) of Ayathan (Ethan): Izarayah (Azariah).
The banay (sons) also of Chatzarawan (Hezron), who were yalad (birth / begot) to him: Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel), and Ram (Ram), and Kalawabay (Chelubai).

Ram (Ram) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Imayanadab (Amminadab), and Imayanadab (Amminadab) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nachashawan (Nahshon), nashayaa (prince) of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah);
And Nachashawan (Nahshon) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalamaa (Salma), and Shalamaa (Salma) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Baiz (Boaz),
And Baiz (Boaz) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Iwabad (Obed), and Iwabad (Obed) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yashay (Jesse);
And Yashay (Jesse) became the yalad (birth / begot) of his bakawar (firstborn) Alayaab (Eliab), and Abayanadab (Abinadab) the shanay (second), and Shamaia (Shimea) the shalayashay (third),
Nathanaal (Nethanel) the rabayaiy (fourth), Raday (Raddai) the chamayashay (fifth),
Atzam (Ozem) the shashay (sixth), Dawad (David) the shabayaiy (seventh);

And their achawath (sisters) were Tzarawayah (Zeruiah) and Abayagayal (Abigail). The banay (sons) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah): Abayashay (Abishai), and Yawaab (Joab), and Ishahaal (Asahel), shalawash (three).
Abayagayal (Abigail) yalad (birth / begot) Imashaa (Amasa); and the ab (father) of Imashaa (Amasa) was Yathar (Jether) the Yashamaialay (Ishmaelite).

Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Chatzarawan (Hezron) became the yalad (birth / begot) of children of Izawabah (Azubah) his ayashah (woman / wife), and of Yarayaiwath (Jerioth); and these were her ban (son): Yashar (Jesher), and Shawabab (Shobab), and Aradawan (Ardon).
Izawabah (Azubah) mawath (death), and Kalab (Caleb) laqach (take / seize) to him aparath (ephrath), who yalad (birth / begot) him Chawar (Hur).
Chawar (Hur) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Awaray (Uri), and Awaray (Uri) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Batzalaal (Bezalel).

Afterward Chatzarawan (Hezron) bawaa (come) in to the banath (daughter) of Makayar (Machir) the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead), whom he laqach (take / seize) as wife when he was shashayam (sixty) shanah (years) ban (son); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Shagawab (Segub).
Shagawab (Segub) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yaayar (Jair), who had twenty - three irayam (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead).

Gashawar (Geshur) and Aram (Aram) laqach (take / seize) the chawath (towns) of Yaayar (Jair) from them, with Qanath (Kenath), and its villages, even shashayam (sixty) iyar (cities). All these were the banay (sons) of Makayar (Machir) the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead).

Achar (other) that Chatzarawan (Hezron) was mawath (death) in Kalabaaparathah (Caleb Ephrathah), then Abayah (Abijah) Chatzarawan (Hezron's) ayashah (woman / wife) yalad (birth / begot) him Ashachawar (Ashhur) the ab (father) of Thaqawai (Tekoa).

The banay (sons) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) the bakawar (firstborn) of Chatzarawan (Hezron) were Ram (Ram) the bakawar (firstborn), and Bawanah (Bunah), and Aran (Oren), and Atzam (Ozem), Achayah (Ahijah).
Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) had achar (other) ayashah (woman / wife), whose sham (name) was Itarah (Atarah); she was the am (mother) of Awanam (Onam).
The banay (sons) of Ram (Ram) the bakawar (firstborn) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) were Maitz (Maaz), and Yamayan (Jamin), and Iqar (Eker).
The banay (sons) of Awanam (Onam) were Shamay (Shammai), and Yadai (Jada). The banay (sons) of Shamay (Shammai): Nadab (Nadab), and Abayashawar (Abishur).
The sham (name) of the ayashah (woman / wife) of Abayashawar (Abishur) was Abayahayal (Abihail); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Achaban (Ahban), and Mawalayad (Molid).
The banay (sons) of Nadab (Nadab): Salad (Seled), and Apayam (Appaim); but Salad (Seled) mawath (death) without banay (children).
The banay (sons) of Apayam (Appaim): Yashaiy (Ishi). The banay (sons) of Yashaiy (Ishi): Shashan (Sheshan). The banay (sons) of Shashan (Sheshan): Achalay (Ahlai).
The banay (sons) of Yadai (Jada) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Shamay (Shammai): Yathar (Jether), and Yawanathan (Jonathan); and Yathar (Jether) mawath (death) without banay (children).
The banay (sons) of Yawanathan (Jonathan): Palath (Peleth), and Zazaa (Zaza). These were the banay (sons) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel).
Now Shashan (Sheshan) had no banayam (sons), but banawath (daughters). Shashan (Sheshan) had a ibad (servant), an Matzaray (Egyptian), whose sham (name) was Yarachai (Jarha).
Shashan (Sheshan) nathan (give) his banath (daughter) to Yarachai (Jarha) his ibad (servant) as ayashah (woman / wife); and she yalad (birth / begot) him Ithay (Attai).
Ithay (Attai) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Nathan (Nathan), and Nathan (Nathan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Zabad (Zabad),
And Zabad (Zabad) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Apalal (Ephlal), and Apalal (Ephlal) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Iwabad (Obed),
And Iwabad (Obed) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yahawaa (Jehu), and Yahawaa (Jehu) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Izarayah (Azariah),
And Izarayah (Azariah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Chalatz (Helez), and Chalatz (Helez) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alaishah (Eleasah),
And Alaishah (Eleasah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Sasamay (Sismai), and Sasamay (Sismai) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shalawam (Shallum),
And Shalawam (Shallum) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yaqamayah (Jekamiah), and Yaqamayah (Jekamiah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alayashamai (Elishama).

The banay (sons) of Kalab (Caleb) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) were Mayashai (Mesha) his bakawar (firstborn), who was the ab (father) of Zayap (Ziph); and the banay (sons) of Maraashah (Mareshah) the ab (father) of Chabarawan (Hebron).
The banay (sons) of Chabarawan (Hebron): Qarach (Korah), and Thapawach (Tappuah), and Raqam (Rekem), and Shamai (Shema).
Shamai (Shema) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Racham (Raham), the yalad (birth / begot) of Yaraqaim (Jorkeam); and Raqam (Rekem) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shamay (Shammai).
The ban (son) of Shamay (Shammai) was maiwan (maon); and maiwan (maon) was the ab (father) of Bayathatzawar (Beth Zur).

Iyapah (Ephah), Kalab (Caleb's) payalagash (concubine), yalad (birth / begot) Charan (Haran), and Mawatzaa (Moza), and Gazaz (Gazez); and Charan (Haran) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Gazaz (Gazez).
The banay (sons) of Yahaday (Jahdai): Ragam (Regem), and Yawatham (Jothan), and Gayashan (Geshan), and Palat (Pelet), and Iyapah (Ephah), and Shaip (Shaaph).
Maikah (Maacah), Kalab (Caleb's) payalagash (concubine), yalad (birth / begot) Shabar (Sheber) and Tharachanah (Tirhanah).

She yalad (birth / begot) also Shaip (Shaaph) the ab (father) of Madamanah (Madmannah), Shawaa (Sheva) the ab (father) of Makabanaa (Machbena), and the ab (father) of Gabaia (Gibea); and the banath (daughter) of Kalab (Caleb) was Ikasah (Achsah).
These were the banay (sons) of Kalab (Caleb), the ban (son) of Chawar (Hur), the bakawar (firstborn) of Ephrathah: Shawabal (Shobal) the ab (father) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim),
Shalamaa (Salma) the ab (father) of Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem), Charap (Hareph) the ab (father) of Bayathagadar (Beth Gader).
Shawabal (Shobal) the ab (father) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim) had banayam (sons): Raah (Haroeh), chatzayahamanachawath (half) of the Menuhoth.

The mashapachawath (families) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim): The yatharay (ithrites), and the Puthites, and the shamathay (shumathites), and the masharaiy (mishraites); of them yatzaa (go out / come out) the Tzaraiy (Zorathites) and the Ashathaalay (Eshtaolites).

The banay (sons) of Shalamaa (Salma): Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem), and the Natapathay (Netophathites), Atroth Beth itarawathabayathayawaab (joab), and chatzayahamanachathay (half) of the Manahathites, the tzaraiy (zorites).

The mashapachawath (families) of saparayam (scribes) who lived at Yaibatz (Jabez): the tharaithayam (tirathites), the shamaithayam (shimeathites), the Sucathites. These are the Qayanay (Kenites) who bawaa (come) of Chamath (Hammath), the ab (father) of the bayath (house) of Rakab (Rechab).

Now these were the banay (sons) of Dawad (David), who were yalad (birth / begot) to him in Chabarawan (Hebron): the bakawar (firstborn), Amanawan (Amnon), of Achayanaim (Ahinoam) the yazaraialayath (jezreelitess); the shanay (second), Danayaal (Daniel), of Abayagayal (Abigail) the karamalayath (carmelitess);

The shalayashay (third), Abayashalawam (Absalom) the ban (son) of Maikah (Maacah) the banath (daughter) of Thalamay (Talmai) malak (king) of Gashawar (Geshur); the rabayaiy (fourth), Adanayah (Adonijah) the ban (son) of Chagayath (Haggith);
The chamayashay (fifth), Shapatayah (Shephatiah) of Abayatal (Abital); the shashay (sixth), Yatharaim (Ithream) by Igalah (Eglah) his ayashah (woman / wife):

Shash (six) were yalad (birth / begot) to him in Chabarawan (Hebron); and there he malak (king) shabai (seven) shanayam (years) and shash (six) chadashayam (months). In Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - shalawash (three) shanayam (years);

And these were yalad (birth / begot) to him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): Shamaia (Shimea), and Shawabab (Shobab), and Nathan (Nathan), and Shalamah (Solomon), arabai (four), of Bathashawai (Bathshua) the banath (daughter) of Imayaal (Ammiel);
And Yabachar (Ibhar), and Alayashamai (Elishama), and Alayapalat (Eliphelet),
And Nagah (Nogah), and Napag (Nepheg), and Yapayai (Japhia),
And Alayashamai (Elishama), and Alayadai (Eliada), and Alayapalat (Eliphelet), thashai (nine).
All these were the banay (sons) of Dawad (David), besides the banay (sons) of the payalagashayam (concubines); and Thamar (Tamar) was their achawath (sister).
Shalamah (Solomon's) ban (son) was Rachabaim (Rehoboam), Abayah (Abijah) his ban (son), Asaa (Asa) his ban (son), Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) his ban (son),
Yawaram (Joram) his ban (son), Achazayah (Ahaziah) his ban (son), Yawaash (Joash) his ban (son),
Amatzayah (Amaziah) his ban (son), Izarayah (Azariah) his ban (son), Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son),
Achaz (Ahaz) his ban (son), Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ban (son), Manashah (Manasseh) his ban (son),
Amawan (Amon) his ban (son), Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son).

The banay (sons) of Yaashayah (Josiah): the bakawar (firstborn) Yawachanan (Johanan), the shanay (second) Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), the shalayashay (third) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), the rabayaiy (fourth) Shalawam (Shallum).
The banay (sons) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim): Yakanayah (Jeconiah) his ban (son), Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) his ban (son).
The banay (sons) of Yakanayah (Jeconiah), the Asayar (captive): Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel) his ban (son),
And Malakayaram (Malchiram), and Padayah (Pedaiah), and Shanaatzar (Shenazzar), Yaqamayah (Jekamiah), Hawashamai (Hoshama), and Nadabayah (Nedabiah).

The banay (sons) of Padayah (Pedaiah): Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and Shamaiy (Shimei). The banay (sons) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel): Mashalam (Meshullam), and Chananayah (Hananiah); and Shalamayath (Shelomith) was their achawath (sister);
And Chashabah (Hashubah), and Ahal (Ohel), and Barakayah (Berechiah), and Chasadayah (Hasadiah), Yawashabachasad (Jushab Hesed), chamash (five).

The banay (sons) of Chananayah (Hananiah): Palatayah (Pelatiah), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah); the banay (sons) of Rapayah (Rephaiah), the banay (sons) of Aranan (Arnan), the banay (sons) of Ibadayah (Obadiah), the banay (sons) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah).

The banay (sons) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah). The banay (sons) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah): Chatawash (Hattush), and Yagaal (Igal), and Barayach (Bariah), and Nairayah (Neariah), and Shapat (Shaphat), shash (six).
The ban (son) of Nairayah (Neariah): Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), and Chazaqayah (Hizkiah), and Izarayaqam (Azrikam), shalawash (three).

The banay (sons) of Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai): Hawadayawahaw (Hodaviah), and Alayashayab (Eliashib), and Palayah (Pelaiah), and Iqawab (Akkub), and Yawachanan (Johanan), and Dalayah (Delaiah), and Inanay (Anani), shabai (seven).
The banay (sons) of Yahawadah (Judah): Paratz (Perez), Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Karamay (Carmi), and Chawar (Hur), and Shawabal (Shobal).

Raayah (Reaiah) the ban (son) of Shawabal (Shobal) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yachath (Jahath); and Yachath (Jahath) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Achawamay (Ahumai) and Lahad (Lahad). These are the mashapachawath (families) of the Tzaraiy (Zorathites).

These were the sons of the ab (father) of Iyatam (Etam): Yazaraial (Jezreel), and Yashamaa (Ishma), and Yadabash (Idbash); and the sham (name) of their achawath (sister) was Tzalalapawanay (Hazzelelponi);

And Panawaal (Penuel) the ab (father) of Gadar (Gedor), and Izar (Ezer) the ab (father) of Chawashah (Hushah). These are the banay (sons) of Chawar (Hur), the bakawar (firstborn) of Ephrathah, the ab (father) of Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem).
Ashachawar (Ashhur) the ab (father) of Thaqawai (Tekoa) had shanayam (two) wives, Chalaah (Helah) and Nairah (Naarah).
Nairah (Naarah) yalad (birth / begot) him Achazam (Ahuzzam), and Chapar (Hepher), and Thayamanay (Temeni), and Achashatharay (Haahashtari). These were the banay (sons) of Nairah (Naarah).
The banay (sons) of Chalaah (Helah) were Tzarath (Zereth), Izhar, and Athanan (Ethnan).
Qawatz (Hakkoz) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Inawab (Anub), and Tzababah (Zobebah), and the mashapachawath (families) of Acharachal (Aharhel) the ban (son) of Haram (Harum).
Yaibatz (Jabez) was more honorable than his ach (brother/kinsman): and his am (mother) sham (name) him Yaibatz (Jabez), amar (spoke), "Because I yalad (birth / begot) him with itzab (sorrow)."

Yaibatz (Jabez) qaraa (called) on the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "Oh that you would barak (blessed) me barak (blessed), and rabah (enlarge) my gabawal (border/boundary), and that your yad (hand) might be with me, and that you would ishah (make) me from rai (evil), that it not be to my sorrow!" Alahayam bawaa (come) him that which he shaal (requested).
Kalawab (Chelub) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Shawachah (Shuhah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Machayar (Mehir), who was the ab (father) of Ashathawan (Eshton).

Ashathawan (Eshton) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Bayatharapaa (Beth Rapha), and Pasach (Paseah), and Thachanah (Tehinnah) the ab (father) of Iyaranachash (Ir Nahash). These are the anashay (men) of Recah.
The banay (sons) of Qanaz (Kenaz): Ithanayaal (Othniel), and Sharayah (Seraiah). The banay (sons) of Ithanayaal (Othniel): Chathath (Hathath).

Maiwanathay (Meonothai) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Iparah (Ophrah): and Sharayah (Seraiah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yawaab (Joab) the ab (father) of Ge Charashayam (Harashim); for they were craftsmen.
The banay (sons) of Kalab (Caleb) the ban (son) of Yapanah (Jephunneh): Iyaraw (Iru), Alah (Elah), and Naim (Naam); and the banay (sons) of Alah (Elah); and Qanaz (Kenaz).
The banay (sons) of Yahalalaal (Jehallelel): Zayap (Ziph), and Zayapah (Ziphah), Thayarayaa (Tiria), and Asharaal (Asarel).

The ban (son) of Izarah (Ezrah): Yathar (Jether), and Marad (Mered), and Ipar (Epher), and Yalawan (Jalon); and she bore Marayam (Miriam), and Shamay (Shammai), and Yashabach (Ishbah) the ab (father) of Ashathamai (Eshtemoa).

His ayashah (woman / wife) the Jewess yalad (birth / begot) Yarad (Jered) the ab (father) of Gadar (Gedor), and Chabar (Heber) the ab (father) of Shawakah (Soco), and Yaqawathayaal (Jekuthiel) the ab (father) of Zanawach (Zanoah). These are the banay (sons) of Bathayah (Bithiah) the banath (daughter) of Paraih (Pharaoh), whom Marad (Mered) laqach (take / seize).

The banay (sons) of the ayashah (woman / wife) of Hawadayah (Hodiah), the achawath (sister) of Nacham (Naham), were the ab (father) of Qaiyalah (Keilah) the garamay (garmite), and Ashathamai (Eshtemoa) the Maikathay (Maacathite).

The banay (sons) of Shayamawan (Shimon): Amanawan (Amnon), and Ranah (Rinnah), Banachanan (Ben Hanan), and Thawalawan (Tilon). The banay (sons) of Yashaiy (Ishi): Zawachath (Zoheth), and Ben Zawachath (Zoheth).

The banay (sons) of Shalah (Shelah) the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ir (Er) the ab (father) of Lakah (Lecah), and Laidah (Laadah) the ab (father) of Maraashah (Mareshah), and the mashapachawath (families) of the bayath (house) of those who ibadah (worked) bawatz (fine) linen, of the bayath (house) of Ashabai (Ashbea);

And Yawaqayam (Jokim), and the anashay (men) of Kazabaa (Cozeba), and Yawaash (Joash), and Sharap (Saraph), who bail (had) dominion in Mawaab (Moab), and Yashabayalacham (Jashubilehem). The records are ithayaq (ancient).
These were the yawatzarayam (potters), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Nataiyam (Netaim) and Gederah: there they lived with the malak (king) for his malaakah (work).
The banay (sons) of Shamaiwan (Simeon): Namawaal (Nemuel), and Yamayan (Jamin), Yarayab (Jarib), Zarach (Zerah), Shaawal (Shaul);
Shalawam (Shallum) his ban (son), Mabasham (Mibsam) his ban (son), Mashamai (Mishma) his ban (son).
The banay (sons) of Mashamai (Mishma): Chamawaal (Hammuel) his ban (son), Zakawar (Zaccur) his ban (son), Shamaiy (Shimei) his ban (son).

Shamaiy (Shimei) had sixteen banayam (sons) and shash (six) banawath (daughters); but his ach (brother/kinsman) didn't rab (have) many banayam (children), neither did all their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) rabah (multiply) like the banayam (children) of Yahawadah (Judah).
They lived at Baar-Shabai (Beersheba), and Mawaladah (Moladah), and Chatzarashawail (Hazarshual),
And at Balahah (Bilhah), and at Itzam (Ezem), and at Thawalad (Tolad),
And at Bathawaal (Bethuel), and at Charamah (Hormah), and at Tzaqalag (Ziklag),

And at Bayathahamarakabawath (Beth Marcaboth), and Chatzarasawasayam (Hazar Susim), and at Bayathabaraay (Beth Biri), and at Shairayam (Shaaraim). These were their iyar (cities) to the malak (king) of Dawad (David).
Their chatzar (villages) were Iyatam (Etam), and Iyan (Ain), Ramawan (Rimmon), and Thakan (Tochen), and Ishan (Ashan), chamash (five) irayam (cities);
And all their chatzar (villages) that were around the same irayam (cities), to Bail (Baal). These were their habitations, and they have their yachash (genealogy).
Mashawabab (Meshobab), and Yamalak (Jamlech), and Yawashah (Joshah) the ban (son) of Amatzayah (Amaziah),
And Yawaal (Joel), and Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Yawashabayah (Joshibiah), the ban (son) of Sharayah (Seraiah), the ban (son) of Ishayaal (Asiel),
And Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), and Yaiqabah (Jaakobah), and Yashawachayah (Jeshohaiah), and Ishayah (Asaiah), and Idayaal (Adiel), and Yashayamaal (Jesimiel), and Banayah (Benaiah),
And Zayazaa (Ziza) the ban (son) of Shapaiy (Shiphi), the ban (son) of alawan (allon), the ban (son) of Yadayah (Jedaiah), the ban (son) of Shamaray (Shimri), the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah)—
These bawaa (come) by sham (name) were nashayaayam (princes) in their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family): and their ab (father)' bayath (house) paratz (increased) greatly.
They yalak (went) to the mabawaa (entrance) of Gadar (Gedor), even to the mazarach (east) side of the gayaa (valley), to baqash (seek) maraih (pasture) for their tzaan (flocks).

They matzaa (found) shaman (fat) maraih (pasture) and tawab (good / proper function), and the aratz (Earth/land) was rachab (wide), and shaqat (quiet), and shalaw (peaceable); for those who lived there panayam (face) were of Cham (Ham).

These kathab (write) by sham (name) bawaa (come) in the yamay (days) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and nakah (struck) their ahal (tents), and the Meunim who were matzaa (found) there, and charam (destroyed) them utterly to this yawam (day), and lived in their maraih (place); because there was pasture there for their tzaan (flocks).

Some of them, even of the banay (sons) of Shamaiwan (Simeon), chamash (five) maah (hundred) banay (men), halak (move) to har (mountain) Shaiyar (Seir), having for their raash (head) Palatayah (Pelatiah), and Nairayah (Neariah), and Rapayah (Rephaiah), and Izayaal (Uzziel), the banay (sons) of Yashaiy (Ishi).
They nakah (struck) the shaarayath (remnant) of the Imalaq (Amalekites) who palayatah (escaped), and have lived there to this yawam (day).

The banay (sons) of Raawaban (Reuben) the bakawar (firstborn) of Yashar-Al (Israel) (for he was the bakawar (firstborn); but, because he chalal (defiled) his ab (father) yatzawai (couch), his bakawarah (birthright) was nathan (give) to the banay (sons) of Yawasap (Joseph) the ban (son) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and the yachash (genealogy) is not to be reckoned after the bakawarah (birthright).
For Yahawadah (Judah) gabar (prevailed) above his ach (brother/kinsman), and of him came the nagayad (prince); but the bakawarah (birthright) was Yawasap (Joseph's):)
The banay (sons) of Raawaban (Reuben) the bakawar (firstborn) of Yashar-Al (Israel): Chanawak (Hanoch), and Palawaa (Pallu), Chatzarawan (Hezron), and Karamay (Carmi).
The banay (sons) of Yawaal (Joel): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) his ban (son), Gawag (Gog) his ban (son), Shamaiy (Shimei) his ban (son),
Mayakah (Micah) his ban (son), Raayah (Reaiah) his ban (son), Bail (Baal) his ban (son),
Baarah (Beerah) his ban (son), whom Thagalathapalaasar (Tilgath Pilneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) galah (carried) away captive: he was nashayaa (prince) of the Raawabanay (Reubenites).

His ach (brother/kinsman) by their mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), when the yachash (genealogy) of their thawaladah (generation) was yachash (reckoned): the raash (head), Yaiyaal (Jeiel), and Zakarayah (Zechariah),
And Balai (Bela) the ban (son) of Izaz (Azaz), the ban (son) of Shamai (Shema), the ban (son) of Yawaal (Joel), who lived in Irawair (Aroer), even to Nabaw (Nebo) and Bailamaiwan (Baal Meon):

And eastward he lived even to the entrance of the madabar (wilderness) from the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates), because their livestock were rabah (multiplied) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead).

In the yamay (days) of Shaawal (Saul), they ishah (make) malachamah (war) with the Hagaray (Hagrites), who napal (fall / be cast down) by their yad (hand); and they lived in their ahal (tents) throughout all the land mazarach (east) of Galaid (Gilead).
The banay (sons) of Gad (Gad) lived over against them, in the aratz (Earth/land) of Bashan (Bashan) to Salakah (Salecah):
Yawaal (Joel) the raash (head), and Shapam (Shapham) the mashanah (second), and Yainay (Janai), and Shapat (Shaphat) in Bashan (Bashan).

Their ach (brother/kinsman) of their ab (father)' bayath (house): Mayakaal (Michael), and Mashalam (Meshullam), and shabai (sheba), and Yawaray (Jorai), and Yaikan (Jacan), and Zayai (Zia), and Ibar (Eber), shabai (seven).

These were the banay (sons) of Abayahayal (Abihail), the ban (son) of Chawaray (Huri), the ban (son) of Yarawach (Jaroah), the ban (son) of Galaid (Gilead), the ban (son) of Mayakaal (Michael), the ban (son) of Yashayashay (Jeshishai), the ban (son) of Yachadaw (Jahdo), the ban (son) of Bawaz (Buz);
Achay (Ahi) the ban (son) of Ibadayaal (Abdiel), the ban (son) of Gawanay (Guni), raash (head) of their ab (father)' bayath (house).
They lived in Galaid (Gilead) in Bashan (Bashan), and in its banath (daughter), and in all the magarashay (suburbs) of Sharawan (Sharon), as far as their thawatzaah (borders).

All these were yachash (reckoned) by genealogies in the yamay (days) of Yawatham (Jotham) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the yamay (days) of Yarabaim (Jeroboam) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

The banay (sons) of Raawaban (Reuben), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), of valiant banay (men), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) nashaa (lift) to bear magan (shield) and charab (sword), and to shoot with qashath (bow), and skillful in malachamah (war), were arabaiyam (forty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) and shashayam (sixty), that were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop).
They ishah (make) malachamah (war) with the Hagaray (Hagrites), with Yatawar (Jetur), and Napayash (Naphish), and Nawadab (Nodab).

They were izar (helped) against them, and the Hagaray (Hagrites) were nathan (give) into their yad (hand), and all who were with them; for they zaiq (cried) to Alahayam in the malachamah (battle), and he was entreated of them, because they batach (put) their trust in him.

They shabah (took) away their livestock; of their gamal (camels) chamashayam (fifty) alap (thousand), and of tzaan (sheep) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) alap (thousand), and of donkeys two alap (thousand), and of adam (men) one maah (hundred) alap (thousand).
For there napal (fall / be cast down) many chalal (slain), because the malachamah (war) was of Alahayam. They lived in their place until the gawalah (captivity).

The banay (children) of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) lived in the aratz (Earth/land): they rabah (increased) from Bashan (Bashan) to Bailacharamawan (Baal Hermon) and Shanayar (Senir) and har (mountain) Bailacharamawan (Hermon).

These were the raashay (heads) of their ab (father)' bayath (house): even Ipar (Epher), and Yashaiy (Ishi), and Alayaal (Eliel), and Izarayaal (Azriel), and Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and Hawadawayah (Hodaviah), and Yachadayaal (Jahdiel), gabawar (mighty) raashay (men) of valor, sham (name) raashay (men), raashay (heads) of their ab (father)' bayath (house).

They mail (top/above) against the Alahayam of their ab (father), and zanah (played) the prostitute achar (other) the Alahayam of the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land), whom Alahayam destroyed panayam (face) them.

The Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel) iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Pawal (Pul) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and the rawach (spirit / wind) of Thagalathapalaasar (Tilgath Pilneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and he galah (carried) them away, even the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), and bawaa (come) them to Chalach (Halah), and Chabawar (Habor), and Haraa (Hara), and to the nahar (river) of Gawazan (Gozan), to this yawam (day).
The banay (sons) of Laway (Levi): Gershon, Qahath (Kohath), and Mararay (Merari).
The banay (sons) of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The banay (children) of Imaram (Amram): Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The banay (sons) of Aaron: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
Eleazar became the ab (father) of Phinehas, Phinehas became the ab (father) of Abishua,
And Abishua became the father of Labanay (Bukki), and Labanay (Bukki) became the father of Uzzi,
And Uzzi became the father of Yaatharay (Zerahiah), and Yaatharay (Zerahiah) became the father of Meraioth,
Meraioth became the father of Qahath (Amariah), and Qahath (Amariah) became the father of Ahitub,
And Ahitub became the father of Abayasap (Zadok), and Abayasap (Zadok) became the father of Ahimaaz,
And Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah, and Azariah became the father of Johanan,
And Johanan became the father of Azariah, (he it is who executed the priest's office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem),
And Azariah became the father of Amariah, and Amariah became the father of Ahitub,
And Ahitub became the father of Zadok, and Zadok became the father of Shallum,
And Shallum became the father of Washanay (Hilkiah), and Washanay (Hilkiah) became the father of Azariah,
And Azariah became the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak;
Jehozadak went into captivity, when Yahawah carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.
The banay (sons) of Kohath were Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
The ban (son) of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Ban (Levites) according to their fathers' households.
Of Gershom: Libni his ban (son), Jahath his ban (son), Zimmah his ban (son),
Joah his ban (son), Iddo his ban (son), Zerah his ban (son), Jeatherai his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Kohath: Amminadab his ban (son), Qarach (Korah) his ban (son), Asayar (Assir) his ban (son),
Elkanah his ban (son), and Ebiasaph his ban (son), and Assir his ban (son),
Tahath his ban (son), Uriel his ban (son), Uzziah his ban (son), and Shaul his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Elkanah: Amasai, and Ahimoth.
As for Athanay (Elkanah), the ban (son) of Athanay (Elkanah): Zophai his ban (son), and Nahath his ban (son),
Eliab his ban (son), Jeroham his ban (son), Elkanah his ban (son).
The ban (son) of Samuel: the ban (son) Joel, and the second Abijah.
The banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari): Mahli, Libni his ban (son), Shimei his ban (son), Uzzah his ban (son),
Shimea his ban (son), Haggiah his ban (son), Asaiah his ban (son).
These are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of Yahawah, after that the ark had rest.
They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, until Solomon had built the house of Yahawah in Jerusalem: and they waited on their office according to their order.
These are those who waited, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,
The ban (son) of Elkanah, the ban (son) of Jeroham, the ban (son) of Eliel, the ban (son) of Toah,
The ban (son) of Zuph, the ban (son) of Elkanah, the ban (son) of Mahath, the ban (son) of Amasai,
The ban (son) of Elkanah, the ban (son) of Joel, the ban (son) of Azariah, the ban (son) of Zephaniah,
The ban (son) of Tahath, the ban (son) of Assir, the ban (son) of Ebiasaph, the ban (son) of Korah,
The ban (son) of Izhar, the ban (son) of Kohath, the ban (son) of Levi, the ban (son) of Israel.
His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the ban (son) of Berechiah, the ban (son) of Shimea,
The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,
The ban (son) of Ethni, the ban (son) of Zerah, the ban (son) of Adaiah,
The ban (son) of Ethan, the ban (son) of Zimmah, the ban (son) of Shimei,
The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
The ban (son) of Amzi, the ban (son) of Bani, the ban (son) of Shemer,
The ban (son) of Mahli, the ban (son) of Mushi, the ban (son) of Merari, the ban (son) of Levi.
Their brothers the Ban (Levites) were ban (son) for all the service of the tabernacle of the house of Alahayam.

But Aaron and his banay (sons) nathan (give) on the altar of burnt nathan (give), and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Yashar-Al (Israel), according to all that Moses the ban (son) of Alahayam had commanded.
These are the banay (sons) of Aaron: Eleazar his ban (son), Phinehas his ban (son), Abishua his ban (son),
Bukki his ban (son), Uzzi his ban (son), Zerahiah his ban (son),
Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),
To them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its magarash (suburbs) around it;
But the fields of the city, and its villages, they gave to Caleb the ban (son) of Jephunneh.
To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron; Libnah also with its magarash (suburbs), and Jattir, and Eshtemoa with its magarash (suburbs),
And Hilen with its magarash (suburbs), Debir with its magarash (suburbs),
And Ashan with its magarash (suburbs), and Beth Shemesh with its magarash (suburbs);

And out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its magarash (suburbs), and Allemeth with its magarash (suburbs), and Anathoth with its magarash (suburbs). All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the matah (staff / rod / tribe), out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

To the banay (sons) of Gershom, according to their families, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Issachar, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Asher, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Naphtali, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zebulun, twelve cities.
The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their magarash (suburbs).

They gave by lot out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the children of Judah, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the children of Simeon, and out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.
Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

They nathan (give) to them the iyar (cities) of maqalat (refuge), Shakam (Shechem) in the har (mountain) country of Aparayam (Ephraim) with its magarash (suburbs); Gazar (Gezer) also with its magarash (suburbs),
And Yaqamaim (Jokmeam) with its magarash (suburbs), and Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Ayalawan (Aijalon) with its magarash (suburbs), and Gatharamawan (Gath Rimmon) with its magarash (suburbs);

And out of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), Inar (Aner) with its magarash (suburbs), and Balaim (Bileam) with its magarash (suburbs), for the yathar (rest) of the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the ban (son) of Qahath (Kohath).

To the ban (son) of Garasham (Gershom) were given, out of the mashapachah (tribe / clan / family) of the half-tribe of Manashah (Manasseh), Gawalan (Golan) in Bashan (Bashan) with its magarash (suburbs), and Ishatharawath (Ashtaroth) with its magarash (suburbs);
And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Yashashakar (Issachar), Qadash (Kedesh) with its magarash (suburbs), dabarath (daberath) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Raamawath (Ramoth) with its magarash (suburbs), and Inam (Anem) with its magarash (suburbs);
And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Ashar (Asher), Mashal (Mashal) with its magarash (suburbs), and Ibadawan (Abdon) with its magarash (suburbs),
And chaqaq (lawgiver) with its magarash (suburbs), and Rachab (Rehob) with its magarash (suburbs);

And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Napathalay (Naphtali), Qadash (Kedesh) in Galayal (Galilee) with its magarash (suburbs), and Chamawan (Hammon) with its magarash (suburbs), and Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim) with its magarash (suburbs).

To the yathar (rest) of the Levites, the ban (son) of Mararay (Merari), were given, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Ramawan (Rimmono) with its magarash (suburbs), Thabawar (Tabor) with its magarash (suburbs);

And ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) at Yarayachaw (Jericho), on the east ibar (side) of the Yaradan (Jordan), were given them, out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Raawaban (Reuben), Batzar (Bezer) in the madabar (wilderness) with its magarash (suburbs), and Yahatz (Jahzah) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Qadamawath (Kedemoth) with its magarash (suburbs), and Mawapaith (Mephaath) with its magarash (suburbs);
And out of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of Gad (Gad), Raamawath (Ramoth) in Galaid (Gilead) with its magarash (suburbs), and Machanayam (Mahanaim) with its magarash (suburbs),
And Chashabawan (Heshbon) with its magarash (suburbs), and Yaizayar (Jazer) with its magarash (suburbs).
Of the banay (sons) of Yashashakar (Issachar): Thawalai (Tola), and Pawaah (Puah), Yashawab (Jashub), and Shamarawan (Shimron), arabai (four).

The banay (sons) of Thawalai (Tola): Izay (Uzzi), and Rapayah (Rephaiah), and Yarayaal (Jeriel), and Yachamay (Jahmai), and Yabasham (Ibsam), and Shamawaal (Shemuel), raashayam (heads) of their ab (father)' bayath (house), of Thawalai (Tola); chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) gabawaray (men) of valor in their thawaladah (generation): their masapar (number) in the yamay (days) of Dawad (David) was isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Izay (Uzzi): Yazarachayah (Izrahiah). The banay (sons) of Yazarachayah (Izrahiah): Mayakaal (Michael), and Ibadayah (Obadiah), and Yawaal (Joel), Yashayah (Isshiah), chamash (five); all of them raash (head) men.

With them, by their thawaladah (generation), after their ab (father)' bayath (house), were gadawaday (bands) of the tzabaa (troop) for malachamah (war), shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six) alap (thousand); for they rabah (had) many wives and banayam (sons).

Their ach (brother/kinsman) among all the mashapachawath (families) of Yashashakar (Issachar), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) gabawaray (men) of valor, yachash (reckoned) in all by genealogy, were shamanayam (eighty) - shabai (seven) alap (thousand).
The sons of Banayamayan (Benjamin): Balai (Bela), and Bakar (Becher), and Yadayaial (Jediael), shalawash (three).

The banay (sons) of Balai (Bela): Atzabawan (Ezbon), and Izay (Uzzi), and Izayaal (Uzziel), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth), and Iyaray (Iri), chamash (five); raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' bayath (house), gabawar (mighty) chayalayam (men) of valor; and they were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shalawashayam (thirty) - arabai (four).

The banay (sons) of Bakar (Becher): Zamayarah (Zemirah), and Yawaish (Joash), and Alayaizar (Eliezer), and Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), and Imaray (Omri), and Yarayamawath (Jeremoth), and Abayah (Abijah), and Inathawath (Anathoth), and Ilamath (Alemeth). All these were the banay (sons) of Bakar (Becher).

They were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy, after their thawaladah (generation), raashay (heads) of their ab (father)' bayath (house), gabawar (mighty) men of valor, isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) two maah (hundred).

The banay (sons) of Yadayaial (Jediael): Balahan (Bilhan). The banay (sons) of Balahan (Bilhan): Yaiwash (Jeush), and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and Ahawad (Ehud), and Kanainah (Chenaanah), and Zayathan (Zethan), and Tharashayash (Tarshish), and Achayashachar (Ahishahar).

All these were banay (sons) of Yadayaial (Jediael), according to the raashay (heads) of their abawath (fathers)' households, gabawar (mighty) chayalayam (men) of valor, seventeen alap (thousand) and two maah (hundred), who were yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth in the tzabaa (troop) for tzabaa (troop).
Shapayam (Shuppim) also, and Chapayam (Huppim), the banay (sons) of Iyar (Ir), Chawashayam (Hushim), the banay (sons) of Achar (Aher).
The banay (sons) of Napathalay (Naphtali): Yachatzayaal (Jahziel), and Gawanay (Guni), and Yatzar (Jezer), and Shalawam (Shallum), the banay (sons) of Balahah (Bilhah).

The banay (sons) of Manashah (Manasseh): Asharayaal (Asriel), whom his payalagash (concubine) the aramay (aramitess) yalad (birth / begot): she yalad (birth / begot) Makayar (Machir) the ab (father) of Galaid (Gilead):

And Makayar (Machir) laqach (take / seize) a ayashah (woman / wife) of Chapayam (Huppim) and Shapayam (Shuppim), whose achawath (sister's) sham (name) was Maikah (Maacah); and the sham (name) of the shanay (second) was Tzalapachad (Zelophehad): and Tzalapachad (Zelophehad) had banawath (daughters).

Maikah (Maacah) the ayashah (woman / wife) of Makayar (Machir) yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son), and she sham (name) him Parash (Peresh); and the sham (name) of his ach (brother/kinsman) was Sharash (Sheresh); and his ban (son) were Awalam (Ulam) and Raqam (Rakem).
The banay (sons) of Awalam (Ulam): Badan (Bedan). These were the banay (sons) of Galaid (Gilead) the ban (son) of Makayar (Machir), the ban (son) of Manashah (Manasseh).
His achawath (sister) Malakath (Hammolecheth) yalad (birth / begot) Ayashahawad (Ishhod), and Abayaizar (Abiezer), and Machalah (Mahlah).
The banay (sons) of Shamayadai (Shemida) were Achayan (Ahian), and Shakam (Shechem), and Laqachay (Likhi), and Anayaim (Aniam).

The banay (sons) of Aparayam (Ephraim): Shawathalach (Shuthelah), and Barad (Bered) his ban (son), and Thachath (Tahath) his ban (son), and Alaidah (Eleadah) his ban (son), and Thachath (Tahath) his ban (son),

And Zabad (Zabad) his ban (son), and Shawathalach (Shuthelah) his ban (son), and Izar (Ezer), and Alaid (Elead), whom the ban (son) of gath (gath) who were yalad (birth / begot) in the aratz (Earth/land) harag (kill), because they yarad (came) down to laqach (take / seize) away their livestock.
Aparayam (Ephraim) their ab (father) abal (mourned) many yamayam (days), and his ach (brother/kinsman) bawaa (come) to nacham (turn away / repent) him.

He bawaa (come) in to his ayashah (woman / wife), and she harah (conceived), and yalad (birth / begot) a ban (son), and he sham (name) him Barayaih (Beriah), because it went rai (evil) with his bayath (house).
His banath (daughter) was Shaarah (Sheerah), who banah (build) Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon) the thachathawan (lower) and the ilayawan (Ilayawan), and Azanashaarah (Uzzen Sheerah).
Rapach (Rephah) was his ban (son), and Rashap (Resheph), and Thalach (Telah) his ban (son), and Thachan (Tahan) his ban (son),
Laidan (Ladan) his ban (son), Imayahawad (Ammihud) his ban (son), Alayashamai (Elishama) his ban (son),
Nawan (Nun) his ban (son), Yahawashawai (Joshua) his ban (son).

Their achazah (possessions) and habitations were Bayath-Al (Bethel) and its banath (daughter), and eastward Nairan (Naaran), and westward Gazar (Gezer), with its banath (daughter); Shakam (Shechem) also and its banath (daughter), to Izah (Azzah) and its banath (daughter);

And by the yaday (borders) of the banay (children) of Manashah (Manasseh), Bayath-Shaan (Beth Shean) and its banath (daughter), Thainak (Taanach) and its banath (daughter), Magadawan (Megiddo) and its banath (daughter), Dawar (Dor) and its banath (daughter). In these lived the banay (children) of Yawasap (Joseph) the ban (son) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
The banay (sons) of Ashar (Asher): Yamanah (Imnah), and Yashawah (Ishvah), and Yashaway (Ishvi), and Barayaih (Beriah), and Sharach (Serah) their achawath (sister).
The banay (sons) of Barayaih (Beriah): Chabar (Heber), and Malakayaal (Malchiel), who was the ab (father) of Barazawath (Birzaith).
Chabar (Heber) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yapalat (Japhlet), and Shawamar (Shomer), and Chawatham (Hotham), and Shawaia (Shua) their achawath (sister).
The banay (sons) of Yapalat (Japhlet): Pasak (Pasach), and Bamahal (Bimhal), and Ishawath (Ashvath). These are the banay (children) of Yapalat (Japhlet).
The banay (sons) of Shamar (Shemer): Achay (Ahi), and Rawahagah (Rohgah), Yachabah (Jehubbah), and Aram (Aram).
The ban (son) of Halam (Helem) his ach (brother/kinsman): Tzawapach (Zophah), and Yamanai (Imna), and Shalash (Shelesh), and Imal (Amal).
The banay (sons) of Tzawapach (Zophah): Sawach (Suah), and Charanapar (Harnepher), and Shawail (Shual), and Baray (Beri), and Yamarah (Imrah),
Batzar (Bezer), and Hawad (Hod), and Shamaa (Shamma), and Shalashah (Shilshah), and Yatharan (Ithran), and Baaraa (Beera).
The banay (sons) of Yathar (Jether): Yapanah (Jephunneh), and Pasapah (Pispa), and Araa (Ara).
The banay (sons) of Ilaa (Ulla): Arach (Arah), and Chanayaal (Hanniel), and Ratzayaa (Rizia).

All these were the banay (children) of Ashar (Asher), raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' bayath (house), barar (choice) and gabawar (mighty) men of valor, raash (head) of the nashayaayam (princes). The masapar (number) of them reckoned by yachash (genealogy) for tzabaa (troop) in war was isharayam (twenty) - shash (six) alap (thousand) banay (men).
Banayamayan (Benjamin) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Balai (Bela) his bakawar (firstborn), Ashabal (Ashbel) the shanay (second), and Acharach (Aharah) the shalayashay (third),
Nawachah (Nohah) the rabayaiy (fourth), and Rapaa (Rapha) the chamayashay (fifth).
Balai (Bela) had banayam (sons): Adar (Addar), and Garaa (Gera), and Abayahawad (Abihud),
And Abayashawai (Abishua), and Naiman (Naaman), and Achawach (Ahoah),
And Garaa (Gera), and Shapawapam (Shephuphan), and Chawaram (Huram).

These are the banay (sons) of Achawad (Ehud): these are the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households of the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Gabai (Geba), and they galah (carried) them captive to Manachath (Manahath):
And Naiman (Naaman), and Achayah (Ahijah), and Garaa (Gera), he galah (carried) them captive: and he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Izaa (Uzza) and Achayachad (Ahihud).
Shacharayam (Shaharaim) became the yalad (birth / begot) of children in the field of Mawaab (Moab), man (from) he had shalach (send) them away; Chawashayam (Hushim) and Bairaa (Baara) were his wives.
He became the yalad (birth / begot) of Chadash (Hodesh) his ayashah (woman / wife), Yawabab (Jobab), and Tzabayaa (Zibia), and Mayashaa (Mesha), and Malakam (Malcam),
And Yaiwatz (Jeuz), and Shabayah (Shachia), and Maramah (Mirmah). These were his ban (son), raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households.
Of Chawashayam (Hushim) he became the yalad (birth / begot) of Abayatawab (Abitub) and Alapail (Elpaal).
The banay (sons) of Alapail (Elpaal): Ibar (Eber), and Mashaim (Misham), and Shamar (Shemed), who banah (build) Awanaw (Ono) and Lad (Lod), with its banath (daughter);

And Barayaih (Beriah), and Shamai (Shema), who were raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households of the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Ayalawan (Aijalon), who barach (put) to flight the yawashabay (inhabitants) of gath (gath);
And Achayaw (Ahio), Shashaq (Shashak), and Yarayamawath (Jeremoth),
And Zabadayah (Zebadiah), and Irad (Arad), and Idar (Eder),
And Mayakaal (Michael), and Yashapah (Ishpah), and Yawachaa (Joha), the banay (sons) of Barayaih (Beriah),
And Zabadayah (Zebadiah), and Mashalam (Meshullam), and Chazaqay (Hizki), and Chabar (Heber),
And Yashamaray (Ishmerai), and Yazalayaah (Izliah), and Yawabab (Jobab), the banay (sons) of Alapail (Elpaal),
And Yaqayam (Jakim), and Zakaray (Zichri), and Zabaday (Zabdi),
And Alayaiyanay (Elienai), and Tzalathay (Zillethai), and Alayaal (Eliel),
And Idayah (Adaiah), and Baraayah (Beraiah), and Shamarath (Shimrath), the banay (sons) of Shamaiy (Shimei),
And Yashapan (Ishpan), and Ibar (Eber), and Alayaal (Eliel),
And Ibadawan (Abdon), and Zakaray (Zichri), and Chanan (Hanan),
And Chananayah (Hananiah), and Iyalam (Elam), and Inathathayah (Anthothijah),
And Yapadayah (Iphdeiah), and Panawaal (Penuel), the banay (sons) of Shashaq (Shashak),
And Shamasharay (Shamsherai), and Shacharayah (Shehariah), and Ithalayah (Athaliah),
And Yairashayah (Jaareshiah), and Alayah (Elijah), and Zakaray (Zichri), the banay (sons) of Yaracham (Jeroham).
These were raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households throughout their thawaladah (generation), raash (head) men: these lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
In Gabaiwan (Gibeon) there lived the ab (father) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon), whose ayashah (woman / wife) sham (name) was Maikah (Maacah);
And his bakawar (firstborn) ban (son) Ibadawan (Abdon), and Tzawar (Zur), and Qayash (Kish), and Bail (Baal), and Nadab (Nadab),
And Gadar (Gedor), and Achayaw (Ahio), and Zakar (Zecher).
Maqalawath (Mikloth) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shamaah (Shimeah). They also lived with their ach (brother/kinsman) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), over nagad (against) their brothers.

Nar (Ner) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Qayash (Kish); and Qayash (Kish) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Shaawal (Saul); and Shaawal (Saul) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yahawanathan (Jonathan), and Malakayashawai (Malchishua), and Abayanadab (Abinadab), and Ashabail (Eshbaal).
The ban (son) of Yahawanathan (Jonathan) was Marayababail (Merib Baal); and Marayababail (Merib Baal) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Mayakah (Micah).
The banay (sons) of Mayakah (Micah): Payathawan (Pithon), and malak (king), and Thaarai (Tarea), and Achaz (Ahaz).

Achaz (Ahaz) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yahawaidah (Jehoaddah); and Yahawaidah (Jehoaddah) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Ilamath (Alemeth), and Izamawath (Azmaveth), and Zamaray (Zimri); and Zamaray (Zimri) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Mawatzaa (Moza).
Mawatzaa (Moza) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Banaia (Binea); Rapaa (Raphah) was his ban (son), Alaishah (Eleasah) his ban (son), Atzal (Azel) his ban (son).
