"Isn't Yahawah your Alahayam with you? Hasn't he given you nawach (rest) on sabayab (surrounding) side? For he nathan (give) delivered the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) into my yad (hand); and the aratz (Earth/land) is kabash (subdued) panayam (face) Yahawah, and panayam (face) his im (nation / people).

Now nathan (give) your labab (heart) and your napash (soul) to darash (seek) after Yahawah your Alahayam. Qawam (rise up) therefore, and banah (build) the maqadash (sanctuary) of Yahawah Alahayam, to bawaa (come) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and the qadash (set apart / make holy) kalay (vessels) of Alahayam, into the bayath (house) that is to be banah (build) to the sham (name) of Yahawah."
Now Dawad (David) was zaqan (old) and shabai (full) of yamayam (days); and he made Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son) malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel).
He asap (gathered) together all the sharay (princes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), with the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites).

The Lawayay (Levites) were sapar (book) from shalawashayam (thirty) years old and upward: and their masapar (number) by their galagalath (polls), gabar (man) by gabar (man), was shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eight) alap (thousand).

David said, "Of these, isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand) were to natzach (oversee) the malaakah (work) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; shash (six) alap (thousand) were shatarayam (officers) and shapatayam (judges);
Arabai (four) alap (thousand) were shairayam (doorkeepers); and arabai (four) alap (thousand) halal (praise) Yahawah with the kalayam (instruments) which I ishah (make), for giving halal (praise)."
Dawad (David) chalaq (divided) them into machalaqawath (divisions) according to the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi): Gershon, Qahath (Kohath), and Mararay (Merari).
Of the garashanay (gershonites): Laidan (Ladan) and Shamaiy (Shimei).
The banay (sons) of Laidan (Ladan): Yachayaal (Jehiel) the raash (head), and Zatham (Zetham), and Yawaal (Joel), shalawash (three).

The banay (sons) of Shamaiy (Shimei): Shalamawath (Shelomoth), and Chazayaal (Haziel), and Haran (Haran), shalawash (three). These were the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of Laidan (Ladan).
The banay (sons) of Shamaiy (Shimei): Yachath (Jahath), Zayanaa (Zina), and Yaiwash (Jeush), and Barayaih (Beriah). These arabai (four) were the banay (sons) of Shamaiy (Shimei).

Yachath (Jahath) was the raash (head), and Zayazah (Zizah) the shanay (second): but Yaiwash (Jeush) and Barayaih (Beriah) didn't rabah (have) many banayam (sons); therefore they became a ab (father)' bayath (house) in achad (one) paqadah (reckoning).
The banay (sons) of Qahath (Kohath): Imaram (Amram), Yatzahar (Izhar), Chabarawan (Hebron), and Izayaal (Uzziel), arabai (four).

The banay (sons) of Imaram (Amram): Aharawan (Aaron) and Mashah (Moses); and Aharawan (Aaron) was badal (separated), that he should qadash (set apart / make holy) the most qadash (set apart / make holy) things, he and his banay (sons), iwalam (forever), to qatar (burn) incense panayam (face) Yahawah, to sharath (minister) to him, and to barak (blessed) in his sham (name), iwalam (forever).
But as for Mashah (Moses) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, his ban (son) were qaraa (called) among the shabat (tribe) of Laway (Levi).
The banay (sons) of Mashah (Moses): Garasham (Gershom) and Alayaizar (Eliezer).
The banay (sons) of Garasham (Gershom): Shabawaal (Shebuel) the raash (head).
The banay (sons) of Alayaizar (Eliezer) were: Rachabayah (Rehabiah) the raash (head); and Alayaizar (Eliezer) had no other banay (sons); but the banay (sons) of Rachabayah (Rehabiah) were very many.
The banay (sons) of Yatzahar (Izhar): Shalamayath (Shelomith) the raash (head).

The banay (sons) of Chabarawan (Hebron): Yarayah (Jeriah) the raash (head), Amarayah (Amariah) the shanay (second), Yachazayaal (Jahaziel) the shalayashay (third), and Yaqamaim (Jekameam) the rabayaiy (fourth).
The banay (sons) of Izayaal (Uzziel): Mayakah (Micah) the raash (head), and Yashayah (Isshiah) the shanay (second).
The banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari): Machalay (Mahli) and Mawashay (Mushi). The banay (sons) of Machalay (Mahli): Alaizar (Eleazar) and Qayash (Kish).
Alaizar (Eleazar) mawath (death), and had no banayam (sons), but banawath (daughters) only: and their ach (brother/kinsman) the banayam (sons) of Qayash (Kish) nashaa (lift) them as wives.
The banay (sons) of Mawashay (Mushi): Machalay (Mahli), and Idar (Eder), and Yarayamawath (Jeremoth), shalawash (three).

These were the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi) after their abawath (fathers)' bayath (house), even the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' houses of those who were paqad (visit) individually, in the masapar (number) of shamawath (names) by their galagalath (polls), who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, from isharayam (twenty) years ban (son) and upward.
For Dawad (David) amar (spoke), "Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), has given nawach (rest) to his im (nation / people); and he shakan (place) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) iwalam (forever).
Also the Lawayay (Levites) will no longer nashaa (lift) to carry the mashakan (tabernacle) and all its kalay (vessels) for its ibadah (service)."
For by the acharawan (last) dabaray (words) of Dawad (David) the lawayay (sons) of Levi were masapar (numbered), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward.

For their maimad (office) was to yad (hand) on the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the chatzarawath (courts), and in the rooms, and in the purifying of all qadash (set apart / make holy) things, even the maishah (work) of the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam;

For the show lacham (bread) also, and for the fine salath (flour) for a meal manachah (offering), whether of unleavened raqayaqay (wafers), or of that which is baked in the machabath (pan), or of that which is soaked, and for all kinds of mashawarah (measure) and madah (size);
And to imad (stand) every baqar (morning) to yadah (thank) and halal (praise) Yahawah, and likewise in the irab (evening);

And to ilah (go up / offer) all burnt ilawath (offerings) to Yahawah, on the shabathawath (sabbaths), on the new chadashayam (moons), and on the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, in masapar (number) according to the mashapat (ordinance) concerning them, continually panayam (face) Yahawah;

And that they should shamar (keep/guard) the duty of the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and the duty of the qadash (set apart / make holy) place, and the duty of the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron) their ach (brother/kinsman), for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
These were the machalaqath (divisions) of the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron). The banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron): Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu), Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar).

But Nadab (Nadab) and Abayahawaa (Abihu) mawath (death) panayam (face) their ab (father), and had no banayam (children): therefore Alaizar (Eleazar) and Ayathamar (Ithamar) executed the yakahanaw (priests) office.

Dawad (David) with Tzadawaq (Zadok) of the banay (sons) of Alaizar (Eleazar), and Achayamalak (Ahimelech) of the banay (sons) of Ayathamar (Ithamar), chalaq (divided) them according to their paqadah (ordering) in their ibadah (service).

There were more raash (head) gabarayam (men) matzaa (found) of the banay (sons) of Alaizar (Eleazar) than of the banay (sons) of Ayathamar (Ithamar); and they were chalaq (divided) like this: of the banay (sons) of Alaizar (Eleazar) there were sixteen, raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' bayath (house); and of the banay (sons) of Ayathamar (Ithamar), according to their abawath (fathers)' bayath (house), shamanah (eight).

Thus were they chalaq (divided) impartially by drawing gawaralawath (lots); for there were sharay (princes) of the qadash (set apart / make holy), and sharay (princes) of Alahayam, both of the banay (sons) of Alaizar (Eleazar), and of the banay (sons) of Ayathamar (Ithamar).

Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ban (son) of Nathanaal (Nethanel) the sapar (book), who was of the Lawayay (Levites), kathab (write) them in the panayam (face) of the malak (king), and the sharayam (princes), and Tzadawaq (Zadok) the kahan (priest), and Achayamalak (Ahimelech) the ban (son) of Abayathar (Abiathar), and the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the kahanayam (priests) and of the Lawayay (Levites); achad (one) abawath (fathers)' bayath (house) being achaz (taken) for Alaizar (Eleazar), and one achaz (taken) for Ayathamar (Ithamar).
Now the raashawan (first) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to Yahawayarayab (Jehoiarib), the shanay (second) to Yadaiyah (Jedaiah),
The shalayashay (third) to Charam (Harim), the rabayaiy (fourth) to Shairayam (Seorim),
The chamayashay (fifth) to Malakayah (Malchijah), the shashay (sixth) to Mayaman (Mijamin),
The shabayaiy (seventh) to Qawatz (Hakkoz), the shamayanay (eighth) to Abayah (Abijah),
The thashayaiy (ninth) to Yashawai (Jeshua), the ishayaray (tenth) to Shakanayah (Shecaniah),
The ishathay (eleven) to Alayashayab (Eliashib), the shanayam (two) to Yaqayam (Jakim),
The thirteenth to Chapah (Huppah), the fourteenth to Yashabaab (Jeshebeab),
The fifteenth to Balagah (Bilgah), the sixteenth to Amar (Immer),
The seventeenth to Chazayar (Hezir), the eighteenth to Patzatz (Happizzez),
The nineteenth to Pathachayah (Pethahiah), the isharayam (twenty) to Yachazaqaal (Jehezkel),
The isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) to Yakayan (Jachin), the isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) to Gamawal (Gamul),
The isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) to Dalayah (Delaiah), the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) to Maizayah (Maaziah).

This was their paqadah (ordering) in their ibadah (service), to bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah according to the mashapat (ordinance) given to them by Aharawan (Aaron) their ab (father), as Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), had tzawah (commanded) him.
Of the yathar (rest) of the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi): of the banay (sons) of Imaram (Amram), Shabawaal (Shubael); of the banay (sons) of Shabawaal (Shubael), Yachadayahaw (Jehdeiah).
Of Rachabayah (Rehabiah): of the banay (sons) of Rachabayah (Rehabiah), Yashayah (Isshiah) the raash (head).
Of the yatzaharay (izharites), Shalamawath (Shelomoth); of the banay (sons) of Shalamawath (Shelomoth), Yachath (Jahath).
The banay (sons) of Hebron: Yarayah (Jeriah), Amarayah (Amariah) the shanay (second), Yachazayaal (Jahaziel) the shalayashay (third), Yaqamaim (Jekameam) the rabayaiy (fourth).
The banay (sons) of Izayaal (Uzziel), Mayakah (Micah); of the banay (sons) of Mayakah (Micah), Shamawar (Shamir).
The ach (brother/kinsman) of Mayakah (Micah), Yashayah (Isshiah); of the banay (sons) of Yashayah (Isshiah), Zakarayah (Zechariah).
The banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari): Machalay (Mahli) and Mawashay (Mushi); the banay (sons) of Yaizayahaw (Jaaziah): Beno.
The banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari): of Yaizayahaw (Jaaziah), Beno, and Shaham (Shoham), and Zakawar (Zaccur), and Ibaray (Ibri).
Of Machalay (Mahli): Alaizar (Eleazar), who had no banayam (sons).
Of Qayash (Kish); the banay (sons) of Qayash (Kish): Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel).
The banay (sons) of Mawashay (Mushi): Machalay (Mahli), and Idar (Eder), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth). These were the banay (sons) of the Lawayay (Levites) after their ab (father)' bayath (house).

These likewise napal (fall / be cast down) gawaralawath (lots) even as their ach (brother/kinsman) the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron) in the panayam (face) of Dawad (David) the malak (king), and Tzadawaq (Zadok), and Achayamalak (Ahimelech), and the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the kahanayam (priests) and of the Lawayay (Levites); the abawath (fathers)' households of the raash (head) even as those of his younger ach (brother/kinsman).

Moreover, Dawad (David) and the sharay (captains) of the tzabaa (troop) set apart for the ibadah (service) certain of the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph), and of Hayaman (Heman), and of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), who should nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) with kanarawath (harps), with stringed instruments, and with matzalathayam (cymbals): and the masapar (number) of those who did the work according to their ibadah (service) was:

Of the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph): Zakawar (Zaccur), and Yawasap (Joseph), and Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Asharaalah (Asharelah), the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph), under the yad (hand) of Asap (Asaph), who nabaa (prophesied) after the yad (hand) of the malak (king).

Of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun); the banay (sons) of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun): Gadalayah (Gedaliah), and Tzaray (Zeri), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah), Chashabayah (Hashabiah), and Mathathayah (Mattithiah), shash (six), under the yaday (hands) of their ab (father) Yadawathawan (Jeduthun) with the kanawar (harp), who nabaa (prophesied) in giving yadah (thanks) and halal (praise) Yahawah.

Of Hayaman (Heman); the banay (sons) of Hayaman (Heman): Baqayah (Bukkiah), Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Izayaal (Uzziel), Shabawaal (Shebuel), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth), Chananayah (Hananiah), Chananay (Hanani), Alayaathah (Eliathah), Gadalathay (Giddalti), and Rawamamathayaizar (Romamti-Ezer), Yashabaqashah (Joshbekashah), Malawathay (Mallothi), Hawathayar (Hothir), Machazayaawath (Mahazioth).

All these were the banayam (sons) of Hayaman (Heman) the malak (king) chazah (seer) in the dabaray (words) of Alahayam, to rawam (will lift up) up the qaran (horn). Alahayam nathan (give) to Hayaman (Heman) fourteen banayam (sons) and shalawash (three) banawath (daughters).

All these were under the yaday (hands) of their ab (father) for shayar (song) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, with matzalathayam (cymbals), stringed instruments, and kanarawath (harps), for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam; Asap (Asaph), Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), and Hayaman (Heman) being under the yad (hand) of the malak (king).

The masapar (number) of them, with their ach (brother/kinsman) who were lamad (teach / instruct) in shayar (song) to Yahawah, even all who were skillful, was two maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - shamanah (eight).

They napal (fall / be cast down) gawaralawath (lots) for their mashamarath (duty / watch), all alike, as well the qatan (small / young / least) as the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), the teacher as the thalamayad (scholar).

Now the raashawan (first) gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth for Asap (Asaph) to Yawasap (Joseph): the shanay (second) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah); he and his ach (brother/kinsman) and ban (son) were shanayam (two):
The shalayashay (third) to Zakawar (Zaccur), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The rabayaiy (fourth) to Yatzaray (Izri), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The chamayashay (fifth) to Nathanayah (Nethaniah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shashay (sixth) to Baqayah (Bukkiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shabayaiy (seventh) to Yasharaalah (Jesharelah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shamayanay (eighth) to Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The thashayaiy (ninth) to Mathanayah (Mattaniah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The ishayaray (tenth) to Shamaiy (Shimei), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The ishathay (eleven) to Izaraal (Azarel), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
The shanayam (two) to Chashabayah (Hashabiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the thirteenth, Shabawaal (Shubael), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the fourteenth, Mathathayah (Mattithiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the fifteenth to Yarayamawath (Jeremoth), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the sixteenth to Chananayah (Hananiah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the seventeenth to Yashabaqashah (Joshbekashah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the eighteenth to Chananay (Hanani), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the nineteenth to Malawathay (Mallothi), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the isharayam (twenty) to Alayaathah (Eliathah), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the achad (one) and isharayam (twenty) to Hawathayar (Hothir), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the shanayam (two) and isharayam (twenty) to Gadalathay (Giddalti), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the shalawash (three) and isharayam (twenty) to Machazayaawath (Mahazioth), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two):
For the arabai (four) and isharayam (twenty) to Rawamamathayaizar (Romamti-Ezer), his ban (son) and his ach (brother/kinsman), shanayam (two).
For the machalaqawath (divisions) of the shairayam (doorkeepers): of the qarachayam (korahites), Mashalamayah (Meshelemiah) the ban (son) of Qawaraa (Kore), of the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph).

Mashalamayah (Meshelemiah) had banayam (sons): Zakarayah (Zechariah) the bakawar (firstborn), Yadayaial (Jediael) the shanay (second), Zabadayah (Zebadiah) the shalayashay (third), Yathanayaal (Jathniel) the rabayaiy (fourth),
Iyalam (Elam) the chamayashay (fifth), Yahawachanan (Jehohanan) the shashay (sixth), Alayahawaiyanay (Eliehoenai) the shabayaiy (seventh).

Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom) had banayam (sons): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the bakawar (firstborn), Yahawazabad (Jehozabad) the shanay (second), Yawaach (Joah) the shalayashay (third), and Shakar (Sacar) the rabayaiy (fourth), and Nathanaal (Nethanel) the chamayashay (fifth),
Imayaal (Ammiel) the shashay (sixth), Yashashakar (Issachar) the shabayaiy (seventh), Pailathay (Peullethai) the shamayanay (eighth); for Alahayam barak (blessed) him.

Also to Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) his ban (son) were banayam (sons) yalad (birth / begot), who mamashal (authority) over the bayath (house) of their ab (father); for they were gabawar (mighty) men of valor.

The banay (sons) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah): Ithanay (Othni), and Rapaal (Rephael), and Iwabad (Obed), Alazabad (Elzabad), whose ach (brother/kinsman) were chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) banay (men), Alayahaw (Elihu), and Samakayahaw (Semachiah).

All these were of the banay (sons) of Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom): they and their banay (sons) and their ach (brother/kinsman), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) ayash (man / husband) in kach (strength / mighty / power) for the ibadah (service); shashayam (sixty) - shanayam (two) of Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom).
Mashalamayah (Meshelemiah) had banayam (sons) and achayam (brothers), chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) banayam (men), eighteen.

Also Chasah (Hosah), of the banay (children) of Mararay (Merari), had banay (sons): Shamaray (Shimri) the raash (head), (for though he was not the bakawar (firstborn), yet his ab (father) shawam (place / establish / appoint) him raash (head)),

Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the shanay (second), Tabalayahaw (Tebaliah) the shalayashay (third), Zakarayah (Zechariah) the rabayaiy (fourth): all the banayam (sons) and achayam (brothers) of Chasah (Hosah) were thirteen.

Of these were the machalaqawath (divisions) of the shairayam (doorkeepers), even of the raash (head) gabarayam (men), having mashamarawath (offices) like their ach (brother/kinsman), to sharath (minister) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They napal (fall / be cast down) gawaralawath (lots), the qatan (small / young / least) as well as the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), according to their ab (father)' bayath (house), for every shair (gate).

The gawaral (lot) eastward napal (fall / be cast down) to Shalamayah (Shelemiah). Then for Zakarayah (Zechariah) his ban (son), a shakal (wise) yaitz (counselor), they napal (fall / be cast down) gawaralawath (lots); and his gawaral (lot) yatzaa (go out / come out) out northward.
To Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom) southward; and to his ban (son) the storehouse.

To Shapayam (Shuppim) and Chasah (Hosah) westward, by the shair (gate) of Shalakath (Shallecheth), at the masalah (causeway) that ilah (go up / offer) up, mashamar (watch) imah (against) mashamar (watch).
Eastward were shash (six) Lawayay (Levites), northward arabai (four) a yawam (day), southward arabai (four) a yawam (day), and for the storehouse shanayam (two) and shanayam (two).
For parabar (parbar) westward, arabai (four) at the masalah (causeway), and shanayam (two) at parabar (parbar).
These were the machalaqawath (divisions) of the shairayam (doorkeepers); of the banay (sons) of the qarachay (korahites), and of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari).
Of the Lawayay (Levites), Achayah (Ahijah) was over the awatzarawath (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and over the awatzarawath (treasures) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things.

The banay (sons) of Laidan (Ladan), the banay (sons) of the garashanay (gershonites) belonging to Laidan (Ladan), the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households belonging to Laidan (Ladan) the garashanay (gershonite): Yachayaalay (Jehieli).
The banay (sons) of Yachayaalay (Jehieli): Zatham (Zetham), and Yawaal (Joel) his ach (brother/kinsman), over the atzarawath (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Of the imaramay (amramites), of the yatzaharay (izharites), of the chabarawanay (hebronites), of the izayaalay (uzzielites):
And Shabawaal (Shebuel) the ban (son) of Garasham (Gershom), the ban (son) of Mashah (Moses), was nagayad (ruler) over the atzarawath (treasures).

His ach (brother/kinsman): of Alayaizar (Eliezer), Rachabayah (Rehabiah) his ban (son), and Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah) his ban (son), and Yawaram (Joram) his ban (son), and Zakaray (Zichri) his ban (son), and Shalamawath (Shelomoth) his ban (son).

This Shalamawath (Shelomoth) and his ach (brother/kinsman) were over all the atzarawath (treasures) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things, which Dawad (David) the malak (king), and the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households, the sharay (captains) over alapayam (thousands) and maawath (hundreds), and the sharay (captains) of the tzabaa (troop), had qadash (set apart / make holy).
They qadash (set apart / make holy) some of the shalal (spoil) won in malachamawath (battles) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

All that Shamawaal (Samuel) the seer, and Shaawal (Saul) the ban (son) of Qayash (Kish), and Abanar (Abner) the ban (son) of Nar (Ner), and Yawaab (Joab) the ban (son) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah), had qadash (set apart / make holy), whoever had qadash (set apart / make holy) anything, it was under the yad (hand) of Shalamayath (Shelomoth), and of his ach (brother/kinsman).

Of the yatzaharay (izharites), Kananayah (Chenaniah) and his ban (son) were for the chayatzawan (outward) malaakah (business) over Yashar-Al (Israel), for shatarayam (officers) and shapatayam (judges).

Of the chabarawanay (hebronites), Chashabayah (Hashabiah) and his ach (brother/kinsman), banay (men) of valor, one alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred), had the paqadah (oversight) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ibar (beyond) the Yaradan (Jordan) westward, for all the malaakah (business) of Yahawah, and for the ibadah (service) of the malak (king).

Of the chabarawanay (hebronites) was Yarayah (Jerijah) the raash (head), even of the chabarawanay (hebronites), according to their thawaladah (generation) by abawath (fathers)' households. In the fortieth shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Dawad (David) they were darash (sought) for, and there were matzaa (found) among them gabawar (mighty) men of valor at Yaizayar (Jazer) of Galaid (Gilead).

His ach (brother/kinsman), banay (men) of valor, were two alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred), raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, whom malak (king) Dawad (David) paqad (visit) overseers over the Raawabanay (Reubenites), and the Gaday (Gadites), and the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of the Manashay (Manassites), for every dabar (word / matter) pertaining to Alahayam, and for the dabar (word / matter) of the malak (king).

Now the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) after their masapar (number), the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households and the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands) and of maawath (hundreds), and their shatar (officers) who sharath (served) the malak (king), in any dabar (word / matter) of the machalaqawath (divisions) which bawaa (come) in and yatzaa (go out / come out) out chadash (month) by chadash (month) throughout all the chadashay (months) of the year—of achad (one) machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

Over the raashawan (first) machalaqath (division) for the raashawan (first) chadash (month) was Yashabaim (Jashobeam) the ban (son) of Zabadayaal (Zabdiel): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).
He was of the banay (children) of Paratz (Perez), the raash (head) of all the sharay (captains) of the tzabaa (troop) for the raashawan (first) chadash (month).

Over the machalaqath (division) of the shanay (second) chadash (month) was Dawaday (Dodai) the Achawachay (Ahohite), and his machalaqath (division); and Maqalawath (Mikloth) the nagayad (ruler): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shalayashay (third) shar (prince / ruler) of the tzabaa (troop) for the shalayashay (third) chadash (month) was Banayah (Benaiah), the ban (son) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest), raash (head): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

This is that Banayah (Benaiah), who was the gabawar (mighty) man of the shalawashayam (thirty), and over the shalawashayam (thirty): and of his machalaqath (division) was Imayazabad (Ammizabad) his ban (son).

The rabayaiy (fourth) captain for the rabayaiy (fourth) chadash (month) was Ishahaal (Asahel) the ach (brother/kinsman) of Yawaab (Joab), and Zabadayah (Zebadiah) his ban (son) achar (other) him: and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The chamayashay (fifth) shar (prince / ruler) for this chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month) was Shamahawath (Shamhuth) the yazarach (izrahite): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shashay (sixth) captain for the shashay (sixth) chadash (month) was Iyaraa (Ira) the ban (son) of Iqash (Ikkesh) the Thaqawaiy (Tekoite): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shabayaiy (seventh) captain for the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) was Chalatz (Helez) the palawanay (pelonite), of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shamayanay (eighth) captain for the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month) was Sabakay (Sibbecai) the chashathay (hushathite), of the Zerahites: and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The thashayaiy (ninth) captain for the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month) was Abayaizar (Abiezer) the Inathathay (Anathothite), of the Banayamayanay (Benjamites): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The ishayaray (tenth) captain for the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month) was Maharay (Maharai) the Natapathay (Netophathite), of the Zerahites: and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The ishathay (eleven) captain for the ishathay (eleven) chadash (month) was Banayah (Benaiah) the paraithawanay (pirathonite), of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

The shanayam (two) captain for the shanayam (two) chadash (month) was Chaladay (Heldai) the Natapathay (Netophathite), of Ithanayaal (Othniel): and in his machalaqath (division) were isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) alap (thousand).

Furthermore over the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel): of the Raawabanay (Reubenites) was Alayaizar (Eliezer) the ban (son) of Zakaray (Zichri) the ruler: of the Shamainay (Simeonites), Shapatayah (Shephatiah) the ban (son) of Maikah (Maacah):
Of Levi, Chashabayah (Hashabiah) the ban (son) of Qamawaal (Kemuel): of Aharawan (Aaron), Tzadawaq (Zadok):
Of Yahawadah (Judah), Alayahaw (Elihu), one of the achay (brothers) of Dawad (David): of Yashashakar (Issachar), Imaray (Omri) the ban (son) of Mayakaal (Michael):
Of Zabawalawan (Zebulun), Yashamaiyah (Ishmaiah) the ban (son) of Ibadayah (Obadiah): of Napathalay (Naphtali), Yarayamawath (Jeremoth) the ban (son) of Izarayaal (Azriel):

Of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim), Hawashai (Hoshea) the ban (son) of Izazayahaw (Azaziah): of the chatzay (half) - shabat (tribe) of Manashah (Manasseh), Yawaal (Joel) the ban (son) of Padayah (Pedaiah):

Of the chatzay (half) - tribe of Manashah (Manasseh) in Galaid (Gilead), Yadaw (Iddo) the ban (son) of Zakarayah (Zechariah): of Banayamayan (Benjamin), Yaishayaal (Jaasiel) the ban (son) of Abanar (Abner):
Of Dan (Dan), Izaraal (Azarel) the ban (son) of Yaracham (Jeroham). These were the sharay (captains) of the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

But Dawad (David) didn't nashaa (lift) the masapar (number) of them from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and under, because Yahawah had amar (spoke) he would rabah (increase) Yashar-Al (Israel) like the kawakabay (stars) of the sky.

Yawaab (Joab) the ban (son) of Tzarawayah (Zeruiah) chalal (began) to manah (number), but didn't kalah (complete / finish); and there came qatzap (wrath) for zaath (this) on Yashar-Al (Israel); neither was the masapar (number) ilah (go up / offer) into the masapar (account) in the dabaray (chronicles) of malak (king) Dawad (David).

Over the malak (king) atzarawath (treasures) was Izamawath (Azmaveth) the ban (son) of Idayaal (Adiel): and over the atzarawath (treasures) in the shadah (fields), in the irayam (cities), and in the kaparayam (villages), and in the magadalawath (towers), was Yahawanathan (Jonathan) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah):
Over those who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of the shadah (field) for ibadah (tillage) of the adamah (ground) was Izaray (Ezri) the ban (son) of Kalawab (Chelub):
And over the karamayam (vineyards) was Shamaiy (Shimei) the ramathay (ramathite): and over the increase of the karamayam (vineyards) for the winecellars was Zabaday (Zabdi) the shapamay (shiphmite):

And over the zayath (olive) trees and the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that were in the lowland was Bailachanan (Baal Hanan) the gadaray (gederite): and over the atzarawath (cellars) of shaman (oil) was Yawaish (Joash):

And over the baqar (morning) that raih (fed) in Sharawan (Sharon) was Shataray (Shitrai) the sharawanay (sharonite): and over the baqar (morning) that were in the imaqayam (valleys) was Shapat (Shaphat) the ban (son) of Idalay (Adlai):

And over the gamalayam (camels) was Awabayal (Obil) the Yashamaialay (Ishmaelite): and over the donkeys was Yachadayahaw (Jehdeiah) the maranathay (meronothite): and over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagrite.
All these were the sharay (rulers) of the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) which was malak (king) Dawad (David's).

Also Yahawanathan (Jonathan), Dawad (David's) dawad (uncle), was a yaitz (counselor), a ayash (man / husband) of bayan (between), and a sapar (book): and Yachayaal (Jehiel) the ban (son) of Chakamawanay (Hachmoni) was with the malak (king) banay (sons):
Achayathapal (Ahithophel) was the malak (king) yaitz (counselor): and Chawashay (Hushai) the arakay (archite) was the malak (king) rai (neigbor/another person):

And achar (other) Achayathapal (Ahithophel) was Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the ban (son) of Banayah (Benaiah), and Abayathar (Abiathar): and the shar (prince / ruler) of the malak (king) tzabaa (troop) was Yawaab (Joab).

Dawad (David) qahal (assembled) all the sharay (princes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), the sharay (princes) of the shabatayam (tribes), and the sharay (captains) of the machalaqawath (companies) who sharath (served) the malak (king) by machalaqath (division), and the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands), and the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), and the rulers over all the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) and maqanah (possessions) of the malak (king) and of his ban (son), with the sarayasayam (officers), and the gabawar (mighty) men, even all the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then Dawad (David) the malak (king) qawam (rise up) up on his ragalay (feet), and amar (spoke), "shamai (hearken / hear) me, my ach (brother/kinsman), and my im (nation / people)! As for me, it was in my labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) of manawachah (rest) for the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, and for the hadam (footstool) of our Alahayam; and I had kawan (prepared) for the banah (build).
But Alahayam amar (spoke) to me, ‘You shall not banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name), because you are a ayash (man / husband) of malachamah (war), and have shapak (shed) dam (blood).'

However Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), bachar (chose) me out of all the bayath (house) of my ab (father) to be malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) iwalam (forever). For he has bachar (chosen) Yahawadah (Judah) to be nagayad (prince); and in the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), the bayath (house) of my ab (father); and among the banay (sons) of my ab (father) he ratzah (took) pleasure in me to make me malak (king) over all Yashar-Al (Israel).

Of all my banayam (sons) (for Yahawah nathan (give) given me many banayam (sons)), he has bachar (chosen) Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yahawah malakawath (kingdom) over Yashar-Al (Israel).

He amar (spoke) to me, ‘Shalamah (Solomon), your ban (son), shall banah (build) my bayath (house) and my chatzar (courts); for I have bachar (chosen) him to be my ban (son), and I will be his ab (father).
I will kawan (establish) his malakawath (kingdom) iwalam (forever), if he chazaq (continues) to ishah (make) my matzawah (commandments) and my mashapat (ordinances), as at this yawam (day).'

Now therefore, in the iyan (eye) of all Yashar-Al (Israel), the qahal (assembly) of Yahawah, and in the azan (ear) of our Alahayam, shamar (keep/guard) and darash (seek) out all the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah your Alahayam; that you may yarash (possess) this tawab (good / proper function) aratz (Earth/land), and leave it for an nachal (inheritance) to your ban (son) achar (other) you iwalam (forever).

You, Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son), yadai (know) the Alahayam of your ab (father), and ibad (servant) him with a shalam (full / whole / complete) lab (heart) and with a chapatz (willing) napash (soul); for Yahawah searches all lababawath (hearts), and bayan (between) all the yatzar (imaginations) of the machashabawath (thoughts). If you darash (seek) him, he will be matzaa (found) by you; but if you izab (forsake) him, he will zanach (cast) you off id (until / as far as).
Raah (see) heed now; for Yahawah has bachar (chosen) you to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the maqadash (sanctuary). Be chazaq (strong), and ishah (make) it."

Then Dawad (David) nathan (give) to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son) the thabanayath (pattern) of the awalam (porch) of the bayath (house), and of its houses, and of its ganazak (treasuries), and of the upper rooms of it, and of the inner rooms of it, and of the bayath (house) of the kaparath (mercy) seat;

And the thabanayath (pattern) of all that he had by the rawach (spirit / wind), for the chatzarawath (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for all the surrounding rooms, for the atzarawath (treasuries) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and for the atzarawath (treasuries) of the qadash (set apart / make holy) things;

Also for the machalaqawath (divisions) of the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), and for all the malaakah (work) of the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and for all the kalay (vessels) of ibadah (service) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah;

Of zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight) for the zahab (gold), for all kalay (vessels) of every kind of ibadah (service); for all the kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver) by mashaqal (weight), for all kalay (vessels) of every kind of ibadah (service);

By mashaqal (weight) also for the lampstands of zahab (gold), and for its nayar (lamps), of zahab (gold), by mashaqal (weight) for every lampstand and for its nayar (lamps); and for the lampstands of kasap (silver), by mashaqal (weight) for every lampstand and for its nayar (lamps), according to the use of every lampstand;
And the zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight) for the shalachanawath (tables) of show mairakath (bread), for every shalachan (table); and kasap (silver) for the shalachanawath (tables) of kasap (silver);

And the forks, and the basins, and the cups, of tahawar (pure) zahab (gold); and for the zahab (gold) bowls by mashaqal (weight) for every bowl; and for the kasap (silver) bowls by mashaqal (weight) for every bowl;

And for the mazabach (altar) of qatarath (incense) zaqaq (refined) zahab (gold) by mashaqal (weight); and zahab (gold) for the thabanayath (pattern) of the marakabah (chariot), the karawab (cherubim), that parash (spread) out, and sakak (covered) the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah.
"All this," said David, "I shakal (have) been made to understand in kathab (write) from the yad (hand) of Yahawah, even all the malaakawath (works) of this thabanayath (pattern)."

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), "Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), and ishah (make) it. Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor be chathath (dismayed); for Yahawah Alahayam, even my Alahayam, is with you. He will not rapah (fail) you, nor izab (forsake) you, until all the malaakah (work) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah is kalah (complete / finish).

Behold, there are the machalaqawath (divisions) of the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), for all the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam. There shall be with you in all kinds of malaakah (work) every nadayab (willing) chakamah (man) who has skill, for any kind of ibadah (service). Also the sharayam (captains) and all the im (nation / people) will be entirely at your command."

Dawad (David) the malak (king) amar (spoke) to all the qahal (assembly), "Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son), whom achad (one) Alahayam has bachar (chosen), is yet nair (young) and rak (tender), and the malaakah (work) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty); for the bayarah (palace) is not for adam (man), but for Yahawah Alahayam.

Now I have kawan (prepared) with all my kach (strength / mighty / power) for the bayath (house) of my Alahayam the zahab (gold) for the things of zahab (gold), and the kasap (silver) for the things of kasap (silver), and the nachashath (brass) for the things of nachashath (brass), the barazal (iron) for the things of barazal (iron), and itz (wood) for the things of itz (wood); shaham (Onyx) abanay (stones), and abanay (stones) to be malaa (set), abanay (stones) for inlaid raqamah (work), and of various colors, and all kinds of yaqar (precious) abanay (stones), and marble abanay (stones) in rab (abundance).

In addition, because I ratzah (have) set my affection on the bayath (house) of my Alahayam, since I yash (have) a treasure of my own of zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), I nathan (give) it to the bayath (house) of my Alahayam, over and mail (top/above) all that I have kawan (prepared) for the qadash (set apart / make holy) bayath (house),

Even shalawash (three) alap (thousand) kakaray (talents) of zahab (gold), of the zahab (gold) of Awapayar (Ophir), and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) kakaray (talents) of zaqaq (refined) kasap (silver), with which to tawach (overlay) the qayarawath (walls) of the bathayam (houses);

Of zahab (gold) for the things of zahab (gold), and of kasap (silver) for the things of kasap (silver), and for all kinds of malaakah (work) to be made by the yad (hand) of artisans. Who then nadab (offers) willingly to malaa (consecrate) yad (hand) this yawam (day) to Yahawah?"

Then the sharay (princes) of the abawath (fathers)' households, and the sharay (princes) of the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands) and of maawath (hundreds), with the sharay (rulers) over the malak (king) malaakah (work), nadab (offered) willingly;

And they nathan (give) for the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam of zahab (gold) chamash (five) alap (thousand) kakarayam (talents) and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) darics, and of kasap (silver) ishar (ten) alap (thousand) kakarayam (talents), and of nachashath (brass) eighteen alap (thousand) kakarayam (talents), and of barazal (iron) a maah (hundred) alap (thousand) kakarayam (talents).

They with whom precious abanayam (stones) were matzaa (found) nathan (give) them to the awatzar (treasure) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, under the yad (hand) of Yachayaal (Jehiel) the garashanay (gershonite).

Then the im (nation / people) shamach (rejoiced), because they nadab (offered) willingly, because with a shalam (full / whole / complete) lab (heart) they nadab (offered) willingly to Yahawah: and Dawad (David) the malak (king) also shamach (rejoiced) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (joy).

Therefore Dawad (David) barak (blessed) Yahawah iyan (eye) all the qahal (assembly); and Dawad (David) amar (spoke), "You are barak (blessed), Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel) our ab (father), iwalam (forever) and iwalam (forever).

Yours, Yahawah, is the gadawalah (greatness), the gabawarah (power), the glory, the natzach (victory), and the hawad (majesty)! For all that is in the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and in the aratz (Earth/land) is yours. Yours is the mamalakah (kingdom), Yahawah, and you are mathanashaa (exalted) as raash (head) above all.

Both riches and honor come from you, and you mashal (rule/have dominion) over all; and in your yad (hand) is kach (strength / mighty / power) and gabawarah (might); and it is in your yad (hand) to gadal (make) great, and to give chazaq (strength) to all.
Now therefore, our Alahayam, we yadah (thank) you, and halal (praise) your thapaarah (glorious) sham (name).

But who am I, and what is my im (nation / people), that we should be kach (strength / mighty / power) to nadab (offer) so willingly as this? For all things come from you, and of your yad (hand) nathan (give) we given you.

For we are garayam (strangers) panayam (face) you, and thawashabayam (foreigners), as all our ab (father) were. Our yawam (day) on the aratz (Earth/land) are as a tzal (shadow), and there is no remaining.

Yahawah our Alahayam, all this hamawan (store) that we have kawan (prepared) to banah (build) you a bayath (house) for your qadash (set apart / make holy) sham (name) comes from your yad (hand), and is all your own.

I yadai (know) also, my Alahayam, that you bachan (try) the labab (heart), and ratzah (have) pleasure in yashar (upright). As for me, in the uprightness of my labab (heart) I have nadab (willingly) offered all these things. Now raah (see) I seen with shamachah (joy) your im (nation / people), that are matzaa (present) here, nadab (offer) willingly to you.

Yahawah, the Alahayam of Abaraham (Abraham), of Yatzachaq (Isaac), and of Yashar-Al (Israel), our ab (father), shamar (keep/guard) this iwalam (forever) in the yatzar (imagination) of the machashabawath (thoughts) of the labab (heart) of your im (nation / people), and kawan (prepare) their labab (heart) for you;

And nathan (give) to Shalamah (Solomon) my ban (son) a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart), to shamar (keep/guard) your matzawah (commandments), your idawath (testimonies), and your idawath (statutes), and to ishah (make) all these things, and to banah (build) the bayarah (palace), for which I have kawan (made) provision."

Dawad (David) amar (spoke) to all the qahal (assembly), "Now barak (blessed) Yahawah your Alahayam!" All the qahal (assembly) barak (blessed) Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), and bowed down their yaqadaw (heads) and prostrated themselves before Yahawah and the malak (king).

They zabach (sacrificed) zabachayam (sacrifices) to Yahawah, and ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) to Yahawah, on the next macharath (day) after that macharath (day), even one alap (thousand) parayam (bulls), one alap (thousand) ayalayam (rams), and one alap (thousand) kabashayam (lambs), with their drink nasak (offerings), and zabachayam (sacrifices) in rab (abundance) for all Yashar-Al (Israel),

And akal (eat) and shathah (drinks) panayam (face) Yahawah on that yawam (day) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (gladness). They made Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) malak (king) the shanay (second) time, and mashach (anointed) him to Yahawah to be nagayad (prince), and Tzadawaq (Zadok) to be kahan (priest).

Then Shalamah (Solomon) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yahawah as malak (king) instead of Dawad (David) his ab (father), and tzalach (prospered); and all Yashar-Al (Israel) shamai (hearken / hear) him.
All the sharayam (princes), the gabawar (mighty) men, and also all of the banay (sons) of malak (king) Dawad (David) submitted yad (hand) to Shalamah (Solomon) the malak (king).

Yahawah gadal (magnified) Shalamah (Solomon) mail (top/above) in the iyan (eye) of all Yashar-Al (Israel), and nathan (give) on him such malakawath (royal) hawad (majesty) as had not been on any malak (king) panayam (face) him in Yashar-Al (Israel).
Now Dawad (David) the ban (son) of Yashay (Jesse) malak (king) over all Yashar-Al (Israel).

The yawam (day) that he malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel) was arabaiyam (forty) shanayam (years); he malak (king) shabai (seven) shanayam (years) in Chabarawan (Hebron), and he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - shalawash (three) years in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He mawath (death) in a tawab (good / proper function) shayabah (old age / white hair - due to age) age, shabai (full) of yamayam (days), riches, and honor: and Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Now the dabaray (acts) of Dawad (David) the malak (king), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (write) in the history of Shamawaal (Samuel) the seer, and in the history of Nathan (Nathan) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and in the history of Gad (Gad) the chazah (seer),

With all his malakawath (reign) and his gabawarah (might), and the ithayam (times) that ibar (pass over/through) over him, and over Yashar-Al (Israel), and over all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratzawath (countries).
Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) was chazaq (strengthened) in his malakawath (kingdom), and Yahawah his Alahayam was with him, and gadal (magnified) him mail (top/above).

Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke) to all Yashar-Al (Israel), to the sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands) and of maawath (hundreds), and to the shapatayam (judges), and to raash (head) prince in all Yashar-Al (Israel), the raashay (heads) of the abawath (fathers)' households.

So Shalamah (Solomon), and all the qahal (assembly) with him, yalak (went) to the bamah (high) place that was at Gabaiwan (Gibeon); for there was the ahal (tent) of Meeting of Alahayam, which Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah ishah (make) made in the madabar (wilderness).

But Dawad (David) had brought the arawan (ark) of Alahayam up from Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim) to the place that Dawad (David) had kawan (prepared) for it; for he had natah (pitched) a ahal (tent) for it at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Moreover the bronze mazabach (altar), that Batzalaal (Bezalel) the ban (son) of Awaray (Uri), the ban (son) of Chawar (Hur), ishah (make) made, was there panayam (face) the mashakan (tabernacle) of Yahawah: and Shalamah (Solomon) and the qahal (assembly) were darash (seeking) counsel there.

Shalamah (Solomon) ilah (go up / offer) up there to the bronze mazabach (altar) panayam (face) Yahawah, which was at the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and ilah (go up / offer) one alap (thousand) burnt ilawath (offerings) on it.
In that layal (night) Alahayam appeared to Shalamah (Solomon), and amar (spoke) to him, "shaal (ask) what I shall nathan (give) you."

Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke) to Alahayam, "You ishah (make) shown gadawal (very great/important/mighty) loving chasad (grace) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), and have made me malak (king) in his place.

Now, Yahawah Alahayam, let your dabar (word / matter) to Dawad (David) my ab (father) be aman (believe / have faith); for you have made me malak (king) over a im (nation / people) like the ipar (dust) of the aratz (Earth/land) in rab (multitude).

Now nathan (give) me chakamah (wisdom) and madai (knowledge), that I may yatzaa (go out / come out) out and bawaa (come) in panayam (face) this im (nation / people); for who can shapat (judge / judgement) this your im (nation / people), that is so gadawal (very great/important/mighty)?"

Alahayam amar (spoke) to Shalamah (Solomon), "Because this was in your labab (heart), and you have not shaal (asked) riches, wealth, or honor, nor the napash (soul) of those who shanaa (hate) you, neither yet have shaal (asked) rab (long) yawam (day); but have shaal (asked) chakamah (wisdom) and madai (knowledge) for yourself, that you may shapat (judge / judgement) my im (nation / people), over whom I have made you malak (king):

Chakamah (wisdom) and madai (knowledge) is nathan (give) to you. I will nathan (give) you riches, wealth, and honor, such as none of the malakayam (kings) have had who have been panayam (face) you; neither shall there any achar (other) you have the like."

So Shalamah (Solomon) bawaa (come) from the bamah (high) place that was at Gabaiwan (Gibeon), from panayam (face) the ahal (tent) of Meeting, to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and he malak (king) over Yashar-Al (Israel).

Shalamah (Solomon) asap (gathered) rakab (chariots) and horsemen: and he had one alap (thousand) arabai (four) maah (hundred) rakab (chariots), and shanayam (two) alap (thousand) horsemen, that he yanach (placed) in the rakab (chariot) iray (cities), and with the malak (king) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) nathan (give) kasap (silver) and zahab (gold) to be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) as abanayam (stones), and arazayam (cedars) nathan (give) he to be as the shaqamah (sycamore) trees that are in the lowland, for rab (abundance).

The sawasayam (horses) which Shalamah (Solomon) had were mawatzaa (brought) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) and from maqawah (gathering / collection); the malak (king) sacharay (merchants) purchased them from maqawah (gathering / collection).

They ilah (go up / offer) up and yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) a marakabah (chariot) for shash (six) maah (hundred) pieces of kasap (silver), and a sawas (horse) for one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty): and so for all the malakay (kings) of the Chathay (Hittites), and the malakay (kings) of Aram (Syria), they yatzaa (go out / come out) them out by their yad (hand).
Now Shalamah (Solomon) purposed to build a house for the name of Yahawah, and a house for his kingdom.

Shalamah (Solomon) counted out seventy thousand ishah (make) to ishah (make) burdens, and eighty thousand men who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
Solomon sent to Huram the king of Tyre, saying, "As you dealt with Yahawah (David) my father, and sent him cedars to banah (build) him a bayath (house) in which to dwell, so deal with me.

Behold, I am about to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the name of Yahawah my Alahayam, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him incense of sweet spices, and for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and kay (surely), on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the banah (build) feasts of Yahawah our Alahayam. This is an ordinance forever to Israel.
"The bayath (house) which I banah (build) is bayath (house); for our Alahayam is bayath (house) above all Alahayam.
But who is able to build him a house, since heaven and the heaven of heavens can't contain him? Who am I then, that I should build him a house, except just to burn incense im (with) him?

"Now therefore shalach (send) me a yadai (man) skillful to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and who yawadaiyam (knows) how to engrave engravings, to be with the skillful yawadaiyam (men) who are with me in Judah and in Jerusalem, whom David my father provided.

"Send me also cedar itzayam (trees), fir trees, and algum trees, out of Lebanon; for I know that your servants know how to cut itz (timber) in Lebanon: and behold, my servants shall be with your servants,
Even to prepare me itz (timber) in abundance; for the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.

Behold, I will nathan (give) to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil."
Then Chawaram (Huram) the malak (king) of Tyre amar (spoke) in writing, which he nathan (give) to Solomon, "Because Yahawah loves his ban (son), he nathan (give) made you malak (king) over them."

Chawaram (Huram) continued, "Blessed be Yahawah, the Alahayam of Israel, that yadai (made) heaven and earth, who yadai (has) given to David the king a chakam (wise) son, endowed with discretion and chakam (understanding), that should build a house for Yahawah, and a house for his kingdom.
Now I have nathan (give) a skillful ayash (man / husband), endowed with yadai (understanding), of Huram my ab (father),

The son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and his father was a man of Tyre, skillful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any kind of engraving, and to devise any device; that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my Adawan David your father.
"Now therefore the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine, which my Adawan has spoken of, bawaa (come) him send to his servants:
And we will cut wood out of Shalamah (Lebanon), as much as you shall need; and we will bring it to you in floats by sea to Joppa; and you shall carry it up to Jerusalem."

Solomon numbered all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the numbering with which David his father had numbered them; and they were found one maah (hundred) fifty - shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred).

He ishah (make) shabaiyam (seventy) alap (thousand) of them to sabal (bear) burdens, and shamanayam (eighty) alap (thousand) who were chatzab (stone) cutters in the har (mountain), and shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) natzach (overseers) to set the im (nation / people) at ibad (servant).

Then Shalamah (Solomon) chalal (began) to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) on har (mountain) Mawarayah (Moriah), where Yahawah raah (see) to Dawad (David) his ab (father), which he prepared in the maqawam (place) that Dawad (David) had appointed, in the garan (threshing) floor of Aranan (Ornan) the Yabawasay (Jebusite).
He chalal (began) to banah (build) in the shanay (second) day of the shanay (second) chadash (month), in the arabai (four) shanah (year) of his malakawath (reign).

Now these are the foundations which Shalamah (Solomon) yasad (laid) for the banah (build) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam. The arak (length) by amawath (cubits) after the raashawan (first) madah (measure) was shashayam (sixty) amawath (cubits), and the rachab (breadth) isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits).

The awalam (porch) that panayam (face) in front, its arak (length), according to the rachab (breadth) of the bayath (house), was isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits), and the gabah (height) one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty); and he overlaid it panayamah (within) with tahawar (pure) zahab (gold).

The greater bayath (house) he made a chapah (ceiling) with barawash (fir) itz (wood), which he overlaid with tawab (good / proper function) zahab (gold), and ornamented it with thamar (palm) trees and sharasharawath (chains).
He garnished the bayath (house) with yaqar (precious) aban (stone) for thapaarah (beauty): and the zahab (gold) was zahab (gold) of Parawayam (Parvaim).

He overlaid also the bayath (house), the qarawath (beams), the sapayam (thresholds), and its qayarawath (walls), and its dalath (doors), with zahab (gold); and pathach (engraved) karawab (cherubim) on the qayarawath (walls).

He ishah (make) the most qadash (set apart / make holy) bayath (house): its arak (length), according to the rachab (breadth) of the bayath (house), was isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits), and its rachab (breadth) isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits); and he overlaid it with tawab (good / proper function) zahab (gold), amounting to shash (six) maah (hundred) kakarayam (talents).
The mashaqal (weight) of the masamarawath (nails) was chamashayam (fifty) shaqalayam (shekels) of zahab (gold). He overlaid the upper rooms with zahab (gold).
In the most qadash (set apart / make holy) bayath (house) he ishah (make) shanayam (two) karawab (cherubim) of tzaitzai (image) maishah (work); and they overlaid them with zahab (gold).

The kanapay (wings) of the karawab (cherubim) were isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits) arak (length): the kanap (wing) of the achad (one) was chamash (five) amawath (cubits), nagai (reaching) to the qayar (wall) of the bayath (house); and the other kanap (wing) was chamash (five) amawath (cubits), nagai (reaching) to the kanap (wing) of the other karawab (cherub).

The kanap (wing) of the other karawab (cherub) was chamash (five) amawath (cubits), nagai (reaching) to the qayar (wall) of the bayath (house); and the other kanap (wing) was chamash (five) amawath (cubits), dabaq (joining) to the kanap (wing) of the other karawab (cherub).

The kanapay (wings) of these karawab (cherubim) parash (spread) themselves forth isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits): and they imad (stood) on their ragal (feet / foot), and their panayam (face) were toward the bayath (house).
He ishah (make) the parakath (veil) of thakalath (blue), and aragaman (purple), and karamayal (crimson), and bawatz (fine) linen, and ornamented it with karawab (cherubim).

Also he ishah (make) panayam (face) the bayath (house) shanayam (two) imawadayam (pillars) of shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five) amawath (cubits) high, and the capital that was on the raash (head) of each of them was chamash (five) amawath (cubits).

He ishah (make) sharasharawath (chains) in the dabayar (oracle), and nathan (give) them on the raash (head) of the imadayam (pillars); and he ishah (make) one maah (hundred) ramawanayam (pomegranates), and nathan (give) them on the sharasharawath (chains).

He qawam (rise up) up the imawadayam (pillars) panayam (face) the hayakal (temple), achad (one) on the right yamayan (right hand), and the other on the shamaawal (left hand); and qaraa (called) the sham (name) of that on the panayam (face) hand Yakayan (Jachin), and the sham (name) of that on the shamaalay (left) Baiz (Boaz).

Then he ishah (make) an mazabach (altar) of nachashath (brass), isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits) its arak (length), and isharayam (twenty) amawath (cubits) its rachab (breadth), and ishar (ten) amawath (cubits) its qawamah (height).

Also he ishah (make) the yatzaq (molten) yam (sea/waters) of ishar (ten) amah (cubits) from shapah (brim) to shapah (brim), igal (round) in sabayab (surrounding); and its qawamah (height) was chamash (five) amah (cubits); and a qaw (line) of shalawashayam (thirty) amah (cubits) encircled it.

Under it was the damawath (likeness) of oxen, which encircled it, for ishar (ten) amah (cubits), encircling the yam (sea/waters). The oxen were in shanayam (two) tawarayam (rows), yatzaq (cast) when it was yatzaq (cast).

It imad (stood) on shanayam (two) oxen, shalawash (three) panah (turn) toward the tzapawan (north), and shalawash (three) panah (turn) toward the yam (sea/waters), and shalawash (three) panah (turn) toward the nagab (south), and shalawash (three) panah (turn) toward the mazarach (east): and the yam (sea/waters) was set on them mail (top/above), and all their hinder achawar (parts) were inward.

It was a tapach (handbreadth) ibay (thick); and its shapah (brim) was maishah (worked) like the shapah (brim) of a kawas (cup), like the parach (flower) of a shawashan (lily): it received and kawal (all) shalawash (three) alap (thousand) bathayam (baths).

He ishah (make) also ishar (ten) basins, and nathan (give) chamash (five) on the right yamayan (right hand), and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand), to rachatz (wash) in them; such things as belonged to the burnt maishah (offering) they dawach (washed) in them; but the yam (sea/waters) was for the kahanayam (priests) to rachatz (wash) in.

He ishah (make) the ishar (ten) lampstands of zahab (gold) according to the mashapat (ordinance) concerning them; and he nathan (give) them in the hayakal (temple), chamash (five) on the right yamayan (right hand), and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand).

He ishah (make) also ishar (ten) shalachanawath (tables), and yanach (placed) them in the hayakal (temple), chamash (five) on the yamayan (right hand) side, and chamash (five) on the shamaawal (left hand). He ishah (make) one maah (hundred) basins of zahab (gold).

Furthermore he ishah (make) the chatzar (court) of the kahanayam (priests), and the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) izarah (court), and dalathawath (doors) for the izarah (court), and overlaid their dalathawath (doors) with nachashath (brass).
He nathan (give) the yam (sea/waters) on the yamanay (right) kathap (side) of the qadam (house) eastward, mawal (toward) the nagab (south).

Chawaram (Huram) ishah (make) the sayarawath (pots), and the yaiyam (shovels), and the basins. So Chawaram (Huram) kalah (complete / finish) an end of doing the malaakah (work) that he ishah (make) for malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam:

The shanayam (two) imawadayam (pillars), and the galawath (bowls), and the shanayam (two) capitals which were on the raash (head) of the imawadayam (pillars), and the shanayam (two) networks to kasah (cover) the shanayam (two) galawath (bowls) of the capitals that were on the raash (head) of the imawadayam (pillars),

And the arabai (four) maah (hundred) ramawanayam (pomegranates) for the shanayam (two) shabakawath (networks); shanayam (two) tawarayam (rows) of ramawanayam (pomegranates) for achad (one) shabakah (network), to kasah (cover) the shanayam (two) galawath (bowls) of the capitals that were on the imawadayam (pillars).
He ishah (make) also the makanawath (bases), and the basins ishah (make) he on the makanawath (bases);
Achad (one) yam (sea/waters), and the shanayam (two) oxen under it.

Chawaram (Huram) his ab (father) also ishah (make) the sayarawath (pots), the yaiyam (shovels), the forks, and all its kalay (vessels) for malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah of maraq (bright) nachashath (brass).
The malak (king) yatzaq (cast) them in the kakar (plain) of the Yaradan (Jordan), in the ib (clay) adamah (ground) between Sakawath (Succoth) and Tzaradah (Zeredah).
Thus Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) all these kalayam (vessels) in maad (great) rab (abundance): for the mashaqal (weight) of the nachashath (brass) could not be chaqar (found) out.

Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) all the kalayam (vessels) that were in the bayath (house) of Alahayam, the zahab (gold) mazabach (altar) also, and the shalachanawath (tables) with the show lacham (bread) on them;
And the lampstands with their nayar (lamps), to bair (burn) according to the mashapat (ordinance) panayam (face) the dabayar (oracle), of sagar (pure) zahab (gold);
And the parach (flowers), and the narawath (lamps), and the malaqachayam (tongs), of zahab (gold), and that makalah (perfect) zahab (gold);

And the mazamarawath (snuffers), and the basins, and the kapawath (spoons), and the machathah (fire) pans, of sagar (pure) zahab (gold): and as for the entry of the bayath (house), the inner dalathay (doors) of it for the most qadash (set apart / make holy) place, and the dalathay (doors) of the main hall of the hayakal (temple) were of zahab (gold).

Thus all the malaakah (work) that Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah was shalam (finished). Shalamah (Solomon) bawaa (come) in the things that Dawad (David) his ab (father) had qadash (set apart / make holy), even the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), and all the kalayam (vessels), and nathan (give) them in the atzarawath (treasuries) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Then Shalamah (Solomon) qahal (assembled) the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and all the raashay (heads) of the matawath (tribes), the nashayaay (princes) of the abawath (fathers)' households of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ilah (go up / offer) up the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah out of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), which is Tzayawan (Zion).
And all the ayash (man / husband) of Yashar-Al (Israel) qahal (assembled) themselves to the malak (king) at the chag (feast/festival), which was in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).
All the zaqanay (elders) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come): and the Lawayay (Levites) nashaa (lift) up the arawan (ark);

And they ilah (go up / offer) up the arawan (ark), and the ahal (tent) of Meeting, and all the qadash (set apart / make holy) kalay (vessels) that were in the ahal (tent); these the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites) ilah (go up / offer) up.

Malak (king) Shalamah (Solomon) and all the idah (congregation) of Yashar-Al (Israel), that were yaid (assembled) to him, were panayam (face) the arawan (ark), zabach (sacrificing) tzaan (sheep) and cattle, that could not be sapar (book) nor manah (numbered) for rab (multitude).

The kahanayam (priests) bawaa (come) in the arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah to its maqawam (place), into the dabayar (oracle) of the bayath (house), to the most qadash (set apart / make holy) place, even under the kanapay (wings) of the karawab (cherubim).

For the karawab (cherubim) parash (spread) forth their kanapayam (wings) over the maqawam (place) of the arawan (ark), and the karawab (cherubim) kasah (covered) the arawan (ark) and its poles mail (top/above).

The poles were so arak (long) that the raashay (ends) of the poles were raah (see) from the arawan (ark) panayam (face) the dabayar (oracle); but they were not raah (see) outside: and there it is to this yawam (day).

There was nothing in the arawan (ark) except the shanayam (two) lachawath (tables) which Mashah (Moses) nathan (give) at Charab (Horeb), when Yahawah karath (cut) a covenant with the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), when they yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt).

It happened, when the kahanayam (priests) yatzaa (go out / come out) come out of the qadash (set apart / make holy) place, (for all the kahanayam (priests) who were matzaa (present) had qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves, and didn't shamar (keep/guard) their machalaqawath (divisions);

Also the Lawayay (Levites) who were the singers, all of them, even Asap (Asaph), Hayaman (Heman), Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), and their ban (son) and their ach (brother/kinsman), labash (arrayed) in bawatz (fine) linen, with matzalathayam (cymbals) and stringed instruments and kanarawath (harps), imad (stood) at the mazarach (east) end of the mazabach (altar), and with them one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) kahanayam (priests) chatzar (sounding) with chatzatzarawath (trumpets);)

It happened, when the machatzatzarayam (trumpeters) and singers were as achad (one), to make achad (one) qawal (sound / voice) to be shamai (hearken / hear) in halal (praise) and yadah (thanking) Yahawah; and when they rawam (will lift up) up their qawal (sound / voice) with the chatzatzarawath (trumpets) and matzalathayam (cymbals) and kalay (instruments) of music, and halal (praise) Yahawah, saying, "For he is tawab (good / proper function); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever)!" That then the bayath (house) was malaa (filled) with a inan (cloud), even the bayath (house) of Yahawah,

So that the kahanayam (priests) yakal (could) not imad (stand) to sharath (minister) by panayam (face) of the inan (cloud): for the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah malaa (filled) the bayath (house) of Alahayam.
Then Shalamah (Solomon) amar (spoke), "Yahawah has amar (spoke) that he would shakan (place) in the irapal (thick) darkness.
But I have banah (build) you a bayath (house) of zabawal (habitation), and a makawan (place) for you to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in iwalam (forever)."
The malak (king) sabab (turned) his panayam (face), and barak (blessed) all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel): and all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel) imad (stood).

He amar (spoke), "barak (blessed) be Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), who dabar (word / matter) with his pah (mouth) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), and has with his yad (hand) malaa (fulfilled) it, amar (spoke),

‘Since the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) forth my im (nation / people) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), I bachar (chose) no iyar (city) out of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to banah (build) a bayath (house) in, that my sham (name) might be there; neither bachar (chose) I any ayash (man / husband) to be nagayad (prince) over my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel):
But I have bachar (chosen) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that my sham (name) might be there; and have bachar (chosen) Dawad (David) to be over my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel).'
Now it was in the labab (heart) of Dawad (David) my ab (father) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

But Yahawah amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) my ab (father), ‘Whereas it was in your labab (heart) to banah (build) a bayath (house) for my sham (name), you tawab (good / proper function) well that it was in your labab (heart):

Raq (concept: what comes out / spittle) you shall not banah (build) the bayath (house); but your ban (son) who shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of your body, he shall banah (build) the bayath (house) for my sham (name).'

"Yahawah has qawam (rise up) his dabar (word / matter) that he dabar (word / matter); for I have qawam (rise up) up in the place of Dawad (David) my ab (father), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel), as Yahawah dabar (word / matter), and have banah (build) the bayath (house) for the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).
There I have shawam (place / establish / appoint) the arawan (ark), in which is the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah, which he karath (cut) with the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)."
He imad (stood) panayam (face) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah in the presence of all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands)

(For Shalamah (Solomon) ishah (make) made a bronze kayawar (scaffold), chamash (five) amawath (cubits) arak (length), and chamash (five) amawath (cubits) rachab (broad), and shalawash (three) amawath (cubits) qawamah (high), and nathan (give) set it in the thawak (midst) of the izarah (court); and on it he imad (stood), and kneeled down on his barak (blessed) before all the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens);)

And he amar (spoke), "Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), there is no Alahayam like you, in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), or on aratz (Earth/land); you who shamar (keep/guard) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with your ibad (servant), who halak (move) panayam (face) you with all their lab (heart);

Who have shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you dabar (word / matter) him: yes, you dabar (word / matter) with your pah (mouth), and malaa (have) fulfilled it with your yad (hand), as it is this yawam (day).

"Now therefore, Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), shamar (keep/guard) with your ibad (servant) Dawad (David) my ab (father) that which you have dabar (word / matter) him, amar (spoke), ‘There shall not karath (cut) you a ayash (man / husband) in my panayam (face) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Yashar-Al (Israel), if only your ban (son) shamar (keep/guard) heed to their darak (way), to yalak (walk) in my thawarah (instruction) as you have yalak (walked) panayam (face) me.'
Now therefore, Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), let your dabar (word / matter) be aman (believe / have faith), which you dabar (word / matter) to your ibad (servant) Dawad (David).

"But will Alahayam indeed yashab (inhabit/dwell) with adam (men) on the aratz (Earth/land)? Behold, shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) of shamay (heavens) can't kawal (all) you; how much less this bayath (house) which I have banah (build)!

Yet have panah (turn) for the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), and to his thachanah (supplication), Yahawah my Alahayam, to shamai (hearken / hear) to the ranah (cry) and to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) palal (prays) panayam (face) you;

That your iyan (eye) may be pathach (open) toward this bayath (house) yawamam (by day) and layal (night), even toward the maqawam (place) where you have amar (spoke) that you would shawam (place / establish / appoint) your sham (name); to shamai (hearken / hear) to the thapalah (prayer) which your ibad (servant) shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place).

Shamai (hearken / hear) to the petitions of your ibad (servant), and of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), when they shall palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place): yes, shamai (hearken / hear) from your yashab (inhabit/dwell) maqawam (place), even from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens); and when you shamai (hearken / hear), salach (forgive/pardon/make clean).

"If a ayash (man / husband) chataa (sin) against his neighbor, and an alah (curse / oath) is nashaa (lift) on him to cause him to alah (swear / adjure), and he bawaa (come) and alah (swear / adjure) panayam (face) your mazabach (altar) in this bayath (house);

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and ishah (make), and shapat (judge / judgement) your ibad (servant), shawab (turn back / repent) retribution to the rashai (wicked), to nathan (give) his darak (way) on his own raash (head); and justifying the tzadayaq (righteous), to nathan (give) him according to his tzadaqah (righteousness).

"If your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel) be nagap (struck) down panayam (face) the ayab (enemy), because they have chataa (sinned) against you, and shall shawab (turn back / repent) again and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and palal (pray) and chanan (showing favor) supplication panayam (face) you in this bayath (house);

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) them again to the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to them and to their ab (father).

"When the sky is itzar (shut) up, and there is no matar (rain), because they have chataa (sinned) against you; if they palal (pray) toward this maqawam (place), and yadah (confess) your sham (name), and shawab (turn back / repent) from their chataah (sin), when you inah (oppress / afflict) them:

Then shamai (hearken / hear) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) the chataah (sin) of your ibad (servant), and of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), when you yarah (teach) them the tawab (good / proper function) darak (way) in which they should yalak (walk); and nathan (give) matar (rain) on your aratz (Earth/land), which you nathan (give) given to your im (nation / people) for an nachalah (inheritance).

"If there is raib (famine) in the aratz (Earth/land), if there is dabar (word / matter), if there is blight or mildew, arabah (locust) or chasayal (caterpillar); if their ayab (enemy) besiege them in the aratz (Earth/land) of their shair (cities); whatever nagai (plague) or whatever machalah (sickness) there is;

Whatever thapalah (prayer) and thachanah (supplication) be made by any adam (man), or by all your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), who shall yadai (know) every ayash (man / husband) his own nagai (plague) and his own makaab (sorrow), and shall parash (spread) forth his kap (hands) toward this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place) and salach (forgive/pardon/make clean), and nathan (give) to every ayash (man / husband) according to all his darak (ways), whose labab (heart) you yadai (know); (for you, even you only, yadai (know) the labab (hearts) of the banay (children) of adam (men);)
That they may yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, to yalak (walk) in your darak (ways), so yawam (day) as they chay (life) in the adamah (land) which you nathan (give) to our ab (father).

"Moreover concerning the nakaray (foreigner), who is not of your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel), when he shall bawaa (come) from a rachawaq (far) aratz (Earth/land) for your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name) sake, and your chazaq (mighty) yad (hand), and your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); when they shall bawaa (come) and palal (pray) toward this bayath (house):

Then shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), even from your yashab (inhabit/dwell) makawan (place), and ishah (make) according to all that the nakaray (foreigner) qaraa (called) to you for; that all the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) may yadai (know) your sham (name), and yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, as does your imay (people) Yashar-Al (Israel), and that they may yadai (know) that this bayath (house) which I have banah (build) is qaraa (called) by your sham (name).
