Then Alayaizar (Eliezer) the ban (son) of Dawadawahaw (Dodavahu) of Maraashah (Mareshah) nabaa (prophesied) against Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), amar (spoke), "Because you chabar (have) joined yourself with Achazayah (Ahaziah), Yahawah has destroyed your maishah (works)." The anayawath (ships) were paratz (broken), so that they were not itzar (able) to yalak (go) to Tharashayash (Tarshish).

Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and was qabar (bury) with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Yahawaram (Jehoram) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

He had achayam (brothers), the banay (sons) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat): Izarayah (Azariah), and Yachayaal (Jehiel), and Zakarayah (Zechariah), and Izarayah (Azariah), and Mayakaal (Michael), and Shapatayah (Shephatiah); all these were the banay (sons) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Their ab (father) nathan (give) them rab (great) mathanawath (gifts), of kasap (silver), and of zahab (gold), and of magadanah (precious) things, with fortified iray (cities) in Yahawadah (Judah): but the mamalakah (kingdom) nathan (give) he to Yahawaram (Jehoram), because he was the bakawar (firstborn).

Now when Yahawaram (Jehoram) was qawam (rise up) up over the mamalakah (kingdom) of his ab (father), and had chazaq (strengthened) himself, he harag (kill) all his ach (brother/kinsman) with the charab (sword), and various also of the sharay (princes) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Yahawaram (Jehoram) was shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) shanayam (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shamanah (eight) shanayam (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel), as ishah (make) the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); for he had the banath (daughter) of Achaab (Ahab) as ayashah (woman / wife): and he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.

However Yahawah would not shachath (destroy) the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), because of the barayath (covenant) that he had karath (cut) with Dawad (David), and as he amar (spoke) to nathan (give) a nayar (lamp) to him and to his ban (son) yamayam (always).
In his yawam (day) Adawam (Edom) pashai (revolted) from under the yad (hand) of Yahawadah (Judah), and malak (king) a malak (king) over themselves.

Then Yahawaram (Jehoram) ibar (pass over/through) over with his sharay (captains), and all his rakab (chariots) with him: and he qawam (rise up) up by layal (night), and nakah (struck) the Adawam (Edomites) who surrounded him, along with the sharay (captains) of the rakab (chariots).

So Adawam (Edom) pashai (revolted) from under the yad (hand) of Yahawadah (Judah) to this yawam (day): then Labanah (Libnah) pashai (revolted) at the same ith (time) from under his yad (hand), because he had forsaken Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father).

Moreover he ishah (make) bamah (high) places in the haray (mountains) of Yahawadah (Judah), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) the inhabitants of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to zanah (play) the prostitute, and led Yahawadah (Judah) astray.

A letter bawaa (come) to him from Alayah (Elijah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke), "Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Dawad (David) your ab (father), ‘Because you have not halak (move) in the darakay (ways) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat) your ab (father), nor in the darakay (ways) of Asaa (Asa) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah),

But have yalak (walked) in the darak (way) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and have made Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to zanah (play) the prostitute, like the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab) did, and also have harag (kill) your ach (brother/kinsman) of your ab (father) bayath (house), who were tawab (good / proper function) than yourself:

Behold, Yahawah will nagap (strike) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) magapah (plague) your im (nation / people), and your ban (son), and your wives, and all your rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions);

And you shall rab (have) great chalay (sickness) by machalah (disease) of your maih (bowels), until your maih (bowels) yatzaa (go out / come out) out by reason of the chalay (sickness), yawam (day) by yawam (day).'"
Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up against Yahawaram (Jehoram) the rawach (spirit / wind) of the Palashathay (Philistines), and of the Irabay (Arabians) who are il (over) the Kawashay (Ethiopians):

And they ilah (go up / offer) up against Yahawadah (Judah), and baqai (broke) into it, and shabah (carried) away all the rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) that was matzaa (found) in the malak (king) bayath (house), and his ban (son) also, and his wives; so that there was never a ban (son) shaar (left) him, except Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz), the youngest of his ban (son).
Achar (other) all this Yahawah nagap (struck) him in his maih (bowels) with an ayan (NO ONE) chalay (disease).

It happened, in process of yawam (day), at the qatz (end) of shanayam (two) yamayam (years), that his maih (bowels) yatzaa (go out / come out) out by reason of his chalay (sickness), and he mawath (death) of severe thachalaayam (diseases). His im (nation / people) ishah (make) no sharapah (burning) for him, like the sharapah (burning) of his ab (father).

Shalawashayam (thirty) - shanayam (two) years ban (son) was he when he began to malak (king), and he malak (king) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shamanah (eight) shanayam (years): and he departed without being chamadah (desired); and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), but not in the tombs of the malakayam (kings).

The inhabitants of Jerusalem made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place; for the band of men who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah reigned.

Arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) was Achazayah (Ahaziah) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (year) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Ithalayah (Athaliah) the banath (daughter) of Imaray (Omri).
He also halak (move) in the darakay (ways) of the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); for his am (mother) was his yaitz (counselor) to rashai (do) wickedly.

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as did the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab); for they were his yawaitzayam (counselors) achar (other) the mawath (death) of his ab (father), to his mashachayath (destruction).

He halak (move) also after their itzah (counsel), and yalak (went) with Yahawaram (Jehoram) the ban (son) of Achaab (Ahab) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to malachamah (war) against Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria) at Ramath-Galaid (Ramoth Gilead): and the Ramay (Syrians) wounded Yawaram (Joram).

He shawab (turn back / repent) to be rapaa (healed) in Yazaraial (Jezreel) of the makayam (wounds) which they had nakah (given) him at Ramah (Ramah), when he lacham (fought) against Chazaal (Hazael) malak (king) of Aram (Syria). Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yahawaram (Jehoram) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yarad (went) down to raah (see) Yahawaram (Jehoram) the ban (son) of Achaab (Ahab) in Yazaraial (Jezreel), because he was chalah (afflict).

Now the thabawasah (destruction) of Achazayah (Ahaziah) was of Alahayam, in that he bawaa (come) to Yawaram (Joram): for when he bawaa (come) come, he yatzaa (go out / come out) out with Yahawaram (Jehoram) against Yahawaa (Jehu) the ban (son) of Namashay (Nimshi), whom Yahawah had mashach (anointed) to karath (cut) off the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab).

It happened, when Yahawaa (Jehu) was executing shapat (judge / judgement) on the bayath (house) of Achaab (Ahab), that he matzaa (found) the sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the banay (sons) of the achay (brothers) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), sharath (ministering) to Achazayah (Ahaziah), and harag (kill) them.

He baqash (sought) Achazayah (Ahaziah), and they lakad (caught) him (now he was chabaa (hiding) in Shamarawan (Samaria)), and they bawaa (come) him to Yahawaa (Jehu), and mawath (death) him; and they qabar (bury) him, for they amar (spoke), "He is the ban (son) of Yahawashapat (Jehoshaphat), who darash (sought) Yahawah with all his labab (heart)." The bayath (house) of Achazayah (Ahaziah) had no kach (strength / mighty / power) to hold the mamalakah (kingdom).

Now when Ithalayah (Athaliah) the am (mother) of Achazayah (Ahaziah) raah (see) that her ban (son) was mawath (death), she qawam (rise up) and dabar (word / matter) all the mamalakah (royal) zarai (seed) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah).

But Yahawashabaith (Jehoshabeath), the banath (daughter) of the malak (king), laqach (take / seize) Yawaash (Joash) the ban (son) of Achazayah (Ahaziah), and ganab (stole) him away from thawak (midst) the malak (king) banay (sons) who were mawath (death), and nathan (give) him and his yanaq (nurse) in the bedroom. So Yahawashabaith (Jehoshabeath), the banath (daughter) of malak (king) Yahawaram (Jehoram), the ayashah (woman / wife) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) (for she was the achawath (sister) of Achazayah (Ahaziah)), sathar (hid) him from Ithalayah (Athaliah), so that she didn't mawath (death) him.
He was with them chabaa (hidden) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam shash (six) shanayam (years): and Ithalayah (Athaliah) malak (king) over the aratz (Earth/land).

In the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year) Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) chazaq (strengthened) himself, and laqach (take / seize) the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yaracham (Jeroham), and Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Yahawachanan (Jehohanan), and Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Iwabad (Obed), and Maishayah (Maaseiah) the ban (son) of Idayah (Adaiah), and Alayashapat (Elishaphat) the ban (son) of Zakaray (Zichri), into barayath (covenant) with him.

They sabab (went) about in Yahawadah (Judah), and qabatz (gathered) the Lawayay (Levites) out of all the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households of Yashar-Al (Israel), and they bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

All the qahal (assembly) karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with the malak (king) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam. He amar (spoke) to them, "Behold, the malak (king) ban (son) shall malak (king), as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning the banay (sons) of Dawad (David).

This is the thing that you shall ishah (make). A shalayashay (third) part of you, who bawaa (come) in on the shabath (shabath / rest), of the kahanayam (priests) and of the Lawayay (Levites), shall be shairay (porters) of the sapayam (thresholds).

A shalayashay (third) part shall be at the malak (king) bayath (house); and a shalayashay (third) part at the shair (gate) of the yasawad (foundation). All the im (nation / people) shall be in the chatzarawath (courts) of Yahawah bayath (house).

But bawaa (come) no one come into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, except the kahanayam (priests), and those who sharath (minister) of the Lawayay (Levites). They shall bawaa (come) in, for they are qadash (set apart / make holy), but all the im (nation / people) shall follow Yahawah instructions.

The Lawayay (Levites) shall surround the malak (king), every ayash (man / husband) with his kalay (weapons) in his yad (hand). Whoever bawaa (come) into the bayath (house), let him be mawath (death). Be with the malak (king) when he bawaa (come) in, and when he yatzaa (go out / come out) out."

So the Lawayay (Levites) and all Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) according to all that Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) tzawah (commanded): and they laqach (take / seize) every ayash (man / husband) his ayash (man / husband), those who were to bawaa (come) in on the shabath (shabath / rest); with those who were to yatzaa (go out / come out) out on the shabath (shabath / rest); for Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) didn't dismiss the shift.

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) nathan (give) to the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds) the chanayathayam (spears), and maganawath (bucklers), and shalatayam (shields), that had been malak (king) Dawad (David's), which were in the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

He imad (set) all the im (nation / people), every ayash (man / husband) with his shalach (weapon) in his yad (hand), from the yamanay (right) kathap (side) of the bayath (house) to the shamaalay (left) kathap (side) of the bayath (house), along by the mazabach (altar) and the bayath (house), around the malak (king).

Then they yatzaa (go out / come out) out the malak (king) ban (son), and nathan (give) the nazar (crown / consecrate) on him, and gave him the idawath (testimony), and made him malak (king): and Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) and his ban (son) mashach (anointed) him; and they amar (spoke), "Long chayah (live) the malak (king)!"

When Ithalayah (Athaliah) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the im (nation / people) running and halal (praise) the malak (king), she bawaa (come) to the im (nation / people) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah:

And she raah (see), and, behold, the malak (king) imad (stood) by his imawad (pillar) at the mabawaa (entrance), and the sharayam (captains) and the chatzatzarawath (trumpets) by the malak (king); and all the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) shamach (rejoiced), and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) chatzatzarawath (trumpets); the singers also played shayar (song) kalay (instruments), and led the singing of halal (praise). Then Ithalayah (Athaliah) qarai (tore) her clothes, and amar (spoke), "qashar (treason)! Qashar (treason)!"

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest) yatzaa (go out / come out) out the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds) who were paqad (visit) over the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and amar (spoke) to them, "yatzaa (go out / come out) her out between the ranks; and whoever bawaa (come) her, let him be mawath (death) with the charab (sword)." For the kahan (priest) amar (spoke), "Don't mawath (death) her in the Yahawah bayath (house)."

So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) yad (hand) for her. She bawaa (come) to the mabawaa (entrance) of the sawas (horse) shair (gate) to the malak (king) bayath (house); and they mawath (death) her there.
Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) between himself, and all the im (nation / people), and the malak (king), that they should be Yahawah im (nation / people).

All the im (nation / people) bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Bail (Baal), and nathatz (broke) it down, and shabar (broke) his mazabachawath (altars) and his tzalam (likeness) in shabaraw (pieces), and harag (kill) Mathan (Mattan) the kahan (priest) of Bail (Baal) panayam (face) the mazabachawath (altars).

Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) shawam (place / establish / appoint) the paqadath (officers) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah under the yad (hand) of the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites), whom Dawad (David) chalaq (had) distributed in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, to ilah (go up / offer) the burnt ilawath (offerings) of Yahawah, as it is kathab (write) in the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), with shamachah (rejoicing) and with shayar (song), according to the yad (hand) of Dawad (David).
He imad (set) the shawairayam (porters) at the shairay (gates) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, that no one who was tamaa (unclean) in anything should bawaa (come) in.

He laqach (take / seize) the sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), and the adayarayam (nobles), and the mawashalayam (governors) of the im (nation / people), and all the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), and yarad (brought) down the malak (king) from the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and they bawaa (come) thawak (midst) the ilayawan (Ilayawan) shair (gate) to the malak (king) bayath (house), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) the malak (king) on the kasaa (throne) of the mamalakah (kingdom).
So all the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) shamach (rejoiced), and the iyar (city) was shaqat (quiet). Ithalayah (Athaliah) they had mawath (death) with the charab (sword).

Yawaash (Joash) was shabai (seven) shanayam (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) arabaiyam (forty) shanayam (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Tzabayah (Zibiah), of Baar-Shabai (Beersheba).
Yawaash (Joash) ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah all the yamay (days) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest).
Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) nashaa (lift) for him shanayam (two) wives; and he became the yalad (birth / begot) of banayam (sons) and banawath (daughters).
It happened achar (other) this, that Yawaash (Joash) intended to chadash (restore) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He qabatz (gathered) together the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), and amar (spoke) to them, "yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and qabatz (gather) kasap (money) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of your Alahayam from all Israel from shanah (year) to shanah (year). See that you expedite this dabar (word / matter)." However the Lawayay (Levites) didn't do it right away.

The malak (king) qaraa (called) for Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the raash (head), and amar (spoke) to him, "Why haven't you darash (required) of the Lawayay (Levites) to bawaa (come) in the tax of Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Yahawah, and of the qahal (assembly) of Yashar-Al (Israel), out of Yahawadah (Judah) and out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), for the ahal (tent) of the idawath (testimony)?"

For the ban (son) of Ithalayah (Athaliah), that marashaith (wicked) woman, had paratz (broken) up the bayath (house) of Alahayam; and they also gave all the qadash (set apart / make holy) things of the bayath (house) of Yahawah to the Bail (Baals).
So the malak (king) commanded, and they ishah (make) a arawan (chest), and nathan (give) it outside at the shair (gate) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They nathan (give) a qawal (sound / voice) through Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to bawaa (come) in for Yahawah the tax that Mashah (Moses) the ibad (servant) of Alahayam laid on Yashar-Al (Israel) in the madabar (wilderness).
All the sharayam (princes) and all the im (nation / people) shamach (rejoiced), and bawaa (come) in, and shalak (cast) into the arawan (chest), until they kalah (complete / finish) made an end.

It was so, that whenever the arawan (chest) was bawaa (come) to the malak (king) paqadah (officers) by the yad (hand) of the Lawayay (Levites), and when they raah (see) that there was much kasap (money), the malak (king) sapar (book) and the raash (head) kahan (priest) officer bawaa (come) and irah (emptied) the arawan (chest), and nashaa (lift) it, and nashaa (lift) it to its maqawam (place) again. Thus they ishah (make) yawam (day) by yawam (day), and asap (gathered) kasap (money) in rab (abundance).

The malak (king) and Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) nathan (give) it to such as ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and they shakar (hired) chatzabayam (masons) and charashayam (carpenters) to chadash (restore) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and also such as worked barazal (iron) and nachashath (brass) to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

So the workmen ishah (make), and the malaakah (work) of repairing went forward in their yad (hand), and they imad (set) up the bayath (house) of Alahayam in its mathakanath (state), and amatz (strengthened) it.

When they kalah (complete / finish) made an end, they bawaa (come) the shaar (rest) of the kasap (money) panayam (face) the malak (king) and Yahawayadai (Jehoiada), of which were ishah (make) kalayam (vessels) for the bayath (house) of Yahawah, even kalayam (vessels) with which to sharath (minister) and to ilah (go up / offer), and kapawath (spoons), and kalayam (vessels) of zahab (gold) and kasap (silver). They ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah continually all the yamay (days) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada).

But Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) grew zaqan (old) and was shabai (full) of yamayam (days), and he mawath (death); one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (years) ban (son) was he when he mawath (death).

They qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David) among the malakayam (kings), because he ishah (make) done tawab (good / proper function) in Yashar-Al (Israel), and toward Alahayam and his bayath (house).

Now achar (other) the mawath (death) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) bawaa (come) the sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah), and shachah (made) obeisance to the malak (king). Then the malak (king) shamai (hearken / hear) to them.

They forsook the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), and ibad (servant) the Asharah (Asherim) and the itzabayam (idols): and qatzap (wrath) came on Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for this their guiltiness.
Yet he shalach (send) nabaayam (prophets) to them, to shawab (turn back / repent) them again to Yahawah; and they iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them: but they would not azan (ear) ear.

The rawach (spirit / wind) of Alahayam labash (came) on Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest); and he imad (stood) above the im (nation / people), and amar (spoke) to them, "Thus amar (spoke) Alahayam, ‘Why ibar (pass over/through) you disobey the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah, so that you can't tzalach (prosper)? Because you have forsaken Yahawah, he has also forsaken you.'"
They qashar (conspired) against him, and ragam (stoned) him with aban (stone) at the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) in the chatzar (court) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Thus Yawaash (Joash) the malak (king) didn't zakar (remember) the chasad (grace) which Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) his ab (father) ishah (make) done to him, but harag (kill) his ban (son). When he mawath (death), he amar (spoke), "May Yahawah raah (see) at it, and repay it."

It happened at the thaqawapah (end) of the shanah (year), that the chayal (army) of the Aram (Syrians) ilah (go up / offer) up bawaa (come) him: and they came to Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and shachath (destroyed) all the sharay (princes) of the im (nation / people) from among the im (nation / people), and shalach (send) all their shalal (spoil) to the malak (king) of Damashaq (Damascus).

For the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Aram (Syrians) bawaa (come) with a matzair (small) company of anashayam (men); and Yahawah nathan (give) a very rab (great) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) into their yad (hand), because they had forsaken Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father). So they ishah (make) shapat (judge / judgement) on Yawaash (Joash).

When they were departed for him (for they izab (left) him very sick), his own ibad (servant) qashar (conspired) against him for the dam (blood) of the banay (sons) of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest), and harag (kill) him on his matah (bed), and he mawath (death); and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), but they didn't qabar (bury) him in the tombs of the malakayam (kings).

These are those who qashar (conspired) against him: Zabad (Zabad) the ban (son) of Shamaith (Shimeath) the imawanayath (ammonitess), and Yahawazabad (Jehozabad) the ban (son) of Shamarayath (Shimrith) the Moabitess.

Now concerning his ban (son), and the greatness of the mashaa (burdens) laid on him, and the rebuilding of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, behold, they are kathab (write) in the commentary of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakayam (kings). Amatzayah (Amaziah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Amatzayah (Amaziah) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yahawaidayan (Jehoaddan), of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, but not with a shalam (full / whole / complete) labab (heart).
Now it happened, when the mamalakah (kingdom) was chazaq (established) to him, that he harag (kill) his ibad (servant) who had harag (kill) the malak (king) his ab (father).

But he didn't put their banayam (children) to mawath (death), but did according to that which is kathab (write) in the thawarah (instruction) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Mashah (Moses), as Yahawah tzawah (commanded), amar (spoke), "The abawath (fathers) shall not mawath (death) for the banayam (children), neither shall the banayam (children) mawath (death) for the abawath (fathers); but every ayash (man / husband) shall mawath (death) for his own chataa (sin)."

Moreover Amatzayah (Amaziah) qabatz (gathered) Yahawadah (Judah) qabatz (together), and ordered them according to their abawath (fathers)' bayath (house), under sharay (captains) of alapayam (thousands) and sharay (captains) of maawath (hundreds), even all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin): and he paqad (visit) them from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, and matzaa (found) them shalawash (three) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) bachar (chosen) men, yatzaa (go out / come out) to go forth to tzabaa (troop), who could achaz (handle) ramach (spear) and tzanah (shield).

He shakar (hired) also one maah (hundred) alap (thousand) gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of valor out of Yashar-Al (Israel) for one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver).

A ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam bawaa (come) to him, amar (spoke), "O malak (king), don't let the tzabaa (troop) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) with you; for Yahawah is not with Yashar-Al (Israel), with all the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

But if you will bawaa (come), ishah (make) action, be chazaq (strong) for the malachamah (battle). Alahayam will overthrow you panayam (face) the ayab (enemy); for Alahayam yash (has) kach (strength / mighty / power) to izar (help), and to overthrow."

Amatzayah (Amaziah) amar (spoke) to the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, "But what shall we ishah (make) for the maah (hundred) kakar (talents) which I nathan (give) given to the gadawad (army) of Yashar-Al (Israel)?" The ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam amar (spoke), "Yahawah is able to nathan (give) you much more than this."

Then Amatzayah (Amaziah) badal (separated) them, the gadawad (army) that bawaa (come) come to him out of Aparayam (Ephraim), to bawaa (come) maqawam (place) again: therefore their ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was maad (greatly) charah (hot with anger) against Yahawadah (Judah), and they shawab (turn back / repent) maqawam (place) in charay (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

Amatzayah (Amaziah) chazaq (took) courage, and nahag (led) forth his im (nation / people), and yalak (went) to the gayaa (valley) of malach (salt), and nakah (struck) ishar (ten) alap (thousand) of the banay (children) of Shaiyar (Seir).

The banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) shabah (carry) away ishar (ten) alap (thousand) chay (life), and bawaa (come) them to the raash (head) of the salai (rock), and shalak (threw) them down from the raash (head) of the salai (rock), so that they all were baqai (broken) in pieces.

But the banay (men) of the gadawad (army) whom Amatzayah (Amaziah) shawab (turn back / repent) back, that they should not yalak (go) with him to malachamah (battle), pashat (fell) on the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), from Shamarawan (Samaria) even to Bayathachawarawan (Beth Horon), and nakah (struck) of them shalawash (three) alap (thousand), and bazaz (took) much bazah (spoil).

Now it happened, achar (other) that Amatzayah (Amaziah) bawaa (come) come from the nakah (slaughter) of the Adawamay (Edomites), that he bawaa (come) the Alahayam of the banay (children) of Shaiyar (Seir), and imad (set) them up to be his Alahayam, and shachah (bowed) down panayam (face) before them, and qatar (burned) incense to them.

Therefore the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah was charah (hot with anger) against Amatzayah (Amaziah), and he shalach (send) to him a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who amar (spoke) to him, "Why have you darash (sought) after the Alahayam of the im (nation / people), which have not natzal (delivered) their own im (nation / people) out of your yad (hand)?"

It happened, as he dabar (word / matter) with him, that the king amar (spoke) to him, "nathan (give) we made you one of the malak (king) yaitz (counselors)? Stop! Why should you be nakah (struck) down?" Then the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) stopped, and amar (spoke), "I yadai (know) that Alahayam has yaitz (determined) to shachath (destroy) you, because you ishah (make) done this, and have not shamai (hearken / hear) to my itzah (counsel)."

Then Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) yaitz (consulted) his advisers, and shalach (send) to Yawaash (Joash), the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yahawaa (Jehu), malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), "ban (son), raah (see) us look one another in the panayam (face)."

Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shalach (send) to Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), "The chawach (thistle) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) shalach (send) to the araz (cedar) that was in Labanawan (Lebanon), amar (spoke), ‘nathan (give) your banath (daughter) to my ban (son) as his ayashah (woman / wife); then a shadah (wild) animal that was in Labanawan (Lebanon) ibar (pass over/through) by, and ramas (trampled) down the chawach (thistle).

You amar (spoke) to yourself that you have nakah (struck) Adawam (Edom); and your lab (heart) nashaa (lift) you up to kabad (boast). Now stay at bayath (house). Why should you garah (meddle) with rai (trouble), that you should napal (fall / be cast down), even you, and Yahawadah (Judah) with you?'"

But Amatzayah (Amaziah) would not shamai (hearken / hear); for it was of Alahayam, that he might nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their enemies, because they had darash (sought) after the Alahayam of Adawam (Edom).

So Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ilah (go up / offer) up; and he and Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) raah (see) one another in the panayam (face) at Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), which belongs to Yahawadah (Judah).
Yahawadah (Judah) was defeated by Yashar-Al (Israel); and they nawas (fled) every ayash (man / husband) to his ahal (tent).

Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) thapash (took) Amatzayah (Amaziah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) the ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz), at Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), and bawaa (come) him to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and paratz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the shair (gate) of Aparayam (Ephraim) to the panah (turn) shair (gate), arabai (four) maah (hundred) amah (cubits).

He took all the zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), and all the kalayam (vessels) that were matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam with Ibadaadawam (Obed-Edom), and the atzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king) bayath (house), the hostages also, and shawab (turn back / repent) to Shamarawan (Samaria).

Amatzayah (Amaziah) the ban (son) of Yawaash (Joash) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) chayah (lived) achar (other) the mawath (death) of Yawaash (Joash) ban (son) of Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chamash (fifteen) shanah (years).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Amatzayah (Amaziah), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, aren't they kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yashar-Al (Israel)?

Now from the ith (time) that Amatzayah (Amaziah) sawar (turned) away from achar (other) Yahawah, they made a qashar (conspiracy) against him in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). He nawas (fled) to Lakayash (Lachish); but they shalach (send) achar (other) him to Lakayash (Lachish), and mawath (death) him there.
They nashaa (lift) him on sawasayam (horses), and qabar (bury) him with his ab (father) in the iyar (city) of Yahawadah (Judah).

All the im (nation / people) of Yahawadah (Judah) laqach (take / seize) Izayah (Uzziah), who was sixteen shanah (years) ban (son), and made him malak (king) in the place of his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah).
He banah (build) Ayalawath (Eloth), and shawab (turn back / repent) it to Yahawadah (Judah), achar (other) that the malak (king) shakab (slept) with his ab (father).

Sixteen shanah (years) ban (son) was Izayah (Uzziah) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yakalayah (Jechiliah), of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) Amatzayah (Amaziah) ishah (make) done.

He set himself to darash (seek) Alahayam in the yamay (days) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), who had bayan (between) in the raah (see) of Alahayam: and as long as he darash (sought) Yahawah, Alahayam made him to tzalach (prosper).

He yatzaa (go out / come out) forth and lacham (warred) against the Palashathay (Philistines), and paratz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of gath (gath), and the chawamah (wall) of Yabanah (Jabneh), and the chawamah (wall) of Ashadawad (Ashdod); and he banah (build) irayam (cities) in the country of Ashadawad (Ashdod), and among the Palashathay (Philistines).
Alahayam izar (helped) him against the Palashathay (Philistines), and against the Irabay (Arabians) who lived in Gawarabail (Gur Baal), and the maiwanay (meunim).
The Imawanay (Ammonites) nathan (give) tribute to Izayah (Uzziah): and his sham (name) yalak (spread) abroad even to the entrance of Matzarayam (Egypt); for he grew mail (top/above) chazaq (strong).

Moreover Izayah (Uzziah) banah (build) magadalayam (towers) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) at the panah (corner / cornerstone) shair (gate), and at the gayaa (valley) shair (gate), and at the maqatzawai (turning) of the wall, and chazaq (fortified) them.

He banah (build) magadalayam (towers) in the madabar (wilderness), and chatzab (dug) out many barawath (cisterns), for he rab (had) much livestock; in the lowland also, and in the mayashawar (plain): and he had farmers and vineyard keepers in the harayam (mountains) and in the Karamal (fruitful) fields; for he ahab (love) farming.

Moreover Izayah (Uzziah) had an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of malachamah (fighting) ishah (make), who yatzaa (go out / come out) out to tzabaa (troop) by gadawad (bands), according to the masapar (number) of their paqadah (reckoning) made by Yaiyaal (Jeiel) the sapar (book) and Maishayah (Maaseiah) the shatar (officer), under the yad (hand) of Chananayah (Hananiah), one of the malak (king) sharay (captains).
The whole masapar (number) of the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, even the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, was two alap (thousand) and shash (six) maah (hundred).

Under their yad (hand) was an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) alap (thousand) and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) and chamash (five) maah (hundred), who ishah (make) malachamah (war) with chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) kach (strength / mighty / power), to izar (help) the malak (king) against the ayab (enemy).

Izayah (Uzziah) kawan (prepared) for them, even for all the tzabaa (troop), maganayam (shields), and ramachayam (spears), and kawabaiyam (helmets), and sharayanawath (coats) of mail, and qashathawath (bows), and abanay (stones) for qalai (slinging).

He ishah (make) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) chashabanawath (engines), machashabah (invented) by skillful chashab (men), to be on the magadalayam (towers) and on the battlements, with which to yarah (shoot) chatzayam (arrows) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) abanayam (stones). His sham (name) yatzaa (go out / come out) rachawaq (far) abroad; for he was marvelously izar (helped), kay (surely) he was chazaq (strong).

But when he was chazaqah (strong), his lab (heart) was gabah (lifted) up, so that he did corruptly, and he mail (top/above) against Yahawah his Alahayam; for he bawaa (come) into the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah to qatar (burn) incense on the mazabach (altar) of qatar (incense).

Izarayah (Azariah) the kahan (priest) bawaa (come) in achar (other) him, and with him shamanayam (eighty) kahanayam (priests) of Yahawah, who were chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) banay (men):

And they resisted Izayah (Uzziah) the malak (king), and amar (spoke) to him, "It isn't for you, Izayah (Uzziah), to qatar (burn) incense to Yahawah, but for the kahanayam (priests) the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron), who are qadash (set apart / make holy) to qatar (burn) incense. Yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the maqadash (sanctuary); for you have mail (top/above); neither shall it be for your honor from Yahawah Alahayam."

Then Izayah (Uzziah) was angry; and he had a maqatarath (censer) in his yad (hand) to qatar (burn) incense; and while he was angry with the kahanayam (priests), the tzaraith (leprosy) broke forth in his matzach (forehead) panayam (face) the kahanayam (priests) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, beside the mazabach (altar) of qatarath (incense).

Izarayah (Azariah) the raash (head) kahan (priest), and all the kahanayam (priests), panah (turn) on him, and behold, he was tzarai (leprous) in his matzach (forehead), and they bahal (thrust) him out quickly from there; yes, himself hurried also to yatzaa (go out / come out) out, because Yahawah had nagai (struck) him.

Izayah (Uzziah) the malak (king) was a tzarai (leper) to the yawam (day) of his mawath (death), and lived in a separate bayath (house), being a tzarai (leper); for he was gazar (cut) off from the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son) was over the malak (king) bayath (house), shapat (judge / judgement) the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Izayah (Uzziah), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), kathab (write).

So Izayah (Uzziah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father); and they qabar (bury) him with his ab (father) in the shadah (field) of qabawarah (burial) which belonged to the malakayam (kings); for they amar (spoke), "He is a tzarai (leper)." Yawatham (Jotham) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yawatham (Jotham) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Yarawashaa (Jerushah) the banath (daughter) of Tzadawaq (Zadok).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, according to all that his ab (father) Izayah (Uzziah) ishah (make) done: however he didn't enter into the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah. The im (nation / people) still did corruptly.
He banah (build) the ilayawan (Ilayawan) shair (gate) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and on the chawamah (wall) of Ipal (Ophel) he banah (build) much.
Moreover he banah (build) irayam (cities) in the har (mountain) country of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the Charash (forests) he banah (build) bayaranayawath (castles) and towers.

He lacham (fought) also with the malak (king) of the children of imawan (ammon), and chazaq (prevailed) against them. The banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon) nathan (give) him the same shanah (year) one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver), and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) karayam (measures) of chatah (wheat), and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) of shairah (barley). The banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon) shawab (turn back / repent) that much to him in the shanay (second) shanah (year) also, and in the shalayashay (third).
So Yawatham (Jotham) became chazaq (mighty), because he kawan (ordered) his darak (ways) panayam (face) Yahawah his Alahayam.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yawatham (Jotham), and all his malachamah (wars), and his darak (ways), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah).
He was chamash (five) and isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king), and malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Yawatham (Jotham) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David): and Achaz (Ahaz) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Achaz (Ahaz) was isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) sixteen shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he didn't do that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, like Dawad (David) his ab (father);
But he yalak (walked) in the darakay (ways) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and ishah (make) also masakah (molten) images for the Bail (Baals).

Moreover he burnt qatar (incense) in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), and burnt his banay (children) in the ash (fire), according to the thaibawath (abominations) of the gawayam (nations) whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
He zabach (sacrificed) and burnt qatar (incense) in the bamah (high) places, and on the gabaiwath (hills), and under every rainan (green) itz (tree).

Therefore Yahawah his Alahayam nathan (give) him into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Aram (Syria); and they nakah (struck) him, and shabah (carried) away of his a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) multitude of shabayah (captives), and bawaa (come) them to Damashaq (Damascus). He was also nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), who nakah (struck) him with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) makah (slaughter).

For Paqach (Pekah) the ban (son) of Ramalayahaw (Remaliah) harag (kill) in Yahawadah (Judah) one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) alap (thousand) in achad (one) yawam (day), all of them chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) banay (men); because they had forsaken Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Zakaray (Zichri), a gabawar (mighty) man of Aparayam (Ephraim), harag (kill) Maishayah (Maaseiah) the malak (king) ban (son), and Izarayaqam (Azrikam) the nagayad (ruler) of the bayath (house), and Alaqanah (Elkanah) who was mashanah (next) to the malak (king).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shabah (carried) away captive of their ach (brother/kinsman) two maah (hundred) alap (thousand), nashayam (women), banay (sons), and banawath (daughters), and bazaz (took) also away much shalal (spoil) from them, and bawaa (come) the shalal (spoil) to Shamarawan (Samaria).

But a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) of Yahawah was there, whose sham (name) was Iwadad (Oded): and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out to panayam (face) the tzabaa (troop) that bawaa (come) to Shamarawan (Samaria), and amar (spoke) to them, "Behold, because Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), was angry with Yahawadah (Judah), he nathan (give) delivered them into your yad (hand), and you have harag (kill) them in a zaip (rage) which has nagai (reached) up to shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

Now you purpose to kabash (keep) under the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for ibadayam (bondservants) and bondmaids for yourselves. Aren't there even with you trespasses of your own against Yahawah your Alahayam?

Now shamai (hearken / hear) me therefore, and shawab (turn back / repent) back the shabayah (captives), that you have shabah (taken) captive from your ach (brother/kinsman); for the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah is on you."

Then some of the raashay (heads) of the banay (children) of Aparayam (Ephraim), Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yahawachanan (Johanan), Barakayah (Berechiah) the ban (son) of Mashalamawath (Meshillemoth), and Yachazaqayah (Jehizkiah) the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum), and Imashaa (Amasa) the ban (son) of Chadalay (Hadlai), qawam (rise up) up bawaa (come) those who came from the tzabaa (troop),

And amar (spoke) to them, "You shall not bawaa (come) in the shabayah (captives) here: for you purpose that which will bring on us a ashamah (trespass) against Yahawah, to yasap (add) to our chataah (sin) and to our ashamah (trespass); for our ashamah (trespass) is rab (great), and there is fierce ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) against Yashar-Al (Israel)."
So the chalatz (armed) men izab (left) the shabayah (captives) and the bazah (spoil) panayam (face) the sharayam (princes) and all the qahal (assembly).

The anashayam (men) who have been mentioned by sham (name) qawam (rise up) up, and chazaq (took) the shabayah (captives), and with the shalal (spoil) labash (clothed) all who were mairam (naked) among them, dressed them, gave them sandals, and gave them something to akal (eat) and to shaqah (drink), sawak (anointed) them, nahal (carried) all the kashal (stumble / stagger) of them on donkeys, and bawaa (come) them to Yarayachaw (Jericho), the iyar (city) of thamar (palm) trees, to their ach (brother/kinsman). Then they shawab (turn back / repent) to Shamarawan (Samaria).
At that ith (time) malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) shalach (send) to the malakay (kings) of Ashawar (Assyria) to izar (help) him.
For again the Adawamay (Edomites) bawaa (come) come and nakah (struck) Yahawadah (Judah), and shabah (carried) away shabay (captives).

The Palashathay (Philistines) also had pashat (invaded) the iray (cities) of the lowland, and of the nagab (south) of Yahawadah (Judah), and had lakad (taken) Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), and Ayalawan (Aijalon), and Gadarawath (Gederoth), and Shawakah (Soco) with its banath (daughter), and Thamanah (Timnah) with its banath (daughter), Gamazaw (Gimzo) also and its banath (daughter): and they lived there.

For Yahawah kanai (brought) Yahawadah (Judah) low because of Achaz (Ahaz) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel); for he had dealt wantonly in Yahawadah (Judah), and mail (top/above) severely against Yahawah.
Thagalathapalaasar (Tilgath Pilneser) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come) to him, and tzawar (distressed) him, but didn't chazaq (strengthen) him.

For Achaz (Ahaz) chalaq (took) away a portion out of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and out of the bayath (house) of the malak (king) and of the sharayam (princes), and nathan (give) it to the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria): but it didn't izarah (help) him.
In the ith (time) of his tzarar (distress), he mail (top/above) yet more against Yahawah, this same malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz).

For he zabach (sacrificed) to the Alahayam of Damashaq (Damascus), which nakah (struck) him; and he amar (spoke), "Because the Alahayam of the malakay (kings) of Aram (Syria) izar (helped) them, so I will zabach (sacrifice) to them, that they may izar (help) me." But they were the kashal (stumble / stagger) of him, and of all Yashar-Al (Israel).

Achaz (Ahaz) asap (gathered) together the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and qatzatz (cut) in pieces the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and sagar (shut) up the dalathawath (doors) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and he ishah (make) him mazabachawath (altars) in every panah (corner / cornerstone) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
In every iyar (city) of Yahawadah (Judah) he ishah (make) bamah (high) places to qatar (burn) incense to other Alahayam, and provoked to kais (anger) Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father).

Now the yathar (rest) of his dabar (word / matter), and all his darak (ways), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yashar-Al (Israel).

Achaz (Ahaz) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in the iyar (city), even in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for they didn't bawaa (come) him into the tombs of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel): and Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) began to malak (king) when he was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son); and he malak (king) isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and his am (mother) sham (name) was Abayah (Abijah), the banath (daughter) of Zakarayah (Zechariah).
He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, according to all that Dawad (David) his ab (father) ishah (make) done.

He in the raashawan (first) shanah (year) of his malak (king), in the raashawan (first) chadash (month), pathach (opened) the dalathawath (doors) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and chazaq (repaired) them.
He bawaa (come) in the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), and asap (gathered) them together into the rachab (broad) place on the mazarach (east),

And amar (spoke) to them, "shamai (hearken / hear) to me, you Lawayay (Levites)! Now qadash (set apart / make holy) yourselves, and qadash (set apart / make holy) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), and yatzaa (go out / come out) out the nadah (filthiness) out of the qadash (set apart / make holy) place.

For our ab (father) have mail (top/above), and ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah our Alahayam, and have forsaken him, and have sabab (turned) away their panayam (face) from the mashakan (habitation) of Yahawah, and nathan (give) their irap (neck).

Also they have sagar (shut) up the dalathawath (doors) of the awalam (porch), and put out the narawath (lamps), and have not qatar (burned) qatarath (incense) nor ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings) in the qadash (set apart / make holy) place to the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Therefore the qatzap (wrath) of Yahawah was on Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and he nathan (give) delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing), as you raah (see) with your iyan (eye).
For, behold, our ab (father) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen by the charab (sword), and our ban (son) and our banath (daughter) and our wives are in shabay (captivity) for this.

Now it is in my labab (heart) to karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), that his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) may shawab (turn back / repent) away from us.

My ban (son), don't be shalah (negligent) now; for Yahawah has bachar (chosen) you to imad (stand) panayam (face) him, to sharath (minister) to him, and that you should be his masharathayam (ministers), and qatar (burn) incense."

Then the Lawayay (Levites) qawam (rise up), Machath (Mahath), the ban (son) of Imashay (Amasai), and Yawaal (Joel) the ban (son) of Izarayah (Azariah), of the banay (sons) of the Qahathay (Kohathites); and of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), Qayash (Kish) the ban (son) of Ibaday (Abdi), and Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Yahalalaal (Jehallelel); and of the garashanay (gershonites), Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Zamah (Zimmah), and Idan (Eden) the ban (son) of Yawaach (Joah);
And of the banay (sons) of Alayatzapan (Elizaphan), Shamaray (Shimri) and Yaiyaal (Jeuel); and of the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph), Zakarayah (Zechariah) and Mathanayah (Mattaniah);
And of the banay (sons) of Hayaman (Heman), Yachayaal (Jehuel) and Shamaiy (Shimei); and of the banay (sons) of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun), Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) and Izayaal (Uzziel).

They asap (gathered) their ach (brother/kinsman), and qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves, and bawaa (come) in, according to the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) by the dabaray (words) of Yahawah, to tahar (cleanse) the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The kahanayam (priests) bawaa (come) in to the inner panayamah (part) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, to tahar (cleanse) it, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out all the tamaah (uncleanness) that they matzaa (found) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah into the chatzar (court) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah. The Lawayay (Levites) qabal (took) it, to yatzaa (go out / come out) it out chawatz (abroad) to the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).

Now they chalal (began) on the achad (one) day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month) to qadash (set apart / make holy), and on the shamanah (eighth) yawam (day) of the chadash (month) bawaa (come) they to the awalam (porch) of Yahawah; and they qadash (set apart / make holy) the bayath (house) of Yahawah in shamanah (eight) yamayam (days): and on the sixteenth day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month) they kalah (complete / finish) an end.

Then they bawaa (come) in to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king) within the palace, and amar (spoke), "We have tahar (cleansed) all the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the mazabach (altar) of burnt ilah (offering), with all its kalay (vessels), and the shalachan (table) of show mairakath (bread), with all its kalay (vessels).

Moreover all the kalayam (vessels), which malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) in his malakawath (reign) threw zanach (away) when he mail (top/above), have we kawan (prepared) and qadash (set apart / make holy); and behold, they are panayam (face) the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah."
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king) arose shakam (early), and asap (gathered) the sharay (princes) of the iyar (city), and ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They bawaa (come) shabai (seven) parayam (bulls), and shabai (seven) ayalayam (rams), and shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs), and shabai (seven) male izayam (goats), for a chataah (sin) offering for the mamalakah (kingdom) and for the maqadash (sanctuary) and for Yahawadah (Judah). He commanded the kahanayam (priests) the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron) to ilah (go up / offer) them on the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah.

So they shachat (killed) the baqar (morning), and the kahanayam (priests) qabal (received) the dam (blood), and zaraq (sprinkled) it on the mazabach (altar): and they shachat (killed) the alayam (rams), and zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) on the mazabach (altar): they shachat (killed) also the kabashayam (lambs), and zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) on the mazabach (altar).
They nagash (brought) near the male shaiyaray (goats) for the chataah (sin) offering panayam (face) the malak (king) and the qahal (assembly); and they samak (laid) their yad (hand) on them:

And the kahanayam (priests) shachat (killed) them, and they made a chataa (sin) offering with their dam (blood) on the mazabach (altar), to make kapar (atonement) for all Yashar-Al (Israel); for the malak (king) commanded that the burnt ilah (offering) and the sin ilah (offering) should be made for all Yashar-Al (Israel).

He imad (set) the Lawayay (Levites) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah with matzalathayam (cymbals), with stringed instruments, and with kanarawath (harps), according to the matzawah (commandment) of Dawad (David), and of Gad (Gad) the malak (king) chazah (seer), and Nathan (Nathan) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); for the matzawah (commandment) was of Yahawah by his nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).
The Lawayay (Levites) imad (stood) with the kalay (instruments) of Dawad (David), and the kahanayam (priests) with the chatzatzarawath (trumpets).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) commanded to ilah (go up / offer) the burnt ilah (go up / offer) on the mazabach (altar). When the burnt ilah (offering) chalal (began), the shayar (song) of Yahawah chalal (began) also, and the chatzatzarawath (trumpets), together with the kalay (instruments) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

All the qahal (assembly) shachah (worshiped), and the singers shayar (sang), and the chatzatzarawath (trumpeters) chatzar (sounded); all this continued until the burnt ilah (offering) was kalah (complete / finish).
When they kalah (complete / finish) made an end of ilah (go up / offer), the malak (king) and all who were matzaa (present) with him karai (bowed) themselves and shachah (worshiped).

Moreover Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king) and the sharayam (princes) commanded the Lawayay (Levites) to sing yahalalaw (praises) to Yahawah with the dabaray (words) of Dawad (David), and of Asap (Asaph) the chazah (seer). They sang yahalalaw (praises) with shamachah (gladness), and they bowed their yaqadaw (heads) and shachah (worshiped).

Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) inah (answer / respond), "Now you malaa (have) consecrated yourselves to Yahawah; nagash (come) near and bawaa (come) zabachayam (sacrifices) and thank thawadawath (offerings) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah." The qahal (assembly) bawaa (come) in zabachayam (sacrifices) and thank thawadawath (offerings); and as many as were of a nadayab (willing) lab (heart) brought burnt ilawath (offerings).

The masapar (number) of the burnt ilah (offerings) which the qahal (assembly) bawaa (come) was shabaiyam (seventy) baqar (morning), one maah (hundred) ayalayam (rams), and two maah (hundred) kabashayam (lambs): all these were for a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah.
The qadash (set apart / make holy) things were shash (six) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle and shalawash (three) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep).

But the kahanayam (priests) were too mait (few), so that they yakal (could) not pashat (flay) all the burnt ilawath (offerings): therefore their ach (brother/kinsman) the Lawayay (Levites) chazaq (helped) them, until the malaakah (work) was kalah (complete / finish), and until the kahanayam (priests) had qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves; for the Lawayay (Levites) were more yashar (upright) in labab (heart) to qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves than the kahanayam (priests).

Also the burnt ilah (offerings) were in rab (abundance), with the chalab (fat) of the shalam (peace) offerings, and with the drink nasakayam (offerings) for every burnt ilah (offering). So the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah was kawan (set) in order.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shamach (rejoiced), and all the im (nation / people), because of that which Alahayam had kawan (prepared) for the im (nation / people): for the thing was done pathaawam (suddenly).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shalach (send) to all Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), and kathab (write) agarawath (letters) also to Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), that they should bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

For the malak (king) had taken yaitz (counsel), and his shar (prince / ruler), and all the qahal (assembly) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) in the shanay (second) chadash (month).

For they yakal (could) not ishah (make) it at that ith (time), because the kahanayam (priests) had not qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves in sufficient number, neither had the im (nation / people) asap (gathered) themselves together to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
The thing was yashar (upright) in the eyes of the malak (king) and of all the qahal (assembly).

So they imad (established) a dabar (word / matter) to ibar (pass over/through) proclamation throughout all Yashar-Al (Israel), from Baar-Shabai (Beersheba) even to Dan (Dan), that they should bawaa (come) to ishah (make) the pasach (passover) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): for they ishah (make) not kept it in rab (great) numbers in such sort as it is kathab (write).

So the couriers yalak (went) with the agarawath (letters) from the malak (king) and his shar (prince / ruler) throughout all Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), and according to the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king), amar (spoke), "You banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), shawab (turn back / repent) again to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Abaraham (Abraham), Yatzachaq (Isaac), and Yashar-Al (Israel), that he may shawab (turn back / repent) to the shaar (remnant) that have palayatah (escaped) of you out of the kap (hand) of the malakay (kings) of Ashawar (Assyria).

Don't be like your ab (father), and like your ach (brother/kinsman), who mail (top/above) against Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), so that he nathan (give) them up to shamah (desolation), as you raah (see).

Now don't be stiff-necked, as your ab (father) were; but nathan (give) yad (hand) to Yahawah, and bawaa (come) into his maqadash (sanctuary), which he has qadash (set apart / make holy) iwalam (forever), and ibad (servant) Yahawah your Alahayam, that his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) may shawab (turn back / repent) away from you.

For if you shawab (turn back / repent) again to Yahawah, your ach (brother/kinsman) and your ban (son) shall find racham (show mercy / love) panayam (face) those who shabah (led) them captive, and shall shawab (turn back / repent) again into this aratz (Earth/land): for Yahawah your Alahayam is chanawan (gracious) and rachawam (merciful), and will not sawar (turn) away his panayam (face) from you, if you shawab (turn back / repent) to him."

So the couriers ibar (pass over/through) from iyar (city) to iyar (city) through the aratz (Earth/land) of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), even to Zabawalawan (Zebulun): but they ridiculed them, and laig (mocked) them.
Nevertheless ayash (man / husband) men of Ashar (Asher) and Manashah (Manasseh) and of Zabawalawan (Zebulun) kanai (humbled) themselves, and bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Also on Yahawadah (Judah) came the yad (hand) of Alahayam to nathan (give) them achad (one) lab (heart), to ishah (make) the matzawah (commandment) of the malak (king) and of the sharayam (princes) by the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

Many im (nation / people) asap (assembled) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) in the shanay (second) chadash (month), a very rab (great) qahal (assembly).

They qawam (rise up) and sawar (took) away the mazabachawath (altars) that were in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and all the altars for qatar (incense) sawar (took) they away, and shalak (cast) them into the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron).

Then they shachat (killed) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth day of the shanay (second) chadash (month): and the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) were kalam (ashamed), and qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves, and bawaa (come) burnt ilawath (offerings) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

They imad (stood) in their imad (place) after their mashapat (order), according to the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam: the kahanayam (priests) zaraq (sprinkled) the dam (blood) which they received of the yad (hand) of the Lawayay (Levites).

For there were many in the qahal (assembly) who had not qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves: therefore the Lawayay (Levites) were in charge of shachayatah (killing) the pasachayam (passovers) for everyone who was not tahawar (clean), to qadash (set apart / make holy) them to Yahawah.

For a marabayath (multitude) of the im (nation / people), even many of Aparayam (Ephraim) and Manashah (Manasseh), Yashashakar (Issachar) and Zabawalawan (Zebulun), had not tahar (cleansed) themselves, yet they akal (eat) the pasach (passover) otherwise than it is kathab (write). For Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) had palal (prayed) for them, amar (spoke), "May the tawab (good / proper function) Yahawah kapar (pardon) everyone

Who kawan (sets) his labab (heart) to darash (seek) Alahayam, Yahawah, the Alahayam of his ab (father), even if they aren't clean according to the taharah (purification) of the qadash (set apart / make holy)."
Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and rapaa (healed) the im (nation / people).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) who were matzaa (present) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) shabai (seven) yamayam (days) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (gladness); and the Lawayay (Levites) and the kahanayam (priests) halal (praise) Yahawah yawam (day) by yawam (day), singing with iz (strength / might / refuge) kalay (instruments) to Yahawah.

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) dabar (word / matter) lab (heart) to all the Lawayay (Levites) who had tawab (good / proper function) shakal (understanding) in the service of Yahawah. So they akal (eat) throughout the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) for the shabai (seven) yamayam (days), zabach (offering) sacrifices of shalam (peace) mazabachayam (offerings), and making yadah (confession) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).
The whole qahal (assembly) took yaitz (counsel) to ishah (make) other shabai (seven) yamayam (days); and they ishah (make) another shabai (seven) yamayam (days) with shamachah (gladness).

For Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) rawam (will lift up) to the qahal (assembly) for offerings one alap (thousand) parayam (bulls) and shabai (seven) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep); and the sharayam (princes) rawam (will lift up) to the qahal (assembly) a alap (thousand) parayam (bulls) and ishar (ten) alap (thousand) tzaan (sheep): and a rab (great) number of kahanayam (priests) qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves.

All the qahal (assembly) of Yahawadah (Judah), with the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), and all the qahal (assembly) who bawaa (come) out of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the foreigners who bawaa (come) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and who lived in Yahawadah (Judah), shamach (rejoiced).

So there was gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (joy) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for yawam (day) the time of Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) there was not the like in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites) qawam (rise up) and barak (blessed) the im (nation / people): and their qawal (sound / voice) was shamai (hearken / hear), and their thapalah (prayer) bawaa (come) up to his qadash (set apart / make holy) maiwan (habitation), even to shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

Now when all this was kalah (complete / finish), all Yashar-Al (Israel) who were matzaa (present) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and shabar (broke) in yashabaraw (pieces) the matzabawath (pillars), and gadai (cut) down the Asharah (Asherim), and nathatz (broke) down the bamah (high) places and the mazabachath (altars) out of all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), in Aparayam (Ephraim) also and Manashah (Manasseh), until they kalah (complete / finish) destroyed them all. Then all the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) shawab (turn back / repent), every ayash (man / husband) to his achazah (possession), into their own iray (cities).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) imad (appointed) the machalaqawath (divisions) of the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) after their machalaqawath (divisions), every ayash (man / husband) pah (according) to his ibadah (service), both the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), for burnt ilah (offerings) and for peace ilah (offerings), to sharath (minister), and to give yadah (thanks), and to halal (praise) in the shairay (gates) of the machanah (camp) of Yahawah.

He appointed also the malak (king) manath (portion) of his rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) for the burnt ilawath (offerings), for the baqar (morning) and irab (evening) burnt ilawath (offerings), and the burnt ilawath (offerings) for the shabathawath (sabbaths), and for the new chadashayam (moons), and for the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts, as it is kathab (write) in the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah.

Moreover he commanded the im (nation / people) who lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to nathan (give) the manath (portion) of the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), that they might give themselves to the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah.

As soon as the commandment paratz (came) abroad, the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) in rabah (abundance) the raashayath (beginning) fruits of grain, new thayarawash (wine), and yatzahar (fresh oil), and dabash (honey), and of all the thabawaah (increase) of the shadah (field); and the maishar (tithe) of all things bawaa (come) they in rab (abundantly).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), who lived in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), they also bawaa (come) in the maishar (tithe) of cattle and tzaan (sheep), and the maishar (tithe) of qadash (set apart / make holy) things which were qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah their Alahayam, and nathan (give) them by iramawath (heaps).
In the shalayashay (third) chadash (month) they chalal (began) to yasad (lay) the foundation of the iramawath (heaps), and kalah (complete / finish) them in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).
When Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) and the sharayam (princes) bawaa (come) and raah (see) the iramawath (heaps), they barak (blessed) Yahawah, and his im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel).
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) darash (questioned) the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) concerning the iramawath (heaps).

Izarayah (Azariah) the raash (head) kahan (priest), of the bayath (house) of Tzadawaq (Zadok), amar (spoke) him and amar (spoke), "Since people chalal (began) to bawaa (come) the tharawamah (offerings) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, we have akal (eat) and shabai (had) enough, and have yathar (left) rab (plenty): for Yahawah has barak (blessed) his im (nation / people); and that which is yathar (left) is this great hamawan (store)."
Then Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) commanded them to kawan (prepare) rooms in the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and they kawan (prepared) them.

They bawaa (come) in the tharawamah (offerings) and the maishar (tithes) and the qadash (set apart / make holy) things faithfully: and over them Kawananayahaw (Conaniah) the Lawayay (Levite) was nagayad (ruler), and Shamaiy (Shimei) his ach (brother/kinsman) was mashanah (second).

Yachayaal (Jehiel), and Izazayahaw (Azaziah), and Nachath (Nahath), and Ishahaal (Asahel), and Yarayamawath (Jerimoth), and Yawazabad (Jozabad), and Alayaal (Eliel), and Yasamakayahaw (Ismachiah), and Machath (Mahath), and Banayah (Benaiah), were paqayadayam (overseers) under the yad (hand) of Kawananayahaw (Conaniah) and Shamaiy (Shimei) his ach (brother/kinsman), by the appointment of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king), and Izarayah (Azariah) the nagayad (ruler) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Qawaraa (Kore) the ban (son) of Yamanah (Imnah) the Lawayay (Levite), the shawair (porter) at the mazarach (east) gate, was over the freewill nadabawath (offerings) of Alahayam, to nathan (give) the tharawamah (offerings) of Yahawah, and the most qadash (set apart / make holy) things.

Under him were Idan (Eden), and Manayamayan (Miniamin), and Yashawai (Jeshua), and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), Amarayah (Amariah), and Shakanayah (Shecaniah), in the iray (cities) of the kahanayam (priests), in their amawanah (office) of trust, to nathan (give) to their ach (brother/kinsman) by machalaqawath (divisions), as well to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) as to the qatan (small / young / least):

Besides those who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of zakarayam (males), from shalawash (three) shanayam (years) ban (son) and upward, even everyone who bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, as the duty of every yawam (day) required, for their ibadah (service) in their mashamarath (duty / watch) according to their machalaqath (divisions);

And those who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of the kahanayam (priests) by their ab (father)' bayath (house), and the Lawayay (Levites) from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, in their mashamarath (duty / watch) by their machalaqath (divisions);

And those who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of all their little tap (ones), their wives, and their ban (son), and their banath (daughter), through all the qahal (congregation): for in their amawanah (office) of trust they qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves in qadash (set apart / make holy).

Also for the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron) the kahanayam (priests), who were in the shaday (fields) of the magarash (suburbs) of their iyar (cities), in every iyar (city), there were banay (men) who were mentioned by sham (name), to nathan (give) manawath (portions) to all the zakar (remember) among the kahanayam (priests), and to all who were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy among the Lawayay (Levites).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) ishah (make) so throughout all Yahawadah (Judah); and he ishah (make) that which was tawab (good / proper function) and yashar (upright) and amath (truth) panayam (face) Yahawah his Alahayam.

In every maishah (work) that he chalal (began) in the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and in the thawarah (instruction), and in the matzawah (commandments), to darash (seek) his Alahayam, he ishah (make) it with all his labab (heart), and tzalach (prospered).

Achar (other) these things, and this amath (truth), Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come), and bawaa (come) into Yahawadah (Judah), and chanah (encamped) against the batzar (fortified) irayam (cities), and amar (spoke) to baqai (win) them for himself.
When Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) raah (see) that Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) bawaa (come) come, and that he panayam (face) purposed to malachamah (fight) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem),

He took yaitz (counsel) with his shar (prince / ruler) and his gabawar (mighty) men to satham (stop) the mayamay (waters) of the springs which were outside of the iyar (city); and they izar (helped) him.

So many im (nation / people) qabatz (gathered) qabatz (together), and they satham (stopped) all the maiyanawath (springs), and the nachal (stream / river) that shatap (flowed) thawak (midst) the midst of the aratz (Earth/land), amar (spoke), "Why should the malakay (kings) of Ashawar (Assyria) bawaa (come), and matzaa (find) much mayam (Waters)?"

He chazaq (took) courage, and banah (build) up all the chawamah (wall) that was paratz (broken) down, and ilah (go up / offer) it up to the magadalawath (towers), and the other chawamah (wall) outside, and chazaq (strengthened) Malawaa (Millo) in the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), and ishah (make) shalach (weapons) and maganayam (shields) in rab (abundance).

He nathan (give) sharay (captains) of malachamah (war) over the im (nation / people), and qabatz (gathered) them together to him in the rachab (broad) place at the shair (gate) of the iyar (city), and dabar (word / matter) labab (comfortably) to them, amar (spoke),

"Be chazaq (strong) and amatz (courageous), don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) nor chathath (dismayed) for the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), nor for all the hamawan (multitude) who is with him; for there is a greater with us than with him.

With him is an zarawai (arm) of bashar (flesh); but with us is Yahawah our Alahayam to izar (help) us, and to lacham (fight) our malachamah (battles)." The im (nation / people) samak (rested) themselves on the dabaray (words) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Achar (other) this, Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) his ibad (servant) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), (now he was before Lakayash (Lachish), and all his mamashalah (power) with him), to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to all Yahawadah (Judah) who were at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), "In whom do you batach (trust), that you yashab (inhabit/dwell) under matzawar (siege) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

Doesn't Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) sawath (persuade) you, to nathan (give) you over to mawath (death) by raib (famine) and by tzamaa (thirst), amar (spoke), ‘Yahawah our Alahayam will natzal (deliver) us out of the kap (hand) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria)?'

Hasn't the same Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) sawar (taken) away his bamah (high) places and his mazabach (altars), and commanded Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), ‘You shall shachah (worship) panayam (face) achad (one) mazabach (altar), and on it you shall qatar (burn) incense?'

Don't you yadai (know) what I and my ab (father) ishah (make) done to all the imay (peoples) of the aratzawath (lands)? Were the Alahayam of the gaway (heathen / nation) of the aratzawath (lands) in any yakal (way) yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) their aratz (Earth/land) out of my yad (hand)?

Who was there among all the Alahayam of those gawayam (nations) which my ab (father) charam (utterly) destroyed, that yakal (could) natzal (deliver) his im (nation / people) out of my yad (hand), that your Alahayam should be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) you out of my yad (hand)?

Now therefore don't let Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) nashaa (lift) you, nor sawath (persuade) you in this way, neither aman (believe / have faith) him; for no Alawah of any gaway (heathen / nation) or mamalakah (kingdom) was yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) his im (nation / people) out of my yad (hand), and out of the yad (hand) of my ab (father). How much less will your Alahayam natzal (deliver) you out of my yad (hand)?"
His ibad (servant) dabar (word / matter) yet more against Yahawah Alahayam, and against his ibad (servant) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah).

He also kathab (write) saparayam (letters) insulting Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), and to amar (spoke) amar (spoke) him, saying, "As the Alahayam of the gaway (heathen / nation) of the aratzawath (lands), which have not natzal (delivered) their im (nation / people) out of my yad (hand), so shall the Alahayam of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) not natzal (deliver) his im (nation / people) out of my yad (hand)."

They qaraa (called) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice) in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language to the im (nation / people) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) who were on the chawamah (wall), to frighten them, and to bahal (trouble) them; that they might lakad (take) the iyar (city).
