They dabar (word / matter) of the Alahayam of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), as of the Alahayam of the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land), which are the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yaday (hands).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) the malak (king), and Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), palal (prayed) because of this, and zaiq (cried) to shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

Yahawah shalach (send) an malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), who kachad (cut) off all the gabawar (mighty) men of valor, and the nagayad (leaders) and shar (prince / ruler), in the machanah (camp) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). So he shawab (turn back / repent) with bashath (shame) of panayam (face) to his own aratz (Earth/land). When he bawaa (come) come into the bayath (house) of his Alahayam, yatzayaa (those) who came forth from his own maih (bowels) killed him there with the charab (sword).

Thus Yahawah yashai (salvation) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the yad (hand) of Sanacharayab (Sennacherib) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), and from the yad (hand) of all others, and nahal (guided) them on sabayab (surrounding) side.

Many bawaa (come) manachah (gifts) to Yahawah to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and magadanah (precious) things to Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); so that he was nashaa (lift) in the iyan (eye) of all gawayam (nations) from achar (other).
In those yamayam (days) Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) was chalah (afflict) even to mawath (death): and he palal (prayed) to Yahawah; and he amar (spoke) to him, and nathan (give) him a mawapath (sign).

But Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) didn't shawab (turn back / repent) again according to the gamawal (benefit) done to him; for his lab (heart) was gabah (lifted) up: therefore there was qatzap (wrath) on him, and on Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Notwithstanding Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) kanai (humbled) himself for the gabah (pride) of his lab (heart), both he and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so that the qatzap (wrath) of Yahawah didn't bawaa (come) on them in the yamay (days) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) had maad (exceeding) much riches and honor: and he ishah (make) him atzarawath (treasuries) for kasap (silver), and for zahab (gold), and for yaqar (precious) aban (stone), and for bashamayam (spices), and for maganayam (shields), and for all kinds of chamadah (goodly) kalay (vessels);

Masakanawath (storehouses) also for the thabawaah (increase) of grain and new thayarawash (wine) and yatzahar (fresh oil); and arawath (stalls) for all kinds of animals, and idarayam (flocks) in folds.

Moreover he ishah (make) him irayam (cities), and maqanah (possessions) of tzaan (flocks) and baqar (morning) in rab (abundance); for Alahayam nathan (give) given him very much rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions).

This same Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) also satham (stopped) the ilayawan (Ilayawan) mawatzaa (spring) of the waters of Gayachawan (Gihon), and brought them yashar (upright) down on the mairab (west) side of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David). Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) tzalach (prospered) in all his maishah (works).

However concerning the malayatzay (ambassadors) of the sharay (princes) of Babal (Babylon), who shalach (send) to him to darash (inquire) of the mawapath (wonder) that was done in the aratz (Earth/land), Alahayam izab (left) him, to nasah (try) him, that he might yadai (know) all that was in his labab (heart).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), and his chasad (grace) deeds, behold, they are kathab (write) in the chazawan (vision) of Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yashar-Al (Israel).

Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in the mailah (ascent) of the tombs of the banay (sons) of Dawad (David): and all Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ishah (make) him honor at his mawath (death). Manashah (Manasseh) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Manashah (Manasseh) was shanayam (two) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) chamashayam (fifty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, after the thawaibawath (abominations) of the gawayam (nations) whom Yahawah yarash (cast) out panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

For he banah (build) again the bamah (high) places which Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) his ab (father) had nathatz (broken) down; and he qawam (rise up) up mazabachawath (altars) for the Bail (Baals), and ishah (make) Asharah (Asheroth), and shachah (worshiped) all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, and ibad (servant) them.
He banah (build) mazabachawath (altars) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, of which Yahawah amar (spoke), "My sham (name) shall be in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) iwalam (forever)."
He banah (build) mazabachawath (altars) for all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky in the shanayam (two) chatzarawath (courts) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He also ibar (pass over/through) his ban (son) to ibar (pass over/through) through the ash (fire) in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom); and he practiced sorcery, and used nachash (enchantments), and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar awab (spirits), and with yadainay (wizards): he ishah (make) much rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, to provoke him to kais (anger).

He shawam (place / establish / appoint) the engraved pasal (image) of the samal (idol), which he ishah (make) made, in the bayath (house) of Alahayam, of which Alahayam amar (spoke) to Dawad (David) and to Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son), "In this bayath (house), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which I have bachar (chosen) out of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel), will I shawam (place / establish / appoint) my sham (name) iyalawam (forever):

Neither will I any more sawar (remove) the ragal (feet / foot) of Yashar-Al (Israel) from off the adamah (land) which I have imad (appointed) for your ab (father), if only they will shamar (keep/guard) to ishah (make) all that I have tzawah (commanded) them, even all the thawarah (instruction) and the chaqayam (statutes) and the mashapatayam (ordinances) given by Mashah (Moses)."

Manashah (Manasseh) thaih (seduced) Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so that they ishah (make) more thaih (evil) than the gawayam (nations) whom Yahawah destroyed panayam (face) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) did.
Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Manashah (Manasseh), and to his im (nation / people); but they qashab (gave) no heed.

Therefore Yahawah bawaa (come) on them the sharay (captains) of the army of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), who lakad (took) Manashah (Manasseh) in chains, and asar (bound) him with nachashathayam (fetters), and yalak (carried) him to Babal (Babylon).
When he was in tzarar (distress), he begged Yahawah his Alahayam, and kanai (humbled) himself maad (greatly) panayam (face) the Alahayam of his ab (father).

He palal (prayed) to him; and he was entreated by him, and shamai (hearken / hear) his thachanah (supplication), and shawab (turn back / repent) him again to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) into his malakawath (kingdom). Then Manashah (Manasseh) yadai (knew) that Yahawah was Alahayam.

Now achar (other) this he banah (build) an outer chawamah (wall) to the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), on the mairab (west) side of Gayachawan (Gihon), in the nachal (stream / river), even to the entrance at the dag (fish) shair (gate); and he encircled Ipal (Ophel) with it, and gabah (raised) it up to a very maad (great) height: and he shawam (place / establish / appoint) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) sharay (captains) in all the batzar (fortified) irayam (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah).

He sawar (took) away the foreign Alahayam, and the samal (idol) out of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and all the mazabachawath (altars) that he had banah (build) in the har (mountain) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and shalak (cast) them out of the iyar (city).

He built up the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, and zabach (offered) thereon sacrifices of shalam (peace) zabachay (offerings) and of thanksgiving, and commanded Yahawadah (Judah) to ibad (servant) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Abal (nevertheless) the im (nation / people) zabach (sacrificed) still in the bamah (high) places, but only to Yahawah their Alahayam.

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Manashah (Manasseh), and his thapalah (prayer) to his Alahayam, and the dabaray (words) of the chazayam (seers) who dabar (word / matter) to him in the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), behold, they are written among the dabaray (acts) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

His thapalah (prayer) also, and how Alahayam was entreated of him, and all his chataah (sin) and his mail (top/above), and the maqamawath (places) in which he banah (build) bamah (high) places, and imad (set) up the Asharah (Asherim) and the engraved pasalayam (images), panayam (face) he kanai (humbled) himself: behold, they are kathab (write) in the history of Hozai.
So Manashah (Manasseh) shakab (slept) with his ab (father), and they qabar (bury) him in his own bayath (house): and Amawan (Amon) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.
Amawan (Amon) was isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two) shanayam (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shanayam (two) shanayam (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah, as ishah (make) Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father); and Amawan (Amon) zabach (sacrificed) to all the engraved pasayalayam (images) which Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father) ishah (make) made, and ibad (servant) them.
He didn't humble panayam (face) before Yahawah, as Manashah (Manasseh) his ab (father) had kanai (humbled) himself; but this same Amawan (Amon) ashamah (trespassed) more and more.
His ibad (servant) qashar (conspired) against him, and put him to mawath (death) in his own bayath (house).

But the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) nakah (killed) all those who had qashar (conspired) against malak (king) Amawan (Amon); and the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yaashayah (Josiah) was shamanah (eight) shanayam (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawashayam (thirty) - achad (one) shanayam (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

He ishah (make) that which was yashar (upright) in the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, and yalak (walked) in the darakay (ways) of Dawad (David) his ab (father), and didn't sawar (turn) aside to the right yamayan (right hand) or to the shamaawal (left hand).

For in the shamanah (eighth) shanah (year) of his malak (king), while he was yet nair (young), he chalal (began) to darash (seek) after the Alahayam of Dawad (David) his ab (father); and in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) he chalal (began) to tahar (purge) Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) from the bamah (high) places, and the Asharah (Asherim), and the engraved pasalayam (images), and the masakah (molten) images.

They nathatz (broke) down the mazabachawath (altars) of the Bail (Baals) in his panayam (face); and the incense chamanayam (altars) that were on mail (top/above) above them he gadai (cut) down; and the Asharah (Asherim), and the engraved pasalayam (images), and the molten pasalayam (images), he shabar (broke) in pieces, and daqaq (made) dust of them, and zaraq (strewed) it on the qabarayam (graves) of those who had zabach (sacrificed) to them.
He burnt the itzamawath (bones) of the kahanayam (priests) on their mazabachawathayam (altars), and tahar (purged) Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
He did this in the iray (cities) of Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim) and Shamaiwan (Simeon), even to Napathalay (Naphtali), around in their ruins.

He nathatz (broke) down the mazabachawath (altars), and kathath (beat) the Asharah (Asherim) and the engraved pasalayam (images) into daqaq (powder), and gadai (cut) down all the incense chamanayam (altars) throughout all the aratz (Earth/land) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now in the eighteenth shanah (year) of his malak (king), when he had tahar (purged) the aratz (Earth/land) and the bayath (house), he shalach (send) Shapan (Shaphan) the ban (son) of Atzalayahaw (Azaliah), and Maishayah (Maaseiah) the shar (prince / ruler) of the iyar (city), and Yawaach (Joah) the ban (son) of Yawaachaz (Joahaz) the zakar (remember), to chazaq (repair) the bayath (house) of Yahawah his Alahayam.

They bawaa (come) to Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and nathan (give) the kasap (money) that was bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Alahayam, which the Lawayay (Levites), the keepers of the sap (threshold), had asap (gathered) of the yad (hand) of Manashah (Manasseh) and Aparayam (Ephraim), and of all the shaarayath (remnant) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and of all Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and of the inhabitants of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They nathan (give) it into the yad (hand) of the workmen who paqad (visit) the oversight of the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and the workmen who labored in the bayath (house) of Yahawah nathan (give) it to chazaq (mend) and badaq (repair) the bayath (house);

Even to the charashayam (carpenters) and to the banayam (builders) nathan (give) they it, to qanah (buy) cut aban (stone), and itz (timber) for machabarawath (couplings), and to make qarah (beams) for the bathayam (houses) which the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah) had shachath (destroyed).

The anashayam (men) ishah (make) the malaakah (work) faithfully: and their natzach (overseers) were Yachath (Jahath) and Ibadayah (Obadiah), the Lawayay (Levites), of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari); and Zakarayah (Zechariah) and Mashalam (Meshullam), of the sons of the Qahathay (Kohathites), to paqad (visit) it forward; and others of the Lawayay (Levites), all who were skillful with kalay (instruments) of music.

Also they were over the sabalayam (bearers) of burdens, and natzach (set) forward all who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) in every kind of ibadah (service): and of the Lawayay (Levites) there were sawaparayam (scribes), and shatarayam (officers), and shawairayam (porters).

When they yatzaa (go out / come out) out the kasap (money) that was bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) matzaa (found) the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah given by Mashah (Moses).

Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) inah (answer / respond) Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), "I matzaa (have) found the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah." Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) nathan (give) the sapar (book / scribed document) to Shapan (Shaphan).

Shapan (Shaphan) bawaa (come) the sapar (book / scribed document) to the malak (king), and moreover shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king), amar (spoke), "All that was nathan (give) to your ibad (servant), they are ishah (make).

They have emptied out the kasap (money) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and nathan (give) delivered it into the yad (hand) of the mapaqadayam (overseers), and into the yad (hand) of the workmen."

Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book) nagad (told) the malak (king), amar (spoke), "Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) the kahan (priest) nathan (give) delivered me a sapar (book / scribed document)." Shapan (Shaphan) qaraa (called) therein panayam (face) the malak (king).
It happened, when the malak (king) had shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of the thawarah (instruction), that he qarai (tore) his clothes.

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), and Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), and Ibadawan (Abdon) the ban (son) of Mayakah (Micah), and Shapan (Shaphan) the sapar (book), and Ishayah (Asaiah) the malak (king) ibad (servant), amar (spoke),

"Yalak (go) darash (inquire) of Yahawah for me, and for those who are shaar (left) in Yashar-Al (Israel) and in Yahawadah (Judah), concerning the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) that is matzaa (found); for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah that is nathak (poured) out on us, because our ab (father) have not shamar (keep/guard) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, to ishah (make) according to all that is kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document)."

So Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), and they whom the malak (king) had commanded, yalak (went) to Chaladah (Huldah) the nabayaah (prophetess), the ayashah (woman / wife) of Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Tokhath, the ban (son) of Chasarah (Hasrah), keeper of the bagad (wardrobe); (now she lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the mashanah (second) quarter;) and they dabar (word / matter) to her to that effect.
She amar (spoke) to them, "Thus amaraw (says) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): ‘amar (spoke) the ayash (man / husband) who shalach (send) you to me,

"Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, ‘Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this maqawam (place), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell), even all the alawath (curses) that are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) which they have qaraa (called) panayam (face) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).

Because they have forsaken me, and have qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, that they might provoke me to kais (anger) with all the maishay (works) of their yad (hand); therefore is my chamah (wrath) nathak (poured) out on this maqawam (place), and it shall not be kabah (quenched).'"'

But to the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who shalach (send) you to darash (inquire) of Yahawah, thus you shall amar (spoke) him, ‘Thus thaamaraw (says) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): "As touching the dabarayam (words) which you have shamai (hearken / hear),

Because your labab (heart) was rakak (tender), and you kanai (humbled) yourself panayam (face) Alahayam, when you shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter) against this maqawam (place), and against its yashab (inhabit/dwell), and have kanai (humbled) yourself panayam (face) me, and have qarai (torn) your clothes, and bakah (wept) panayam (face) me; I also have shamai (hearken / hear) you," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

"Behold, I will asap (gather) you to your ab (father), and you shall be asap (gathered) to your qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) in shalawam (peace / safety), neither shall your iyan (eye) raah (see) all the rai (evil) that I will bawaa (come) on this maqawam (place), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell)."'" They shawab (turn back / repent) shawab (turn back / repent) dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king).
Then the malak (king) shalach (send) and asap (gathered) together all the zaqanay (elders) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) ilah (go up / offer) up to the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and all the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), and all the im (nation / people), both gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small / young / least): and he qaraa (called) in their azan (ear) all the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) of the barayath (covenant) that was matzaa (found) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

The malak (king) imad (stood) in his imad (place), and karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) panayam (face) Yahawah, to yalak (walk) achar (other) Yahawah, and to shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments), and his idawath (testimonies), and his chaq (statute), with all his labab (heart), and with all his napash (soul), to ishah (make) the dabaray (words) of the barayath (covenant) that were kathab (write) in this sapar (book / scribed document).

He caused all who were matzaa (found) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) to imad (stand). The yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ishah (make) according to the barayath (covenant) of Alahayam, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Yaashayah (Josiah) sawar (took) away all the thawaibawath (abominations) out of all the aratzawath (countries) that pertained to the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and made all who were matzaa (found) in Yashar-Al (Israel) to ibad (servant), even to ibad (servant) Yahawah their Alahayam. All his yawam (day) they didn't sawar (depart) from achar (other) Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father).

Yaashayah (Josiah) ishah (make) a pasach (passover) to Yahawah in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and they shachat (killed) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month).
He imad (set) the kahanayam (priests) in their mashamarath (duty / watch), and chazaq (encouraged) them to the ibadah (service) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

He amar (spoke) to the Lawayay (Levites) who bayan (between) all Yashar-Al (Israel), who were qadawash (holy) to Yahawah, "nathan (give) the qadash (set apart / make holy) arawan (ark) in the bayath (house) which Shalamah (Solomon) the ban (son) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) banah (build). There shall no more be a mashaa (burden) on your kathap (shoulders). Now ibad (servant) Yahawah your Alahayam, and his im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel).

Kawan (prepare) yourselves after your ab (father)' bayath (house) by your machalaqath (divisions), according to the kathab (write) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and according to the makathab (writing) of Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son).

Imad (stand) in the qadash (set apart / make holy) place according to the palagawath (divisions) of the abawath (fathers)' bayath (house) of your ach (brother/kinsman) the children of the banay (people), and let there be for each a portion of a abawath (fathers)' house of the Lawayay (Levites).

Shachat (kill) the pasach (passover), and qadash (set apart / make holy) yourselves, and kawan (prepare) for your ach (brother/kinsman), to ishah (make) according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by Mashah (Moses)."

Yaashayah (Josiah) rawam (will lift up) to the children of the banay (people), of the tzaan (flock), kabashayam (lambs) and ban (son) goats, all of them for the pasach (passover) offerings, to all who were matzaa (present), to the masapar (number) of shalawashayam (thirty) alap (thousand), and shalawash (three) alap (thousand) baqar (morning): these were of the malak (king) rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions).

His shar (prince / ruler) rawam (will lift up) for a freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) to the im (nation / people), to the kahanayam (priests), and to the Lawayay (Levites). Chalaqayah (Hilkiah) and Zakarayah (Zechariah) and Yachayaal (Jehiel), the nagayaday (rulers) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, nathan (give) to the kahanayam (priests) for the pasach (passover) offerings two alap (thousand) and shash (six) maah (hundred) small livestock, and shalawash (three) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle.

Kawananayahaw (Conaniah) also, and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) and Nathanaal (Nethanel), his ach (brother/kinsman), and Chashabayah (Hashabiah) and Yaiyaal (Jeiel) and Yawazabad (Jozabad), the sharay (chiefs) of the Lawayay (Levites), rawam (will lift up) to the Lawayay (Levites) for the pasach (passover) offerings chamash (five) alap (thousand) small livestock, and chamash (five) maah (hundred) baqar (morning) of cattle.

So the ibadah (service) was kawan (prepared), and the kahanayam (priests) imad (stood) in their imad (place), and the Lawayay (Levites) by their machalaqath (divisions), according to the malak (king) matzawah (commandment).
They shachat (killed) the pasach (passover), and the kahanayam (priests) zaraq (sprinkled) the blood which they received of their yad (hand), and the Lawayay (Levites) pashat (flayed) them.

They sawar (removed) the burnt ilah (offerings), that they might nathan (give) them according to the mapalagawath (divisions) of the abawath (fathers)' houses of the children of the banay (people), to qarab (come close) to Yahawah, as it is kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Mashah (Moses). So they did with the cattle.

They bashal (roasted) the pasach (passover) with ash (fire) according to the mashapat (ordinance): and the qadash (set apart / make holy) offerings bashal (boiled) they in sayarawath (pots), and in dawadayam (caldrons), and in tzalachawath (pans), and carried them quickly to all the children of the banay (people).

Afterward they kawan (prepared) for themselves, and for the kahanayam (priests), because the kahanayam (priests) the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron) were busy with ilah (go up / offer) the burnt ilah (go up / offer) and the chalab (fat) until layal (night): therefore the Lawayay (Levites) kawan (prepared) for themselves, and for the kahanayam (priests) the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron).

The singers the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph) were in their maimad (place), according to the matzawah (commandment) of Dawad (David), and Asap (Asaph), and Hayaman (Heman), and Yadawathawan (Jeduthun) the malak (king) chazah (seer); and the shairayam (porters) were at every shair (gate): they didn't need to sawar (depart) from their ibadah (service); for their ach (brother/kinsman) the Lawayay (Levites) kawan (prepared) for them.

So all the ibadah (service) of Yahawah was kawan (prepared) the same yawam (day), to ishah (make) the pasach (passover), and to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) on the mazabach (altar) of Yahawah, according to the matzawah (commandment) of malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah).

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) who were matzaa (present) ishah (make) the pasach (passover) at that ith (time), and the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) shabai (seven) yamayam (days).

There was no pasach (passover) kamaw (like) that ishah (make) in Yashar-Al (Israel) from the yamay (days) of Shamawaal (Samuel) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); neither ishah (make) any of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) such a pasach (passover) as Yaashayah (Josiah) ishah (make), and the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), and all Yahawadah (Judah) and Yashar-Al (Israel) who were matzaa (present), and the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
In the eighteenth shanah (year) of the malakawath (reign) of Yaashayah (Josiah) was this pasach (passover) ishah (make).

Achar (other) all this, when Yaashayah (Josiah) had kawan (prepared) the bayath (house), Nakaw (Neco) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up to lacham (fight) against Karakamayash (Carchemish) by the Parath (Euphrates): and Yaashayah (Josiah) yatzaa (go out / come out) out qaraah (against) him.

But he shalach (send) malaakayam (ambassadors) to him, amar (spoke), "What have I to do with you, you malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah)? I come not against you this yawam (day), but against the bayath (house) with which I have malachamah (war). Alahayam has commanded me to bahal (make) haste. Beware that it is Alahayam who is with me, that he not shachath (destroy) you."

Nevertheless Yaashayah (Josiah) would not sabab (turn) his panayam (face) from him, but disguised himself, that he might lacham (fight) with him, and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabaray (words) of Nakaw (Neco) from the pah (mouth) of Alahayam, and bawaa (come) to lacham (fight) in the baqaih (valley) of Magadawan (Megiddo).

The yaraw (archers) yarah (shot) at malak (king) Yaashayah (Josiah); and the malak (king) amar (spoke) to his ibad (servant), "ibar (pass over/through) me away, because I am seriously chalah (afflict)!"

So his ibad (servant) ibar (pass over/through) him out of the marakabah (chariot), and rakab (put) him in the mashanah (second) rakab (chariot) that he had, and yalak (brought) him to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and he mawath (death), and was qabar (bury) in the tombs of his ab (father). All Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) abal (mourned) for Yaashayah (Josiah).

Yaramayah (Jeremiah) qawan (lamented) for Yaashayah (Josiah): and all the shayar (singing) men and shayar (singing) women amar (spoke) of Yaashayah (Josiah) in their qayanawath (lamentations) to this yawam (day); and they nathan (give) them an chaq (statute) in Yashar-Al (Israel): and behold, they are kathab (write) in the qayanawath (lamentations).
Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and his chasad (grace) deeds, according to that which is kathab (write) in the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah,

And his dabar (word / matter), raashawan (first) and acharawan (last), behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah).

Then the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) laqach (take / seize) Yahawaachaz (Jehoahaz) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), and made him malak (king) in his ab (father) place in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yawaachaz (Joahaz) was isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawash (three) chadashayam (months) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

The malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) deposed him at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and fined the aratz (Earth/land) one maah (hundred) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver) and a kakar (talent) of zahab (gold).

The malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) made Alayaqayam (Eliakim) his ach (brother/kinsman) malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and sabab (changed) his sham (name) to Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim). Nakaw (Neco) laqach (take / seize) Yawaachaz (Joahaz) his ach (brother/kinsman), and laqach (take / seize) him to Matzarayam (Egypt).

Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) was isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah his Alahayam.
Against him ilah (go up / offer) up Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and asar (bound) him in nachashathayam (fetters), to yalak (carry) him to Babal (Babylon).
Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) also bawaa (come) of the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah to Babal (Babylon), and nathan (give) them in his hayakal (temple) at Babal (Babylon).

Now the yathar (rest) of the dabaray (acts) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), and his thawaibah (abominations) which he ishah (make), and that which was matzaa (found) in him, behold, they are kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the malakay (kings) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah): and Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) his ban (son) malak (king) in his place.

Yahawayakayan (Jehoiachin) was shamanah (eight) shanayam (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) shalawash (three) chadashayam (months) and ishar (ten) yamayam (days) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah.

At the thashawabah (return) of the shanah (year) malak (king) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) shalach (send), and bawaa (come) him to Babal (Babylon), with the chamadah (goodly) kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and made Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) his ach (brother/kinsman) malak (king) over Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) was isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) shanah (years) ban (son) when he began to malak (king); and he malak (king) achad (one) shanah (years) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem):

And he ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah his Alahayam; he didn't kanai (humble) panayam (face) before Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) speaking from the pah (mouth) of Yahawah.

He also marad (rebelled) against malak (king) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar), who had made him shabai (swear / take oath) by Alahayam: but he stiffened his irap (neck), and amatz (hardened) his labab (heart) against shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Moreover all the sharay (chiefs) of the kahanayam (priests), and the im (nation / people), mail (top/above) very greatly after all the thaibawath (abominations) of the gawayam (nations); and they tamaa (polluted) the bayath (house) of Yahawah which he had made qadash (set apart / make holy) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yahawah, the Alahayam of their ab (father), shalach (send) to them by his malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send), because he chamal (had) compassion on his im (nation / people), and on his maiwan (dwelling) place:

But they laib (mocked) the malaakay (messengers) of Alahayam, and bazah (despised) his dabar (word / matter), and scoffed at his nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), until the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah arose against his im (nation / people), until there was no marapaa (remedy).

Therefore he ilah (go up / offer) on them the malak (king) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), who harag (kill) their bachawar (young) men with the charab (sword) in the bayath (house) of their maqadash (sanctuary), and chamal (had) no compassion on bachawar (young) man or bathawalah (virgin), old zaqan (man) or gray-headed: he nathan (give) them all into his yad (hand).

All the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small / young / least), and the atzarawath (treasures) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and the atzarawath (treasures) of the malak (king), and of his shar (prince / ruler), all these he bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon).

They burnt the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and nathatz (broke) down the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and burnt all its aramawan (palaces) with ash (fire), and shachath (destroyed) all the machamad (goodly) kalay (vessels) of it.

He carried those who shaarayath (had) escaped from the charab (sword) away to Babal (Babylon); and they were ibadayam (servants) to him and his ban (son) until the malak (king) of the malakawath (kingdom) of Paras (Persia):

To fulfill the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), until the aratz (Earth/land) ratzah (had) enjoyed its shabath (shabath / rest). As long as it shamam (lay) desolate it shabath (shabath / rest) Sabbath, to fulfill shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years).

Now in the achad (one) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) might be kalah (complete / finish), Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), so that he ibar (pass over/through) a proclamation throughout all his malakawath (kingdom), and put it also in makathab (writing), amar (spoke),

"Thus amar (spoke) Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), ‘Yahawah, the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), nathan (give) given all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) to me; and he paqad (visit) commanded me to banah (build) him a bayath (house) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which is in Yahawadah (Judah). Whoever there is among you of all his im (nation / people), Yahawah his Alahayam be with him, and let him ilah (go up / offer) up.'"

Now in the achad (one) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah by the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) might be kalah (complete / finish), Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), so that he ibar (pass over/through) a proclamation throughout all his malakawath (kingdom), and put it also in makathab (writing), amar (spoke),

"Thus amar (spoke) Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), ‘Yahawah, the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), nathan (give) given me all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land); and he paqad (visit) commanded me to banah (build) him a bayath (house) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which is in Yahawadah (Judah).

Whoever there is among you of all his im (nation / people), may his Alahayam be with him, and let him ilah (go up / offer) up to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which is in Yahawadah (Judah), and banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel) (he is Alahayam), which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Whoever is shaar (left), in any maqawam (place) where he lives, let the anashay (men) of his maqawam (place) nashaa (lift) him with kasap (silver), with zahab (gold), with rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and with animals, besides the freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) for the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).'"

Then the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), even all whose rawach (spirit / wind) Alahayam had iwar (rouse / awaken) to ilah (go up / offer) up ilah (go up / offer) up to banah (build) the bayath (house) of Yahawah which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

All those who were around them chazaq (strengthened) their yad (hand) with kalay (vessels) of kasap (silver), with zahab (gold), with rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions), and with animals, and with magadanah (precious) things, besides all that was nadab (willingly) offered.

Also Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah, which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) yatzaa (go out / come out) brought out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and nathan (give) put in the bayath (house) of his Alahayam;

Even those, Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia) yatzaa (go out / come out) out by the yad (hand) of Matharadath (Mithredath) the gazabar (treasurer), and sapar (book) them to Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar), the nashayaa (prince) of Yahawadah (Judah).
This is the masapar (number) of them: shalawashayam (thirty) platters of zahab (gold), one alap (thousand) platters of kasap (silver), isharayam (twenty) - thashai (nine) knives,
Shalawashayam (thirty) bowls of zahab (gold), kasap (silver) bowls of a mashanah (second) sort arabai (four) maah (hundred) and ishar (ten), and other kalayam (vessels) one alap (thousand).

All the kalayam (vessels) of zahab (gold) and of kasap (silver) were chamash (five) alap (thousand) and arabai (four) maah (hundred). Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar) ilah (go up / offer) all these up, when the gawalah (captives) were ilah (go up / offer) up from Babal (Babylon) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now these are the banay (children) of the madayanah (province), who ilah (go up / offer) up out of the shabay (captivity) of those who had been carried away, whom Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had galah (carried) away to Babal (Babylon), and who shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), everyone to his iyar (city);

Who bawaa (come) with Zarababal (Zerubbabel), Yashawai (Jeshua), Nachamayah (Nehemiah), Sharayah (Seraiah), Railayah (Reelaiah), Maradakay (Mordecai), Balashan (Bilshan), Masapar (Mispar), Bagaway (Bigvai), Rachawam (Rehum), Bainah (Baanah). The masapar (number) of the anashay (men) of the im (nation / people) of Yashar-Al (Israel):
The banay (children) of Paraish (Parosh), two alap (thousand) one maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Arach (Arah), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Pachathamawaab (Pahathmoab), of the banay (children) of Yashawai (Jeshua) and Yawaab (Joab), two alap (thousand) shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Iyalam (Elam), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The banay (children) of Zathawaa (Zattu), thashai (nine) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Zakay (Zaccai), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty).
The banay (children) of Banay (Bani), shash (six) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Babay (Bebai), shash (six) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three). Three.
The banay (children) of Izagad (Azgad), one alap (thousand) shanayam (two) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Adanayaqam (Adonikam), shash (six) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - shash (six).
The banay (children) of Bagaway (Bigvai), two alap (thousand) chamashayam (fifty) - shash (six).
The banay (children) of Idayan (Adin), arabai (four) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The banay (children) of Atar (Ater), of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), thashaiyam (ninety) - shamanah (eight).
The banay (children) of Batzay (Bezai), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The banay (children) of Yawarah (Jorah), one maah (hundred) shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Chasham (Hashum), two maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The banay (children) of Gabar (Gibbar), thashaiyam (ninety) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The anashay (men) of Natapah (Netophah), chamashayam (fifty) - shash (six).
The anashay (men) of Inathawath (Anathoth), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).
The banay (children) of Izamawath (Azmaveth), arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Arim), Kapayarah (Chephirah), and Baarawath (Beeroth), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shalawash (three).
The banay (children) of Ramah (Ramah) and Gabai (Geba), shash (six) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - achad (one).
The anashay (men) of Makamas (Michmas), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two).
The anashay (men) of Bayath-Al (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), two maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The banay (children) of Nabaw (Nebo), chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Magabayash (Magbish), one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - shash (six).
The banay (children) of the other Iyalam (Elam), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The banay (children) of Charam (Harim), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty).
The banay (children) of Lad (Lod), Chadayad (Hadid), and Awanaw (Ono), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Yarayachaw (Jericho), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Sanaah (Senaah), shalawash (three) alap (thousand) shash (six) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
The kahanayam (priests): the banay (children) of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), of the bayath (house) of Yashawai (Jeshua), thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shalawash (three).
The banay (children) of Amar (Immer), one alap (thousand) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Pashachawar (Pashhur), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shabai (seven).
The banay (children) of Charam (Harim), one alap (thousand) seventeen.
The Lawayay (Levites): the banay (children) of Yashawai (Jeshua) and Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), of the banay (children) of Hawadawayah (Hodaviah), shabaiyam (seventy) - arabai (four).
The singers: the banay (children) of Asap (Asaph), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).

The banay (children) of the shairayam (porters): the banay (children) of Shalawam (Shallum), the banay (children) of Atar (Ater), the banay (children) of Talamawan (Talmon), the banay (children) of Iqawab (Akkub), the banay (children) of Chatayataa (Hatita), the banay (children) of Shabay (Shobai), in all one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - thashai (nine).
The nathayan (nethinim): the banay (children) of Tzayachaa (Ziha), the banay (children) of Chashawapaa (Hasupha), the banay (children) of Tabaiwath (Tabbaoth),
The banay (children) of Qayaras (Keros), the banay (children) of Sayaia (Siaha), the banay (children) of Padawan (Padon),
The banay (children) of Labanaa (Lebanah), the banay (children) of Chagabaa (Hagabah), the banay (children) of Iqawab (Akkub),
The banay (children) of Chagab (Hagab), the banay (children) of Shamalay (Shamlai), the banay (children) of Chanan (Hanan),
The banay (children) of Gadal (Giddel), the banay (children) of Gachar (Gahar), the banay (children) of Raayah (Reaiah),
The banay (children) of Ratzayan (Rezin), the banay (children) of Naqawadaa (Nekoda), the banay (children) of Gazam (Gazzam),
The banay (children) of Izaa (Uzza), the banay (children) of Pasach (Paseah), the banay (children) of Basay (Besai),
The banay (children) of Asanah (Asnah), the banay (children) of maiwanay (meunim), the banay (children) of Nephisim,
The banay (children) of Baqabawaq (Bakbuk), the banay (children) of Chaqawapaa (Hakupha), the banay (children) of Charachawar (Harhur),
The banay (children) of Batzalawath (Bazluth), the banay (children) of Machayadaa (Mehida), the banay (children) of Charashaa (Harsha),
The banay (children) of Baraqawas (Barkos), the banay (children) of Sayasaraa (Sisera), the banay (children) of Thamach (Temah),
The banay (children) of Natzayach (Neziah), the banay (children) of Chatayapaa (Hatipha).
The banay (children) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibaday (servants): the banay (children) of Sawatay (Sotai), the banay (children) of Saparath (Hassophereth), the banay (children) of Parawadaa (Peruda),
The banay (children) of Yailaa (Jaalah), the banay (children) of Daraqawan (Darkon), the banay (children) of Gadal (Giddel),
The banay (children) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), the banay (children) of Chatayal (Hattil), the banay (children) of Pakarathatzabayayam (Pochereth Hazzebaim), the banay (children) of Amay (Ami).
All the nathayan (nethinim), and the banay (children) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibaday (servants), were shalawash (three) maah (hundred) thashaiyam (ninety) - shanayam (two).

These were those who ilah (go up / offer) up from Thalamalach (Tel Melah), Thalacharashaa (Tel Harsha), karawab (cherub), Adan (Addan), and Amar (Immer); but they yakal (could) not show their ab (father)' bayath (house), and their zarai (seed), whether they were of Yashar-Al (Israel):
The banay (children) of Dalayah (Delaiah), the banay (children) of Tawabayah (Tobiah), the banay (children) of Naqawadaa (Nekoda), shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).

Of the banay (children) of the kahanayam (priests): the banay (children) of Chabayah (Habaiah), the banay (children) of Qawatz (Hakkoz), the banay (children) of Barazalay (Barzillai), who laqach (take / seize) a ayashah (woman / wife) of the banawath (daughters) of Barazalay (Barzillai) the Galaiday (Gileadite), and was qaraa (called) after their sham (name).

These baqash (sought) their place among those who were kathab (write) by yachash (genealogy), but they were not matzaa (found): therefore were they deemed gaal (polluted) and put from the kahanah (priesthood).

The governor amar (spoke) to them, that they should not akal (eat) of the most qadash (set apart / make holy) things, until there imad (stood) up a kahan (priest) with awarayam (urim) and with thamayam (complete / whole).
The whole qahal (assembly) achad (one) was arabai (four) - two alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty),

Besides their male ibad (servant) and their female ibad (servant), of whom there were shabai (seven) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven): and they had two maah (hundred) shayar (singing) men and shayar (singing) women.
Their sawas (horses) were shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six); their parad (mules), two maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five);
Their gamal (camels), arabai (four) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five); their donkeys, shash (six) alap (thousand) shabai (seven) maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty).

Some of the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, when they bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), nadab (offered) willingly for the bayath (house) of Alahayam to imad (set) it up in its makawan (place):

They nathan (give) after their kach (strength / mighty / power) into the awatzar (treasury) of the malaakah (work) shash (six) - one alap (thousand) darics of zahab (gold), and chamash (five) alap (thousand) minas of kasap (silver), and one maah (hundred) kahanayam (priests)' kathanath (garments).

So the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), and some of the im (nation / people), and the singers, and the shawairayam (porters), and the nathayan (nethinim), lived in their iyar (cities), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) in their iyar (cities).

When the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) had nagai (come), and the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) were in the irayam (cities), the im (nation / people) asap (gathered) themselves together as achad (one) ayash (man / husband) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then qawam (rise up) up Yashawai (Jeshua) the ban (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and his ach (brother/kinsman) the kahanayam (priests), and Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and his ach (brother/kinsman), and banah (build) the mazabach (altar) of the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) thereon, as it is kathab (write) in the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam.

They kawan (set) the mazabach (altar) on its makawanah (base); for ayamah (fear) was on them because of the imay (peoples) of the aratzawath (countries): and they ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) thereon to Yahawah, even burnt ilawath (offerings) baqar (morning) and irab (evening).

They ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of sakawath (tents), as it is kathab (write), and offered the yawam (day) burnt ilah (offerings) by masapar (number), according to the mashapat (ordinance), as the dabar (word / matter) of every yawam (day) yawam (day);

And afterward the thamayad (continual) burnt ilah (offering), and the offerings of the new chadashayam (moons), and of all the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts of Yahawah that were qadash (set apart / make holy), and of everyone who nadab (willingly) offered a freewill nadab (offering) to Yahawah.

From the achad (one) yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) chalal (began) they to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilawath (offerings) to Yahawah: but the yasad (foundation) of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah was not yet yasad (laid).

They nathan (give) kasap (money) also to the chatzabayam (masons), and to the charashayam (carpenters); and maakal (food), and mashathah (drink), and shaman (oil), to them of tzayadanay (sidon), and to them of tzaray (tyre), to bawaa (come) araz (cedar) itzay (trees) from Labanawan (Lebanon) to the yam (sea/waters), to Yapaw (Joppa), according to the rashayawan (grant) that they had of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

Now in the shanay (second) shanah (year) of their bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Alahayam at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), in the shanay (second) chadash (month), chalal (began) Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yashawai (Jeshua) the ban (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and the shaar (rest) of their ach (brother/kinsman) the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), and all those who were bawaa (come) out of the shabay (captivity) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and imad (appointed) the Lawayay (Levites), from isharayam (twenty) shanah (years) ban (son) and upward, to have the oversight of the malaakah (work) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Then imad (stood) Yashawai (Jeshua) with his banay (sons) and his ach (brother/kinsman), Qadamayaal (Kadmiel) and his banay (sons), the banay (sons) of Yahawadah (Judah), achad (one), to have the oversight of the workmen in the bayath (house) of Alahayam: the banay (sons) of Chanadad (Henadad), with their banay (sons) and their ach (brother/kinsman) the Lawayay (Levites).

When the banayam (builders) yasad (laid) the foundation of the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, they imad (set) the kahanayam (priests) in their labash (clothing) with chatzatzarawath (trumpets), and the Lawayay (Levites) the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph) with matzalathayam (cymbals), to halal (praise) Yahawah, after the yad (hand) of Dawad (David) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

They inah (answer / respond) one to another in halal (praise) and giving yadah (thanks) to Yahawah, "For he is tawab (good / proper function), for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever) toward Yashar-Al (Israel)." All the im (nation / people) rawai (shouted) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tharawaih (shout), when they halal (praise) Yahawah, because the yasad (foundation) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah was yasad (laid).

But many of the kahanayam (priests) and Lawayay (Levites) and raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, the zaqan (old) men who raah (see) seen the raashawan (first) bayath (house), when the yasad (foundation) of this bayath (house) was yasad (laid) before their iyan (eye), bakah (wept) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice); and many tharawaih (shouted) aloud for shamachah (joy):

So that the im (nation / people) nakar (could) not discern the qawal (sound / voice) of the tharawaih (shout) of shamachah (joy) from the qawal (sound / voice) of the bakay (weeping) of the im (nation / people); for the im (nation / people) rawai (shouted) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tharawaih (shout), and the qawal (sound / voice) was shamai (hearken / hear) rachawaq (afar) off.

Now when the tzaray (adversaries) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) shamai (hearken / hear) that the banay (children) of the gawalah (captivity) were banah (build) a hayakal (temple) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel);

Then they nagash (drew) near to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and to the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, and amar (spoke) to them, "Let us banah (build) with you; for we darash (seek) your Alahayam, as you do; and we zabach (sacrifice) to him since the yamay (days) of Asarachadawan (Esar Haddon) malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria), who ilah (go up / offer) us up here."

But Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and Yashawai (Jeshua), and the shaar (rest) of the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke) to them, "You have nothing to do with us in banah (build) a bayath (house) to our Alahayam; but we ourselves yachad (together) will banah (build) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), as malak (king) Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) of Paras (Persia) has tzawah (commanded) us."
Then the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) rapah (weakened) the yaday (hands) of the im (nation / people) of Yahawadah (Judah), and balah (troubled) them in banah (build),

And shakar (hired) yawaitzayam (counselors) against them, to parar (frustrate) their itzah (purpose), all the yamay (days) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), even until the malakawath (reign) of Darayawash (Darius) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

In the malakawath (reign) of Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), in the thachalah (beginning) of his malakawath (reign), kathab (write) they an shatanah (accusation) against the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

In the yamay (days) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) kathab (write) Bashalam (Bishlam), Matharadath (Mithredath), Tabaal (Tabeel), and the shaar (rest) of his kanath (companions), to Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) malak (king) of Paras (Persia); and the kathab (write) of the letter was kathab (write) in Aramayath (Syrian), and set forth in the Aramayath (Syrian) language.

Rachawam (Rehum) the bail (chancellor) and Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book) kathab (write) a agaraa (letter) il (over) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king) in kanamaa (this) sort:

Then Rachawam (Rehum) the bail (chancellor), and Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book), and the shaar (rest) of their kanath (companions), the dayanay (dinaites), and the Apharsathchites, the tarapalay (tarpelites), the aparasay (apharsites), the arakaway (archevites), the Babalay (Babylonians), the Shushanchites, the Dehaites, the Ilamay (Elamites),

And the shaar (rest) of the amay (nations) whom the rab (great) and yaqayar (noble) Asanapar (Osnappar) galah (brought) over, and yathab (set) in the qarayaa (city) of Shamarayan (Samaria), and in the shaar (rest) of the country Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and so forth, wrote.

Dan (this) is the parashagan (copy) of the agaraa (letter) that they shalach (sent) to Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king): Your ibad (servant) the anash (men) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and so forth.

Be it yadai (known) to the malak (king), that the Yahawadaay (Jews) who salaq (came) up from you have athah (you (masc)) to us to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); they are banaa (building) the marad (rebellious) and the baawash (bad) qarayaa (city), and have kalal (finished) the shawaray (walls), and repaired the ashay (foundations).

Be it yadai (known) kain (now) to the malak (king) that if dak (this) qarayaa (city) is banaa (built), and the shawaray (walls) kalal (finished), they will not nathan (give) balaw (tribute), halak (move), or madah (toll), and in the end it will be nazaq (hurtful) to the malakayam (kings).

Kain (now) qabal (because) we eat the salt of the hayakal (palace), and it is not appropriate for us to chazaa (see) the malak (king) irawah (dishonor), il (over) have we shalach (sent) and informed the malak (king);

That baqar (morning) may be made in the sapar (book) of the dakaranay (records) of your ab (father): so you shall shakach (find) in the sapar (book) of the dakaranay (records), and yadai (know) that dak (this) qarayaa (city) is a marad (rebellious) qarayaa (city), and nazaq (hurtful) to malakayan (kings) and madanan (provinces), and that they have ibad (servant) ashathadawar (sedition) within the same of ilam (old) yawam (day); for which cause was dak (this) qarayaa (city) laid waste.

We inform the malak (king) that, if dak (this) qarayaa (city) be banaa (built), and the shawaray (walls) kalal (finished), by dan (this) qabal (means) you shall ayathay (have) no chalaq (portion) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river).

Then the malak (king) shalach (sent) an pathagam (answer) to Rachawam (Rehum) the bail (chancellor), and to Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book), and to the shaar (rest) of their kanath (companions) who yathab (dwell) in Shamarayan (Samaria), and in the shaar (rest) of the country Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river): shalam (peace), and so forth.
The nashathawan (letter) which you shalach (sent) to us has been plainly qaraa (called) qadam (before) me.

I decreed, and baqar (morning) has been made, and it is shakach (found) that dak (this) qarayaa (city) of ilam (old) yawam (day) has nashaa (lift) insurrection il (over) malakayan (kings), and that marad (rebellion) and ashathadawar (sedition) have been ibad (servant) therein.

There hawaa (which/who/that is) been thaqayap (mighty) malakayan (kings) also over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), who have shalayat (ruled) over kal (every) the country Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river); and balaw (tribute), halak (move), and madah (toll), was yahab (paid) to them.

Shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) kain (now) to batal (cause) these gabaray (men) to batal (cease), and that dak (this) qarayaa (city) not be banaa (built), id (until / as far as) a decree shall be shawam (place / establish / appoint) by me.
Hawaa (which/who/that is) heed that you not be slack herein: mah (why) should chabal (damage) shagaa (grow) to the nazaq (hurt) of the malakayan (kings)?

Then when the parashagan (copy) of malak (king) Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes)' nashathawan (letter) was qaraa (called) qadam (before) Rachawam (Rehum), and Shamashay (Shimshai) the sapar (book), and their kanath (companions), they went in bahayalaw (haste) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to the Yahawadaay (Jews), and made them to batal (cease) by adarai (force) and chayal (power).

Then batal (ceased) the ibayadah (work) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and it hawaa (which/who/that is) id (until / as far as) the tharayan (second) shanah (year) of the malakaw (reign) of Darayawash (Darius) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

Now the nabayaay (prophets), Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and Zakarayah (Zechariah) the bar (son) of Idaw (Iddo), nabaa (prophesied) to the Yahawadaay (Jews) who were in Yahawad (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); in the sham (name) of the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel) they prophesied to them.

Then qawam (rise up) up Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the bar (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yashawai (Jeshua) the bar (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and sharaa (began) to banaa (build) the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and with them were the nabayaay (prophets) of Alahayam, said (helping) them.

At the same zaman (time) athah (you (masc)) to them Tattenai, the pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and their kanath (companions), and amar (spoke) kan (for sure) to them, "Who shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a decree to banaa (build) dan (this) bayath (house), and to kalal (finish) dan (this) asharanaa (wall)?"
Then we amar (spoke) them in kanamaa (this) way, man (from) the shamahath (names) of the gabaray (men) were who were banaa (making) dan (this) banayan (building).

But the iyan (eye) of their Alahayam was on the shabay (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews), and they did not batal (make) them batal (cease), id (until / as far as) the taim (matter) should hawak (come) to Darayawash (Darius), and then thawab (answer) should be returned by nashathawan (letter) il (over) it.

The parashagan (copy) of the agaraa (letter) that Tattenai, the pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and his kanath (companions) the aparasakay (apharsachites), who were Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), shalach (sent) to Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king);
They shalach (sent) a pathagam (letter) to him, in which was kathab (write) dan (thus): To Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king), kal (every) shalam (peace).

Be it known to the malak (king), that we azal (went) into the madayanah (province) of Yahawad (Judah), to the bayath (house) of the rab (great) Alahayam, which is banaa (built) with galal (great) aban (stone), and ai (timber) is shawam (place / establish / appoint) in the kathalay (walls); and dak (this) ibayadah (work) ibad (servant) on with diligence and tzalach (prospers) in their yad (hand).

Then we shaal (asked) alak (those) shabay (elders), and amar (spoke) to them kanamaa (thus), "Who shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a decree to banaa (build) dan (this) bayath (house), and to kalal (finish) dan (this) asharanaa (wall)?"
We shaal (asked) them their sham (name) also, to inform you that we might kathab (write) the sham (name) of the gabaray (men) who were at their raash (head).

Kanamaa (thus) they thawab (returned) us pathagam (answer), amar (spoke), "We are the ibad (servant) of the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven) and arai (earth), and are banaa (building) the bayath (house) that was banaa (built) these many shanayan (years) qadamah (ago), which a rab (great) malak (king) of Yasharaal (Israel) banaa (built) and kalal (finished).

But man (from) that our ab (father) had ragaz (provoked) the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven) to ragaz (wrath), he yahab (gave) them into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), the Kasaday (Chaldean), who sathar (destroyed) dan (this) bayath (house), and galah (carried) the im (nation / people) galah (away) into Babal (Babylon).

But in the chad (first) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) to banaa (build) dan (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam.

The dahab (gold) and kasap (silver) maanay (vessels) also of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, which Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) napaq (took) out of the hayakal (temple) that was in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and yabal (brought) into the hayakal (temple) of Babal (Babylon), hamaw (those) Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) took out of the hayakal (temple) of Babal (Babylon), and they were yahab (delivered) to one whose sham (name) was Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar), whom he had shawam (place / establish / appoint) pachah (governor);

And he amar (spoke) to him, ‘nashaa (lift) these maanay (vessels), azal (go), put them in the hayakal (temple) that is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and let the bayath (house) of Alahayam be banaa (built) in its athar (place).'

Then the same Shashabatzar (Sheshbazzar) athah (you (masc)), and yahab (laid) the ashay (foundations) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and man (from) that adayan (time) even id (until / as far as) kain (now) has it been in banaa (building), and yet it is not completed.

Kain (now) therefore, if it seem tab (good) to the malak (king), let a baqar (morning) be made in the malak (king) ganaz (treasure) bayath (house), which is there at Babal (Babylon), han (behold) it be so, that a taim (decree) was shawam (place / establish / appoint) of Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) to banaa (build) dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and let the malak (king) shalach (send) his raiwath (pleasure) to us il (over) dan (this) matter."

Then Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king) shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree), and baqar (morning) was made in the bayath (house) of the archives, tham (where) the ganazay (treasures) were nachath (laid) up in Babal (Babylon).

There was shakach (found) at Achamathaa (Achmetha), in the bayaraa (palace) that is in the madayanah (province) of Maday (Media), a scroll, and therein was kan (for sure) kathab (write) for a dakarawan (record):

In the chad (first) shanah (year) of Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king), Kawarash (Cyrus) the malak (king) shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree): Concerning the bayath (house) of Alahayam at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), let the bayath (house) be banaa (built), the athar (place) where they dabach (offer) dabachayan (sacrifices), and let its ash (fire) be sabal (strongly) laid; its rawam (will lift up) shathayan (sixty) amayan (cubits), and its pathay (breadth) shathayan (sixty) amayan (cubits);
With thalath (three) courses of galal (great) aban (stone), and a course of chadath (new) ai (timber): and let the napaqaa (expenses) be yahab (given) out of the malak (king) bayath (house).

Also let the dahab (gold) and kasap (silver) maanay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, which Nabawakadanatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) napaq (took) forth out of the hayakal (temple) which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and yabal (brought) to Babal (Babylon), be thawab (restored), and hawak (brought) again to the hayakal (temple) which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), everyone to its athar (place); and you shall put them in the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Kain (now) therefore, Tattenai, pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and your kanath (companions) the aparasakay (apharsachites), who are Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), you must stay rachayaq (far) from there.

Leave the ibayadah (work) of dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam shabaq (alone); let the pachah (governor) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) and the shabay (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) banaa (build) dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam in its athar (place).

Moreover I shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) maa (what) you shall ibad (servant) to these shabay (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) for the banaa (building) of dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam: that of the malak (king) nakasay (goods), even of the madah (tribute) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), napaqaa (expenses) be yahab (given) with all diligence to these gabaray (men), that they be not batal (hindered).

That which they chashach (have) need of, both ban (son) bulls, and dakarayan (rams), and amarayan (lambs), for burnt ilawan (offerings) to the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven); also chanataa (wheat), malach (salt), chamar (wine), and mashach (oil), according to the word of the kahanay (priests) who are at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), let it be yahab (given) them yawam (day) by yawam (day) laa (NOT) shalaw (fail);
That they may offer nayachawachayan (sacrifices) of pleasant aroma to the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven), and tzalaa (pray) for the chay (life) of the malak (king), and of his ban (son).

Also I have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree), that whoever shall shanaa (hate) dan (this) pathagam (word), let a beam be nasach (pulled) out from his bayath (house), and let him be lifted up and fastened thereon; and let his bayath (house) be ibad (servant) a nawalaw (dunghill) for dan (this):

And the Alahayam who has caused his sham (name) to shakan (place) there overthrow kal (every) malak (king) and im (nation / people) who shall shalach (put) forth their yad (hand) to shanaa (hate) the same, to chabal (destroy) dak (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). I Darayawash (Darius) have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree); let it be ibad (servant) with all diligence.

Then Tattenai, the pachah (governor) Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), Shatharabawazanay (Shetharbozenai), and their kanath (companions), because Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king) had shalach (sent) a decree, ibad (servant) accordingly with all diligence.

The shabay (elders) of the Yahawadaay (Jews) banaa (built) and tzalach (prospered), through the nabawaah (prophesying) of Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) and Zakarayah (Zechariah) the bar (son) of Idaw (Iddo). They banaa (built) and kalal (finished) it, man (from) to the commandment of the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), and according to the taim (decree) of Kawarash (Cyrus), and Darayawash (Darius), and Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) malak (king) of Paras (Persia).

Dan (this) bayath (house) was yatzaa (go out / come out) on the thalath (third) yawam (day) of the yarach (month) Adar (Adar), which was in the shath (sixth) shanah (year) of the malakaw (reign) of Darayawash (Darius) the malakaw (king).

The banay (children) of Yasharaal (Israel), the kahanay (priests), and the Laway (Levites), and the shaar (rest) of the banay (children) of the galawath (captivity), kept the chanakaa (dedication) of dan (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam with chadawah (joy).

They offered at the chanakaa (dedication) of dan (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam one maah (hundred) bulls, two maah (hundred) dakarayan (rams), arabai (four) maah (hundred) amarayan (lambs); and for a chatayaa (sin) offering for kal (every) Yasharaal (Israel), tharayan (twelve) male izayan (goats), according to the manayan (number) of the shabatay (tribes) of Yasharaal (Israel).

They qawam (rise up) the kahanay (priests) in their palagah (divisions), and the Laway (Levites) in their courses, for the ibayadah (service) of Alahayam, which is at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); as it is kathab (write) in the sapar (book) of Mashah (Moses).
The banay (children) of the gawalah (captivity) ishah (make) the pasach (passover) on the fourteenth day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month).

For the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) had tahar (purified) themselves achad (one); all of them were tahawar (pure): and they shachat (killed) the pasach (passover) for all the banay (children) of the gawalah (captivity), and for their ach (brother/kinsman) the kahanayam (priests), and for themselves.

The banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) who had shawab (turn back / repent) again out of the gawalah (captivity), and all such as had badal (separated) themselves to them from the tamaah (filthiness) of the gaway (heathen / nation) of the aratz (Earth/land), to darash (seek) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), akal (eat),

And ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) of unleavened matzah (bread) shabai (seven) yamayam (days) with shamachah (joy): for Yahawah shamach (had) made them joyful, and had sabab (turned) the lab (heart) of the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) to them, to chazaq (strengthen) their yad (hand) in the malaakah (work) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Now achar (other) these things, in the malakawath (reign) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) malak (king) of Paras (Persia), Izaraa (Ezra) the ban (son) of Sharayah (Seraiah), the ban (son) of Izarayah (Azariah), the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah),
The ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum), the ban (son) of Tzadawaq (Zadok), the ban (son) of Achayatawab (Ahitub),
The ban (son) of Amarayah (Amariah), the ban (son) of Izarayah (Azariah), the ban (son) of Marayawath (Meraioth),
The ban (son) of Zarachayah (Zerahiah), the ban (son) of Izay (Uzzi), the ban (son) of Baqay (Bukki),
The ban (son) of Abayashawai (Abishua), the ban (son) of Payanachas (Phinehas), the ban (son) of Alaizar (Eleazar), the ban (son) of Aharawan (Aaron) the raash (head) kahan (priest);

This Izaraa (man) ilah (go up / offer) up from Babal (Babylon): and he was a mahayar (ready) sapar (book) in the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), which Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), nathan (give) given; and the malak (king) nathan (give) him all his baqashah (request), according to the yad (hand) of Yahawah his Alahayam on him.

There ilah (go up / offer) up some of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and of the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), and the singers, and the shairayam (porters), and the nathayan (nethinim), to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), in the shabai (seven) shanah (year) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king).
He bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), which was in the shabayaiy (seventh) shanah (year) of the malak (king).

For on the achad (one) day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month) yasad (began) he to mailah (ascent/climbing up) up from Babal (Babylon); and on the achad (one) day of the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month) bawaa (come) he to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), according to the tawab (good / proper function) yad (hand) of his Alahayam on him.

For he had kawan (set) his labab (heart) to darash (seek) the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah, and to ishah (make) it, and to lamad (teach / instruct) in Yashar-Al (Israel) chaq (statute) and mashapat (ordinances).

Now this is the parashagan (copy) of the nashathawan (letter) that the malak (king) Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) nathan (give) to Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest), the sapar (book), even the sapar (book) of the dabaray (words) of the matzawath (commandments) of Yahawah, and of his chaq (statute) to Yashar-Al (Israel):

Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes), malak (king) of malakay (kings), to Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest), the sapar (book) of the dath (law) of the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven), gamar (perfect) and so forth.

I shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree), that kal (every) those of the im (nation / people) of Yasharaal (Israel), and their kahan (priest) and the Laway (Levites), in my malakaw (realm), who are nadab (minded) of their own free will to hawak (go) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), hawak (go) with you.

Because you are shalach (sent) of the malak (king) and his shabaih (seven) counselors, to baqar (morning) il (over) Yahawad (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), according to the dath (law) of your Alahayam which is in your yad (hand),

And to yabal (carry) the kasap (silver) and dahab (gold), which the malak (king) and his counselors have nadab (freely) offered to the Alahayam of Yasharaal (Israel), whose mashakan (habitation) is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem),

And kal (every) the kasap (silver) and dahab (gold) that you shall shakach (find) in kal (every) the madayanah (province) of Babal (Babylon), with the freewill nadab (offering) of the im (nation / people), and of the kahanay (priests), nadab (offering) willingly for the bayath (house) of their Alahayam which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

Therefore you shall with all diligence qanaa (jealous) with dan (this) kasap (money) bulls, dakarayan (rams), amarayan (lambs), with their meal manachah (offerings) and their drink nasak (offerings), and shall offer them on the madabach (altar) of the bayath (house) of your Alahayam which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Whatever shall seem yatab (good) to you and to your ach (brother/kinsman) to ibad (servant) with the shaar (rest) of the kasap (silver) and the dahab (gold), ibad (servant) that after the raiwath (will) of your Alahayam.
The maanay (vessels) that are yahab (given) to you for the palachan (service) of the bayath (house) of your Alahayam, shalam (deliver) qadam (before) the Alahayam of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Whatever more shall be chashachawath (needful) for the bayath (house) of your Alahayam, which you shall napal (fall / be cast down) occasion to nathan (give), nathan (give) it out of the malak (king) ganaz (treasure) bayath (house).

I, even I Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king), do shawam (place / establish / appoint) a taim (decree) to kal (every) the gazabaray (treasurers) who are Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), that whatever Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest), the sapar (book) of the dath (law) of the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven), shall shaal (require) of you, it be ibad (servant) with all diligence,
