To one maah (hundred) kakarayan (talents) of kasap (silver), and to one maah (hundred) karayan (measures) of chanataa (wheat), and to one maah (hundred) bathayan (baths) of chamar (wine), and to one maah (hundred) bathayan (baths) of mashach (oil), and malach (salt) laa (NOT) kathab (write) how much.

Whatever is commanded by the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven), let it be ibad (servant) exactly for the bayath (house) of the Alahayam of shamayan (heaven); for mah (why) should there be qatzap (wrath) il (over) the malakaw (realm) of the malak (king) and his ban (son)?

Also we inform you, that touching any of the kahanay (priests) and Laway (Levites), the zamaray (singers), tharaiy (porters), nathayan (nethinim), or palachay (servants) of dan (this) bayath (house) of Alahayam, it shall not be shalayat (lawful) to ramah (impose) balaw (tribute), halak (move), or madah (toll), on them.

You, Izaraa (Ezra), after the chakamah (wisdom) of your Alahayam who is in your yad (hand), appoint shapatayan (magistrates) and dayanayan (judges), who may hawaa (which/who/that is) kal (every) the im (nation / people) who are Ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), kal (every) such as yadai (know) the dathay (laws) of your Alahayam; and yadai (teach) him who doesn't yadai (know) them.

Whoever will not hawaa (which/who/that is) the dath (law) of your Alahayam, and the dath (law) of the malak (king), let dayan (judge) be ibad (servant) on him with all diligence, han (behold) it be to mawath (death), or to sharashaw (banishment), or to inash (confiscation) of nakasayan (goods), or to asawar (imprisonment).

Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, the Alahayam of our ab (father), who nathan (give) put such a thing as this in the malak (king) lab (heart), to paar (beautify) the bayath (house) of Yahawah which is in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And has natah (extended) loving chasad (grace) to me panayam (face) the malak (king), and his yaitz (counselors), and before all the malak (king) gabawar (mighty) sharay (princes). I was chazaq (strengthened) according to the yad (hand) of Yahawah my Alahayam on me, and I qabatz (gathered) together out of Yashar-Al (Israel) raash (head) men to ilah (go up / offer) up with me.

Now these are the raashay (heads) of their ab (father)' households, and this is the yachash (genealogy) of those who ilah (go up / offer) up with me from Babal (Babylon), in the malakawath (reign) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malakawath (king):
Of the banay (sons) of Payanachas (Phinehas), Garasham (Gershom). Of the banay (sons) of Ayathamar (Ithamar), Danayaal (Daniel). Of the banay (sons) of Dawad (David), Chatawash (Hattush).

Of the banay (sons) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah), of the banay (sons) of Paraish (Parosh), Zakarayah (Zechariah); and with him were yachash (reckoned) by genealogy of the zakarayam (males) one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty).
Of the banay (sons) of Pachathamawaab (Pahathmoab), Alayahawaiyanay (Eliehoenai) the ban (son) of Zarachayah (Zerahiah); and with him two maah (hundred) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah), the ban (son) of Yachazayaal (Jahaziel); and with him shalawash (three) maah (hundred) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Idayan (Adin), Ibad (Ebed) the ban (son) of Yawanathan (Jonathan); and with him chamashayam (fifty) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Iyalam (Elam), Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah) the ban (son) of Ithalayah (Athaliah); and with him shabaiyam (seventy) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), Zabadayah (Zebadiah) the ban (son) of Mayakaal (Michael); and with him shamanayam (eighty) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Yawaab (Joab), Ibadayah (Obadiah) the ban (son) of Yachayaal (Jehiel); and with him two maah (hundred) and eighteen zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Shalamayath (Shelomith), the ban (son) of Yawasapayah (Josiphiah); and with him one maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Babay (Bebai), Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Babay (Bebai); and with him isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Izagad (Azgad), Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qatan (Hakkatan); and with him one maah (hundred) ishar (ten) zakarayam (males).

Of the banay (sons) of Adanayaqam (Adonikam), who were the acharawan (last); and these are their sham (name): Alayapalat (Eliphelet), Yaiyaal (Jeuel), and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah); and with them shashayam (sixty) zakarayam (males).
Of the banay (sons) of Bagaway (Bigvai), Iwathay (Uthai) and Zabawad (Zabbud); and with them shabaiyam (seventy) zakarayam (males).

I qabatz (gathered) them together to the nahar (river) that bawaa (come) to Ahawaa (Ahava); and there we chanah (encamped) shalawash (three) yamayam (days): and I bayan (between) the im (nation / people), and the kahanayam (priests), and matzaa (found) there none of the banay (sons) of Laway (Levi).

Then shalach (send) I for Alayaizar (Eliezer), for Arayaal (Ariel), for Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and for Alanathan (Elnathan), and for Yarayab (Jarib), and for Alanathan (Elnathan), and for Nathan (Nathan), and for Zakarayah (Zechariah), and for Mashalam (Meshullam), raash (head) men; also for Yawayarayab (Joiarib), and for Alanathan (Elnathan), who were teachers.

I yatzaa (go out / come out) them yatzaa (go out / come out) to Adaw (Iddo) the raash (head) at the maqawam (place) Kasapayaa (Casiphia); and I shawam (place / establish / appoint) them dabar (word / matter) they should shawam (place / establish / appoint) Adaw (Iddo), and his ach (brother/kinsman) the nathayan (nethinim), at the maqawam (place) Kasapayaa (Casiphia), that they should bawaa (come) to us masharathayam (ministers) for the bayath (house) of our Alahayam.

According to the tawab (good / proper function) yad (hand) of our Alahayam on us they bawaa (come) us a ayash (man / husband) of shakal (discretion), of the banay (sons) of Machalay (Mahli), the ban (son) of Laway (Levi), the ban (son) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and Sharabayah (Sherebiah), with his banay (sons) and his ach (brother/kinsman), eighteen;
And Chashabayah (Hashabiah), and with him Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah) of the banay (sons) of Mararay (Merari), his ach (brother/kinsman) and their banay (sons), isharayam (twenty);

And of the nathayan (nethinim), whom Dawad (David) and the sharayam (princes) nathan (give) given for the ibadah (service) of the Lawayay (Levites), two maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty) nathayan (nethinim): all of them were mentioned by sham (name).

Then I qaraa (called) a tzawam (fast) there, at the nahar (river) Ahawaa (Ahava), that we might inah (oppress / afflict) ourselves panayam (face) our Alahayam, to baqash (seek) of him a yashar (upright) darak (way) for us, and for our little tap (ones), and for all our rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions).

For I was bawash (ashamed) to shaal (ask) of the malak (king) a chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of soldiers and horsemen to izar (help) us against the ayab (enemy) in the darak (way), because we had amar (spoke) to the malak (king), amar (spoke), "The yad (hand) of our Alahayam is on all those who baqash (seek) him, for tawab (good / proper function); but his iz (strength / might / refuge) and his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is against all those who izab (forsake) him."
So we tzawam (fasted) and baqash (begged) our Alahayam for this: and he was entreated of us.
Then I set apart shanayam (two) of the sharay (chiefs) of the kahanayam (priests), even Sharabayah (Sherebiah), Chashabayah (Hashabiah), and ishar (ten) of their ach (brother/kinsman) with them,

And shaqal (weighed) to them the kasap (silver), and the zahab (gold), and the kalayam (vessels), even the tharawamah (offering) for the bayath (house) of our Alahayam, which the malak (king), and his yaitz (counselors), and his shar (prince / ruler), and all Yashar-Al (Israel) there matzaa (present), had rawam (will lift up):

I shaqal (weighed) into their yad (hand) shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) kakarayam (talents) of kasap (silver), and kasap (silver) kalay (vessels) one maah (hundred) kakarayam (talents); of zahab (gold) one maah (hundred) kakarayam (talents);

And isharayam (twenty) bowls of zahab (gold), of one alap (thousand) darics; and shanayam (two) kalay (vessels) of tawab (good / proper function) bright nachashath (brass), chamadah (precious) as zahab (gold).

I amar (spoke) to them, "You are qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah, and the kalayam (vessels) are qadash (set apart / make holy); and the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) are a freewill nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father).

Shaqad (watch), and shamar (keep/guard) them, until you shaqal (weigh) them panayam (face) the sharay (chiefs) of the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), and the sharay (princes) of the abawath (fathers)' households of Yashar-Al (Israel), at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), in the rooms of the bayath (house) of Yahawah."

So the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) qabal (received) the mashaqal (weight) of the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold), and the kalayam (vessels), to bawaa (come) them to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to the bayath (house) of our Alahayam.

Then we departed from the nahar (river) Ahawaa (Ahava) on the shanayam (two) day of the raashawan (first) chadash (month), to yalak (go) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): and the yad (hand) of our Alahayam was on us, and he natzal (delivered) us from the kap (hand) of the ayab (enemy) and the bandit by the darak (way).
We bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and stayed there shalawash (three) yamayam (days).

On the rabayaiy (fourth) yawam (day) the kasap (silver) and the zahab (gold) and the kalayam (vessels) were shaqal (weighed) in the bayath (house) of our Alahayam into the yad (hand) of Maramawath (Meremoth) the ban (son) of Awarayah (Uriah) the kahan (priest); and with him was Alaizar (Eleazar) the ban (son) of Payanachas (Phinehas); and with them was Yawazabad (Jozabad) the ban (son) of Yashawai (Jeshua), and Nawaidayah (Noadiah) the ban (son) of Banaway (Binnui), the Lawayay (Levite);
The whole by masapar (number) and by mashaqal (weight): and all the mashaqal (weight) was kathab (write) at that ith (time).

The banay (children) of the gawalah (captivity), who bawaa (come) come out of exile, qarab (come close) burnt ilawath (offerings) to the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), shanayam (two) parayam (bulls) for all Yashar-Al (Israel), thashaiyam (ninety) - shash (six) ayalayam (rams), shabaiyam (seventy) - shabai (seven) kabashayam (lambs), and shanayam (two) male tzapayaray (goats) for a chataah (sin) offering: all this was a burnt ilah (offering) to Yahawah.

They nathan (give) the malak (king) dathay (commissions) to the malak (king) satraps, and to the pachawawath (governors) ibar (beyond) the nahar (river): and they nashaa (lift) the im (nation / people) and the bayath (house) of Alahayam.

Now when these things were kalah (complete / finish), the sharayam (princes) nagash (drew) near to me, amar (spoke), "The imay (people) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites), have not badal (separated) themselves from the imay (peoples) of the aratzawath (lands), following their thawaibah (abominations), even those of the Kanainay (Canaanites), the Chathay (Hittites), the Parazay (Perizzites), the Yabawasay (Jebusites), the Imawanay (Ammonites), the Mawaabay (Moabites), the Matzaray (Egyptians), and the Amaray (Amorites).

For they have nashaa (lift) of their banath (daughter) for themselves and for their ban (son), so that the qadash (set apart / make holy) zarai (seed) have mixed themselves with the imay (peoples) of the aratzawath (lands). Yes, the yad (hand) of the sharayam (princes) and saganayam (rulers) has been chief in this mail (top/above)."

When I shamai (hearken / hear) this thing, I qarai (tore) my bagad (garment) and my bagad (robe), and marat (plucked) off the shair (hair) of my raash (head) and of my zaqan (beard), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) down confounded.

Then were asap (assembled) to me everyone who trembled at the dabaray (words) of the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), because of their mail (top/above) of the gawalah (captivity); and I yashab (inhabit/dwell) confounded until the irab (evening) manachah (offering).

At the irab (evening) manachah (offering) I qawam (rise up) up from my humiliation, even with my bagad (garment) and my bagad (robe) qarai (torn); and I karai (fell) on my barak (blessed), and parash (spread) out my kap (hands) to Yahawah my Alahayam;

And I amar (spoke), "My Alahayam, I am bawash (ashamed) and kalam (blush) to rawam (will lift up) up my panayam (face) to you, my Alahayam; for our iwan (guilt/iniquity) rabah (have) increased over our raash (head), and our guiltiness has gadal (grown) up to the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

Since the yamay (days) of our ab (father) we have been gadawal (very great/important/mighty) guilty to this yawam (day); and for our iwan (guilt/iniquity) we, our malakay (kings), and our kahan (priest), nathan (give) been delivered into the yad (hand) of the malakay (kings) of the aratzawath (lands), to the charab (sword), to shabay (captivity), to plunder, and to bashath (confusion) of panayam (face), as it is this yawam (day).

Now for a mait (little) ragai (in an instance) thachanah (grace) has been shown from Yahawah our Alahayam, to shaar (leave) us a palayatah (remnant) to escape, and to nathan (give) us a yathad (nail) in his qadash (set apart / make holy) maqawam (place), that our Alahayam may lighten our iyan (eye), and nathan (give) us a mait (little) machayah (reviving) in our ibadawath (bondage).

For we are ibadayam (bondservants); yet our Alahayam has not forsaken us in our ibadawath (bondage), but has natah (extended) loving chasad (grace) to us in the panayam (face) of the malakay (kings) of Paras (Persia), to nathan (give) us a machayah (reviving), to rawam (will lift up) up the bayath (house) of our Alahayam, and to imad (repair) its ruins, and to nathan (give) us a gadar (wall) in Yahawadah (Judah) and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
"Now, our Alahayam, what shall we amar (spoke) achar (other) this? For we have forsaken your matzawah (commandments),

Which you have tzawah (commanded) by your ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets), amar (spoke), ‘The aratz (Earth/land), to which you bawaa (come) to yarash (possess) it, is an nadah (unclean) aratz (Earth/land) through the uncleanness of the imay (peoples) of the aratzawath (lands), through their thawaibah (abominations), which malaa (have) filled it from one pah (end) to another with their tamaah (filthiness).

Now therefore don't nathan (give) your banath (daughter) to their ban (son), neither nashaa (lift) their banath (daughter) to your ban (son), nor darash (seek) their shalawam (peace / safety) or their tawab (good / proper function) iwalam (forever); that you may be chazaq (strong), and akal (eat) the tawab (good / proper function) of the aratz (Earth/land), and yarash (leave) it for an inheritance to your ban (son) iwalam (forever).'

"Achar (other) all that bawaa (come) come on us for our rai (evil) maishah (deeds), and for our gadawal (very great/important/mighty) ashamah (guilt), since you, our Alahayam, have chashak (darkness) us matah (less) than our iwan (guilt/iniquity) deserve, and nathan (give) given us such a palayatah (remnant),

Shall we again parar (break) your matzawah (commandments), and chathan (join) in affinity with the imay (peoples) that do these thaibawath (abominations)? Wouldn't you be anap (angry) with us until you kalah (complete / finish) consumed us, so that there should be no shaarayath (remnant), nor any to palayatah (escape)?

Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), you are tzadayaq (righteous); for we are left a shaar (remnant) that has palayatah (escaped), as it is this yawam (day). Behold, we are panayam (face) you in our guiltiness; for none can imad (stand) panayam (face) you because of this."

Now while Izaraa (Ezra) palal (prayed) and made yadah (confession), bakah (weeping) and napal (fall / be cast down) himself down panayam (face) the bayath (house) of Alahayam, there was qabatz (gathered) together to him out of Yashar-Al (Israel) a very rab (great) qahal (assembly) of rab (men) and nashayam (women) and yaladayam (children); for the panay (people) bakah (wept) very bitterly.

Shakanayah (Shecaniah) the ban (son) of Yachayaal (Jehiel), one of the banay (sons) of Iyalam (Elam), inah (answer / respond) Izaraa (Ezra), "We have mail (top/above) against our Alahayam, and have yashab (inhabit/dwell) foreign nashayam (women) of the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land). Yet now there is maqawah (gathering / collection) for Yashar-Al (Israel) concerning this thing.

Now therefore let us karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with our Alahayam to yatzaa (go out / come out) away all the wives, and such as are yalad (birth / begot) of them, according to the itzah (counsel) of my Adanay, and of those who tremble at the matzawah (commandment) of our Alahayam. Let it be ishah (make) according to the thawarah (instruction).
Qawam (rise up); for the dabar (word / matter) belongs to you, and we are with you. Be courageous, and ishah (make) it."

Then Izaraa (Ezra) qawam (rise up), and made the sharay (chiefs) of the kahanayam (priests), the Lawayay (Levites), and all Yashar-Al (Israel), to shabai (swear / take oath) that they would ishah (make) according to this dabar (word / matter). So they shabai (swear / take oath).

Then Izaraa (Ezra) qawam (rise up) up from panayam (face) the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and yalak (went) into the room of Yahawachanan (Jehohanan) the ban (son) of Alayashayab (Eliashib): and when he yalak (came) there, he akal (eat) no lacham (bread), nor shathah (drinks) mayam (Waters); for he abal (mourned) because of their mail (top/above) of the gawalah (captivity).

They ibar (pass over/through) proclamation throughout Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to all the banay (children) of the gawalah (captivity), that they should qabatz (gather) themselves together to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And that whoever didn't bawaa (come) within shalawash (three) yamayam (days), according to the itzah (counsel) of the sharayam (princes) and the zaqanayam (elders), all his rakawash (wealth / property / goods / possessions) should be charam (forfeited), and himself badal (separated) from the qahal (assembly) of the gawalah (captivity).

Then all the anashay (men) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Banayamayan (Benjamin) qabatz (gathered) themselves together to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) within the shalawash (three) yamayam (days); it was the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month), on the isharayam (twenty) day of the chadash (month): and all the im (nation / people) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the rachab (broad) place before the bayath (house) of Alahayam, raid (trembling) dabar (word / matter) of this matter, and for the great gasham (rain).

Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest) qawam (rise up) up, and amar (spoke) to them, "You have mail (top/above), and have yashab (inhabit/dwell) foreign nashayam (women), to yasap (increase) the ashamah (guilt) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Now therefore nathan (give) thawadah (confession) to Yahawah, the Alahayam of your ab (father), and ishah (make) his ratzawan (pleasure); and badal (separated) yourselves from the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land), and from the foreign nashayam (women)."
Then all the qahal (assembly) inah (answer / respond) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice), "As you have amar (spoke) concerning us, so must we ishah (make).

But the im (nation / people) are many, and it is a ith (time) of much gasham (rain), and we are not kach (strength / mighty / power) to imad (stand) outside; neither is this a malaakah (work) of achad (one) yawam (day) or shanayam (two); for we have greatly pashai (transgressed) in this dabar (word / matter).

Let now our shar (prince / ruler) be imad (appointed) for all the qahal (assembly), and let all those who are in our iyar (cities) who have yashab (inhabit/dwell) foreign nashayam (women) bawaa (come) at zaman (appointed) ithayam (times), and with them the zaqanay (elders) of every iyar (city), and its shapat (judge / judgement), until the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of our Alahayam be shawab (turn back / repent) from us, until this dabar (word / matter) is resolved."

Only Yawanathan (Jonathan) the ban (son) of Ishahaal (Asahel) and Yachazayah (Jahzeiah) the ban (son) of Thaqawah (Tikvah) imad (stood) up against this; and Mashalam (Meshullam) and Shabathay (Shabbethai) the Lawayay (Levite) izar (helped) them.

The banay (children) of the gawalah (captivity) ishah (make) so. Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest), with ayash (man / husband) raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, after their abawath (fathers)' bayath (house), and all of them by their shamawath (names), were set apart; and they yashab (inhabit/dwell) down in the achad (one) yawam (day) of the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month) to examine the dabar (word / matter).
They kalah (complete / finish) an end with all the anashayam (men) who had yashab (inhabit/dwell) foreign nashayam (women) by the achad (one) yawam (day) of the achad (one) chadash (month).

Among the banay (sons) of the kahanayam (priests) there were matzaa (found) who had yashab (inhabit/dwell) foreign nashayam (women): of the banay (sons) of Yashawai (Jeshua), the ban (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and his ach (brother/kinsman), Maishayah (Maaseiah), and Alayaizar (Eliezer), and Yarayab (Jarib), and Gadalayah (Gedaliah).
They nathan (give) their yad (hand) that they would yatzaa (go out / come out) away their wives; and being asham (guilty), they offered a ayal (ram) of the tzaan (flock) for their ashamah (guilt).
Of the banay (sons) of Amar (Immer): Chananay (Hanani) and Zabadayah (Zebadiah).
Of the banay (sons) of Charam (Harim): Maishayah (Maaseiah), and Alayah (Elijah), and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Yachayaal (Jehiel), and Izayah (Uzziah).
Of the banay (sons) of Pashachawar (Pashhur): Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), Maishayah (Maaseiah), Yashamaial (Ishmael), Nathanaal (Nethanel), Yawazabad (Jozabad), and Alaishah (Elasah).
Of the Lawayay (Levites): Yawazabad (Jozabad), and Shamaiy (Shimei), and Qalayah (Kelaiah) (the same is Qalayataa (Kelita)), Pathachayah (Pethahiah), Yahawadah (Judah), and Alayaizar (Eliezer).
Of the singers: Alayashayab (Eliashib). Of the shairayam (porters): Shalawam (Shallum), and Talam (Telem), and Awaray (Uri).

Of Yashar-Al (Israel): Of the banay (sons) of Paraish (Parosh): Ramayah (Ramiah), and Yazayah (Izziah), and Malakayah (Malchijah), and Mayaman (Mijamin), and Alaizar (Eleazar), and Malakayah (Malchijah), and Banayah (Benaiah).
Of the banay (sons) of Iyalam (Elam): Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Zakarayah (Zechariah), and Yachayaal (Jehiel), and Ibaday (Abdi), and Yarayamawath (Jeremoth), and Alayah (Elijah).
Of the banay (sons) of Zathawaa (Zattu): Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), Alayashayab (Eliashib), Mathanayah (Mattaniah), and Yarayamawath (Jeremoth), and Zabad (Zabad), and Izayazaa (Aziza).
Of the banay (sons) of Babay (Bebai): Yahawachanan (Jehohanan), Chananayah (Hananiah), Zabay (Zabbai), Ithalay (Athlai).
Of the banay (sons) of Banay (Bani): Mashalam (Meshullam), Malawak (Malluch), and Idayah (Adaiah), Yashawab (Jashub), and Shaal (Sheal), Jeremoth.

Of the banay (sons) of Pachathamawaab (Pahathmoab): Idanaa (Adna), and Kalal (Chelal), Banayah (Benaiah), Maishayah (Maaseiah), Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Batzalaal (Bezalel), and Banaway (Binnui), and Manashah (Manasseh).
Of the banay (sons) of Charam (Harim): Alayaizar (Eliezer), Yashayah (Isshijah), Malakayah (Malchijah), Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), Shamaiwan (Shimeon),
Banayamayan (Benjamin), Malawak (Malluch), Shamarayah (Shemariah).
Of the banay (sons) of Chasham (Hashum): Mathanay (Mattenai), Mathathah (Mattattah), Zabad (Zabad), Alayapalat (Eliphelet), Yaramay (Jeremai), Manashah (Manasseh), Shamaiy (Shimei).
Of the banay (sons) of Banay (Bani): Maiday (Maadai), Imaram (Amram), and Awaal (Uel),
Banayah (Benaiah), Badayah (Bedeiah), Kalawahay (Cheluhi),
Wanayah (Vaniah), Maramawath (Meremoth), Alayashayab (Eliashib),
Mathanayah (Mattaniah), Mathanay (Mattenai), and Yaishaw (Jaasu),
And Banay (Bani), and Banaway (Binnui), Shamaiy (Shimei),
And Shalamayah (Shelemiah), and Nathan (Nathan), and Idayah (Adaiah),
Makanadabay (Machnadebai), Shashay (Shashai), Sharay (Sharai),
Izaraal (Azarel), and Shalamayah (Shelemiah), Shamarayah (Shemariah),
Shalawam (Shallum), Amarayah (Amariah), Yawasap (Joseph).
Of the banay (sons) of Nabaw (Nebo): Yaiyaal (Jeiel), Mathathayah (Mattithiah), Zabad (Zabad), Zabayanaa (Zebina), Yadaw (Iddo), and Yawaal (Joel), Banayah (Benaiah).
All these had nashaa (lift) foreign wives; and some of them yash (had) wives by whom they had banayam (children).

The dabaray (words) of Nachamayah (Nehemiah) the ban (son) of Chakalayah (Hacaliah). Now it happened in the chadash (month) Kasalaw (Chislev), in the isharayam (twenty) shanah (year), as I was in Shawashan (Shushan) the bayarah (palace),

That Chananay (Hanani), achad (one) of my ach (brother/kinsman), bawaa (come), he and achad (one) men out of Yahawadah (Judah); and I shaal (asked) them concerning the Yahawaday (Jews) who had palayatah (escaped), who were shaar (left) of the shabay (captivity), and concerning Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They amar (spoke) to me, "The shaar (remnant) who are shaar (left) of the shabay (captivity) there in the madayanah (province) are in gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (affliction) and charapah (reproach). The chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) also is paratz (broken) down, and its shair (gates) are yatzath (burned) with ash (fire)."

It happened, when I shamai (hearken / hear) these dabarayam (words), that I yashab (inhabit/dwell) down and bakah (wept), and abal (mourned) certain yamayam (days); and I tzawam (fasted) and palal (prayed) panayam (face) the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens),

And amar (spoke), "I beg you, Yahawah, the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and awesome Al, who shamaray (keeps) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace) with those who ahab (love) him and shamar (keep/guard) his matzawah (commandments):

Let your azan (ear) now be qashab (attentive), and your iyan (eye) pathach (open), that you may shamai (hearken / hear) to the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), which I palal (pray) panayam (face) you at this yawam (day), yawamam (by day) and layal (night), for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) your ibad (servant) while I yadah (confess) the chataawath (sins) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), which we have chataa (sinned) against you. Yes, I and my ab (father) bayath (house) have chataa (sinned).

We have dealt very chabal (corruptly) against you, and have not shamar (keep/guard) the matzawath (commandments), nor the chaqayam (statutes), nor the mashapatayam (ordinances), which you tzawah (commanded) your ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses).

"Zakar (remember), I beg you, the dabar (word / matter) that you tzawah (commanded) your ibad (servant) Mashah (Moses), amar (spoke), ‘If you mail (top/above), I will pawatz (scatter) you abroad among the imayam (peoples);

But if you shawab (turn back / repent) to me, and shamar (keep/guard) my matzawah (commandments) and ishah (make) them, though your nadach (outcasts) were in the uttermost part of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), yet will I qabatz (gather) them from there, and will bawaa (come) them to the maqawam (place) that I have bachar (chosen), to cause my sham (name) to shakan (place) there.'

"Now these are your ibad (servant) and your im (nation / people), whom you have padah (redeemed) by your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power), and by your chazaq (strong) yad (hand).

Adanay, I beg you, let your azan (ear) be qashab (attentive) now to the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), and to the thapalah (prayer) of your ibad (servant), who chapatz (delight) to yaraa (fear / be afraid) your sham (name); and please tzalach (prosper) your ibad (servant) this yawam (day), and nathan (give) him racham (show mercy / love) in the panayam (face) of this ayash (man / husband)." Now I was cup bearer to the malak (king).

It happened in the chadash (month) Nayasan (Nisan), in the isharayam (twenty) shanah (year) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king), when yayan (wine) panayam (face) before him, that I nashaa (lift) up the yayan (wine), and nathan (give) it to the malak (king). Now I had not been rai (sad) panayam (face) in his presence.

The malak (king) amar (spoke) to me, "Why is your panayam (face) rai (sad), since you are not chalah (afflict)? This is nothing else but rai (sorrow) of lab (heart)." Then I was very much yaraa (fear / be afraid).

I amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "Let the malak (king) chayah (live) iwalam (forever)! Why shouldn't my panayam (face) be sad, when the iyar (city), the bayath (house) of my ab (father)' tombs, lies charab (waste), and its shair (gates) have been akal (eat) with ash (fire)?"
Then the malak (king) amar (spoke) to me, "For what do you baqash (make) request?" So I palal (prayed) to the Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

I amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "If it tawab (good / proper function) the malak (king), and if your ibad (servant) yatab (has) found favor in your panayam (face), that you would shalach (send) me to Yahawadah (Judah), to the iyar (city) of my ab (father)' tombs, that I may banah (build) it."

The malak (king) amar (spoke) to me (the shagal (queen) was also sitting by him), "For how long shall your mahalak (journey) be? And when will you shawab (turn back / repent)?" So it yatab (pleased) the malak (king) to shalach (send) me; and I nathan (give) him a zaman (time).

Moreover I amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "If it tawab (good / proper function) the malak (king), let agarawath (letters) be nathan (give) me to the pachawawath (governors) ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), that they may let me ibar (pass over/through) through until I bawaa (come) to Yahawadah (Judah);

And a agarath (letter) to Asap (Asaph) the keeper of the malak (king) paradas (forest), that he may nathan (give) me itz (timber) to make qarah (beams) for the shairay (gates) of the citadel by the bayath (house), for the chawamah (wall) of the iyar (city), and for the bayath (house) that I shall bawaa (come) into." The malak (king) nathan (give) my requests, because of the tawab (good / proper function) yad (hand) of my Alahayam on me.

Then I bawaa (come) to the pachawawath (governors) ibar (beyond) the nahar (river), and nathan (give) them the malak (king) agarawath (letters). Now the malak (king) had shalach (send) with me sharay (captains) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) and horsemen.

When Sanabalat (Sanballat) the charanay (horonite), and Tawabayah (Tobiah) the ibad (servant), the Imawanay (Ammonite), shamai (hearken / hear) of it, it grieved them rai (exceedingly), because a adam (man) bawaa (come) come to baqash (seek) the tawab (good / proper function) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
So I bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and was there shalawash (three) yamayam (days).

I qawam (rise up) in the layal (night), I and some mait (few) anashayam (men) with me; neither nagad (told) I any ayash (man / husband) what my Alahayam nathan (give) into my lab (heart) to ishah (make) for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); neither was there any animal with me, except the animal that I rakab (rode) on.

I yatzaa (go out / come out) out by layal (night) by the gayaa (valley) shair (gate), even panayam (face) the jackal's iyan (eye), and to the ashapath (dung) shair (gate), and shabar (viewed) the chawamath (walls) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), which were paratz (broken) down, and its shair (gates) were akal (eat) with ash (fire).
Then I ibar (pass over/through) on to the spring shair (gate) and to the malak (king) barakah (pool): but there was no maqawam (place) for the animal that was under me to ibar (pass over/through).

Then ilah (go up / offer) I up in the layal (night) by the nachal (stream / river), and shabar (viewed) the chawamah (wall); and I shawab (turn back / repent) back, and bawaa (come) by the gayaa (valley) shair (gate), and so shawab (turn back / repent).

The saganayam (rulers) didn't yadai (know) where I halak (move), or what I ishah (make); neither had I as yet nagad (told) it to the Yahawaday (Jews), nor to the kahanayam (priests), nor to the charayam (nobles), nor to the saganayam (rulers), nor to the yathar (rest) who ishah (make) the malaakah (work).

Then I amar (spoke) to them, "You raah (see) the rai (evil) case that we are in, how Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) lies charab (waste), and its shair (gates) are yatzath (burned) with ash (fire). Yalak (come), let us banah (build) up the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that we won't be disgraced."

I nagad (told) them of the yad (hand) of my Alahayam which was tawab (good / proper function) on me, as also of the malak (king) dabaray (words) that he had amar (spoke) to me. They amar (spoke), "Let's qawam (rise up) up and banah (build)." So they chazaq (strengthened) their yad (hand) for the tawab (good / proper function) work.

But when Sanabalat (Sanballat) the charanay (horonite), and Tawabayah (Tobiah) the ibad (servant), the Imawanay (Ammonite), and Gasham (Geshem) the Irabay (Arabian), shamai (hearken / hear) it, they ridiculed us, and bazah (despised) us, and amar (spoke), "dabar (word / matter) is this thing that you are ishah (make)? Will you marad (rebel) against the malak (king)?"

Then shawab (turn back / repent) I them, and amar (spoke) to them, "The Alahayam of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) will tzalach (prosper) us. Therefore we, his ibad (servant), will qawam (rise up) and banah (build); but you have no chalaq (portion), nor tzadaqah (righteousness), nor zakarawan (memorial), in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."

Then Alayashayab (Eliashib) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) qawam (rise up) up with his ach (brother/kinsman) the kahanayam (priests), and they banah (build) the tzaan (sheep) shair (gate); they qadash (set apart / make holy) it, and imad (set) up its dalath (doors); even to the magadal (tower) of Hammeah they qadash (set apart / make holy) it, to the magadal (tower) of Chananaal (Hananel).
Next to him banah (build) the anashay (men) of Yarayachaw (Jericho). Next to them banah (build) Zakawar (Zaccur) the ban (son) of Amaray (Imri).
The banay (sons) of Sanaah (Hassenaah) banah (build) the dag (fish) shair (gate). They qarah (laid) its beams, and imad (set) up its dalath (doors), its bolts, and its barayach (bars).

Next to them, Maramawath (Meremoth) the ban (son) of Awarayah (Uriah), the ban (son) of Qawatz (Hakkoz) chazaq (made) repairs. Next to them, Mashalam (Meshullam) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah), the ban (son) of Mashayazabaal (Meshezabel) chazaq (made) repairs. Next to them, Tzadawaq (Zadok) the ban (son) of Bainaa (Baana) chazaq (made) repairs.
Next to them, the Thaqawaiy (Tekoites) chazaq (made) repairs; but their adayar (nobles) didn't bawaa (come) their tzawaar (necks) to the ibadah (work) of their Adawan.

Yawayadai (Joiada) the ban (son) of Pasach (Paseah) and Mashalam (Meshullam) the ban (son) of Basawadayah (Besodeiah) chazaq (repaired) the yashan (old) shair (gate). They qarah (laid) its beams, and imad (set) up its dalath (doors), and its bolts, and its barayach (bars).

Next to them, Malatayah (Melatiah) the Gabainay (Gibeonite), and Yadawan (Jadon) the maranathay (meronothite), the chazaq (men) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon), and of Matzapah (Mizpah), chazaq (repaired) the residence of the pachah (governor) ibar (beyond) the nahar (river).

Next to him, Izayaal (Uzziel) the ban (son) of Charahayah (Harhaiah), tzawarapayam (goldsmiths), chazaq (made) repairs. Next to him, Chananayah (Hananiah) ban (son) of the perfumers chazaq (made) repairs, and they izab (fortified) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) even to the rachab (broad) chawamah (wall).
Next to them, Rapayah (Rephaiah) the ban (son) of Chawar (Hur), the shar (prince / ruler) of chatzay (half) the district of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), chazaq (made) repairs.

Next to them, Yadayah (Jedaiah) the ban (son) of Charawamap (Harumaph) chazaq (made) repairs across from his bayath (house). Next to him, Chatawash (Hattush) the ban (son) of Chashabanayah (Hashabneiah) chazaq (made) repairs.

Malakayah (Malchijah) the ban (son) of Charam (Harim), and Chashawab (Hasshub) the ban (son) of Pachathamawaab (Pahathmoab), chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion, and the magadal (tower) of the thanawarayam (furnaces).

Next to him, Shalawam (Shallum) the ban (son) of Lawachash (Hallohesh), the shar (prince / ruler) of chatzay (half) the district of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), he and his banath (daughter), chazaq (made) repairs.

Chanawan (Hanun) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Zanawach (Zanoah) chazaq (repaired) the gayaa (valley) shair (gate). They banah (build) it, and imad (set) up its dalath (doors), its bolts, and its barayach (bars), and one alap (thousand) amah (cubits) of the chawamah (wall) to the ashapath (dung) shair (gate).

Malakayah (Malchijah) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), the shar (prince / ruler) of the district of Bayathahakaram (Beth Haccherem) chazaq (repaired) the ashapath (dung) shair (gate). He banah (build) it, and imad (set) up its dalath (doors), its bolts, and its barayach (bars).

Shalawan (Shallun) the ban (son) of Kalachazah (Colhozeh), the shar (prince / ruler) of the district of Matzapah (Mizpah) chazaq (repaired) the spring shair (gate). He banah (build) it, and talal (covered) it, and imad (set) up its dalath (doors), its bolts, and its barayach (bars), and the chawamah (wall) of the barakah (pool) of Shelah by the malak (king) gan (garden), even to the mailawath (stairs) that yarad (go) down from the iyar (city) of Dawad (David).

Achar (other) him, Nachamayah (Nehemiah) the ban (son) of Izabawaq (Azbuk), the shar (prince / ruler) of chatzay (half) the district of Bayathatzawar (Beth Zur), chazaq (made) repairs to the qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher) opposite the tombs of Dawad (David), and to the barakah (pool) that was ishah (make), and to the bayath (house) of the gabawar (mighty) men.

Achar (other) him, the Lawayay (Levites), Rachawam (Rehum) the ban (son) of Banay (Bani) chazaq (made) repairs. Next to him, Chashabayah (Hashabiah), the shar (prince / ruler) of chatzay (half) the district of Qaiyalah (Keilah), chazaq (made) repairs for his district.

Achar (other) him, their ach (brother/kinsman), Baway (Bavvai) the ban (son) of Chanadad (Henadad), the shar (prince / ruler) of chatzay (half) the district of Qaiyalah (Keilah) chazaq (made) repairs.

Next to him, Izar (Ezer) the ban (son) of Yashawai (Jeshua), the shar (prince / ruler) of Matzapah (Mizpah), chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion, across from the ascent to the armory at the maqatzawai (turning) of the wall.

Achar (other) him, Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Zabay (Zabbai) charah (hot with anger) chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion, from the maqatzawai (turning) of the wall to the pathach (door) of the bayath (house) of Alayashayab (Eliashib) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest).

Achar (other) him, Maramawath (Meremoth) the ban (son) of Awarayah (Uriah) the ban (son) of Qawatz (Hakkoz) chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion, from the pathach (door) of the bayath (house) of Alayashayab (Eliashib) even to the thakalayath (end) of the bayath (house) of Alayashayab (Eliashib).
Achar (other) him, the kahanayam (priests), the hachazayaqaw (men) of the kakar (plain) chazaq (made) repairs.

Achar (other) them, Banayamayan (Benjamin) and Chashawab (Hasshub) chazaq (made) repairs across from their bayath (house). Achar (other) them, Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah) the ban (son) of Inanayah (Ananiah) chazaq (made) repairs beside his own bayath (house).

Achar (other) him, Banaway (Binnui) the ban (son) of Chanadad (Henadad) chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion, from the bayath (house) of Izarayah (Azariah) to the maqatzawai (turning) of the wall, and to the panah (corner / cornerstone).

Palal (Palal) the ban (son) of Awazay (Uzai) made repairs opposite the maqatzawai (turning) of the wall, and the magadal (tower) that yatzaa (go out / come out) out from the ilayawan (Ilayawan) bayath (house) of the malak (king), which is by the chatzar (court) of the guard. Achar (other) him Padayah (Pedaiah) the ban (son) of Paraish (Parosh) made repairs.
(Now the nathayan (nethinim) lived in Ipal (Ophel), to the place over against the mayam (Waters) shair (gate) toward the mazarach (east), and the magadal (tower) that yatzaa (go out / come out) out.)

Achar (other) him the Thaqawaiy (Tekoites) chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion, over against the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) magadal (tower) that yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and to the chawamah (wall) of Ipal (Ophel).
Above the sawas (horse) shair (gate), the kahanayam (priests) chazaq (made) repairs, everyone across from his own bayath (house).

Achar (other) them, Tzadawaq (Zadok) the ban (son) of Amar (Immer) chazaq (made) repairs across from his own bayath (house). Achar (other) him, Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ban (son) of Shakanayah (Shecaniah), the keeper of the mazarach (east) shair (gate) chazaq (made) repairs.

Achar (other) him, Chananayah (Hananiah) the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), and Chanawan (Hanun) the shashay (sixth) ban (son) of Tzalap (Zalaph), chazaq (repaired) shanay (second) portion. Achar (other) him, Mashalam (Meshullam) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah) chazaq (made) repairs across from his room.

Achar (other) him, Malakayah (Malchijah) ban (son) of the tzarapay (goldsmiths) to the bayath (house) of the nathayan (nethinim), and of the rakalayam (merchants), chazaq (made) repairs over against the shair (gate) of Hammiphkad, and to the ilayah (ascent) of the panah (corner / cornerstone).
Between the ilayah (ascent) of the panah (corner / cornerstone) and the tzaan (sheep) shair (gate), the tzarapayam (goldsmiths) and the rakalayam (merchants) chazaq (made) repairs.

But it happened that when Sanabalat (Sanballat) shamai (hearken / hear) that we were building the chawamah (wall), he was charah (hot with anger), and ilah (go up / offer) great indignation, and mocked the Jews.

He spoke before his brothers and the army of Samaria, and said, "What are these feeble Jews ishah (make)? Will they fortify themselves? Will they ishah (make)? Will they ishah (make) in a day? Will they revive the stones out of the heaps of rubbish, since they are burned?"
Now Tobiah the Ammonite was by him, and he said, "What they are building, if a fox climbed up it, he would break down their stone wall."
"Hear, our Alahayam; for we are despised; and turn back their reproach on their own head, amar (spoke) them up for a spoil in a land of captivity;
Don't cover their iniquity, and don't let their sin be blotted out from laa (NOT) you; for they yadai (have) insulted the builders."
So we shawab (turn back / repent) the wall; and all the wall was joined together to half its height: for the people had a mind to work.

But it happened that when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the chawamah (walls) of Jerusalem went forward, and that the breaches began to be filled, then they were very angry;
And they conspired all of them together to zakar (remember) and lacham (fight) against Jerusalem, and to cause confusion therein.
But we shamai (hearken / hear) our prayer to our Alahayam, and shawab (turn back / repent) a watch against them hayah (came to pass) and night, ashar (who/that) of them.
Yahawadah (Judah) said, "The strength of the bearers of burdens is fading, and there is much rubbish; so that we are not able to build the wall."
Our adversaries said, "They shall not know, neither see, until we come into their midst, and kill them, and cause the malaakah (work) to cease."
It happened that when the Jews who lived by them came, they said to us ten il (over) from all places, "Wherever you turn, they will attack us."
Therefore set I in the lowest parts of the space behind the chawamah (wall), in the open places, I set the im (nation / people) after their families with their swords, their spears, and their bows.

I looked, and rose up, and said to the nobles, and to the rulers, and to the rest of the people, "Don't be afraid of them! Remember the Adanay, who is alahayam (God) and awesome, and lacham (fight) for your brothers, your sons, and your daughters, your wives, and your houses."
It happened, when our enemies heard that it was known to us, and Alahayam had ishah (make) their counsel to nothing, that we returned all of us to the wall, everyone to his malaakah (work).

It happened from that yawam (day) forth, that thawak (midst) of my nair (servants) malaakah (worked) in the malaakah (work), and thawak (midst) of them held the spears, the shields, and the bows, and the coats of mail; and the rulers were behind all the house of Judah.
They all built the wall and those who bore burdens loaded themselves; everyone with one of his hands worked in the work, and with the other held his shalach (weapon);
And the banah (build), everyone wore his charab (sword) at his mathan (side), and so banah (build). He who thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) was by me.

I amar (spoke) to the char (nobles), and to the sagan (rulers) and to the yathar (rest) of the im (nation / people), "The malaakah (work) is rabah (great) and large, and we are parad (separated) on the chawamah (wall), ayash (man / husband) rachawaq (far) from ach (brother/kinsman).
Wherever you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn), rally there to us. Our Alahayam will lacham (fight) for us."
So we ishah (make) in the malaakah (work): and chatzay (half) of them chazaq (held) the ramach (spears) from the ilah (go up / offer) of the shachar (morning) until the kawakab (star) appeared.

Likewise at the same ith (time) amar (spoke) I to the im (nation / people), "Let everyone with his nair (servant) lawan (lodge) thawak (midst) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that in the layal (night) they may be a mashamar (guard) to us, and may malaakah (labor) in the yawam (day)."

So neither I, nor my ach (brother/kinsman), nor my nair (servants), nor the anawash (men) of the mashamar (guard) who achar (other) me, none of us took off our clothes. Everyone took his shalach (weapon) to the mayam (Waters).
Then there arose a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tzaiqah (cry) of the im (nation / people) and of their wives against their ach (brother/kinsman) the Yahawaday (Jews).
For there were that amar (spoke), "We, our ban (son) and our banath (daughter), are many. Let us laqach (take / seize) grain, that we may akal (eat) and chayah (live)."

Some also there were that amar (spoke), "We are irab (evening) our shadah (fields), and our karam (vineyards), and our bayath (house). Let us laqach (take / seize) grain, because of the raib (famine)."
There were also some who amar (spoke), "We have lawah (borrowed) kasap (money) for the malak (king) madah (tribute) using our shadah (fields) and our karam (vineyards) as collateral.

Yet now our bashar (flesh) is as the bashar (flesh) of our ach (brother/kinsman), our ban (son) as their ban (son). Behold, we kabash (bring) into bondage our ban (son) and our banath (daughter) to be ibadayam (servants), and some of our banath (daughter) yash (have) been kabash (brought) into bondage. Neither is it in our al (Alahayam) to help it; for other acharayam (men) have our shadah (fields) and our karam (vineyards)."
I was very charah (hot with anger) when I shamai (hearken / hear) their zaiq (cry) and these dabarayam (words).

Then I malak (king) with myself, and rayab (contended) with the charayam (nobles) and the saganayam (rulers), and amar (spoke) to them, "You nashah (exact) mashaa (usury), everyone of his ach (brother/kinsman)." I held a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahalah (assembly) against them.

I amar (spoke) to them, "We, day (after) our ability, have qanah (redeemed) our ach (brother/kinsman) the Yahawaday (Jews) that were makar (sold) to the gawayam (nations); and would you even makar (sell) your ach (brother/kinsman), and should they be makar (sold) to us?" Then they held their charash (peace), and matzaa (found) never a dabar (word / matter).

Also I amar (spoke), "The thing that you ishah (make) is not tawab (good / proper function). Ought you not to yalak (walk) in the yaraah (fear) of our Alahayam, because of the charapah (reproach) of the gawayam (nations) our ayab (enemy)?
I likewise, my ach (brother/kinsman) and my nair (servants), nashah (lend) them kasap (money) and grain. Please let us stop this mashaa (usury).

Please shawab (turn back / repent) to them, even this yawam (day), their shadah (fields), their karam (vineyards), their zayath (olive) groves, and their bayath (house), also the hundredth part of the kasap (money), and of the grain, the new thayarawash (wine), and the yatzahar (fresh oil), that you are charging them."

Then they amar (spoke), "We will shawab (turn back / repent) them, and will baqash (require) nothing of them; so will we ishah (make), even as you amar (spoke)." Then I qaraa (called) the kahanayam (priests), and took an shabai (swear / take oath) of them, that they would ishah (make) according to this dabar (word / matter).

Also I nair (shook) out my chatzan (lap), and amar (spoke), "So may Alahayam nair (shake) out every ayash (man / husband) from his bayath (house), and from his yagayai (labor), that doesn't qawam (rise up) this dabar (word / matter); even thus be he nair (shaken) out, and rayaq (emptied)." All the qahal (assembly) amar (spoke), "aman (believe / have faith)," and halal (praise) Yahawah. The im (nation / people) ishah (make) according to this dabar (word / matter).

Moreover from the yawam (day) that I was tzawah (appointed) to be their pachah (governor) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), from the isharayam (twenty) shanah (year) even to the shanayam (two) and shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (year) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) the malak (king), that is, shanayam (two) shanayam (years), I and my ach (brother/kinsman) have not akal (eat) the lacham (bread) of the pachah (governor).

But the raashawan (former) pachawath (governors) who were panayam (face) me were supported by the im (nation / people), and laqach (take / seize) lacham (bread) and yayan (wine) from them, achar (other) arabaiyam (forty) shaqalayam (shekels) of kasap (silver); yes, even their nair (servants) shalat (ruled) over the im (nation / people): but I didn't do so, panayam (face) of the yaraah (fear) of Alahayam.
Yes, also I chazaq (continued) in the malaakah (work) of this chawamah (wall), neither bought we any shadah (land): and all my nair (servants) were qabatz (gathered) there to the malaakah (work).

Moreover there were at my shalachan (table), of the Yahawaday (Jews) and the saganayam (rulers), one maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) men, besides those who bawaa (come) to us from among the gawayam (nations) that were around us.

Now that which was ishah (make) for one yawam (day) was achad (one) shawar (ox) and shash (six) barar (choice) tzaan (sheep); also tzaparayam (fowls) were ishah (make) for me, and once in ishar (ten) yamayam (days) rabah (store) of all sorts of yayan (wine): yet for im (with) this I didn't demand the lacham (bread) of the pachah (governor), because the ibadah (bondage) was kabad (heavy) on this im (nation / people).
Zakar (remember) to me, my Alahayam, for tawab (good / proper function), all that I ishah (make) done for this im (nation / people).

Now it happened, when it was shamai (hearken / hear) to Sanabalat (Sanballat) and Tawabayah (Tobiah), and to Gasham (Geshem) the Irabay (Arabian), and to the yathar (rest) of our ayab (enemy), that I had banah (build) the chawamah (wall), and that there was no paratz (breach) yathar (left) therein; (gam (indeed / moreover) even to that ith (time) I had not imad (set) up the dalathawath (doors) in the shairayam (gates);)

That Sanabalat (Sanballat) and Gasham (Geshem) shalach (send) to me, amar (spoke), "yalak (come), let us yaid (meet) yachad (together) in the kapayarayam (villages) in the baqaih (plain) of Awanaw (Ono)." But they intended to rai (harm) me.

I shalach (send) malaakayam (messengers) to them, amar (spoke), "I am ishah (make) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malaakah (work), so that I can't yarad (come) down. Why should the malaakah (work) shabath (shabath / rest), while I rapah (leave) it, and yarad (come) down to you?"
They shalach (send) to me arabai (four) paimayam (times) after this sort; and I shawab (turn back / repent) them the same dabar (word / matter).
Then Sanabalat (Sanballat) shalach (send) his nair (servant) to me the same dabar (word / matter) the chamayashay (fifth) paim (time) with an pathach (open) agarath (letter) in his yad (hand),

In which was kathab (write), "It is shamai (hearken / hear) among the gawayam (nations), and Gasham (Gashmu) amar (spoke) it, that you and the Yahawaday (Jews) intend to marad (rebel). Because of that, you are banah (build) the chawamah (wall). You would be their malak (king), according to these dabarayam (words).

You have also imad (appointed) nabayaayam (prophets) to qaraa (called) of you at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), ‘There is a malak (king) in Yahawadah (Judah)!' Now it will be shamai (hearken / hear) to the malak (king) according to these dabarayam (words). Yalak (come) now therefore, and let us take yaitz (counsel) yachad (together)."
Then I shalach (send) to him, amar (spoke), "There are no such things hayah (came to pass) as you amar (spoke), but you imagine them out of your own lab (heart)."

For they all would have made us yaraa (fear / be afraid), amar (spoke), "Their yad (hand) will be rapah (weakened) from the malaakah (work), that it not be ishah (make). But now, chazaq (strengthen) my yad (hand)."

I bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ban (son) of Dalayah (Delaiah) the ban (son) of Mahayatabaal (Mehetabel), who was itzar (shut) in at his home; and he amar (spoke), "Let us yaid (meet) together in the bayath (house) of Alahayam, thawak (midst) the hayakal (temple), and let us sagar (shut) the dalathawath (doors) of the hayakal (temple); for they will bawaa (come) to harag (kill) you; yes, in the layal (night) will they bawaa (come) to harag (kill) you."

I amar (spoke), "Should such a ayash (man / husband) as I barach (flee)? Who is there that, being such as I, would bawaa (come) into the hayakal (temple) to chayay (life) his life? I will not bawaa (come) in."

I nakar (discerned), and behold, Alahayam had not shalach (send) him; but he dabar (word / matter) this nabawaah (prophecy) against me. Tawabayah (Tobiah) and Sanabalat (Sanballat) had shakar (hired) him.

He shakar (hired) so that I would be yaraa (fear / be afraid), ishah (make) so, and chataa (sin), and that they might have material for an rai (evil) sham (name), that they might charap (reproach) me.

"Zakar (remember), my Alahayam, Tawabayah (Tobiah) and Sanabalat (Sanballat) according to these their maishah (works), and also the nabayaah (prophetess) Nawaidayah (Noadiah), and the yathar (rest) of the nabayaayam (prophets), that would have put me in yaraa (fear / be afraid)."
So the chawamah (wall) was shalam (finished) in the isharayam (twenty) - chamash (fifth) day of Alawal (Elul), in chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two) yawam (day).

It happened, when all our ayab (enemy) shamai (hearken / hear) of it, that all the gawayam (nations) that were sabayab (surrounding) us were afraid, and were much napal (fall / be cast down) down in their own iyan (eye); for they yadai (perceived) that this malaakah (work) was malaakah (worked) of our Alahayam.
Moreover in those yamayam (days) the charay (nobles) of Yahawadah (Judah) halak (move) many agarath (letters) to Tawabayah (Tobiah), and Tawabayah (Tobiah's) letters bawaa (come) to them.

For there were many in Yahawadah (Judah) bail (sworn) to him, because he was the son-in-law of Shakanayah (Shecaniah) the ban (son) of Arach (Arah); and his ban (son) Yahawachanan (Jehohanan) had laqach (take / seize) the banath (daughter) of Mashalam (Meshullam) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah) as wife.

Also they amar (spoke) of his tawab (good / proper function) deeds panayam (face) me, and reported my dabar (word / matter) to him. Tawabayah (Tobiah) shalach (send) agarawath (letters) to put me in yaraa (fear / be afraid).

Now it happened, when the chawamah (wall) was banah (build), and I had imad (set) up the dalathawath (doors), and the shawairayam (porters) and the singers and the Lawayay (Levites) were paqad (visit),

That I put my ach (brother/kinsman) Chananay (Hanani), and Chananayah (Hananiah) the shar (prince / ruler) of the castle, in tzawah (charge) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for he was a amath (truth) ayash (man / husband), and yaraa (fear / be afraid) Alahayam above many.

I amar (spoke) to them, "Don't let the shairay (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) be pathach (opened) until the shamash (sun) is cham (hot); and while they imad (stand) guard, let them gawap (shut) the dalathawath (doors), and you achaz (bar) them: and imad (appoint) watches of the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), everyone in his mashamar (watch), with everyone near his bayath (house)."
Now the iyar (city) was rachab (wide) and rachab (large); but the im (nation / people) were mait (few) therein, and the bathayam (houses) were not banah (build).

My Alahayam nathan (give) into my lab (heart) to qabatz (gather) together the charayam (nobles), and the saganayam (rulers), and the im (nation / people), that they might be yachash (reckoned) by genealogy. I matzaa (found) the sapar (book / scribed document) of the yachash (genealogy) of those who ilah (go up / offer) up at the raashawan (first), and I matzaa (found) kathab (write) therein:

These are the banay (children) of the madayanah (province), who ilah (go up / offer) up out of the shabay (captivity) of those who had been carried away, whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had galah (carried) away, and who shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and to Yahawadah (Judah), everyone to his iyar (city);

Who bawaa (come) with Zarababal (Zerubbabel), Yashawai (Jeshua), Nachamayah (Nehemiah), Izarayah (Azariah), Raimayah (Raamiah), Nachamanay (Nahamani), Maradakay (Mordecai), Balashan (Bilshan), Masaparath (Mispereth), Bagaway (Bigvai), Nachawam (Nehum), Bainah (Baanah). The masapar (number) of the anashay (men) of the anashay (people) of Yashar-Al (Israel):
The banay (children) of Paraish (Parosh), shanayam (two) alap (thousand) one maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Arach (Arah), shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Pachathamawaab (Pahathmoab), of the banay (children) of Yashawai (Jeshua) and Yawaab (Joab), two alap (thousand) shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) eighteen.
The banay (children) of Iyalam (Elam), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The banay (children) of Zathawaa (Zattu), shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Zakay (Zaccai), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty).
The banay (children) of Banaway (Binnui), shash (six) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shamanah (eight).
The banay (children) of Babay (Bebai), shash (six) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).
The banay (children) of Izagad (Azgad), shanayam (two) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Adanayaqam (Adonikam), shash (six) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - shabai (seven).
The banay (children) of Bagaway (Bigvai), two alap (thousand) shashayam (sixty) - shabai (seven).
The banay (children) of Idayan (Adin), shash (six) maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Atar (Ater), of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), thashaiyam (ninety) - shamanah (eight).
The banay (children) of Chasham (Hashum), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).
The banay (children) of Batzay (Bezai), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four).
The banay (children) of Charayap (Hariph), one maah (hundred) shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon), thashaiyam (ninety) - chamash (five).
The anashay (men) of Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem) and Natapah (Netophah), one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - shamanah (eight).
The anashay (men) of Inathawath (Anathoth), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).
The anashay (men) of Beth Azmaveth, arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two).
The anashay (men) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim), Kapayarah (Chephirah), and Baarawath (Beeroth), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shalawash (three).
The anashay (men) of Ramah (Ramah) and Gabai (Geba), shash (six) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - achad (one).
The anashay (men) of Makamas (Michmas), one maah (hundred) and isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two).
The anashay (men) of Bayath-Al (Bethel) and Iy (Ai), a maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shalawash (three).
The anashay (men) of the other Nabaw (Nebo), chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of the other Iyalam (Elam), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) chamashayam (fifty) - arabai (four).
The banay (children) of Charam (Harim), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty).
The banay (children) of Yarayachaw (Jericho), shalawash (three) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five).
The banay (children) of Lad (Lod), Chadayad (Hadid), and Awanaw (Ono), shabai (seven) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - achad (one).
The banay (children) of Sanaah (Senaah), shalawash (three) alap (thousand) thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty).
The kahanayam (priests): The banay (children) of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), of the bayath (house) of Yashawai (Jeshua), thashai (nine) maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shalawash (three).
The banay (children) of Amar (Immer), one alap (thousand) chamashayam (fifty) - shanayam (two).
The banay (children) of Pashachawar (Pashhur), one alap (thousand) two maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shabai (seven).
The banay (children) of Charam (Harim), one alap (thousand) seventeen.
The Lawayay (Levites): the banay (children) of Yashawai (Jeshua), of Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), of the banay (children) of Hawadawah (Hodevah), shabaiyam (seventy) - arabai (four).
The singers: the banay (children) of Asap (Asaph), one maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shamanah (eight).

The shairayam (porters): the banay (children) of Shalawam (Shallum), the banay (children) of Atar (Ater), the banay (children) of Talamawan (Talmon), the banay (children) of Iqawab (Akkub), the banay (children) of Chatayataa (Hatita), the banay (children) of Shabay (Shobai), one maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shamanah (eight).
The nathayan (nethinim): the banay (children) of Tzayachaa (Ziha), the banay (children) of Chashawapaa (Hasupha), the banay (children) of Tabaiwath (Tabbaoth),
The banay (children) of Qayaras (Keros), the banay (children) of Sayaia (Sia), the banay (children) of Padawan (Padon),
The banay (children) of Labanaa (Lebana), the banay (children) of Chagabaa (Hagaba), the banay (children) of Shalamay (Salmai),
The banay (children) of Chanan (Hanan), the banay (children) of Gadal (Giddel), the banay (children) of Gachar (Gahar),
The banay (children) of Raayah (Reaiah), the banay (children) of Ratzayan (Rezin), the banay (children) of Naqawadaa (Nekoda),
The banay (children) of Gazam (Gazzam), the banay (children) of Izaa (Uzza), the banay (children) of Pasach (Paseah).
The banay (children) of Basay (Besai), the banay (children) of maiwanay (meunim), the banay (children) of Nephushesim,
The banay (children) of Baqabawaq (Bakbuk), the banay (children) of Chaqawapaa (Hakupha), the banay (children) of Charachawar (Harhur),
The banay (children) of Batzalawath (Bazlith), the banay (children) of Machayadaa (Mehida), the banay (children) of Charashaa (Harsha),
The banay (children) of Baraqawas (Barkos), the banay (children) of Sayasaraa (Sisera), the banay (children) of Thamach (Temah),
The banay (children) of Natzayach (Neziah), the banay (children) of Chatayapaa (Hatipha).
The banay (children) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibaday (servants): the banay (children) of Sawatay (Sotai), the banay (children) of Saparath (Sophereth), the banay (children) of Parawadaa (Perida),
The banay (children) of Yailaa (Jaala), the banay (children) of Daraqawan (Darkon), the banay (children) of Gadal (Giddel),
The banay (children) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), the banay (children) of Chatayal (Hattil), the banay (children) of Pakarathatzabayayam (Pochereth Hazzebaim), the banay (children) of Amawan (Amon).
All the nathayan (nethinim), and the banay (children) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibaday (servants), were shalawash (three) maah (hundred) thashaiyam (ninety) - shanayam (two).

These were those who ilah (go up / offer) up from Thalamalach (Tel Melah), Thalacharashaa (Tel Harsha), karawab (cherub), Adawan (Addon), and Amar (Immer); but they yakal (could) not show their ab (father)' bayath (house), nor their zarai (seed), whether they were of Yashar-Al (Israel):
The banay (children) of Dalayah (Delaiah), the banay (children) of Tawabayah (Tobiah), the banay (children) of Naqawadaa (Nekoda), shash (six) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two).

Of the kahanayam (priests): the banay (children) of Chabayah (Hobaiah), the banay (children) of Qawatz (Hakkoz), the banay (children) of Barazalay (Barzillai), who laqach (take / seize) a ayashah (woman / wife) of the banawath (daughters) of Barazalay (Barzillai) the Galaiday (Gileadite), and was qaraa (called) after their sham (name).
These searched for their geneological records, but couldn't matzaa (find) them. Therefore were they deemed gaal (polluted) and put from the kahanah (priesthood).

The governor amar (spoke) to them, that they should not akal (eat) of the most qadash (set apart / make holy) things, until there imad (stood) up a kahan (priest) with awarayam (urim) and thamayam (complete / whole).
The whole qahal (assembly) achad (one) was arabai (four) - two alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty),

Besides their male amah (servants) and their female amah (servants), of whom there were shabai (seven) alap (thousand) shalawash (three) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shabai (seven): and they had two maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - chamash (five) shayar (singing) men and shayar (singing) women.
Their horses were shabai (seven) maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - shash (six); their mules, two maah (hundred) forty - chamash (five);
Their camels, four maah (hundred) shalawashayam (thirty) - chamash (five); their donkeys, six alap (thousand) seven maah (hundred) twenty.

Some from among the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households nathan (give) to the malaakah (work). The governor nathan (give) to the awatzar (treasury) one alap (thousand) darics of zahab (gold), fifty basins, and five maah (hundred) thirty priests' garments.

Some of the heads of fathers' households nathan (give) into the treasury of the work shanayam (two) rabaw (thousand) darics of zahab (gold), and two rabaw (thousand) two hundred minas of kasap (silver).
That which the rest of the im (nation / people) gave was twenty thousand darics of gold, and two thousand minas of silver, and sixty - seven kahanayam (priests)' garments.

So the kahan (priest), and the Lawayay (Levites), and the shawair (porters), and the singers, and some of the im (nation / people), and the nathayan (nethinim), and all Yashar-Al (Israel), lived in their iyar (cities). When the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month) had nagai (come), the ban (son) of Yashar-Al (Israel) were in their iyar (cities).

All the im (nation / people) asap (gathered) themselves together as achad (one) ayash (man / husband) into the rachab (broad) place that panayam (face) before the mayam (Waters) shair (gate); and they amar (spoke) to Izaraa (Ezra) the sapar (book) to bawaa (come) the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Mashah (Moses), which Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) to Yashar-Al (Israel).

Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest) bawaa (come) the thawarah (instruction) panayam (face) the qahal (assembly), both ayash (man / husband) and ayashah (woman / wife), and all who could shamai (hearken / hear) with bayan (between), on the achad (one) yawam (day) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).

He qaraa (called) therein panayam (face) the rachab (broad) place that panayam (face) before the mayam (Waters) shair (gate) from early awar (light) until machatzayath (midday), in the presence of the anashayam (men) and the nashayam (women), and of those who could bayan (between); and the azanay (ears) of all the im (nation / people) were attentive to the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction).

Izaraa (Ezra) the sapar (book) imad (stood) on a pulpit of itz (wood), which they ishah (make) made for the dabar (word / matter); and beside him imad (stood) Mathathayah (Mattithiah), and Shamai (Shema), and Inayah (Anaiah), and Awarayah (Uriah), and Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), and Maishayah (Maaseiah), on his right yamayan (right hand); and on his left yamayan (right hand), Padayah (Pedaiah), and Mayashaal (Mishael), and Malakayah (Malchijah), and Chasham (Hashum), and Chashabadanah (Hashbaddanah), Zakarayah (Zechariah), and Mashalam (Meshullam).

Izaraa (Ezra) pathach (opened) the sapar (book / scribed document) in the iyan (eye) of all the im (nation / people); (for he was above all the im (nation / people);) and when he pathach (opened) it, all the im (nation / people) imad (stood) up:

And Izaraa (Ezra) barak (blessed) Yahawah, the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) Alahayam. All the im (nation / people) inah (answer / respond), "aman (believe / have faith), aman (believe / have faith)," with the mail (top/above) up of their yad (hand). They qadad (bowed) their heads, and shachah (worshiped) Yahawah with their apayam (faces) to the aratz (Earth/land).

Also Yashawai (Jeshua), and Banay (Bani), and Sharabayah (Sherebiah), Yamayan (Jamin), Iqawab (Akkub), Shabathay (Shabbethai), Hawadayah (Hodiah), Maishayah (Maaseiah), Qalayataa (Kelita), Izarayah (Azariah), Yawazabad (Jozabad), Chanan (Hanan), Palayah (Pelaiah), and the Lawayay (Levites), caused the im (nation / people) to bayan (between) the thawarah (instruction): and the im (nation / people) stayed in their imad (place).

They qaraa (called) in the sapar (book / scribed document), in the thawarah (instruction) of Alahayam, parash (distinctly); and they shawam (place / establish / appoint) the shakal (sense), so that they bayan (between) the maqaraa (reading).

Nachamayah (Nehemiah), who was the governor, and Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest) the sapar (book), and the Lawayay (Levites) who bayan (between) the im (nation / people), amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people), "This yawam (day) is qadawash (holy) to Yahawah your Alahayam. Don't abal (mourn), nor bakah (weep)." For all the im (nation / people) bakah (wept), when they shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of the thawarah (instruction).

Then he amar (spoke) to them, "Go your yalak (way). Akal (eat) the mashaman (fat), shathah (drinks) the mamathaq (sweet), and shalach (send) manawath (portions) to him for whom nothing is kawan (prepared); for this yawam (day) is qadawash (holy) to our Adawan. Don't be itzab (grieved); for the chadawah (joy) of Yahawah is your maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection)."
So the Lawayay (Levites) chashah (stilled) all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "Hold your hasah (peace), for the yawam (day) is qadawash (holy); neither be itzab (grieved)."

All the im (nation / people) went their yalak (way) to akal (eat), and to shathah (drinks), and to shalach (send) manawath (portions), and to ishah (make) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (mirth), because they bayan (between) understood the dabarayam (words) that were yadai (declared) to them.

On the shanay (second) yawam (day) were asap (gathered) together the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households of all the im (nation / people), the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), to Izaraa (Ezra) the sapar (book), even to give attention to the dabaray (words) of the thawarah (instruction).

They matzaa (found) kathab (write) in the thawarah (instruction), how that Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) by Mashah (Moses), that the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) should yashab (inhabit/dwell) in sakawath (booths) in the chag (feast/festival) of the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month);

And that they should shamai (hearken / hear) and ibar (pass over/through) in all their iyar (cities), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), "yatzaa (go out / come out) out to the har (mountain), and bawaa (come) zayath (olive) branches, and branches of wild shaman (olive), and hadas (myrtle) branches, and thamar (palm) branches, and branches of ibath (thick) itz (trees), to ishah (make) sakath (booths), as it is kathab (write)."

So the im (nation / people) yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and bawaa (come) them, and ishah (make) themselves sakawath (booths), everyone on the gag (roof) of his house, and in their chatzarawath (courts), and in the chatzarawath (courts) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and in the rachab (broad) place of the mayam (Waters) shair (gate), and in the rachab (broad) place of the shair (gate) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

All the qahal (assembly) of those who had shawab (turn back / repent) again out of the shabay (captivity) ishah (make) sakawath (booths), and lived in the sakawath (booths); for since the yamay (days) of Yashawai (Jeshua) the ban (son) of Nawan (Nun) to that yawam (day) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) not done so. There was very gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (gladness).

Also yawam (day) by yawam (day), from the raashawan (first) yawam (day) to the acharawan (last) yawam (day), he qaraa (called) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Alahayam. They ishah (make) the chag (feast/festival) shabai (seven) yamayam (days); and on the shamayanay (eighth) yawam (day) was a solemn itzarah (assembly), according to the mashapat (ordinance).

Now in the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of this chadash (month) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) were asap (assembled) with tzawam (fasting), and with sackcloth, and adamah (earth) on them.

The zarai (seed) of Yashar-Al (Israel) badal (separated) themselves from all foreigners, and imad (stood) and yadah (confessed) their chataah (sin), and the iwanawath (iniquities) of their ab (father).

They qawam (rise up) up in their imad (place), and qaraa (called) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah their Alahayam a rabayaiy (fourth) part of the yawam (day); and a rabayaiy (fourth) part they yadah (confessed), and shachah (worshiped) Yahawah their Alahayam.

Then Yashawai (Jeshua), and Banay (Bani), Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), Shabanayah (Shebaniah), Banay (Bunni), Sharabayah (Sherebiah), Banay (Bani), and Kananay (Chenani) of the Lawayay (Levites) qawam (rise up) up on the mailah (stairs), and zaiq (cried) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice) to Yahawah their Alahayam.

Then the Lawayay (Levites), Yashawai (Jeshua), and Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), Banay (Bani), Chashabanayah (Hashabneiah), Sharabayah (Sherebiah), Hawadayah (Hodiah), Shabanayah (Shebaniah), and Pathachayah (Pethahiah), amar (spoke), "qawam (rise up) up and barak (blessed) Yahawah your Alahayam from iwalam (forever) to iwalam (forever)! Bessed be your kabawad (glorious) sham (name), which is rawam (will lift up) above all barakah (blessing) and thahalah (praise)!

You are Yahawah, even you alone. You ishah (make) made shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) of shamay (heavens), with all their tzabaa (troop), the aratz (Earth/land) and all things that are on it, the yamayam (seas) and all that is in them, and you chayah (preserve) them all. The tzabaa (troop) of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mashathachawayam (worships) you.

You are Yahawah, the Alahayam who bachar (chose) Abaram (Abram), and yatzaa (go out / come out) him out of Awar (Ur) of the Kashaday (Chaldees), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) him the sham (name) of Abaraham (Abraham),

And matzaa (found) his labab (heart) aman (believe / have faith) panayam (face) you, and karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with him to nathan (give) the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kanainay (Canaanite), the Chathay (Hittite), the Amaray (Amorite), and the Parazay (Perizzite), and the Yabawasay (Jebusite), and the Garagashay (Girgashite), to nathan (give) it to his zarai (seed), and have qawam (rise up) your dabar (word / matter); for you are tzadayaq (righteous).
"You raah (see) the inay (affliction) of our ab (father) in Matzarayam (Egypt), and shamai (hearken / hear) their zaiq (cry) by the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters),

And showed athath (signs) and mapathayam (wonders) against Paraih (Pharaoh), and against all his ibad (servant), and against all the im (nation / people) of his aratz (Earth/land); for you yadai (knew) that they dealt zawad (proudly) against them, and ishah (make) a sham (name) for yourself, as it is this yawam (day).

You baqai (divided) the yam (sea/waters) panayam (face) them, so that they ibar (pass over/through) through the thawak (midst) of the yam (sea/waters) on the dry yabashah (dry land); and you shalak (cast) their radap (pursuers) into the matzawalath (depths), as a aban (stone) into the iz (mighty) mayam (Waters).

Moreover, in a imawad (pillar) of inan (cloud) you nachah (led) them by yawamam (by day); and in a imawad (pillar) of ash (fire) by layal (night), to give them awar (light) in the darak (way) in which they should yalak (go).

"You yarad (came) down also on har (mountain) Sayanay (Sinai), and dabar (word / matter) with them from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and nathan (give) them yashar (upright) mashapatayam (ordinances) and amath (truth) thawarawath (laws), tawab (good / proper function) chaqayam (statutes) and matzawath (commandments),
