And yadai (made) known to them your qadash (set apart / make holy) shabath (shabath / rest), and tzawah (commanded) them matzawawath (commandments), and chaqayam (statutes), and a thawarah (instruction), by Mashah (Moses) your ibad (servant),

And nathan (give) them lacham (bread) from the sky for their raib (hunger), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth mayam (Waters) for them out of the salai (rock) for their tzamaa (thirst), and commanded them that they should bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land) which you had yad (hand) to nathan (give) them.
"But they and our ab (father) dealt zawad (proudly) and hardened their irap (neck), didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to your matzawah (commandments),

And maan (refused) to shamai (hearken / hear), neither were they zakar (remember) of your palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) that you ishah (make) among them, but hardened their irap (neck), and in their rebellion nathan (give) a raash (head) to shawab (turn back / repent) to their ibadawath (bondage). But you are a Alawah ready to salayachah (pardon), chanawan (gracious) and rachawam (merciful), arak (slow) to ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and abundant in loving chasad (grace), and didn't izab (forsake) them.

Yes, when they ishah (make) made them a masakah (molten) igal (calf), and amar (spoke), ‘This is your Alahayam who ilah (go up / offer) you up out of Matzarayam (Egypt),' and ishah (make) committed awful naatzawath (blasphemies);

Yet you in your manifold racham (show mercy / love) didn't izab (forsake) them in the madabar (wilderness): the imawad (pillar) of inan (cloud) didn't sawar (depart) from over them by yawamam (by day), to nachah (lead) them in the darak (way); neither the imawad (pillar) of ash (fire) by layal (night), to show them awar (light), and the darak (way) in which they should yalak (go).

You nathan (give) also your tawab (good / proper function) rawach (spirit / wind) to shakal (instruct) them, and didn't manai (withhold) your man (from) from their pah (mouth), and nathan (give) them mayam (Waters) for their tzamaa (thirst).

"Yes, arabaiyam (forty) shanah (years) you kawal (all) them in the madabar (wilderness). They chasar (lacked) nothing. Their shalamah (dress / garment) didn't grow balah (old), and their ragal (feet / foot) didn't batzaq (swell).

Moreover you nathan (give) them mamalakawath (kingdoms) and imamayam (peoples), which you allotted according to their portions. So they yarash (possessed) the aratz (Earth/land) of Sayachawan (Sihon), even the aratz (Earth/land) of the malak (king) of Chashabawan (Heshbon), and the aratz (Earth/land) of Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan).

You also rabah (multiplied) their ban (son) as the kakabay (stars) of the sky, and bawaa (come) them into the aratz (Earth/land) concerning which you amar (spoke) to their ab (father), that they should bawaa (come) in to yarash (possess) it.

"So the banayam (children) bawaa (come) in and yarash (possessed) the aratz (Earth/land), and you kanai (subdued) panayam (face) them the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land), the Kanainay (Canaanites), and nathan (give) them into their yad (hand), with their malak (king), and the imamay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land), that they might ishah (make) with them as they pleased.

They lakad (took) batzar (fortified) irayam (cities), and a rich adamah (land), and yarash (possessed) bathayam (houses) malaa (full) of all tawab (good / proper function) things, barawath (cisterns) chatzab (dug) out, karamayam (vineyards), and zayath (olive) groves, and maakal (fruit) itz (trees) in rab (abundance). So they akal (eat), were shabai (filled), shaman (became) fat, and idan (Idan / Eden) themselves in your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) goodness.

"Nevertheless they were marah (disobedient), and marad (rebelled) against you, and shalak (cast) your thawarah (instruction) achar (other) their gaw (back), and harag (kill) your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) that iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them to shawab (turn back / repent) them again to you, and they ishah (make) awful naatzawath (blasphemies).

Therefore you nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their tzar (oppressor / distressor), who tzar (oppressor / distressor) them. In the ith (time) of their tzarah (trouble), when they tzaiq (cried) to you, you shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens); and according to your manifold racham (show mercy / love) you nathan (give) them saviors who yashai (salvation) them out of the yad (hand) of their tzar (oppressor / distressor).

But after they had nawach (rest), they ishah (make) rai (evil) again panayam (face) you; therefore izab (left) you them in the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy), so that they radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) the dominion over them; yet when they shawab (turn back / repent), and zaiq (cried) to you, you shamai (hearken / hear) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens); and many ithayam (times) you natzal (delivered) them according to your racham (show mercy / love),

And iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them, that you might shawab (turn back / repent) them again to your thawarah (instruction). Yet they dealt zawad (proudly), and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to your matzawah (commandments), but chataa (sinned) against your mashapat (ordinances), (which if a adam (man) ishah (make), he shall chayah (live) in them), nathan (give) their backs, stiffened their irap (neck), and would not shamai (hearken / hear).

Yet many shanayam (years) you put up with them, and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them by your rawach (spirit / wind) yad (hand) your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy). Yet nathan (give) they not give azan (ear). Therefore you nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of the imay (peoples) of the aratzath (lands).

"Nevertheless in your manifold racham (show mercy / love) you ishah (make) not make a kalah (complete / finish) end of them, nor izab (forsake) them; for you are a chanawan (gracious) and rachawam (merciful) Al.

Now therefore, our Alahayam, the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), the gabawar (mighty), and the awesome Al, who shamar (keep/guard) barayath (covenant) and loving chasad (grace), don't let all the thalaah (travail) seem mait (little) panayam (face) you, that matzaa (has) come on us, on our malakay (kings), on our shar (prince / ruler), and on our kahan (priest), and on our nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and on our ab (father), and on all your im (nation / people), yawam (day) the time of the malakay (kings) of Ashawar (Assyria) to this yawam (day).
However you are tzadayaq (righteous) in all that bawaa (come) come on us; for you ishah (make) dealt truly, but we ishah (make) done wickedly;

Neither have our malak (king), our shar (prince / ruler), our kahan (priest), nor our ab (father), ishah (make) your thawarah (instruction), nor listened to your matzawah (commandments) and your idawath (testimonies) with which you iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them.

For they have not ibad (servant) you in their malakawath (kingdom), and in your rab (great) goodness that you nathan (give) them, and in the rachab (large) and rich aratz (Earth/land) which you nathan (give) panayam (face) them, neither did they shawab (turn back / repent) from their rai (wicked) mailal (works).

"Behold, we are ibadayam (servants) this yawam (day), and as for the aratz (Earth/land) that you nathan (give) to our ab (father) to akal (eat) its paray (fruit) and its tawab (good / proper function), behold, we are ibadayam (servants) in it.

It rabah (yields) much thabawaah (increase) to the malakayam (kings) whom you nathan (give) set over us because of our chataah (sin): also they have mashal (rule/have dominion) over our gawayah (corpse), and over our livestock, at their ratzawan (pleasure), and we are in gadawal (very great/important/mighty) tzarah (distress).
Yet for all this, we karath (cut) a amanah (sure) covenant, and kathab (write) it; and our shar (prince / ruler), our Lawayay (Levites), and our kahan (priest), chatham (seal) it."
Now those who chatham (sealed) were: Nehemiah the governor, the son of Hacaliah, and Zedekiah,
Seraiah, Azariah, Jeremiah,
Pashhur, Amariah, Malchijah,
Hattush, Shebaniah, Malluch,
Harim, Meremoth, Obadiah,
Daniel, Ginnethon, Baruch,
Meshullam, Abijah, Mijamin,
Maaziah, Bilgai, Shemaiah; these were the priests.
The Levites: namely, Jeshua the son of Azaniah, Binnui of the sons of Henadad, Kadmiel;
And their brothers, Shebaniah, Hodiah, Kelita, Pelaiah, Hanan,
Mica, Rehob, Hashabiah,
Zaccur, Sherebiah, Shebaniah,
Hodiah, Bani, Beninu.
The chiefs of the people: Parosh, Pahathmoab, Elam, Zattu, Banay (Bani),
Bunni, Azgad, Bebai,
Adonijah, Bigvai, Adin,
Ater, Hezekiah, Azzur,
Hodiah, Hashum, Bezai,
Hariph, Anathoth, Nobai,
Magpiash, Meshullam, Hezir,
Meshezabel, Zadok, Jaddua,
Pelatiah, Hanan, Anaiah,
Hoshea, Hananiah, Hasshub,
Hallohesh, Pilha, Shobek,
Rehum, Hashabnah, Maaseiah,
And Ahiah, Hanan, Anan,
Malluch, Harim, Baanah.

The rest of the people, the priests, the Levites, the porters, the singers, the Nethinim, and all those who had separated themselves from the peoples of the lands to the law of Alahayam, their wives, their sons, and their daughters, everyone who had knowledge, and understanding—

They joined with their brothers, their nobles, and entered into a curse, and into an oath, to walk in Alahayam thawarah (instruction), which was yadai (given) by Moses the ban (son) of Alahayam, and to observe and do all the commandments of Yahawah our Adawan, and his ordinances and his statutes;
And that we nathan (give) not give our daughters to the peoples of the land, nor chazaq (take) their daughters for our sons;

And if the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) nathan (give) wares or any grain on the Sabbath day to sell, that we would not laqach (take / seize) of them on the Sabbath, or on a holy day; and that we would forego the seventh year, and the exaction of every debt.
Also we made yad (hand) for ourselves, to yad (hand) ourselves yearly with the third part of a shekel for the yad (hand) of the house of our Alahayam;

For the show bread, and for the continual meal nathan (give), and for the continual burnt nathan (give), for the Sabbaths, for the new moons, for the imad (set) feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offerings to make atonement for Israel, and for all the ibadah (work) of the bayath (house) of our Alahayam.

We cast lots, the priests, the Levites, and the people, for the wood manachah (offering), to bring it into the bayath (house) of our Alahayam, according to our fathers' bayath (house), at mawaidayam (times) mawaid (Feast/Holy Day), year by year, to burn on the altar of Yahawah our Alahayam, as it is written in the law;
And to bawaa (come) the first fruits of our ground, and the first fruits of all fruit of all kinds of itzayam (trees), shanah (year) by shanah (year), to the bayath (house) of Yahawah;

Also the firstborn of our sons, and of our livestock, as it is written in the law, and the firstborn of our herds and of our flocks, to bawaa (come) to the bayath (house) of our Alahayam, to the priests who minister in the bayath (house) of our Alahayam;

And that we should bawaa (come) the ban (son) fruits of our dough, and our wave offerings, and the fruit of all kinds of trees, the new wine and the oil, to the kahanayam (priests), to the rooms of the bayath (house) of our Alahayam; and the tithes of our ground to the Ban (Levites); for they, the Ban (Levites), bawaa (come) the tithes in all the cities of our tillage.

The kahan (priest) the son of Aaron shall be with the Lawayay (Levites), when the Lawayay (Levites) ishar (take) tithes: and the Lawayay (Levites) shall bawaa (come) up the maishar (tithe) of the maishar (tithes) to the bayath (house) of our Alahayam, to the rooms, into the treasure bayath (house).

For the ban (son) of Israel and the ban (son) of Levi shall ilah (go up / offer) the wave ilah (go up / offer) of the grain, of the new wine, and of the oil, to the rooms, where are the vessels of the sanctuary, and the kahan (priest) who minister, and the porters, and the singers. We will not forsake the bayath (house) of our Alahayam.

The sharay (princes) of the im (nation / people) lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): the shaar (rest) of the im (nation / people) also napal (fall / be cast down) gawaralawath (lots), to bawaa (come) achad (one) of ishar (ten) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) the qadash (set apart / make holy) iyar (city), and thashai (nine) yadawath (parts) in the other irayam (cities).
The im (nation / people) barak (blessed) all the im (nation / people) who nadab (willingly) offered themselves to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Now these are the raashay (chiefs) of the madayanah (province) who lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); but in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) everyone lived in his achazah (possession) in their iray (cities): Yashar-Al (Israel), the kahanayam (priests), and the Lawayay (Levites), and the nathayan (nethinim), and the banay (children) of Shalamah (Solomon's) ibaday (servants).

In Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) lived certain of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah), and of the banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin). Of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah): Ithayah (Athaiah) the ban (son) of Izayah (Uzziah), the ban (son) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), the ban (son) of Amarayah (Amariah), the ban (son) of Shapatayah (Shephatiah), the ban (son) of Mahalalaal (Mahalalel), of the banay (children) of Paratz (Perez);

And Maishayah (Maaseiah) the ban (son) of Barawak (Baruch), the ban (son) of Kalachazah (Colhozeh), the ban (son) of Chazayah (Hazaiah), the ban (son) of Idayah (Adaiah), the ban (son) of Yawayarayab (Joiarib), the ban (son) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), the ban (son) of the Shalanay (Shilonite).

All the banay (sons) of Paratz (Perez) who lived in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) were arabai (four) maah (hundred) shashayam (sixty) - shamanah (eight) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) banay (men).

These are the banay (sons) of Banayamayan (Benjamin): Salaw (Sallu) the ban (son) of Mashalam (Meshullam), the ban (son) of Yawaid (Joed), the ban (son) of Padayah (Pedaiah), the ban (son) of Qawalayah (Kolaiah), the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), the ban (son) of Ayathayaal (Ithiel), the ban (son) of Yashaiyah (Jeshaiah).
Achar (other) him Gabay (Gabbai), Salaw (Sallai), thashai (nine) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight).
Yawaal (Joel) the ban (son) of Zakaray (Zichri) paqayad (was) their overseer; and Yahawadah (Judah) the ban (son) of Sanawaah (Hassenuah) was mashanah (second) over the iyar (city).
Of the kahanayam (priests): Yadaiyah (Jedaiah) the ban (son) of Yawayarayab (Joiarib), Yakayan (Jachin),

Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), the ban (son) of Mashalam (Meshullam), the ban (son) of Tzadawaq (Zadok), the ban (son) of Marayawath (Meraioth), the ban (son) of Achayatawab (Ahitub), the nagayad (ruler) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam,

And their ach (brother/kinsman) who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of the bayath (house), shamanah (eight) maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shanayam (two); and Idayah (Adaiah) the ban (son) of Yaracham (Jeroham), the ban (son) of Palalayah (Pelaliah), the ban (son) of Amatzay (Amzi), the ban (son) of Zakarayah (Zechariah), the ban (son) of Pashachawar (Pashhur), the ban (son) of Malakayah (Malchijah),

And his ach (brother/kinsman), raashayam (chiefs) of abawath (fathers)' households, shanayam (two) maah (hundred) arabaiyam (forty) - shanayam (two); and Imashasay (Amashsai) the ban (son) of Izaraal (Azarel), the ban (son) of Achazay (Ahzai), the ban (son) of Mashalamawath (Meshillemoth), the ban (son) of Amar (Immer),

And their ach (brother/kinsman), gabawar (mighty) men of valor, one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shamanah (eight); and their paqayad (overseer) was Zabadayaal (Zabdiel), the ban (son) of Haggedolim.
Of the Lawayay (Levites): Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the ban (son) of Chashawab (Hasshub), the ban (son) of Izarayaqam (Azrikam), the ban (son) of Chashabayah (Hashabiah), the ban (son) of Banay (Bunni);

And Shabathay (Shabbethai) and Yawazabad (Jozabad), of the raashay (chiefs) of the Lawayay (Levites), who had the oversight of the chayatzawan (outward) malaakah (business) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam;

And Mathanayah (Mattaniah) the ban (son) of Mica, the ban (son) of Zabaday (Zabdi), the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph), who was the raash (head) to thachalah (begin) the thanksgiving in thapalah (prayer), and Baqabaqayah (Bakbukiah), the mashanah (second) among his ach (brother/kinsman); and Ibadaa (Abda) the ban (son) of Shamawai (Shammua), the ban (son) of Galal (Galal), the ban (son) of Yadawathawan (Jeduthun).
All the Lawayay (Levites) in the qadash (set apart / make holy) iyar (city) were two maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) - arabai (four).

Moreover the shawairayam (porters), Iqawab (Akkub), Talamawan (Talmon), and their ach (brother/kinsman), who shamar (keep/guard) watch at the shairayam (gates), were one maah (hundred) shabaiyam (seventy) - shanayam (two).
The shaar (residue) of Yashar-Al (Israel), of the kahanayam (priests), the Lawayay (Levites), were in all the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), everyone in his nachalah (inheritance).
But the nathayan (nethinim) lived in Ipal (Ophel): and Tzayachaa (Ziha) and Gashapaa (Gishpa) were over the nathayan (nethinim).

The paqayad (overseer) also of the Lawayay (Levites) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) was Izay (Uzzi) the ban (son) of Banay (Bani), the ban (son) of Chashabayah (Hashabiah), the ban (son) of Mathanayah (Mattaniah), the ban (son) of Mayakaa (Mica), of the banay (sons) of Asap (Asaph), the singers, over the malaakah (business) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam.
For there was a matzawah (commandment) from the malak (king) concerning them, and a settled provision for the singers, as every yawam (day) required.

Pathachayah (Pethahiah) the ban (son) of Mashayazabaal (Meshezabel), of the banay (children) of Zarach (Zerah) the ban (son) of Yahawadah (Judah), was at the malak (king) yad (hand) in all dabar (word / matter) concerning the im (nation / people).

As for the chatzarayam (villages), with their shadah (fields), some of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) lived in Kiriath Qarayathaarabai (Arba) and its towns, and in Dayabawan (Dibon) and its towns, and in Yaqabatzaal (Jekabzeel) and its banath (daughter),
And in Yashawai (Jeshua), and in Mawaladah (Moladah), and Bayathapalat (Beth Pelet),
And in Chatzarashawail (Hazar Shual), and in Baar-Shabai (Beersheba) and its banath (daughter),
And in Tzaqalag (Ziklag), and in Makanah (Meconah) and in its banath (daughter),
And in Iyanaramawan (En Rimmon), and in Tzaraih (Zorah), and in Yaramawath (Jarmuth),

Zanawach (Zanoah), Idalam (Adullam), and their chatzar (villages), Lakayash (Lachish) and its shadah (fields), Izaqah (Azekah) and its banath (daughter). So they chanah (encamped) from Baar-Shabai (Beersheba) to the gayaa (valley) of Hanam (Hinnom).
The banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin) also lived from Gabai (Geba) onward, at Makamas (Michmash) and Iy (Aija), and at Bayath-Al (Bethel) and its banath (daughter),
At Inathawath (Anathoth), Nab (Nob), Inanayah (Ananiah),
Chatzawar (Hazor), Ramah (Ramah), Gathayam (Gittaim),
Chadayad (Hadid), Tzabaiyam (Zeboim), Nabalat (Neballat),
Lad (Lod), and Awanaw (Ono), the gayaa (valley) of craftsmen.
Of the Lawayay (Levites), certain machalaqawath (divisions) in Yahawadah (Judah) settled in Banayamayan (Benjamin's) territory.

Now these are the kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) who ilah (go up / offer) up with Zarababal (Zerubbabel) the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yashawai (Jeshua): Sharayah (Seraiah), Yaramayah (Jeremiah), Izaraa (Ezra),
Amarayah (Amariah), Malawak (Malluch), Chatawash (Hattush),
Shakanayah (Shecaniah), Rachawam (Rehum), Maramawath (Meremoth),
Idaw (Iddo), Ganathawan (Ginnethoi), Abayah (Abijah),
Mayaman (Mijamin), Maidayah (Maadiah), Balagah (Bilgah),
Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Yawayarayab (Joiarib), Yadaiyah (Jedaiah).

Salaw (Sallu), Imawaq (Amok), Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), Yadaiyah (Jedaiah). These were the raashay (chiefs) of the kahanayam (priests) and of their ach (brother/kinsman) in the yamay (days) of Yashawai (Jeshua).

Moreover the Lawayay (Levites): Yashawai (Jeshua), Banaway (Binnui), Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), Sharabayah (Sherebiah), Yahawadah (Judah), and Mathanayah (Mattaniah), who was over the hayadah (thanksgiving), he and his ach (brother/kinsman).
Also Baqabaqayah (Bakbukiah) and Inay (Unno), their ach (brother/kinsman), were over against them according to their mashamarawath (offices).

Yashawai (Jeshua) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yawayaqayam (Joiakim), and Yawayaqayam (Joiakim) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Alayashayab (Eliashib), and Alayashayab (Eliashib) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yawayadai (Joiada),
And Yawayadai (Joiada) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yawanathan (Jonathan), and Yawanathan (Jonathan) became the yalad (birth / begot) of Yadawai (Jaddua).

In the yamay (days) of Yawayaqayam (Joiakim) were kahanayam (priests), raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households: of Sharayah (Seraiah), Marayah (Meraiah); of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), Chananayah (Hananiah);
Of Izaraa (Ezra), Mashalam (Meshullam); of Amarayah (Amariah), Yahawachanan (Jehohanan);
Of Malawak (Malluchi), Yawanathan (Jonathan); of Shabanayah (Shebaniah), Yawasap (Joseph);
Of Charam (Harim), Idanaa (Adna); of Marayawath (Meraioth), Chalaqay (Helkai);
Of Idaw (Iddo), Zakarayah (Zechariah); of Ganathawan (Ginnethon), Mashalam (Meshullam);
Of Abayah (Abijah), Zakaray (Zichri); of Manayamayan (Miniamin), of Mawaidayah (Moadiah), Palatay (Piltai);
Of Balagah (Bilgah), Shamawai (Shammua); of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), Yahawanathan (Jehonathan);
And of Yawayarayab (Joiarib), Mathanay (Mattenai); of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), Izay (Uzzi);
Of Salaw (Sallai), Qalay (Kallai); of Imawaq (Amok), Ibar (Eber);
Of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), Chashabayah (Hashabiah); of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), Nathanaal (Nethanel).

As for the Lawayay (Levites), in the yamay (days) of Alayashayab (Eliashib), Yawayadai (Joiada), and Yawachanan (Johanan), and Yadawai (Jaddua), there were kathab (write) the raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households; also the kahanayam (priests), in the malakawath (reign) of Darayawash (Darius) the Parasay (Persian).

The banay (sons) of Laway (Levi), raashay (heads) of abawath (fathers)' households, were kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles), even until the yamayam (days) of Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Alayashayab (Eliashib).

The raashay (chiefs) of the Lawayay (Levites): Chashabayah (Hashabiah), Sharabayah (Sherebiah), and Yashawai (Jeshua) the ban (son) of Qadamayaal (Kadmiel), with their ach (brother/kinsman) over against them, to halal (praise) and halal (praise) thanks, according to the matzawah (commandment) of Dawad (David) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, mashamar (watch) next to mashamar (watch).

Mathanayah (Mattaniah), and Baqabaqayah (Bakbukiah), Ibadayah (Obadiah), Mashalam (Meshullam), Talamawan (Talmon), Iqawab (Akkub), were shawairayam (porters) shamar (keep/guard) the mashamar (watch) at the storehouses of the shairayam (gates).

These were in the yamay (days) of Yawayaqayam (Joiakim) the ban (son) of Yashawai (Jeshua), the ban (son) of Yawatzadaq (Jozadak), and in the yamay (days) of Nachamayah (Nehemiah) the pachah (governor), and of Izaraa (Ezra) the kahan (priest) the sapar (book).

At the chanakah (dedication) of the chawamah (wall) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) they baqash (sought) the Lawayay (Levites) out of all their maqawam (place), to bawaa (come) them to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to ishah (make) the chanakah (dedication) with shamachah (gladness), both with thawadah (giving) thanks, and with shayar (song), with matzalathayam (cymbals), stringed instruments, and with kanarawath (harps).

The banay (sons) of the singers asap (gathered) themselves together, both out of the kakar (plain) around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and from the chatzaray (villages) of the Natapathay (Netophathites);

Also from Beth Galagal (Gilgal), and out of the shadawath (fields) of Gabai (Geba) and Izamawath (Azmaveth): for the singers had banah (build) them chatzarayam (villages) around Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
The kahanayam (priests) and the Lawayay (Levites) tahar (purified) themselves; and they tahar (purified) the im (nation / people), and the shairayam (gates), and the chawamah (wall).

Then I ilah (go up / offer) up the sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah) on the chawamah (wall), and imad (appointed) shanayam (two) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) companies who gave thawadath (thanks) and thahalakah (went) in procession. One went on the right yamayan (right hand) on the chawamah (wall) toward the ashapath (dung) shair (gate);
And achar (other) them yalak (went) Hawashaiyah (Hoshaiah), and chatzay (half) of the sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah),
And Izarayah (Azariah), Izaraa (Ezra), and Mashalam (Meshullam),
Yahawadah (Judah), and Banayamayan (Benjamin), and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Yaramayah (Jeremiah),

And certain of the kahanayam (priests)' banay (sons) with chatzatzarawath (trumpets): Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Yawanathan (Jonathan), the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), the ban (son) of Mathanayah (Mattaniah), the ban (son) of Mayakayah (Micaiah), the ban (son) of Zakawar (Zaccur), the ban (son) of Asap (Asaph);

And his ach (brother/kinsman), Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Izaraal (Azarel), Malalay (Milalai), Galalay (Gilalai), Maiy (Maai), Nathanaal (Nethanel), and Yahawadah (Judah), Chananay (Hanani), with the shayar (song) kalay (instruments) of Dawad (David) the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam; and Izaraa (Ezra) the sapar (book) panayam (face) before them.

By the spring shair (gate), and straight before them, they ilah (go up / offer) up by the mailawath (stairs) of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), at the mailah (ascent) of the chawamah (wall), above the bayath (house) of Dawad (David), even to the mayam (Waters) shair (gate) eastward.

The other company of those who gave thawadah (thanks) halak (move) to meet them, and I achar (other) them, with the chatzay (half) of the im (nation / people), on the chawamah (wall), above the magadal (tower) of the thanawarayam (furnaces), even to the rachab (broad) chawamah (wall),

And above the shair (gate) of Aparayam (Ephraim), and by the old shair (gate), and by the dag (fish) shair (gate), and the magadal (tower) of Chananaal (Hananel), and the magadal (tower) of Hammeah, even to the tzaan (sheep) shair (gate): and they imad (stood) still in the shair (gate) of the guard.
So imad (stood) the shanayam (two) companies of those who gave thawadath (thanks) in the bayath (house) of Alahayam, and I, and the chatzay (half) of the saganayam (rulers) with me;

And the kahanayam (priests), Alayaqayam (Eliakim), Maishayah (Maaseiah), Manayamayan (Miniamin), Mayakayah (Micaiah), Alayahawaiyanay (Elioenai), Zakarayah (Zechariah), and Chananayah (Hananiah), with chatzatzarawath (trumpets);

And Maishayah (Maaseiah), and Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Alaizar (Eleazar), and Izay (Uzzi), and Yahawachanan (Jehohanan), and Malakayah (Malchijah), and Iyalam (Elam), and Izar (Ezer). The singers sang loud, with Yazarachayah (Jezrahiah) their paqayad (overseer).

They zabach (offered) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) zabachayam (sacrifices) that yawam (day), and shamach (rejoiced); for Alahayam shamach (had) made them rejoice with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shamachah (joy); and the nashayam (women) also and the yaladayam (children) shamach (rejoiced): so that the shamachah (joy) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) was shamai (hearken / hear) even rachawaq (afar) off.

On that yawam (day) were anashayam (men) paqad (visit) over the rooms for the awatzarawath (treasures), for the wave tharawamawath (offerings), for the raashayath (beginning) fruits, and for the maisharawath (tithes), to kanas (gather) into them, according to the shaday (fields) of the irayam (cities), the manaawath (portions) appointed by the thawarah (instruction) for the kahanayam (priests) and Lawayay (Levites): for Yahawadah (Judah) shamachah (rejoiced) for the kahanayam (priests) and for the Lawayay (Levites) who waited.

They performed the duty of their Alahayam, and the duty of the taharah (purification), and so did the singers and the shairayam (porters), according to the matzawah (commandment) of Dawad (David), and of Shalamah (Solomon) his ban (son).
For in the yamay (days) of Dawad (David) and Asap (Asaph) of qadam (old) there was a raash (head) of the singers, and shayar (song) of thahalah (praise) and thanksgiving to Alahayam.

All Yashar-Al (Israel) in the yamay (days) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel), and in the yamay (days) of Nachamayah (Nehemiah), nathan (give) the manayawath (portions) of the singers and the shairayam (porters), as every yawam (day) required: and they set apart that which was for the Lawayay (Levites); and the Lawayay (Levites) set apart that which was for the banay (sons) of Aharawan (Aaron).

On that yawam (day) they qaraa (called) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of Mashah (Moses) in the azan (ear) of the im (nation / people); and therein was matzaa (found) kathab (write), that an Imawanay (Ammonite) and a Mawaabay (Moabite) should not bawaa (come) into the qahal (assembly) of Alahayam iwalam (forever),

Because they didn't qadam (meet) the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) with lacham (bread) and with mayam (Waters), but shakar (hired) Balaim (Balaam) against them, to qalal (curse) them: however our Alahayam hapak (turned) the qalal (curse) into a barakah (blessing).
It came to pass, when they had shamai (hearken / hear) the thawarah (instruction), that they badal (separated) from Yashar-Al (Israel) all the irab (evening) multitude.
Now panayam (face) this, Alayashayab (Eliashib) the kahan (priest), who was nathan (give) over the rooms of the bayath (house) of our Alahayam, being qarawab (allied) to Tawabayah (Tobiah),

Ishah (make) prepared for him a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) room, where panayam (face) they nathan (give) the meal manachah (offerings), the labawanah (frankincense), and the kalayam (vessels), and the maishar (tithes) of the grain, the new thayarawash (wine), and the yatzahar (fresh oil), which were given by matzawah (commandment) to the Lawayay (Levites), and the singers, and the shairayam (porters); and the wave tharawamah (offerings) for the kahanayam (priests).

But in all this, I was not at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for in the shanayam (two) and shalawashayam (thirty) shanah (year) of Arathachashashathaa (Artaxerxes) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) I bawaa (come) to the malak (king): and qatz (after) certain yamayam (days) shaal (asked) I leave of the malak (king),

And I bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and bayan (between) the rai (evil) that Alayashayab (Eliashib) ishah (make) done for Tawabayah (Tobiah), in ishah (make) him a room in the chatzaray (courts) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam.
It grieved me severely: therefore I shalak (cast) forth all the bayath (house) kalay (stuff) of Tawabayah (Tobiah) out of the room.

Then I commanded, and they tahar (cleansed) the rooms: and there shawab (turn back / repent) I again the kalay (vessels) of the bayath (house) of Alahayam, with the meal manachah (offerings) and the labawanah (frankincense).

I yadai (perceived) that the manayawath (portions) of the Lawayay (Levites) nathan (give) not been given them; so that the Lawayay (Levites) and the singers, who ishah (make) the malaakah (work), had barach (fled) everyone to his shadah (field).
Then I rayab (contended) with the saganayam (rulers), and amar (spoke), "Why is the bayath (house) of Alahayam forsaken?" I qabatz (gathered) them together, and imad (set) them in their imad (place).
Then bawaa (come) all Yahawadah (Judah) the maishar (tithe) of the grain and the new thayarawash (wine) and the yatzahar (fresh oil) to the awatzarawath (treasuries).

I made atzar (treasurers) over the awatzarawath (treasuries), Shalamayah (Shelemiah) the kahan (priest), and Tzadawaq (Zadok) the sapar (book), and of the Lawayay (Levites), Padayah (Pedaiah): and next to them was Chanan (Hanan) the ban (son) of Zakawar (Zaccur), the ban (son) of Mathanayah (Mattaniah); for they were chashab (counted) aman (believe / have faith), and their business was to chalaq (distribute) to their ach (brother/kinsman).
Zakar (remember) me, my Alahayam, concerning this, and don't machah (wipe) out my chasad (grace) deeds that I ishah (make) done for the bayath (house) of my Alahayam, and for its observances.

In those yamayam (days) raah (see) I in Yahawadah (Judah) some men darak (treading) winepresses on the shabath (shabath / rest), and bawaa (come) in sheaves, and imas (loading) donkeys; as also yayan (wine), inabayam (grapes), and thaanayam (figs), and all kinds of mashaa (burdens), which they bawaa (come) into Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) on the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day): and I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) against them in the yawam (day) in which they makar (sold) tzayad (food).

There lived men of tzaray (tyre) also therein, who bawaa (come) in dag (fish), and all kinds of makar (wares), and makar (sold) on the shabath (shabath / rest) to the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then I rayab (contended) with the charay (nobles) of Yahawadah (Judah), and amar (spoke) to them, "What rai (evil) thing is this that you ishah (make), and chalal (profane) the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day)?

Didn't your ab (father) ishah (make) thus, and didn't our Alahayam bawaa (come) all this rai (evil) on us, and on this iyar (city)? Yet you bawaa (come) more charawan (wrath) on Yashar-Al (Israel) by chalal (profaning) the shabath (shabath / rest)."

It came to pass that, when the shairay (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) tzalal (began) to be dark panayam (face) the shabath (shabath / rest), I commanded that the dalathawath (doors) should be sagar (shut), and commanded that they should not be pathach (opened) until achar (other) the shabath (shabath / rest). I imad (set) some of my nair (servants) over the shairay (gates), that no mashaa (burden) should be bawaa (come) in on the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day).
So the rakalayam (merchants) and sellers of all kinds of mamakar (wares) lawan (lodged) outside of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) paim (once) or shanayam (two).

Then I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) amar (spoke) them, and said to them, "Why do you stay around the chawamah (wall)? If you shanah (do) so again, I will shalach (send) yad (hand) on you." From that ith (time) on, they didn't bawaa (come) on the shabath (shabath / rest).

I commanded the Lawayay (Levites) that they should tahar (purify) themselves, and that they should bawaa (come) and shamar (keep/guard) the shairayam (gates), to qadash (set apart / make holy) the shabath (shabath / rest) yawam (day). Zakar (remember) to me, my Alahayam, this also, and chawas (spare) me according to the greatness of your loving chasad (grace).
In those yamayam (days) also raah (see) I the Yahawaday (Jews) who had yashab (inhabit/dwell) nashayam (women) of ashadawaday (ashdod), of imawanay (ammon), and of mawaabay (moab):

And their ban (son) dabar (word / matter) chatzay (half) in the ashadawadayath (speech) of Ashdod, and nakar (could) not dabar (word / matter) in the Yahawadayath (Jews)' language, but according to the lashawan (tongue / language) of each im (nation / people).

I rayab (contended) with them, and qalal (cursed) them, and nakah (struck) ayash (man / husband) of them, and marat (plucked) off their hair, and made them shabai (swear / take oath) by Alahayam, "You shall not nathan (give) your banath (daughter) to their ban (son), nor nashaa (lift) their banath (daughter) for your ban (son), or for yourselves.

Didn't Shalamah (Solomon) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel) chataa (sin) by these things? Yet among many gawayam (nations) was there no malak (king) ahab (love) him, and he was beloved of his Alahayam, and Alahayam nathan (give) him malak (king) over all Yashar-Al (Israel). Nevertheless foreign nashayam (women) caused even him to chataa (sin).

Shall we then shamai (hearken / hear) to you to ishah (make) all this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil), to mail (top/above) against our Alahayam in yashab (inhabit/dwell) foreign nashayam (women)?"

One of the banay (sons) of Yawayadai (Joiada), the ban (son) of Alayashayab (Eliashib) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), was son-in-law to Sanabalat (Sanballat) the charanay (horonite): therefore I barach (chased) him from me.
Zakar (remember) them, my Alahayam, because they have gaal (defiled) the kahanah (priesthood), and the barayath (covenant) of the kahanah (priesthood), and of the Lawayay (Levites).
Thus I tahar (cleansed) them from all foreigners, and imad (appointed) duties for the kahanayam (priests) and for the Lawayay (Levites), everyone in his malaakah (work);
And for the itz (wood) qaraban (offering), at ithayam (times) zaman (appointed), and for the bakawar (first) fruits. Zakar (remember) me, my Alahayam, for tawab (good / proper function).

Now it happened in the yamay (days) of Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) (this is Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) who malak (king) from Hadaw (India) even to Kawash (Ethiopia), over one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shabai (seven) madayanah (provinces)),

That in those yamayam (days), when the malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of his malakawath (kingdom), which was in Shawashan (Shushan) the bayarah (palace),

In the shalawash (three) shanah (year) of his malak (king), he ishah (make) a mashathah (feast) for all his sharay (princes) and his ibad (servant); the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of Paras (Persia) and Maday (Media), the parathamayam (nobles) and sharay (princes) of the madayanawath (provinces), being panayam (face) him.

He displayed the riches of his kabawad (glorious) malakawath (kingdom) and the honor of his excellent gadawalah (majesty) many yamayam (days), even one maah (hundred) shamanayam (eighty) yamayam (days).

When these yamayam (days) were malaa (fulfilled), the malak (king) ishah (make) a shabai (seven) yawam (day) mashathah (feast) for all the im (nation / people) who were matzaa (present) in Shawashan (Shushan) the bayarah (palace), both gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small / young / least), in the chatzar (court) of the ganah (garden) of the malak (king) bayathan (palace).

There were hangings of chawar (white), karapas (green), and thakalath (blue) material, achaz (fastened) with chabalay (cords) of bawatz (fine) linen and aragaman (purple) to kasap (silver) galayalay (rings) and shash (six) imawaday (pillars). The couches were of zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), on a ratzapah (pavement) of bahat (red), dar (white), yellow, and sacharath (black) shash (six).
They shaqah (gave) them drinks in zahab (gold) kalayam (vessels) of various kinds, including malakawath (royal) yayan (wine) in abundance, according to the yad (hand) of the malak (king).

In accordance with the dath (law), the shathayah (drinking) was not compulsory; for so the malak (king) had yasad (instructed) all the officials of his bayath (house), that they should ishah (make) according to every ayash (man / husband) ratzawan (pleasure).

Also Washathay (Vashti) the malakah (queen) ishah (make) a mashathah (feast) for the nashayam (women) in the malakawath (royal) bayath (house) which belonged to malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus).

On the shabayaiy (seventh) yawam (day), when the lab (heart) of the malak (king) was tawab (good / proper function) with yayan (wine), he commanded Mahawaman (Mehuman), Bazathaa (Biztha), Charabawanaa (Harbona), Bagathaa (Bigtha), and Abagathaa (Abagtha), Zathar (Zethar), and Karakas (Carcass), the shabai (seven) sarayasayam (eunuchs) who sharath (served) in the panayam (face) of Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) the malak (king),

To bawaa (come) Washathay (Vashti) the malakah (queen) panayam (face) the malak (king) with the malakawath (royal) kathar (crown), to show the imayam (people) and the sharayam (princes) her yapay (beauty); for she was tawab (good / proper function).

But the malakah (queen) Washathay (Vashti) maan (refused) to bawaa (come) at the malak (king) commandment by the sarayasayam (eunuchs). Therefore the malak (king) was very qatzap (angry), and his chamah (anger) bair (burned) in him.
Then the malak (king) amar (spoke) to the chakam (wise) men, who yadai (knew) the ithayam (times), (for it was the malak (king) custom to consult those who yadai (knew) dath (law) and dayan (judge);

And the qarawab (next) to him were Karashanaa (Carshena), Shathar (Shethar), Adamathaa (Admatha), Tharashayash (Tarshish), Maras (Meres), Marasanaa (Marsena), and Mamawakan (Memucan), the shabai (seven) sharay (princes) of Paras (Persia) and Maday (Media), who raah (see) the malak (king) panayam (face), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) raashawan (first) in the malakawath (kingdom)),

"What shall we ishah (make) to the malakah (queen) Washathay (Vashti) according to dath (law), because she ishah (make) not done the bidding of the malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) by the sarayasayam (eunuchs)?"

Mamawakan (Memucan) amar (spoke) panayam (face) the malak (king) and the sharayam (princes), "Washathay (Vashti) the malakah (queen) has not iwah (done) wrong to just the malak (king), but also to all the sharayam (princes), and to all the imayam (people) who are in all the madayanawath (provinces) of the malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus).

For this dabar (word / matter) of the malakah (queen) will become known to all nashayam (women), causing them to show contempt for their bail (husbands), when it is amar (spoke), ‘malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) commanded Washathay (Vashti) the malakah (queen) to be bawaa (come) in panayam (face) him, but she didn't bawaa (come).'

Today, the princesses of Paras (Persia) and Maday (Media) who have shamai (hearken / hear) of the malakah (queen's) dabar (word / matter) will amar (spoke) all the malak (king) sharay (princes). This will cause much bazayawan (contempt) and qatzap (wrath).

"If it tawab (good / proper function) the malak (king), let a malakawath (royal) commandment yatzaa (go out / come out) from him, and let it be kathab (write) among the dathay (laws) of the Paras (Persians) and the Maday (Medes), so that it cannot be ibar (pass over/through), that Washathay (Vashti) may never again bawaa (come) panayam (face) malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus); and let the malak (king) nathan (give) her malakawath (royal) estate to raiwath (another) who is tawab (good / proper function) than she.

When the malak (king) pathagam (decree) which he shall ishah (make) is shamai (hearken / hear) throughout all his malakawath (kingdom) (for it is rab (great)), all the wives will nathan (give) their bail (husbands) honor, both gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and qatan (small / young / least)."
This dabar (word / matter) yatab (pleased) the malak (king) and the sharayam (princes), and the malak (king) ishah (make) according to the dabar (word / matter) of Mamawakan (Memucan):

For he shalach (send) saparayam (letters) into all the malak (king) madayanawath (provinces), into every madayanah (province) according to its kathab (write), and to every im (nation / people) in their lashawan (tongue / language), that every ayash (man / husband) should sharar (rule) his own bayath (house), dabar (word / matter) in the lashawan (tongue / language) of his own im (nation / people).

Achar (other) these things, when the chamah (wrath) of malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) was shakak (pacified), he zakar (remember) Washathay (Vashti), and what she ishah (make) done, and what was gazar (decreed) against her.
Then the malak (king) nairay (servants) who sharath (served) him amar (spoke), "Let tawab (good / proper function) nairah (young) bathawalawath (virgins) be baqash (sought) for the malak (king).

Let the malak (king) paqad (visit) officers in all the madayanawath (provinces) of his malakawath (kingdom), that they may qabatz (gather) together all the tawab (good / proper function) nairah (young) bathawalah (virgins) to the citadel of Shawashan (Susa), to the nashayam (womens) bayath (house), to the yad (hand) of Hagaa (Hegai) the malak (king) sarayas (eunuch), keeper of the nashayam (women). Let cosmetics be nathan (give) them;
And let the nairah (maiden) who yatab (pleases) the malak (king) be malak (king) instead of Washathay (Vashti)." The thing yatab (pleased) the malak (king), and he ishah (make) so.

There was a ayash (man / husband) Yahawaday (Jew) in the citadel of Shawashan (Susa), whose sham (name) was Maradakay (Mordecai), the ban (son) of Yaayar (Jair), the ban (son) of Shamaiy (Shimei), the ban (son) of Qayash (Kish), a Banayamayanay (Benjamite),

Who had been galah (carried) away from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with the gawalah (captives) who had been galah (carried) away with Yakanayah (Jeconiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had galah (carried) away.

He aman (believe / have faith) up Hadasah (Hadassah), that is, Asathar (Esther), his dawad (uncle's) banath (daughter); for she had neither ab (father) nor am (mother). The nairah (maiden) was yapah (fair) and yapah (beautiful); and when her ab (father) and am (mother) were mawath (death), Maradakay (Mordecai) laqach (take / seize) her for his own banath (daughter).

So it happened, when the malak (king) commandment and his dabar (word / matter) was shamai (hearken / hear), and when many nairawath (maidens) were qabatz (gathered) together to the citadel of Shawashan (Susa), to the yad (hand) of Hagaa (Hegai), that Asathar (Esther) was laqach (take / seize) into the malak (king) bayath (house), to the yad (hand) of Hagaa (Hegai), keeper of the nashayam (women).

The nairah (maiden) yatab (pleased) him, and she nashaa (lift) chasad (grace) from him. He quickly nathan (give) her cosmetics and her manah (portions) of food, and the shabai (seven) choice nairawath (maidens) who were to be nathan (give) her out of the malak (king) bayath (house). He moved her and her nairawath (maidens) to the tawab (good / proper function) place in the nashayam (womens) bayath (house).
Asathar (Esther) had not made known her im (nation / people) nor her relatives, because Maradakay (Mordecai) had instructed her that she should not make it known.

Maradakay (Mordecai) halak (move) every yawam (day) in panayam (face) of the chatzar (court) of the nashayam (womens) bayath (house), to find out how Asathar (Esther) was shalawam (peace / safety), and what would ishah (make) of her.

Each nairah (young) woman's thawar (turn) nagai (came) to go in to malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) qatz (after) her purification for shanayam (two) chadashayam (months) (for so were the yamay (days) of their marawaq (purification) malaa (accomplished), shash (six) chadashayam (months) with shaman (oil) of mar (myrrh), and shash (six) chadashayam (months) with basham (sweet) fragrances and with preparations for beautifying nashayam (women)).

The nairah (young) woman then bawaa (come) to the malak (king) like this: whatever she amar (spoke) was nathan (give) her to bawaa (come) with her out of the nashayam (womens) bayath (house) to the malak (king) bayath (house).

In the irab (evening) she bawaa (come), and on the next baqar (morning) she shawab (turn back / repent) into the shanay (second) nashayam (womens) bayath (house), to the yad (hand) of Shaishagaz (Shaashgaz), the malak (king) sarayas (eunuch), who shamar (keep/guard) the payalagashayam (concubines). She bawaa (come) in to the malak (king) no more, unless the malak (king) chapatz (delighted) in her, and she was qaraa (called) by sham (name).

Now when the thawar (turn) of Asathar (Esther), the banath (daughter) of Abayahayal (Abihail) the dawad (uncle) of Maradakay (Mordecai), who had laqach (take / seize) her for his banath (daughter), nagai (came) to go in to the malak (king), she baqash (required) nothing but what Hagaa (Hegai) the malak (king) sarayas (eunuch), the keeper of the nashayam (women), advised. Asathar (Esther) nashaa (lift) favor in the iyan (eye) of all those who raah (see) at her.

So Asathar (Esther) was laqach (take / seize) to malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) into his malakawath (royal) bayath (house) in the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Tabath (Tebeth), in the shabai (seven) shanah (year) of his malakawath (reign).

The malak (king) ahab (love) Asathar (Esther) more than all the nashayam (women), and she nashaa (lift) favor and nashaa (lift) in his panayam (face) more than all the bathawalath (virgins); so that he shawam (place / establish / appoint) the malakawath (royal) kathar (crown) on her raash (head), and made her malak (king) instead of Washathay (Vashti).

Then the malak (king) ishah (make) a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mashathah (feast) for all his shar (prince / ruler) and his ibad (servant), even Asathar (Esther's) mashathah (feast); and he proclaimed a holiday in the madayanawath (provinces), and nathan (give) mashaath (gifts) according to the malak (king) yad (hand).
When the bathawalawath (virgins) were qabatz (gathered) together the shanay (second) time, Maradakay (Mordecai) was sitting in the malak (king) shair (gate).

Asathar (Esther) had not yet made known her relatives nor her im (nation / people), as Maradakay (Mordecai) had tzawah (commanded) her; for Asathar (Esther) obeyed Maradakay (Mordecai), like she ishah (make) when she was amanah (brought) up by him.

In those yamayam (days), while Maradakay (Mordecai) was sitting in the malak (king) shair (gate), shanayam (two) of the malak (king) sarayasay (eunuchs), Bagathan (Bigthan) and Tharash (Teresh), who were doorkeepers, were qatzap (angry), and baqash (sought) to shalach (send) yad (hand) on the malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus).
This thing became yadai (known) to Maradakay (Mordecai), who informed Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen); and Asathar (Esther) informed the malak (king) in Maradakay (Mordecai's) sham (name).

When this dabar (word / matter) was investigated, and it was matzaa (found) to be so, they were shanayam (two) hanged on a itz (tree); and it was kathab (write) in the sapar (book / scribed document) of the dabaray (chronicles) in the malak (king) panayam (face).

Achar (other) these things malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) gadal (promoted) Haman (Haman) the ban (son) of Madathaa (Hammedatha) the agagay (agagite), and nashaa (lift) him, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) his kasaa (seat) above all the sharayam (princes) who were with him.

All the malak (king) ibaday (servants) who were in the malak (king) shair (gate) karai (bowed) down, and paid homage to Haman (Haman); for the malak (king) had so tzawah (commanded) concerning him. But Maradakay (Mordecai) didn't karai (bow) down or pay him homage.

Then the malak (king) ibaday (servants), who were in the malak (king) shair (gate), amar (spoke) to Maradakay (Mordecai), "Why ibar (pass over/through) you disobey the malak (king) matzawah (commandment)?"

Now it came to pass, when they amar (spoke) yawam (day) to him, and he didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to them, that they nagad (told) Haman (Haman), to raah (see) whether Maradakay (Mordecai's) dabar (word / matter) would imad (stand); for he had nagad (told) them that he was a Yahawaday (Jew).
When Haman (Haman) raah (see) that Maradakay (Mordecai) didn't karai (bow) down, nor pay him homage, Haman (Haman) was malaa (full) of chamah (wrath).

But he bazah (scorned) the iyan (eye) of shalach (send) yad (hand) on Maradakay (Mordecai) nagad (alone), for they had made known to him Maradakay (Mordecai's) im (nation / people). Therefore Haman (Haman) baqash (sought) to shamad (destroy) all the Yahawaday (Jews) who were throughout the whole malakawath (kingdom) of Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), even Maradakay (Mordecai's) im (nation / people).

In the raashawan (first) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Nayasan (Nisan), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), they napal (fall / be cast down) Pawar (Pur), that is, the gawaral (lot), panayam (face) Haman (Haman) from yawam (day) to yawam (day), and from chadash (month) to chadash (month), and chose the shanayam (two) chadash (month), which is the month Adar (Adar).

Haman (Haman) amar (spoke) to malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), "There is a achad (one) imayam (people) pazar (scattered) abroad and parad (dispersed) among the imayam (peoples) in all the madayanawath (provinces) of your malakawath (kingdom), and their dathay (laws) are different than other imayam (peoples). They don't ishah (make) the malak (king) dathay (laws). Therefore it is not for the malak (king) shawah (profit) to allow them to remain.

If it tawab (good / proper function) the malak (king), let it be kathab (write) that they be abad (destroy / perish); and I will shaqal (pay) ishar (ten) alap (thousand) kakar (talents) of kasap (silver) into the yaday (hands) of those who are in ishah (make) of the king's malaakah (business), to bawaa (come) it into the malak (king) ganazay (treasuries)."

The malak (king) sawar (took) his tabaith (ring) from his yad (hand), and nathan (give) it to Haman (Haman) the ban (son) of Madathaa (Hammedatha) the agagay (agagite), the Yahawaday (Jews)' tzarar (enemy).

The malak (king) amar (spoke) to Haman (Haman), "The kasap (silver) is nathan (give) to you, the im (nation / people) also, to ishah (make) with them as it seems tawab (good / proper function) to you."

Then the malak (king) saparay (scribes) were qaraa (called) in on the raashawan (first) chadash (month), on the thirteenth yawam (day) of the chadash (month); and all that Haman (Haman) tzawah (commanded) was written to the malak (king) satraps, and to the pachawath (governors) who were over every madayanah (province), and to the sharay (princes) of every im (nation / people), to every madayanah (province) according its kathab (write), and to every im (nation / people) in their lashawan (tongue / language). It was kathab (write) in the sham (name) of malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), and it was chatham (sealed) with the malak (king) tabaith (ring).

Saparayam (letters) were shalach (send) by couriers into all the malak (king) madayanawath (provinces), to shamad (destroy), to harag (kill), and to cause to shamad (perish), all Yahawaday (Jews), both nair (young) and zaqan (old), little tap (children) and nashayam (women), in achad (one) yawam (day), even on the thirteenth yawam (day) of the shanayam (two) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Adar (Adar), and to plunder their shalal (possessions).

A parashagan (copy) of the letter, that the dath (decree) should be nathan (give) out in every madayanah (province), was galah (published) to all the imayam (peoples), that they should be ithayad (ready) against that yawam (day).

The couriers yatzaa (go out / come out) forth in dachap (haste) by the malak (king) commandment, and the dath (decree) was nathan (give) out in the citadel of Shawashan (Susa). The malak (king) and Haman (Haman) yashab (inhabit/dwell) down to shathah (drinks); but the iyar (city) of Shawashan (Shushan) was perplexed.

Now when Maradakay (Mordecai) found out all that was ishah (make), Maradakay (Mordecai) qarai (tore) his clothes, and labash (put) on sackcloth with ashes, and yatzaa (go out / come out) out into the thawak (midst) of the iyar (city), and wailed loudly and bitterly.
He bawaa (come) even panayam (face) the malak (king) shair (gate), for no bawaa (come) is allowed inside the malak (king) shair (gate) labawash (clothed) with sackcloth.

In every madayanah (province), wherever the malak (king) commandment and his dabar (word / matter) nagai (came), there was gadawal (very great/important/mighty) abal (mourning) among the Yahawaday (Jews), and tzawam (fasting), and bakay (weeping), and masapad (wailing); and many yatzai (lay) in sackcloth and ashes.

Asathar (Esther's) nairawath (maidens) and her sarayas (eunuchs) bawaa (come) and nagad (told) her this, and the malakah (queen) was maad (exceedingly) chawal (grieved). She shalach (send) bagad (clothing) to Maradakay (Mordecai), to replace his sackcloth; but he didn't qabal (receive) it.

Then Asathar (Esther) qaraa (called) for Hathak (Hathach), one of the malak (king) sarayasay (eunuchs), whom he had imad (appointed) to attend her, and tzawah (commanded) him to go to Maradakay (Mordecai), to find out what this was, and why it was.
So Hathak (Hathach) yatzaa (go out / come out) out to Maradakay (Mordecai), to iyar (city) square which panayam (face) before the malak (king) shair (gate).

Maradakay (Mordecai) nagad (told) him of all that had qarah (happened) to him, and the exact parashah (sum) of the kasap (money) that Haman (Haman) had amar (spoke) to shaqal (pay) to the malak (king) ganazay (treasuries) for the abad (destroy / perish) of the Yahawaday (Jews).

He also nathan (give) him the parashagan (copy) of the kathab (write) of the dath (decree) that was nathan (give) out in Shawashan (Shushan) to shamad (destroy) them, to show it to Asathar (Esther), and to nagad (declare) it to her, and to urge her to bawaa (come) in to the malak (king), to chanan (showing favor) supplication to him, and to baqash (make) request panayam (face) him, for her im (nation / people).
Hathak (Hathach) bawaa (come) and nagad (told) Asathar (Esther) the dabaray (words) of Maradakay (Mordecai).
Then Asathar (Esther) amar (spoke) to Hathak (Hathach), and tzawah (gave) him a message to Maradakay (Mordecai):

"All the malak (king) ibaday (servants), and the im (nation / people) of the malak (king) madayanawath (provinces), yadai (know), that whoever, whether ayash (man / husband) or ayashah (woman / wife), bawaa (come) to the malak (king) into the inner chatzar (court) without being qaraa (called), there is achad (one) dath (law) for him, that he be put to mawath (death), bad (except) those to whom the malak (king) might yashat (hold) out the zahab (gold) scepter, that he may chayah (live). I have not been qaraa (called) to bawaa (come) in to the malak (king) these shalawashayam (thirty) yawam (day)."
They nagad (told) to Maradakay (Mordecai) Asathar (Esther's) dabaray (words).

Then Maradakay (Mordecai) asked them shawab (turn back / repent) answer to Asathar (Esther), "Don't damah (think) to yourself that you will malat (escape) in the malak (king) bayath (house) any more than all the Yahawaday (Jews).

For if you remain charash (silent) now, then relief and hatzalah (deliverance) will come to the Yahawaday (Jews) from achar (other) maqawam (place), but you and your ab (father) bayath (house) will abad (destroy / perish). Who yadai (knows) if you haven't nagai (come) to the malakawath (kingdom) for such a ith (time) as this?"
Then Asathar (Esther) asked them to shawab (turn back / repent) Maradakay (Mordecai),

"Yalak (go), kanas (gather) together all the Yahawaday (Jews) who are matzaa (present) in Shawashan (Shushan), and tzawam (fast) for me, and neither akal (eat) nor shathah (drinks) shalawash (three) yamayam (days), layal (night) or yawam (day). I and my nairah (maidens) will also tzawam (fast) the same kan (for sure). Then I will bawaa (come) in to the malak (king), which is against the dath (law); and if I abad (destroy / perish), I abad (destroy / perish)."
So Maradakay (Mordecai) went his ibar (pass over/through), and ishah (make) according to all that Asathar (Esther) had tzawah (commanded) him.

Now it happened on the shalayashay (third) yawam (day) that Asathar (Esther) labash (put) on her malakawath (royal) clothing, and imad (stood) in the inner chatzar (court) of the malak (king) bayath (house), next to the malak (king) bayath (house). The malak (king) yashab (inhabit/dwell) on his malakawath (royal) kasaa (throne) in the malakawath (royal) bayath (house), next to the pathach (entrance) of the bayath (house).

When the malak (king) raah (see) Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen) imad (standing) in the chatzar (court), she nashaa (lift) favor in his iyan (eye); and the malak (king) yashat (held) out to Asathar (Esther) the zahab (gold) scepter that was in his yad (hand). So Asathar (Esther) qarab (come close) near, and nagai (touched) the raash (head) of the scepter.

Then the malak (king) asked her, "What would you like, malakah (queen) Asathar (Esther)? What is your baqashah (request)? It shall be nathan (give) you even to the chatzay (half) of the malakawath (kingdom)."

Asathar (Esther) amar (spoke), "If it seems tawab (good / proper function) to the malak (king), let the malak (king) and Haman (Haman) bawaa (come) today to the mashathah (banquet) that I ishah (make) prepared for him."

Then the malak (king) amar (spoke), "Bring Haman (Haman) mahar (quickly), so that it may be ishah (make) as Asathar (Esther) has dabar (word / matter)." So the malak (king) and Haman (Haman) bawaa (come) to the mashathah (banquet) that Asathar (Esther) ishah (make) prepared.

The malak (king) amar (spoke) to Asathar (Esther) at the mashathah (banquet) of yayan (wine), "What is your shaalah (petition)? It shall be nathan (give) you. What is your baqashah (request)? Even to the chatzay (half) of the malakawath (kingdom) it shall be ishah (make)."
Then Asathar (Esther) inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke), "My shaalah (petition) and my baqashah (request) is this.

If I matzaa (have) found favor in the iyan (eye) of the malak (king), and if it tawab (good / proper function) the malak (king) to nathan (give) my shaalah (petition) and to ishah (make) my baqashah (request), let the malak (king) and Haman (Haman) bawaa (come) to the mashathah (banquet) that I will ishah (make) for them, and I will ishah (make) machar (tomorrow) as the malak (king) has dabar (word / matter)."

Then Haman (Haman) yatzaa (go out / come out) out that yawam (day) shamach (joyful) and tawab (good / proper function) of lab (heart), but when Haman (Haman) raah (see) Maradakay (Mordecai) in the malak (king) shair (gate), that he didn't qawam (rise up) up nor zawai (move) for him, he was malaa (filled) with chamah (wrath) against Maradakay (Mordecai).
Nevertheless Haman (Haman) apaq (restrained) himself, and bawaa (come) bayath (house). There, he shalach (send) and bawaa (come) for his ahab (love) and Zarash (Zeresh) his ayashah (woman / wife).

Haman (Haman) recounted to them the kabawad (glory) of his riches, the rab (multitude) of his ban (son), all the things in which the malak (king) had gadal (promoted) him, and how he had nashaa (lift) him above the sharayam (princes) and ibaday (servants) of the malak (king).

Haman (Haman) also amar (spoke), "Yes, Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen) bawaa (come) no man come in with the malak (king) to the mashathah (banquet) that she ishah (make) prepared but myself; and machar (tomorrow) I am also qaraa (called) by her together with the malak (king).
Yet all this shawah (avails) me nothing, so ith (long) as I raah (see) Maradakay (Mordecai) the Yahawaday (Jew) sitting at the malak (king) shair (gate)."

Then Zarash (Zeresh) his ayashah (woman / wife) and all his ahab (love) amar (spoke) to him, "Let a itz (gallows) be ishah (make) chamashayam (fifty) amah (cubits) gabah (high), and in the baqar (morning) amar (spoke) to the malak (king) about thalah (hanging) Maradakay (Mordecai) on it. Then bawaa (come) in merrily with the malak (king) to the mashathah (banquet)." This yatab (pleased) Haman (Haman), so he ishah (make) the itz (gallows) ishah (make).

On that layal (night), the malak (king) couldn't shanah (sleep). He commanded the sapar (book / scribed document) of zakaranawath (records) of the dabaray (chronicles) to be bawaa (come), and they were qaraa (called) to the malak (king).

It was matzaa (found) kathab (write) that Maradakay (Mordecai) had nagad (told) of Bagathan (Bigthana) and Tharash (Teresh), shanayam (two) of the malak (king) sarayasay (eunuchs), who were doorkeepers, who had tried to shalach (send) yad (hand) on the malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus).

The malak (king) amar (spoke), "What honor and gadawalah (dignity) ishah (make) been bestowed on Maradakay (Mordecai) for this?" Then the malak (king) nairay (servants) who attended him amar (spoke), "Nothing ishah (make) been done for him."

The malak (king) amar (spoke), "Who is in the chatzar (court)?" Now Haman (Haman) bawaa (come) come into the chayatzawan (outer) chatzar (court) of the malak (king) bayath (house), to amar (spoke) to the malak (king) about thalah (hanging) Maradakay (Mordecai) on the itz (gallows) that he had kawan (prepared) for him.
The malak (king) nairay (servants) amar (spoke) to him, "Behold, Haman (Haman) imad (stands) in the chatzar (court)." The malak (king) amar (spoke), "bawaa (come) him come in."

So Haman (Haman) bawaa (come) in. The malak (king) amar (spoke) to him, "What shall be ishah (make) to the ayash (man / husband) whom the malak (king) delights to honor?" Now Haman (Haman) amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), "Who would the malak (king) chapatz (delight) to honor more than myself?"
Haman (Haman) amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "For the ayash (man / husband) whom the malak (king) chapatz (delights) to honor,

Let malakawath (royal) labawash (clothing) be bawaa (come) which the malak (king) uses to labash (wear), and the sawas (horse) that the malak (king) rakab (rides) on, and on the raash (head) of which a kathar (crown) malakawath (royal) is nathan (give).

Let the labawash (clothing) and the sawas (horse) be nathan (give) to the yad (hand) of ayash (man / husband) of the malak (king) most paratham (noble) sharay (princes), that they may labash (array) the ayash (man / husband) whom the malak (king) chapatz (delights) to honor with them, and have him rakab (ride) on horseback through the iyar (city) square, and qaraa (called) panayam (face) him, ‘Thus shall it be ishah (make) to the ayash (man / husband) whom the malak (king) chapatz (delights) to honor!'"

Then the malak (king) amar (spoke) to Haman (Haman), "Hurry and laqach (take / seize) the labawash (clothing) and the sawas (horse), as you have dabar (word / matter), and ishah (make) this for Maradakay (Mordecai) the Yahawaday (Jew), who yashab (inhabit/dwell) at the malak (king) shair (gate). Let nothing napal (fall / be cast down) of all that you have dabar (word / matter)."

Then Haman (Haman) laqach (take / seize) the labawash (clothing) and the sawas (horse), and labash (arrayed) Maradakay (Mordecai), and had him rakab (ride) through the iyar (city) square, and qaraa (called) panayam (face) him, "Thus shall it be ishah (make) to the ayash (man / husband) whom the malak (king) chapatz (delights) to honor!"
Maradakay (Mordecai) shawab (turn back / repent) back to the malak (king) shair (gate), but Haman (Haman) hurried to his bayath (house), abal (mourning) and having his raash (head) chapah (covered).

Haman (Haman) recounted to Zarash (Zeresh) his ayashah (woman / wife) and all his ahab (love) everything that had qarah (happened) to him. Then his chakam (wise) men and Zarash (Zeresh) his ayashah (woman / wife) amar (spoke) to him, "If Maradakay (Mordecai), panayam (face) whom you have chalal (begun) to napal (fall / be cast down), is of Jewish descent, you will not yakal (prevail) against him, but you will napal (fall / be cast down) napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (face) him."

While they were yet dabar (word / matter) with him, the malak (king) sarayasay (eunuchs) nagai (came), and hurried to bawaa (come) Haman (Haman) to the mashathah (banquet) that Asathar (Esther) ishah (make) prepared.
So the malak (king) and Haman (Haman) bawaa (come) to shathah (drinks) with Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen).

The malak (king) amar (spoke) again to Asathar (Esther) on the shanay (second) yawam (day) at the mashathah (banquet) of yayan (wine), "What is your shaalah (petition), malakah (queen) Asathar (Esther)? It shall be nathan (give) you. What is your baqashah (request)? Even to the chatzay (half) of the malakawath (kingdom) it shall be ishah (make)."

Then Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen) inah (answer / respond), "If I matzaa (have) found favor in your iyan (eye), O malak (king), and if it tawab (good / proper function) the malak (king), let my napash (soul) be nathan (give) me at my shaalah (petition), and my im (nation / people) at my baqashah (request).

For we are makar (sold), I and my im (nation / people), to be destroyed, to be harag (kill), and to abad (destroy / perish). But if we had been makar (sold) for ibadayam (bondservants) and bondmaids, I would have held my charash (peace), although the tzar (oppressor / distressor) could not have compensated for the malak (king) loss."
Then malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) amar (spoke) to Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen), "Who is he, and where is he who dared malaa (presume) in his lab (heart) to ishah (make) so?"

Asathar (Esther) amar (spoke), "An ayash (man / husband) and an ayab (enemy), even this rai (wicked) Haman (Haman)!" Then Haman (Haman) was baith (afraid) panayam (face) the malak (king) and the malakah (queen).

The malak (king) qawam (rise up) in his chamah (wrath) from the mashathah (banquet) of yayan (wine) and went into the bayathan (palace) ganah (garden). Haman (Haman) imad (stood) up to baqash (make) request for his napash (soul) to Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen); for he raah (see) that there was rai (evil) kalah (complete / finish) against him by the malak (king).

Then the malak (king) shawab (turn back / repent) out of the bayathan (palace) ganah (garden) into the bayath (house) of the mashathah (banquet) of yayan (wine); and Haman (Haman) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen on the couch where Asathar (Esther) was. Then the malak (king) amar (spoke), "Will he even assault the malakah (queen) in front of me in the bayath (house)?" As the dabar (word / matter) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the malak (king) pah (mouth), they chapah (covered) Haman (Haman's) panayam (face).

Then Charabawanaa (Harbonah), achad (one) of the sarayasayam (eunuchs) who were with the malak (king) amar (spoke), "Behold, the itz (gallows) chamashayam (fifty) amah (cubits) gabah (high), which Haman (Haman) ishah (make) made for Maradakay (Mordecai), who dabar (word / matter) tawab (good / proper function) for the malak (king), is imad (standing) at Haman (Haman's) bayath (house)." The malak (king) amar (spoke), "thalah (hang) him on it!"
So they hanged Haman (Haman) on the itz (gallows) that he had kawan (prepared) for Maradakay (Mordecai). Then was the malak (king) chamah (wrath) shakak (pacified).

On that yawam (day), malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) nathan (give) the bayath (house) of Haman (Haman), the Yahawaday (Jews)' tzarar (enemy), to Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen). Maradakay (Mordecai) bawaa (come) panayam (face) the malak (king); for Asathar (Esther) had nagad (told) what he was to her.

The malak (king) sawar (took) off his tabaith (ring), which he ibar (pass over/through) taken from Haman (Haman), and nathan (give) it to Maradakay (Mordecai). Asathar (Esther) shawam (place / establish / appoint) Maradakay (Mordecai) over the bayath (house) of Haman (Haman).

Asathar (Esther) dabar (word / matter) yet again panayam (face) the malak (king), and napal (fall / be cast down) down at his ragal (feet / foot), and begged him with bakah (tears) to ibar (pass over/through) away the rai (mischief) of Haman (Haman) the agagay (agagite), and his machashabah (device) that he had chashab (devised) against the Yahawaday (Jews).
Then the malak (king) yashat (held) out to Asathar (Esther) the zahab (gold) scepter. So Asathar (Esther) qawam (rise up), and imad (stood) panayam (face) the malak (king).

She amar (spoke), "If it pleases the malak (king), and if I matzaa (have) found favor in his panayam (face), and the thing seem kashar (right) to the malak (king), and I am pleasing in his iyan (eye), let it be kathab (write) to shawab (turn back / repent) the saparayam (letters) machashabah (devised) by Haman (Haman), the ban (son) of Madathaa (Hammedatha) the agagay (agagite), which he kathab (write) to abad (destroy / perish) the Yahawaday (Jews) who are in all the malak (king) madayanawath (provinces).

For ayak (how) yakal (can) I endure to raah (see) the rai (evil) that would matzaa (come) to my im (nation / people)? Ayak (how) yakal (can) I endure to raah (see) the abadan (destruction) of my relatives?"

Then malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus) amar (spoke) to Asathar (Esther) the malakah (queen) and to Maradakay (Mordecai) the Yahawaday (Jew), "See, I nathan (give) given Asathar (Esther) the bayath (house) of Haman (Haman), and him they have hanged on the itz (gallows), because he shalach (send) his yad (hand) on the Yahawaday (Jews).

Kathab (write) also to the Yahawaday (Jews), as it pleases you, in the malak (king) sham (name), and chatham (seal) it with the malak (king) tabaith (ring); for the kathab (write) which is kathab (write) in the malak (king) sham (name), and chatham (sealed) with the malak (king) tabaith (ring), may not be shawab (turn back / repent) by any man."

Then the malak (king) saparay (scribes) were qaraa (called) at that ith (time), in the shalayashay (third) chadash (month) Sayawan (Sivan), on the isharayam (twenty) - third day of the chadash (month); and it was kathab (write) according to all that Maradakay (Mordecai) tzawah (commanded) to the Yahawaday (Jews), and to the satraps, and the pachawath (governors) and sharay (princes) of the madayanawath (provinces) which are from Hadaw (India) to Kawash (Ethiopia), one maah (hundred) isharayam (twenty) - shabai (seven) madayanawath (provinces), to every madayanah (province) according to its kathab (write), and to every im (nation / people) in their lashawan (tongue / language), and to the Yahawaday (Jews) in their kathab (write), and in their lashawan (tongue / language).

He kathab (write) in the sham (name) of malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), and chatham (sealed) it with the malak (king) tabaith (ring), and shalach (send) saparayam (letters) by courier on horseback, rakab (riding) on royal horses that were ban (son) from swift steeds.

In those letters, the malak (king) nathan (give) the Yahawaday (Jews) who were in every iyar (city) to qahal (gather) themselves together, and to defend their napash (soul), to shamad (destroy), to harag (kill), and to cause to abad (destroy / perish), all the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the im (nation / people) and madayanah (province) that would tzawar (assault) them, their little tap (ones) and nashayam (women), and to plunder their bazaz (possessions),

On achad (one) yawam (day) in all the madayanawath (provinces) of malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), on the thirteenth day of the shanayam (two) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Adar (Adar).

A parashagan (copy) of the letter, that the dath (decree) should be nathan (give) out in every madayanah (province), was galah (published) to all the imayam (peoples), that the Yahawaday (Jews) should be ithawad (ready) for that yawam (day) to naqam (avenge) themselves on their ayab (enemy).

So the couriers who rakab (rode) on royal horses yatzaa (go out / come out) out, hastened and dachap (pressed) on by the malak (king) commandment. The dabar (word / matter) was nathan (give) out in the citadel of Shawashan (Susa).

Maradakay (Mordecai) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of the panayam (face) of the malak (king) in malakawath (royal) labawash (clothing) of thakalath (blue) and chawar (white), and with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) itarah (crown) of zahab (gold), and with a robe of bawatz (fine) linen and aragaman (purple); and the iyar (city) of Shawashan (Susa) tzahal (shouted) and was shamach (glad).
The Yahawaday (Jews) had awarah (light), shamachah (gladness), shamachah (joy), and honor.

In every madayanah (province), and in every iyar (city), wherever the malak (king) commandment and his dabar (word / matter) nagai (came), the Yahawaday (Jews) had shashawan (gladness), shamachah (joy), a mashathah (feast), and a tawab (good / proper function) yawam (day). Many from among the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land) yahad (became) Jews; for the pachad (fear / dread) of the mathayahadayam (jews) was napal (fall / be cast down) on them.

Now in the shanayam (two) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Adar (Adar), on the thirteenth yawam (day) of the month, when the malak (king) commandment and his dath (decree) nagai (drew) near to be ishah (make) in execution, on the yawam (day) that the ayabay (enemies) of the Yahawaday (Jews) shabar (hoped) to conquer them, (but it was hapak (turned) out the opposite happened, that the Yahawaday (Jews) conquered those who shanaa (hate) them),

The Yahawaday (Jews) qahal (gathered) themselves together in their iyar (cities) throughout all the madayanawath (provinces) of the malak (king) Achashawarawash (Ahasuerus), to shalach (send) yad (hand) on those who wanted to rai (harm) them. No ayash (man / husband) could withstand them, because the pachad (fear / dread) of them napal (fall / be cast down) fallen on all the imayam (people).

All the sharay (princes) of the madayanawath (provinces), the satraps, the pachawath (governors), and those who did the malak (king) business nashaa (lift) the Yahawaday (Jews), because the pachad (fear / dread) of Maradakay (Mordecai) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen on them.

For Maradakay (Mordecai) was gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in the malak (king) bayath (house), and his shamai (fame) halak (move) out throughout all the madayanawath (provinces); for the ayash (man / husband) Maradakay (Mordecai) halak (move) greater and greater.

The Yahawaday (Jews) nakah (struck) all their ayab (enemy) with the makah (stroke) of the charab (sword), and with harag (kill) and abadan (destruction), and ishah (make) what they wanted to those who shanaa (hate) them.
In the citadel of Shawashan (Susa), the Yahawaday (Jews) harag (kill) and abad (destroy / perish) chamash (five) maah (hundred) ayash (man / husband).
They killed Parashanadathaa (Parshandatha), Dalapawan (Dalphon), Asapathaa (Aspatha),
Pawarathaa (Poratha), Adalayaa (Adalia), Arayadathaa (Aridatha),
Paramashathaa (Parmashta), Arayasay (Arisai), Arayaday (Aridai), and Wayazathaa (Vaizatha),
The ishar (ten) banay (sons) of Haman (Haman) the ban (son) of Madathaa (Hammedatha), the yahawadayam (jews) tzarar (enemy), but they didn't shalach (send) their yad (hand) on the plunder.
On that yawam (day), the masapar (number) of those who were harag (kill) in the citadel of Shawashan (Susa) was bawaa (come) panayam (face) the malak (king).
