Qawam (rise up), Yahawah, in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting). Nashaa (lift) up yourself against the ibarah (rage) of my tzarar (adversaries). Iwar (rouse / awaken) for me. You have tzawah (commanded) mashapat (judgment).
Let the idah (congregation) of the laamayam (peoples) surround you. Rule over them on marawam (high).
Yahawah administers dayan (judge) to the imayam (peoples). Dayan (judge) me, Yahawah, according to my tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), and to my tham (integrity) that is in me.

Oh let the rai (wickedness) of the rashai (wicked) gamar (come) to an end, but kawan (establish) the tzadayaq (righteous); their kalayawath (minds) and labawath (hearts) are searched by the tzadayaq (righteous) Alahayam.
My magan (shield) is with Alahayam, who yashai (salvation) the yashar (upright) in lab (heart).
Alahayam is a tzadayaq (righteous) shapat (judge / judgement), yes, a Al who has zaim (indignation) every yawam (day).
If a shawab (turn back / repent) doesn't relent, he will latash (sharpen) his charab (sword); he has bent and strung his qashath (bow).
He has also kawan (prepared) for himself the kalay (instruments) of mawath (death). He pail (makes) ready his flaming chatz (arrows).
Behold, he chabal (travails) with awan (iniquity). Yes, he has harah (conceived) imal (mischief), and yalad (birth / begot) forth falsehood.
He has chapar (dug) a hole, and napal (fall / be cast down) fallen into the shachath (pit) which he pail (made).
The imal (trouble) he causes shall shawab (turn back / repent) to his own raash (head). His chamas (violence) shall yarad (come) down on the qadaqad (crown) of his own head.
I will give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah according to his tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), and will sing zamar (praise) to the sham (name) of Yahawah Most ilayawan (Ilayawan).
Yahawah, our Adawan, how majestic is your sham (name) in all the aratz (Earth/land), who nathan (give) set your glory above the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens)!

From the lips of iwalalayam (babes) and infants you have yasad (established) iz (strength / might / refuge), because of your tzarar (adversaries), that you might silence the ayab (enemy) and the avenger.
When I raah (see) your shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), the maishah (work) of your atzabai (fingers), the yarach (moon) and the kawakabayam (stars), which you have kawan (ordained);
What is anawash (man), that you zakar (remember) of him? What is the ban (son) of adam (man), that you care for him?
For you have made him a mait (little) chasar (lower) than Alahayam, and itar (crowned) him with kabawad (glory) and honor.
You mashal (rule/have dominion) him ruler over the maishay (works) of your yad (hand). You have shayath (put / appoint / make) all things under his ragal (feet / foot):
All tzanaa (sheep) and cattle, yes, and the animals of the shadah (field),
The tzapawar (birds) of the sky, the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), and whatever passes ibar (pass over/through) the arachawath (paths) of the yamayam (seas).
Yahawah, our Adawan, how majestic is your sham (name) in all the aratz (Earth/land)!
I will give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah with my whole lab (heart). I will sapar (book) of all your marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous).
I will be shamach (glad) and ilatz (rejoice) in you. I will sing zamar (praise) to your sham (name), O Most ilayawan (Ilayawan).
When my ayab (enemy) shawab (turn back / repent) achawar (back), they kashal (stumble / stagger) and abad (destroy / perish) in your panayam (face).
For you ishah (make) maintained my mashapat (just) dayan (judge). You yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) shapat (judge / judgement) righteously.
You have gair (rebuked) the gawayam (nations). You abad (destroy / perish) destroyed the rashai (wicked). You have machah (blotted) out their sham (name) iwalam (forever) and iwalam (forever).
The ayab (enemy) is overtaken by endless ruin. The very zakar (remember) of the cities which you have overthrown abad (destroy / perish) perished.
But Yahawah yashab (inhabit/dwell) iwalam (forever). He has kawan (prepared) his kasaa (throne) for mashapat (judgment).
He will shapat (judge / judgement) the thabal (world) in tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). He will administer dayan (judge) to the laamayam (peoples) in uprightness.
Yahawah will also be a high tower for the dak (oppressed); a high tower in ithawath (times) of tzarah (trouble).
Those who yadai (know) your sham (name) will batach (put) their trust in you, for you, Yahawah, have not forsaken those who darash (seek) you.
Sing zamaraw (praises) to Yahawah, who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Tzayawan (Zion), and nagad (declare) among the imayam (people) what he has done.
For he who avenges dam (blood) zakar (remember) them. He doesn't shakach (forget) the tzaiqah (cry) of the afflicted.
Have chanan (showing favor) on me, Yahawah. Raah (see) my inay (affliction) by those who shanaa (hate) me, and rawam (will lift up) me up from the shairay (gates) of mawath (death);
That I may show sapar (book) all your thahalah (praise). In the shairay (gates) of the banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion), I will gayal (rejoice) in your yashawaih (salvation).
The gawayam (nations) have tabai (sunk) down in the shachath (pit) that they ishah (make). In the rashath (net) which they taman (hid), their own ragal (feet / foot) is lakad (taken).

Yahawah yadai (has) made himself known. He ishah (make) executed mashapat (judgment). The rashai (wicked) is naqash (snared) by the pail (work) of his own kap (hands). Hagayawan (meditation). Salah (selah).
The rashai (wicked) shall be shawab (turn back / repent) back to shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), even all the gawayam (nations) that shakach (forget) Alahayam.
For the abayawan (needy) shall not natzach (always) be shakach (forgotten), nor the thaqawah (hope) of the abayawan (poor) abad (destroy / perish) id (until / as far as).
Qawam (rise up), Yahawah! Don't let anawash (man) izaz (prevail). Let the gawayam (nations) be shapat (judge / judgement) in your panayam (face).
Shayath (put / appoint / make) them in mawaraa (fear), Yahawah. Let the gawayam (nations) yadai (know) that they are only anawash (men). Salah (selah).
Why do you imad (stand) rachawaq (far) off, Yahawah? Why do you ilam (hide) yourself in ithawath (times) of tzarah (trouble)?
In arrogance, the rashai (wicked) hunt down the weak. They are thapash (caught) in the schemes that they chashab (devise).
For the rashai (wicked) halal (praise) of his napash (soul) cravings. He blesses the batzai (greedy), and condemns Yahawah.
The rashai (wicked), in the gabah (pride) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), has no room in his mazamah (thoughts) for Alahayam.
His darak (ways) are prosperous at all ith (times). He is haughty, and your mashapat (laws) are far from his sight. As for all his tzarar (adversaries), he sneers at them.
He amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), "I shall not be mawat (shaken). For dawar (generation / age / period) I shall have no rai (trouble)."
His pah (mouth) is malaa (full) of alah (curse / oath), maramah (deceit), and oppression. Under his lashawan (tongue / language) is imal (mischief) and awan (iniquity).
He lies in maarab (wait) near the chatzarayam (villages). From ambushes, he harag (kill) the naqay (innocent). His iyan (eye) are secretly set against the helpless.
He lurks in masathar (secret) as a aray (lion) in his ambush. He lies in arab (wait) to chatap (catch) the helpless. He catches the helpless, when he mashak (draws) him in his rashath (net).
The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They napal (fall / be cast down) under his itzawam (strength).
He amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), "Al has shakach (forgotten). He sathar (hides) his panayam (face). He will never raah (see) it."
Qawam (rise up), Yahawah! Al, nashaa (lift) up your yad (hand)! Don't shakach (forget) the helpless.
Why does the rashai (wicked) person condemn Alahayam, and amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), "Alahayam won't call me into account?"
But you do nabat (see) imal (trouble) and kais (grief). You nathan (give) it to take it into your yad (hand). You izar (help) the victim and the yathawam (fatherless).
Shabar (break) the zarawai (arm) of the rashai (wicked). As for the rashai (evil) man, darash (seek) out his rai (wickedness) until you matzaa (find) bal (none).
Yahawah is malak (king) id (until / as far as) and iwalam (forever)! The gawayam (nations) will abad (destroy / perish) out of his aratz (Earth/land).
Yahawah, you have shamai (hearken / hear) the thaawah (desire) of the inaw (humble). You will kawan (prepare) their lab (heart). You will cause your azan (ear) to qashab (hear),
To shapat (judge / judgement) the yathawam (fatherless) and the dak (oppressed), that anawash (man) who is of the aratz (Earth/land) may terrify no more.
In Yahawah, I take chasah (refuge). How can you amar (spoke) to my napash (soul), "nawad (flee) as a tzapawar (bird) to your har (mountain)!"

For, behold, the rashai (wicked) darak (bend) their qashath (bows). They kawan (set) their chatz (arrows) on the yathar (strings), that they may yarah (shoot) in apal (darkness) at the yashar (upright) in lab (heart).
If the shathawath (foundations) are haras (destroyed), what can the tzadayaq (righteous) pail (do)?

Yahawah is in his qadash (set apart / make holy) hayakal (temple). Yahawah is on his kasaa (throne) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens). His iyan (eye) observe. His ipaip (eyes) bachan (examine) the banay (children) of adam (men).
Yahawah bachan (examines) the tzadayaq (righteous), but the rashai (wicked) and him who ahab (love) chamas (violence) his napash (soul) shanaa (hate).
On the rashai (wicked) he will matar (rain) blazing coals; ash (fire), sulfur, and scorching rawach (spirit / wind) shall be the manath (portion) of their kawas (cup).
For Yahawah is tzadayaq (righteous). He ahab (love) tzadaqah (righteousness). The yashar (upright) shall chazah (see) his panayam (face).
Yashai (salvation), Yahawah; for the chasayad (godly) man gamar (ceases). For the aman (believe / have faith) fail from among the banay (children) of adam (men).
Everyone shawaa (vanity) to his neighbor. They dabar (word / matter) with chalaqah (flattering) shapah (lips), and with a lab (heart) lab (heart).
May Yahawah karath (cut) off all chalaqah (flattering) shapathay (lips), and the lashawan (tongue / language) that boasts,
Who have amar (spoke), "With our lashawan (tongue / language) we will gabar (prevail). Our shapah (lips) are our own. Who is Adawan over us?"

"Because of the shad (oppression) of the weak and because of the anaqah (groaning) of the abayawan (needy), I will now qawam (rise up)," amar (spoke) Yahawah; "I will shayath (put / appoint / make) him in yashai (salvation) from those who malign him."
The amarawath (words) of Yahawah are flawless amarawath (words), as kasap (silver) tzarap (refined) in a clay ilayal (furnace), zaqaq (purified) shabaithayam (seven) times.
You will shamar (keep/guard) them, Yahawah. You will natzar (preserve) them from zaw (this) dawar (generation / age / period) iwalam (forever).
The rashai (wicked) halak (move) on sabayab (surrounding) side, when what is vile is rawam (will lift up) among the banay (sons) of men.
How long, Yahawah? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?
How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?
Behold, and answer me, Yahawah, my Alahayam. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;
Lest my enemy inah (answer / respond), "I nabat (have) prevailed against him;" Lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.
But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart yagayalaw (rejoices) in your salvation.
I will shayar (sing) to Yahawah, because he has been gamal (good) to me.

The nabal (fool) has amar (spoke) in his lab (heart), "There is no Alahayam." They are shachath (corrupt). They have thaib (done) abominable ilayalah (works). There is none who ishah (make) tawab (good / proper function).
Yahawah shaqap (looked) down from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) on the banay (children) of adam (men), to raah (see) if there were any who shakal (understood), who darash (sought) after Alahayam.
They have all sawar (gone) aside. They have yachad (together) alach (become) corrupt. There is none who ishah (make) tawab (good / proper function), no, not achad (one).
Have all the pailay (workers) of awan (iniquity) no yadai (knowledge), who akal (eat) up my im (nation / people) as they akal (eat) lacham (bread), and don't qaraa (called) on Yahawah?
There they were in pachad (fear / dread) pachad (fear / dread), for Alahayam is in the dawar (generation / age / period) of the tzadayaq (righteous).
You frustrate the plan of the inay (poor), because Yahawah is his machasah (refuge).

Oh that the yashawaih (salvation) of Yashar-Al (Israel) would come out of Tzayawan (Zion)! When Yahawah restores the fortunes of his im (nation / people), then Yaiqab (Jacob) shall gayal (rejoice), and Yashar-Al (Israel) shall be shamach (glad).
Yahawah, who shall gawar (dwell) in your ahal (sanctuary)? Who shall live on your qadash (set apart / make holy) har (mountain)?
He who halak (move) blamelessly pail (does) what is tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), and dabar (word / matter) amath (truth) in his labab (heart);
He who doesn't ragal (slander) with his lashawan (tongue / language), nor ishah (make) rai (evil) to his rai (neigbor/another person), nor nashaa (lift) slurs against his fellow qarawab (man);

In whose iyan (eye) a maas (vile) man is bazah (despised), but who honors those who yaraa (fear) Yahawah; he who keeps an shabai (swear / take oath) even when it raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), and doesn't mawar (change);

He who doesn't nathan (give) out his kasap (money) for nashak (usury), nor laqach (take / seize) a shachad (bribe) against the naqay (innocent). He who ishah (make) these things shall iwalam (forever) be mawat (shaken).
Shamar (keep/guard) me, Al, for in you do I take chasah (refuge).
My soul, you have amar (spoke) to Yahawah, "You are my Adawan. Apart from you I have no tawab (good / proper function) thing."
As for the qadawashayam (saints) who are in the aratz (Earth/land), they are the adayar (excellent) ones in whom is all my chapatz (delight).

Their itzabath (sorrows) shall be rabah (multiplied) who give gifts to achar (other) Alahayam. Their drink offerings of dam (blood) I will not nasak (offer), nor nashaa (lift) their sham (name) on my shapah (lips).
Yahawah assigned my manah (portion) and my kawas (cup). You made my gawaral (lot) secure.
The chabalayam (lines) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen to me in naiyam (pleasant) places. Yes, I have a shapar (good) nachalah (inheritance).
I will barak (blessed) Yahawah, who has given me yaitz (counsel). Yes, my kalayah (heart) yasar (instructs) me in the layal (night) seasons.
I have set Yahawah thamayad (always) before me. Because he is at my right yamayan (right hand), I shall not be mawat (moved).
Therefore my lab (heart) is shamach (glad), and my tongue gayal (rejoices). My bashar (flesh) shall also shakan (place) in safety.
For you will not izab (leave) my napash (soul) in shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), neither will you allow your chasayad (holy) one to raah (see) shachath (corruption).

You yadai (will) show me the arach (path) of chay (life). In your panayam (face) is shabai (fullness) of shamachah (joy). In your right yamayan (right hand) there are naimawath (pleasures) forevermore.
Shamai (hearken / hear), Yahawah, my tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) plea; azan (ear) ear to my thapalah (prayer), that doesn't go out of deceitful shapathay (lips).
Let my mashapat (sentence) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from your panayam (face). Let your iyan (eye) chazah (look) on mayashar (equity).

You have bachan (proved) my lab (heart). You paqad (visit) visited me in the layal (night). You have tzarap (tried) me, and matzaa (found) nothing. I have resolved that my pah (mouth) shall not disobey.
As for the pailawath (works) of adam (men), by the dabar (word / matter) of your shapah (lips), I have shamar (keep/guard) myself from the arachawath (ways) of the violent.
My ashar (who/that) have thamak (held) fast to your maigal (paths). My paim (feet) have not mawat (slipped).
I have qaraa (called) on you, for you will inah (answer / respond) me, Al. Natah (turn) your azan (ear) to me. Shamai (hearken / hear) my amarah (sayings).
Palah (show) your marvelous loving chasad (grace), you who yashai (salvation) those who take chasah (refuge) by your right yamayan (right hand) from their mathaqawamamayam (enemies).
Shamar (keep/guard) me as the ayashawan (apple) of your banath (daughter). Sathar (hide) me under the tzal (shadow) of your kanap (wings),
From the rashai (wicked) who shadad (oppress) me, my napash (soul) ayab (enemy), who surround me.
They sagar (close) up their callous hearts. With their pah (mouth) they dabar (word / matter) gaawath (proudly).
They have now surrounded us in our ashar (who/that). They shayath (put / appoint / make) their iyan (eye) to cast us down to the aratz (Earth/land).
He is damayawan (like) a aray (lion) that is kasap (greedy) of his prey, as it were a young kapayar (lion) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in masathar (secret) places.
Qawam (rise up), Yahawah, confront him. Karai (cast) him down. Palat (deliver) my napash (soul) from the rashai (wicked) by your charab (sword);

From mathayam (men) by your yad (hand), Yahawah, from mathayam (men) of the chalad (world), whose chalaq (portion) is in this chay (life). You malaa (fill) the batan (belly) of your cherished ones. Your banayam (sons) shabai (have) plenty, and they store up wealth for their iwalal (children).
As for me, I shall chazah (see) your panayam (face) in tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). I shall be shabai (satisfied), when I qawatz (awake), with seeing your form.
I racham (show mercy / love) you, Yahawah, my chazaq (strength).

Yahawah is my salai (rock), my matzawad (fortress), and my deliverer; my Al, my tzawar (rock), in whom I take chasah (refuge); my magan (shield), and the qaran (horn) of my yashai (salvation), my high tower.
I qaraa (called) on Yahawah, who is halal (praise) to be praised; and I am yashai (salvation) from my ayab (enemy).
The chabalay (cords) of mawath (death) surrounded me. The nachalay (floods) of ungodliness made me baith (afraid).
The chabalay (cords) of shaawal (Sheol / afterlife) were around me. The mawaqashay (snares) of mawath (death) qadam (came) on me.

In my tzar (oppressor / distressor) I qaraa (called) on Yahawah, and shawai (cried) to my Alahayam. He shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice) out of his hayakal (temple). My cry panayam (face) him bawaa (come) into his azan (ear).

Then the aratz (Earth/land) gaish (shook) and raish (trembled). The mawasaday (foundations) also of the harayam (mountains) ragaz (quaked) and were gaish (shaken), because he was charah (hot with anger).
Ishan (smoke) ilah (go up / offer) out of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting). Akal (eat) ash (fire) came out of his pah (mouth). Gachalayam (coals) were bair (kindled) by it.
He natah (bowed) the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) also, and yarad (came) down. Irapal (thick) darkness was under his ragal (feet / foot).
He rakab (rode) on a karawab (cherub), and iwap (flying). Yes, he soared on the kanapay (wings) of the rawach (spirit / wind).
He shayath (put / appoint / make) chashak (darkness) his sathar (secret / hidden) place, his sakah (pavilion) around him, chashakah (darkness) of mayam (Waters), ib (thick) clouds of the skies.
At the nagah (brightness) before him his ib (thick) clouds ibar (pass over/through), hailstones and gachalay (coals) of ash (fire).
Yahawah also raim (thundered) in the sky. The Most ilayawan (Ilayawan) nathan (give) his qawal (sound / voice): hailstones and gachalay (coals) of ash (fire).
He shalach (send) out his chatz (arrows), and pawatz (scattered) them; Yes, great baraq (lightning) bolts, and routed them.

Then the apayaqay (channels) of mayam (Waters) raah (see). The mawasadawath (foundations) of the thabal (world) were laid bare at your gairah (rebuke), Yahawah, at the nashamah (breathing thing) of the rawach (spirit / wind) of your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).
He shalach (send) from on marawam (high). He laqach (take / seize) me. He mashah (Moses) me out of many mayam (Waters).
He natzal (delivered) me from my iz (strong) ayab (enemy), from those who shanaa (hate) me; for they were too amatz (mighty) for me.
They qadam (came) on me in the yawam (day) of my ayad (calamity), but Yahawah was my support.
He yatzaa (go out / come out) me forth also into a marachab (large) place. He chalatz (delivered) me, because he chapatz (delighted) in me.
Yahawah has gamal (rewarded) me according to my tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). According to the bar (cleanness) of my yad (hand) has he shawab (turn back / repent) me.
For I have shamar (keep/guard) the darakay (ways) of Yahawah, and have not wickedly departed from my Alahayam.
For all his mashapat (ordinances) were before me. I didn't sawar (put) away his chaqah (statutes) from me.
I was also blameless with him. I shamar (keep/guard) myself from my iwan (guilt/iniquity).
Therefore Yahawah has shawab (turn back / repent) me according to my tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), according to the bar (cleanness) of my yad (hand) in his eyesight.
With the chasayad (merciful) you will show yourself chasad (grace). With the thamayam (complete / whole) gabar (man), you will show yourself thamam (perfect).
With the barar (pure), you will show yourself barar (pure). With the iqash (crooked) you will show yourself shrewd.
For you will yashai (salvation) the inay (afflicted) im (nation / people), but the rawam (will lift up) iyanayam (eyes) you will shapal (bring) down.
For you will awar (light) my nayar (lamp), Yahawah. My Alahayam will nagah (light) up my chashak (darkness).
For by you, I advance rawatz (through) a gadawad (troop). By my Alahayam, I dalag (leap) over a shawar (wall).
As for Al, his darak (way) is thamayam (complete / whole). The amarah (sayings) of Yahawah is tzarap (tried). He is a magan (shield) to all those who take chasah (refuge) in him.
For who is Alawah, except Yahawah? Who is a tzawar (rock), zawalah (besides) our Alahayam,
The Al who arms me with chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and nathan (give) my darak (way) thamayam (complete / whole)?
He shawah (makes) my ragal (feet / foot) like deer's feet, and imad (sets) me on my bamah (high) places.
He teaches my yad (hand) to malachamah (war), so that my zarawai (arms) bend a qashath (bow) of bronze.
You nathan (give) also given me the magan (shield) of your yashai (salvation). Your right yamayan (right hand) sustains me. Your inawah (gentleness) rabah (has) made me great.
You have enlarged my tzaid (steps) under me, My qarasal (feet) have not maid (slipped).
I will radap (pursue) my ayab (enemy), and nashag (overtake) them. Neither will I shawab (turn back / repent) again until they are kalah (complete / finish).
I will machatz (crush / shatter) them through, so that they will not be yakal (able) to qawam (rise up). They shall napal (fall / be cast down) under my ragal (feet / foot).
For you have armed me with chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) to the malachamah (battle). You have karai (subdued) under me those who qawam (rise up) up against me.
You nathan (give) also made my ayab (enemy) turn their irap (neck) to me, that I might tzamath (cut) off those who shanaa (hate) me.
They shawai (cried), but there was none to yashai (salvation); even to Yahawah, but he didn't inah (answer / respond) them.
Then I shachaq (beat) them small as the ipar (dust) panayam (face) the rawach (spirit / wind). I rawaq (cast) them out as the tayat (mire) of the chawatzawath (streets).

You have palat (delivered) me from the rayabay (strivings) of the im (nation / people). You have shawam (place / establish / appoint) me the raash (head) of the gawayam (nations). A im (nation / people) whom I yadai (have) not known shall ibad (servant) me.
As soon as they shamai (hear) of me they shall shamai (hearken / hear) me. The foreigners shall kachash (submit) themselves to me.
The foreigners shall nabal (fade) away, and shall come trembling out of their masagarath (close) places.
Yahawah chay (life); and barak (blessed) be my tzawar (rock). Rawam (will lift up) be the Alahayam of my yashai (salvation),
Even the Al who executes vengeance for me, and dabar (word / matter) imayam (peoples) under me.
He rescues me from my ayab (enemy). Yes, you rawam (will lift up) me up above those who rawam (will lift up) up against me. You natzal (deliver) me from the chamas (violent) ayash (man / husband).
Therefore I will give yadah (thanks) to you, Yahawah, among the gawayam (nations), and will sing zamar (praises) to your sham (name).
He gadal (gives) great yashawaih (salvation) to his malak (king), and shows loving chasad (grace) to his mashayach (anointed one), to Dawad (David) and to his zarai (seed), forevermore.
The shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) sapar (book) the kabawad (glory) of Al. The expanse shows his handiwork.
Yawam (day) after yawam (day) they nabai (pour) forth amar (spoke), and layal (night) after layal (night) they display daith (knowledge).
There is no amar (spoke) nor dabar (word / matter), where their qawal (sound / voice) is not shamai (hearken / hear).

Their qaw (voice) yatzaa (go out / come out) gone out through all the aratz (Earth/land), their malah (words) to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the thabal (world). In them he has shawam (place / establish / appoint) a ahal (tent) for the shamash (sun),
Which is as a chathan (bridegroom) yatzaa (go out / come out) out of his room, like a strong gabawar (man) shawash (rejoicing) to rawatz (run) his course.

His mawatzaa (going) forth is from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), his thaqawapah (circuit) to its ends; There is nothing sathar (hidden) from its chamah (heat).

Yahawah thawarah (instruction) is thamayam (complete / whole), shawab (turn back / repent) the napash (soul). Yahawah idawath (testimony) is aman (believe / have faith), chakam (making) wise the pathay (simple).
Yahawah paqawaday (precepts) are yashar (upright), shamach (rejoicing) the lab (heart). Yahawah matzawah (commandment) is bar (pure), enlightening the iyanayam (eyes).
The yaraah (fear) of Yahawah is tahawar (clean), imad (enduring) id (until / as far as). Yahawah mashapatay (ordinances) are amath (truth), and tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) yachad (altogether).
More to be chamad (desired) are they than zahab (gold), yes, than much paz (fine) gold; sweeter also than dabash (honey) and the extract of the napath (honeycomb).
Moreover by them is your ibad (servant) zahar (warn). In shamar (keep/guard) them there is rab (great) iqab (award / effect after the cause).
Who can bayan (between) his shagayaawath (errors)? Forgive me from sathar (hidden) errors.

Chashak (darkness) back your ibad (servant) also from zad (presumptuous) sins. Let them not mashal (rule/have dominion) dominion over me. Then I will be thamam (upright). I will be naqah (clean/innocent) and innocent of rab (great) pashai (transgression).
Let the amaray (words) of my pah (mouth) and the hagayawan (meditation) of my lab (heart) be ratzawan (acceptable) in your panayam (face), Yahawah, my tzawar (rock), and my gaal (redeemer).
May Yahawah inah (answer / respond) you in the yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble). May the sham (name) of the Alahayam of Yaiqab (Jacob) shagab (set) you up on high,
Shalach (send) you izar (help) from the qadash (set apart / make holy), grant you support from Tzayawan (Zion),
Zakar (remember) all your manachah (offerings), and dashan (accept) your ilah (burnt) sacrifice. Salah (selah).
May He nathan (give) you your labab (heart's) desire, and fulfill all your itzah (counsel).
We will ranan (triumph) in your yashawaih (salvation). In the sham (name) of our Alahayam, we will dagal (set) up our banners. May Yahawah grant all your requests.

Now I yadai (know) that Yahawah yashai (salvation) his mashayach (anointed one). He will inah (answer / respond) him from his qadash (set apart / make holy) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), with the yashai (salvation) gabawarah (strength) of his right yamayan (right hand).
Some trust in rakab (chariots), and some in sawasayam (horses), but we trust the sham (name) of Yahawah our Alahayam.
They are karai (bowed) down and napal (fall / be cast down), but we qawam (rise up) up, and stand iwad (admonish/bear witness against).
Yashai (salvation), Yahawah! Let the malak (king) inah (answer / respond) us when we qaraa (called)!
The malak (king) shamach (rejoices) in your iz (strength / might / refuge), Yahawah! How maad (greatly) he gayal (rejoices) in your yashawaih (salvation)!
You nathan (give) given him his lab (heart) thaawah (desire), and have not withheld the arashath (request) of his shapah (lips). Salah (selah).
For you qadam (meet) him with the barakawath (blessings) of goodness. You shayath (put / appoint / make) a itarah (crown) of paz (fine) gold on his raash (head).
He shaal (asked) chay (life) of you, you nathan (give) it to him, even arak (length) of yamayam (days) iwalam (forever) and id (until / as far as).
His kabawad (glory) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in your yashawaih (salvation). You shawah (lay) honor and hadar (glory / majesty / splendor) on him.
For you shayath (put / appoint / make) him most blessed id (until / as far as). You shayath (put / appoint / make) him glad with joy in your panayam (face).
For the malak (king) batach (trusts) in Yahawah. Through the loving chasad (grace) of the Most ilayawan (Ilayawan), he shall not be mawat (moved).
Your yad (hand) will matzaa (find) out all of your ayab (enemy). Your right yamayan (right hand) will matzaa (find) out those who shanaa (hate) you.

You will shayath (put / appoint / make) them as a ash (fire) thanawar (furnace) in the ith (time) of your panayam (face). Yahawah will balai (swallow) them up in his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting). The ash (fire) shall akal (eat) them.
You will abad (destroy / perish) their descendants from the aratz (Earth/land), their posterity from among the banay (children) of adam (men).
For they natah (intended) rai (evil) against you. They plotted mazamah (evil) against you which cannot succeed.
For you will shayath (put / appoint / make) them turn their shakam (back), when you aim drawn bows at their panayam (face).
Be rawam (will lift up), Yahawah, in your iz (strength / might / refuge), so we will shayar (sing) and zamar (praise) your gabawarah (power).
My Al, my Al, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so rachawaq (far) from yashawaih (salvation) me, and from the dabaray (words) of my groaning?
My Alahayam, I qaraa (called) in the yawamam (by day), but you don't inah (answer / respond); in the layal (night) season, and am not dawamayah (silent).
But you are qadawash (holy), you who yashab (inhabit/dwell) the thahalawath (praises) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
Our ab (father) batach (trusted) in you. They batach (trusted), and you palat (delivered) them.
They zaiq (cried) to you, and were malat (delivered). They batach (trusted) in you, and were not disappointed.
But I am a thawalai (worm), and no ayash (man / husband); a charapah (reproach) of adam (men), and bazah (despised) by the adam (people).
All those who raah (see) me laig (mock) me. They insult me with their shapah (lips). They nawai (shake) their raash (head), saying,
"He galal (trusts) in Yahawah; let him palat (deliver) him. Let him rescue him, since he chapatz (delights) in him."
But you gayach (brought) me out of the batan (womb). You batach (made) me trust at my am (mother) shaday (breasts).
I was shalak (thrown) on you from my mother's racham (womb). You are my Al since my am (mother) batan (bore) me.
Don't be rachaq (far) from me, for tzarah (trouble) is qarawab (near). For there is none to izar (help).
Many parayam (bulls) have surrounded me. Abayar (strong) bulls of Bashan (Bashan) have encircled me.
They patzah (open) their pah (mouths) wide against me, aray (lions) tarap (tearing) prey and shaag (roaring).
I am shapak (poured) out like mayam (Waters). All my itzam (bones) are out of parad (joint). My lab (heart) is like dawanag (wax); it is masas (melted) thawak (midst) me.

My kach (strength / mighty / power) is yabash (dry land) up like a charash (potsherd). My lashawan (tongue / language) dabaq (sticks) to the roof of my malaqawach (mouth). You have shapath (brought) me into the ipar (dust) of mawath (death).
For kalabayam (dogs) have surrounded me. A idah (company) of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my yad (hand) and ragal (feet / foot).
I can sapar (book) all of my itzam (bones). They nabat (look) and raah (see) at me.
They chalaq (divide) my bagad (garments) among them. They napal (fall / be cast down) gawaral (lots) for my labawash (clothing).
But don't be rachaq (far) off, Yahawah. You are my help: hurry to izarah (help) me.
Natzal (deliver) my napash (soul) from the charab (sword), my precious life from the yad (hand) of the kalab (dog).
Yashai (salvation) me from the aray (lion's) pah (mouth)! Yes, from the qaranay (horns) of the wild oxen, you have inah (answer / respond) me.
I will sapar (book) your sham (name) to my ach (brother/kinsman). In the thawak (midst) of the qahal (assembly), I will halal (praise) you.
You who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, halal (praise) him! All you descendants of Yaiqab (Jacob), kabad (glorify) him! Gawar (stand) in awe of him, all you descendants of Yashar-Al (Israel)!

For he has not bazah (despised) nor shaqatz (abhorred) the inawath (affliction) of the inay (afflicted), Neither has he sathar (hidden) his panayam (face) from him; but when he shawai (cried) to him, he shamai (hearken / hear).
Of you comes my thahalah (praise) in the rab (great) qahal (assembly). I will shalam (pay) my nadar (vow) before those who yaraa (fear) him.
The inaw (humble) shall akal (eat) and be shabai (satisfied). They shall halal (praise) Yahawah who darash (seek) after him. Let your labab (hearts) chayah (live) id (until / as far as).

All the apasay (ends) of the aratz (Earth/land) shall zakar (remember) and shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah. All the relatives of the gawayam (nations) shall shachah (worship) panayam (face) you.
For the malawakah (kingdom) is Yahawah. He is the mashal (rule/have dominion) over the gawayam (nations).

All the rich ones of the aratz (Earth/land) shall akal (eat) and shachah (worship). All those who yarad (go) down to the ipar (dust) shall karai (bow) panayam (face) him, even he who can't keep his napash (soul) chayah (alive).
Posterity shall ibad (servant) him. Future dawar (generation / age / period) shall be sapar (book) about the Adanay.
They shall bawaa (come) and shall nagad (declare) his tzadaqah (righteousness) to a im (nation / people) that shall be yalad (birth / begot), for he ishah (make) done it.
Yahawah is my raih (shepherd): I shall chasar (lack) nothing.
He rabatz (makes) me lie down in dashaa (green) naawath (pastures). He nahal (leads) me beside still may (waters).
He shawab (turn back / repent) my napash (soul). He nachah (guides) me in the maigalay (paths) of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) for his sham (name) sake.

Even though I yalak (walk) through the gayaa (valley) of the shadow of tzalamawath (death), I will yaraa (fear / be afraid) no rai (evil), for you are with me. Your shabat (rod) and your mashainah (staff), they nacham (turn away / repent) me.
You irak (prepare) a shalachan (table) panayam (face) me in the presence of my tzarar (enemies). You dashan (anoint) my raash (head) with shaman (oil). My kawas (cup) runs over.
Surely goodness and loving chasad (grace) shall radap (follow) me all the yamay (days) of my chay (life), and I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Yahawah bayath (house) arak (length).
The aratz (Earth/land) is Yahawah, with its fullness; the thabal (world), and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.
For he has founded it on the yamayam (seas), and kawan (established) it on the naharawath (floods).
Who may ilah (go up / offer) to Yahawah har (mountain)? Who may qawam (rise up) in his qadash (set apart / make holy) maqawam (place)?
He who has naqay (clean) kapayam (hands) and a bar (pure) labab (heart); who has not nashaa (lift) up his napash (soul) to falsehood, and has not shabai (swear / take oath) deceitfully.
He shall nashaa (lift) a barakah (blessing) from Yahawah, tzadaqah (righteousness) from the Alahayam of his yashai (salvation).
This is the dawar (generation / age / period) of those who darash (seek) Him, who baqash (seek) your face—even Yaiqab (Jacob). Salah (selah).
Nashaa (lift) up your raash (head), you shairayam (gates)! Be nashaa (lift) up, you iwalam (forever) shairayam (doors), and the malak (king) of kabawad (glory) will bawaa (come) in.
Who is the malak (king) of kabawad (glory)? Yahawah izawaz (strong) and gabawar (mighty), Yahawah gabawar (mighty) in malachamah (battle).
Nashaa (lift) up your raash (head), you shairayam (gates); yes, nashaa (lift) them up, you iwalam (forever) pathachay (doors), and the malak (king) of kabawad (glory) will bawaa (come) in.
Who is this malak (king) of kabawad (glory)? Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) is the malak (king) of kabawad (glory)! Salah (selah).
To you, Yahawah, do I nashaa (lift) up my napash (soul).
My Alahayam, I have batach (trusted) in you. Don't let me be bawash (shamed). Don't let my ayab (enemy) ilatz (triumph) over me.
Yes, no one who qawah (gather/wait) for you shall be bawash (shamed). They shall be bawash (shamed) who bagad (deal) treacherously rayaqam (without) cause.
Show me your darak (ways), Yahawah. Lamad (teach / instruct) me your arach (paths).
Darak (guide) me in your amath (truth), and lamad (teach / instruct) me, For you are the Alahayam of my yashai (salvation), I qawah (gather/wait) for you all yawam (day) long.
Yahawah, zakar (remember) your tender racham (show mercy / love) and your racham (show mercy / love) kindness, for they are from iwalam (forever) times.
Don't zakar (remember) the chataawath (sins) of my naiwar (youth), nor my pashai (transgressions). Zakar (remember) me according to your loving chasad (grace), for your goodness' sake, Yahawah.
Tawab (good / proper function) and yashar (upright) is Yahawah, therefore he will yarah (instruct) chataayam (sinners) in the darak (way).
He will darak (guide) the inaw (humble) in mashapat (justice). He will lamad (teach / instruct) the inaw (humble) his darak (way).
All the arachawath (paths) of Yahawah are loving chasad (grace) and amath (truth) to such as natzar (keep) his barayath (covenant) and his idah (testimonies).
For your sham (name) sake, Yahawah, salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) my iwan (guilt/iniquity), for it is rab (great).
What ayash (man / husband) is he who yaraa (fears) Yahawah? He shall yarah (instruct) him in the darak (way) that he shall bachar (choose).
His napash (soul) shall lawan (dwell) at tawab (good / proper function). His zarai (seed) shall yarash (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land).
The friendship of Yahawah is with those who yaraa (fear) him. He yadai (will) show them his barayath (covenant).
My iyan (eye) are thamayad (ever) on Yahawah, for he will yatzaa (go out / come out) my ragal (feet / foot) out of the rashath (net).
Panah (turn) to me, and have chanan (showing favor) on me, for I am yachayad (desolate) and inay (afflicted).
The tzarawath (troubles) of my labab (heart) are enlarged. Oh yatzaa (go out / come out) me out of my distresses.
Raah (see) my inay (affliction) and my imal (travail). Nashaa (lift) all my chataah (sin).
Raah (see) my ayab (enemy), for they are many. They shanaa (hate) me with chamas (cruel) hatred.
Oh shamar (keep/guard) my napash (soul), and natzal (deliver) me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take chasah (refuge) in you.
Let tham (integrity) and yashar (upright) natzar (preserve) me, for I qawah (gather/wait) for you.
Padah (redeem) Yashar-Al (Israel), Alahayam, out all of his tzarah (troubles).
Judge me, Yahweh, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in Yahweh without wavering.
Examine me, Yahweh, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.
For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.
I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, Yahweh;
That I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard, and tell of all your wondrous works.
Yahweh, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.
Don't gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men;
In whose hands is wickedness, their right hand is full of bribes.
But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.
My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless Yahweh.

Yahawah is my awar (light) and my yashai (salvation). Whom shall I yaraa (fear / be afraid)? Yahawah is the maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) of my chay (life). Of whom shall I be pachad (fear / dread)?
When evildoers qarab (come close) at me to akal (eat) up my bashar (flesh), even my tzar (oppressor / distressor) and my ayab (enemy), they kashal (stumble / stagger) and napal (fall / be cast down).

Though an machanah (army) should chanah (encamp) against me, my lab (heart) shall not yaraa (fear / be afraid). Though malachamah (war) should qawam (rise up) against me, even then I will be batach (confident).

Achad (one) thing I have shaal (asked) of Yahawah, that I will baqash (seek) after, that I may yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah all the yamay (days) of my chay (life), to chazah (see) Yahawah naim (beauty), and to baqar (morning) in his hayakal (temple).

For in the yawam (day) of rai (trouble) he will keep me secretly in his sak (pavilion). In the sathar (secret / hidden) of his ahal (tabernacle) he will sathar (hide) me. He will rawam (will lift up) me up on a tzawar (rock).

Now my raash (head) will be rawam (will lift up) up above my ayab (enemy) around me. I will zabach (offer) zabachay (sacrifices) of tharawaih (joy) in his ahal (tent). I will shayar (sing), yes, I will sing zamar (praises) to Yahawah.
Shamai (hearken / hear), Yahawah, when I qaraa (called) with my qawal (sound / voice). Have chanan (showing favor) also on me, and inah (answer / respond) me.
When you said, "baqash (seek) my panayam (face)," my lab (heart) amar (spoke) to you, "I will baqash (seek) your panayam (face), Yahawah."

Don't sathar (hide) your panayam (face) from me. Don't natah (put) your ibad (servant) natah (away) in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting). You have been my izarah (help). Don't abandon me, neither izab (forsake) me, Alahayam of my yashai (salvation).
When my ab (father) and my am (mother) izab (forsake) me, then Yahawah will asap (take) me up.
Yarah (teach) me your darak (way), Yahawah. Nachah (lead) me in a mayashawar (straight) arach (path), because of my sharar (enemies).
Don't nathan (give) me over to the napash (soul) of my tzar (oppressor / distressor), for shaqar (false) witnesses have qawam (rise up) up against me, such as yapach (breathe) out chamas (cruelty).
I am still confident of this: I will raah (see) the goodness of Yahawah in the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life).
Qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah. Be amatz (strong), and let your lab (heart) chazaq (take) courage. Yes, qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah.

To you, Yahawah, I qaraa (called). My tzawar (rock), don't be deaf to me; lest, if you are charash (silent) to me, I would mashal (speak in proverb/parable) like those who yarad (go) down into the bawar (pit).
Shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of my petitions, when I shawai (cry) to you, when I nashaa (lift) up my yad (hand) toward your Most qadash (set apart / make holy) Place.

Don't mashak (draw) me away with the rashai (wicked), with the pailay (workers) of awan (iniquity) who dabar (word / matter) shalawam (peace / safety) with their neighbors, but rai (mischief) is in their labab (hearts).

Nathan (give) them according to their pail (work), and according to the rai (wickedness) of their mailal (doings). Nathan (give) them according to the maishah (operation) of their yad (hand). Shawab (turn back / repent) back on them what they deserve.
Because they don't respect the pailath (works) of Yahawah, nor the maishah (operation) of his yad (hand), he will haras (break) them down and not banah (build) them up.
Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, because he has shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of my petitions.

Yahawah is my iz (strength / might / refuge) and my magan (shield). My lab (heart) has batach (trusted) in him, and I am izar (helped). Therefore my lab (heart) greatly ilaz (rejoices). With my shayar (song) I will yadah (thank) him.
Yahawah is their iz (strength / might / refuge). He is a stronghold of yashawaih (salvation) to his mashayach (anointed one).
Yashai (salvation) your im (nation / people), and barak (blessed) your nachalah (inheritance). Be their raih (shepherd) also, and nashaa (lift) them up iwalam (forever).
Yahab (ascribe) to Yahawah, you banay (sons) of the mighty, yahab (ascribe) to Yahawah kabawad (glory) and iz (strength / might / refuge).
Yahab (ascribe) to Yahawah the kabawad (glory) due to his sham (name). Shachah (worship) Yahawah in qadash (set apart / make holy) array.
Yahawah qawal (sound / voice) is on the mayam (Waters). The Al of kabawad (glory) raim (thunders), even Yahawah on many mayam (Waters).
Yahawah qawal (sound / voice) is kach (strength / mighty / power). Yahawah qawal (sound / voice) is full of hadar (glory / majesty / splendor).
The qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah shabar (breaks) the arazayam (cedars). Yes, Yahawah shabar (breaks) in pieces the arazayam (cedars) of Labanawan (Lebanon).
He makes them also to raqad (skip) like a igal (calf); Labanawan (Lebanon) and Sharayawan (Sirion) like a ban (son), wild ox.
Yahawah qawal (sound / voice) strikes with flashes of lightning.
Yahawah qawal (sound / voice) chawal (shakes) the madabar (wilderness). Yahawah chawal (shakes) the madabar (wilderness) of Qadash (Kadesh).
Yahawah qawal (sound / voice) makes the deer chawal (calve), and strips the yairawath (forests) bare. In his hayakal (temple) everything amar (spoke), "kabawad (glory)!"
Yahawah yashab (inhabit/dwell) enthroned at the mabawal (flood). Yes, Yahawah yashab (inhabit/dwell) as malak (king) iwalam (forever).
Yahawah will nathan (give) iz (strength / might / refuge) to his im (nation / people). Yahawah will barak (blessed) his im (nation / people) with shalawam (peace / safety).
I will rawam (will lift up) you, Yahawah, for you have raised me up, and have not made my ayab (enemy) to shamach (rejoice) over me.
Yahawah my Alahayam, I shawai (cried) to you, and you have rapaa (healed) me.
Yahawah, you have ilah (go up / offer) up my napash (soul) from shaawal (Sheol / afterlife). You have chayah (kept) me alive, that I should not yarad (go) down to the bawar (pit).
Zamar (sing) praise to Yahawah, you chasayad (saints) of his. Give hawadaw (thanks) to his qadash (set apart / make holy) zakar (remember).

For his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is but for a ragai (in an instance). His favor is for a chay (life). Bakay (weeping) may stay for the irab (evening), but ranah (joy) comes in the baqar (morning).
As for me, I amar (spoke) in my shalaw (prosperity), "I shall iwalam (forever) be mawat (moved)."
You, Yahawah, when you favored me, made my harar (mountain) imad (stand) iz (strength / might / refuge); but when you sathar (hid) your panayam (face), I was bahal (troubled).
I qaraa (called) to you, Yahawah. To Yahawah I chanan (showing favor) supplication:
"What batzai (profit) is there in my destruction, if I yarad (go) down to the shachath (pit)? Shall the ipar (dust) yadah (praise) you? Shall it nagad (declare) your amath (truth)?
Shamai (hearken / hear), Yahawah, and have chanan (showing favor) on me. Yahawah, be my helper."
You have hapak (turned) my masapad (mourning) into machawal (dancing) for me. You pathach (have) removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with shamachah (gladness),
To the end that my kabawad (heart) may zamar (sing) praise to you, and not be damam (silent). Yahawah my Alahayam, I will give yadah (thanks) to you iwalam (forever)!
In you, Yahawah, I take chasah (refuge). Let me al (not) be disappointed. Palat (deliver) me in your tzadaqah (righteousness).

Natah (bow) down your azan (ear) to me. Natzal (deliver) me maharah (speedily). Be to me a maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) tzawar (rock), a bayath (house) of matzawad (defense) to yashai (salvation) me.
For you are my salai (rock) and my matzawad (fortress), therefore for your sham (name) sake nachah (lead) me and nachah (guide) me.
Yatzaa (go out / come out) me out of the rashath (net) that they have taman (laid) secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.
Into your yad (hand) I commend my rawach (spirit / wind). You padah (redeem) me, Yahawah, Al of amath (truth).
I shanaa (hate) those who shamar (keep/guard) shawaa (vanity) habalay (vanities), but I batach (trust) in Yahawah.
I will be gayal (glad) and shamach (rejoice) in your loving chasad (grace), for you raah (see) seen my inay (affliction). You yadai (have) known my napash (soul) in tzarawath (adversities).
You have not sagar (shut) me up into the yad (hand) of the ayab (enemy). You have imad (set) my ragal (feet / foot) in a marachab (large) place.
Have chanan (showing favor) on me, Yahawah, for I am in tzarar (distress). My iyan (eye), my napash (soul), and my batan (body) waste away with kais (grief).

For my chay (life) is kalah (complete / finish) with yagawan (sorrow), my shanah (years) with anachah (sighing). My kach (strength / mighty / power) kashal (stumble / stagger) because of my iwan (guilt/iniquity). My itzam (bones) are wasted away.

Because of all my tzarar (adversaries) I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, A pachad (fear / dread) to my yadai (acquaintances). Those who raah (see) me on the street nadad (fled) from me.
I am shakach (forgotten) from their lab (heart) like a mawath (death) man. I am like abad (destroy / perish) pottery.

For I have shamai (hearken / hear) the dabah (slander) of many, magawar (terror) on sabayab (surrounding) side, while they conspire yachad (together) against me, they zamam (plot) to laqach (take / seize) away my napash (soul).
But I batach (trust) in you, Yahawah. I amar (spoke), "You are my Alahayam."
My ith (times) are in your yad (hand). Natzal (deliver) me from the yad (hand) of my ayab (enemy), and from those who radap (persecute) me.
Make your panayam (face) to awar (light) on your ibad (servant). Yashai (salvation) me in your loving chasad (grace).
Let me not be disappointed, Yahawah, for I have qaraa (called) on you. Let the rashai (wicked) be disappointed. Let them be damam (silent) in shaawal (Sheol / afterlife).
Let the shaqar (lying) shapathay (lips) be mute, which dabar (word / matter) against the tzadayaq (righteous) insolently, with gaawah (pride) and bawaz (contempt).

Oh how rab (great) is your goodness, which you have tzapan (laid) up for those who yaraa (fear) you, which you have pail (worked) for those who take chasah (refuge) in you, before the banay (sons) of adam (men)!

In the shelter of your panayam (face) you will sathar (hide) them from the plotting of ayash (man / husband). You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the rayab (strife) of lashanawath (tongues).
Barak (blessed) be to Yahawah, for he has shown me his palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) loving chasad (grace) in a matzawar (strong) iyar (city).

As for me, I amar (spoke) in my chapaz (haste), "I am garaz (cut) off from before your iyan (eye)." Akan (nevertheless) you shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of my petitions when I shawai (cried) to you.
Oh ahab (love) Yahawah, all you his chasayad (saints)! Yahawah natzar (preserves) the aman (believe / have faith), and fully shalam (recompenses) him who behaves arrogantly.
Be amatz (strong), and let your labab (heart) chazaq (take) courage, all you who yachal (hope) in Yahawah.
Ashar (who/that) is he whose disobedience is nashaa (lift), whose chataah (sin) is kasah (covered).
Ashar (who/that) is the adam (man) to whom Yahawah doesn't chashab (impute) iwan (guilt/iniquity), in whose rawach (spirit / wind) there is no ramayah (deceit).
When I charash (kept) silence, my itzam (bones) balah (wasted) away through my groaning all yawam (day) long.
For yawamam (by day) and layal (night) your yad (hand) was kabad (heavy) on me. My lashad (strength) was sapped in the heat of qayatz (summer). Salah (selah).

I yadai (acknowledged) my chataah (sin) to you. I didn't kasah (hide) my iwan (guilt/iniquity). I amar (spoke), I will yadah (confess) my pashai (transgressions) to Yahawah, and you nashaa (lift) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of my chataah (sin). Salah (selah).

For this, let everyone who is chasayad (godly) palal (pray) to you in a ith (time) when you may be matzaa (found). Surely when the rab (great) mayam (Waters) overflow, they shall not nagai (reach) to him.
You are my sathar (secret / hidden) place. You will natzar (preserve) me from tzar (oppressor / distressor). You will surround me with ranay (songs) of palat (deliverance). Salah (selah).
I will shakal (instruct) you and yarah (teach) you in the darak (way) which you shall yalak (go). I will yaitz (counsel) you with my iyan (eye) on you.
Don't be like the sawas (horse), or like the parad (mule), which have no bayan (between), who are controlled by mathag (bit) and rasan (bridle), or else they will not qarab (come close) near to you.
Many makaawabayam (sorrows) come to the rashai (wicked), but loving chasad (grace) shall surround him who batach (trusts) in Yahawah.
Be shamach (glad) in Yahawah, and gayal (rejoice), you tzadayaq (righteous)! Ranan (shout) for joy, all you who are yashar (upright) in lab (heart)!
Ranan (rejoice) in Yahawah, you tzadayaq (righteous)! Thahalah (praise) is fitting for the tzadayaq (righteous).
Give hawadaw (thanks) to Yahawah with the lyre. Zamar (sing) nabal (praises) to him with the harp of ishawar (ten) strings.
Shayar (sing) to him a chadash (new) shayar (song). Nagan (play) skillfully with a tharawaih (shout) of joy!
For the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah is yashar (upright). All his maishah (work) is done in amawanah (faithfulness).
He ahab (love) tzadaqah (righteousness) and mashapat (justice). The aratz (Earth/land) is malaa (full) of the loving chasad (grace) of Yahawah.
By Yahawah dabar (word / matter), the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) were ishah (make); all their tzabaa (troop) by the rawach (spirit / wind) of his pah (mouth).
He kanas (gathers) the may (waters) of the yam (sea/waters) together as a nad (heap). He nathan (give) up the thahawamawath (deeps) in atzarawath (storehouses).
Let all the aratz (Earth/land) yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah. Let all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the thabal (world) gawar (stand) in awe of him.
For he amar (spoke), and it was done. He tzawah (commanded), and it imad (stood) firm.
Yahawah pawar (brings) the itzah (counsel) of the gawayam (nations) to nothing. He nawaa (makes) the machashabawath (thoughts) of the imayam (peoples) to be of no nawaa (effect).
The itzah (counsel) of Yahawah imad (stands) fast iwalam (forever), the machashabawath (thoughts) of his lab (heart) to all dawar (generation / age / period).
Ashar (who/that) is the gaway (heathen / nation) whose Alahayam is Yahawah, the im (nation / people) whom he has bachar (chosen) for his own nachalah (inheritance).
Yahawah nabat (looks) from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens). He nabat (sees) all the banay (sons) of adam (men).
From the makawan (place) of his yashab (inhabit/dwell) he shagach (looks) out on all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land),
He who yatzar (fashions) yachad (all) of their lab (heart); and he bayan (between) all of their maishah (works).

There is no malak (king) yashai (salvation) by the rab (multitude) of an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor). A gabawar (mighty) man is not natzal (delivered) by rab (great) kach (strength / mighty / power).
A sawas (horse) is a shaqar (vain) thing for thashawaih (deliverance), neither does he malat (deliver) any by his rab (great) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor).
Behold, Yahawah iyan (eye) is on those who yaraa (fear) him, on those who yachal (hope) in his loving chasad (grace);
To natzal (deliver) their napash (soul) from mawath (death), to chayah (keep) them alive in raib (famine).
Our napash (soul) has chakah (waited) for Yahawah. He is our izar (help) and our magan (shield).
For our lab (heart) shamach (rejoices) in him, because we have batach (trusted) in his qadash (set apart / make holy) sham (name).
Let your loving chasad (grace) be on us, Yahawah, since we yachal (have) hoped in you.
I will barak (blessed) Yahawah at all ith (times). His thahalah (praise) will always be in my pah (mouth).
My napash (soul) shall halal (praise) in Yahawah. The inaw (humble) shall shamai (hearken / hear) of it, and be shamach (glad).
Oh gadal (magnify) Yahawah with me. Let us rawam (will lift up) his sham (name) yachad (together).
I darash (sought) Yahawah, and he inah (answer / respond) me, and natzal (delivered) me from all my magawarah (fears).
They nabat (looked) to him, and were radiant. Their panayam (face) shall never be covered with chapar (shame).
This inay (poor) man qaraa (called), and Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear) him, and yashai (salvation) him out of all his tzarah (troubles).
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah chanah (encamps) around those who yaraa (fear) him, and chalatz (delivers) them.
Oh taim (taste) and raah (see) that Yahawah is tawab (good / proper function). Ashar (who/that) is the gabar (man) who takes chasah (refuge) in him.
Oh yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, you his qadawash (saints), for there is no machasawar (lack) with those who yaraa (fear) him.
The young kapayarayam (lions) do rawash (lack), and raib (suffer) hunger, but those who darash (seek) Yahawah shall not chasar (lack) any tawab (good / proper function) thing.
Yalak (come), you banayam (children), shamai (hearken / hear) to me. I will lamad (teach / instruct) you the yaraah (fear) of Yahawah.
Who is someone who chapatz (desires) chay (life), and ahab (love) many yamayam (days), that he may raah (see) tawab (good / proper function)?
Natzar (keep) your lashawan (tongue / language) from rai (evil), and your shapah (lips) from dabar (word / matter) lies.
Sawar (depart) from rai (evil), and ishah (make) tawab (good / proper function). Baqash (seek) shalawam (peace / safety), and radap (pursue) it.
Yahawah iyanay (eyes) are toward the tzadayaq (righteous). His azan (ear) listen to their cry.
Yahawah panayam (face) is against those who ishah (make) rai (evil), to karath (cut) off their zakar (remember) from the aratz (Earth/land).
The righteous tzaiq (cry), and Yahawah shamai (hearken / hear), and natzal (delivers) them out of all their tzarah (troubles).
Yahawah is qarawab (near) to those who have a shabar (broken) lab (heart), and yashai (salvation) those who have a crushed rawach (spirit / wind).
Many are the raiwath (afflictions) of the tzadayaq (righteous), but Yahawah natzal (delivers) him out of them all.
He protects all of his itzam (bones). Not achad (one) of them is shabar (broken).
Rai (evil) shall mawath (death) the rashai (wicked). Those who shanaa (hate) the tzadayaq (righteous) shall be condemned.
Yahawah padah (redeems) the napash (soul) of his ibad (servant). None of those who take chasah (refuge) in him shall be condemned.
Rayab (contend), Yahawah, with those who rayab (contend) with me. Lacham (fight) against those who lacham (fight) against me.
Chazaq (take) hold of magan (shield) and tzanah (buckler), and qawam (rise up) up for my izarah (help).
Brandish the chanayath (spear) and block those who radap (pursue) me. Amar (spoke) my napash (soul), "I am your yashawaih (salvation)."
Let those who baqash (seek) after my napash (soul) be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be sawag (turned) achawar (back) and chapar (confounded).
Let them be as matz (chaff) panayam (face) the rawach (spirit / wind), Yahawah malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) dachah (driving) them on.
Let their darak (way) be chashak (darkness) and chalaqalaqah (slippery), Yahawah malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) radap (pursuing) them.
For chanam (without) cause they have taman (hidden) their rashath (net) in a shachath (pit) for me. Chanam (without) cause they have chapar (dug) a pit for my napash (soul).
Let shawaa (vanity) bawaa (come) on him yadai (unawares). Let his rashath (net) that he has taman (hidden) lakad (catch) himself. Napal (fall / be cast down) him fall into that shawaa (vanity).
My napash (soul) shall be gayal (joyful) in Yahawah. It shall shawash (rejoice) in his yashawaih (salvation).

All my itzam (bones) shall amar (spoke), "Yahawah, who is like you, who natzal (delivers) the inay (poor) from him who is too chazaq (strong) for him; yes, the inay (poor) and the inay (needy) from him who gazal (robs) him?"
Chamas (unrighteous) witnesses qawam (rise up) up. They shaal (ask) me about things that I don't yadai (know) about.
They shalam (reward) me rai (evil) for tawab (good / proper function), to the bereaving of my napash (soul).

But as for me, when they were chalah (afflict), my labawash (clothing) was sackcloth. I inah (oppress / afflict) my napash (soul) with tzawam (fasting). My thapalah (prayer) shawab (turn back / repent) into my own chayaq (bosom).
I halak (move) myself as though it had been my rai (neigbor/another person) or my ach (brother/kinsman). I shachach (bowed) down qadar (mourning), as one who abal (mourns) his am (mother).

But in my tzalai (adversity), they shamach (rejoiced), and asap (gathered) themselves together. The attackers asap (gathered) themselves together against me, and I didn't yadai (know) it. They qarai (tore) at me, and didn't damam (cease).
Like the profane laigay (mockers) in maiwag (feasts), they charaq (gnashed) their shan (teeth) at me.
Adanay, how long will you raah (see) on? Shawab (turn back / repent) my napash (soul) from their shawaa (vanity), my precious life from the kapayarayam (lions).
I will give you yadah (thanks) in the rab (great) qahal (assembly). I will halal (praise) you among many im (nation / people).
Don't let those who are my ayab (enemy) shaqar (wrongfully) shamach (rejoice) over me; neither let those who shanaa (hate) me chanam (without) a cause qaratz (wink) their iyan (eye).
For they don't dabar (word / matter) shalawam (peace / safety), but they chashab (devise) deceitful dabaray (words) against those who are ragai (quiet) in the aratz (Earth/land).
Yes, they opened their pah (mouth) rachab (wide) amar (spoke) me. They said, "haach (aha)! Haach (aha)! Our iyan (eye) raah (see) seen it!"
You raah (see) seen it, Yahawah. Don't charash (keep) silent. Adawan, don't be rachaq (far) from me.
Qawatz (wake) up! Mashapat (rise) up to defend me, my Alahayam! My Adanay, rayab (contend) for me!
Vindicate me, Yahawah my Alahayam, according to your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Don't let them gloat over me.
Don't let them amar (spoke) in their lab (heart), "haach (aha)! That's the napash (soul) we want it!" Don't let them amar (spoke), "We have balai (swallowed) him up!"

Let them be disappointed and bawash (confounded) yachad (together) who shamach (rejoice) at my rai (calamity). Let them be labash (clothed) with bashath (shame) and dishonor who gadal (magnify) themselves against me.

Let them ranan (shout) for joy and be shamach (glad), who favor my tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) cause. Yes, let them amar (spoke) continually, "Yahawah be gadal (magnified), who chapatz (has) pleasure in the prosperity of his ibad (servant)!"
My lashawan (tongue / language) shall hagah (talk) about your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) and about your thahalah (praise) all yawam (day) long.
An oracle is qarab (among / near) my lab (heart) about the disobedience of the rashai (wicked): "There is no pachad (fear / dread) of Alahayam before his iyan (eye)."
For he chalaq (flatters) himself in his own iyan (eye), too much to detect and shanaa (hate) his sin.
The dabaray (words) of his pah (mouth) are awan (iniquity) and maramah (deceit). He has chadal (ceased) to be shakal (wise) and to do yatab (good).
He plots awan (iniquity) on his mashakab (bed). He yatzab (sets) himself in a darak (way) that is not tawab (good / proper function). He doesn't maas (abhor) rai (evil).
Your loving chasad (grace), Yahawah, is in the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens). Your amawanah (faithfulness) reaches to the shachaqayam (skies).
Your tzadaqah (righteousness) is like the hararay (mountains) of Al. Your mashapat (judgments) are like a rab (great) thahawam (depths). Yahawah, you yashai (salvation) adam (man) and animal.
How yaqar (precious) is your loving chasad (grace), Alahayam! The banay (children) of adam (men) take chasah (refuge) under the tzal (shadow) of your kanap (wings).
They shall be abundantly rawah (satisfied) with the abundance of your bayath (house). You will shaqah (make) them drink of the nachal (stream / river) of your idan (Idan / Eden).
For with you is the maqawar (spring) of chay (life). In your awar (light) shall we raah (see) awar (light).
Oh mashak (continue) your loving chasad (grace) to those who yadai (know) you, your tzadaqah (righteousness) to the yashar (upright) in lab (heart).
Don't let the ragal (feet / foot) of gaawah (pride) bawaa (come) against me. Don't let the yad (hand) of the rashai (wicked) drive me away.
There the pailay (workers) of awan (iniquity) are napal (fall / be cast down). They are dachah (thrust) down, and shall not be yakal (able) to qawam (rise up).
Don't charah (hot with anger) because of evildoers, neither be qanaa (jealous) against those who ishah (make) iwal (unrighteousness).
For they shall maharah (soon) be namal (cut) down like the chatzayar (grass), and nabal (wither) like the yaraq (green) dashaa (herb).
Batach (trust) in Yahawah, and ishah (make) tawab (good / proper function). Shakan (place) in the aratz (Earth/land), and enjoy safe pasture.
Also inag (delight) yourself in Yahawah, and he will nathan (give) you the mashaalath (desires) of your lab (heart).
Galal (commit) your darak (way) to Yahawah. Batach (trust) also in him, and he will ishah (make) this:
He will make your tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth as the awar (light), and your mashapat (justice) as the noon tzahar (day) sun.

Damam (rest) in Yahawah, and chawal (wait) patiently for him. Don't charah (hot with anger) because of him who tzalach (prospers) in his darak (way), because of the ayash (man / husband) who ishah (make) mazamah (wicked) plots happen.
Rapah (cease) from ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and izab (forsake) chamah (wrath). Don't charah (hot with anger), it leads only to evildoing.
For evildoers shall be karath (cut) off, but those who qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah shall yarash (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land).
For yet a mait (little) while, and the rashai (wicked) will be no more. Yes, though you bayan (between) for his maqawam (place), he isn't there.
But the inaw (humble) shall yarash (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land), and shall inag (delight) themselves in the rab (abundance) of shalawam (peace / safety).
The rashai (wicked) zamam (plots) against the tzadayaq (righteous), and gnashes at him with his shan (teeth).
The Adanay will shachaq (laugh) at him, for he raah (see) that his yawam (day) is bawaa (come).

The rashai (wicked) pathach (have) drawn out the charab (sword), and have bent their qashath (bow), to napal (fall / be cast down) down the inay (poor) and inay (needy), to tabach (kill) those who are yashar (upright) in the darak (way).
Their charab (sword) shall bawaa (come) into their own lab (heart). Their qashath (bows) shall be shabar (broken).
Tawab (good / proper function) is a mait (little) that the tzadayaq (righteous) has, than the hamawan (abundance) of many rashai (wicked).
For the zarawaiwath (arms) of the rashai (wicked) shall be shabar (broken), but Yahawah samak (upholds) the tzadayaq (righteous).
Yahawah yadai (knows) the yamay (days) of the thamayam (complete / whole). Their nachalah (inheritance) shall be iwalam (forever).
They shall not be disappointed in the ith (time) of rai (evil). In the yamay (days) of raibawan (famine) they shall be shabai (satisfied).
But the rashai (wicked) shall abad (destroy / perish). The ayabay (enemies) of Yahawah shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like ishan (smoke).
The rashai (wicked) lawah (borrow), and don't shalam (pay) back, but the tzadayaq (righteous) nathan (give) generously.
For such as are barak (blessed) by him shall yarash (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land). Those who are qalal (cursed) by him shall be karath (cut) off.
A gabar (man's) matzaiday (goings) are kawan (established) by Yahawah. He chapatz (delights) in his darak (way).
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahawah samak (holds) him up with his yad (hand).
I have been nair (young), and now am zaqan (old), yet I raah (see) not seen the tzadayaq (righteous) forsaken, nor his zarai (children) baqash (begging) for lacham (bread).
All yawam (day) long he chanan (showing favor) graciously, and lawah (lends). His zarai (seed) is blessed.
Sawar (depart) from rai (evil), and ishah (make) tawab (good / proper function). Live securely iwalam (forever).

For Yahawah ahab (love) mashapat (justice), and doesn't izab (forsake) his chasayad (saints). They are shamar (keep/guard) iwalam (forever), but the zarai (children) of the rashai (wicked) shall be karath (cut) off.
The tzadayaq (righteous) shall yarash (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land), and live in it id (until / as far as).
The pah (mouth) of the tzadayaq (righteous) hagah (talks) of chakamah (wisdom). His lashawan (tongue / language) hagah (speaks) mashapat (justice).
The thawarah (instruction) of his Alahayam is in his lab (heart). None of his ashar (who/that) shall maid (slide).
The rashai (wicked) watches the tzadayaq (righteous), and baqash (seeks) to mawath (death) him.
Yahawah will not izab (leave) him in his yad (hand), nor rashai (condemn) him when he is shapat (judge / judgement).

Qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah, and shamar (keep/guard) his darak (way), and he will rawam (will lift up) you to yarash (inherit) the aratz (Earth/land). When the rashai (wicked) are karath (cut) off, you shall raah (see) it.
I raah (see) seen the rashai (wicked) in great irayatz (power), irah (spreading) himself like a rainan (green) azarach (tree) in its native soil.
But he ibar (pass over/through) away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I baqash (sought) him, but he could not be matzaa (found).
Shamar (keep/guard) the tham (perfect) man, and raah (see) the yashar (upright), for there is a future for the ayash (man / husband) of shalawam (peace / safety).
As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed yachad (together). The future of the rashai (wicked) shall be karath (cut) off.
But the thashawaih (deliverance) of the tzadayaq (righteous) is from Yahawah. He is their stronghold in the ith (time) of tzarah (trouble).
Yahawah izar (helps) them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the rashai (wicked), and yashai (salvation) them, Because they chasah (have) taken refuge in him.
Yahawah, don't yakach (rebuke) me in your qatzap (wrath), neither yasar (chasten) me in your chamah (hot) displeasure.
For your chatz (arrows) have pierced me, your yad (hand) presses hard on me.
There is no matham (soundness) in my bashar (flesh) panayam (face) of your zaim (indignation), neither is there any shalawam (peace / safety) in my itzam (bones) panayam (face) of my chataah (sin).
For my iwan (guilt/iniquity) ibar (pass over/through) gone over my raash (head). As a kabad (heavy) mashaa (burden), they are too kabad (heavy) for me.
My chabawarah (wounds) are baash (loathsome) and maqaq (corrupt), panayam (face) of my awalath (foolishness).
I am pained and shachach (bowed) down maad (greatly). I halak (move) qadar (mourning) all yawam (day) long.
For my waist is malaa (filled) with burning. There is no matham (soundness) in my bashar (flesh).
I am pawag (faint) and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my lab (heart).
Adanay, all my thaawah (desire) is before you. My anachah (groaning) is not sathar (hidden) from you.
My lab (heart) throbs. My kach (strength / mighty / power) izab (fails) me. As for the awar (light) of my iyan (eye), it has also left me.
My lovers and my rai (neigbor/another person) imad (stand) nagad (aloof) from my nagai (plague). My kinsmen imad (stand) rachawaq (far) away.

They also who baqash (seek) after my napash (soul) lay yanaqashaw (snares). Those who darash (seek) my rai (hurt) dabar (word / matter) hawah (calamity / destruction) things, and hagah (meditate) maramawath (deceits) all yawam (day) long.
But I, as a charash (deaf) man, don't shamai (hearken / hear). I am as a mute alam (man) who doesn't pathach (open) his pah (mouth).
Yes, I am as a ayash (man / husband) who doesn't shamai (hearken / hear), in whose pah (mouth) are no thawakachawath (reproofs).
For in you, Yahawah, do I yachal (hope). You will inah (answer / respond), Adanay my Alahayam.
For I amar (spoke), "Don't let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my ragal (feet / foot) mawat (slips)."
For I am kawan (ready) to fall. My makaab (pain) is continually before me.
For I will nagad (declare) my iwan (guilt/iniquity). I will be daag (sorry) for my chataah (sin).
But my ayab (enemy) are vigorous and many. Those who shanaa (hate) me shaqar (without) reason are numerous.
They who also shalam (render) rai (evil) for tawab (good / proper function) are shatan (adversaries) to me, because I radap (follow) what is tawab (good / proper function).
Don't izab (forsake) me, Yahawah. My Alahayam, don't be rachaq (far) from me.
Hurry to izarah (help) me, Adanay, my thashawaih (deliverance).

I amar (spoke), "I will shamar (keep/guard) my darak (ways), so that I don't chataa (sin) with my lashawan (tongue / language). I will shamar (keep/guard) my pah (mouth) with a machasawam (bridle) while the rashai (wicked) is before me."
I was mute with dawamayah (silence). I held my chashah (peace), even from tawab (good / proper function). My kaab (sorrow) was ikar (stirred).
My lab (heart) was chamam (hot) qarab (among / near) me. While I meditated, the ash (fire) bair (burned): I dabar (word / matter) with my lashawan (tongue / language):
"Yahawah, show me my qatz (end), what is the madah (measure) of my yawam (day). Yadai (let) me know how chadal (frail) I am.
Behold, you nathan (give) made my yawam (day) tapachawath (handbreadths). My lifetime is as kal (every) before you. Surely every adam (man) natzab (stands) as a habal (breath)." Salah (selah).
"Surely every ayash (man / husband) halak (move) like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in habal (vain). He tzabar (heaps) up, and doesn't yadai (know) who shall asap (gather).
Now, Adanay, what do I qawah (gather/wait) for? My thawachalath (hope) is in you.
Natzal (deliver) me from all my pashai (transgressions). Don't shawam (place / establish / appoint) me the charapah (reproach) of the foolish.
I was mute. I didn't pathach (open) my pah (mouth), because you ishah (make) it.
Sawar (remove) your scourge sawar (away) from me. I am overcome by the thagarah (blow) of your yad (hand).

When you thawakachah (rebuke) and yasar (correct) ayash (man / husband) for iwan (guilt/iniquity), You masah (consume) his wealth like a ish (made). Surely every adam (man) is but a habal (breath)." Salah (selah).

"Shamai (hearken / hear) my thapalah (prayer), Yahawah, and azan (ear) ear to my cry. Don't be charash (silent) at my damaih (tears). For I am a gar (sojourner / stranger / foreigner) with you, a thawashab (foreigner), as all my ab (father) were.
Oh shaih (spare) me, that I may recover balag (strength), before I yalak (go) away, and exist no more."
I qawah (gather/wait) qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah. He natah (turned) to me, and shamai (hearken / hear) my cry.

He ilah (go up / offer) me up also out of a shaawan (horrible) bawar (pit), out of the yawan (miry) tayat (clay). He qawam (rise up) my ragal (feet / foot) on a salai (rock), and gave me a kawan (firm) place to stand.

He nathan (give) put a chadash (new) shayar (song) in my pah (mouth), even thahalah (praise) to our Alahayam. Many shall raah (see) it, and yaraa (fear / be afraid), and shall batach (trust) in Yahawah.
Ashar (who/that) is the gabar (man) who shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yahawah his mabatach (trust), and doesn't panah (turn) the rahab (proud), nor such as shawat (turn) aside to kazab (lies).

Many, Yahawah, my Alahayam, are the palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) ishah (make) which you have done, and your machashabah (thoughts) which are toward us. They can't be nagad (declared) back to you. If I would nagad (declare) and dabar (word / matter) of them, they are more than can be sapar (book).
Zabach (sacrifice) and manachah (offering) you didn't chapatz (desire). You have karah (opened) my azanayam (ears). You have not shaal (required) burnt ilah (offering) and chataah (sin) offering.
Then I amar (spoke), "Behold, I bawaa (come) come. It is kathab (write) about me in the sapar (book / scribed document) in the scroll.
I chapatz (delight) to ishah (make) your ratzawan (will), my Alahayam. Yes, your thawarah (instruction) is thawak (midst) my maih (heart)."
I have proclaimed glad news of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) in the rab (great) qahal (assembly). Behold, I will not seal my shapah (lips), Yahawah, you yadai (know).

I have not kasah (hidden) your tzadaqah (righteousness) thawak (midst) my lab (heart). I have amar (spoke) your amawanah (faithfulness) and your thashawaih (deliverance). I have not kachad (concealed) your loving chasad (grace) and your amath (truth) from the rab (great) qahal (assembly).
Don't kalaa (withhold) your tender racham (show mercy / love) from me, Yahawah. Let your loving chasad (grace) and your amath (truth) continually natzar (preserve) me.

For innumerable raiwath (evils) have surrounded me. My iwan (guilt/iniquity) have overtaken me, so that I am not yakal (able) to raah (see) up. They are more than the shairawath (hairs) of my raash (head). My lab (heart) has izab (failed) me.
Be ratzah (pleased), Yahawah, to natzal (deliver) me. Hurry to izarah (help) me, Yahawah.

Let them be disappointed and chapar (confounded) yachad (together) who baqash (seek) after my napash (soul) to sapah (destroy) it. Let them be sawag (turned) backward and brought to dishonor who chapatz (delight) in my rai (hurt).
Let them be shamam (desolate) by reason of their bashath (shame) that amar (spoke) me, "haach (aha)! Haach (aha)!"
Let all those who baqash (seek) you shawash (rejoice) and be shamach (glad) in you. Let such as ahab (love) your thashawaih (deliverance) amar (spoke) continually, "Let Yahawah be exalted!"
