Who can malal (utter) the gabawarah (mighty) acts of Yahawah, or fully shamai (hearken / hear) all his thahalah (praise)?
Ashar (who/that) are those who shamar (keep/guard) mashapat (justice). Blessed is one who ishah (make) what is tzadaqah (righteousness) at all ith (times).
Zakar (remember) me, Yahawah, with the favor that you show to your im (nation / people). Paqad (visit) me with your yashawaih (salvation),

That I may raah (see) the tawab (good / proper function) of your bachayar (chosen), that I may shamach (rejoice) in the shamachah (gladness) of your gaway (heathen / nation), that I may glory with your nachalah (inheritance).
We have chataa (sinned) with our ab (father). We have committed iwah (iniquity). We have rashai (done) wickedly.

Our ab (father) didn't shakal (understand) your palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in Matzarayam (Egypt). They didn't zakar (remember) the rab (multitude) of your chasad (grace) kindnesses, but were rebellious at the yam (sea/waters), even at the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).
Nevertheless he yashai (salvation) them for his sham (name) sake, that he might make his gabawarah (mighty) power yadai (known).
He gair (rebuked) the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters) also, and it was charab (dried) up; so he yalak (led) them through the thahamawath (depths), as through a madabar (desert).
He yashai (salvation) them from the yad (hand) of him who shanaa (hate) them, and gaal (redeemed) them from the yad (hand) of the ayab (enemy).
The mayam (Waters) kasah (covered) their tzar (oppressor / distressor). There was not achad (one) of them yathar (left).
Then they aman (believe / have faith) his dabar (word / matter). They shayar (sang) his thahalah (praise).
They mahar (soon) shakach (forgot) his maishah (works). They didn't chakah (wait) for his itzah (counsel),
But gave in to craving in the madabar (desert), and tested Al in the wasteland.
He nathan (give) them their shaalah (request), but shalach (send) razawan (leanness) into their napash (soul).
They qanaa (jealous) Mashah (Moses) also in the machanah (camp), and Aharawan (Aaron), Yahawah qadawash (saint).
The aratz (Earth/land) pathach (opened) and balai (swallowed) up Dathan (Dathan), and kasah (covered) the idah (company) of Abayaram (Abiram).
A ash (fire) was bair (kindled) in their idah (company). The lahabah (flame) lahat (burned) up the rashai (wicked).
They ishah (make) a igal (calf) in Charab (Horeb), and shachah (worshiped) a masakah (molten) image.
Thus they mawar (exchanged) their kabawad (glory) for an thabanayath (image) of a shawar (bull) that akal (eat) ishab (grass).
They shakach (forgot) Al, their Savior, who ishah (make) done gadawal (very great/important/mighty) things in Matzarayam (Egypt),
Wondrous napalaawath (works) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Cham (Ham), and awesome things by the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters).

Therefore he amar (spoke) that he would shamad (destroy) them, had Mashah (Moses), his bachayar (chosen), not imad (stood) panayam (face) him in the paratz (breach), to shawab (turn back / repent) away his chamah (wrath), so that he wouldn't shachath (destroy) them.
Yes, they maas (despised) the chamadah (pleasant) aratz (Earth/land). They didn't aman (believe / have faith) his dabar (word / matter),
But ragan (murmured) in their ahal (tents), and didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to Yahawah qawal (sound / voice).
Therefore he nashaa (lift) to them that he would napal (fall / be cast down) them in the madabar (wilderness),
That he would napal (fall / be cast down) their zarai (seed) among the gawayam (nations), and zarah (scatter) them in the aratzawath (lands).
They tzamad (joined) themselves also to Bailapaiwar (Baal) Peor, and akal (eat) the zabachay (sacrifices) of the mawath (death).
Thus they provoked him to kais (anger) with their deeds. The magapah (plague) paratz (broke) in on them.
Then Payanachas (Phinehas) imad (stood) up, and executed palal (judgment), so the magapah (plague) was itzar (stopped).
That was credited to him for tzadaqah (righteousness), for all dawar (generation / age / period) to come.
They qatzap (angered) him also at the may (waters) of marayabah (meribah), so that Mashah (Moses) was troubled for their sakes;
Because they were rebellious against his rawach (spirit / wind), he bataa (spoke) rashly with his shapah (lips).
They didn't shamad (destroy) the imayam (peoples), as Yahawah commanded them,
But mixed themselves with the gawayam (nations), and lamad (teach / instruct) their maishah (works).
They ibad (servant) their itzab (idols), which became a mawaqash (snare) to them.
Yes, they zabach (sacrificed) their ban (son) and their banath (daughter) to demons.

They shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood), even the dam (blood) of their ban (son) and of their banath (daughter), whom they zabach (sacrificed) to the itzabay (idols) of Kanain (Canaan). The aratz (Earth/land) was chanap (polluted) with dam (blood).
Thus were they tamaa (defiled) with their maishah (works), and prostituted themselves in their maishah (deeds).
Therefore Yahawah charah (hot with anger) with ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) against his im (nation / people). He thaib (abhorred) his nachalah (inheritance).
He nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of the gawayam (nations). Those who shanaa (hate) them mashal (rule/have dominion) over them.
Their ayab (enemy) also lachatz (oppressed) them. They were kanai (brought) into subjection under their yad (hand).
Many paimayam (times) he natzal (delivered) them, but they were rebellious in their itzah (counsel), and were makak (brought) low in their iwan (guilt/iniquity).
Nevertheless he raah (see) their tzar (oppressor / distressor), when he shamai (hearken / hear) their ranah (cry).
He zakar (remember) for them his barayath (covenant), and nacham (turn away / repent) according to the rab (multitude) of his chasad (grace) kindnesses.
He nathan (give) them also to be racham (show mercy / love) by all those who shabah (carried) them captive.

Yashai (salvation) us, Yahawah, our Alahayam, qabatz (gather) us from among the gawayam (nations), to give yadah (thanks) to your qadash (set apart / make holy) sham (name), to shabach (triumph) in your thahalah (praise)!

Barak (blessed) BOOK be V Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), from iwalam (forever) even to iwalam (forever)! Let all the im (nation / people) amar (spoke), "aman (believe / have faith)." Halal (praise) Yah!
Give hadaw (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (good / proper function), for his loving tawab (good / proper function) endures iwalam (forever).
Let the gaal (redeemed) by Yahawah amar (spoke) so, whom he has gaal (redeemed) from the yad (hand) of the tzar (oppressor / distressor),
And qabatz (gathered) out of the aratzawath (lands), from the mazarach (east) and from the mairab (west), from the tzapawan (north) and from the yam (sea/waters).
They thaih (wandered) in the madabar (wilderness) in a yashayamawan (desert) darak (way). They matzaa (found) no iyar (city) to live in.
Raib (hungry) and thirsty, their napash (soul) itap (fainted) in them.
Then they tzaiq (cried) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he natzal (delivered) them out of their distresses,
He darak (led) them also by a yashar (upright) darak (way), that they might yalak (go) to a iyar (city) to live in.
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to the banay (children) of adam (men)!
For he shabai (satisfies) the shaqaq (longing) napash (soul). He malaa (fills) the raib (hungry) napash (soul) with tawab (good / proper function).
Some yashab (inhabit/dwell) in chashak (darkness) and in the shadow of tzalamawath (death), being asayar (bound) in inay (affliction) and barazal (iron),
Because they marah (rebelled) against the amaray (words) of Al, and condemned the itzah (counsel) of the Most ilayawan (Ilayawan).
Therefore he kanai (brought) down their lab (heart) with imal (labor). They kashal (stumble / stagger) down, and there was none to izar (help).
Then they zaiq (cried) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he yashai (salvation) them out of their distresses.
He yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of chashak (darkness) and the shadow of tzalamawath (death), and nathaq (broke) their mawasar (bonds) in sunder.
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to the banay (children) of adam (men)!
For he has shabar (broken) the dalathawath (gates) of nachashath (brass), and gadai (cut) through barayachay (bars) of barazal (iron).
Awalayam (fools) are inah (oppress / afflict) darak (because) of their disobedience, and because of their iwan (guilt/iniquity).
Their napash (soul) thaib (abhors) all kinds of akal (food). They nagai (draw) near to the shairay (gates) of mawath (death).
Then they zaiq (cry) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), he yashai (salvation) them out of their distresses.
He shalach (send) his dabar (word / matter), and rapaa (heals) them, and malat (delivers) them from their shachayath (graves).
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to the banay (children) of adam (men)!
Let them offer the yazabachaw (sacrifices) of thanksgiving, and sapar (book) his maishah (works) with ranah (singing).
Those who yarad (go) down to the yam (sea/waters) in anayawath (ships), who ishah (make) malaakah (business) in rab (great) mayam (Waters);
These raah (see) Yahawah maishay (works), and his palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in the matzawalah (deep).
For he commands, and imad (raises) the sair (stormy) rawach (spirit / wind), which rawam (will lift up) up its gal (waves).
They ilah (go up / offer) up to the sky; they yarad (go) down again to the thahawamawath (depths). Their napash (soul) mawag (melts) away because of rai (trouble).
They chagag (reel) back and forth, and nawai (stagger) like a drunken shakawar (man), and are at their chakamah (wits)' balai (end).
Then they tzaiq (cry) to Yahawah in their tzar (oppressor / distressor), and he yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of their matzawaqah (distress).
He qawam (rise up) the sair (storm) a damamah (calm), so that its gal (waves) are still.
Then they are shamach (glad) because it is shathaq (calm), so he nachah (brings) them to their chapatz (desired) machawaz (haven).
Let them yadah (praise) Yahawah for his loving chasad (grace), for his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) for the banay (children) of adam (men)!
Let them rawam (will lift up) him also in the qahal (assembly) of the im (nation / people), and halal (praise) him in the mawashab (seat) of the zaqanayam (elders).
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) naharawath (rivers) into a madabar (desert), mayam (Waters) springs into a thirsty tzamaawan (ground),
And a paray (fruitful) aratz (Earth/land) into a malachah (salt) waste, for the rai (wickedness) of those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in it.
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) a madabar (desert) into a agam (pool) of mayam (Waters), and a tzayah (dry) aratz (Earth/land) into mayam (Waters) springs.
There he makes the raib (hungry) live, that they may kawan (prepare) a iyar (city) to live in,
Zarai (sow) shadawath (fields), natai (plant) karamayam (vineyards), and reap the paray (fruits) of thabawaah (increase).
He blesses them also, so that they are rabah (multiplied) maad (greatly). He doesn't allow their livestock to mait (decrease).
Again, they are mait (diminished) and shachach (bowed) down through itzar (oppression), rai (trouble), and yagawan (sorrow).
He shapak (pours) bawaz (contempt) on nadayabayam (princes), and thaih (causes) them to wander in a trackless thahaw (formless).
Yet he lifts the abayawan (needy) out of their inay (affliction), and increases their mashapachawath (families) like a tzaan (flock).
The yashar (upright) will raah (see) it, and be shamach (glad). All the iwal (wicked) will qapatz (shut) their pah (mouths).
Whoever is chakam (wise) will pay attention to these things. They will bayan (between) the chasad (grace) kindnesses of Yahawah.
My lab (heart) is steadfast, Alahayam. I will shayar (sing) and I will make music with my kabawad (soul).
Iwar (rouse / awaken) up, harp and lyre! I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up the dawn.
I will give yadah (thanks) to you, Yahawah, among the imayam (nations). I will sing zamar (praises) to you among the amayam (peoples).
For your loving chasad (grace) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) above the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens). Your amath (truth) reaches to the shachaqayam (skies).
Be rawam (will lift up), Alahayam, above the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens)! Let your kabawad (glory) be over all the aratz (Earth/land).
That your yadayad (beloved) may be chalatz (delivered), yashai (salvation) with your right yamayan (right hand), and inah (answer / respond) us.

Alahayam has dabar (word / matter) from his qadash (set apart / make holy): "In ilaz (triumph), I will chalaq (divide) Shakam (Shechem), and madad (measure) out the imaq (valley) of Sakawath (Succoth).
Galaid (Gilead) is mine. Manashah (Manasseh) is mine. Aparayam (Ephraim) also is my helmet. Yahawadah (Judah) is my scepter.
Mawaab (Moab) is my rachatz (wash) pot. I will toss my sandal on Adawam (Edom). I will rawai (shout) over Palashath (Philistia)."
Who will yabal (bring) me into the fortified iyar (city)? Who has nachah (led) me to Adawam (Edom)?
Haven't you rejected us, Alahayam? You don't yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, Alahayam, with our tzabaa (troop).
Yahab (give) us izarah (help) against the tzar (oppressor / distressor), for the thashawaih (deliverance) of adam (man) is shawaa (vanity).
Through Alahayam, we will ishah (make) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor). For it is he who will bawas (tread) down our tzar (oppressor / distressor).
Alahayam of my thahalah (praise), don't remain charash (silent),

For they pathach (have) opened the pah (mouth) of the rashai (wicked) and the pah (mouth) of maramah (deceit) against me. They have dabar (word / matter) to me with a shaqar (lying) lashawan (tongue / language).
They have also surrounded me with dabaray (words) of hatred, and lacham (fought) against me chanam (without) a cause.
In return for my ahabah (love), they are my shatan (adversaries); but I am in thapalah (prayer).
They have shawam (place / establish / appoint) me rai (evil) for tawab (good / proper function), and hatred for my ahabah (love).
Paqad (visit) a rashai (wicked) man over him. Let an shatan (adversary) imad (stand) at his right yamayan (right hand).
When he is shapat (judge / judgement), yatzaa (go out / come out) him come forth rashai (guilty). Let his thapalah (prayer) be turned into chataah (sin).
Let his yawam (day) be mait (few). Let achar (other) laqach (take / seize) his paqadah (office).
Let his ban (son) be yathawam (fatherless), and his ayashah (woman / wife) a alamanah (widow).
Let his ban (son) be nawai (wandering) beggars. Let them be darash (sought) from their ruins.
Let the nashah (creditor) seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his yagayai (labor).
Let there be no one to mashak (extend) chasad (grace) to him, neither let there be anyone to chanan (showing favor) pity on his yathawam (fatherless) children.
Let his acharayath (posterity) be karath (cut) off. In the dawar (generation / age / period) achar (other) let their sham (name) be machah (blotted) out.
Let the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of his ab (father) be zakar (remember) by Yahawah. Don't let the chataah (sin) of his am (mother) be machah (blotted) out.
Let them be before Yahawah continually, that he may karath (cut) off their zakar (remember) from the aratz (Earth/land);

Because he didn't zakar (remember) to show chasad (grace), but radap (persecuted) the inay (poor) and abayawan (needy) ayash (man / husband), the kaah (broken) in labab (heart), to mawath (death) them.
Yes, he ahab (love) qalalah (cursing), and it bawaa (come) to him. He didn't chapatz (delight) in barakah (blessing), and it was rachaq (far) from him.
He labash (clothed) himself also with qalalah (cursing) as with his mad (garment). It bawaa (come) into his qarab (among / near) parts like mayam (Waters), like shaman (oil) into his itzam (bones).
Let it be to him as the bagad (clothing) with which he itah (covers) himself, for the belt that is thamayad (always) around him.
This is the pailah (reward) of my shatan (adversaries) from Yahawah, of those who dabar (word / matter) rai (evil) against my napash (soul).
But ishah (make) with me, Yahawah the Adanay, for your sham (name) sake, because your loving chasad (grace) is tawab (good / proper function), natzal (deliver) me;
For I am inay (poor) and abayawan (needy). My lab (heart) is wounded qarab (among / near) me.
I fade halak (move) like an evening tzal (shadow). I am nair (shaken) off like a arabah (locust).
My barak (blessed) are kashal (stumble / stagger) through tzawam (fasting). My bashar (flesh) is thin and lacks shaman (fat).
I have also become a charapah (reproach) to them. When they raah (see) me, they nawai (shake) their raash (head).
Izar (help) me, Yahawah, my Alahayam. Yashai (salvation) me according to your loving chasad (grace);
That they may yadai (know) that this is your yad (hand); that you, Yahawah, ishah (make) done it.
They may qalal (curse), but you barak (blessed). When they qawam (rise up), they will be bawash (shamed), but your ibad (servant) shall shamach (rejoice).
Let my shatan (adversaries) be labash (clothed) with dishonor. Let them itah (cover) themselves with their own bashath (shame) as with a maiyal (robe).
I will give maad (great) yadah (thanks) to Yahawah with my pah (mouth). Yes, I will halal (praise) him thawak (midst) the rab (multitude).
For he will imad (stand) at the right yamayan (right hand) of the abayawan (needy), to yashai (salvation) him from those who shapat (judge / judgement) his napash (soul).

Yahawah naam (declares prophetically) to my Adawan, "yashab (inhabit/dwell) at my right yamayan (right hand), until I shayath (put / appoint / make) your ayab (enemy) your hadam (footstool) for your feet."

Yahawah will shalach (send) forth the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of your iz (strength / might / refuge) out of Tzayawan (Zion). Radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) in the qarab (among / near) of your ayab (enemy).

Your im (nation / people) offer themselves nadabah (voluntary / freewill offering) in the yawam (day) of your chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), in qadash (set apart / make holy) array. Out of the racham (womb) of the mashachar (earnest / diligent search), you have the tal (dew) of your yaladawath (youth).
Yahawah has shabai (swear / take oath), and will not change his mind: "You are a kahan (priest) iwalam (forever) in the dabarah (order) of Malakayatzadaq (Melchizedek)."
The Adanay is at your right yamayan (right hand). He will machatz (crush / shatter) malakayam (kings) in the yawam (day) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).
He will dayan (judge) among the gawayam (nations). He will heap up dead gawayawath (bodies). He will machatz (crush / shatter) the raash (head) of the whole aratz (Earth/land).
He will shathah (drinks) of the nachal (stream / river) in the darak (way); therefore he will rawam (will lift up) up his raash (head).
Halal (praise) Yah! I will give yadah (thanks) to Yahawah with my whole labab (heart), in the council of the yashar (upright), and in the idah (congregation).
Yahawah maishay (works) are gadawal (very great/important/mighty), pondered by all those who chapatz (delight) in them.
His pail (work) is honor and hadar (glory / majesty / splendor). His tzadaqah (righteousness) imad (endures) id (until / as far as).
He ishah (make) caused his wonderful palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) to be remembered. Yahawah is chanawan (gracious) and rachawam (merciful).
He nathan (give) given food to those who yaraa (fear) him. He iwalam (forever) zakar (remember) his barayath (covenant).
He has shown his im (nation / people) the kach (strength / mighty / power) of his maishah (works), in nathan (give) them the nachalah (heritage) of the gawayam (nations).
The maishay (works) of his yad (hand) are amath (truth) and mashapat (justice). All his paqawad (precepts) are aman (believe / have faith).
They are samak (established) id (until / as far as) and id (until / as far as). They are ishah (make) in amath (truth) and uprightness.
He has shalach (send) padawath (redemption) to his im (nation / people). He has ordained his barayath (covenant) iwalam (forever). His sham (name) is qadawash (holy) and awesome!

The yaraah (fear) of Yahawah is the raashayath (beginning) of chakamah (wisdom). All those who ishah (make) his work have a tawab (good / proper function) shakal (understanding). His thahalah (praise) imad (endures) id (until / as far as)!
Halal (praise) Yah! Ashar (who/that) is the ayash (man / husband) who yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah, who chapatz (delights) maad (greatly) in his matzawah (commandments).
His zarai (seed) will be gabawar (mighty) in the aratz (Earth/land). The dawar (generation / age / period) of the yashar (upright) will be barak (blessed).
Hawan (wealth) and riches are in his bayath (house). His tzadaqah (righteousness) imad (endures) id (until / as far as).
Awar (light) dawns in the chashak (darkness) for the yashar (upright), chanawan (gracious), rachawam (merciful), and tzadayaq (righteous).
It is tawab (good / proper function) with the ayash (man / husband) who chanan (showing favor) graciously and lawah (lends). He will maintain his dabar (word / matter) in mashapat (judgment).
For he will iwalam (forever) be mawat (shaken). The tzadayaq (righteous) will be remembered iwalam (forever).
He will not be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of rai (evil) shamawaih (news). His lab (heart) is steadfast, batach (trusting) in Yahawah.
His lab (heart) is samak (established). He will not be yaraa (fear / be afraid) in the end when he raah (see) his tzar (oppressor / distressor).
He has pazar (dispersed), he nathan (give) given to the abayawan (poor). His tzadaqah (righteousness) imad (endures) id (until / as far as). His qaran (horn) will be rawam (will lift up) with honor.

The rashai (wicked) will raah (see) it, and be kais (grieved). He shall charaq (gnash) with his shan (teeth), and masas (melt) away. The thaawah (desire) of the rashai (wicked) will abad (destroy / perish).
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise), you ibaday (servants) of Yahawah, halal (praise) the sham (name) of Yahawah.
Barak (blessed) be the sham (name) of Yahawah, from ithah (now / present moment) time forth and forevermore.
From the mazarach (rising) of the shamash (sun) to the mabawaa (going) down of the same, Yahawah sham (name) is to be halal (praise).
Yahawah is rawam (will lift up) above all gawayam (nations), his kabawad (glory) above the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).
Who is like Yahawah, our Alahayam, who has his yashab (inhabit/dwell) on gabah (high),
Who stoops down to raah (see) in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and in the aratz (Earth/land)?
He qawam (rise up) up the dal (poor) out of the ipar (dust). Rawam (will lift up) up the abayawan (needy) from the ash heap;
That he may yashab (inhabit/dwell) him with nadayabayam (princes), even with the nadayabayam (princes) of his im (nation / people).
He yashab (inhabit/dwell) the iqar (barren) woman in her bayath (house), as a shamach (joyful) am (mother) of banayam (children). Halal (praise) Yah!
When Yashar-Al (Israel) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt), the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob) from a im (nation / people) of foreign laiz (language);
Yahawadah (Judah) became his qadash (set apart / make holy), Yashar-Al (Israel) his mamashalah (dominion).
The yam (sea/waters) raah (see) it, and nawas (fled). The Yaradan (Jordan) was sabab (driven) achawar (back).
The harayam (mountains) raqad (skipped) like ayalayam (rams), the gabaih (little) hills like banay (lambs).
What was it, you yam (sea/waters), that you nawas (fled)? You Yaradan (Jordan), that you sabab (turned) achawar (back)?
You harayam (mountains), that you raqad (skipped) like ayalayam (rams); you gabaih (little) hills, like banay (lambs)?
Chawal (tremble), you aratz (Earth/land), at the panayam (face) of the Adawan, at the panayam (face) of the Alawah of Yaiqab (Jacob),
Who hapak (turned) the tzawar (rock) into a agam (pool) of mayam (Waters), the chalamayash (flint) into a maiyan (spring) of mayam (Waters).
Not to us, Yahawah, not to us, but to your sham (name) nathan (give) kabawad (glory), for your loving chasad (grace), and for your amath (truth) sake.
Why should the gawayam (nations) amar (spoke), "Where is their Alahayam, now?"
But our Alahayam is in the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens). He ishah (make) whatever he pleases.
Their itzab (idols) are kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yaday (hands).
They have pah (mouths), but they don't dabar (word / matter). They have iyanayam (eyes), but they don't raah (see).
They have azanayam (ears), but they don't shamai (hearken / hear). They have ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), but they don't rawach (spirit / wind).
They have yad (hand), but they don't mawash (feel). They have ragal (feet / foot), but they don't halak (move), neither do they hagah (speak) through their garawan (throat).
Those who ishah (make) them will be like them; yes, everyone who batach (trusts) in them.
Yashar-Al (Israel), batach (trust) in Yahawah! He is their izar (help) and their magan (shield).
Bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron), batach (trust) in Yahawah! He is their izar (help) and their magan (shield).
You who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, batach (trust) in Yahawah! He is their izar (help) and their magan (shield).
Yahawah zakar (remember) us. He will barak (blessed) us. He will barak (blessed) the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel). He will barak (blessed) the bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron).
He will barak (blessed) those who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, both qatan (small / young / least) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty).
May Yahawah yasap (increase) you more and more, you and your ban (son).
Barak (blessed) are you by Yahawah, who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land).
The shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) are the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) of Yahawah; but the aratz (Earth/land) nathan (give) he given to the banay (children) of adam (men).
The mawath (death) don't halal (praise) Yah, neither any who yarad (go) down into dawamah (silence);
But we will barak (blessed) Yah, from this time forth and forevermore. Halal (praise) Yah!
I ahab (love) Yahawah, because he shamai (hearken / hear) to my qawal (sound / voice), and my cries for thachanawan (mercy).
Because he has natah (turned) his azan (ear) to me, therefore I will qaraa (called) on him as yawam (day) as I live.
The chabalay (cords) of mawath (death) surrounded me, the matzaray (pains) of shaawal (Sheol / afterlife) matzaa (got) a hold of me. I matzaa (found) tzarah (trouble) and yagawan (sorrow).
Then I qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah: "Yahawah, I beg you, malat (deliver) my napash (soul)."
Yahawah is chanawan (gracious) and tzadayaq (righteous). Yes, our Alahayam is merciful.
Yahawah shamar (keep/guard) the pathay (simple). I was dalal (brought) low, and he yashai (salvation) me.
Shawab (turn back / repent) to your manawachah (rest), my napash (soul), for Yahawah has dealt gamal (bountifully) with you.
For you have chalatz (delivered) my napash (soul) from mawath (death), my iyan (eye) from damaih (tears), and my ragal (feet / foot) from dachay (falling).
I will halak (move) panayam (face) Yahawah in the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life).
I aman (believe / have faith), therefore I dabar (word / matter), "I was maad (greatly) inah (oppress / afflict)."
I amar (spoke) in my chapaz (haste), "All adam (men) are kazab (liars)."
What will I shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah for all his thagamawal (benefits) toward me?
I will nashaa (lift) the kawas (cup) of yashawaih (salvation), and qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah.
I will shalam (pay) my nadar (vow) to Yahawah, yes, in the presence of all his im (nation / people).
Yaqar (precious) in the iyan (eye) of Yahawah is the mawath (death) of his chasayad (saints).
Yahawah, truly I am your ibad (servant). I am your ibad (servant), the ban (son) of your handmaid. You pathach (have) freed me from my chains.

Those who ahab (love) your thawarah (instruction) rab (have) great shalawam (peace / safety). Makashawal (nothing) causes them to stumble.
I have shabar (hoped) for your yashawaih (salvation), Yahawah. I ishah (make) done your matzawah (commandments).
My napash (soul) has shamar (keep/guard) your idah (testimonies). I ahab (love) them maad (exceedingly).
I have obeyed your paqawad (precepts) and your idah (testimonies), for all my darak (ways) are before you.
Let my ranah (cry) qarab (come close) panayam (face) you, Yahawah. Give me bayan (between) according to your dabar (word / matter).
Let my thachanah (supplication) bawaa (come) panayam (face) you. Natzal (deliver) me according to your amarah (sayings).
Let my shapah (lips) nabai (utter) thahalah (praise), for you lamad (teach / instruct) me your chaq (statute).
Let my lashawan (tongue / language) inah (answer / respond) of your amarah (sayings), for all your matzawah (commandments) are tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).
Let your yad (hand) be ready to izar (help) me, for I have bachar (chosen) your paqawad (precepts).
I have thaab (longed) for your yashawaih (salvation), Yahawah. Your thawarah (instruction) is my shaishai (delight).
Let my napash (soul) chayah (live), that I may halal (praise) you. Let your mashapat (ordinances) izar (help) me.
I have thaih (gone) astray like a abad (destroy / perish) shah (sheep). Baqash (seek) your ibad (servant), for I don't shakach (forget) your matzawah (commandments).
In my tzarah (distress), I qaraa (called) to Yahawah. He inah (answer / respond) me.
Natzal (deliver) my napash (soul), Yahawah, from shaqar (lying) shapah (lips), from a deceitful lashawan (tongue / language).
What will be nathan (give) to you, and what will be yasap (done) more to you, you deceitful lashawan (tongue / language)?
Shanan (sharp) chatzay (arrows) of the gabawar (mighty), with gachalay (coals) of ratham (juniper).
Awayah (woe) is me, that I live in Mashak (Meshech), that I shakan (place) among the ahalay (tents) of Qadar (Kedar)!
My napash (soul) shakan (place) had her dwelling rab (too) long with him who shanaa (hate) shalawam (peace / safety).
I am for shalawam (peace / safety), but when I dabar (word / matter), they are for malachamah (war).
I will nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye) to the harayam (hills). Ayan (NO ONE) does my izar (help) bawaa (come) from?
My izar (help) comes from Yahawah, who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land).
He will not allow your ragal (feet / foot) to be mawat (moved). He who shamar (keep/guard) you will not nawam (slumber).
Behold, he who shamar (keep/guard) Yashar-Al (Israel) will neither nawam (slumber) nor sleep.
Yahawah is your keeper. Yahawah is your tzal (shade) on your yamayan (right hand) yad (hand).
The shamash (sun) will not harm you by yawamam (by day), nor the yarach (moon) by layal (night).
Yahawah will shamar (keep/guard) you from all rai (evil). He will shamar (keep/guard) your napash (soul).
Yahawah will shamar (keep/guard) your yatzaa (go out / come out) out and your bawaa (come) in, from this time forth, and forevermore.
I was shamach (glad) when they amar (spoke) to me, "nalak (lets) go to Yahawah bayath (house)!"
Our ragal (feet / foot) are imad (standing) within your shair (gates), Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);
Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that is banah (build) as a iyar (city) that is chabar (compact) yachad (together);
Where the shabatayam (tribes) ilah (go up / offer) up, even Yah shabatayam (tribes), according to an idawath (ordinance) for Yashar-Al (Israel), to give yadah (thanks) to the sham (name) of Yahawah.
For there are yashab (inhabit/dwell) kasaawath (thrones) for mashapat (judgment), the kasaawath (thrones) of Dawad (David's) bayath (house).
Shaal (pray) for the shalawam (peace / safety) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Those who ahab (love) you will shalah (prosper).
Shalawam (peace / safety) be within your chayal (walls), and shalawah (prosperity) within your aramawan (palaces).
For my ach (brother/kinsman)' and rai (neigbor/another person)' sakes, I will now dabar (word / matter), "shalawam (peace / safety) be within you."
For the sake of the bayath (house) of Yahawah our Alahayam, I will baqash (seek) your tawab (good / proper function).
To you I do nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), you who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

Behold, as the iyanay (eyes) of ibadayam (servants) look to the yad (hand) of their adawan (master / lord), as the iyanay (eyes) of a shapachah (maid) to the yad (hand) of her gabarath (mistress); so our iyanay (eyes) look to Yahawah, our Alahayam, until he has chanan (showing favor) on us.
Have chanan (showing favor) on us, Yahawah, have chanan (showing favor) on us, for we rab (have) endured much bawaz (contempt).
Our napash (soul) is rab (exceedingly) shabai (filled) with the scoffing of those who are at shaanan (ease), with the bawaz (contempt) of the gaayawan (proud).
If it had not been Yahawah who was on our side, let Yashar-Al (Israel) now amar (spoke),
If it had not been Yahawah who was on our side, when adam (men) qawam (rise up) up against us;
Then they would have balai (swallowed) us up chay (life), when their ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was charah (hot with anger) against us;
Then the mayam (Waters) would have shatap (overwhelmed) us, the nachal (stream / river) would ibar (pass over/through) gone over our napash (soul);
Then the zayadawan (proud) mayam (Waters) would ibar (pass over/through) gone over our napash (soul).
Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, who nathan (give) not given us as a tarap (prey) to their shan (teeth).
Our napash (soul) has malat (escaped) like a tzapawar (bird) out of the yawaqashayam (fowlers) pach (snare / trap). The pach (snare / trap) is shabar (broken), and we have malat (escaped).
Our izar (help) is in the sham (name) of Yahawah, who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land).
Those who batach (trust) in Yahawah are as har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion), which can't be mawat (moved), but yashab (inhabit/dwell) iwalam (forever).
As the harayam (mountains) surround Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so Yahawah surrounds his im (nation / people) from this time forth and forevermore.
For the scepter of rashai (wickedness) won't nawach (remain) over the allotment of the tzadayaq (righteous); so that the tzadayaq (righteous) won't use their yad (hand) to do iwal (evil).
Do tawab (good / proper function), Yahawah, to those who are tawab (good / proper function), to those who are yashar (upright) in their labah (hearts).

But as for those who natah (turn) aside to their crooked iqalaqal (ways), Yahawah will yalak (lead) them away with the pailay (workers) of awan (iniquity). Shalawam (peace / safety) be on Yashar-Al (Israel).
When Yahawah shawab (turn back / repent) back those who shawab (turn back / repent) to Tzayawan (Zion), we were like those who dream.

Then our pah (mouth) was malaa (filled) with shachawaq (laughter/joking matter), and our lashawan (tongue / language) with ranah (singing). Then they amar (spoke) among the gawayam (nations), "Yahawah ishah (make) done gadal (great) things for them."
Yahawah ishah (make) done gadal (great) things for us, and we are shamach (glad).
Shabawath (restore) our fortunes again, Yahawah, like the apayaqayam (streams) in the Negev.
Those who zarai (sow) in damaih (tears) will qatzar (reap) in ranah (joy).
He who yalak (goes) out bakah (weeping), nashaa (lift) zarai (seed) for sowing, will bawaa (come) bawaa (come) again with ranah (joy), nashaa (lift) his sheaves.

Unless Yahawah banah (build) the bayath (house), they imal (labor) in shawaa (vanity) who banah (build) it. Unless Yahawah watches over the iyar (city), the shamar (keep/guard) guards it in shawaa (vanity).
It is shawaa (vanity) for you to qawam (rise up) up shakam (early), to stay up achar (other), akal (eat) the lacham (bread) of toil; for he nathan (give) shanah (sleep) to his loved yadayad (ones).
Behold, banayam (children) are a nachalah (heritage) of Yahawah. The paray (fruit) of the batan (womb) is his shakar (reward).
As chatzayam (arrows) in the yad (hand) of a gabawar (mighty) man, so are the banay (children) of naiwar (youth).
Ashar (who/that) is the gabar (man) who has his ashapah (quiver) malaa (full) of them. They won't be disappointed when they dabar (word / matter) with their awayabayam (enemies) in the shair (gate).
Ashar (who/that) is everyone who yaraa (fears) Yahawah, who halak (move) in his darak (ways).
For you will akal (eat) the yagayai (labor) of your kap (hands). You will be ashar (who/that), and it will be tawab (good / proper function) with you.

Your ayashah (woman / wife) will be as a parah (fruitful) gapan (vine), in the innermost yarakathay (parts) of your bayath (house); your ban (son) like zayath (olive) shathalay (plants), around your shalachan (table).
Behold, thus is the gabar (man) barak (blessed) who yaraa (fears) Yahawah.
May Yahawah barak (blessed) you out of Tzayawan (Zion), and may you raah (see) the tawab (good / proper function) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) all the yamay (days) of your chay (life).
Yes, may you raah (see) your banayam (childrens) banayam (children). Shalawam (peace / safety) be upon Yashar-Al (Israel).
Many rab (times) they have tzarar (afflicted) me from my naiwar (youth) up. Let Yashar-Al (Israel) now amar (spoke),
Many rab (times) they have tzarar (afflicted) me from my naiwar (youth) up, yet they yakal (have) not prevailed against me.
The plowers charash (plowed) on my gab (back). They made their mainah (furrows) arak (long).
Yahawah is tzadayaq (righteous). He has qatzatz (cut) apart the ibath (cords) of the rashai (wicked).
Let them be disappointed and sawag (turned) backward, all those who shanaa (hate) Tzayawan (Zion).
Let them be as the chatzayar (grass) on the housetops, which yabash (dry land) before it shalap (grows) up;
With which the qatzar (reaper) doesn't malaa (fill) his kap (hand), nor he who imar (binds) sheaves, his chatzan (bosom).
Neither ibar (pass over/through) those who go by amar (spoke), "The barakah (blessing) of Yahawah be on you. We barak (blessed) you in the sham (name) of Yahawah."
Out of the maimaqayam (depths) I have qaraa (called) to you, Yahawah.
Adanay, shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice). Let your azan (ear) be qashab (attentive) to the qawal (sound / voice) of my petitions.
If you, Yah, shamar (keep/guard) a record of iwanawath (sins), Adanay, who could imad (stand)?
But there is salayachah (forgiveness) with you, therefore you are yaraa (fear / be afraid).
I qawah (gather/wait) for Yahawah. My napash (soul) qawah (gather/wait). I yachal (hope) in his dabar (word / matter).
My napash (soul) longs for the Adanay more than watchmen long for the baqar (morning); more than watchmen for the baqar (morning).
Yashar-Al (Israel), yachal (hope) in Yahawah, for with Yahawah there is loving chasad (grace). With him is abundant padawath (redemption).
He will padah (redeem) Yashar-Al (Israel) from all their iwan (guilt/iniquity).

Yahawah, my lab (heart) isn't gabah (haughty), nor my iyan (eye) rawam (will lift up); nor do I concern myself with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) matters, or things palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) wonderful for me.
Surely I have stilled and damam (quieted) my napash (soul), like a weaned child with his am (mother), like a weaned child is my napash (soul) within me.
Yashar-Al (Israel), yachal (hope) in Yahawah, from this time forth and forevermore.
Yahawah, zakar (remember) Dawad (David) and all his affliction,
How he shabai (swear / take oath) to Yahawah, and nadar (make vow) to the abayar (mighty) One of Yaiqab (Jacob):
"Bawaa (come) I will not come into the structure of my bayath (house), nor ilah (go up / offer) up into my irash (bed);
I will not nathan (give) sleep to my iyan (eye), or thanawamah (slumber) to my ipaip (eyelids);
Until I matzaa (find) out a maqawam (place) for Yahawah, a mashakan (dwelling) for the abayar (mighty) One of Yaiqab (Jacob)."
Behold, we shamai (hearken / hear) of it in Ephrathah. We matzaa (found) it in the shadah (field) of Jaar:
"We will bawaa (come) into his mashakan (dwelling) place. We will shachah (worship) at his hadam (footstool).
Qawam (rise up), Yahawah, into your manawachah (resting) place; you, and the arawan (ark) of your iz (strength / might / refuge).
Let your kahan (priest) be labash (clothed) with tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Let your chasayad (saints) ranan (shout) for joy!"
For your ibad (servant) Dawad (David's) sake, don't shawab (turn back / repent) away the panayam (face) of your mashayach (anointed one) one.

Yahawah has shabai (swear / take oath) to Dawad (David) in amath (truth). He will not shawab (turn back / repent) from it: "I will shayath (put / appoint / make) the paray (fruit) of your batan (body) on your kasaa (throne).

If your ban (son) will shamar (keep/guard) my barayath (covenant), my idah (testimony) that I will lamad (teach / instruct) them, their ban (son) also will yashab (inhabit/dwell) on your kasaa (throne) forevermore."
For Yahawah has bachar (chosen) Tzayawan (Zion). He has awah (desired) it for his habitation.
"This is my manawachah (resting) place id (until / as far as). Here I will live, for I have awah (desired) it.
I will barak (blessed) barak (blessed) her provision. I will shabai (satisfy) her abayawan (poor) with lacham (bread).
Her kahan (priest) I will also labash (clothe) with yashai (salvation). Her chasayad (saints) will ranan (shout) aloud for joy.
There I will tzamach (make) the qaran (horn) of Dawad (David) to tzamach (bud). I have irak (ordained) a nayar (lamp) for my mashayach (anointed one).
I will labash (clothe) his ayab (enemy) with bashath (shame), but on himself, his nazar (crown / consecrate) will be resplendent."
See how tawab (good / proper function) and how naiyam (pleasant) it is for achayam (brothers) to live yachad (together) in unity!

It is like the tawab (good / proper function) shaman (oil) on the raash (head), that yarad (ran) down on the zaqan (beard), even Aharawan (Aaron's) zaqan (beard); that yarad (came) down on the pah (edge) of his robes;
Like the tal (dew) of Charamawan (Hermon), that yarad (comes) down on the hararay (hills) of Tzayawan (Zion): for there Yahawah tzawah (gives) the barakah (blessing), even chay (life) forevermore.
Look! Barak (blessed) Yahawah, all you ibaday (servants) of Yahawah, who imad (stand) by layal (night) in Yahawah bayath (house)!
Nashaa (lift) up your yad (hand) in the qadash (set apart / make holy). Barak (blessed) Yahawah!
May Yahawah barak (blessed) you from Tzayawan (Zion); even he who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land).
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise) the sham (name) of Yahawah! Halal (praise) him, you ibaday (servants) of Yahawah,
You who imad (stand) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the chatzarawath (courts) of our Alahayam bayath (house).
Halal (praise) Yah, for Yahawah is tawab (good / proper function). Sing zamaraw (praises) to his sham (name), for that is naiyam (pleasant).
For Yah has bachar (chosen) Yaiqab (Jacob) for himself; Yashar-Al (Israel) for his own sagalah (possession).
For I yadai (know) that Yahawah is gadawal (very great/important/mighty), that our Adawan is above all Alahayam.
Whatever Yahawah chapatz (pleased), that he ishah (make) done, in shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and in aratz (Earth/land), in the yamayam (seas) and in all thahawamawath (deeps);

Who causes the nashaayam (clouds) to ilah (go up / offer) from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); who ishah (make) baraqayam (lightnings) with the matar (rain); who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the rawach (spirit / wind) out of his awatzar (treasuries);
Who nakah (struck) the bakawar (firstborn) of Matzarayam (Egypt), both of adam (man) and animal;
Who shalach (send) athawath (signs) and mapathayam (wonders) into the thawak (midst) of you, Matzarayam (Egypt), on Paraih (Pharaoh), and on all his ibad (servant);
Who nakah (struck) many gawayam (nations), and nakah (killed) rab (mighty) malakayam (kings),
Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites), Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan), and all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of Kanain (Canaan),
And nathan (give) their aratz (Earth/land) for a nachalah (heritage), a nachalah (heritage) to Yashar-Al (Israel), his im (nation / people).
Your sham (name), Yahawah, endures iwalam (forever); your renown, Yahawah, throughout all dawar (generation / age / period).
For Yahawah will dayan (judge) his im (nation / people), and have compassion on his ibad (servant).
The itzabay (idols) of the gawayam (nations) are kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), the maishah (work) of adam (men's) yaday (hands).
They have pah (mouths), but they can't dabar (word / matter). They have iyanayam (eyes), but they can't raah (see).
They have azanayam (ears), but they can't azan (ear); neither is there any rawach (spirit / wind) in their pah (mouths).
Those who ishah (make) them will be like them; yes, everyone who batach (trusts) in them.
Bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel), barak (blessed) Yahawah! Bayath (house) of Aharawan (Aaron), barak (blessed) Yahawah!
Bayath (house) of Laway (Levi), barak (blessed) Yahawah! You who yaraa (fear) Yahawah, barak (blessed) Yahawah!
Barak (blessed) be Yahawah from Tzayawan (Zion), Who shakan (place) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Halal (praise) Yah!
Give hawadaw (thanks) to Yahawah, for he is tawab (good / proper function); for his loving tawab (good / proper function) endures iwalam (forever).
Give hawadaw (thanks) to the Alahayam of Alahayam; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).
Give hawadaw (thanks) to the Adawan of adanay (lords); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who alone ishah (make) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) napalaawath (wonders); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who by thabawan (understanding) ishah (make) the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who raqai (spread) out the aratz (Earth/land) above the mayam (Waters); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who ishah (make) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) awarayam (lights); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
The shamash (sun) to mamashalah (rule) by yawam (day); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
The yarach (moon) and kawakabayam (stars) to mamashalah (rule) by layal (night); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who nakah (struck) down the Matzarayam (Egyptian) bakawar (firstborn); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
And yatzaa (go out / come out) out Yashar-Al (Israel) from thawak (midst) them; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
With a chazaq (strong) yad (hand), and with an natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who gazar (divided) the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters) apart; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
And made Yashar-Al (Israel) to ibar (pass over/through) through its thawak (midst); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
But overthrew Paraih (Pharaoh) and his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) in the sawap (red) yam (sea/waters); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who yalak (led) his im (nation / people) through the madabar (wilderness); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
To him who nakah (struck) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malakayam (kings); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
And harag (kill) adayar (mighty) malakayam (kings); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
Sayachawan (Sihon) malak (king) of the Amaray (Amorites); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
Iwag (Og) malak (king) of Bashan (Bashan); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
And nathan (give) their aratz (Earth/land) as an nachalah (inheritance); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
Even a nachalah (heritage) to Yashar-Al (Israel) his ibad (servant); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
Who zakar (remember) us in our shapal (low) estate; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever);
And has paraq (delivered) us from our tzar (oppressor / distressor); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever):
Who nathan (give) lacham (food) to every creature; for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).
Oh give hawadaw (thanks) to the Al of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens); for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever).
By the naharawath (rivers) of Babal (Babylon), there we yashab (inhabit/dwell) down. Yes, we bakah (wept), when we zakar (remember) Tzayawan (Zion).
On the irabayam (willows) in its thawak (midst), we thalah (hung) up our kanawar (harps).

For there, those who shabah (led) us captive shaal (asked) us for dabaray (songs). Those who tormented us demanded dabaray (songs) of joy: "shayar (sing) us one of the shayar (song) of Tzayawan (Zion)!"
How can we shayar (sing) Yahawah shayar (song) in a foreign adamah (land)?
If I shakach (forget) you, Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), let my right yamayan (right hand) shakach (forget) its skill.

Let my lashawan (tongue / language) dabaq (stick) to the roof of my chak (mouth) if I don't zakar (remember) you; if I don't ilah (go up / offer) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) above my raash (head) shamachah (joy).
Zakar (remember), Yahawah, against the banay (children) of Adawam (Edom), the yawam (day) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); who amar (spoke), "Raze it! Raze it even to its yasawad (foundation)!"
Banath (daughter) of Babal (Babylon), doomed to destruction, he will be ashar (who/that) who shalam (rewards) you, as you have gamal (served) us.
Ashar (who/that) shall he be, who achaz (takes) and dashes your iwalal (little) ones against the salai (rock).
I will give you yadah (thanks) with my whole lab (heart). Before the Alahayam, I will sing zamar (praises) to you.

I will shachah (bow) down toward your qadash (set apart / make holy) hayakal (temple), and give yadah (thanks) to your sham (name) for your loving chasad (grace) and for your amath (truth); for you have exalted your sham (name) and your amarah (sayings) above all.
In the yawam (day) that I qaraa (called), you inah (answer / respond) me. You encouraged me with iz (strength / might / refuge) in my napash (soul).
All the malakay (kings) of the aratz (Earth/land) will give you yadah (thanks), Yahawah, for they have shamai (hearken / hear) the amaray (words) of your pah (mouth).
Yes, they will shayar (sing) of the darakay (ways) of Yahawah; for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is Yahawah kabawad (glory).
For though Yahawah is rawam (will lift up), yet he raah (see) after the lowly; but the gabah (proud), he yadai (knows) from afar.

Though I yalak (walk) in the qarab (among / near) of tzarah (trouble), you will chayah (revive) me. You will shalach (send) forth your yad (hand) against the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of my ayab (enemy). Your right yamayan (right hand) will yashai (salvation) me.
Yahawah will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving chasad (grace), Yahawah, endures iwalam (forever). Don't rapah (forsake) the maishay (works) of your own yad (hand).
Yahawah, you have chaqar (searched) me, and you yadai (know) me.
You yadai (know) my sitting down and my qawam (rise up) up. You bayan (between) my rai (thoughts) from rachawaq (afar).
You search out my arach (path) and my rabai (fourth) down, and are sakan (acquainted) with all my darak (ways).
For there is not a malah (word) on my lashawan (tongue / language), but, behold, Yahawah, you yadai (know) it altogether.
You hem me in achawar (behind) and qadam (before). You shayath (put / appoint / make) your kap (hand) on me.
This daith (knowledge) is beyond me. It's shagab (lofty). I can't yakal (attain) it.
Where could I yalak (go) from your rawach (spirit / wind)? Or where could I barach (flee) from your panayam (face)?
If I nasaq (ascend) up into shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), you are there. If I yatzai (make) my bed in shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), behold, you are there!
If I nashaa (lift) the kanapay (wings) of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the yam (sea/waters);
Even there your yad (hand) will nachah (lead) me, and your right yamayan (right hand) will achaz (hold) me.
If I amar (spoke), "Surely the chashak (darkness) will overwhelm me; the awar (light) around me will be layal (night);"
Even the chashak (darkness) doesn't chashak (darkness) from you, but the layal (night) awar (light) as the yawam (day). The chashakah (darkness) is like awarah (light) to you.
For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my am (mother) batan (womb).

I will give yadah (thanks) to you, for I am fearfully and palah (wonderfully) made. Your maishah (works) are palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous). My napash (soul) yadai (knows) that very maad (well).
My frame wasn't kachad (hidden) from you, when I was ishah (make) in sathar (secret / hidden), woven together in the depths of the aratz (Earth/land).
Your iyan (eye) raah (see) my body. In your sapar (book / scribed document) they were all kathab (write), the yamayam (days) that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.
How yaqar (precious) to me are your rai (thoughts), Al! How vast is their raash (head)!
If I would sapar (book) them, they are more in number than the chawal (sand). When I qawatz (wake) up, I am still with you.
If only you, Alawah, would qatal (kill) the rashai (wicked). Sawar (get) away from me, you bloodthirsty anashay (men)!
For they amar (spoke) against you mazamah (wickedly). Your ir (enemies) nashaa (lift) your name in shawaa (vanity).
Yahawah, don't I shanaa (hate) those who shanaa (hate) you? Am I not grieved with those who thaqawamam (rise) up against you?
I shanaa (hate) them with thakalayath (perfect) hatred. They have become my awayabayam (enemies).
Chaqar (search) me, Al, and yadai (know) my labab (heart). Bachan (try) me, and yadai (know) my sharaip (thoughts).
Raah (see) if there is any itzab (wicked) darak (way) in me, and nachah (lead) me in the iwalam (forever) darak (way).
Chalatz (deliver) me, Yahawah, from the rai (evil) adam (man). Natzar (preserve) me from the chamas (violent) ayash (man / husband);
Those who chashab (devise) rai (mischief) in their lab (heart). They yawam (day) gawar (gather) themselves together for malachamah (war).
They have shanan (sharpened) their lashawan (tongue / language) like a nachash (serpent). Viper's chamah (poison) is under their shapah (lips). Salah (selah).
Yahawah, shamar (keep/guard) me from the yaday (hands) of the rashai (wicked). Natzar (preserve) me from the chamas (violent) ayash (man / husband) who have determined to trip my paim (feet).

The gaah (proud) have taman (hidden) a pach (snare / trap) for me, they have parash (spread) the chabalayam (cords) of a rashath (net) by the yad (hand). They have shayath (put / appoint / make) maqashayam (traps) for me. Salah (selah).
I amar (spoke) to Yahawah, "You are my Al." Listen to the qawal (sound / voice) of my petitions, Yahawah.
Yahawah, the Adanay, the iz (strength / might / refuge) of my yashawaih (salvation), you have sakak (covered) my raash (head) in the yawam (day) of nashaq (battle).
Yahawah, don't nathan (give) the maawayay (desires) of the rashai (wicked). Don't let their rashai (evil) plans succeed, or they will become rawam (will lift up). Salah (selah).
As for the raash (head) of those who surround me, let the imal (mischief) of their own shapah (lips) kasah (cover) them.
Let burning gachalayam (coals) mawat (fall) on them. Napal (fall / be cast down) them be thrown into the ash (fire), into miry mahamarawath (pits), from where they never qawam (rise up).
An ayash (man / husband) speaker won't be kawan (established) in the aratz (Earth/land). Rai (evil) will tzawad (hunt) the chamas (violent) ayash (man / husband) to madachapah (overthrow) him.
I yadai (know) that Yahawah will ishah (make) the dayan (judge) of the inay (afflicted), and mashapat (justice) for the abayawan (needy).
Surely the tzadayaq (righteous) will give yawadaw (thanks) to your sham (name). The yashar (upright) will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your panayam (face).
Yahawah, I have qaraa (called) on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my qawal (sound / voice) when I qaraa (called) to you.
Let my thapalah (prayer) be kawan (set) panayam (face) you like qatarath (incense); the mashaath (lifting) up of my kap (hands) like the irab (evening) manachah (sacrifice).
Shayath (put / appoint / make) a shamarah (watch), Yahawah, before my pah (mouth). Natzar (keep) the dalath (door) of my shapah (lips).

Don't natah (incline) my lab (heart) to any rai (evil) thing, to practice ilalawath (deeds) of rashai (wickedness) with ayashayam (men) who ilayalah (work) awan (iniquity). Don't let me lacham (eat) of their delicacies.

Let the tzadayaq (righteous) strike me, it is chasad (grace); let him yakach (reprove) me, it is like shaman (oil) on the raash (head); don't let my raash (head) refuse it; Yet my thapalah (prayer) is always against rai (evil) deeds.
Their shapat (judge / judgement) are shamat (thrown) down by the yaday (sides) of the salai (rock). They will shamai (hearken / hear) my amar (spoke), for they are well spoken.
"As when palach (one) plows and baqai (breaks) up the aratz (Earth/land), our itzam (bones) are pazar (scattered) at the pah (mouth) of shaawal (Sheol / afterlife)."
For my iyan (eye) are on you, Yahawah, the Adanay. In you, I take chasah (refuge). Don't irah (leave) my napash (soul) irah (destitute).
Shamar (keep/guard) me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the maqashawath (traps) of the pailay (workers) of awan (iniquity).
Let the rashai (wicked) napal (fall / be cast down) together into their own makamar (nets), while I ibar (pass over/through) by.
I zaiq (cry) with my qawal (sound / voice) to Yahawah. With my qawal (sound / voice), I ask Yahawah for chanan (showing favor).
I shapak (pour) out my shayach (complaint) panayam (face) him. I nagad (tell) him my tzarah (troubles).

When my rawach (spirit / wind) was itap (overwhelmed) within me, you yadai (knew) my nathayab (path). In the arach (way) in which I halak (move), they have taman (hidden) a pach (snare / trap) for me.

Nabat (look) on my yamayan (right hand), and raah (see); for there is no nakar (one) who is concerned for me. Manawas (refuge) abad (destroy / perish) fled from me. No one darash (cares) for my napash (soul).
I zaiq (cried) to you, Yahawah. I amar (spoke), "You are my machasah (refuge), my chalaq (portion) in the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life)."
Listen to my ranah (cry), for I am in desperate need. Natzal (deliver) me from my persecutors, For they are amatz (stronger) than me.
Yatzaa (go out / come out) my napash (soul) out of masagar (prison), that I may give yadah (thanks) to your sham (name). The tzadayaq (righteous) will surround me, for you will be gamal (good) to me.
Shamai (hearken / hear) my thapalah (prayer), Yahawah. Listen to my petitions. In your amawanah (faithfulness) and tzadaqah (righteousness), relieve me.
Don't bawaa (come) into mashapat (judgment) with your ibad (servant), for in your panayam (face) no man chay (life) is tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).

For the ayab (enemy) radap (pursues) my napash (soul). He has struck my chay (life) down to the aratz (Earth/land). He has yashab (inhabit/dwell) me live in machashak (dark) places, as those who have been iwalam (forever) mawath (death).
Therefore my rawach (spirit / wind) is itap (overwhelmed) within me. My lab (heart) thawak (midst) me is shamam (desolate).
I zakar (remember) the yamayam (days) of qadam (old). I hagah (meditate) on all your pail (doings). I contemplate the pail (work) of your yad (hand).
I parash (spread) forth my yad (hand) to you. My napash (soul) thirsts for you, like a parched aratz (Earth/land). Salah (selah).

Hurry to inah (answer / respond) me, Yahawah. My rawach (spirit / wind) kalah (complete / finish). Don't sathar (hide) your panayam (face) from me, so that I don't mashal (speak in proverb/parable) like those who yarad (go) down into the bawar (pit).

Shamai (hearken / hear) me to hear your loving chasad (grace) in the baqar (morning), for I batach (trust) in you. Yadai (cause) me to know the darak (way) in which I should yalak (walk), for I nashaa (lift) up my napash (soul) to you.
Natzal (deliver) me, Yahawah, from my ayab (enemy). I flee to you to kasah (hide) me.

Lamad (teach / instruct) me to ishah (make) your ratzawan (will), for you are my Alahayam. Your rawach (spirit / wind) is tawab (good / proper function). Nachah (lead) me in the aratz (Earth/land) of mayashawar (uprightness).
Chayah (revive) me, Yahawah, for your sham (name) sake. In your tzadaqah (righteousness), yatzaa (go out / come out) my napash (soul) out of tzarah (trouble).
In your loving chasad (grace), tzamath (cut) off my ayab (enemy), and abad (destroy / perish) all those who tzarar (afflict) my napash (soul), For I am your ibad (servant).
Barak (blessed) be Yahawah, my tzawar (rock), who teaches my yad (hand) to qarab (war), and my atzabai (fingers) to malachamah (battle):
My loving chasad (grace), my matzawad (fortress), my high tower, my deliverer, my magan (shield), and he in whom I take chasah (refuge); who radad (subdues) my im (nation / people) under me.
Yahawah, what is adam (man), that you care for him? Or the ban (son) of anawash (man), that you chashab (think) of him?
Adam (man) is damah (like) a habal (breath). His yawam (day) are like a tzal (shadow) that passes ibar (pass over/through).
Part your shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), Yahawah, and yarad (come) down. Nagai (touch) the harayam (mountains), and they will ishan (smoke).
Throw out baraq (lightning), and pawatz (scatter) them. Shalach (send) out your chatz (arrows), and rout them.
Shalach (send) out your yad (hand) from marawam (above), natzal (rescue) me, and natzal (deliver) me out of rab (great) mayam (Waters), out of the yad (hand) of foreigners;
Whose pah (mouths) dabar (word / matter) deceit, Whose right yamayan (right hand) is a right yamayan (right hand) of falsehood.
I will shayar (sing) a chadash (new) shayar (song) to you, Alahayam. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing zamar (praises) to you.
You are he who nathan (give) thashawaih (deliverance) to malakayam (kings), who rescues Dawad (David), his ibad (servant), from the deadly charab (sword).
Rescue me, and natzal (deliver) me out of the yad (hand) of foreigners, whose pah (mouths) dabar (word / matter) deceit, whose right yamayan (right hand) is a right yamayan (right hand) of falsehood.
Then our ban (son) will be like well-nurtured nataiyam (plants), our banath (daughter) like pillars carved to adorn a hayakal (palace).
Our barns are malaa (full), filled with all kinds of provision. Our tzaan (sheep) bring forth maalayapawath (thousands) and ten maalayapawath (thousands) in our chawatz (fields).
Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no paratz (breaking) in, and no yatzaa (go out / come out) away, and no outcry in our rachab (streets).
Ashar (who/that) are the im (nation / people) who are in such a situation. Ashar (who/that) are the im (nation / people) whose Alahayam is Yahawah.
I will rawam (will lift up) you, my Alahayam, the malak (king). I will barak (blessed) your sham (name) iwalam (forever) and iwalam (forever).
Every yawam (day) I will barak (blessed) you. I will extol your sham (name) iwalam (forever) and iwalam (forever).
Gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is Yahawah, and maad (greatly) to be halal (praise)! His gadawalah (greatness) is unsearchable.
Dawar (generation / age / period) dawar (generation / age / period) will shabach (commend) your maishah (works) to another, and will nagad (declare) your gabawarah (mighty) acts.
Of the kabawad (glorious) majesty of your honor, of your palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) dabaray (works), I will shayach (meditate).
Men will amar (spoke) of the izawaz (might) of your awesome yaraa (fear / be afraid). I will sapar (book) your gadawalah (greatness).
They will nabai (utter) the zakar (remember) of your rab (great) goodness, and will ranan (sing) of your tzadaqah (righteousness).
Yahawah is chanawan (gracious), rachawam (merciful), arak (slow) to ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and of gadawal (very great/important/mighty) loving chasad (grace).
Yahawah is tawab (good / proper function) to all. His tender racham (show mercy / love) are over all his maishah (works).
All your maishah (works) will give yadah (thanks) to you, Yahawah. Your chasayad (saints) will extol you.
They will amar (spoke) of the kabawad (glory) of your malakawath (kingdom), and dabar (word / matter) about your gabawarah (power);
To yadai (make) known to the banay (sons) of adam (men) his gabawarah (mighty) acts, the kabawad (glory) of the majesty of his malakawath (kingdom).

Your malakawath (kingdom) is an iwalam (forever) malakawath (kingdom). Your mamashalah (dominion) endures throughout all generations. Yahawah is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.
Yahawah samak (upholds) all who napal (fall / be cast down), and zaqap (raises) up all those who are kapap (bowed) down.
The iyanay (eyes) of all shabar (wait) for you. You nathan (give) them their akal (food) in due ith (season).
You pathach (open) your yad (hand), and shabai (satisfy) the ratzawan (desire) of every chay (life) thing.
Yahawah is tzadayaq (righteous) in all his darak (ways), and gracious in all his maishah (works).
Yahawah is qarawab (near) to all those who qaraa (called) on him, to all who qaraa (called) on him in amath (truth).
He will ishah (make) the ratzawan (desire) of those who yaraa (fear) him. He also will shamai (hearken / hear) their cry, and will yashai (salvation) them.
Yahawah shamar (keep/guard) all those who ahab (love) him, but all the rashai (wicked) he will shamad (destroy).

My pah (mouth) will dabar (word / matter) the thahalah (praise) of Yahawah. Let all bashar (flesh) barak (blessed) his qadash (set apart / make holy) sham (name) id (until / as far as) and iwalam (forever).
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise) Yahawah, my napash (soul).
While I chay (life), I will halal (praise) Yahawah. I will sing zamar (praises) to my Alahayam as long as I exist.
Don't batach (put) your trust in nadayabayam (princes), each a ban (son) of adam (man) in whom there is no thashawaih (deliverance).
His rawach (spirit / wind) departs, and he shawab (turn back / repent) to the adamah (earth). In that very yawam (day), his ishathanah (thoughts) abad (destroy / perish).
Ashar (who/that) is he who has the Al of Yaiqab (Jacob) for his izar (help), whose shabar (hope) is in Yahawah, his Alahayam:
Who ishah (make) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land), the yam (sea/waters), and all that is in them; who shamar (keep/guard) amath (truth) iwalam (forever);
Who ishah (make) mashapat (justice) for the ishaq (oppressed); who nathan (give) lacham (food) to the raib (hungry). Yahawah frees the asawarayam (prisoners).
Yahawah paqach (opens) the eyes of the iwar (blind). Yahawah zaqap (raises) up those who are kapap (bowed) down. Yahawah ahab (love) the tzadayaq (righteous).
Yahawah shamar (keep/guard) the foreigners. He upholds the yathawam (fatherless) and alamanah (widow), but the darak (way) of the rashai (wicked) he iwath (turns) upside down.
Yahawah will malak (king) iwalam (forever); your Alahayam, O Tzayawan (Zion), to all dawar (generation / age / period). Halal (praise) Yah!
Halal (praise) Yah, for it is tawab (good / proper function) to sing zamar (praises) to our Alahayam; for it is naiyam (pleasant) and fitting to thahalah (praise) him.
Yahawah banah (build) up Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). He kanas (gathers) together the nadachay (outcasts) of Yashar-Al (Israel).
He rapaa (heals) the shabar (broken) in lab (heart), and chabash (binds) up their itzabath (wounds).
He manah (counts) the masapar (number) of the kawakabayam (stars). He qaraa (called) them all by their shamawath (names).
Gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is our Adawan, and rab (mighty) in kach (strength / mighty / power). His thabawan (understanding) is masapar (infinite).
Yahawah upholds the inaw (humble). He shapal (brings) the rashai (wicked) down to the aratz (Earth/land).
Inah (answer / respond) to Yahawah with thanksgiving. Sing zamaraw (praises) on the kanawar (harp) to our Alahayam,
Who kasah (covers) the sky with ibayam (clouds), who kawan (prepares) matar (rain) for the aratz (Earth/land), who makes chatzayar (grass) tzamach (grow) on the harayam (mountains).
He provides lacham (food) for the livestock, and for the ban (son) irab (evening) when they qaraa (called).
He doesn't chapatz (delight) in the gabawarah (strength) of the sawas (horse). He ratzah (takes) no pleasure in the shawaqay (legs) of a ayash (man / husband).
Yahawah ratzah (takes) pleasure in those who yaraa (fear) him, in those who yachal (hope) in his loving chasad (grace).
Shabach (praise) Yahawah, Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)! Halal (praise) your Alahayam, Tzayawan (Zion)!
For he has chazaq (strengthened) the barayachay (bars) of your shair (gates). He has barak (blessed) your ban (son) inside you.
He shawam (place / establish / appoint) shalawam (peace / safety) in your gabawal (border/boundary). He shabai (fills) you with the chalab (finest) of the chatah (wheat).
He shalach (send) out his commandment to the aratz (Earth/land). His dabar (word / matter) rawatz (runs) very maharah (swiftly).
He nathan (give) shalag (snow) like tzamar (wool), and pazar (scatters) kapawar (frost) like ashes.
He shalak (hurls) down his hail like pebbles. Who can imad (stand) panayam (face) his qarah (cold)?
He shalach (send) out his dabar (word / matter), and masah (melts) them. He causes his rawach (spirit / wind) to nashab (blow), and the mayam (Waters) nazal (flow).
He shows his dabar (word / matter) to Yaiqab (Jacob); his chaq (statute) and his mashapat (ordinances) to Yashar-Al (Israel).
He ishah (make) not done this for just any gaway (heathen / nation). They don't yadai (know) his mashapatayam (ordinances). Halal (praise) Yah!
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise) Yahawah from the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens)! Halal (praise) him in the marawamayam (heights)!
Halal (praise) him, all his malaak (angel / messenger of Yah)! Halal (praise) him, all his tzabaa (troop)!
Halal (praise) him, shamash (sun) and yarach (moon)! Halal (praise) him, all you shining kawakabay (stars)!
Halal (praise) him, you shamay (heavens) of shamay (heavens), You mayam (Waters) that are above the shamay (heavens).
Let them halal (praise) the sham (name) of Yahawah, For he tzawah (commanded), and they were baraa (created).
He has also imad (established) them id (until / as far as) and id (until / as far as). He nathan (give) made a chaq (statute) which will not ibar (pass over/through) away.
Halal (praise) Yahawah from the aratz (Earth/land), you great thanayan (sea) creatures, and all thahamawath (depths)!
Lightning and barad (hail), shalag (snow) and clouds; sair (stormy) rawach (spirit / wind), ishah (make) his dabar (word / matter);
Harayam (mountains) and all gabaiwath (hills); paray (fruit) itz (trees) and all arazayam (cedars);
Wild animals and all livestock; small creatures and kanap (flying) tzapawar (birds);
Malakay (kings) of the aratz (Earth/land) and all laamayam (peoples); sharayam (princes) and all shapatay (judges) of the aratz (Earth/land);
Both bachawar (young) men and maidens; zaqan (old) men and children:
Let them halal (praise) the sham (name) of Yahawah, for his sham (name) alone is shagab (exalted). His glory is above the aratz (Earth/land) and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens).

He has rawam (will lift up) up the qaran (horn) of his im (nation / people), the thahalah (praise) of all his chasayad (saints); even of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel), a im (nation / people) qarawab (near) to him. Halal (praise) Yah!
Halal (praise) Yahawah! Shayar (sing) to Yahawah a chadash (new) shayar (song), his thahalah (praise) in the qahal (assembly) of the chasayadayam (saints).
Let Yashar-Al (Israel) shamach (rejoice) in him who ishah (make) them. Let the banay (children) of Tzayawan (Zion) be gayal (joyful) in their malak (king).
Let them halal (praise) his sham (name) in the machawal (dance)! Let them sing yazamaraw (praises) to him with tambourine and kanawar (harp)!
For Yahawah ratzah (takes) pleasure in his im (nation / people). He paar (crowns) the inaw (humble) with yashawaih (salvation).
Let the chasayadayam (saints) rejoice in honor. Let them ranan (sing) for joy on their mashakab (beds).
May the rawamamah (high) praises of Al be in their garawan (mouths), and a payapayah (two-edged) charab (sword) in their yad (hand);
To ishah (make) naqamah (vengeance) on the gawayam (nations), and punishments on the amayam (peoples);
To asar (bind) their malak (king) with zaqayam (chains), and their kabad (nobles) with kabalay (fetters) of barazal (iron);
To ishah (make) on them the kathab (write) mashapat (judgment). All his chasayad (saints) have this honor. Halal (praise) Yah!
Halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise) Al in his qadash (set apart / make holy)! Halal (praise) him in his raqayai (Firmament) for his acts of iz (strength / might / refuge)!
Halal (praise) him for his gabawarah (mighty) acts! Halal (praise) him according to his rab (excellent) gadal (greatness)!
Halal (praise) him with the thaqai (blow / sound alarm) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn)! Halal (praise) him with harp and lyre!
Halal (praise) him with tambourine and machawal (dancing)! Halal (praise) him with man (from) instruments and flute!
Halal (praise) him with shamai (loud) tzalatzalay (cymbals)! Halal (praise) him with resounding tzalatzalay (cymbals)!
Let everything that has nashamah (breathing thing) halal (praise) Yah! Halal (praise) Yah!
The mashalay (proverbs) of Shalamah (Solomon), the ban (son) of Dawad (David), malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel):
To yadai (know) chakamah (wisdom) and mawasar (instruction); to bayan (between) the amaray (words) of bayanah (understanding);
To laqach (take / seize) mawasar (instruction) in shakal (wise) dealing, in tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), and mayashar (equity);
To nathan (give) iramah (prudence) to the pathay (simple), daith (knowledge) and mazamah (discretion) to the nair (young) man:
That the chakam (wise) man may shamai (hearken / hear), and yasap (increase) in laqach (learning); that the bayan (between) of understanding may qanah (attain) to sound thachabalah (counsel):
To bayan (between) a mashal (proverb), and parables, the dabaray (words) and chayadah (riddles) of the chakam (wise).
The yaraah (fear) of Yahawah is the raashayath (beginning) of daith (knowledge); but the awayal (foolish) bawaz (despise) chakamah (wisdom) and mawasar (instruction).
My ban (son), shamai (hearken / hear) to your ab (father) mawasar (instruction), and don't natash (forsake) your am (mother) teaching:
For they will be a garland to chan (favor) your raash (head), and inaqayam (chains) around your garagarawath (neck).
My ban (son), if chataayam (sinners) pathah (entice) you, don't abah (be willing / desire).
If they amar (spoke), "yalak (come) with us, Let's arab (lay) in wait for dam (blood); let's tzapan (lurk) secretly for the naqay (innocent) chanam (without) cause;
Let's balai (swallow) them up chay (life) like shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), and thamayam (complete / whole), like those who yarad (go) down into the bawar (pit).
We'll matzaa (find) all valuable hawan (wealth). We'll malaa (fill) our bayath (house) with shalal (spoil).
You shall napal (fall / be cast down) your gawaral (lot) thawak (midst) us. We'll all have achad (one) kayas (purse)."
My ban (son), don't yalak (walk) in the darak (way) with them. Manai (keep) your ragal (feet / foot) from their nathayab (path),
For their ragal (feet / foot) rawatz (run) to rai (evil). They hurry to shapak (shed) dam (blood).
For in chanam (vain) is the rashath (net) zarah (spread) in the iyan (eye) of any bail (bird):
But these arab (lay) wait for their own dam (blood). They tzapan (lurk) secretly for their napash (soul) lives.
So are the arachawath (ways) of everyone who is batzai (greedy) for batzai (gain). It laqach (take / seize) away the napash (soul) of its owners.
Chakamawath (wisdom) calls aloud in the chawatz (street). She nathan (give) her qawal (sound / voice) in the public squares.
She qaraa (called) at the raash (head) of noisy raash (head). At the pathach (entrance) of the iyar (city) shairayam (gates), she amar (spoke) her amar (spoke):
"How long, you pathay (simple) ones, will you ahab (love) simplicity? How long will latzayam (mockers) chamad (delight) themselves in mockery, and kasayalayam (fools) shanaa (hate) daith (knowledge)?
Shawab (turn back / repent) at my thawakachah (reproof). Behold, I will nabai (pour) out my rawach (spirit / wind) on you. I yadai (will) make known my dabar (word / matter) to you.
Because I have qaraa (called), and you have maan (refused); I have natah (stretched) out my yad (hand), and no qashab (one) has paid attention;
But you have ignored all my itzah (counsel), and wanted none of my thawakachah (reproof);
I also will shachaq (laugh) at your disaster. I will laig (mock) when calamity overtakes you;
When calamity overtakes you like a sawapah (storm), when your disaster athah (you (masc)) on like a sawapah (whirlwind); when tzarah (distress) and tzawaq (anguish) bawaa (come) on you.
Then will they qaraa (called) on me, but I will not inah (answer / respond). They will shachar (seek) me diligently, but they will not matzaa (find) me;
Because they shanaa (hate) daith (knowledge), and didn't bachar (choose) the yaraah (fear) of Yahawah.
They wanted none of my itzah (counsel). They naatz (despised) all my thawakachah (reproof).
Therefore they will akal (eat) of the paray (fruit) of their own darak (way), and be shabai (filled) with their own schemes.
For the mashawabah (backsliding) of the pathay (simple) will harag (kill) them. The careless ease of kasayalayam (fools) will abad (destroy / perish) them.
But whoever shamai (hearken / hear) to me will shakan (place) securely, and will be at shaan (ease), without pachad (fear / dread) of rai (harm)."
My ban (son), if you will laqach (take / seize) my amar (spoke), and store up my matzawah (commandments) within you;
So as to qashab (turn) your azan (ear) to chakamah (wisdom), and natah (apply) your lab (heart) to thabawan (understanding);
