The qawal (sound / voice) of a hamawan (multitude) is in the harayam (mountains), as of a rab (great) im (nation / people); the qawal (sound / voice) of an uproar of the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the gawayam (nations) asap (gathered) together! Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) is mustering the tzabaa (troop) for the malachamah (battle).

They bawaa (come) from a marachaq (far) aratz (Earth/land), from the uttermost part of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), even Yahawah, and the kalay (weapons) of his zaim (indignation), to chabal (destroy) the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Wail; for the yawam (day) of Yahawah is at qarawab (hand)! It will bawaa (come) as shad (destruction) from the Shaday.
Therefore all yadayam (hands) will be rapah (feeble), and everyone's labab (heart) will melt.

They will be bahal (dismayed). Tzayarayam (pangs) and chabalayam (sorrows) will seize them. They will be in chawal (pain) like a yalad (birth / begot) in labor. They will look in amazement ayash (man / husband) at rai (neigbor/another person). Their panay (faces) will be panay (faces) of flame.

Behold, the yawam (day) of Yahawah bawaa (come), akazaray (cruel), with ibarah (wrath) and charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting); to shawam (place / establish / appoint) the aratz (Earth/land) a shamah (desolation), and to shamad (destroy) its chataa (sinners) out of it.

For the kawakabay (stars) of the sky and its kasayal (constellations) will not halal (praise) their awar (light). The shamash (sun) will be chashak (darkness) in its yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, and the yarach (moon) will not cause its awar (light) to nagah (shine).

I will paqad (visit) the thabal (world) for their rai (evil), and the rashai (wicked) for their iwan (guilt/iniquity). I will cause the arrogance of the zad (proud) to shabath (shabath / rest), and will shapal (humble) the gaawah (haughtiness) of the irayatz (terrible).
I will make anawash (people) more rare than paz (fine) gold, even a adam (person) than the katham (pure) gold of Awapayar (Ophir).

Therefore I will make the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) ragaz (tremble), and the aratz (Earth/land) will be raish (shaken) out of its maqawam (place) in the ibarah (wrath) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), and in the yawam (day) of his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

It will happen that like a hunted gazelle, and like tzaan (sheep) that no ayash (man / husband) qabatz (gathers), they will each panah (turn) to their own im (nation / people), and will ayash (man / husband) nawas (flee) to their own aratz (Earth/land).
Everyone who is matzaa (found) will be thrust daqar (through). Everyone who is captured will napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword).
Their iwalal (infants) also will be ratash (dashed) in pieces before their iyan (eye). Their bayath (house) will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
Behold, I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up the Maday (Medes) against them, who will not value kasap (silver), and as for zahab (gold), they chapatz (will) not delight in it.

Their qashathawath (bows) will ratash (dash) the nair (young) men in pieces; and they shall racham (show mercy / love) no pity on the paray (fruit) of the batan (womb). Their iyan (eye) will not chawas (spare) banayam (children).

Babal (Babylon), the glory of mamalakawath (kingdoms), the thapaarah (beauty) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans)' gaawan (pride), will be like when Alahayam mahapakah (overthrew) Sadam (Sodom) and Imarah (Gomorrah).

It will never be yashab (inhabit/dwell), neither will it be lived in from dawar (generation / age / period) to dawar (generation / age / period). The Irabay (Arabian) will not pitch a ahal (tent) there, neither will raiyam (shepherds) rabatz (make) their flocks lie down there.

But tzayay (wild) animals of the desert will rabatz (lie) there, and their bayath (house) will be malaa (full) of jackals. Ostriches will shakan (place) there, and wild shaiyarayam (goats) will frolic there.

Wolves will inah (answer / respond) in their castles, and jackals in the inag (pleasant) hayakalay (palaces). Her ith (time) is qarawab (near) to bawaa (come), and her yawam (day) will not be prolonged.

For Yahawah will racham (show mercy / love) compassion on Yaiqab (Jacob), and will yet bachar (choose) Yashar-Al (Israel), and yanach (set) them in their own adamah (land). The foreigner will lawah (join) himself with them, and they will unite with the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob).

The imayam (peoples) will laqach (take / seize) them, and bawaa (come) them to their maqawam (place). The bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) will nachal (possess) them in Yahawah adamah (land) for ibadayam (servants) and for handmaids. They will shabah (take) as captives those whose shabayam (captives) they were; and they shall radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) over their nagash (oppressors).

It will happen in the yawam (day) that Yahawah will give you nawach (rest) from your itzab (sorrow), from your trouble, and from the qashah (rough / hard) ibadah (service) in which you were made to ibad (servant),

That you will nashaa (lift) up this mashal (parable) against the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and amar (spoke), "How the nagash (oppressor) has shabath (shabath / rest)! The madahabah (golden) city has shabath (shabath / rest)!"
Yahawah has shabar (broken) the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of the rashai (wicked), the scepter of the mashalayam (rulers),

Who nakah (struck) the imayam (peoples) in ibarah (wrath) with a balathay (without) makah (stroke), who radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) the gawayam (nations) in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), with a persecution that balay (none) restrained.
The whole aratz (Earth/land) is at nawach (rest), and is shaqat (quiet). They patzach (break) out song.
Yes, the barawash (fir) trees shamach (rejoice) with you, with the arazay (cedars) of Labanawan (Lebanon), saying, "Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has ilah (go up / offer) up against us."

Shaawal (Sheol / afterlife) from beneath has ragaz (moved) for you to qaraah (meet) you at your bawaa (come). It iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rapaa (dead) for you, even all the ithawaday (rulers) of the aratz (Earth/land). It has qawam (rise up) up from their kasaa (thrones) all the malakay (kings) of the gawayam (nations).
They all will inah (answer / respond) and ask you, "Have you also become as chalah (afflict) as we are? Have you mashal (speak in proverb/parable) like us?"

Your gaawan (pomp) is yarad (brought) down to shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are yatzai (spread) out under you, and ramah (worms) makasah (cover) you.

How you napal (fall / be cast down) fallen from shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), morning hayalal (star), ban (son) of the dawn! How you are gadai (cut) down to the aratz (Earth/land), who laid the gawayam (nations) low!

You amar (spoke) in your labab (heart), "I will ilah (go up / offer) into shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens)! I will rawam (will lift up) my kasaa (throne) mail (top/above) the kawakabay (stars) of Al! I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the har (mountain) of mawaid (Feast/Holy Day), in the far tzapawan (north)!
I will ilah (go up / offer) above the bamathay (heights) of the ib (clouds)! I will make myself damah (like) the Most ilayawan (Ilayawan)!"
Yet you shall be yarad (brought) down to shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), to the depths of the bawar (pit).

Those who raah (see) you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, "Is this the ayash (man / husband) who made the aratz (Earth/land) to ragaz (tremble), who raish (shook) mamalakawath (kingdoms);
Who shawam (place / establish / appoint) the thabal (world) like a madabar (wilderness), and overthrew its iyar (cities); who didn't release his asayar (prisoners) to their bayath (house)?"
All the malakay (kings) of the gawayam (nations), sleep in kabawad (glory), everyone in his own bayath (house).

But you are shalak (cast) away from your tomb like an thaib (abominable) natzar (branch), labawash (clothed) with the harag (kill), who are tain (thrust) through with the charab (sword), who yarad (go) down to the abanay (stones) of the bawar (pit); like a pagar (dead) body bawas (trodden) under foot.

You will not yachad (join) them in qabawarah (burial), because you have shachath (destroyed) your aratz (Earth/land). You have harag (kill) your im (nation / people). The zarai (seed) of evildoers will not be qaraa (called) iwalam (forever).

Kawan (prepare) for matabach (slaughter) of his ban (son) because of the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of their ab (father), that they not qawam (rise up) up and yarash (possess) the aratz (Earth/land), and malaa (fill) the surface of the thabal (world) with cities.

"I will qawam (rise up) up against them," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "and karath (cut) off from Babal (Babylon) sham (name) and shaar (remnant), and nayan (son) and nakad (son's) son," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

"I will also shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a mawarash (possession) for the porcupine, and agamay (pools) of mayam (Waters). I will tawaa (sweep) it with the broom of destruction," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has shabai (swear / take oath), amar (spoke), "Surely, as I have damah (thought), so shall it happen; and as I have yaitz (purposed), so shall it qawam (rise up):

That I will shabar (break) the Ashawar (Assyrian) in my aratz (Earth/land), and bawas (tread) him under foot on my har (mountain). Then his il (over) will sawar (leave) them, and his sabal (burden) sawar (leave) their shakam (shoulders).
This is the plan that is yaitz (determined) for the whole aratz (Earth/land). This is the yad (hand) that is natah (stretched) out over all the gawayam (nations).
For Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has planned, and who can stop it? His yad (hand) is natah (stretched) out, and who can shawab (turn back / repent) it back?"
This mashaa (burden) was in the shanah (year) that malak (king) Achaz (Ahaz) mawath (death).

Don't shamach (rejoice), O Palashath (Philistia), all of you, because the shabat (rod) that nakah (struck) you is shabar (broken); for out of the nachash (serpent's) sharash (root) an tzapai (adder) will emerge, and his paray (fruit) will be a sharap (fiery) iwap (flying) serpent.

The bakawar (firstborn) of the dal (poor) will raih (eat), and the abayawan (needy) will rabatz (lie) down in safety; and I will mawath (death) your sharash (root) with raib (famine), and your shaarayath (remnant) will be harag (kill).

Yalal (howl), shair (gate)! Zaiq (cry), iyar (city)! You are mawag (melted) away, Palashath (Philistia), all of you; for ishan (smoke) bawaa (come) out of the tzapawan (north), and there is no straggler in his ranks.

What will they inah (answer / respond) the malaakay (messengers) of the gaway (heathen / nation)? That Yahawah has founded Tzayawan (Zion), and in her the inay (afflicted) of his im (nation / people) will take chasah (refuge).

The mashaa (burden) of Mawaab (Moab): for in a layal (night), Ir (Ar) of Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste), and damah (brought) to nothing; for in a layal (night) Qayar (Kir) of Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste), and damah (brought) to nothing.

They have ilah (go up / offer) up to Bayith, and to Dayabawan (Dibon), to the bamah (high) places, to bakay (weep). Mawaab (Moab) wails over Nabaw (Nebo) and over May-Dabaa (Medeba). Qarachah (baldness) is on all of their raash (head). Every zaqan (beard) is ilah (go up / offer) off.
In their chawatz (streets), they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their rachab (streets) and on their housetops, everyone wails, bakay (weeping) yarad (abundantly).

Chashabawan (Heshbon) zaiq (cries) out with Alailaa (Elealeh). Their qawal (sound / voice) is shamai (hearken / hear) even to Yahatz (Jahaz). Therefore the chalatz (armed) men of Mawaab (Moab) rawai (cry) aloud. Their napash (soul) tremble within them.

My lab (heart) zaiq (cries) out for Mawaab (Moab)! Her nobles flee to Tzair (Zoar), to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Lawachayath (Luhith) with bakay (weeping); for in the darak (way) of Charanayam (Horonaim), they ilah (go up / offer) up a zaiq (cry) of shabar (destruction).

For the may (waters) of Namarayam (Nimrim) will be mashamah (desolate); for the dashaa (grass) has yabash (dry land) away, the tender dashaa (grass) kalah (complete / finish), there is no yaraq (green) thing.
Therefore they will carry away the yatharah (abundance) they ishah (make) gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the nachal (stream / river) of the irabayam (willows).
For the zaiq (cry) has naqap (gone) around the gabawal (border/boundary) of Mawaab (Moab); its wailing to Agalayam (Eglaim), and its wailing to Baaraalayam (Beer Elim).

For the may (waters) of Dayamawan (Dimon) are malaa (full) of dam (blood); for I will shayath (put / appoint / make) yet more on Dayamawan (Dimon), a aray (lion) on those of Mawaab (Moab) who palayatah (escape), and on the shaarayath (remnant) of the adamah (land).

Shalach (send) the kar (lambs) for the mashal (rule/have dominion) of the aratz (Earth/land) from salai (selah) to the madabar (wilderness), to the har (mountain) of the banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion).
For it will be that as nadad (wandering) iwap (flying), as a scattered qan (nest), so will the banawath (daughters) of Mawaab (Moab) be at the maibarath (fords) of the Aranawan (Arnon).

Give itzah (counsel)! Ishah (make) palayalah (justice)! Shayath (put / appoint / make) your tzal (shade) like the layal (night) in the thawak (midst) of the noonday! Sathar (hide) the nadachayam (outcasts)! Don't betray the fugitive!

Let my nadach (outcasts) gawar (dwell) with you! As for Mawaab (Moab), be a sathar (secret / hidden) place for him from the panayam (face) of the shadad (destroyer). For the mawatz (extortioner) is apas (brought) to nothing. Shad (destruction) kalah (complete / finish). The ramas (oppressors) are thamam (consumed) out of the aratz (Earth/land).

A kasaa (throne) will be kawan (established) in loving chasad (grace). One will yashab (inhabit/dwell) on it in amath (truth), in the ahal (tent) of Dawad (David), shapat (judge / judgement), darash (seeking) mashapat (justice), and swift to do tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).
We have shamai (hearken / hear) of the gaawan (pride) of Mawaab (Moab), that he is very gaa (proud); even of his arrogance, his gaawan (pride), and his ibarah (wrath). His boastings are nothing.
Therefore Mawaab (Moab) will wail for Mawaab (Moab). Everyone will wail. You will hagah (mourn) for the raisin cakes of Qayaracharash (Kir Hareseth), utterly nakaa (stricken).

For the shadamawath (fields) of Chashabawan (Heshbon) amal (languish) with the gapan (vine) of Shabam (Sibmah). The bailay (lords) of the gawayam (nations) have halam (broken) down its choice branches, which nagai (reached) even to Yaizayar (Jazer), which thaih (wandered) into the madabar (wilderness). Its shoots were natash (spread) abroad. They ibar (pass over/through) over the yam (sea/waters).

Therefore I will bakah (weep) with the bakay (weeping) of Yaizayar (Jazer) for the gapan (vine) of Shabam (Sibmah). I will rawah (water) you with my damaih (tears), Chashabawan (Heshbon), and Alailaa (Elealeh): for on your qayatz (summer) fruits and on your qatzayar (harvest) the battle hayadad (shout) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen.

Shamachah (gladness) is asap (taken) away, and gayal (joy) out of the karamal (fruitful) field; and in the karamayam (vineyards) there will be no ranan (singing), neither rawai (joyful) noise. Nobody will darak (tread) out yayan (wine) in the presses. I have made the hayadad (shouting) stop.
Therefore my maih (heart) yahamaw (sounds) like a kanawar (harp) for Mawaab (Moab), and my qarab (among / near) parts for Qayaracharash (Kir Heres).

It will happen that when Mawaab (Moab) raah (see) himself, when he laah (wearies) himself on the bamah (high) place, and bawaa (come) to his maqadash (sanctuary) to palal (pray), that he will not yakal (prevail).
This is the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) concerning Mawaab (Moab) in az (time) past.

But now Yahawah has dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), "Within shalawash (three) shanayam (years), as a worker bound by contract would count them, the kabawad (glory) of Mawaab (Moab) shall be brought into contempt, with all his rab (great) hamawan (multitude); and the shaar (remnant) will be very small and feeble."
The mashaa (burden) of Damashaq (Damascus): "Behold, Damashaq (Damascus) is sawar (taken) away from being a iyar (city), and it will be a mapalah (ruinous) maiy (heap).
The iray (cities) of Irawair (Aroer) are forsaken. They will be for idarayam (flocks), which shall rabatz (lie) down, and none shall make them charad (afraid).

The mabatzar (fortress) shall shabath (shabath / rest) from Aparayam (Ephraim), and the mamalakah (kingdom) from Damashaq (Damascus), and the shaar (remnant) of Aram (Syria). They will be as the kabawad (glory) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
"It will happen in that yawam (day) that the kabawad (glory) of Yaiqab (Jacob) will be dalal (made) thin, and the fatness of his bashar (flesh) will become razah (lean).

It will be like when the harvester asap (gathers) the wheat, and his zarawai (arm) qatzar (reaps) the grain. Yes, it will be like when one laqat (gleans) grain in the imaq (valley) of Rapaa (Rephaim).

Yet gleanings will be shaar (left) there, like the naqap (shaking) of an zayath (olive) tree, shanayam (two) or shalawash (three) olives in the raash (head) of the uppermost amayar (bough), arabai (four) or chamash (five) in the outermost branches of a parah (fruitful) tree," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).
In that yawam (day), adam (people) will shaih (look) to their Maker, and their iyan (eye) will raah (see) respect for the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel).

They will not shaih (look) to the mazabachawath (altars), the maishah (work) of their yad (hand); neither shall they raah (see) that which their atzabai (fingers) ishah (make) made, either the Asharah (Asherim), or the incense chamanayam (altars).

In that yawam (day), their maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) iray (cities) will be like the forsaken Charash (places) in the woods and on the panayam (face) top, which were forsaken from before the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); and it will be a shamamah (desolation).

For you have shakach (forgotten) the Alahayam of your yashai (salvation), and have not zakar (remember) the tzawar (rock) of your maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection). Therefore you natai (plant) naiman (pleasant) nataiy (plants), and zarai (set) out foreign seedlings.

In the yawam (day) of your natai (planting), you hedge it in. In the baqar (morning), you make your zarai (seed) parach (blossom), but the qatzayar (harvest) flees away in the yawam (day) of chalah (afflict) and of anash (desperate) kaab (sorrow).

Haway (Alas/Woe!), the uproar of many imayam (peoples), who hamah (great uproar) like the hamah (great uproar) of the yamayam (seas); and the shaawan (rushing) of laamayam (nations), that shaah (rush) like the rushing of kabayar (mighty) mayam (Waters)!

The laamayam (nations) will shaah (rush) like the shaawan (rushing) of many mayam (Waters): but he will gair (rebuke) them, and they will nawas (flee) marachaq (far) off, and will be radap (chased) like the matz (chaff) of the harayam (mountains) panayam (face) the rawach (spirit / wind), and like the whirling dust panayam (face) the sawapah (storm).
At ith (evening), behold, balahah (terror)! Before the baqar (morning), they are no more. This is the chalaq (portion) of those who plunder us, and the gawaral (lot) of those who bazaz (rob) us.
Haway (Alas/Woe!), the aratz (Earth/land) of the rustling of kanapayam (wings), which is ibar (beyond) the naharay (rivers) of Kawash (Ethiopia);

That shalach (send) tzayarayam (ambassadors) by the yam (sea/waters), even in kalay (vessels) of papyrus on the mayam (Waters), saying, "yalak (go), you qal (swift) malaakayam (messengers), to a gaway (heathen / nation) tall and smooth, to a im (nation / people) awesome from their beginning onward, a gaway (heathen / nation) that measures out and treads down, whose aratz (Earth/land) the naharayam (rivers) divide!"

All you yashabay (inhabitants) of the thabal (world), and you shakanay (dwellers) on the aratz (Earth/land), when a nas (banner) is nashaa (lift) up on the harayam (mountains), raah (see)! When the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) is thaqai (blow / sound alarm), shamai (hearken / hear)!

For Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "I will be still, and I will nabat (see) in my makawan (dwelling) place, like tzach (clear) cham (heat) in sunshine, like a ib (cloud) of tal (dew) in the cham (heat) of qatzayar (harvest)."

For panayam (face) the qatzayar (harvest), when the parach (blossom) is over, and the natzah (flower) becomes a gamal (ripening) basar (grape), he will karath (cut) off the zalazalayam (sprigs) with mazamarah (pruning) hooks, and he will thazaz (cut) down and sawar (take) away the spreading branches.

They will be izab (left) yachad (together) for the iyat (ravenous) birds of the harayam (mountains), and for the animals of the aratz (Earth/land). The iyat (ravenous) birds will qawatz (summer) on them, and all the animals of the aratz (Earth/land) will winter on them.

In that ith (time), a shay (present) will be yabal (brought) to Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) from a im (nation / people) tall and smooth, even from a im (nation / people) awesome from their beginning onward, a gaway (heathen / nation) that measures out and treads down, whose aratz (Earth/land) the naharayam (rivers) divide, to the maqawam (place) of the sham (name) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion).

The mashaa (burden) of Matzarayam (Egypt): "Behold, Yahawah rakab (rides) on a qal (swift) ib (cloud), and bawaa (come) to Matzarayam (Egypt). The alayalay (idols) of Matzarayam (Egypt) will tremble at his panayam (face); and the labab (heart) of Matzarayam (Egypt) will masas (melt) in its qarab (among / near).

I will stir up the Matzarayam (Egyptians) against the Matzarayam (Egyptians), and they will lacham (fight) everyone against his ach (brother/kinsman), and everyone against his neighbor; iyar (city) against iyar (city), and mamalakah (kingdom) against mamalakah (kingdom).

The rawach (spirit / wind) of Matzarayam (Egypt) will baqaq (fail) in its qarab (among / near). I will balai (destroy) its itzah (counsel). They will darash (seek) the alayalayam (idols), the atayam (charmers), those who have familiar abawath (spirits), and the yadainayam (wizards).

I will sakar (give) over the Matzarayam (Egyptians) into the yad (hand) of a qashah (rough / hard) Adawan. A iz (fierce) malak (king) will mashal (rule/have dominion) over them," naam (declares prophetically) the Adawan, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
The mayam (Waters) will nashath (fail) from the yam (sea/waters), and the nahar (river) will be charab (wasted) and become yabash (dry land).
The naharawath (rivers) will become foul. The yaaray (streams) of Matzawar (Egypt) will be diminished and charab (dried) up. The qanah (reeds) and sawap (flags) will qamal (wither) away.
The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the mazarai (sown) fields of the Nile, will become yabash (dry land), be nadap (driven) away, and be no more.
The fishermen will anah (lament), and all those who fish in the Nile will abal (mourn), and those who parash (spread) makamarath (nets) on the mayam (Waters) will amal (languish).
Moreover those who ibad (servant) in combed pashathah (flax), and those who weave white cloth, will be bawash (confounded).
The pillars will be dakaa (broken) in pieces. All those who ishah (make) for hire will be grieved in napash (soul).

The sharay (princes) of Tzain (Zoan) are utterly awayal (foolish). The itzah (counsel) of the wisest counselors of Paraih (Pharaoh) has become stupid. How do you amar (spoke) to Paraih (Pharaoh), "I am the ban (son) of the chakam (wise), the ban (son) of qadam (ancient) malakay (kings)?"
Ay (where) then are your chakam (wise) men? Let them nagad (tell) you now; and yadai (let) them know what Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has yaitz (purposed) concerning Matzarayam (Egypt).

The sharay (princes) of Tzain (Zoan) have yaal (become) fools. The sharay (princes) of Nap (Memphis) are nashaa (lift). They have caused Matzarayam (Egypt) to thaih (go) astray, who are the cornerstone of her shabat (tribes).

Yahawah has mixed a rawach (spirit / wind) of perverseness in the qarab (among / near) of her; and they have caused Matzarayam (Egypt) to thaih (go) astray in all of its maishah (works), like a shakawar (drunken) man hathaiw (staggers) in his qaa (vomit).
Neither shall there be any maishah (work) for Matzarayam (Egypt), which raash (head) or zanab (tail), palm kapah (branch) or agamawan (rush), may ishah (make).

In that yawam (day) the Matzarayam (Egyptians) will be like nashayam (women). They will charad (tremble) and pachad (fear / dread) panayam (face) of the thanawapah (shaking) of the yad (hand) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), which he nawap (shakes) over them.

The adamah (land) of Yahawadah (Judah) will become a chagaa (terror) to Matzarayam (Egypt). Everyone to whom zakar (remember) is pachad (fear / dread) of it will be afraid, panayam (face) of the plans of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), which he yaitz (determines) against it.

In that yawam (day), there will be chamash (five) irayam (cities) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) that dabar (word / matter) the shapah (language) of Kanain (Canaan), and shabai (swear / take oath) to Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies). Achad (one) will be amar (spoke) "The iyar (city) of haras (destruction)."

In that yawam (day), there will be an mazabach (altar) to Yahawah in the thawak (midst) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and a matzabah (pillar) to Yahawah at its gabawal (border/boundary).

It will be for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) and for a id (until / as far as) to Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); for they will tzaiq (cry) to Yahawah panayam (face) of lachatzayam (oppressors), and he will shalach (send) them a savior and a defender, and he will natzal (deliver) them.

Yahawah yadai (will) be known to Matzarayam (Egypt), and the Matzarayam (Egyptians) yadai (will) know Yahawah in that yawam (day). Yes, they will ibad (servant) with zabach (sacrifice) and manachah (offering), and will nadar (vow) a nadar (make vow) to Yahawah, and will shalam (perform) it.
Yahawah will nagap (strike) Matzarayam (Egypt), nagap (striking) and rapaa (healing). They will shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawah, and he will be entreated by them, and will rapaa (heal) them.

In that yawam (day) there will be a masalah (highway) out of Matzarayam (Egypt) to Ashawar (Assyria), and the Ashawar (Assyrian) shall bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt), and the Matzarayam (Egyptian) into Ashawar (Assyria); and the Matzarayam (Egyptians) will ibad (servant) with the Ashawar (Assyrians).
In that yawam (day), Yashar-Al (Israel) will be the shalayashay (third) with Matzarayam (Egypt) and with Ashawar (Assyria), a barakah (blessing) in the qarab (among / near) of the aratz (Earth/land);

Because Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has barak (blessed) them, amar (spoke), "barak (blessed) be Matzarayam (Egypt) my im (nation / people), Ashawar (Assyria) the maishah (work) of my yad (hand), and Yashar-Al (Israel) my nachalah (inheritance)."

In the shanah (year) that tharathan (tartan) bawaa (come) to Ashadawad (Ashdod), when Saragawan (Sargon) the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) shalach (send) him, and he lacham (fought) against Ashadawad (Ashdod) and lakad (took) it;

At that ith (time) Yahawah dabar (word / matter) by Yashaiyah (Isaiah) the ban (son) of Amawatz (Amoz), amar (spoke), "yalak (go), and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your nail (shoes) from off your ragal (feet / foot)." He ishah (make) so, halak (move) irawam (naked) and yachap (barefoot).

Yahawah amar (spoke), "As my ibad (servant) Yashaiyah (Isaiah) has halak (move) irawam (naked) and yachap (barefoot) shalawash (three) shanayam (years) for a awath (sign / mark / miracle) and a mawapath (wonder) concerning Matzarayam (Egypt) and concerning Kawash (Ethiopia),

So the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria) will nahag (lead) away the shabay (captives) of Matzarayam (Egypt) and the exiles of Kawash (Ethiopia), nair (young) and zaqan (old), irawam (naked) and yachap (barefoot), and with shathah (drinks) chashap (uncovered), to the irawah (shame) of Matzarayam (Egypt).
They will be chathath (dismayed) and bawash (confounded), because of Kawash (Ethiopia) their mabat (expectation), and of Matzarayam (Egypt) their glory.

The yashab (inhabit/dwell) of this coast ay (land) will amar (spoke) in that yawam (day), ‘Behold, kah (this) is our mabat (expectation), where we nawas (fled) for izarah (help) to be natzal (delivered) from the malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). And we, how will we malat (escape)?'"

The mashaa (burden) of the madabar (wilderness) of the yam (sea/waters). As sawapawath (whirlwinds) in the nagab (south) sweep through, it bawaa (come) from the madabar (wilderness), from an awesome aratz (Earth/land).

A qashah (rough / hard) chazawath (vision) is nagad (declared) to me. The treacherous bagad (man) bagad (deals) treacherously, and the shadad (destroyer) shadad (destroys). Ilah (go up / offer) up, Iyalam (Elam); attack! I have stopped all of Maday (Media's) anachah (sighing).

Therefore my thighs are malaa (filled) with anguish. Chalachalah (pains) achaz (have) taken hold on me, like the tzayarayam (pains) of a yalad (birth / begot) in labor. I am in so much pain that I can't shamai (hearken / hear). I so am bahal (dismayed) that I can't raah (see).
My labab (heart) flutters. Palatzawath (horror) has frightened me. The nashap (twilight) that I chashaq (desired) has been shawam (place / establish / appoint) into charadah (trembling) for me.
They irak (prepare) the shalachan (table). They irak (set) the watch. They akal (eat). They shathah (drinks). Qawam (rise up) up, you sharayam (princes), mashach (oil) the magan (shield)!
For the Adanay amar (spoke) to me, "yalak (go), imad (set) a tzapah (watchman / keep watch). Let him nagad (declare) what he raah (see).
When he raah (see) a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of gamal (camels), he shall listen qashab (diligently) with rab (great) attentiveness."
He qaraa (called) like a aray (lion): "Adanay, I imad (stand) continually on the watchtower in the yawamam (by day), and every layal (night) I stay at my post.

Behold, here bawaa (come) a troop of ayash (man / husband), horsemen in pairs." He inah (answer / respond), "napal (fall / be cast down), napal (fall / be cast down) is Babal (Babylon); and all the engraved pasayalay (images) of her Alahayam are shabar (broken) to the aratz (Earth/land).

You are my madashah (threshing), and the grain of my garan (floor)!" That which I have shamai (hearken / hear) from Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), I have nagad (declared) to you.
The mashaa (burden) of Dawamah (Dumah). One qaraa (called) to me out of Shaiyar (Seir), "shamar (keep/guard), what of the layal (night)? Shamar (keep/guard), what of the layal (night)?"

The shamar (keep/guard) amar (spoke), "The baqar (morning) athayaw (comes), and also the layal (night). If you will baih (inquire), baih (inquire). Athah (you (masc)) shawab (turn back / repent) again."
The mashaa (burden) on Irab (Arabia). In the yair (forest) in Irab (Arabia) you will lawan (lodge), you caravans of Dedanites.
They athah (you (masc)) mayam (Waters) to him who was thirsty. The yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Thayamaa (Tema) qadam (met) the fugitives with their lacham (bread).
For they nadad (fled) away from the charabawath (swords), from the natash (drawn) charab (sword), from the bent qashath (bow), and from the heat of malachamah (battle).
For the Adanay amar (spoke) to me, "Within a shanah (year), as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the kabawad (glory) of Qadar (Kedar) will kalah (complete / finish),

And the shaar (residue) of the masapar (number) of the qashath (archers), the gabawar (mighty) men of the banay (children) of Qadar (Kedar), will be mait (few); for Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), has dabar (word / matter) it."
The mashaa (burden) of the gayaa (valley) of chazayawan (vision). What ails you apaw (now), that you have all ilah (go up / offer) up to the housetops?

You that are full of thashaah (shouting), a hamah (great uproar) iyar (city), a ilayaz (joyous) town; your chalal (slain) are not chalal (slain) with the charab (sword), neither are they mawath (death) in malachamah (battle).

All your qatzayan (rulers) nadad (fled) away yachad (together). They were asar (bound) by the qashath (archers). All who were matzaa (found) by you were asar (bound) yachad (together). They barach (fled) rachawaq (far) away.

Therefore I amar (spoke), "shaih (look) away from me. I will bakay (weep) bitterly. Don't awatz (labor) to nacham (turn away / repent) me for the shad (destruction) of the banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people).

For it is a yawam (day) of mahawamah (confusion), and of mabawasah (treading) down, and of mabawakah (perplexity), from the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), in the gayaa (valley) of chazayawan (vision); a qawar (breaking) down of the qayar (walls), and a shawai (crying) to the har (mountain)."
Iyalam (Elam) nashaa (lift) his ashapah (quiver), with rakab (chariots) of adam (men) and horsemen; and Qayar (Kir) irah (uncovered) the magan (shield).

It happened that your mabachar (choicest) imaq (valleys) were malaa (full) of rakab (chariots), and the horsemen shayath (put / appoint / make) themselves in shayath (put / appoint / make) at the shair (gate).
He took away the masak (covering) of Yahawadah (Judah); and you nabat (looked) in that yawam (day) to the armor in the bayath (house) of the yair (forest).
You raah (see) the breaches of the iyar (city) of Dawad (David), that they were many; and you qabatz (gathered) together the may (waters) of the thachathawan (lower) barakah (pool).
You sapar (book) the bathay (houses) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and you nathatz (broke) down the bathay (houses) to batzar (fortify) the chawamah (wall).

You also ishah (make) a reservoir between the two chamathayam (walls) for the mayam (Waters) of the yashan (old) barakah (pool). But you didn't nabat (look) to him who ishah (make) done this, neither did you raah (see) respect for him who yatzar (purposed) it rachawaq (long) ago.
In that yawam (day), the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), qaraa (called) to bakay (weeping), and to masapad (mourning), and to qarachah (baldness), and to dressing in sackcloth:

And behold, shashawan (joy) and shamachah (gladness), harag (kill) cattle and shachat (killing) tzaan (sheep), akal (eat) bashar (flesh) and shathah (drinks) yayan (wine): "Let us akal (eat) and shathah (drinks), for machar (tomorrow) we will mawath (death)."

Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) galah (revealed) himself in my azan (ear), "Surely this iwan (guilt/iniquity) will not be kapar (forgiven) you until you mawath (death)," amar (spoke) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
Thus amar (spoke) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "yalak (go), bawaa (come) yourself to this sakan (treasurer), even to Shabanaa (Shebna), who is over the bayath (house), and say,

‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have chatzab (dug) out a tomb here?' Chatzab (cutting) himself out a tomb on marawam (high), chiseling a mashakan (habitation) for himself in the salai (rock)!"
Behold, Yahawah will overcome you and hurl you tawal (away) violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.

He will tzanap (surely) tzanap (wind) you around and around, and throw you like a dawar (ball) into a rachab (large) aratz (Earth/land). There you will mawath (death), and there the marakabawath (chariots) of your kabawad (glory) will be, you qalawan (shame) of your Adawan bayath (house).
I will hadap (thrust) you from your office. You will be haras (pulled) down from your station.
It will happen in that yawam (day) that I will qaraa (called) my ibad (servant) Alayaqayam (Eliakim) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah),

And I will labash (clothe) him with your kathanath (robe), and chazaq (strengthen) him with your belt. I will nathan (give) your mamashalah (government) into his yad (hand); and he will be a ab (father) to the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and to the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah).

I will nathan (give) the mapathach (key) of the bayath (house) of Dawad (David) on his shakam (shoulder). He will pathach (open), and no one will sagar (shut). He will sagar (shut), and no one will pathach (open).
I will thaqai (blow / sound alarm) him like a yathad (nail) in a aman (believe / have faith) maqawam (place). He will be for a kasaa (throne) of kabawad (glory) to his ab (father) bayath (house).

They will thalah (hang) on him all the kabawad (glory) of his ab (father) bayath (house), the tzaatzaa (offspring) and the tzapaih (issue), every qatan (small / young / least) kalay (vessel), from the aganawath (cups) even to all the nabalayam (pitchers).

"In that yawam (day)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "the yathad (nail) that was thaqai (blow / sound alarm) in a aman (believe / have faith) maqawam (place) will give mawash (way). It will be gadai (cut) down, and napal (fall / be cast down). The mashaa (burden) that was on it will be karath (cut) off, for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it."

The mashaa (burden) of Tzar (Tyre). Yalal (howl), you anayawath (ships) of Tharashayash (Tarshish)! For it is laid shadad (waste), so that there is no bayath (house), no bawaa (come) in. From the aratz (Earth/land) of Kathay (Kittim) it is galah (revealed) to them.
Be still, you yashabay (inhabitants) of the coast, you whom the sachar (merchants) of Tzayadawan (Sidon), that ibar (pass over/through) over the yam (sea/waters), malaa (have) replenished.
On rab (great) mayam (Waters), the zarai (seed) of the Shayachawar (Shihor), the qatzayar (harvest) of the Nile, was her thabawaah (revenue). She was the market of gawayam (nations).

Be bawash (ashamed), Tzayadawan (Sidon); for the yam (sea/waters) has amar (spoke), the stronghold of the yam (sea/waters), amar (spoke), "I have not chawal (travailed), nor yalad (birth / begot) forth, neither have I gadal (nourished) bachawar (young) men, nor gadal (brought) up bathawalawath (virgins)."
When the shamai (report) comes to Matzarayam (Egypt), they will be in anguish at the shamai (report) of Tzar (Tyre).
Ibar (pass over/through) over to Tharashayash (Tarshish)! Wail, you yashabay (inhabitants) of the coast!
Is this your ilayaz (joyous) city, whose qadamah (antiquity) is of qadam (ancient) yamay (days), whose ragal (feet / foot) yabal (carried) her rachawaq (far) away to travel?
Who has planned this against Tzar (Tyre), the giver of itar (crowns), whose sachar (merchants) are sharayam (princes), whose Kanain (traffickers) are the honorable of the aratz (Earth/land)?
Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has planned it, to chalal (stain) the gaawan (pride) of all glory, to qalal (bring) into contempt all the honorable of the aratz (Earth/land).
Ibar (pass over/through) through your aratz (Earth/land) like the Nile, banath (daughter) of Tharashayash (Tarshish). There is no restraint any more.

He has natah (stretched) out his yad (hand) over the yam (sea/waters). He has ragaz (shaken) the mamalakawath (kingdoms). Yahawah has tzawah (ordered) the destruction of Kanain (Canaan's) strongholds.

He amar (spoke), "You shall ilaz (rejoice) no more, you ishaq (oppressed) bathawalah (virgin) banath (daughter) of Tzayadawan (Sidon). Qawam (rise up), ibar (pass over/through) over to Kathay (Kittim). Even there you will have no nawach (rest)."

Behold, the aratz (Earth/land) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans). This im (nation / people) was not. The Ashawar (Assyrians) founded it for those who dwell in the tzayay (wilderness). They qawam (rise up) up their bachayan (towers). They overthrew its aramawan (palaces). They shawam (place / establish / appoint) it a mapalah (ruin).
Yalal (howl), you anayawath (ships) of Tharashayash (Tarshish), for your stronghold is laid shadad (waste)!

It will come to pass in that yawam (day) that Tzar (Tyre) will be shakach (forgotten) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years), according to the yamay (days) of achad (one) malak (king). Qatz (after) the end of shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) it will be to Tzar (Tyre) like in the shayar (song) of the prostitute.

Laqach (take / seize) a kanawar (harp); sabab (go) about the iyar (city), you prostitute that has been shakach (forgotten). Yatab (make) sweet nagan (melody). Sing many shayar (song), that you may be zakar (remember).

It will happen qatz (after) the end of shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) that Yahawah will paqad (visit) Tzar (Tyre), and she shall shawab (turn back / repent) to her wages, and will zanah (play) the prostitute with all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) on the surface of the adamah (earth).

Her sachar (merchandise) and her wages will be qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah. It will not be atzar (treasured) nor chasan (laid) up; for her sachar (merchandise) will be for those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) panayam (face) Yahawah, to akal (eat) shabaih (seven), and for ithayaq (durable) makasah (clothing).
Behold, Yahawah makes the aratz (Earth/land) baqaq (empty), makes it balaq (waste), iwah (turns) it panayam (face) down, and pawatz (scatters) its yashab (inhabit/dwell).

It will be as with the im (nation / people), so with the kahan (priest); as with the ibad (servant), so with his adawan (master / lord); as with the shapachah (maid), so with her gabarath (mistress); as with the qanah (buyer), so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the nashaa (lift) of interest.
The aratz (Earth/land) will be baqaq (utterly) baqaq (emptied) and bazaz (utterly) laid waste; for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) this dabar (word / matter).
The aratz (Earth/land) abal (mourns) and nabal (fades) away. The thabal (world) languishes and nabal (fades) away. The lofty im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land) amal (languish).

The aratz (Earth/land) also is chanap (polluted) under its yashab (inhabit/dwell), because they ibar (pass over/through) transgressed the thawarath (laws), violated the chaq (statute), and parar (broken) the iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant).

Therefore the alah (curse / oath) has akal (eat) the aratz (Earth/land), and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein are asham (found) guilty. Therefore the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) are charar (burned), and mazair (few) anawash (men) shaar (left).
The new thayarawash (wine) abal (mourns). The gapan (vine) languishes. All the shamach (merry-hearted) anach (sigh).
The mashawash (mirth) of tambourines shabath (shabath / rest). The sound of those who ilayaz (rejoice) chadal (ends). The mashawash (joy) of the kanawar (harp) shabath (shabath / rest).
They will not shathah (drinks) yayan (wine) with a shayar (song). Shakar (strong) drink will be marar (bitter) to those who shathah (drinks) it.
The confused qarayah (city / town) is shabar (broken) down. Every bayath (house) is sagar (shut) up, that no man may bawaa (come) in.
There is a tzawachah (crying) in the chawatzawath (streets) because of the yayan (wine). All shamachah (joy) is irab (evening). The mashawash (mirth) of the aratz (Earth/land) is galah (gone).
The iyar (city) is shaar (left) in shamah (desolation), and the shair (gate) is struck with shaayah (destruction).

For it will be so in the qarab (among / near) of the aratz (Earth/land) thawak (midst) the imayam (peoples), as the naqap (shaking) of an zayath (olive) tree, as the gleanings when the batzayar (vintage) is kalah (complete / finish).
These shall nashaa (lift) up their qawal (sound / voice). They will ranan (shout) for the gaawan (majesty) of Yahawah. They tzahal (cry) aloud from the yam (sea/waters).
Therefore kabad (glorify) Yahawah in the east, even the sham (name) of Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), in the ayay (islands) of the yam (sea/waters)!

From the kanap (uttermost) part of the aratz (Earth/land) have we shamai (hearken / hear) zamarath (songs). Glory to the tzadayaq (righteous)! But I amar (spoke), "I pine away! I pine away! Away (woe) is me!" The bagad (treacherous) have dealt bagad (treacherously). Yes, the bagad (treacherous) have dealt very bagad (treacherously).
Pachad (fear / dread), the pachath (pit), and the pach (snare / trap), are on you who yashab (inhabit/dwell) the aratz (Earth/land).

It will happen that he who nawas (flees) from the qawal (sound / voice) of the pachad (fear / dread) will napal (fall / be cast down) into the pachath (pit); and he who ilah (go up / offer) up out of the thawak (midst) of the pachath (pit) will be lakad (taken) in the pach (snare / trap); for the arabawath (windows) on marawam (high) are pathach (opened), and the mawasaday (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land) raish (tremble).
The aratz (Earth/land) is utterly raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil). The aratz (Earth/land) is torn apart. The aratz (Earth/land) is mawat (shaken) violently.

The aratz (Earth/land) will nawai (stagger) like a shakawar (drunken) nawai (man), and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be kabad (heavy) on it, and it will napal (fall / be cast down) and not qawam (rise up) again.

It shall happen in that yawam (day) that Yahawah will paqad (visit) the tzabaa (troop) of the marawam (high) ones on marawam (high), and the malakay (kings) of the adamah (earth) on the adamah (earth).

They shall be asap (gathered) together, as asayar (prisoners) are gathered in the bawar (pit), and shall be sagar (shut) up in the masagar (prison); and after many yamayam (days) shall they be paqad (visit).

Then the labanah (moon) shall be chapar (confounded), and the chamah (sun) bawash (ashamed); for Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) will malak (king) on har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion), and in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and before his zaqan (elders) will be kabawad (glory).

Yahawah, you are my Alahayam. I will rawam (will lift up) you! I will yadah (praise) your sham (name), for you ishah (make) done wonderful things, things planned rachawaq (long) ago, in complete amawanah (faithfulness) and aman (believe / have faith).

For you have shawam (place / establish / appoint) a iyar (city) into a gal (heap), a batzar (fortified) qarayah (city / town) into a mapalah (ruin), a aramawan (palace) of strangers to be no iyar (city). It will iwalam (forever) be banah (build).
Therefore a iz (strong) im (nation / people) will kabad (glorify) you. A qarayah (city / town) of awesome gawayam (nations) will yaraa (fear / be afraid) you.

For you have been a stronghold to the dal (poor), a stronghold to the abayawan (needy) in his tzar (oppressor / distressor), a machasah (refuge) from the zaram (storm), a tzal (shade) from the charab (heat), when the rawach (spirit / wind) of the dreaded irayatzayam (ones) is like a zaram (storm) against the qayar (wall).

As the charab (heat) in a tzayawan (dry) place will you kanai (bring) down the shaawan (noise) of strangers; as the charab (heat) by the tzal (shade) of a ib (cloud), the song of the dreaded irayatzayam (ones) will be inah (answer / respond) low.

In this har (mountain), Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) will ishah (make) all imayam (peoples) a mashathah (feast) of shaman (fat) things, a mashathah (feast) of choice shamarayam (wines), of shaman (fat) things machah (full) of marrow, of well zaqaq (refined) choice shamarayam (wines).
He will balai (destroy) in this har (mountain) the surface of the lawat (covering) that covers all imayam (peoples), and the masakah (veil) that is nasak (spread) over all gawayam (nations).

He has balai (swallowed) up mawath (death) natzach (forever)! The Adanay Yahawah will machah (wipe) away damaih (tears) from off all panayam (face). He will take the charapah (reproach) of his im (nation / people) sawar (away) from off all the aratz (Earth/land), for Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) it.

It shall be amar (spoke) in that yawam (day), "Behold, this is our Alahayam! We have qawah (gather/wait) for him, and he will yashai (salvation) us! This is Yahawah! We have qawah (gather/wait) for him. We will be gayal (glad) and shamach (rejoice) in his yashawaih (salvation)!"

For in this har (mountain) the yad (hand) of Yahawah will nawach (rest). Mawaab (Moab) will be dawash (trodden) down in his place, even like mathaban (straw) is dawash (trodden) down in the water of the madamanah (dunghill).

He will parash (spread) out his yad (hand) in its qarab (among / near), like one who shachah (swims) parash (spreads) out hands to shachah (swim), but his gaawah (pride) will be shapal (humbled) together with the craft of his yad (hand).
He has brought the high mabatzar (fortress) of your chawamah (walls) down, shapal (laid) low, and nagai (brought) to the aratz (Earth/land), even to the ipar (dust).

In that yawam (day), this shayar (song) will be shayar (sung) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah): "We have a iz (strong) iyar (city). Alahayam appoints yashawaih (salvation) for chawamawath (walls) and chayal (bulwarks).
Pathach (open) the shairayam (gates), that the tzadayaq (righteous) gaway (heathen / nation) may bawaa (come): the one which shamar (keep/guard) amawan (faith).
You will natzar (keep) whoever's yatzar (mind) is steadfast in shalawam (peace / safety) shalawam (peace / safety), because he batach (trusts) in you.
Batach (trust) in Yahawah id (until / as far as); for in Yah, Yahawah, is an iwalam (forever) tzawar (rock).

For he has shachach (brought) down those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on marawam (high), the shagab (lofty) qarayah (city / town). He shapal (lays) it low. He shapal (lays) it low even to the aratz (Earth/land). He nagai (brings) it even to the ipar (dust).
The ragal (feet / foot) shall ramas (tread) it down; Even the ragalay (feet) of the inay (poor), and the paimay (steps) of the dal (needy)."
The arach (way) of the tzadayaq (righteous) is uprightness. You who are yashar (upright) palas (make) the maigal (path) of the tzadayaq (righteous) level.
Yes, in the arach (way) of your mashapat (judgments), Yahawah, have we qawah (gather/wait) for you. Your sham (name) and your renown are the thaawah (desire) of our napash (soul).

With my napash (soul) have I awah (desired) you in the layal (night). Yes, with my rawach (spirit / wind) qarab (among / near) me will I shachar (seek) you earnestly; for when your mashapat (judgments) are in the aratz (Earth/land), the yashabay (inhabitants) of the thabal (world) lamad (teach / instruct) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair).

Let favor be shown to the rashai (wicked), yet he will not lamad (teach / instruct) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). In the aratz (Earth/land) of nakachah (uprightness) he will iwal (deal) wrongfully, and will not raah (see) Yahawah gaawath (majesty).

Yahawah, your yad (hand) is rawam (will lift up) up, yet they don't chazah (see); but they will chazah (see) your qanaah (zeal) for the im (nation / people), and be disappointed. Yes, ash (fire) will akal (eat) your tzar (oppressor / distressor).
Yahawah, you will shapath (ordain) shalawam (peace / safety) for us, for you have also pail (worked) all our maishah (works) for us.
Yahawah our Alahayam, other lords zawalah (besides) you bail (have) had dominion over us, but by you only will we zakar (remember) mention of your sham (name).

The mawath (death) shall not chayah (live). The rapaa (deceased) shall not qawam (rise up). Therefore paqad (visit) you visited and destroyed them, and caused all zakar (remember) of them to abad (destroy / perish).

You have yasap (increased) the gaway (heathen / nation), O Yahawah. You have yasap (increased) the gaway (heathen / nation)! You are kabad (glorified)! You have enlarged all the borders of the aratz (Earth/land).
Yahawah, in tzar (oppressor / distressor) they paqad (visit) visited you. They tzawaq (poured) out a lachash (prayer) when your mawasar (chastening) was on them.

Kamaw (like) as a harah (woman) with child, who qarab (come close) near the yalad (birth / begot) of her delivery, is in chawal (pain) and zaiq (cries) out in her chabal (pangs); so we have been panayam (face) you, Yahawah.

We have harah (been) with child. We have been in chawal (pain). We gave yalad (birth / begot), it seems, only to rawach (spirit / wind). We ishah (make) not worked any yashawaih (salvation) in the aratz (Earth/land); bal (neither) have the yashabay (inhabitants) of the thabal (world) napal (fall / be cast down).

Your mawath (death) shall chayah (live). My nabalah (dead) bodies shall qawam (rise up). Qawatz (awake) and ranan (sing), you who shakan (place) in the ipar (dust); for your tal (dew) is like the tal (dew) of awarath (herbs), and the aratz (Earth/land) will napal (fall / be cast down) forth the rapaa (dead).

Yalak (come), my im (nation / people), bawaa (come) into your rooms, and sagar (shut) your dalath (doors) behind you. Chabah (hide) yourself for a mait (little) ragai (in an instance), until the zaim (indignation) is past.

For, behold, Yahawah yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of his maqawam (place) to paqad (visit) the yashab (inhabit/dwell) of the aratz (Earth/land) for their iwan (guilt/iniquity). The aratz (Earth/land) also will galah (disclose) her dam (blood), and will no longer kasah (cover) her harag (kill).

In that yawam (day), Yahawah with his qashah (rough / hard) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) and chazaq (strong) charab (sword) will paqad (visit) lawayathan (leviathan), the fleeing nachash (serpent), and lawayathan (leviathan) the twisted nachash (serpent); and he will harag (kill) the thanayan (dragon) that is in the yam (sea/waters).
In that yawam (day), inah (answer / respond) to her, "A pleasant karam (vineyard)!
I, Yahawah, am its keeper. I will shaqah (water) it every ragai (in an instance). Lest anyone damage it, I will natzar (keep) it layal (night) and yawam (day).

Chamah (wrath) is not in me, but if I should find shamayar (briers) and shayath (thorns), I nathan (give) do malachamah (battle)! I would march on them and I would tzawath (burn) them yachad (together).

Or else let him chazaq (take) hold of my maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection), that he may ishah (make) shalawam (peace / safety) with me. Let him ishah (make) shalawam (peace / safety) with me."

In days to bawaa (come), Yaiqab (Jacob) will sharash (take) root. Yashar-Al (Israel) will tzawatz (blossom) and parach (bud). They will malaa (fill) the surface of the thabal (world) with thanawabah (fruit).
Has he nakah (struck) them as he struck those who nakah (struck) them? Or are they harag (kill) like those who harag (kill) them were harag (kill)?

In saasaah (measure), when you shalach (send) them away, you rayab (contend) with them. He has removed them with his qashah (rough / hard) rawach (spirit / wind) in the yawam (day) of the east qadayam (wind).

Zaath (this), by this the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of Yaiqab (Jacob) will be kapar (forgiven), and zaath (this) is all the paray (fruit) of sawar (taking) away his chataah (sin): that he shawam (place / establish / appoint) all the abanay (stones) of the mazabach (altar) as chalk abanay (stones) that are napatz (beaten) in pieces, so that the Asharah (Asherim) and the incense altars shall rise no more.

For the batzar (fortified) iyar (city) is badad (solitary), a nawah (habitation) deserted and forsaken, like the madabar (wilderness). The igal (calf) will raih (feed) there, and there he will rabatz (lie) down, and kalah (complete / finish) its branches.

When its qatzayar (boughs) are yabash (dry land), they will be shabar (broken) off. The nashayam (women) will bawaa (come) and set them on awar (light), for they are a im (nation / people) of no bayanah (understanding). Therefore he who ishah (make) them will not racham (show mercy / love) compassion on them, and he who yatzar (formed) them will show them no favor.

It will happen in that yawam (day), that Yahawah will chabat (thresh) from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the nachal (stream / river) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and you will be laqat (gathered) achad (one) by achad (one), banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

It will happen in that yawam (day) that a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) will be thaqai (blow / sound alarm); and those who were ready to abad (destroy / perish) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Ashawar (Assyria), and those who were nadachayam (outcasts) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), shall bawaa (come); and they will shachah (worship) Yahawah in the qadash (set apart / make holy) har (mountain) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the itarah (crown) of gaawath (pride) of the drunkards of Aparayam (Ephraim), and to the nabal (fading) tzayatz (flower) of his tzabay (glorious) thapaarah (beauty), which is on the raash (head) of the fertile gayaa (valley) of those who are halam (overcome) with yayan (wine)!

Behold, the Adanay has a chazaq (mighty) and amayatz (strong) one. Like a zaram (storm) of barad (hail), a qatab (destroying) shair (storm), and like a zaram (storm) of kabayar (mighty) mayam (Waters) shatap (overflowing), he will yanach (cast) them down to the aratz (Earth/land) with his yad (hand).
The itarah (crown) of gaawath (pride) of the drunkards of Aparayam (Ephraim) will be ramas (trodden) under ragal (feet / foot).

The nabal (fading) tzayatzah (flower) of his tzabay (glorious) thapaarah (beauty), which is on the raash (head) of the fertile gayaa (valley), shall be like the first-ripe fig before the qayatz (summer); which someone picks and balai (eats) as soon as he raah (see) it.
In that yawam (day), Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) will become a itarah (crown) of glory, and a tzapayarah (diadem) of thapaarah (beauty), to the shaar (residue) of his im (nation / people);

And a rawach (spirit / wind) of mashapat (justice) to him who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in mashapat (judgment), and gabawarah (strength) to those who shawab (turn back / repent) back the malachamah (battle) at the shair (gate).

They also reel with yayan (wine), and thaih (stagger) with shakar (strong) drink. The kahan (priest) and the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) reel with shakar (strong) drink. They are balai (swallowed) up by yayan (wine). They thaih (stagger) with shakar (strong) drink. They shagah (err) in raah (see / saw). They pawaq (stumble) in palayalayah (judgment).
For all shalachanawath (tables) are completely malaa (full) of filthy qaa (vomit) and tzawaah (filthiness).
Whom will he yarah (teach) daih (knowledge)? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the chalab (milk), and ithayaq (drawn) from the shadayam (breasts)?
For it is tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept), tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept); qaw (line) on qaw (line), qaw (line) on qaw (line); here a zaiyar (little), there a zaiyar (little).
But he will dabar (word / matter) to this im (nation / people) with laig (stammering) shapah (lips) and in achar (other) lashawan (tongue / language);
To whom he amar (spoke), "This is the nawach (resting) place. Give manawachah (rest) to iyap (weary);" and "This is the maragaih (refreshing);" yet they would not shamai (hearken / hear).

Therefore the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah will be to them tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept), tzaw (precept) on tzaw (precept); qaw (line) on qaw (line), qaw (line) on qaw (line); here a zaiyar (little), there a zaiyar (little); that they may yalak (go), kashal (stumble / stagger) backward, be shabar (broken), be yaqash (snared), and be lakad (taken).
Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, you latzawan (scoffers), that mashal (rule/have dominion) this anashay (people) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem):

"Because you have amar (spoke), ‘We have karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with mawath (death), and with shaawal (Sheol / afterlife) are we in chazah (agreement). When the shatap (overflowing) shayat (scourge) passes ibar (pass over/through), it won't bawaa (come) to us; for we have shawam (place / establish / appoint) kazab (lies) our machasah (refuge), and we have sathar (hidden) ourselves under falsehood.'"

Therefore thus amar (spoke) the Adanay Yahawah, "Behold, I yasad (lay) in Tzayawan (Zion) for a foundation a aban (stone), a bachan (tried) aban (stone), a yaqar (precious) cornerstone of a yasad (sure) mawasad (foundation). He who aman (believe / have faith) shall not act hastily.

I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) mashapat (justice) the measuring qaw (line), and tzadaqah (righteousness) the plumb line. The barad (hail) will yaih (sweep) away the machasah (refuge) of kazab (lies), and the mayam (Waters) will shatap (overflow) the sathar (secret / hidden) place.

Your barayath (covenant) with mawath (death) shall be annulled, and your chazawath (agreement) with shaawal (Sheol / afterlife) shall not qawam (rise up). When the shatap (overflowing) shawat (scourge) passes ibar (pass over/through), then you will be trampled down by it.

As often as it passes ibar (pass over/through), it will laqach (take / seize) you; for baqar (morning) by baqar (morning) it will ibar (pass over/through) through, by yawam (day) and by layal (night); and it will be nothing but terror to bayan (between) the message."
For the matzai (bed) is too qatzar (short) to sharai (stretch) out on, and the blanket is too narrow to kanas (wrap) oneself in.

For Yahawah will qawam (rise up) up as on har (mountain) Paratzayam (Perazim). He will be angry as in the imaq (valley) of Gabaiwan (Gibeon); that he may ishah (make) his maishah (work), his unusual maishah (work), and ibad (servant) to pass his ibadah (act), his extraordinary ibadah (act).

Now therefore don't be thathalawatzatzaw (scoffers), lest your mawasar (bonds) be chazaq (made) strong; for I have shamai (hearken / hear) a charatz (decree) of destruction from the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), on the whole aratz (Earth/land).
Azan (ear) ear, and shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice)! Listen, and shamai (hearken / hear) my amarah (sayings)!
Does he who charash (plows) to zarai (sow) charash (plow) yawam (day)? Does he keep turning the soil and shadad (breaking) the clods?

When he has leveled its surface, doesn't he plant the dill, and zaraq (scatter) the cumin seed, and shawam (place / establish / appoint) in the chatah (wheat) in rows, the shairah (barley) in the saman (appointed) place, and the spelt in its gabawalah (place)?
For his Alahayam yasar (instructs) him in right mashapat (judgment), and teaches him.

For the dill are not dawash (threshed) with a charawatz (sharp) instrument, neither is a igalah (cart) awapan (wheel) sabab (turned) over the cumin; but the dill is chabat (beaten) out with a stick, and the cumin with a shabat (rod).

Lacham (bread) flour must be daqaq (ground); so he will not natzach (always) be adash (threshing) it. Although he drives the galagal (wheel) of his threshing igalah (cart) over it, his horses don't grind it.

This also yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), who is palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in itzah (counsel), and gadal (excellent) in thawashayah (wisdom).

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To Arayaal (Ariel)! Arayaal (Ariel), the qarayah (city / town) where Dawad (David) chanah (encamped)! Sapah (add) shanah (year) to shanah (year); let the chagayam (feasts) come around;
Then I will tzawaq (distress) Arayaal (Ariel), and there will be thaanayah (mourning) and anayah (lamentation). She shall be to me as an Arayaal (altar) hearth.
I will chanah (encamp) against you all around you, and will tzawar (lay) siege against you with posted troops. I will qawam (rise up) siege works qawam (rise up) you.

You will be shapal (brought) down, and will dabar (word / matter) out of the aratz (Earth/land). Your amarah (sayings) will mumble out of the ipar (dust). Your qawal (sound / voice) will be as of one who has a familiar awab (spirit), out of the aratz (Earth/land), and your amarah (sayings) will tzapap (whisper) out of the ipar (dust).

But the hamawan (multitude) of your foes will be like fine abaq (dust), and the hamawan (multitude) of the ruthless irayatzayam (ones) like matz (chaff) that blows ibar (pass over/through). Yes, it will be in an pathai (instant), pathaawam (suddenly).

She will be paqad (visit) by Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) with raim (thunder), with raish (earthquake), with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qawal (sound / voice), with sawapah (whirlwind) and sair (storm), and with the lahab (flame) of a akal (eat) ash (fire).

The hamawan (multitude) of all the gawayam (nations) that tzabaa (troop) against Arayaal (Ariel), even all who tzabaa (troop) against her and her stronghold, and who tzawaq (distress) her, will be like a chalawam (dream), a chazawan (vision) of the layal (night).

It will be like when a raib (hungry) chalam (dream) dreams, and behold, he akal (eat); but he qawatz (awakes), and his hunger isn't satisfied; or like when a thirsty tzamaa (man) dreams, and behold, he shathah (drinks); but he qawatz (awakes), and behold, he is iyap (faint), and he is still thirsty. The hamawan (multitude) of all the gawayam (nations) that tzabaa (troop) against har (mountain) Tzayawan (Zion) will be like that.
Pause and thamah (wonder)! Blind yourselves and be blind! They are shakar (drunken), but not with yayan (wine); they nawai (stagger), but not with shakar (strong) drink.

For Yahawah has nasak (poured) out on you a rawach (spirit / wind) of tharadamah (deep) sleep, and has itzam (closed) your iyan (eye), the nabayaayam (prophets); and he has kasah (covered) your raash (head), the chazayam (seers).

All chazawath (vision) has become to you like the dabaray (words) of a sapar (book / scribed document) that is chatham (sealed), which men nathan (give) to yadai (one) who is educated, amar (spoke), "qaraa (called) this, please;" and he amar (spoke), "I can't, for it is chatham (sealed):"
And the sapar (book / scribed document) is nathan (give) to yadai (one) who is not educated, amar (spoke), "qaraa (called) this, please;" and he amar (spoke), "I can't read."

The Adanay amar (spoke), "yain (because) this im (nation / people) nagash (draws) near with their pah (mouth) and with their shapah (lips) to honor me, but they have rachaq (removed) their lab (heart) rachaq (far) from me, and their yaraa (fear) of me is a commandment of im (nation / people) which has been lamad (teach / instruct);

Therefore, behold, I will yasap (proceed) to do a marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) among this im (nation / people), even a marvelous palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) and a palaa (wonder); and the chakamah (wisdom) of their chakam (wise) men will abad (destroy / perish), and the bayanah (understanding) of their bayan (between) men will be sathar (hidden)."

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who imaq (deeply) sathar (hide) their itzah (counsel) from Yahawah, and whose maishah (works) are in the machashak (dark), and who amar (spoke), "Who raah (see) us?" And "Who yadai (knows) us?"

You turn things hapak (upside) down! Should the yatzar (potter) be chashab (thought) to be like chamar (clay); that the thing ishah (make) should amar (spoke) ishah (make) him who made it, "He didn't ishah (make) me;" or the thing formed amar (spoke) of him who yatzar (formed) it, "He has no bayan (between)?"

Isn't it yet a very mait (little) while, and Labanawan (Lebanon) will be shawab (turn back / repent) into a karamal (fruitful) field, and the karamal (fruitful) field will be chashab (regarded) as a yair (forest)?

In that yawam (day), the charash (deaf) will shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document), and the iyanay (eyes) of the iwar (blind) will raah (see) out of apal (obscurity) and out of chashak (darkness).
The inaw (humble) also will yasap (increase) their shamachah (joy) in Yahawah, and the abayawan (poor) among adam (men) will gayal (rejoice) in the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel).
For the ruthless is apas (brought) to nothing, and the lawatz (scoffer) kalah (complete / finish), and all those who are alert to do awan (evil) are karath (cut) off—
Who cause a adam (person) to be indicted by a dabar (word / matter), and qawash (lay) a snare for the arbiter in the shair (gate), and who deprive the innocent of justice with false testimony.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, who padah (redeemed) Abaraham (Abraham), concerning the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob): "Yaiqab (Jacob) shall no longer be bawash (ashamed), neither shall his panayam (face) grow chawar (pale).

But when he raah (see) his yalad (birth / begot), the maishah (work) of my yad (hand), in the qarab (among / near) of him, they will qadash (set apart / make holy) my sham (name). Yes, they will qadash (set apart / make holy) the qadawash (holy) One of Yaiqab (Jacob), and will stand in awe of the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel).
They also who thaih (err) in rawach (spirit / wind) yadai (will) come to bayanah (understanding), and those who grumble will receive instruction."

"Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the sarar (rebellious) banayam (children)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "who ishah (make) itzah (counsel), but not from me; and who make an alliance, but not with my rawach (spirit / wind), that they may sapah (add) chataah (sin) to chataah (sin),

Who set out to yarad (go) down into Matzarayam (Egypt), and have not shaal (asked) my advice; to izaz (strengthen) themselves in the maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) of Paraih (Pharaoh), and to take chasah (refuge) in the tzal (shadow) of Matzarayam (Egypt)!
Therefore the maiwaz (stronghold / fortress / protection) of Paraih (Pharaoh) will be your bashath (shame), and the refuge in the tzal (shadow) of Matzarayam (Egypt) your kalamah (confusion).
For their shar (prince / ruler) are at Tzain (Zoan), and their malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) have nagai (come) to Chanas (Hanes).

They shall all be bashath (ashamed) because of a im (nation / people) that can't yail (profit) them, that are not a izar (help) nor yail (profit), but a bashath (shame), and also a charapah (reproach)."

The mashaa (burden) of the animals of the nagab (south). Through the aratz (Earth/land) of tzarah (trouble) and tzawaq (anguish), of the lioness and the layash (lion), the apaih (viper) and sharap (fiery) iwap (flying) serpent, they nashaa (lift) their riches on the kathap (shoulders) of iyar (young) donkeys, and their awatzar (treasures) on the humps of gamalayam (camels), to an unprofitable im (nation / people).
For Matzarayam (Egypt) yaizaraw (helps) in habal (vain), and to no rayaq (purpose); therefore have I qaraa (called) her rahab (rahab) who shabath (shabath / rest) still.

Now bawaa (come), kathab (write) it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a sapar (book / scribed document), that it may be for the yawam (day) to acharawan (come) iwalam (forever) and yawam (day).
For it is a rebellious im (nation / people), kachash (lying) banayam (children), banayam (children) who abah (be willing / desire) not shamai (hearken / hear) the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah;

Who amar (spoke) the seers, "Don't raah (see)!" And to the chazayam (prophets), "Don't chazah (prophesy) to us nakachah (right) things. Dabar (word / matter) us pleasant things. Chazah (prophesy) mahathalawath (deceits).
Sawar (get) out of the darak (way). Natah (turn) aside from the arach (path). Cause the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel) to shabath (shabath / rest) from panayam (face) us."

Therefore thus amar (spoke) the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel), "Because you maas (despise) this dabar (word / matter), and batach (trust) in ishaq (oppression) and lawaz (perverseness), and shain (rely) on it;

Therefore this iwan (guilt/iniquity) shall be to you like a paratz (breach) napal (fall / be cast down) to fall, baih (swelling) out in a shagab (high) chawamah (wall), whose shabar (breaking) bawaa (come) pathaawam (suddenly) in an pathai (instant).

He will shabar (break) it as a yawatzarayam (potters) nabal (vessel) is shabar (broken), breaking it in kathath (pieces) without chamal (sparing), so that there won't be matzaa (found) among the broken piece a piece good enough to chathah (take) ash (fire) from the yaqad (hearth), or to dip up mayam (Waters) out of the cistern."

For thus amar (spoke) the Adanay Yahawah, the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel), "You will be yashai (salvation) in shawabah (returning) and nachath (rest). Your gabawarah (strength) will be in shaqat (quietness) and in batachah (confidence)." You refused,

But you amar (spoke), "No, for we will nawas (flee) on sawas (horses);" therefore you will nawas (flee); and, "We will rakab (ride) on the qal (swift);" therefore those who radap (pursue) you will be qalal (swift).

Achad (one) alap (thousand) will flee at the threat of achad (one). At the threat of chamash (five), you will nawas (flee) until you are yathar (left) like a tharan (beacon) on the raash (head) of a har (mountain), and like a nas (banner) on a gabaih (hill).

Therefore Yahawah will chakah (wait), that he may be gracious to you; and therefore he will be rawam (will lift up), that he may have racham (show mercy / love) on you, for Yahawah is a Alahayam of mashapat (justice). Ashar (who/that) are all those who chakah (wait) for him.

For the im (nation / people) will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Tzayawan (Zion) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). You will bakah (weep) no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the qawal (sound / voice) of your qawal (sound / voice). When he shamai (hearken / hear) you, he will inah (answer / respond) you.

Though the Adanay may nathan (give) you the lacham (bread) of adversity and the mayam (Waters) of lachatz (affliction), yet your teachers won't be hidden anymore, but your iyan (eye) will raah (see) your teachers;

And when you aman (believe / have faith) to the right hand, and when you shamaal (turn) to the left, your azan (ear) will shamai (hearken / hear) a dabar (word / matter) achar (other) you, amar (spoke), "This is the darak (way). Yalak (walk) in it."

You shall tamaa (defile) the tzapaway (overlaying) of your engraved pasayalay (images) of kasap (silver), and the plating of your masakah (molten) images of zahab (gold). You shall zarah (cast) them away as an dawah (unclean) thing. You shall amar (spoke) it, "yatzaa (go out / come out) away!"

He will nathan (give) the matar (rain) for your zarai (seed), with which you will zarai (sow) the adamah (ground); and lacham (bread) of the thabawaah (increase) of the adamah (ground) will be rich and plentiful. In that yawam (day), your livestock will raih (feed) in rachab (large) kar (pastures).

The alapayam (oxen) likewise and the iyar (young) donkeys that ibad (servant) the adamah (ground) will akal (eat) savory balayal (provender), which has been zarah (winnowed) with the rachath (shovel) and with the fork.

There shall be brooks and yabalay (streams) of mayam (Waters) on every gabah (lofty) har (mountain) and on every nashaa (lift) gabaih (hill) in the yawam (day) of the rab (great) harag (kill), when the magadalayam (towers) napal (fall / be cast down).

Moreover the awar (light) of the labanah (moon) will be like the awar (light) of the chamah (sun), and the awar (light) of the chamah (sun) will be shabai (seven) times brighter, like the awar (light) of shabai (seven) yamayam (days), in the yawam (day) that Yahawah chabash (binds) up the fracture of his im (nation / people), and rapaa (heals) the makah (wound) they were struck with.

Behold, the sham (name) of Yahawah bawaa (come) from marachaq (far) bair (away), burning with his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and in thick rising kabad (smoke). His shapah (lips) are malaa (full) of zaim (indignation), and his lashawan (tongue / language) is as a akal (eat) ash (fire).

His rawach (spirit / wind) is as an shatap (overflowing) nachal (stream / river) that reaches even to the tzawaar (neck), to nawap (sift) the gawayam (nations) with the napah (sieve) of destruction; and a rasan (bridle) that leads to ruin will be in the lachayay (jaws) of the imayam (peoples).

You will have a shayar (song), as in the layal (night) when a qadash (set apart / make holy) chag (feast/festival) is qadash (set apart / make holy); and shamachah (gladness) of labab (heart), as when one halak (move) with a flute to bawaa (come) to Yahawah har (mountain), to Yashar-Al (Israel's) tzawar (rock).

Yahawah will cause his hawad (glorious) qawal (sound / voice) to be shamai (hearken / hear), and will show the descent of his zarawai (arm), with the zaip (indignation) of his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and the lahab (flame) of a akal (eat) ash (fire), with a blast, zaram (storm), and hailstones.
For through the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah the Ashawar (Assyrian) will be chathath (dismayed). He will nakah (strike) him with his shabat (rod).

Kal (every) stroke of the matah (staff / rod / tribe) of punishment, which Yahawah will nawach (lay) on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and kanarawath (harps). He will lacham (fight) with them in malachamawath (battles), brandishing weapons.

For his Thapathah (burning) place has long been ready. Yes, for the malak (king) it is kawan (prepared). He has made its pyre imaq (deep) and rachab (large) with ash (fire) and much itz (wood). Yahawah nashamah (breathing thing), like a nachal (stream / river) of sulfur, bair (kindles) it.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To those who yarad (go) down to Matzarayam (Egypt) for izarah (help), and shain (rely) on sawasayam (horses), and batach (trust) in rakab (chariots) because they are many, and in horsemen because they are very itzam (strong), but they don't shaih (look) to the qadawash (holy) One of Yashar-Al (Israel), and they don't darash (seek) Yahawah!

Yet he also is chakam (wise), and will bawaa (come) disaster, and will not sawar (call) back his dabar (word / matter), but will qawam (rise up) against the bayath (house) of the evildoers, and against the izarah (help) of those who pail (work) awan (iniquity).

Now the Matzarayam (Egyptians) are adam (men), and not Al; and their sawas (horses) bashar (flesh), and not rawach (spirit / wind). When Yahawah stretches out his yad (hand), both he who izar (helps) shall kashal (stumble / stagger), and he who is izar (helped) shall napal (fall / be cast down), and they all shall be kalah (complete / finish) yachad (together).
