It shall happen that, before they qaraa (called), I will inah (answer / respond); and while they are yet dabar (word / matter), I will shamai (hearken / hear).

The zaab (wolf) and the talah (lamb) shall raih (feed) achad (one), and the aray (lion) shall akal (eat) thaban (straw) like the baqar (morning); and ipar (dust) shall be the nachash (serpent's) lacham (food). They shall not raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) nor shachath (destroy) in all my qadash (set apart / make holy) har (mountain)," amar (spoke) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) is my kasaa (throne), and the aratz (Earth/land) is my footstool: what kind of bayath (house) will you banah (build) to me? And what maqawam (place) shall be my manawachah (rest)?

For all these things has my yad (hand) ishah (make), and so all these things came to be," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: "but to this man will I nabat (look), even to him who is inay (poor) and of a nakah (contrite) rawach (spirit / wind), and who trembles at my dabar (word / matter).

He who shachat (kills) an shawar (ox) is as he who nakah (kills) a ayash (man / husband); he who zabach (sacrifices) a shah (lamb), as he who irap (breaks) a kalab (dog's) irap (neck); he who ilah (go up / offer) an manachah (offering), as he who offers pig's dam (blood); he who zakar (remember) labawanah (frankincense), as he who blesses an awan (idol). Yes, they have bachar (chosen) their own darak (ways), and their napash (soul) chapatz (delights) in their shaqawatz (abominations):

I also will bachar (choose) their thailawal (delusions), and will bawaa (come) their magawarah (fears) on them; because when I qaraa (called), no one dabar (word / matter); when I dabar (word / matter), they didn't shamai (hearken / hear); but they ishah (make) that which was rai (evil) in my iyan (eye), and bachar (chose) that in which I didn't chapatz (delight)."

Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, you who tremble at his dabar (word / matter): "Your ach (brother/kinsman) who shanaa (hate) you, who nadah (cast) you out for my sham (name) sake, have amar (spoke), ‘Let Yahawah be kabad (glorified), that we may raah (see) your shamachah (joy);' but it is those who shall be disappointed.

A qawal (sound / voice) of shaawan (tumult) from the iyar (city), a qawal (sound / voice) from the hayakal (temple), a qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah that shalam (renders) gamawal (recompense) to his ayab (enemy).
"Before she chawal (travailed), she yalad (birth / begot) forth; before her chabal (pain) bawaa (come), she malat (delivered) a zakar (remember).

Who has shamai (hearken / hear) such a thing? Who raah (see) seen such things? Shall a aratz (Earth/land) be born in achad (one) yawam (day)? Shall a gaway (heathen / nation) be chawal (brought) forth at paim (once)? For as soon as Tzayawan (Zion) chawal (travailed), she yalad (birth / begot) forth her ban (son).

Shall I shabar (bring) to the birth, and not cause to yalad (birth / begot) forth?" Amar (spoke) Yahawah: "shall I who cause to yalad (birth / begot) forth itzar (shut) the womb?" Amar (spoke) your Alahayam.
"Shamach (rejoice) with Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and be gayal (glad) for her, all you who ahab (love) her: shawash (rejoice) for mashawash (joy) with her, all you who abal (mourn) over her;

That you may yanaq (nurse) and be shabai (satisfied) at the thanachawam (comforting) shad (breasts); that you may drink deeply, and be inag (delighted) with the zayaz (abundance) of her kabawad (glory)."

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "Behold, I will natah (extend) shalawam (peace / safety) to her like a nahar (river), and the kabawad (glory) of the gawayam (nations) like an shatap (overflowing) nachal (stream / river): and you will yanaq (nurse). You will be nashaa (lift) on her tzad (side), and will be shaii (dandled) on her barakayam (knees).
As ayash (man / husband) whom his am (mother) thanachamaw (comforts), so will I nacham (turn away / repent) you; and you will be nacham (turn away / repent) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."

You will raah (see) it, and your lab (heart) shall shawash (rejoice), and your itzam (bones) shall parach (flourish) like the tender dashaa (grass): and the yad (hand) of Yahawah shall be yadai (known) toward his ibad (servant); and he will have zaim (indignation) against his ayab (enemy).

For, behold, Yahawah will bawaa (come) with ash (fire), and his marakabah (chariots) shall be like the sawapah (whirlwind); to shawab (turn back / repent) his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) with fierceness, and his gairah (rebuke) with lahabay (flames) of ash (fire).
For by ash (fire) will Yahawah execute shapat (judge / judgement), and by his charab (sword), on all bashar (flesh); and the chalal (slain) of Yahawah shall be many.

"Those who qadash (set apart / make holy) themselves and tahar (purify) themselves to go to the ganawath (gardens), achar (other) achad (one) in the thawak (midst), akal (eat) pig's bashar (flesh), and the shaqatz (abomination), and the ikabar (mouse), they shall come to an sawap (end) yachad (together)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

"For I know their maishah (works) and their machashabah (thoughts): the time baaw (comes), that I will qabatz (gather) all gawayam (nations) and lashanawath (languages); and they shall bawaa (come), and shall raah (see) my kabawad (glory).

"I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) a awath (sign / mark / miracle) among them, and I will shalach (send) such as palayat (escape) of them to the gawayam (nations), to Tharashayash (Tarshish), Pawal (Pul), and Lawad (Lud), who mashak (draw) the qashath (bow), to Thawabal (Tubal) and Yawan (Javan), to the ayayam (islands) rachawaq (afar) off, who have not shamai (hearken / hear) my shamai (fame), neither raah (see) seen my kabawad (glory); and they shall nagad (declare) my kabawad (glory) among the gawayam (nations).

They shall bawaa (come) all your ach (brother/kinsman) out of all the gawayam (nations) for an manachah (offering) to Yahawah, on sawasayam (horses), and in rakab (chariots), and in tzabayam (litters), and on paradayam (mules), and on dromedaries, to my qadash (set apart / make holy) har (mountain) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke) Yahawah, as the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bawaa (come) their manachah (offering) in a tahawar (clean) kalay (vessel) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Of them also will I laqach (take / seize) for kahanayam (priests) and for Lawayay (Levites)," amar (spoke) Yahawah.

"For as the chadash (new) shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the chadash (new) aratz (Earth/land), which I will ishah (make), shall imad (remain) panayam (face) me," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "so your zarai (seed) and your sham (name) shall imad (remain).

It shall happen, that from one new chadash (month) to another, and from one shabath (shabath / rest) to another, shall all bashar (flesh) bawaa (come) to shachah (worship) panayam (face) me," amar (spoke) Yahawah.

"They shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, and raah (see) on the pagar (dead) bodies of the anashayam (men) who have pashai (transgressed) against me: for their thawalai (worm) shall not mawath (death), neither shall their ash (fire) be kabah (quenched); and they will be loathsome to all bashar (flesh)."
The dabaray (words) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), of the kahanayam (priests) who were in Inathawath (Anathoth) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin):

To whom the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came in the yamay (days) of Yaashayah (Josiah) the ban (son) of Amawan (Amon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the thirteenth shanah (year) of his malak (king).

It came also in the yamay (days) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), to the thamam (end) of the ishathay (eleven) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), to the galah (carrying) away of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) galah (captive) in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month).
Now the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

"Taram (before) I yatzar (formed) you in the batan (belly), I yadai (knew) you. Before you yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the racham (womb), I qadash (set apart / make holy) you. I nathan (give) appointed you a nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to the gawayam (nations)."
Then I amar (spoke), "ahah (ah), Adanay Yahawah! Behold, I don't know how to dabar (word / matter); for I am a nair (child)."

But Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Don't amar (spoke), ‘I am a nair (child);' for to whoever I shall shalach (send) you, you shall yalak (go), and whatever I shall tzawah (command) you, you shall dabar (word / matter).
Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) panayam (face) of them; for I am with you to natzal (deliver) you," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Then Yahawah shalach (send) forth his yad (hand), and nagai (touched) my pah (mouth); and Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Behold, I nathan (give) put my dabar (word / matter) in your pah (mouth).

Raah (see), I have this yawam (day) paqad (visit) you over the gawayam (nations) and over the mamalakawath (kingdoms), to nathash (pluck) up and to nathatz (break) down and to abad (destroy / perish) and to haras (overthrow), to banah (build) and to natai (plant)."
Moreover the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke), "Yaramayah (Jeremiah), what do you raah (see)?" I amar (spoke), "I raah (see) a branch of an shaqad (almond) tree."
Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "You raah (see) seen yatab (well); for I shaqad (watch) over my dabar (word / matter) to ishah (make) it."

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me the shanay (second) time, amar (spoke), "What do you raah (see)?" I amar (spoke), "I raah (see) a boiling sayar (caldron); and it is tipping away from the tzapawan (north)."
Then Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "Out of the tzapawan (north) rai (evil) will pathach (break) out on all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land).

For, behold, I will qaraa (called) all the mashapachawath (families) of the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the tzapawan (north)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; "and they shall bawaa (come), and they shall ayash (man / husband) nathan (give) his kasaa (throne) at the pathach (entrance) of the shairay (gates) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and against all its chawamah (walls) all around, and against all the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah).

I will dabar (word / matter) my mashapat (judgments) il (over) them touching all their rai (wickedness), in that they have forsaken me, and have qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, and shachah (worshiped) the maishay (works) of their own yad (hand).

"You therefore put your belt on your waist, qawam (rise up), and dabar (word / matter) to them all that I tzawah (command) you. Don't be chathath (dismayed) at them, lest I chathath (dismay) you panayam (face) them.

For, behold, I nathan (give) made you this yawam (day) a fortified iyar (city), and an barazal (iron) imawad (pillar), and bronze chamawath (walls), against the whole aratz (Earth/land), against the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah), against its shar (prince / ruler), against its kahan (priest), and against the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land).
They will lacham (fight) against you; but they will not yakal (prevail) against you; for I am with you," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "to natzal (deliver) you."
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

"Halak (move), and qaraa (called) in the azanay (ears) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "I zakar (remember) for you the chasad (grace) of your naiwar (youth), the ahabah (love) of your weddings; how you yalak (went) achar (other) me in the madabar (wilderness), in a aratz (Earth/land) that was not zarai (sown).

Yashar-Al (Israel) was qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah, the raashayath (beginning) fruits of his thabawaah (increase). Akal (eat) who devour him shall be asham (held) guilty. Rai (evil) shall bawaa (come) on them,"' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah."
Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, O bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and all the mashapachawath (families) of the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel)!

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "What iwal (unrighteousness) have your ab (father) matzaa (found) in me, that they have rachaq (gone) far from me, and have yalak (walked) achar (other) habal (vanity), and are habal (become) vain?

Neither did they amar (spoke), ‘Where is Yahawah who ilah (go up / offer) us up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), who yalak (led) us through the madabar (wilderness), through a aratz (Earth/land) of irabah (deserts) and of shawachah (pits), through a aratz (Earth/land) of tzayah (drought) and of the shadow of tzalamawath (death), through a aratz (Earth/land) that ayash (man / husband) ibar (pass over/through) through, and where no ayash (man / husband) lived?'

I bawaa (come) you into a karamal (plentiful) aratz (Earth/land), to akal (eat) its paray (fruit) and its goodness; but when you bawaa (come), you tamaa (defiled) my aratz (Earth/land), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) my nachalah (heritage) an thawaibah (abomination).

The kahanayam (priests) didn't amar (spoke), ‘Where is Yahawah?' And those who thapash (handle) the thawarah (instruction) didn't yadai (know) me. The raiyam (rulers) also pashai (transgressed) against me, and the nabayaayam (prophets) nabaa (prophesied) by Bail (Baal), and halak (move) achar (other) things that yail (do) not profit.
"Therefore I will yet rayab (contend) with you," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "and I will rayab (contend) with your banay (childrens) banay (children).

For ibar (pass over/through) over to the ayay (islands) of Kathay (Kittim), and raah (see); and shalach (send) to Qadar (Kedar), and bayan (between) maad (diligently); and raah (see) if there has been such a thing.

Has a gaway (heathen / nation) mawar (changed) its Alahayam, which really are no Alahayam? But my im (nation / people) have mawar (changed) their kabawad (glory) for that which yail (does) not profit.
"Be shamam (astonished), you shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), at this, and be horribly shair (dread / storm / horror). Be very charab (desolate)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

"For my im (nation / people) ishah (make) committed shanayam (two) raiwath (evils): they have forsaken me, the maqawar (spring) of chay (life) mayam (Waters), and chatzab (cut) them out baarawath (cisterns), shabar (broken) baarawath (cisterns), that kawal (all) hold no mayam (Waters).
Is Yashar-Al (Israel) a ibad (servant)? Is he a native-born slave? Madawai (for what reason?) Has he become a baz (prey)?

The young kaparayam (lions) have shaag (roared) at him, and yelled. They have shayath (put / appoint / make) his aratz (Earth/land) shamah (waste). His iyar (cities) are yatzath (burned) up, without yashab (inhabit/dwell).
The banay (children) also of Nap (Memphis) and Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes) have raih (broken) the qadaqad (crown) of your head.
"Haven't you ishah (make) this to yourself, in that you have forsaken Yahawah your Alahayam, when he yalak (led) you by the darak (way)?

Now what have you to do in the darak (way) to Matzarayam (Egypt), to shathah (drinks) the may (waters) of the Shayachawar (Shihor)? Or what have you to do in the darak (way) to Ashawar (Assyria), to shathah (drinks) the may (waters) of the nahar (river)?

"Your own rai (wickedness) shall yasar (correct) you, and your mashawabah (backsliding) shall yakach (reprove) you. Yadai (know) therefore and raah (see) that it is an rai (evil) thing and a mar (bitter), that you have forsaken Yahawah your Alahayam, and that my pachadah (fear) is not in you," naam (declares prophetically) the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

"For of iwalam (forever) time I have shabar (broken) your il (over), and nathaq (burst) your mawasar (bonds); and you amar (spoke), ‘I will not ibad (servant);' for on every gabah (high) gabaih (hill) and under every rainan (green) itz (tree) you bowed yourself, zanah (playing) the prostitute.
Yet I had natai (planted) you a sharaq (noble) vine, wholly a amath (truth) zarai (seed). How then have you hapak (turned) into the sawar (degenerate) branches of a foreign gapan (vine) to me?
For though you kabas (wash) yourself with lye, and use much soap, yet your iwan (guilt/iniquity) is katham (marked) panayam (face) me," naam (declares prophetically) the Adanay Yahawah.

"How can you amar (spoke), ‘I am not tamaa (defiled). I have not halak (move) achar (other) the Bail (Baals)'? Raah (see) your darak (way) in the gayaa (valley). Yadai (know) what you ishah (make) done. You are a qal (swift) bakarah (dromedary) sharak (traversing) her darak (ways);

A paraa (wild) donkey used to the madabar (wilderness), that shaap (snuffs) up the rawach (spirit / wind) in her awah (desire). When she is in heat, who can shawab (turn back / repent) her away? All those who baqash (seek) her will not yaip (weary) themselves. In her chadash (month), they will matzaa (find) her.

"Manai (withhold) your ragal (feet / foot) from yachap (being) unshod, and your throat from tzamaah (thirst). But you amar (spoke), ‘It is in vain. No, for I have ahab (love) strangers, and I will yalak (go) achar (other) them.'

As the ganab (thief) is bashath (ashamed) when he is matzaa (found), so is the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) bashath (ashamed); they, their malak (king), their shar (prince / ruler), and their kahan (priest), and their nabayaa (prophet/prophecy);

Who amar (spoke) itz (wood), ‘You are my ab (father);' and a aban (stone), ‘You have yalad (birth / begot) me out:' for they have panah (turn) their irap (neck) to me, and not their panayam (face); but in the ith (time) of their rai (trouble) they will amar (spoke), ‘qawam (rise up), and yashai (salvation) us.'

"But where are your Alahayam that you ishah (make) made for yourselves? Let them qawam (rise up), if they can yashai (salvation) you in the ith (time) of your rai (trouble): for according to the masapar (number) of your iyar (cities) are your Alahayam, Yahawadah (Judah).
"Why will you rayab (contend) with me? You all have pashai (transgressed) against me," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

"I have nakah (struck) your ban (son) in shawaa (vanity). They laqach (take / seize) no mawasar (correction). Your own charab (sword) has akal (eat) your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), like a shachath (destroying) aray (lion).

Dawar (generation / age / period), raah (see) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah. Have I been a madabar (wilderness) to Yashar-Al (Israel)? Or a aratz (Earth/land) of thick maapalayah (darkness)? Why do my im (nation / people) amar (spoke), ‘We rawad (have) broken loose. We will bawaa (come) to you no more?'

"Can a bathawalah (virgin) shakach (forget) her iday (ornament / adornment), or a kalah (complete / finish) her qashar (attire)? Yet my im (nation / people) have shakach (forgotten) me for yamayam (days) without masapar (number).
How yatab (well) you prepare your darak (way) to baqash (seek) ahabah (love)! Therefore you have lamad (teach / instruct) even the rai (wicked) women your darak (ways).

Also the dam (blood) of the napashawath (souls) of the naqay (innocent) abayawan (poor) is matzaa (found) in your kanap (skirts). You did not matzaa (find) them machatharath (breaking) in; but it is because of all these things.

"Yet you amar (spoke), ‘I am naqah (clean/innocent). Surely his ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) has shawab (turn back / repent) away from me.' "Behold, I will shapat (judge / judgement) you, because you amar (spoke), ‘I have not chataa (sinned).'
Why do you azal (go) about so much to shanah (change) your darak (way)? You will be bawash (ashamed) of Matzarayam (Egypt) also, as you were bawash (ashamed) of Ashawar (Assyria).

From there also you shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, with your yad (hand) on your raash (head); for Yahawah has maas (rejected) those in whom you mabatach (trust), and you shall not tzalach (prosper) with them.

"They amar (spoke), ‘If a ayash (man / husband) shalach (send) away his ayashah (woman / wife), and she halak (move) from him, and become achar (other) ayash (man / husband), will he shawab (turn back / repent) to her again?' Wouldn't that aratz (Earth/land) be chanap (greatly) chanap (polluted)? But you have zanah (played) the prostitute with many raiyam (lovers); yet shawab (turn back / repent) again to me," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

"Nashaa (lift) up your iyan (eye) to the bare heights, and raah (see)! Ayapah (where) have you not been shagal (lain) with? You have yashab (inhabit/dwell) for them by the darakayam (ways), as an Irabay (Arabian) in the madabar (wilderness). You have chanap (polluted) the aratz (Earth/land) with your prostitution and with your rai (wickedness).
Therefore the rababayam (showers) have been withheld, and there has been no malaqawash (latter) rain; yet you have a prostitute's matzach (forehead), you maan (refused) to be kalam (ashamed).
Will you not from this time qaraa (called) to me, ‘My ab (father), you are the alawap (guide) of my naiwar (youth)?'

"‘Will he retain his anger forever? Will he shamar (keep/guard) it to the natzach (end)?' Behold, you have dabar (word / matter) and ishah (make) done rai (evil) things, and yakal (have) had your way."

Moreover, Yahawah amar (spoke) to me in the yamay (days) of Yaashayah (Josiah) the malak (king), "raah (see) you seen that which mashawabah (backsliding) Yashar-Al (Israel) ishah (make) done? She has halak (move) up on every gabah (high) har (mountain) and under every rainan (green) itz (tree), and there has zanah (played) the prostitute.

I amar (spoke) achar (other) she ishah (make) done all these things, ‘She will shawab (turn back / repent) to me;' but she didn't shawab (turn back / repent); and her bagawad (treacherous) achawath (sister) Yahawadah (Judah) raah (see) it.

I raah (see), when, for this very awadawath (cause) that mashawabah (backsliding) Yashar-Al (Israel) had naap (committed) adultery, I had shalach (send) her away and nathan (give) her a sapar (book / scribed document) of karayathawath (divorce), yet bagad (treacherous) Yahawadah (Judah), her achawath (sister), didn't yaraa (fear / be afraid); but she also yalak (went) and zanah (played) the prostitute.
It happened through the qawal (sound / voice) of her prostitution, that the aratz (Earth/land) was chanap (polluted), and she naap (committed) adultery with aban (stone) and with itz (stocks).

Yet for all this her bagawad (treacherous) achawath (sister), Yahawadah (Judah), has not shawab (turn back / repent) to me with her whole lab (heart), but only in pretense," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "mashawabah (backsliding) Yashar-Al (Israel) napash (soul) shown herself more tzadaq (righteous / just / fair) than bagad (treacherous) Yahawadah (Judah).

Halak (move), and qaraa (called) these dabarayam (words) toward the tzapawan (north), and amar (spoke), ‘shawab (turn back / repent), you mashawabah (backsliding) Yashar-Al (Israel),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; ‘I will not look in panayam (face) on you; for I am chasayad (merciful),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah. ‘I will not natar (keep) anger forever.

Only yadai (acknowledge) your iwan (guilt/iniquity), that you have pashai (transgressed) against Yahawah your Alahayam, and have pazar (scattered) your darak (ways) to the strangers under every rainan (green) itz (tree), and you have not shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah."

"Shawab (turn back / repent), shawabab (backsliding) banayam (children)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; "for I am a bail (husband) to you. I will laqach (take / seize) you achad (one) of a iyar (city), and shanayam (two) of a mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), and I will bawaa (come) you to Tzayawan (Zion).
I will nathan (give) you raiyam (shepherds) according to my lab (heart), who shall raih (feed) you with daih (knowledge) and shakal (understanding).

It shall come to pass, when you are rabah (multiplied) and parah (increased) in the aratz (Earth/land), in those yamayam (days)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "they shall amar (spoke) no more, ‘The arawan (ark) of the barayath (covenant) of Yahawah!' Neither shall it ilah (go up / offer) to lab (heart); neither shall they zakar (remember) it; neither shall they paqad (visit) it; neither shall it be ishah (make) any more.

At that ith (time) they shall qaraa (called) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) ‘The kasaa (throne) of Yahawah;' and all the gawayam (nations) shall be qawah (gather/wait) to it, to the sham (name) of Yahawah, to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Neither shall they yalak (walk) any more achar (other) the stubbornness of their rai (evil) lab (heart).

In those yamayam (days) the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) shall yalak (walk) with the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and they shall bawaa (come) yachad (together) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of the tzapawan (north) to the aratz (Earth/land) that I gave for an nachal (inheritance) to your ab (father).

"But I amar (spoke), ‘How I would shayath (put / appoint / make) you among the banayam (children), and nathan (give) you a chamadah (pleasant) aratz (Earth/land), a tzabay (goodly) nachalah (heritage) of the tzabaawath (armies) of the gawayam (nations)!' And I amar (spoke), ‘You shall qaraa (called) me "My ab (father)," and shall not shawab (turn back / repent) away from achar (other) me.'

"Akan (surely) as a ayashah (woman / wife) bagad (treacherously) departs from her rai (neigbor/another person), so you have dealt bagad (treacherously) with me, bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

A qawal (sound / voice) is shamai (hearken / hear) on the bare heights, the bakay (weeping) and the petitions of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel); because they have iwah (perverted) their darak (way), they have shakach (forgotten) Yahawah their Alahayam.

Shawab (turn back / repent), you shawabab (backsliding) banayam (children), I will rapaa (heal) your mashawabah (backsliding). "Behold, we have athah (you (masc)) to you; for you are Yahawah our Alahayam.

Akan (truly) in shaqar (vain) is help from the gabaiwath (hills), the hamawan (tumult) on the harayam (mountains). Akan (truly) the thashawaih (deliverance) of Yashar-Al (Israel) is in Yahawah our Alahayam.
But the shameful thing has akal (eat) the yagayai (labor) of our ab (father) from our naiwar (youth), their tzaan (flocks) and their baqar (morning), their ban (son) and their banath (daughter).

Let us shakab (lie) down in our bashath (shame), and let our kalamah (confusion) kasah (cover) us; for we have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah our Alahayam, we and our ab (father), from our naiwar (youth) even to this yawam (day). We have not shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam."

"If you will shawab (turn back / repent), Yashar-Al (Israel)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "if you will shawab (turn back / repent) to me, and if you will sawar (put) away your shaqawatz (abominations) out of my panayam (face); then you shall not be nawad (removed);

And you shall shabai (swear / take oath), ‘As Yahawah chay (life),' in amath (truth), in mashapat (justice), and in tzadaqah (righteousness). The gawayam (nations) shall barak (blessed) themselves in him, and in him shall they glory."

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) and to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), "nayar (break) up your fallow nayar (ground), and don't zarai (sow) among qawatzayam (thorns).

Mawal (circumcise) yourselves to Yahawah, and sawar (take) away the iralawath (foreskins) of your labab (heart), you ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) and yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); lest my chamah (wrath) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth like ash (fire), and bair (burn) so that none can kabah (quench) it, panayam (face) of the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings).

Nagad (declare) in Yahawadah (Judah), and shamai (hearken / hear) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and amar (spoke), ‘thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) in the aratz (Earth/land)!' Qaraa (called) aloud and amar (spoke), ‘asap (assemble) yourselves! Bawaa (come) us go into the fortified iray (cities)!'

Nashaa (lift) up a nas (standard) toward Tzayawan (Zion). Iwaz (flee) for safety! Don't wait; for I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) from the tzapawan (north), and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (destruction)."

A aray (lion) is ilah (go up / offer) up from his sabak (thicket), and a destroyer of gawayam (nations); he is on his nasai (way), he is yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from his maqawam (place), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) your aratz (Earth/land) shamah (desolate), that your iyar (cities) be natzah (laid) waste, without yashab (inhabit/dwell).
For this clothe yourself with sackcloth, sapad (lament) and wail; for the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah hasn't shawab (turn back / repent) back from us.

"It shall happen at that yawam (day)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "that the lab (heart) of the malak (king) shall abad (destroy / perish), and the lab (heart) of the sharayam (princes); and the kahanayam (priests) shall be shamam (astonished), and the nabayaayam (prophets) shall thamah (wonder)."

Then I amar (spoke), "ahah (ah), Adanay Yahawah! Akan (surely) you have nashaa (lift) nashaa (lift) this im (nation / people) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), ‘You shall have shalawam (peace / safety);' whereas the charab (sword) reaches to the napash (soul)."

At that ith (time) shall it be amar (spoke) to this im (nation / people) and to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), "A hot rawach (spirit / wind) from the bare heights in the madabar (wilderness) darak (toward) the banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people), not to zarah (winnow), nor to barar (cleanse);
A malaa (full) rawach (spirit / wind) from these shall bawaa (come) for me. Now I will also dabar (word / matter) mashapatayam (judgments) against them."

Behold, he shall ilah (go up / offer) up as inanayam (clouds), and his marakabah (chariots) shall be as the sawapah (whirlwind): his sawas (horses) are qalal (swifter) than nasharayam (eagles). Away (woe) to us! For we are ruined.

Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), kabas (wash) your lab (heart) from rai (wickedness), that you may be yashai (salvation). How long shall your awan (evil) machashabawath (thoughts) lawan (lodge) qarab (among / near) you?
For a qawal (sound / voice) nagad (declares) from Dan (Dan), and publishes awan (evil) from the Aparayam (hills) of Aparayam (Ephraim):

"Tell the gawayam (nations); behold, shamai (hearken / hear) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), ‘natzarayam (watchers) bawaa (come) from a marachaq (far) aratz (Earth/land), and raise their qawal (sound / voice) against the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah).
As keepers of a shadah (field), they are against her all around, because she has been rebellious against me,'" naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
"Your darak (way) and your mailal (doings) ishah (make) brought these things to you. This is your rai (wickedness); for it is mar (bitter), for it reaches to your lab (heart)."

My anguish, my anguish! I am chawal (pained) at my very lab (heart); my lab (heart) is hamah (great uproar) in me; I can't hold my charash (peace); because you have shamai (hearken / hear), O my napash (soul), the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn), the tharawaih (alarm) of malachamah (war).

Shabar (destruction) on shabar (destruction) is qaraa (called); for the whole aratz (Earth/land) is laid shadad (waste): pathaawam (suddenly) are my ahal (tents) shadad (destroyed), and my yarayaih (curtains) in a ragai (in an instance).
How long shall I raah (see) the nas (standard), and shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn)?

"For my im (nation / people) are awayal (foolish), they don't yadai (know) me. They are sakal (foolish) banayam (children), and they have no bayan (between). They are skillful in doing raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), but to do yatab (good) they have no yadai (knowledge)."
I raah (see) the aratz (Earth/land), and, behold, it was thahaw (formless) and bahaw (void); and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and they had no awar (light).
I raah (see) the harayam (mountains), and behold, they raish (trembled), and all the gabaiwath (hills) qalal (moved) back and forth.
I raah (see), and behold, there was no adam (man), and all the iwap (flying) of the sky had nadad (fled).

I raah (see), and behold, the karamal (fruitful) field was a madabar (wilderness), and all its iyar (cities) were nathatz (broken) down at the panayam (face) of Yahawah, before his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "The whole aratz (Earth/land) shall be a shamamah (desolation); yet will I not ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end.

For this the aratz (Earth/land) will abal (mourn), and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mail (top/above) be qadar (black); because I have dabar (word / matter) it, I have zamam (purposed) it, and I have not nacham (turn away / repent), neither will I shawab (turn back / repent) back from it."

Every iyar (city) barach (flees) for the qawal (sound / voice) of the horsemen and qashath (archers); they bawaa (come) into the ibayam (thickets), and ilah (go up / offer) up on the kapayam (rocks): every iyar (city) is forsaken, and not a ayash (man / husband) yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.

You, when you are made desolate, what will you ishah (make)? Though you labash (clothe) yourself with shanay (second), though you idah (deck) you with iday (ornament / adornment) of zahab (gold), though you enlarge your iyan (eye) with pawak (paint), in shawaa (vanity) do you make yourself yapah (beautiful); your igabayam (lovers) maas (despise) you, they baqash (seek) your napash (soul).

For I have shamai (hearken / hear) a qawal (sound / voice) as of a chalah (afflict) in travail, the tzarah (anguish) as of her who brings forth her bakar (first) child, the qawal (sound / voice) of the banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion), who gasps for breath, who parash (spreads) her kap (hands), saying, "away (woe) is me now! For my napash (soul) faints before the haragayam (murderers)."

"Shawat (run) back and forth through the chawatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and raah (see) now, and yadai (know), and baqash (seek) in the rachab (broad) places of it, if you can matzaa (find) a ayash (man / husband), if there are any who ishah (make) justly, who baqashaw (seeks) amawanah (truth); and I will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) her.
Though they amar (spoke), ‘As Yahawah chay (life);' surely they shabai (swear / take oath) falsely."

O Yahawah, don't your iyan (eye) look on amawanah (truth)? You have nakah (stricken) them, but they were not chawal (grieved). You kalah (complete / finish) consumed them, but they have maan (refused) to laqach (take / seize) mawasar (correction). They have made their panayam (face) harder than a salai (rock). They have maan (refused) to shawab (turn back / repent).
Then I amar (spoke), "Surely these are dal (poor). They are yaal (foolish); for they don't yadai (know) the darak (way) of Yahawah, nor the mashapat (law) of their Alahayam.

I will yalak (go) to the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) men, and will dabar (word / matter) to them; for they yadai (know) the darak (way) of Yahawah, and the mashapat (law) of their Alahayam." But these with yachad (one) accord have shabar (broken) the il (over), and nathaq (burst) the mawasarawath (bonds).

Therefore a aray (lion) out of the yair (forest) shall nakah (kill) them, a zaab (wolf) of the irabawath (evenings) shall shadad (destroy) them, a namar (leopard) shall shaqad (watch) against their iyar (cities); everyone who yatzaa (go out / come out) out there shall be tarap (torn) in pieces; because their pashai (transgressions) are many, and their mashawabah (backsliding) is itzam (increased).

"Ay (how) can I salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) you? Your ban (son) have forsaken me, and shabai (swear / take oath) by what are no Alahayam. When I had shabai (swear / take oath) them to the full, they naap (committed) adultery, and gadad (assembled) themselves in troops at the prostitutes' bayath (house).
They were as zawan (fed) sawasayam (horses) roaming at large: everyone tzahal (neighed) after his neighbor's ayashah (woman / wife).
Shouldn't I paqad (visit) them for these things?" Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; "and shouldn't my napash (soul) be naqam (avenged) on such a gaway (heathen / nation) as this?
"Ilah (go up / offer) up on her sharah (walls), and shachath (destroy); but don't ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end. Sawar (take) away her branches; for they are not Yahawah.
For the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) have dealt very bagad (treacherously) against me," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
They have kachash (denied) Yahawah, and amar (spoke), "It is not he; neither shall rai (evil) bawaa (come) on us; neither shall we raah (see) charab (sword) nor raib (famine).
The nabayaayam (prophets) shall become rawach (spirit / wind), and the word is not in them. Thus shall it be ishah (make) to them."

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaawath (armies), "Because you dabar (word / matter) this dabar (word / matter), behold, I will nathan (give) my dabar (word / matter) in your pah (mouth) ash (fire), and this im (nation / people) itz (wood), and it shall akal (eat) them.

Behold, I will bawaa (come) a gaway (heathen / nation) on you from marachaq (far), bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah. "It is a ayathan (mighty) gaway (heathen / nation). It is an iwalam (forever) gaway (heathen / nation), a gaway (heathen / nation) whose lashawan (tongue / language) you don't yadai (know), neither shamai (hearken / hear) what they dabar (word / matter).
Their ashapah (quiver) is an pathach (open) tomb, they are all gabawar (mighty) men.

They shall akal (eat) up your qatzayar (harvest), and your lacham (bread), which your ban (son) and your banath (daughter) should akal (eat). They shall akal (eat) up your tzaan (flocks) and your baqar (morning). They shall akal (eat) up your gapan (vines) and your thaan (fig) trees. They shall beat down your fortified iray (cities), in which you batach (trust), with the charab (sword).
"But even in those yamayam (days)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "I will not ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end with you.

It will happen, when you amar (spoke), ‘Why has Yahawah our Alahayam ishah (make) all these things to us?' Then you shall amar (spoke) to them, ‘Just like you have forsaken me, and ibad (servant) foreign Alahayam in your aratz (Earth/land), so you shall ibad (servant) strangers in a aratz (Earth/land) that is not yours.'
"Nagad (declare) this in the bayath (house) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and shamai (hearken / hear) it in Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke),

‘Shamai (hearken / hear) now this, sakal (foolish) im (nation / people), and without lab (heart); who have iyanayam (eyes), and don't raah (see); who have azanayam (ears), and don't shamai (hearken / hear):

Don't you yaraa (fear / be afraid) me?' Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah ‘Won't you chawal (tremble) at my panayam (face), who have shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chawal (sand) for the gabawal (border/boundary) of the yam (sea/waters), by a iwalam (forever) chaq (statute), that it can't ibar (pass over/through) it? And though its gal (waves) gaish (toss) themselves, yet they can't yakal (prevail); though they hamah (great uproar), yet they can't ibar (pass over/through) over it.'
"But this im (nation / people) has a sarar (revolting) and a rebellious lab (heart); they have sawar (revolted) and yalak (gone).

Neither do they amar (spoke) in their labab (heart), ‘Let us now yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah our Alahayam, who nathan (give) gasham (rain), both the yawarah (former) and the malaqawash (latter), in its ith (season); who shamar (keep/guard) to us the chaqah (appointed) shabaiwath (weeks) of the qatzayar (harvest).'
"Your iwan (guilt/iniquity) have natah (turned) away these things, and your chataah (sin) have withheld tawab (good / proper function) from you.

For among my im (nation / people) are matzaa (found) rashai (wicked) men. They watch, as yaqawashayam (fowlers) lie in shawar (wait). They natzab (set) a mashachayath (trap). They lakad (catch) im (nation / people).
As a kalawab (cage) is malaa (full) of iwap (flying), so are their bayath (house) malaa (full) of maramah (deceit). Therefore they have become gadal (great), and grew ishar (rich).

They have grown shaman (fat). They ishath (shine); yes, they excell in dabaray (deeds) of rai (wickedness). They don't plead the dayan (judge), the cause of the yathawam (fatherless), that they may tzalach (prosper); and they don't shapat (judge / judgement) the mashapat (right) of the abayawan (needy).
"Shall I not paqad (visit) for these things?" Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah. "Shall not my napash (soul) be naqam (avenged) on such a gaway (heathen / nation) as this?
"An astonishing and shairawarah (horrible) thing hayah (came to pass) happened in the aratz (Earth/land).

The nabayaayam (prophets) nabaa (prophesy) falsely, and the kahanayam (priests) radah (rule over / have dominion of / subdue) by their yad (hand) authority; and my im (nation / people) ahab (love) to ishah (make) it so. What will you do in the acharayath (end) of it?

"Iwaz (flee) for safety, you banay (children) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), out of the qarab (among / near) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) in Thaqawai (Tekoa), and nashaa (lift) up a signal on Bayathahakaram (Beth Haccherem); for rai (evil) shaqap (looks) forth from the tzapawan (north), and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (destruction).
The naawah (comely) and inag (delicate) one, the banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion), will I cut off.

Raiyam (shepherds) with their idar (flocks) shall bawaa (come) to her; they shall thaqai (blow / sound alarm) their ahalayam (tents) against her all around; they shall raih (feed) everyone in his place."

"Qadash (set apart / make holy) malachamah (war) against her; qawam (rise up), and let us ilah (go up / offer) up at tzahar (noon). Away (woe) to us! For the yawam (day) declines, for the tzalalay (shadows) of the irab (evening) are natah (stretched) out.
Qawam (rise up), and let us ilah (go up / offer) up by layal (night), and let us shachath (destroy) her aramawan (palaces)."

For Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) amar (spoke), "karath (cut) down itzah (trees), and shapak (cast) up a mound against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem): this is the iyar (city) to be paqad (visit); she is wholly ishaq (oppression) in the qarab (among / near) of her.

As a bawar (well) qawar (casts) forth its mayam (Waters), so she qawar (casts) forth her rai (wickedness): chamas (violence) and shad (destruction) is shamai (hearken / hear) in her; panayam (face) me continually is chalay (sickness) and makah (wounds).

Be yasar (instructed), Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), lest my napash (soul) be yaqai (alienated) from you; lest I shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a shamamah (desolation), a aratz (Earth/land) not yashab (inhabit/dwell)."

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "They shall ilal (thoroughly) ilal (glean) the shaarayath (remnant) of Yashar-Al (Israel) like a gapan (vine). Shawab (turn back / repent) again your yad (hand) as a grape batzar (gatherer) into the salasalawath (baskets)."

To whom shall I dabar (word / matter) and testify, that they may shamai (hearken / hear)? Behold, their azan (ear) is iral (uncircumcised), and they can't listen. Behold, the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah has become a charapah (reproach) to them. They chapatz (have) no delight in it.

Therefore I am malaa (full) of the chamah (wrath) of Yahawah. I am laah (weary) with kawal (all) in. "Shapak (pour) it out on the iwalal (children) in the chawatz (street), and on the sawad (assembly) of bachawar (young) men yachad (together); for even the ayash (man / husband) with the ayashah (woman / wife) shall be lakad (taken), the zaqan (aged) with him who is malaa (full) of yamayam (days).

Their bayath (house) shall be sabab (turned) to others, their shadawath (fields) and their wives yachad (together); for I will natah (stretch) out my yad (hand) on the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah."

"For from their qatan (small / young / least) even to their greatest, everyone is batzai (given) to batzai (covetousness); and from the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) even to the kahan (priest), everyone ishah (make) falsely.

They have rapaa (healed) also the shabar (hurt) of my im (nation / people) superficially, amar (spoke), ‘shalawam (peace / safety), shalawam (peace / safety)!' When there is no shalawam (peace / safety).

Were they yabash (dry land) when they ishah (make) committed thawaibah (abomination)? No, they were not at all bawash (ashamed), gam (indeed / moreover) yadai (could) they kalam (blush). Therefore they shall napal (fall / be cast down) among those who napal (fall / be cast down); at the ith (time) that I paqad (visit) them, they shall be kashal (stumble / stagger) down," amar (spoke) Yahawah.

Thus yaamaraw (says) Yahawah, "imad (stand) in the darakayam (ways) and raah (see), and shaal (ask) for the iwalam (forever) nathabawath (paths), ‘Where is the tawab (good / proper function) darak (way)?' And yalak (walk) in it, and you will matzaa (find) maragawai (rest) for your napash (soul). But they amar (spoke), ‘We will not yalak (walk) in it.'
I qawam (rise up) watchmen over you, saying, ‘Listen to the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn)!' But they amar (spoke), ‘We will not listen!'
Therefore shamai (hearken / hear), you gawayam (nations), and yadai (know), idah (congregation), what is among them.

Shamai (hearken / hear), aratz (Earth/land)! Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on this im (nation / people), even the paray (fruit) of their machashabah (thoughts), because they have not listened to my dabar (word / matter); and as for my thawarah (instruction), they have maas (rejected) it.

To what purpose bawaa (come) there to me labawanah (frankincense) from Shabaa (Sheba), and the tawab (good / proper function) qanah (cane) from a marachaq (far) aratz (Earth/land)? Your burnt ilah (offerings) are not ratzawan (acceptable), nor your zabach (sacrifices) irab (evening) to me."

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "Behold, I will nathan (give) makashawal (stumbling) blocks before this im (nation / people). The abawath (fathers) and the banayam (sons) yachad (together) shall kashal (stumble / stagger) against them. The neighbor and his rai (neigbor/another person) shall abad (destroy / perish)."

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "Behold, a im (nation / people) bawaa (come) from the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land). A gadawal (very great/important/mighty) gaway (heathen / nation) shall be iwar (rouse / awaken) up from the uttermost yarakathay (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land).

They chazaq (take) hold of qashath (bow) and kayadawan (spear). They are akazaray (cruel), and have no racham (show mercy / love). Their qawal (sound / voice) hamah (great uproar) like the yam (sea/waters), and they rakab (ride) on sawasayam (horses), everyone irak (set) in array, as a ayash (man / husband) to the malachamah (battle), against you, banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion)."
We have shamai (hearken / hear) its report; our yad (hand) become rapah (feeble): tzarah (anguish) has chazaq (taken) hold of us, and chayal (pains) as of a yalad (birth / begot) in labor.

Don't yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into the shadah (field), nor yalak (walk) by the darak (way); for the charab (sword) of the ayab (enemy) and magawar (terror), are on sabayab (surrounding) side.

Banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people), clothe yourself with sackcloth, and wallow in ashes! Mourn, as for an only yachayad (son), most thamarawar (bitter) masapad (lamentation); for the shadad (destroyer) shall pathaawam (suddenly) bawaa (come) on us.
"I nathan (give) made you a tester of metals and a mabatzar (fortress) among my im (nation / people); that you may yadai (know) and bachan (try) their darak (way).
They are all sawar (grievous) rebels, halak (move) about with rakayal (slanders); they are nachashath (brass) and barazal (iron): they all of them deal corruptly.

The mapach (bellows) blow fiercely; the iwaparath (lead) is consumed of the ashah (fire / offering made by fire): in shawaa (vanity) do they go on tzarap (refining); for the rai (wicked) are not nathaq (plucked) away.
Men will qaraa (called) them maas (rejected) kasap (silver), because Yahawah has maas (rejected) them."
The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

"Imad (stand) in the shair (gate) of Yahawah bayath (house), and qaraa (called) there this dabar (word / matter), and amar (spoke), ‘shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all you of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) in at these shairayam (gates) to shachah (worship) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings), and I will shakan (place) you to dwell in this maqawam (place).
Don't batach (trust) in shaqar (lying) dabaray (words), amar (spoke), The hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah, are these.
For if you yatab (thoroughly) yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings); if you ishah (make) ishah (make) mashapat (justice) between a ayash (man / husband) and his neighbor;

If you don't ishaq (oppress) the foreigner, the yathawam (fatherless), and the alamanah (widow), and don't shapak (shed) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) in this maqawam (place), neither yalak (walk) achar (other) other Alahayam to your own rai (hurt):
Then will I shakan (place) you to dwell in this maqawam (place), in the aratz (Earth/land) that I nathan (give) to your ab (father), from of iwalam (forever) even forevermore.
Behold, you batach (trust) in shaqar (lying) dabaray (words), that can't yail (profit).

Will you ganab (steal), ratzach (murder), and naap (commit) adultery, and shabai (swear / take oath) falsely, and qatar (burn) incense to Bail (Baal), and halak (move) achar (other) other Alahayam that you yadai (have) not known,

And bawaa (come) and imad (stand) panayam (face) me in this bayath (house), which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), and amar (spoke), We are natzal (delivered); that you may ishah (make) all these thawaibawath (abominations)?

Is this bayath (house), which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), become a mairah (den) of paratzayam (robbers) in your iyan (eye)? Raah (see), I, even I, have seen it, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

But yalak (go) now to my maqawam (place) which was in Shayalah (Shiloh), where I caused my sham (name) to shakan (place) at the raashawan (first), and raah (see) what I ishah (make) to it for the rai (wickedness) of my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel).

Now, because you ishah (make) done all these maishayam (works), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, and I dabar (word / matter) to you, shakam (rising) up early and dabar (word / matter), but you didn't shamai (hearken / hear); and I qaraa (called) you, but you didn't inah (answer / respond):

Therefore will I ishah (make) to the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), in which you batach (trust), and to the maqawam (place) which I nathan (give) to you and to your ab (father), as I ishah (make) to Shayalah (Shiloh).
I will shalak (cast) you out of my panayam (face), as I have shalak (cast) out all your ach (brother/kinsman), even the whole zarai (seed) of Aparayam (Ephraim).

Therefore don't palal (pray) for this im (nation / people), neither nashaa (lift) up a ranah (cry) nor thapalah (prayer) for them, neither pagai (make) intercession to me; for I will not shamai (hearken / hear) you.
Don't you raah (see) what they ishah (make) in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

The banayam (children) laqat (gather) itz (wood), and the abawath (fathers) bair (kindle) the ash (fire), and the nashayam (women) lawash (knead) the batzaq (dough), to ishah (make) kawanayam (cakes) to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and to nasak (pour) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to other Alahayam, that they may provoke me to kais (anger).
Do they provoke me to kais (anger)? Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah. Don't they provoke themselves, to the bashath (confusion) of their own panayam (face)?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) the Adanay Yahawah: Behold, my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and my chamah (wrath) shall be nathak (poured) out on this maqawam (place), on adam (man), and on animal, and on the itz (trees) of the shadah (field), and on the paray (fruit) of the adamah (ground); and it shall bair (burn), and shall not be kabah (quenched).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): sapah (add) your burnt ilah (offerings) to your zabach (sacrifices), and akal (eat) meat.

For I didn't dabar (word / matter) to your ab (father), nor tzawah (command) them in the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), dabar (word / matter) burnt ilah (offerings) or zabach (sacrifices):

But this thing I tzawah (commanded) them, amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) to my qawal (sound / voice), and I will be your Alahayam, and you shall be my im (nation / people); and halak (move) in all the darak (way) that I tzawah (command) you, that it may be yatab (well) with you.

But they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) nor natah (turn) their azan (ear), but yalak (walked) in their own maitzawath (counsels) and in the stubbornness of their rai (evil) lab (heart), and went backward, and not forward.

Since the yawam (day) that your ab (father) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to this yawam (day), I have shalach (send) to you all my ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets), yawam (day) shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them:

Yet they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to me, nor natah (inclined) their azan (ear), but made their irap (neck) qashah (rough / hard): they raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) worse than their ab (father).

You shall dabar (word / matter) all these dabarayam (words) to them; but they will not shamai (hearken / hear) to you: you shall also qaraa (called) to them; but they will not inah (answer / respond) you.

You shall amar (spoke) them, This is the gaway (heathen / nation) that has not shamai (hearken / hear) to the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah their Alahayam, nor laqach (take / seize) mawasar (instruction): amawanah (truth) is abad (destroy / perish), and is karath (cut) off from their pah (mouth).

Gazaz (cut) off your nazar (crown / consecrate), and shalak (throw) it away, and nashaa (lift) up a qayanah (lamentation) on the bare heights; for Yahawah has maas (rejected) and forsaken the dawar (generation / age / period) of his ibarah (wrath).

For the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) done that which is rai (evil) in my iyan (eye), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: they have shawam (place / establish / appoint) their shaqawatz (abominations) in the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), to tamaa (defile) it.

They have banah (build) the bamah (high) places of Thapath (Topheth), which is in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), to sharap (burn) their ban (son) and their banath (daughter) in the ash (fire); which I didn't tzawah (command), nor did it ilah (go up / offer) into my lab (heart).

Therefore, behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that it shall no more be amar (spoke) Thapath (Topheth), nor The gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), but The gayaa (valley) of haragah (slaughter): for they shall qabar (bury) in Thapath (Topheth), until there is no maqawam (place) to bury.
The nabalah (dead) bodies of this im (nation / people) shall be maakal (food) for the iwap (flying) of the sky, and for the animals of the aratz (Earth/land); and none shall frighten them away.

Then will I shabath (shabath / rest) to cease from the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and from the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the qawal (sound / voice) of shashawan (mirth) and the qawal (sound / voice) of shamachah (gladness), the qawal (sound / voice) of the chathan (bridegroom) and the qawal (sound / voice) of the kalah (complete / finish); for the aratz (Earth/land) shall become a charabah (waste).

At that ith (time), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, they shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out the itzamawath (bones) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the itzamawath (bones) of his shar (prince / ruler), and the itzamawath (bones) of the kahanayam (priests), and the itzamawath (bones) of the nabayaayam (prophets), and the itzamawath (bones) of the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), out of their qabar (grave / tomb / sepulcher);

And they shall shatach (spread) them before the shamash (sun), and the yarach (moon), and all the tzabaa (troop) of the sky, which they have ahab (love), and which they have ibad (servant), and achar (other) which they have halak (move), and which they have darash (sought), and which they have shachah (worshiped): they shall not be asap (gathered), nor be qabar (bury), they shall be for daman (dung) on the surface of the adamah (earth).

Mawath (death) shall be bachar (chosen) rather than chay (life) by all the shaarayath (residue) that shaar (remain) of this rai (evil) mashapachah (tribe / clan / family), that shaar (remain) in all the maqamawath (places) where I have nadach (driven) them, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

Moreover you shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Shall men napal (fall / be cast down), and not qawam (rise up) up again? Shall one shawab (turn back / repent) away, and not shawab (turn back / repent)?

Why then is this im (nation / people) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) slidden shawab (turn back / repent) by a perpetual mashawabah (backsliding)? They chazaq (hold) fast tharamah (deceit), they maan (refuse) to shawab (turn back / repent).

I listened and shamai (hearken / hear), but they didn't dabar (word / matter) aright: no ayash (man / husband) nacham (turn away / repent) him of his rai (wickedness), amar (spoke), What ishah (make) I done? Everyone shawab (turn back / repent) to his marawatzah (course), as a sawas (horse) that rushes headlong in the malachamah (battle).

Yes, the chasayadah (stork) in the sky yadaiw (knows) her mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) times; and the turtledove and the igawar (swallow) and the sawas (crane) shamar (keep/guard) the ith (time) of their bawaa (come); but my im (nation / people) don't yadai (know) Yahawah mashapat (law).
How do you amar (spoke), We are chakam (wise), and the thawarah (instruction) of Yahawah is with us? But, behold, the shaqar (false) it (pen) of the saparayam (scribes) ishah (make) worked falsely.

The chakam (wise) men are disappointed, they are chathath (dismayed) and lakad (taken): behold, they have maas (rejected) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah; and what kind of chakamah (wisdom) is in them?

Therefore will I nathan (give) their wives to others, and their shadah (fields) to those who shall yarash (possess) them: for everyone from the qatan (small / young / least) even to the greatest is batzai (given) to batzai (covetousness); from the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) even to the kahan (priest) every one ishah (make) falsely.

They have rapaa (healed) the shabar (hurt) of the banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people) qalal (slightly), amar (spoke), shalawam (peace / safety), shalawam (peace / safety); when there is no shalawam (peace / safety).

Were they yabash (dry land) when they ishah (make) committed thawaibah (abomination)? Nay, they were not at all bawash (ashamed), neither yadai (could) they kalam (blush): therefore shall they napal (fall / be cast down) among those who napal (fall / be cast down); in the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation) they shall be kashal (stumble / stagger) down, amar (spoke) Yahawah.

I will asap (utterly) sawap (consume) them, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: no inabayam (grapes) shall be on the gapan (vine), nor thaanayam (figs) on the thaan (fig) tree, and the ilah (leaf) shall nabal (fade); and the things that I nathan (give) given them shall ibar (pass over/through) away from them.

Why do we yashab (inhabit/dwell) still? Asap (assemble) yourselves, and bawaa (come) us enter into the fortified iray (cities), and let us be damam (silent) there; for Yahawah our Alahayam has put us to damam (silence), and given us mayam (Waters) of raash (head) to shaqah (drink), because we have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah.
We qawah (gather/wait) for shalawam (peace / safety), but no tawab (good / proper function) came; and for a ith (time) of marapaa (healing), and behold, baithah (dismay)!

The nachar (snorting) of his sawas (horses) is shamai (hearken / hear) from Dan (Dan): at the qawal (sound / voice) of the matzahalah (neighing) of his abayar (strong) ones the whole aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles); for they bawaa (come) come, and have akal (eat) the aratz (Earth/land) and malaa (all) that is in it; the iyar (city) and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.

For, behold, I will shalach (send) nachashayam (serpents), tzapainayam (adders), among you, which will not be lachash (charmed); and they shall nashak (bite) you, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Oh that I could mabalayagayath (comfort) myself against yagawan (sorrow)! My lab (heart) is daway (faint) within me.

Behold, the qawal (sound / voice) of the cry of the banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people) from a aratz (Earth/land) that is very marachaq (far) off: isn't Yahawah in Tzayawan (Zion)? Isn't her malak (king) in her? Why have they provoked me to kais (anger) with their engraved pasayal (images), and with foreign habalay (vanities)?
The qatzayar (harvest) is past, the qayatz (summer) is kalah (complete / finish), and we are not yashai (salvation).
For the shabar (hurt) of the banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people) am I shabar (hurt): I qadar (mourn); shamah (dismay) has chazaq (taken) hold on me.
Is there no tzaray (balm) in Galaid (Gilead)? Is there no rapaa (physician) there? Why then isn't the arawakah (health) of the banath (daughter) of my im (nation / people) ilah (go up / offer)?
Oh that my head were waters, and my eyes a spring of tears, that I might nathan (give) day and night for the slain of the daughter of my im (nation / people)!

Oh that I had in the aratz (Earth/land) a lodging place of wayfaring men; that I might leave my naam (declares prophetically), and darak (go) from them! For they are all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous men.
They bend their tongue, as their bow, for falsehood; and they are grown strong in the land, but not for truth: for they proceed from evil to evil, and they don't know me, says Yahawah.
Take heed everyone of his neighbor, and don't trust in any rai (neigbor/another person); for every rai (neigbor/another person) will utterly supplant, and every neighbor will go about with slanders.
They will deceive everyone his neighbor, and will not speak the truth: they have yadai (taught) their tongue to speak yadai (lies); they weary themselves to commit iniquity.
Your habitation is in the midst of deceit; through deceit they refuse to know me, amar (spoke) Yahawah.
Therefore thus dabar (word / matter) Yahawah of Armies, Behold, I will melt them, and try them; for how should I deal with the daughter of my people?
Their tongue is a deadly arrow; it speaks deceit: one speaks peaceably to his neighbor with his mouth, but in his napash (soul) he paqad (visit) wait for him.
Shall I not visit them for these things? Says Yahawah; shall not my soul be avenged on such a nation as this?

For the mountains will I nathan (give) up a nathan (give) and wailing, and for the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up, so that balay (none) passes through; neither can men hear the voice of the livestock; both the birds of the sky and the animals are fled, they are gone.
I will bayan (between) Jerusalem heaps, a dwelling place of jackals; and I will bayan (between) the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.

Who is the wise halak (move), that may shamai (hearken / hear) this? Who is he to whom the panayam (face) of Yahawah has amar (spoke), that he may amar (spoke) it? Why is the land perished and burned up like a wilderness, so that none passes il (over)?
Yahawah says, Because they have forsaken my law which I set before them, and have not obeyed my voice, neither yalak (walked) therein,
But have walked kan (for sure) the stubbornness of their own heart, and kan (for sure) the Baals, which their fathers taught them;
Therefore thus says Yahawah of Armies, the Alahayam of Israel, Behold, I will feed them, even this gawayam (people), with wormwood, and give them water of gall to drink.
I will scatter them also among the nations, whom neither they nor their fathers bayan (between) known; and I will shalach (send) the sword al (toward) them, until I bayan (between) consumed them.
Thus says Yahawah of Armies, Consider, and call for the mourning women, that they may yarad (come); and send for the skillful women, that they may yarad (come):
And let them shamai (hearken / hear) haste, and take up a nahay (wailing) for us, that our eyes may run down with tears, and our eyelids gush out with waters.
For a voice of nahay (wailing) is shamai (hearken / hear) out of Zion, How are we ruined! We are greatly confounded, because we have forsaken the land, because they have cast down our dwellings.
Yet hear the word of Yahawah, you women, and let your ear receive the word of his mouth; and teach your daughters wailing, and everyone her neighbor lamentation.
For death has come up into our windows, it is entered into our palaces; to qatzar (cut) off the children from outside, and the young men from the panay (streets).
Amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, The dead bodies of chakam (men) shall fall as dung on the open field, and as the handful after the harvester; and none shall gather them.

Thus naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, Don't let the shakal (wise) halal (praise) glory in his shakal (wisdom), neither let the mighty halal (praise) glory in his might, don't let the rich halal (praise) glory in his riches;

But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahawah who exercises loving kindness, justice, and naam (declares prophetically), in the earth: for in these things I delight, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Behold, the days ban (son), says Yahawah, that I will punish all those who are circumcised in uncircumcision:

Matzarayam (Egypt), and Yahawadah (Judah), and Adawam (Edom), and the ban (son) of Imawan (Ammon), and Mawaab (Moab), and all that have the paah (corners) of their hair qatzatz (cut) off, who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the madabar (wilderness); for all the gaway (heathen / nation) are iral (uncircumcised), and all the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) are iral (uncircumcised) in lab (heart).
Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) which Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to you, bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel)!

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, "Don't lamad (teach / instruct) the darak (way) of the gawayam (nations), and don't be chathath (dismayed) at the athawath (signs) of the sky; for the gawayam (nations) are chathath (dismayed) at them.

For the chaqawath (customs) of the imayam (peoples) are habal (vanity); for one karath (cut) a itz (tree) out of the yair (forest), the maishah (work) of the yaday (hands) of the charash (workman) with the axe.
They yapah (deck) it with kasap (silver) and with zahab (gold); they chazaq (fasten) it with masamarawath (nails) and with maqabawath (hammers), that it not pawaq (move).

They are like a thamar (palm) tree, of turned dabar (word / matter), and don't speak: they must be nashaa (lift), because they can't tzaid (go). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them; for they can't do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), neither is it in them to do yatab (good)."
There is none like you, Yahawah; you are gadawal (very great/important/mighty), and your sham (name) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in gabawarah (might).

Who should not yaraa (fear / be afraid) you, malak (king) of the gawayam (nations)? For it yaah (appertains) to you; because among all the chakam (wise) men of the gawayam (nations), and in all their malakawath (royal) estate, there is none like you.
But they are achad (one) bair (brutish) and kasal (foolish): the mawasar (instruction) of idols! It is but a itz (stock).

There is kasap (silver) raqai (beaten) into plates, which is bawaa (come) from Tharashayash (Tarshish), and zahab (gold) from Awapaz (Uphaz), the maishah (work) of the charash (artificer) and of the yaday (hands) of the tzarap (goldsmith); thakalath (blue) and aragaman (purple) for their labawash (clothing); they are all the maishah (work) of skillful chakamayam (men).

But Yahawah is the amath (truth) Alahayam; he is the chay (life) Alahayam, and an iwalam (forever) malak (king): at his qatzap (wrath) the aratz (Earth/land) raish (trembles), and the gawayam (nations) are not kawal (all) to withstand his zaim (indignation).

You shall amar (spoke) this to them: The Alahayam that have not ibad (servant) the shamay (heavens) and the araq (earth), these shall abad (destroy / perish) from the arai (earth), and from under the shamay (heavens).

He ishah (make) made the aratz (Earth/land) by his kach (strength / mighty / power), he has kawan (established) the thabal (world) by his chakamah (wisdom), and by his chakamah (understanding) has he natah (stretched) out the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens):

When he nathan (give) his qawal (sound / voice), there is a hamawan (tumult) of mayam (Waters) in the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and he causes the vapors to ilah (go up / offer) from the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); he ishah (make) baraqayam (lightnings) for the matar (rain), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the rawach (spirit / wind) out of his awatzar (treasuries).

Every adam (man) has become bair (brutish) and without daith (knowledge); every tzarap (goldsmith) is disappointed by his engraved pasal (image); for his molten nasak (image) is falsehood, and there is no rawach (spirit / wind) in them.
They are habal (vanity), a maishah (work) of delusion: in the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation) they shall abad (destroy / perish).

The chalaq (portion) of Yaiqab (Jacob) is not like these; for he is the former of all things; and Yashar-Al (Israel) is the shabat (tribe) of his nachalah (inheritance): Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) is his sham (name).
Asap (gather) up your kanaih (wares) out of the aratz (Earth/land), you who live under matzawar (siege).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will qalai (sling) out the yawashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) at paim (this) time, and will tzarar (distress) them, that they may feel it.
Away (woe) is me because of my shabar (hurt)! My makah (wound) is chalah (afflict): but I amar (spoke), ak (truly) this is my chalay (grief), and I must nashaa (lift) it.

My ahal (tent) is shadad (destroyed), and all my mayathar (cords) are nathaq (broken): my ban (son) are yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from me, and they are no more: there is none to natah (spread) my ahal (tent) any more, and to qawam (rise up) up my yarayaih (curtains).
For the raiyam (shepherds) are become bair (brutish), and have not darash (inquired) of Yahawah: therefore they shakal (have) not prospered, and all their maraiyath (flocks) are pawatz (scattered).

The qawal (sound / voice) of shamawaih (news), behold, it bawaa (come), and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) raish (commotion) out of the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land), to shawam (place / establish / appoint) the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) a shamamah (desolation), a maiwan (dwelling) place of jackals.
Yahawah, I yadai (know) that the darak (way) of adam (man) is not in himself: it is not in ayash (man / husband) who halak (move) to kawan (direct) his tzaid (steps).
Yahawah, yasar (correct) me, but in mashapat (measure): not in your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), lest you mait (bring) me to nothing.

Shapak (pour) out your chamah (wrath) on the gawayam (nations) that don't yadai (know) you, and on the mashapachawath (families) that don't qaraa (called) on your sham (name): for they have akal (eat) Yaiqab (Jacob), yes, they have akal (eat) him and kalah (complete / finish) him, and have shamam (laid) waste his nawah (habitation).
The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of this barayath (covenant), and dabar (word / matter) to the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

And amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): arar (cursed) is the ayash (man / husband) who doesn't shamai (hearken / hear) the dabaray (words) of this barayath (covenant),

Which I tzawah (commanded) your ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) them forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the barazal (iron) kawar (furnace), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice), and ishah (make) them, according to all which I tzawah (command) you: so you shall be my im (nation / people), and I will be your Alahayam;

That I may qawam (rise up) the shabawaih (oath) which I shabai (swear / take oath) to your ab (father), to nathan (give) them a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey), as at this yawam (day). Then inah (answer / respond) I, and amar (spoke), aman (believe / have faith), Yahawah.

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, qaraa (called) all these dabarayam (words) in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabarayam (words) of this barayath (covenant), and ishah (make) them.

For I iwad (admonish/bear witness against) iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to your ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I ilah (go up / offer) them up out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), even to this yawam (day), shakam (rising) early and iwad (admonish/bear witness against), amar (spoke), shamai (hearken / hear) my qawal (sound / voice).

Yet they didn't shamai (hearken / hear), nor natah (turn) their azan (ear), but yalak (walked) everyone in the stubbornness of their rai (evil) lab (heart): therefore I bawaa (come) on them all the dabaray (words) of this barayath (covenant), which I tzawah (commanded) them to ishah (make), but they didn't ishah (make) them.
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, A qashar (conspiracy) is matzaa (found) among the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah), and among the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They are shawab (turn back / repent) back to the iwanath (iniquities) of their raashanayam (forefathers), who maan (refused) to shamai (hearken / hear) my dabar (word / matter); and they are halak (move) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them: the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) have parar (broken) my barayath (covenant) which I karath (cut) with their ab (father).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on them, which they shall not be yakal (able) to yatzaa (go out / come out); and they shall zaiq (cry) to me, but I will not shamai (hearken / hear) to them.

Then shall the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) halak (move) and zaiq (cry) to the Alahayam to which they qatar (offer) incense: but they will not yashai (salvation) them at yashai (salvation) in the ith (time) of their rai (trouble).

For according to the masapar (number) of your iyar (cities) are your Alahayam, Yahawadah (Judah); and according to the masapar (number) of the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) have you shawam (place / establish / appoint) up mazabachawath (altars) to the shameful thing, even mazabachawath (altars) to qatar (burn) incense to Bail (Baal).

Therefore don't palal (pray) for this im (nation / people), neither nashaa (lift) up ranah (cry) nor thapalah (prayer) for them; for I will not shamai (hearken / hear) them in the ith (time) that they qaraa (called) to me because of their rai (trouble).

What has my yadayad (beloved) to do in my bayath (house), since she ishah (make) worked mazamah (lewdness) with many, and the qadash (set apart / make holy) bashar (flesh) is ibar (pass over/through) from you? When you do rai (evil), then you ilaz (rejoice).

Yahawah qaraa (called) your sham (name), A rainan (green) zayath (olive) tree, yapah (beautiful) with thaar (goodly) paray (fruit): with the qawal (sound / voice) of a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) hamalah (tumult) he has yatzath (kindled) ash (fire) on it, and its branches are raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil).

For Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), who natai (planted) you, has dabar (word / matter) rai (evil) against you, galal (because) of the rai (evil) of the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), which they ishah (make) worked for themselves in provoking me to kais (anger) by qatar (offering) incense to Bail (Baal).
Yahawah gave me yadai (knowledge) of it, and I yadai (knew) it: then you showed me their mailal (doings).

But I was like a gentle kabash (lamb) that is yabal (led) to the tabach (slaughter); and I didn't yadai (know) that they had chashab (devised) machashabawath (devices) against me, saying, "Let us shachath (destroy) the itz (tree) with its lacham (fruit), and let us karath (cut) him off from the aratz (Earth/land) of the chay (life), that his sham (name) may be no more zakar (remember).
