Then laqach (take / seize) I the kawas (cup) at Yahawah yad (hand), and made all the gawayam (nations) to shaqah (drink), to whom Yahawah had shalach (send) me:

Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and its malak (king), and its shar (prince / ruler), to nathan (give) them a desolation, an shamah (astonishment), a sharaqah (hissing), and a qalalah (curse), as it is this yawam (day);
Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and his ibad (servant), and his shar (prince / ruler), and all his im (nation / people);

And all the mixed people, and all the malakay (kings) of the aratz (Earth/land) of the Iwatz (Uz), and all the malakay (kings) of the Palashathay (Philistines), and Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), and Izah (Gaza), and Iqarawan (Ekron), and the shaarayath (remnant) of Ashadawad (Ashdod);
Adawam (Edom), and Mawaab (Moab), and the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon);
And all the malakay (kings) of Tzar (Tyre), and all the malakay (kings) of Tzayadawan (Sidon), and the malakay (kings) of the ay (isle) which is ibar (beyond) the yam (sea/waters);
Dadan (Dedan), and Thayamaa (Tema), and Bawaz (Buz), and all who have the paah (corners) of their beard qatzatz (cut) off;
And all the malakay (kings) of Irab (Arabia), and all the malakay (kings) of the mixed irab (evening) who shakan (place) in the madabar (wilderness);
And all the malakay (kings) of Zamaray (Zimri), and all the malakay (kings) of Iyalam (Elam), and all the malakay (kings) of the Maday (Medes);

And all the malakay (kings) of the tzapawan (north), rachawaq (far) and qarawab (near), ayash (man / husband) with ach (brother/kinsman); and all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land), which are on the surface of the adamah (earth): and the malak (king) of Shashak (Sheshach) shall shathah (drinks) achar (other) them.

You shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): shathah (drinks), and be shakar (drunk), vomit, napal (fall / be cast down), and qawam (rise up) no more, panayam (face) of the charab (sword) which I will shalach (send) among you.

It shall be, if they maan (refuse) to laqach (take / seize) the kawas (cup) at your yad (hand) to shathah (drinks), then you shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): You shall shathah (drinks) shathah (drinks).

For, behold, I chalal (begin) to work raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) at the iyar (city) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name); and should you be naqah (clean/innocent) naqah (clean/innocent)? You shall not be naqah (clean/innocent); for I will qaraa (called) for a charab (sword) on all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

Therefore nabaa (prophesy) you against them all these dabarayam (words), and amar (spoke) them, Yahawah will shaag (roar) from on marawam (high), and nathan (give) his qawal (sound / voice) from his qadash (set apart / make holy) maiwan (habitation); he will shaag (mightily) shaag (roar) against his nawah (habitation); he will inah (answer / respond) a hayadad (shout), as those who darak (tread) grapes, against all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land).

A shaawan (noise) shall bawaa (come) even to the qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land); for Yahawah has a rayab (controversy) with the gawayam (nations); he will enter into shapat (judge / judgement) with all bashar (flesh): as for the rashai (wicked), he will nathan (give) them to the charab (sword), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), Behold, rai (evil) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from gaway (heathen / nation) to gaway (heathen / nation), and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sair (storm) shall be iwar (rouse / awaken) up from the uttermost yarakathay (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land).

The chalal (slain) of Yahawah shall be at that yawam (day) from one qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land) even to the other qatzah (end / extremity / border) of the aratz (Earth/land): they shall not be sapad (lamented), neither asap (gathered), nor qabar (bury); they shall be daman (dung) on the surface of the adamah (ground).

Wail, you raiyam (shepherds), and zaiq (cry); and wallow in dust, you adayar (principal) of the tzaan (flock); for the yawam (day) of your tabach (slaughter) and of your thapawatzah (dispersions) are fully come, and you shall napal (fall / be cast down) like a chamadah (goodly) kalay (vessel).
The raiyam (shepherds) shall have no manawas (way) to abad (destroy / perish), nor the adayar (principal) of the tzaan (flock) to palayatah (escape).
A qawal (sound / voice) of the tzaiqah (cry) of the raiyam (shepherds), and the wailing of the adayar (principal) of the tzaan (flock)! For Yahawah lays shadad (waste) their maraiyath (pasture).
The peaceable folds are brought to damam (silence) panayam (face) of the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah.

He has izab (left) his sak (covert), as the kapayar (lion); for their aratz (Earth/land) has become an shamah (astonishment) panayam (face) of the charawan (fierceness) of the oppression, and panayam (face) of his charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

In the raashayath (beginning) of the mamalakawath (reign) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), came this dabar (word / matter) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: imad (stand) in the chatzar (court) of Yahawah bayath (house), and dabar (word / matter) to all the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), which bawaa (come) to shachah (worship) in Yahawah bayath (house), all the dabarayam (words) that I tzawah (command) you to dabar (word / matter) to them; don't garai (diminish) a dabar (word / matter).

It may be they will shamai (hearken / hear), and shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (man / husband) from his rai (evil) darak (way); that I may nacham (turn away / repent) me of the rai (evil) which I chashab (purpose) to ishah (make) to them panayam (face) of the rai (evil) of their mailal (doings).
You shall amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, to yalak (walk) in my thawarah (instruction), which I nathan (give) set panayam (face) you,

To shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabaray (words) of my ibad (servant) the nabaayam (prophets), whom I shalach (send) to you, even shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them, but you have not shamai (hearken / hear);
Then will I nathan (give) this bayath (house) like Shayalah (Shiloh), and will nathan (give) this iyar (city) a qalalah (curse) to all the gawayay (nations) of the aratz (Earth/land).

The kahanayam (priests) and the nabaayam (prophets) and all the im (nation / people) shamai (hearken / hear) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) dabar (word / matter) these dabarayam (words) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

It happened, when Yaramayah (Jeremiah) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of dabar (word / matter) all that Yahawah had tzawah (commanded) him to dabar (word / matter) to all the im (nation / people), that the kahanayam (priests) and the nabaayam (prophets) and all the im (nation / people) thapash (laid) hold on him, amar (spoke), You shall mawath (death) mawath (death).

Why have you nabaa (prophesied) in the sham (name) of Yahawah, amar (spoke), This bayath (house) shall be like Shayalah (Shiloh), and this iyar (city) shall be charab (desolate), without yashab (inhabit/dwell)? All the im (nation / people) were qahal (gathered) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

When the sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah) shamai (hearken / hear) these things, they ilah (go up / offer) up from the malak (king) bayath (house) to the bayath (house) of Yahawah; and they yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the entry of the chadash (new) shair (gate) of Yahawah house.

Then amar (spoke) the kahanayam (priests) and the nabaayam (prophets) to the sharayam (princes) and to all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), This ayash (man / husband) is mashapat (worthy) of mawath (death); for he has nabaa (prophesied) against this iyar (city), as you have shamai (hearken / hear) with your azan (ear).

Then amar (spoke) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) to all the sharayam (princes) and to all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), Yahawah shalach (send) me to nabaa (prophesy) against this bayath (house) and against this iyar (city) all the dabarayam (words) that you have shamai (hearken / hear).

Now therefore yatab (amend) your darak (ways) and your mailal (doings), and shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam; and Yahawah will nacham (turn away / repent) him of the rai (evil) that he has dabar (word / matter) against you.
But as for me, behold, I am in your yad (hand): ishah (make) with me as is tawab (good / proper function) and yashar (upright) in your eyes.

Only yadai (know) for certain that, if you put me to mawath (death), you will nathan (give) naqay (innocent) dam (blood) on yourselves, and on this iyar (city), and on its yashab (inhabit/dwell); for of a amath (truth) Yahawah has shalach (send) me to you to dabar (word / matter) all these dabarayam (words) in your azan (ear).

Then the sharayam (princes) and all the im (nation / people) amar (spoke) to the kahanayam (priests) and to the nabayaayam (prophets): This ayash (man / husband) is not mashapat (worthy) of mawath (death); for he has dabar (word / matter) to us in the sham (name) of Yahawah our Alahayam.
Then qawam (rise up) up ayash (man / husband) of the zaqanay (elders) of the aratz (Earth/land), and amar (spoke) to all the qahal (assembly) of the im (nation / people), amar (spoke),

Mayakayah (Micah) the Morashtite nabaa (prophesied) in the yamay (days) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah); and he amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): Tzayawan (Zion) shall be charash (plowed) as a shadah (field), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shall become iyayam (heaps), and the har (mountain) of the bayath (house) as the bamah (high) places of a yair (forest).

Did Chazaqayah (Hezekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and mawath (death) Yahawadah (Judah) put him to mawath (death)? Didn't he yaraa (fear) Yahawah, and entreat the favor of Yahawah, and Yahawah relented of the disaster which he had dabar (word / matter) against them? Thus should we ishah (make) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) against our own napash (soul).

There was also a ayash (man / husband) who nabaa (prophesied) in the sham (name) of Yahawah, Awarayah (Uriah) the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) of Kiriath Qarayath-Yairayam (Jearim); and he nabaa (prophesied) against this iyar (city) and against this aratz (Earth/land) according to all the dabaray (words) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah):

And when Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king), with all his gabawar (mighty) men, and all the sharayam (princes), shamai (hearken / hear) his dabar (word / matter), the malak (king) baqash (sought) to put him to mawath (death); but when Awarayah (Uriah) shamai (hearken / hear) it, he was yaraa (fear / be afraid), and barach (fled), and bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt):

And Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king) shalach (send) anashayam (men) into Matzarayam (Egypt), Alanathan (Elnathan) the ban (son) of Ikabawar (Achbor), and ayash (man / husband) men with him, into Matzarayam (Egypt);

And they yatzaa (go out / come out) forth Awarayah (Uriah) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), and bawaa (come) him to Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king), who nakah (killed) him with the charab (sword), and shalak (cast) his nabalah (dead) body into the qabaray (graves) of the ban (son) im (nation / people).

But the yad (hand) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan) was with Yaramayah (Jeremiah), that they should not nathan (give) him into the yad (hand) of the im (nation / people) to put him to mawath (death).

In the raashayath (beginning) of the mamalakah (reign) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), came this dabar (word / matter) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah to me: ishah (make) mawasarawath (bonds) and bars, and nathan (give) them on your tzawaar (neck);

And shalach (send) them to the malak (king) of Adawam (Edom), and to the malak (king) of Mawaab (Moab), and to the malak (king) of the banay (children) of Ammon, and to the malak (king) of Tzar (Tyre), and to the malak (king) of Tzayadawan (Sidon), by the yad (hand) of the malaakayam (messengers) who bawaa (come) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah);

And give them a tzawah (command) to their adawan (master / lord), amar (spoke), Thus thaamaraw (says) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), You shall amar (spoke) your adawan (master / lord):

I ishah (make) made the aratz (Earth/land), the adam (men) and the animals that are on the surface of the aratz (Earth/land), by my gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and by my natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); and I nathan (give) it to whom it seems yashar (upright) to me.

Now nathan (give) I given all these aratzawath (lands) into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), my ibad (servant); and the animals of the shadah (field) also nathan (give) I given him to ibad (servant) him.

All the gawayam (nations) shall ibad (servant) him, and his ban (son), and his ban (son) ban (son), until the ith (time) of his own aratz (Earth/land) bawaa (come): and then many gawayam (nations) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) malakayam (kings) shall ibad (servant) him their bondservant.

It shall happen, that the gaway (heathen / nation) and the mamalakah (kingdom) which will not ibad (servant) the same Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and that will not nathan (give) their tzawaar (neck) under the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), that gaway (heathen / nation) will I paqad (visit), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, with the charab (sword), and with the raib (famine), and with the dabar (word / matter), until I thamam (have) consumed them by his yad (hand).

But as for you, don't you shamai (hearken / hear) to your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), nor to your diviners, nor to your chalawam (dreams), nor to your inan (cloud intepreting / soothsaying / astrology), nor to your kashap (sorcerers), who amar (spoke) to you, amar (spoke), You shall not ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon):
For they nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you, to rachaq (remove) you far from your adamah (land), and that I should nadach (drive) you out, and you should abad (destroy / perish).

But the gaway (heathen / nation) that shall bawaa (come) their tzawaar (neck) under the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and ibad (servant) him, that nation will I yanach (let) remain in their own adamah (land), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; and they shall ibad (servant) it, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.

I dabar (word / matter) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) according to all these dabarayam (words), amar (spoke), bawaa (come) your tzawaar (necks) under the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and ibad (servant) him and his im (nation / people), and chayah (live).

Why will you mawath (death), you and your im (nation / people), by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter), as Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning the gaway (heathen / nation) that will not ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon)?

Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabaray (words) of the nabaayam (prophets) who amar (spoke) to you, amar (spoke), You shall not ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon); for they nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you.

For I have not shalach (send) them, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, but they nabaa (prophesy) falsely in my sham (name); that I may nadach (drive) you out, and that you may abad (destroy / perish), you, and the nabaayam (prophets) who nabaa (prophesy) to you.

Also I dabar (word / matter) to the kahanayam (priests) and to all this im (nation / people), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabaray (words) of your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesy) to you, amar (spoke), Behold, the kalay (vessels) of Yahawah bayath (house) shall now maharah (shortly) be shawab (turn back / repent) again from Babal (Babylon); for they nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you.
Don't shamai (hearken / hear) to them; ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and chayah (live): why should this iyar (city) become a desolation?

But if they be nabaayam (prophets), and if the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah be with them, let them now pagai (make) intercession to Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), that the kalayam (vessels) which are yathar (left) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), don't bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) concerning the imadayam (pillars), and concerning the yam (sea/waters), and concerning the makanawath (bases), and concerning the yathar (residue) of the kalayam (vessels) that are yathar (left) in this iyar (city),

Which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) didn't laqach (take / seize), when he galah (carried) away captive Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon), and all the charay (nobles) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem);

Yes, thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), concerning the kalayam (vessels) that are yathar (left) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, and in the bayath (house) of the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem):

They shall be bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon), and there shall they be, until the yawam (day) that I paqad (visit) them, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; then will I ilah (go up / offer) them up, and shawab (turn back / repent) them to this maqawam (place).

It happened the same shanah (year), in the raashayath (beginning) of the mamalakah (reign) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year), in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), that Chananayah (Hananiah) the ban (son) of Izawar (Azzur), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), who was of Gabaiwan (Gibeon), amar (spoke) to me in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the iyan (eye) of the kahanayam (priests) and of all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), I have shabar (broken) the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

Within yawam (day) full shanathayam (years) will I shawab (turn back / repent) again into this maqawam (place) all the kalay (vessels) of Yahawah bayath (house), that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) laqach (take / seize) away from this maqawam (place), and bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon):

And I will shawab (turn back / repent) again to this maqawam (place) Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), with all the galawath (captives) of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; for I will shabar (break) the il (over) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

Then the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Chananayah (Hananiah) in the iyan (eye) of the kahanayam (priests), and in the iyan (eye) of all the im (nation / people) who imad (stood) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah,

Even the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), aman (believe / have faith): Yahawah ishah (make) so; Yahawah qawam (rise up) your dabar (word / matter) which you have nabaa (prophesied), to shawab (turn back / repent) again the kalay (vessels) of Yahawah bayath (house), and all them of the gawalah (captivity), from Babal (Babylon) to this maqawam (place).
Nevertheless shamai (hearken / hear) you now this dabar (word / matter) that I dabar (word / matter) in your azanay (ears), and in the azanay (ears) of all the im (nation / people):

The nabayaayam (prophets) who have been panayam (face) me and panayam (face) you of iwalam (forever) nabaa (prophesied) against many aratzawath (countries), and against gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mamalakawath (kingdoms), of malachamah (war), and of rai (evil), and of dabar (word / matter).

The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who prophesies of shalawam (peace / safety), when the dabar (word / matter) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) shall happen, then shall the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) be yadai (known), that Yahawah has truly shalach (send) him.
Then Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) laqach (take / seize) the bar from off the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah's) tzawaar (neck), and shabar (broke) it.

Chananayah (Hananiah) amar (spoke) in the iyan (eye) of all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Even so will I shabar (break) the il (over) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) within yawam (day) full shanathayam (years) from off the tzawaar (neck) of all the gawayam (nations). The nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yalak (went) his darak (way).

Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), achar (other) that Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) had shabar (broken) the bar from off the tzawaar (neck) of the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Halak (move), and amar (spoke) Chananayah (Hananiah), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: You have shabar (broken) the bars of itz (wood); but you ishah (make) made in their place bars of barazal (iron).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): I nathan (give) put a il (over) of barazal (iron) on the tzawaar (neck) of all these gawayam (nations), that they may ibad (servant) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon); and they shall ibad (servant) him: and I nathan (give) given him the animals of the shadah (field) also.

Then the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), shamai (hearken / hear) now, Chananayah (Hananiah): Yahawah has not shalach (send) you; but you make this im (nation / people) to batach (trust) in a shaqar (lie).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will shalach (send) you away from off the surface of the adamah (earth): this shanah (year) you shall mawath (death), because you have dabar (word / matter) sarah (rebellion) against Yahawah.
So Chananayah (Hananiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) mawath (death) the same shanah (year) in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month).

Now these are the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) shalach (send) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to the yathar (residue) of the zaqanay (elders) of the gawalah (captivity), and to the kahanayam (priests), to the nabayaayam (prophets), and to all the im (nation / people), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) had galah (carried) away captive from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon),

(Achar (other) that Yakanayah (Jeconiah) the malak (king), the gabayarah (queen) mother, the sarayasayam (eunuchs), the sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah) and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the craftsmen, and the masagar (smiths), yatzaa (go out / come out) departed from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)),

By the yad (hand) of Alaishah (Elasah) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), and Gamarayah (Gemariah) the ban (son) of Chalaqayah (Hilkiah), (whom Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shalach (send) to Babal (Babylon) to Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon)), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to all the captivity, whom I have caused to be galah (carried) away gawalah (captive) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon):
Banah (build) bathayam (houses), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in them; and natai (plant) ganawath (gardens), and akal (eat) their paray (fruit).

Laqach (take / seize) wives, and yalad (birth / begot) banayam (sons) and banawath (daughters); and laqach (take / seize) wives for your banayam (sons), and nathan (give) your banawath (daughters) to anashayam (husbands), that they may yalad (birth / begot) banayam (sons) and banayam (daughters); and rabah (multiply) there, and don't be mait (diminished).

Darash (seek) the shalawam (peace / safety) of the iyar (city) where I have caused you to be galah (carried) away captive, and palal (pray) to Yahawah for it; for in its shalawam (peace / safety) you shall have shalawam (peace / safety).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Don't let your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who are in the qarab (among / near) of you, and your diviners, nashaa (lift) you; neither shamai (hearken / hear) to your chalawam (dreams) which you cause to be chalam (dream).
For they nabaa (prophesy) falsely to you in my sham (name): I have not shalach (send) them, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, pah (after) shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years) are malaa (accomplished) for Babal (Babylon), I will paqad (visit) you, and qawam (rise up) my tawab (good / proper function) dabar (word / matter) toward you, in causing you to shawab (turn back / repent) to this maqawam (place).

For I yadai (know) the machashabath (thoughts) that I chashab (think) toward you, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, machashabath (thoughts) of shalawam (peace / safety), and not of rai (evil), to nathan (give) you thaqawah (hope) and a future.
You shall qaraa (called) on me, and you shall halak (move) and palal (pray) to me, and I will shamai (hearken / hear) to you.
You shall baqash (seek) me, and matzaa (find) me, when you shall darash (search) for me with all your labab (heart).

I will be matzaa (found) by you, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, and I will shawab (turn back / repent) again your shabawath (captivity), and I will qabatz (gather) you from all the gawayam (nations), and from all the maqawamawath (places) where I have nadach (driven) you, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; and I will shawab (turn back / repent) you again to the maqawam (place) from where I caused you to be galah (carried) away captive.
Because you have amar (spoke), Yahawah has qawam (rise up) us up nabaayam (prophets) in Babal (Babylon);

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning the malak (king) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David), and concerning all the im (nation / people) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this iyar (city), your ach (brother/kinsman) who haven't yatzaa (go out / come out) forth with you into gawalah (captivity);

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies); Behold, I will shalach (send) on them the charab (sword), the raib (famine), and the dabar (word / matter), and will nathan (give) them like shair (vile) thaanayam (figs), that can't be akal (eat), they are so rai (bad).

I will radap (pursue) achar (other) them with the charab (sword), with the raib (famine), and with the dabar (word / matter), and will nathan (give) them to be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land), to be an object of horror, and an shamah (astonishment), and a sharaqah (hissing), and a charapah (reproach), among all the gawayam (nations) where I have nadach (driven) them;

Because they have not shamai (hearken / hear) to my dabar (word / matter), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, with which I shalach (send) to them my ibad (servant) the nabaayam (prophets), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them; but you would not shamai (hearken / hear), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Shamai (hearken / hear) therefore the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all you of the gawalah (captivity), whom I have shalach (send) away from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to Babal (Babylon).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), concerning Achaab (Ahab) the ban (son) of Qawalayah (Kolaiah), and concerning Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), who nabaa (prophesy) a shaqar (lie) to you in my sham (name): Behold, I will nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon); and he shall nakah (kill) them before your iyan (eye);

And of them shall be laqach (take / seize) up a qalalah (curse) by all the galawath (captives) of Yahawadah (Judah) who are in Babal (Babylon), amar (spoke), Yahawah shawam (place / establish / appoint) you like Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) and like Achaab (Ahab), whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) qalah (roasted) in the ash (fire);

Because they ishah (make) worked nabalah (folly) in Yashar-Al (Israel), and ishah (make) committed naap (adultery) with their neighbors' wives, and have dabar (word / matter) dabar (word / matter) in my sham (name) falsely, which I didn't tzawah (command) them; and I am he who yadai (knows), and am id (until / as far as), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Concerning Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nachalamay (nehelamite) you shall amar (spoke), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), Because you have shalach (send) saparayam (letters) in your own sham (name) to all the im (nation / people) who are at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and to Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), the kahan (priest), and to all the kahanayam (priests), amar (spoke),

Yahawah nathan (give) made you kahan (priest) in the place of Yahawayadai (Jehoiada) the kahan (priest), that there may be officers in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, for every ayash (man / husband) who is shagai (mad), and makes himself a nabaa (prophet), that you should nathan (give) him in the tzayanaq (stocks) and in shackles.
Now therefore, why have you not gair (rebuked) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) of inathathay (anathoth), who makes himself a nabaa (prophet) to you,

Because he has shalach (send) to us in Babal (Babylon), amar (spoke), The captivity is arak (long): banah (build) bathayam (houses), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in them; and natai (plant) ganawath (gardens), and akal (eat) their paray (fruit)?
Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the kahan (priest) qaraa (called) this sapar (book / scribed document) in the azanay (ears) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Shalach (send) to all them of the gawalah (captivity), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nachalamay (nehelamite): Because Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) has nabaa (prophesied) to you, and I didn't shalach (send) him, and he has caused you to batach (trust) in a shaqar (lie);

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will paqad (visit) Shamaiyah (Shemaiah) the nachalamay (nehelamite), and his zarai (seed); he shall not have a ayash (man / husband) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) thawak (midst) this im (nation / people), neither shall he raah (see) the tawab (good / proper function) that I will ishah (make) to my im (nation / people), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, because he has dabar (word / matter) sarah (rebellion) against Yahawah.
The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), kathab (write) all the dabarayam (words) that I have dabar (word / matter) to you in a sapar (book / scribed document).

For, behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that I will shawab (turn back / repent) again the shabawath (captivity) of my im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel) and Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke) Yahawah; and I will cause them to shawab (turn back / repent) to the aratz (Earth/land) that I nathan (give) to their ab (father), and they shall yarash (possess) it.
These are the dabarayam (words) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) concerning Yashar-Al (Israel) and concerning Yahawadah (Judah).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: We have shamai (hearken / hear) a qawal (sound / voice) of charadah (trembling), of pachad (fear / dread), and not of shalawam (peace / safety).

Shaal (ask) now, and raah (see) whether a zakar (remember) does yalad (birth / begot) with child: why do I raah (see) every gabar (man) with his yad (hand) on his waist, as a yalad (birth / begot) in travail, and all panayam (face) are hapak (turned) into paleness?

Haway (Alas/Woe!)! For that yawam (day) is gadawal (very great/important/mighty), so that none is like it: it is even the ith (time) of Yaiqab (Jacob's) tzarah (trouble); but he shall be yashai (salvation) out of it.

It shall come to pass in that yawam (day), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), that I will shabar (break) his il (over) from off your tzawaar (neck), and will nathaq (burst) your mawasar (bonds); and strangers shall no more ibad (servant) him their bondservant;
But they shall ibad (servant) Yahawah their Alahayam, and Dawad (David) their malak (king), whom I will qawam (rise up) up to them.

Therefore don't you be yaraa (fear / be afraid), O Yaiqab (Jacob) my ibad (servant), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; neither be chathath (dismayed), Yashar-Al (Israel): for, behold, I will yashai (salvation) you from rachawaq (afar), and your zarai (seed) from the aratz (Earth/land) of their shabay (captivity); and Yaiqab (Jacob) shall shawab (turn back / repent), and shall be shaqat (quiet) and at shaan (ease), and none shall make him charad (afraid).

For I am with you, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, to yashai (salvation) you: for I will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of all the gawayam (nations) where I have pawatz (scattered) you, but I will not ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of you; but I will yasar (correct) you in mashapat (measure), and will in no naqah (clean/innocent) leave you naqah (clean/innocent).
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Your shabar (hurt) is anash (incurable), and your makah (wound) chalah (afflict).
There is none to plead your dayan (judge), that you may be mazawar (bound) up: you have no thailah (healing) rapaawath (medicines).

All your lovers have shakach (forgotten) you; they don't darash (seek) you: for I have wounded you with the makah (wound) of an ayab (enemy), with the mawasar (chastisement) of a akazaray (cruel) one, for the greatness of your iwan (guilt/iniquity), because your chataah (sin) were itzam (increased).

Why do you zaiq (cry) for your shabar (hurt)? Your makaab (pain) is anash (incurable): for the greatness of your iwan (guilt/iniquity), because your chataah (sin) were itzam (increased), I ishah (make) done these things to you.

Therefore akal (eat) those who devour you shall be akal (eat); and all your tzar (oppressor / distressor), everyone of them, shall yalak (go) into shabay (captivity); and those who despoil you shall be a shaas (spoil), and all who bazaz (prey) on you will I nathan (give) for a baz (prey).

For I will ilah (go up / offer) arawakah (health) to you, and I will rapaa (heal) you of your makah (wounds), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; because they have qaraa (called) you an nadach (outcast), saying, "It is Tzayawan (Zion), whom no man darash (seeks) after.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I will shawab (turn back / repent) again the shabawath (captivity) of Yaiqab (Jacob's) ahalay (tents), and racham (show mercy / love) compassion on his mashakan (dwelling) places; and the iyar (city) shall be banah (build) on its own hill, and the aramawan (palace) shall be yashab (inhabit/dwell) in its own mashapat (way).

Out of them shall yatzaa (go out / come out) thanksgiving and the qawal (sound / voice) of those who shachaq (make) merry: and I will rabah (multiply) them, and they shall not be mait (few); I will also kabad (glorify) them, and they shall not be tzair (small).
Their ban (son) also shall be as qadam (before), and their idah (congregation) shall be kawan (established) panayam (face) me; and I will paqad (visit) all who lachatz (oppress) them.

Their adayar (prince) shall be of themselves, and their mashal (rule/have dominion) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) from their qarab (among / near); and I will cause him to qarab (come close) near, and he shall nagash (approach) to me: for who is he who has had boldness to nagash (approach) to me? Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
You shall be my im (nation / people), and I will be your Alahayam.
Behold, the sair (storm) of Yahawah, his chamah (wrath), yatzaa (go out / come out) gone forth, a sweeping sair (storm): it shall burst on the raash (head) of the rashai (wicked).

The charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah will not shawab (turn back / repent), until he ishah (make) executed, and until he has qawam (rise up) the intentions of his lab (heart). In the acharayath (latter) yamayam (days) you will bayan (between) it.
At that ith (time), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, will I be the Alahayam of all the mashapachawath (families) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and they shall be my im (nation / people).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, The im (nation / people) who were sharayad (left) of the charab (sword) matzaa (found) favor in the madabar (wilderness); even Yashar-Al (Israel), when I halak (move) to cause him to ragai (rest).
Yahawah raah (see) of rachawaq (old) to me, saying, "Yes, I have ahab (love) you with an iwalam (forever) ahabah (love): therefore with ahabah (loving) chasad (grace) have I mashak (drawn) you.

Again will I banah (build) you, and you shall be banah (build), O bathawalah (virgin) of Yashar-Al (Israel): again you shall be idah (adorned) with your tambourines, and shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth in the machawal (dances) of those who shachaq (make) merry.
Again you shall natai (plant) karamayam (vineyards) on the haray (mountains) of Shamarawan (Samaria); the nataiw (planters) shall natai (plant), and shall enjoy its fruit.

For there yash (shall) be a yawam (day), that the watchmen on the har (mountain) of Aparayam (Ephraim) shall qaraa (called), qawam (rise up), and let us ilah (go up / offer) up to Tzayawan (Zion) to Yahawah our Alahayam.

For thus amaraw (says) Yahawah, ranan (sing) with shamachah (gladness) for Yaiqab (Jacob), and tzahal (shout) for the raash (head) of the gawayam (nations): shamai (hearken / hear), halal (praise), and amar (spoke), Yahawah, yashai (salvation) your im (nation / people), the shaarayath (remnant) of Yashar-Al (Israel).

Behold, I will bawaa (come) them from the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land), and qabatz (gather) them from the uttermost yarakathay (parts) of the aratz (Earth/land), along with the iwar (blind) and the pasach (lame), the harah (woman) with child and her who yalad (birth / begot) with child yachad (together): a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (company) shall they shawab (turn back / repent) here.

They shall bawaa (come) with bakay (weeping); and with petitions will I yabal (lead) them: I will yalak (cause) them to walk by nachalay (rivers) of mayam (Waters), in a yashar (upright) darak (way) in which they shall not kashal (stumble / stagger); for I am a ab (father) to Yashar-Al (Israel), and Aparayam (Ephraim) is my bakawar (firstborn).

Shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, you gawayam (nations), and nagad (declare) it in the ayayam (islands) afar off; and amar (spoke), He who zarah (scattered) Yashar-Al (Israel) will qabatz (gather) him, and shamar (keep/guard) him, as raih (shepherd) does his idar (flock).
For Yahawah has gaal (ransomed) Yaiqab (Jacob), and padah (redeemed) him from the yad (hand) of him who was chazaq (stronger) than he.

They shall bawaa (come) and ranan (sing) in the marawam (height) of Tzayawan (Zion), and shall nahar (flow) to the goodness of Yahawah, to the grain, and to the new thayarawash (wine), and to the yatzahar (fresh oil), and to the ban (son) of the tzaan (flock) and of the baqar (morning): and their napash (soul) shall be as a rawah (watered) gan (garden); and they shall not daab (sorrow) any more at all.

Then shall the bathawalah (virgin) shamach (rejoice) in the machawal (dance), and the bachawar (young) men and the zaqan (old) yachad (together); for I will hapak (turn) their abal (mourning) into shashawan (joy), and will nacham (turn away / repent) them, and shamach (make) them rejoice from their yagawan (sorrow).

I will rawah (satiate) the napash (soul) of the kahanayam (priests) with dashan (fatness), and my im (nation / people) shall be shabai (satisfied) with my goodness, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: A qawal (sound / voice) is shamai (hearken / hear) in Ramah (Ramah), nahay (lamentation), and thamarawar (bitter) bakay (weeping), Rachal (Rachel) bakah (weeping) for her ban (son); she maan (refuses) to be nacham (turn away / repent) for her ban (son), because they are no more.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: manai (refrain) your qawal (sound / voice) from bakay (weeping), and your iyan (eye) from damaih (tears); for your pailah (work) yash (shall) be shakar (rewarded), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; and they shall shawab (turn back / repent) again from the aratz (Earth/land) of the ayab (enemy).

There is thaqawah (hope) for your acharayath (latter) end, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; and your banayam (children) shall shawab (turn back / repent) again to their own gabawal (border/boundary).

I have shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear) Aparayam (Ephraim) nawad (bemoaning) himself thus, You have yasar (chastised) me, and I was yasar (chastised), as an untrained igal (calf): shawab (turn back / repent) me, and I shall be shawab (turn back / repent); for you are Yahawah my Alahayam.

Surely achar (other) that I was shawab (turn back / repent), I nacham (turn away / repent); and achar (other) that I was yadai (instructed), I sapaq (struck) on my yarak (thigh): I was bawash (ashamed), yes, even kalam (confounded), because I nashaa (lift) the charapah (reproach) of my naiwar (youth).

Is Aparayam (Ephraim) my yaqayar (dear) ban (son)? Is he a darling yalad (birth / begot)? For as often as I dabar (word / matter) against him, I do zakar (remember) zakar (remember) him still: therefore my maih (heart) yearns for him; I will racham (show mercy / love) have racham (show mercy / love) on him, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

Natzab (set) up road tzayanayam (signs), shawam (place / establish / appoint) guideposts; shayath (put / appoint / make) your lab (heart) toward the masalah (highway), even the darak (way) by which you halak (move): shawab (turn back / repent) again, bathawalah (virgin) of Yashar-Al (Israel), shawab (turn back / repent) again to these your iyar (cities).

How long will you chamaq (go) here and there, you shawabab (backsliding) banath (daughter)? For Yahawah has baraa (created) a chadash (new) thing in the aratz (Earth/land): a naqabah (woman) shall encompass a gabar (man).

Thus yaamaraw (says) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), Yet again shall they use this dabar (word / matter) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in its iyar (cities), when I shall shawab (turn back / repent) again their shabawath (captivity): Yahawah barak (blessed) you, nawah (habitation) of tzadaq (righteous / just / fair), har (mountain) of qadash (set apart / make holy).
Yahawadah (Judah) and all its iyar (cities) shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein yachad (together), the farmers, and those who nasai (go) about with idar (flocks).
For I have rawah (satiated) the iyap (weary) napash (soul), and every daab (sorrowful) napash (soul) malaa (have) I replenished.
On this I awakened, and raah (see); and my shanah (sleep) was irab (evening) to me.

Behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that I will zarai (sow) the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) with the zarai (seed) of adam (man), and with the zarai (seed) of animal.

It shall happen that, like as I have shaqad (watched) over them to nathash (pluck) up and to nathatz (break) down and to haras (overthrow) and to abad (destroy / perish) and to raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil), so will I shaqad (watch) over them to banah (build) and to natai (plant), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
In those yamayam (days) they shall amar (spoke) no more, The abawath (fathers) have akal (eat) basar (sour) grapes, and the banayam (childrens) shanay (teeth) are qahah (set) on edge.
But everyone shall mawath (death) for his own iwan (guilt/iniquity): every adam (man) who akal (eat) the basar (sour) grapes, his shan (teeth) shall be qahah (set) on edge.

Behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that I will karath (cut) a chadash (new) barayath (covenant) with the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel), and with the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah):

Not according to the barayath (covenant) that I karath (cut) with their ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I chazaq (took) them by the yad (hand) to yatzaa (go out / come out) them out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); which my barayath (covenant) they parar (broke), although I was a bail (husband) to them, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

But this is the barayath (covenant) that I will karath (cut) with the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) achar (other) those yamayam (days), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: I will nathan (give) my thawarah (instruction) in their qarab (among / near) parts, and in their lab (heart) will I kathab (write) it; and I will be their Alahayam, and they shall be my im (nation / people):

And they shall lamad (teach / instruct) no more every ayash (man / husband) his neighbor, and every ayash (man / husband) his ach (brother/kinsman), amar (spoke), yadai (know) Yahawah; for they shall all yadai (know) me, from their qatan (small / young / least) to their greatest, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: for I will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) their iwan (guilt/iniquity), and their chataah (sin) will I zakar (remember) no more.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, who nathan (give) the shamash (sun) for a awar (light) by yawamam (by day), and the chaqath (ordinances) of the yarach (moon) and of the kawakabayam (stars) for a awar (light) by layal (night), who stirs up the yam (sea/waters), so that its gal (waves) hamah (great uproar); Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) is his sham (name):

If these chaqayam (ordinances) depart from panayam (face) me, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, then the zarai (seed) of Yashar-Al (Israel) also shall shabath (shabath / rest) from being a gaway (heathen / nation) panayam (face) me yawam (day).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) mail (top/above) can be madad (measured), and the mawasaday (foundations) of the aratz (Earth/land) chaqar (searched) out matah (beneath), then will I also maas (cast) off all the zarai (seed) of Yashar-Al (Israel) for all that they ishah (make) done, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

Behold, the yamayam (days) come, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that the iyar (city) shall be banah (build) to Yahawah from the magadal (tower) of Chananaal (Hananel) to the shair (gate) of the panah (corner / cornerstone).
The madah (measuring) qawah (gather/wait) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out further straight onward to the gabaih (hill) Garab (Gareb), and shall sabab (turn) about to Gaih (Goah).

The whole imaq (valley) of the pagar (dead) bodies and of the ashes, and all the sharamawath (fields) to the nachal (stream / river) Qadarawan (Kidron), to the panah (corner / cornerstone) of the sawas (horse) shair (gate) toward the mazarach (east), shall be qadash (set apart / make holy) to Yahawah; it shall not be nathash (plucked) up, nor haras (thrown) down any more iwalam (forever).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah in the ishayaray (tenth) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), which was the eighteenth shanah (year) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar).

Now at that time the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) was tzawar (besieging) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) was kalaa (shut) up in the chatzar (court) of the guard, which was in the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah's) bayath (house).

For Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had kalaa (shut) him up, amar (spoke), Why do you nabaa (prophesy), and amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) this iyar (city) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall lakad (take) it;

And Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) shall not malat (escape) out of the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), but shall nathan (give) be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and shall dabar (word / matter) with him pah (mouth) to pah (mouth), and his iyan (eye) shall raah (see) his iyan (eye);

And he shall yalak (bring) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) to Babal (Babylon), and he shall be there until I paqad (visit) him, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: though you lacham (fight) with the Kashaday (Chaldeans), you shall not tzalach (prosper)?
Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

Behold, Chanamaal (Hanamel) the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum) your dawad (uncle) shall bawaa (come) to you, amar (spoke), qanah (buy) my shadah (field) that is in Inathawath (Anathoth); for the mashapat (right) of gaalah (redemption) is yours to qanah (buy) it.

So Chanamaal (Hanamel) my dawad (uncle's) ban (son) bawaa (come) to me in the chatzar (court) of the guard according to the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, and amar (spoke) to me, Please qanah (buy) my shadah (field) that is in Inathawath (Anathoth), which is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin); for the mashapat (right) of yarashah (inheritance) is yours, and the gaalah (redemption) is yours; qanah (buy) it for yourself. Then I yadai (knew) that this was the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

I bought the shadah (field) that was in Inathawath (Anathoth) of Chanamaal (Hanamel) my dawad (uncle's) ban (son), and shaqal (weighed) him the kasap (money), even seventeen shaqalayam (shekels) of kasap (silver).
I kathab (write) the deed, and chatham (sealed) it, and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) witnesses, and shaqal (weighed) him the kasap (money) in the maazanayam (balances).
So I laqach (take / seize) the deed of the maqanah (purchase), both that which was chatham (sealed), containing the terms and conditions, and that which was galah (open);

And I nathan (give) the deed of the maqanah (purchase) to Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), the ban (son) of Machasayah (Mahseiah), in the iyan (eye) of Chanamaal (Hanamel) my dawad (uncle's) son, and in the iyan (eye) of the witnesses who kathab (write) the deed of the maqanah (purchase), iyan (eye) all the Yahawaday (Jews) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the chatzar (court) of the guard.
I tzawah (commanded) Barawak (Baruch) iyan (eye) them, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): laqach (take / seize) these deeds, this deed of the maqanah (purchase) which is chatham (sealed), and this deed which is galah (open), and nathan (give) them in an charash (earthen) kalay (vessel); that they may imad (continue) many yamayam (days).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): bathayam (houses) and shadawath (fields) and karamayam (vineyards) shall yet again be bought in this aratz (Earth/land).
Now achar (other) I nathan (give) delivered the deed of the maqanah (purchase) to Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), I palal (prayed) to Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Ahah (ah) Adanay Yahawah! Behold, you ishah (make) made the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the aratz (Earth/land) by your gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kach (strength / mighty / power) and by your natah (outstretched) zarawai (arm); there is nothing palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) hard for you,

Who show loving chasad (grace) to alapayam (thousands), and shalam (recompense) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of the abawath (fathers) into the chayaq (bosom) of their ban (son) achar (other) them; the gadawal (very great/important/mighty), the gabawar (mighty) Al, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) is his sham (name);

Gadawal (very great/important/mighty) in itzah (counsel), and rab (mighty) in ilayalayah (work); whose iyan (eye) are paqach (open) on all the darakay (ways) of the banay (sons) of adam (men), to nathan (give) everyone according to his darakay (ways), and according to the paray (fruit) of his mailal (doings):

Who performed athawath (signs) and mapathayam (wonders) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), even to this yawam (day), both in Yashar-Al (Israel) and among other adam (men); and ishah (make) yourself a sham (name), as in this yawam (day);

And yatzaa (go out / come out) forth your im (nation / people) Yashar-Al (Israel) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) with athawath (signs), and with mawapathayam (wonders), and with a chazaq (strong) yad (hand), and with an outstretched azarawai (arm), and with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) mawaraa (terror);

And nathan (give) them this aratz (Earth/land), which you shabai (swear / take oath) to their ab (father) to nathan (give) them, a aratz (Earth/land) zawab (flow) with chalab (milk) and dabash (honey);

And they bawaa (come) in, and yarash (possessed) it, but they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) your qawal (sound / voice), neither halak (move) in your thawarah (instruction); they ishah (make) done nothing of all that you tzawah (commanded) them to ishah (make): therefore you have caused all this rai (evil) to qaraa (called) on them.

Behold, the mounds, they bawaa (come) come to the iyar (city) to lakad (take) it; and the iyar (city) is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who lacham (fight) panayam (face) it, because of the charab (sword), and of the raib (famine), and of the dabar (word / matter); and what you have dabar (word / matter) raah (see) happened; and behold, you see it.

You have amar (spoke) to me, Adanay Yahawah, qanah (buy) the shadah (field) for kasap (money), and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) witnesses; whereas the iyar (city) is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),
Behold, I am Yahawah, the Alahayam of all bashar (flesh): is there anything palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) hard for me?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, I will nathan (give) this iyar (city) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall lakad (take) it:

And the Kashaday (Chaldeans), who lacham (fight) against this iyar (city), shall bawaa (come) and yatzath (set) this iyar (city) on ash (fire), and sharap (burn) it, with the bathayam (houses), on whose gag (roofs) they have qatar (offered) incense to Bail (Baal), and nasak (poured) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to other Alahayam, to provoke me to kais (anger).

For the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah) ishah (make) done only that which was rai (evil) in my iyan (eye) from their naiwar (youth); for the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) have only provoked me to kais (anger) with the maishah (work) of their yad (hand), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

For this iyar (city) has been to me a provocation of my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and of my chamah (wrath) from the yawam (day) that they banah (build) it even to this yawam (day); that I should sawar (remove) it from before my panayam (face),

Because of all the rai (evil) of the banay (children) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and of the banay (children) of Yahawadah (Judah), which they ishah (make) done to provoke me to kais (anger), they, their malak (king), their shar (prince / ruler), their kahan (priest), and their nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

They have panah (turn) to me the irap (neck), and not the panayam (face): and though I lamad (teach / instruct) them, shakam (rising) up early and lamad (teach / instruct) them, yet they have not shamai (hearken / hear) to laqach (take / seize) mawasar (instruction).
But they shawam (place / establish / appoint) their shaqawatz (abominations) in the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name), to tamaa (defile) it.

They banah (build) the bamah (high) places of Bail (Baal), which are in the gayaa (valley) of the ban (son) of Hanam (Hinnom), to cause their ban (son) and their banath (daughter) to ibar (pass over/through) through fire to Malak (Molech); which I didn't tzawah (command) them, neither did it ilah (go up / offer) into my lab (heart), that they should ishah (make) this thawaibah (abomination), to cause Yahawadah (Judah) to chataa (sin).

Now therefore thus amarayam (says) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), concerning this iyar (city), about which you amar (spoke), It is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) by the charab (sword), and by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter):

Behold, I will qabatz (gather) them out of all the aratzawath (countries), where I have nadach (driven) them in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), and in my chamah (wrath), and in gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qatzap (indignation); and I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again to this maqawam (place), and I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) them to dwell safely:
And they shall be my im (nation / people), and I will be their Alahayam:

And I will nathan (give) them achad (one) lab (heart) and achad (one) darak (way), that they may yaraa (fear / be afraid) me yawam (day), for their tawab (good / proper function), and of their ban (son) achar (other) them:

And I will karath (cut) an iwalam (forever) barayath (covenant) with them, that I will not shawab (turn back / repent) away from achar (other) them, to do them yatab (good); and I will nathan (give) my yaraah (fear) in their labab (hearts), that they may not sawar (depart) from me.

Yes, I will shawash (rejoice) over them to do them tawab (good / proper function), and I will natai (plant) them in this aratz (Earth/land) amath (truth) with my whole lab (heart) and with my whole napash (soul).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Like as I bawaa (come) brought all this gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) on this im (nation / people), so will I bawaa (come) on them all the tawab (good / proper function) that I have dabar (word / matter) them.

Shadah (fields) shall be bought in this aratz (Earth/land), about which you amar (spoke), It is shamamah (desolate), without adam (man) or animal; it is nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

Men shall qanah (buy) shadawath (fields) for kasap (money), and kathab (write) the deeds, and chatham (seal) them, and iwad (admonish/bear witness against) witnesses, in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), and in the sabayabay (places) about Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the iray (cities) of the har (mountain) country, and in the iray (cities) of the lowland, and in the iray (cities) of the nagab (south): for I will cause their shabawath (captivity) to shawab (turn back / repent), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Moreover the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the shanay (second) time, while he was yet itzar (shut) up in the chatzar (court) of the guard, amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah who ishah (make) it, Yahawah who yatzar (forms) it to kawan (establish) it; Yahawah is his sham (name):
Qaraa (called) to me, and I will inah (answer / respond) you, and will show you gadawal (very great/important/mighty) things, and difficult, which you don't yadai (know).

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), concerning the bathay (houses) of this iyar (city), and concerning the bathay (houses) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah), which are nathatz (broken) down to make a defense against the mounds and against the charab (sword);

While men bawaa (come) to lacham (fight) with the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and to malaa (fill) them with the pagar (dead) bodies of adam (men), whom I have nakah (killed) in my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and in my chamah (wrath), and for all whose rai (wickedness) I have sathar (hidden) my panayam (face) from this iyar (city):

Behold, I will ilah (go up / offer) it arawakah (health) and marapaa (cure), and I will rapaa (cure) them; and I will galah (reveal) to them itharath (abundance) of shalawam (peace / safety) and amath (truth).

I will cause the shabawath (captivity) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the shabawath (captivity) of Yashar-Al (Israel) to shawab (turn back / repent), and will banah (build) them, as at the raashawan (first).

I will tahar (cleanse) them from all their iwan (guilt/iniquity), by which they have chataa (sinned) against me; and I will salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) all their iwan (guilt/iniquity), by which they have chataa (sinned) against me, and by which they have pashai (transgressed) against me.

This city shall be to me for a sham (name) of shashawan (joy), for a thahalah (praise) and for a glory, before all the gawayay (nations) of the aratz (Earth/land), which shall shamai (hearken / hear) all the tawab (good / proper function) that I ishah (make) to them, and shall pachad (fear / dread) and ragaz (tremble) for all the tawab (good / proper function) and for all the shalawam (peace / safety) that I ishah (make) to it.

Thus amarayam (says) Yahawah: Yet again there shall be shamai (hearken / hear) in this maqawam (place), about which you amar (spoke), It is charab (waste), without adam (man) and without animal, even in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), that are shamam (desolate), without adam (man) and without yashab (inhabit/dwell) and without animal,

The qawal (sound / voice) of shashawan (joy) and the qawal (sound / voice) of shamachah (gladness), the qawal (sound / voice) of the chathan (bridegroom) and the qawal (sound / voice) of the kalah (complete / finish), the qawal (sound / voice) of those who amar (spoke), Give hawadaw (thanks) to Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), for Yahawah is tawab (good / proper function), for his loving chasad (grace) endures iwalam (forever); who bawaa (come) thanksgiving into the bayath (house) of Yahawah. For I will cause the shabawath (captivity) of the aratz (Earth/land) to shawab (turn back / repent) as at the raashawan (first), amarayam (says) Yahawah.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): Yet again shall there be in this maqawam (place), which is charab (waste), without adam (man) and without animal, and in all its iyar (cities), a nawah (habitation) of raiyam (shepherds) causing their tzaan (flocks) to rabatz (lie) down.

In the iray (cities) of the har (mountain) country, in the iray (cities) of the lowland, and in the iray (cities) of the nagab (south), and in the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), and in the sabayabay (places) about Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), shall the tzaan (flocks) again pass under the yaday (hands) of him who manah (numbers) them, amar (spoke) Yahawah.

Behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that I will qawam (rise up) that tawab (good / proper function) dabar (word / matter) which I have dabar (word / matter) concerning the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) and concerning the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah).

In those yamayam (days), and at that ith (time), will I cause a tzamach (branch) of tzadaqah (righteousness) to tzamach (grow) up to Dawad (David); and he shall ishah (make) mashapat (justice) and tzadaqah (righteousness) in the aratz (Earth/land).

In those yamayam (days) shall Yahawadah (Judah) be yashai (salvation), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shall shakan (place) safely; and this is the qaraa (called) by which she shall be called: Yahawah our righteousness.
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Dawad (David) shall laa (NOT) karath (cut) a ayash (man / husband) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel);

Neither shall the kahanayam (priests) the Lawayay (Levites) karath (cut) a ayash (man / husband) panayam (face) me to ilah (go up / offer) burnt ilah (offerings), and to qatar (burn) meal manachah (offerings), and to ishah (make) zabach (sacrifice) yawam (day).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If you can parar (break) my barayath (covenant) of the yawam (day), and my barayath (covenant) of the layal (night), so that there shall not be yawamam (by day) and layal (night) in their ith (season);

Then may also my barayath (covenant) be parar (broken) with Dawad (David) my ibad (servant), that he shall not have a ban (son) to malak (king) on his kasaa (throne); and with the Lawayay (Levites) the kahanayam (priests), my sharath (ministers).

As the tzabaa (troop) of the sky can't be sapar (book), neither the chawal (sand) of the yam (sea/waters) madad (measured); so will I rabah (multiply) the zarai (seed) of Dawad (David) my ibad (servant), and the Lawayay (Levites) who sharath (minister) to me.
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Don't raah (see) what this im (nation / people) has dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke), The shanayam (two) mashapachawath (families) which Yahawah bachar (chose), he has maas (cast) them off? Thus do they naatz (despise) my im (nation / people), that they should be no more a gaway (heathen / nation) panayam (face) them.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: If my barayath (covenant) of yawamam (by day) and layal (night) fails, if I have not shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chaqawath (ordinances) of shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and aratz (Earth/land);

Then will I also maas (cast) away the zarai (seed) of Yaiqab (Jacob), and of Dawad (David) my ibad (servant), so that I will not laqach (take / seize) of his zarai (seed) to be mashalayam (rulers) over the zarai (seed) of Abaraham (Abraham), Yashachaq (Isaac), and Yaiqab (Jacob): for I will cause their shabawath (captivity) to shawab (turn back / repent), and will have racham (show mercy / love) on them.

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, when Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land) that were under his yad (hand), and all the imayam (peoples), were lacham (fighting) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and against all the iyar (cities) of it, amar (spoke):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), halak (move), and amar (spoke) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), and amar (spoke) him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) this iyar (city) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall sharap (burn) it with ash (fire):

And you shall not malat (escape) out of his yad (hand), but shall thapash (surely) be thapash (taken), and nathan (give) into his yad (hand); and your iyanay (eyes) shall raah (see) the iyanay (eyes) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall dabar (word / matter) with you pah (mouth) to pah (mouth), and you shall bawaa (come) to Babal (Babylon).

Yet shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, O Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah): thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning you, You shall not mawath (death) by the charab (sword);

You shall mawath (death) in shalawam (peace / safety); and with the masharapawath (burnings) of your ab (father), the raashawan (former) malakayam (kings) who were panayam (face) you, so shall they sharap (make) a burning for you; and they shall sapad (lament) you, saying, haway (Alas/Woe!) Adawan! For I have dabar (word / matter) the dabar (word / matter), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) dabar (word / matter) all these dabarayam (words) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem),

When the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) was lacham (fighting) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and against all the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) that were yathar (left), against Lakayash (Lachish) and against Izaqah (Azekah); for these alone shaar (remained) of the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) as fortified iray (cities).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, achar (other) that the malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with all the im (nation / people) who were at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to qaraa (called) darawar (liberty) to them;

That every ayash (man / husband) should let his male servant, and every ayash (man / husband) his female servant, who is a ibaray (hebrew) or a Hebrewess, shalach (send) chapashay (free); that none should ibad (servant) bondservants of them, of a Yahawaday (Jew) his ach (brother/kinsman).

All the sharayam (princes) and all the im (nation / people) obeyed, who bawaa (come) entered into the barayath (covenant), that everyone should let his male ayash (man / husband), and everyone his female servant, shalach (send) chapashay (free), that none should ibad (servant) bondservants of them any more; they shamai (hearken / hear), and shalach (send) them go:

But afterwards they shawab (turn back / repent), and caused the ibadayam (servants) and the handmaids, whom they had shalach (send) go chapashay (free), to shawab (turn back / repent), and kabash (brought) them into subjection for ibadayam (servants) and for handmaids.
Therefore the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): I karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) with your ab (father) in the yawam (day) that I yatzaa (go out / come out) them forth out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), out of the bayath (house) of ibad (servant), amar (spoke),

At the qatz (end) of shabai (seven) shanayam (years) you shall shalach (send) go every ayash (man / husband) his ach (brother/kinsman) who is a ibaray (hebrew), who has been makar (sold) to you, and has ibad (servant) you shash (six) shanayam (years), you shall shalach (send) him go chapashay (free) from you: but your ab (father) didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to me, neither natah (inclined) their azan (ear).

You had yawam (day) shawab (turn back / repent), and ishah (make) done that which is yashar (upright) in my iyan (eye), in qaraa (called) darawar (liberty) every ayash (man / husband) to his neighbor; and you had karath (cut) a barayath (covenant) panayam (face) me in the bayath (house) which is qaraa (called) by my sham (name):

But you shawab (turn back / repent) and chalal (profaned) my sham (name), and caused every ayash (man / husband) his ibad (servant), and every ayash (man / husband) his handmaid, whom you had shalach (send) go chapashay (free) at their napash (soul), to shawab (turn back / repent); and you kabash (brought) them into subjection, to be to you for ibadayam (servants) and for handmaids.

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: you have not shamai (hearken / hear) to me, to qaraa (called) darawar (liberty), every ayash (man / husband) to his ach (brother/kinsman), and every ayash (man / husband) to his neighbor: behold, I qaraa (called) to you a darawar (liberty), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, to the charab (sword), to the dabar (word / matter), and to the raib (famine); and I will nathan (give) you to be tossed back and forth among all the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the aratz (Earth/land).

I will nathan (give) the anashayam (men) who ibar (pass over/through) transgressed my barayath (covenant), who have not qawam (rise up) the dabaray (words) of the barayath (covenant) which they karath (cut) panayam (face) me, when they karath (cut) the igal (calf) in shanayam (two) and ibar (pass over/through) between its bathar (parts);

The sharay (princes) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the sharay (princes) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), the sarasayam (eunuchs), and the kahanayam (priests), and all the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), who ibar (pass over/through) between the batharay (parts) of the igal (calf);

I will even nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their napash (soul); and their nabalah (dead) bodies shall be for maakal (food) to the iwap (flying) of the sky, and to the animals of the aratz (Earth/land).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and his shar (prince / ruler) will I nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of their ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their napash (soul), and into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), who have ilah (go up / offer) away from you.

Behold, I will tzawah (command), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, and cause them to shawab (turn back / repent) to this iyar (city); and they shall lacham (fight) against it, and lakad (take) it, and sharap (burn) it with ash (fire): and I will nathan (give) the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) a shamamah (desolation), without yashab (inhabit/dwell).

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah in the yamay (days) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke),

Halak (move) to the bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites), and dabar (word / matter) to them, and bawaa (come) them into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, into achad (one) of the rooms, and give them yayan (wine) to shaqah (drink).

Then I laqach (take / seize) Yaazanayah (Jaazaniah) the ban (son) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), the ban (son) of Chabatzanayah (Habazziniah), and his ach (brother/kinsman), and all his ban (son), and the whole bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites);

And I bawaa (come) them into the bayath (house) of Yahawah, into the room of the banay (sons) of Chanan (Hanan) the ban (son) of Yagadalayahaw (Igdaliah), the ayash (man / husband) of Alahayam, which was by the room of the sharayam (princes), which was mail (top/above) the room of Maishayah (Maaseiah) the ban (son) of Shalawam (Shallum), the keeper of the sap (threshold).

I nathan (give) panayam (face) the banay (sons) of the bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites) bowls malaa (full) of yayan (wine), and kasawath (cups); and I amar (spoke) to them, shathah (drinks) yayan (wine)!

But they amar (spoke), We will shathah (drinks) no yayan (wine); for Yawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), our ab (father), tzawah (commanded) us, amar (spoke), You shall shathah (drinks) no yayan (wine), neither you, nor your ban (son), iwalam (forever):

Neither shall you banah (build) bayath (house), nor zarai (sow) zarai (seed), nor natai (plant) karam (vineyard), nor have any; but all your yamayam (days) you shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in ahalayam (tents); that you may chayah (live) many yamayam (days) in the adamah (land) in which you live.

We have shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), our ab (father), in all that he tzawah (commanded) us, to shathah (drinks) no yayan (wine) all our yawam (day), we, our wives, our ban (son), or our banath (daughter);
Nor to banah (build) bathayam (houses) for us to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in; neither have we karam (vineyard), nor shadah (field), nor zarai (seed):
But we have lived in ahalayam (tents), and have shamai (hearken / hear), and ishah (make) according to all that Yawanadab (Jonadab) our ab (father) tzawah (commanded) us.

But it happened, when Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) ilah (go up / offer) up into the aratz (Earth/land), that we amar (spoke), bawaa (come), and bawaa (come) us go to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for panayam (face) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and for panayam (face) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Aram (Syrians); so we yashab (inhabit/dwell) at Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): halak (move), and amar (spoke) the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) and the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), Will you not laqach (take / seize) mawasar (instruction) to shamai (hearken / hear) to my dabar (word / matter)? Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

The dabaray (words) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab), that he tzawah (commanded) his ban (son), not to shathah (drinks) yayan (wine), are qawam (rise up); and to this yawam (day) they shathah (drinks) none, for they shamai (hearken / hear) their ab (father) matzawah (commandment): but I have dabar (word / matter) to you, shakam (rising) up early and dabar (word / matter); and you have not shamai (hearken / hear) to me.
