I have shalach (send) also to you all my ibad (servant) the nabaayam (prophets), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them, amar (spoke), shawab (turn back / repent) now every ayash (man / husband) from his rai (evil) darak (way), and yatab (amend) your mailal (doings), and don't yalak (go) achar (other) other Alahayam to ibad (servant) them, and you shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the adamah (land) which I nathan (give) given to you and to your ab (father): but you have not natah (inclined) your azan (ear), nor shamai (hearken / hear) to me.

Because the banay (sons) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab) have qawam (rise up) the matzawah (commandment) of their ab (father) which he tzawah (commanded) them, but this im (nation / people) has not shamai (hearken / hear) to me;

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Behold, I will bawaa (come) on Yahawadah (Judah) and on all the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) all the rai (evil) that I have dabar (word / matter) against them; because I have dabar (word / matter) to them, but they have not shamai (hearken / hear); and I have qaraa (called) to them, but they have not inah (answer / respond).

Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to the bayath (house) of the Rakah (Rechabites), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Because you have shamai (hearken / hear) the matzawah (commandment) of Yahawanadab (Jonadab) your ab (father), and shamar (keep/guard) all his matzawah (precepts), and ishah (make) according to all that he tzawah (commanded) you;

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Yawanadab (Jonadab) the ban (son) of Rakab (Rechab) shall not karath (cut) a ayash (man / husband) to imad (stand) panayam (face) me yawam (day).

It happened in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), that this dabar (word / matter) came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seize) a scroll of a sapar (book / scribed document), and kathab (write) therein all the dabarayam (words) that I have dabar (word / matter) to you against Yashar-Al (Israel), and against Yahawadah (Judah), and against all the gawayam (nations), from the yawam (day) I dabar (word / matter) to you, from the yamay (days) of Yaashayah (Josiah), even to this yawam (day).

It may be that the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) will shamai (hearken / hear) all the rai (evil) which I chashab (purpose) to ishah (make) to them; that they may shawab (turn back / repent) every ayash (man / husband) from his rai (evil) darak (way); that I may salach (forgive/pardon/make clean) their iwan (guilt/iniquity) and their chataah (sin).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) qaraa (called) Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah); and Barawak (Baruch) kathab (write) from the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) all the dabaray (words) of Yahawah, which he had dabar (word / matter) to him, on a scroll of a sapar (book / scribed document).
Yaramayah (Jeremiah) tzawah (commanded) Barawak (Baruch), amar (spoke), I am itzar (shut) up; I can't bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yahawah:

Therefore you bawaa (come), and qaraa (called) in the scroll, which you have kathab (write) from my pah (mouth), the dabaray (words) of Yahawah in the azanay (ears) of the im (nation / people) in Yahawah bayath (house) on the tzawam (fast) yawam (day); and also you shall qaraa (called) them in the azanay (ears) of all Yahawadah (Judah) who bawaa (come) out of their iyar (cities).

It may be they will napal (fall / be cast down) their thachanah (supplication) panayam (face) Yahawah, and will shawab (turn back / repent) everyone from his rai (evil) darak (way); for gadawal (very great/important/mighty) is the ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and the chamah (wrath) that Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) against this im (nation / people).

Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah) ishah (make) according to all that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) tzawah (commanded) him, qaraa (called) in the sapar (book / scribed document) the dabaray (words) of Yahawah in Yahawah bayath (house).

Now it happened in the chamayashay (fifth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month), that all the im (nation / people) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and all the im (nation / people) who bawaa (come) from the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), qaraa (called) a tzawam (fast) panayam (face) Yahawah.

Then qaraa (called) Barawak (Baruch) in the sapar (book / scribed document) the dabaray (words) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in the bayath (house) of Yahawah, in the room of Gamarayah (Gemariah) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), the sapar (book), in the ilayawan (Ilayawan) chatzar (court), at the entry of the chadash (new) shair (gate) of Yahawah bayath (house), in the azanay (ears) of all the im (nation / people).

When Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) the ban (son) of Gamarayah (Gemariah), the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), had shamai (hearken / hear) out of the sapar (book / scribed document) all the dabaray (words) of Yahawah,

He yarad (went) down into the malak (king) bayath (house), into the sapar (book) room: and behold, all the sharayam (princes) were sitting there, Alayashamai (Elishama) the sapar (book), and Dalayah (Delaiah) the ban (son) of Shamaiyah (Shemaiah), and Alanathan (Elnathan) the ban (son) of Ikabawar (Achbor), and Gamarayah (Gemariah) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), and Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Chananayah (Hananiah), and all the sharayam (princes).

Then Mayakayahaw (Micaiah) nagad (declared) to them all the dabarayam (words) that he had shamai (hearken / hear), when Barawak (Baruch) qaraa (called) the sapar (book / scribed document) in the azanay (ears) of the im (nation / people).

Therefore all the sharayam (princes) shalach (send) Yahawaday (Jehudi) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), the ban (son) of Kawashay (Cushi), to Barawak (Baruch), amar (spoke), laqach (take / seize) in your yad (hand) the scroll in which you have qaraa (called) in the azanay (ears) of the im (nation / people), and yalak (come). So Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah) laqach (take / seize) the scroll in his yad (hand), and bawaa (come) to them.
They amar (spoke) to him, yashab (inhabit/dwell) down now, and qaraa (called) it in our azan (ear). So Barawak (Baruch) qaraa (called) it in their azan (ear).

Now it happened, when they had shamai (hearken / hear) all the dabarayam (words), they turned in pachad (fear / dread) ayash (man / husband) al (toward) rai (neigbor/another person), and amar (spoke) to Barawak (Baruch), We will nagad (surely) nagad (tell) the malak (king) of all these dabarayam (words).
They shaal (asked) Barawak (Baruch), amar (spoke), nagad (tell) us now, How did you kathab (write) all these dabarayam (words) at his pah (mouth)?
Then Barawak (Baruch) amar (spoke) them, He qaraa (called) all these dabarayam (words) to me with his pah (mouth), and I kathab (write) them with dayaw (ink) in the sapar (book / scribed document).
Then the sharayam (princes) amar (spoke) to Barawak (Baruch), yalak (go), sathar (hide), you and Yaramayah (Jeremiah); and let no ayash (man / husband) yadai (know) ayapah (where) you are.

They bawaa (come) in to the malak (king) into the chatzar (court); but they paqad (visit) laid up the scroll in the room of Alayashamai (Elishama) the sapar (book); and they nagad (told) all the dabarayam (words) in the azanay (ears) of the malak (king).

So the malak (king) shalach (send) Yahawaday (Jehudi) to laqach (take / seize) the scroll; and he laqach (take / seize) it out of the room of Alayashamai (Elishama) the sapar (book). Yahawaday (Jehudi) qaraa (called) it in the azanay (ears) of the malak (king), and in the azanay (ears) of all the sharayam (princes) who imad (stood) il (over) the malak (king).
Now the malak (king) was sitting in the winter bayath (house) in the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month): and there was a ach (brother/kinsman) in the brazier bair (burning) panayam (face) him.

It happened, when Yahawaday (Jehudi) had qaraa (called) shalawash (three) or arabai (four) leaves, that the king qarai (cut) it with the thair (razor), and shalak (cast) it into the ash (fire) that was in the brazier, until all the scroll was thamam (consumed) in the ash (fire) that was in the brazier.
They were not pachad (fear / dread), nor qarai (tore) their bagad (garments), neither the malak (king), nor any of his ibad (servant) who shamai (hearken / hear) all these dabarayam (words).

Moreover Alanathan (Elnathan) and Dalayah (Delaiah) and Gamarayah (Gemariah) had pagai (made) intercession to the malak (king) that he would not sharap (burn) the scroll; but he would not shamai (hearken / hear) them.

The malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Yarachamaal (Jerahmeel) the malak (king) ban (son), and Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Izarayaal (Azriel), and Shalamayah (Shelemiah) the ban (son) of Ibadaal (Abdeel), to laqach (take / seize) Barawak (Baruch) the sapar (book) and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy); but Yahawah sathar (hid) them.

Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), achar (other) that the malak (king) had sharap (burned) the scroll, and the dabarayam (words) which Barawak (Baruch) kathab (write) at the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seize) again achar (other) scroll, and kathab (write) in it all the raashawan (former) dabarayam (words) that were in the raashawan (first) scroll, which Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) has sharap (burned).

Concerning Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) you shall amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: You have sharap (burned) this scroll, amar (spoke), Why have you kathab (write) therein, amar (spoke), The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shall bawaa (come) bawaa (come) and shachath (destroy) this aratz (Earth/land), and shall shabath (shabath / rest) to cease from there adam (man) and animal?

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah concerning Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah): He shall have none to yashab (inhabit/dwell) on the kasaa (throne) of Dawad (David); and his nabalah (dead) body shall be shalak (cast) out in the yawam (day) to the charab (heat), and in the layal (night) to the qarach (frost).

I will paqad (visit) him and his zarai (seed) and his ibad (servant) for their iwan (guilt/iniquity); and I will bawaa (come) on them, and on the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and on the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah), all the rai (evil) that I have dabar (word / matter) against them, but they didn't shamai (hearken / hear).

Then laqach (take / seize) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) achar (other) scroll, and nathan (give) it to Barawak (Baruch) the sapar (book), the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), who kathab (write) therein from the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah) all the dabaray (words) of the sapar (book / scribed document) which Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) had sharap (burned) in the ash (fire); and there were yasap (added) besides to them many like dabaray (words).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah) malak (king) as malak (king), instead of Kanayahaw (Coniah) the ban (son) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim), whom Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) made malak (king) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah).

But neither he, nor his ibad (servant), nor the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), shamai (hearken / hear) to the dabaray (words) of Yahawah, which he dabar (word / matter) by the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shalach (send) Yahawakal (Jehucal) the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), and Tzapanayah (Zephaniah) the ban (son) of Maishayah (Maaseiah), the kahan (priest), to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke), palal (pray) now to Yahawah our Alahayam for us.
Now Yaramayah (Jeremiah) bawaa (come) in and yatzaa (go out / come out) out thawak (midst) the im (nation / people); for they nathan (give) not put him into bayath (house).

Paraih (Pharaoh's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) yatzaa (go out / come out) come forth out of Matzarayam (Egypt); and when the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who were tzawar (besieging) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shamai (hearken / hear) news of them, they broke up from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),

Thus thaamaraw (says) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), You shall amar (spoke) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), who shalach (send) you to me to darash (inquire) of me: Behold, Paraih (Pharaoh's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), which yatzaa (go out / come out) come forth to izarah (help) you, shall shawab (turn back / repent) to Matzarayam (Egypt) into their own aratz (Earth/land).
The Kashaday (Chaldeans) shall shawab (turn back / repent) again, and lacham (fight) against this iyar (city); and they shall lakad (take) it, and sharap (burn) it with ash (fire).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Don't nashaa (lift) yourselves, amar (spoke), The Kashaday (Chaldeans) shall halak (move) depart from us; for they shall not depart.

For though you had nakah (struck) the whole chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who lacham (fight) against you, and there shaar (remained) but wounded chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) among them, yes would they qawam (rise up) up every ayash (man / husband) in his ahal (tent), and sharap (burn) this iyar (city) with ash (fire).

It happened that, when the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) was ilah (go up / offer) up from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) for panayam (face) of Paraih (Pharaoh's) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor),

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) to yalak (go) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), to receive his portion there, in the thawak (midst) of the im (nation / people).

When he was in the shair (gate) of Banayamayan (Benjamin), a bail (captain) of the guard was there, whose sham (name) was Yaraayayah (Irijah), the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), the ban (son) of Chananayah (Hananiah); and he thapash (laid) hold on Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke), You are napal (fall / be cast down) away to the Kashaday (Chaldeans).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), It is shaqar (false); I am not napal (fall / be cast down) away to the Kashaday (Chaldeans). But he didn't shamai (hearken / hear) to him; so Yaraayayah (Irijah) thapash (laid) hold on Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and brought him to the sharayam (princes).

The sharayam (princes) were qatzap (angry) with Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and nakah (struck) him, and nathan (give) him in asawar (prison) in the bayath (house) of Yahawanathan (Jonathan) the sapar (book); for they ishah (make) made that the kalaa (prison).
When Yaramayah (Jeremiah) bawaa (come) come into the bayath (house) chanawath (house), and into the cells, and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) had yashab (inhabit/dwell) there many yamayam (days);

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shalach (send), and laqach (take / seize) him: and the malak (king) shaal (asked) him secretly in his bayath (house), and amar (spoke), Is there any dabar (word / matter) from Yahawah? Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), There is. He amar (spoke) also, You shall be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

Moreover Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to malak (king) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), Wherein have I chataa (sinned) against you, or against your ibad (servant), or against this im (nation / people), that you nathan (give) put me in bayath (house)?

Ay (where) now are your nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) who nabaa (prophesied) to you, amar (spoke), The malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shall not bawaa (come) against you, nor against this aratz (Earth/land)?

Now please shamai (hearken / hear), my Adawan the malak (king): please let my thachanah (supplication) be napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (face) you, that you not cause me to shawab (turn back / repent) to the bayath (house) of Yahawanathan (Jonathan) the sapar (book), lest I mawath (death) there.

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) tzawah (commanded), and they paqad (visit) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) into the chatzar (court) of the guard; and they nathan (give) him yawam (day) a kakar (loaf) of lacham (bread) out of the bakers' chawatz (street), until all the lacham (bread) in the iyar (city) was thamam (spent). Thus Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the chatzar (court) of the guard.

Shapatayah (Shephatiah) the ban (son) of Mathan (Mattan), and Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Pashachawar (Pashhur), and Yawakal (Jucal) the ban (son) of Shalamayah (Shelemiah), and Pashachawar (Pashhur) the ban (son) of Malakayah (Malchijah), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabarayam (words) that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) dabar (word / matter) to all the im (nation / people), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, He who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this iyar (city) shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter); but he who yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the Kashaday (Chaldeans) shall chayah (live), and his napash (soul) shall be to him for a shalal (prey), and he shall chayah (live).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, This iyar (city) shall nathan (give) be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and he shall lakad (take) it.

Then the sharayam (princes) amar (spoke) to the malak (king), "Please let this ayash (man / husband) be put to mawath (death); because he rapah (weakens) the yaday (hands) of the mawath (death) of malachamah (war) who shaar (remain) in this iyar (city), and the yaday (hands) of all the im (nation / people), in dabar (word / matter) such dabarayam (words) to them: for this ayash (man / husband) doesn't darash (seek) the shalawam (peace / safety) of this im (nation / people), but the rai (hurt)."
Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) amar (spoke), Behold, he is in your yad (hand); for the malak (king) is not he who yakal (can) dabar (word / matter) anything against you.

Then laqach (take / seize) they Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and shalak (cast) him into the bawar (dungeon) of Malakayah (Malchijah) the king's ban (son), that was in the chatzar (court) of the guard: and they shalach (send) down Yaramayah (Jeremiah) with chabalayam (cords). In the bawar (dungeon) there was no mayam (Waters), but tayat (mire); and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) tabai (sank) in the tayat (mire).

Now when Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian), a sarayas (eunuch), who was in the malak (king) bayath (house), shamai (hearken / hear) that they nathan (give) put Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in the bawar (dungeon) (the malak (king) then sitting in the shair (gate) of Banayamayan (Benjamin)),
Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the malak (king) bayath (house), and dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king), amar (spoke),

My Adawan the malak (king), these haraiw (men) have done raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) in all that they ishah (make) done to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), whom they have shalak (cast) into the bawar (dungeon); and he is likely to mawath (death) in the thachath (under) where he is, panayam (face) of the raib (famine); for there is no more lacham (bread) in the iyar (city).

Then the malak (king) tzawah (commanded) Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian), amar (spoke), laqach (take / seize) from here shalawashayam (thirty) zah (this / that / these) with you, and ilah (go up / offer) up Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) out of the bawar (dungeon), before he mawath (death).

So Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) laqach (take / seize) the anashayam (men) with him, and bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of the malak (king) under the awatzar (treasury), and laqach (take / seize) there rags and worn-out garments, and shalach (send) them down by chabalayam (cords) into the bawar (dungeon) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah).

Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), shawam (place / establish / appoint) now these rags and worn-out garments under your armpits under the chabalayam (cords). Yaramayah (Jeremiah) ishah (make) so.

So they mashak (drew) up Yaramayah (Jeremiah) with the chabalayam (cords), and ilah (go up / offer) him up out of the bawar (dungeon): and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the chatzar (court) of the guard.

Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shalach (send), and laqach (take / seize) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) to him into the shalayashay (third) mabawaa (entry) that is in the bayath (house) of Yahawah: and the malak (king) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), I will shaal (ask) you something. Kachad (hide) nothing from me.

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), If I nagad (declare) it to you, will you not mawath (death) put me to mawath (death)? And if I give you yaitz (counsel), you will not shamai (hearken / hear) to me.

So Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) shabai (swear / take oath) secretly to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke), As Yahawah chay (life), who ishah (make) us this napash (soul), I will not put you to mawath (death), neither will I nathan (give) you into the yad (hand) of these ishah (make) who baqash (seek) your napash (soul).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): If you will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) sharay (princes), then your napash (soul) shall chayah (live), and this iyar (city) shall not be sharap (burned) with ash (fire); and you shall chayah (live), and your bayath (house).

But if you will not yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) sharay (princes), then shall this iyar (city) be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), and they shall sharap (burn) it with ash (fire), and you shall not malat (escape) out of their yad (hand).

Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), I am daag (afraid) of the Yahawaday (Jews) who are napal (fall / be cast down) away to the Kashaday (Chaldeans), lest they nathan (give) me into their yad (hand), and they ilal (mock) me.

But Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke), They shall not nathan (give) you. Shamai (hearken / hear), I beg you, the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, in that which I dabar (word / matter) to you: so it shall be yatab (well) with you, and your napash (soul) shall chayah (live).
But if you maan (refuse) to yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, this is the dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah raah (see) shown me:

Behold, all the nashayam (women) who are shaar (left) in the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah's) bayath (house) shall be yatzaa (go out / come out) forth to the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon's) sharay (princes), and those women shall amar (spoke), Your familiar friends have sawath (set) you on, and yakal (have) prevailed over you. Your ragal (feet / foot) are tabai (sunk) in the batz (mire), they have sawag (turned) away achawar (back).

They shall yatzaa (go out / come out) out all your wives and your ban (son) to the Kashaday (Chaldeans); and you shall not malat (escape) out of their yad (hand), but shall be thapash (taken) by the yad (hand) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon): and you shall cause this iyar (city) to be sharap (burned) with ash (fire).
Then Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), Let no ayash (man / husband) yadai (know) of these dabarayam (words), and you shall not mawath (death).

But if the sharayam (princes) shamai (hearken / hear) that I have dabar (word / matter) with you, and they bawaa (come) to you, and amar (spoke) you, nagad (declare) to us now what you have dabar (word / matter) to the malak (king); don't kachad (hide) it from us, and we will not put you to mawath (death); also what the malak (king) dabar (word / matter) to you:

Then you shall amar (spoke) them, I napal (fall / be cast down) my thachanah (supplication) panayam (face) the malak (king), that he would not cause me to shawab (turn back / repent) to Yahawanathan (Jonathan's) bayath (house), to mawath (death) there.

Then bawaa (come) all the sharayam (princes) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and shaal (asked) him; and he nagad (told) them according to all these dabarayam (words) that the malak (king) had tzawah (commanded). So they charash (left) off speaking with him; for the dabar (word / matter) was not shamai (hearken / hear).
So Yaramayah (Jeremiah) stayed in the chatzar (court) of the guard until the yawam (day) that Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) was lakad (taken).

It happened when Jerusalem was taken, (in the thashayaiy (ninth) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), in the ishayaray (tenth) chadash (month), bawaa (come) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) and all his chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and tzawar (besieged) it;

In the ishathay (eleven) shanah (year) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) chadash (month), the thashai (nine) day of the chadash (month), a baqai (breach) was made in the iyar (city)),

That all the sharay (princes) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) bawaa (come) in, and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the thawak (midst) shair (gate), Naragalasharaatzar (Nergal Sharezer), Samagaranabaw (Samgarnebo), Sharasakayam (Sarsechim), rabasarayas (rabsaris), Naragalasharaatzar (Nergal Sharezer), rabamag (rabmag), with all the rest of the sharay (princes) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon).

It happened that, when Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) the malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) and all the anashay (men) of malachamah (war) raah (see) them, then they barach (fled), and yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of the iyar (city) by layal (night), by the darak (way) of the malak (king) gan (garden), through the shair (gate) between the two chamathayam (walls); and he yatzaa (go out / come out) out toward the irabah (arabah).

But the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans) radap (pursued) achar (other) them, and overtook Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) in the irabawath (plains) of Yarayachaw (Jericho): and when they had laqach (take / seize) him, they ilah (go up / offer) him up to Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) to Rabalah (Riblah) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Chamath (Hamath); and he dabar (word / matter) mashapat (judgment) on him.

Then the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shachat (killed) the banay (sons) of Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) in Rabalah (Riblah) before his iyan (eye): also the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) shachat (killed) all the charay (nobles) of Yahawadah (Judah).
Moreover he iwar (put) out Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah's) iyanay (eyes), and asar (bound) him in nachashathayam (fetters), to bawaa (come) him to Babal (Babylon).

The Kashaday (Chaldeans) sharap (burned) the malak (king) bayath (house), and the bayath (house) of the im (nation / people), with ash (fire), and nathatz (broke) down the chamawath (walls) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Then Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) galah (carried) away captive into Babal (Babylon) the yathar (residue) of the im (nation / people) who shaar (remained) in the iyar (city), the deserters also who napal (fall / be cast down) napal (fall / be cast down) to him, and the yathar (residue) of the im (nation / people) who shaar (remained).

But Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) shaar (left) of the dal (poor) of the im (nation / people), who had maawamah (nothing), in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), and nathan (give) them karamayam (vineyards) and yagabayam (fields) at the same yawam (day).

Now Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) tzawah (commanded) Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) concerning Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),
Laqach (take / seize) him, and iyan (eye) well to him, and ishah (make) him no harm; but ishah (make) to him even as he shall dabar (word / matter) you.

So Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) shalach (send), and Nabawashazaban (Nebushazban), rabasarayas (rabsaris), and Naragalasharaatzar (Nergal Sharezer), rabamag (rabmag), and all the chief rabay (officers) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon);

They shalach (send), and laqach (take / seize) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) out of the chatzar (court) of the guard, and nathan (give) him to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), that he should yatzaa (go out / come out) him bayath (house): so he lived thawak (midst) the im (nation / people).
Now the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), while he was itzar (shut) up in the chatzar (court) of the guard, amar (spoke),

Halak (move), and amar (spoke) to Ibadamalak (Ebedmelech) the Kawashay (Ethiopian), amar (spoke), Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Behold, I will bawaa (come) my dabar (word / matter) on this iyar (city) for rai (evil), and not for tawab (good / proper function); and they shall be accomplished panayam (face) you in that yawam (day).

But I will natzal (deliver) you in that yawam (day), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; and you shall not be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the anashayam (men) of whom you are yagawar (afraid).

For I will malat (surely) malat (save) you, and you shall not napal (fall / be cast down) by the charab (sword), but your napash (soul) shall be for a shalal (prey) to you; because you have batach (put) your trust in me, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

The dabar (word / matter) which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) from Yahawah, achar (other) that Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) had shalach (send) him go from Ramah (Ramah), when he had laqach (take / seize) him being asar (bound) in azaqayam (chains) thawak (midst) all the galawath (captives) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and Yahawadah (Judah), who were galah (carried) away captive to Babal (Babylon).
The rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) laqach (take / seize) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), and amar (spoke) to him, Yahawah your Alahayam dabar (word / matter) this rai (evil) on this maqawam (place);

And Yahawah bawaa (come) brought it, and ishah (make) according as he dabar (word / matter): because you have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, and have not shamai (hearken / hear) his qawal (sound / voice), therefore this thing has come on you.

Now, behold, I release you this yawam (day) from the azaqayam (chains) which are on your yad (hand). If it seems tawab (good / proper function) to you to bawaa (come) with me into Babal (Babylon), bawaa (come), and I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) care of you; but if it seems bad to you to bawaa (come) with me into Babal (Babylon), don't: raah (see), all the aratz (Earth/land) is panayam (face) you; where it seems tawab (good / proper function) and yashar (upright) to you to yalak (go), there yalak (go).

Now while he had not yet shawab (turn back / repent) back, shawab (turn back / repent) back then, he said, to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan), whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) paqad (visit) made governor over the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) with him thawak (midst) the im (nation / people); or yalak (go) wherever it seems yashar (upright) to you to yalak (go). So the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) nathan (give) him food and a present, and shalach (send) him go.

Then bawaa (come) Yaramayah (Jeremiah) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) to Matzapah (Mizpah), and lived with him thawak (midst) the im (nation / people) who were shaar (left) in the aratz (Earth/land).

Now when all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces) who were in the shadah (fields), even they and their chayalayam (men), shamai (hearken / hear) that the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) had made Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) governor in the aratz (Earth/land), and paqad (visit) committed to him chayalayam (men), and nashayam (women), and tap (children), and of the poorest of the aratz (Earth/land), of those who were not galah (carried) away captive to Babal (Babylon);

Then they bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) to Matzapah (Mizpah), Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and Yawachanan (Johanan) and Yawanathan (Jonathan) the banay (sons) of Qarach (Kareah), and Sharayah (Seraiah) the ban (son) of Thanachamath (Tanhumeth), and the banay (sons) of Iwapay (Ephai) the Natapathay (Netophathite), and Yazanayah (Jezaniah) the ban (son) of the Maikathay (Maacathite), they and their banay (men).

Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan) shabai (swear / take oath) to them and to their ban (son), amar (spoke), Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) to ibad (servant) the Kashaday (Chaldeans): yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land), and ibad (servant) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and it shall be yatab (well) with you.

As for me, behold, I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) at Matzapah (Mizpah), to imad (stand) before the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who shall bawaa (come) to us: but you, asap (gather) yayan (wine) and qayatz (summer) fruits and shaman (oil), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them in your kalay (vessels), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your iyar (cities) that you have thapash (taken).

Likewise when all the Yahawaday (Jews) who were in Mawaab (Moab), and among the children of Imawan (Ammon), and in Adawam (Edom), and who were in all the aratzawath (countries), shamai (hearken / hear) that the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nathan (give) left a shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), and that he paqad (visit) set over them Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan);

Then all the Yahawaday (Jews) shawab (turn back / repent) out of all maqamawath (places) where they were nadach (driven), and bawaa (come) to the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), to Gadalayah (Gedaliah), to Matzapah (Mizpah), and asap (gathered) yayan (wine) and qayatz (summer) fruits very much.

Moreover Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces) who were in the shadah (fields), bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) to Matzapah (Mizpah),

And amar (spoke) to him, Do you yadai (know) that Bailayas (Baalis) the malak (king) of the banay (children) of Ammon has shalach (send) Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) to take your life? But Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) didn't aman (believe / have faith) them.

Then Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah) amar (spoke) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) in Matzapah (Mizpah) secretly, amar (spoke), Please yalak (let) me go, and I will nakah (kill) Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and no ayash (man / husband) shall yadai (know) it: why should he take your life, that all the Jews who are qabatz (gathered) to you should be pawatz (scattered), and the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah) abad (destroy / perish)?

But Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) amar (spoke) to Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), You shall not ishah (make) this thing; for you dabar (word / matter) falsely of Yashamaial (Ishmael).

Now it happened in the shabayaiy (seventh) chadash (month), that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), the ban (son) of Alayashamai (Elishama), of the zarai (seed) malawakah (royal) and one of the chief rabay (officers) of the malak (king), and ishar (ten) ban (son) with him, bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) to Matzapah (Mizpah); and there they akal (eat) lacham (bread) yachad (together) in Mizpah.

Then qawam (rise up) Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and the ishar (ten) ban (son) who were with him, and nakah (struck) Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam) the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan) with the charab (sword), and mawath (death) him, whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) paqad (visit) made governor over the aratz (Earth/land).

Yashamaial (Ishmael) also nakah (killed) all the Yahawaday (Jews) who were with him, with Gadalayah (Gedaliah), at Matzapah (Mizpah), and the Kashaday (Chaldeans) who were matzaa (found) there, the anashay (men) of malachamah (war).
It happened the shanay (second) yawam (day) after he had mawath (death) Gadalayah (Gedaliah), and no ayash (man / husband) yadai (knew) it,

That there bawaa (come) anashayam (men) from Shakam (Shechem), from Shayalah (Shiloh), and from Shamarawan (Samaria), even shamanayam (eighty) anashayam (men), having their zaqan (beards) galach (shaved) and their clothes qarai (torn), and having gadad (cut) themselves, with meal manachah (offerings) and labawanah (frankincense) in their yad (hand), to bawaa (come) them to the bayath (house) of Yahawah.

Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from Matzapah (Mizpah) to qaraah (meet) them, bakah (weeping) all halak (move) as he halak (move): and it happened, as he pagash (met) them, he amar (spoke) to them, bawaa (come) to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam).

It was so, when they bawaa (come) into the thawak (midst) of the iyar (city), that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) shachat (killed) them, and cast them into the thawak (midst) of the bawar (pit), he, and the ban (son) who were with him.

But ishar (ten) anashayam (men) were matzaa (found) among those who amar (spoke) to Yashamaial (Ishmael), Don't mawath (death) us; for we yash (have) stores hidden in the shadah (field), of chatah (wheat), and of shairah (barley), and of shaman (oil), and of dabash (honey). So he stopped, and didn't mawath (death) them thawak (midst) their ach (brother/kinsman).

Now the bawar (pit) in which Yashamaial (Ishmael) shalak (cast) all the pagar (dead) bodies of the anashayam (men) whom he had nakah (killed), by the yad (hand) of Gadalayah (Gedaliah) (the same was who which Asaa (Asa) the malak (king) ishah (make) made for panayam (face) of Baishaa (Baasha) malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel)), Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) malaa (filled) it with those who were chalal (killed).

Then Yashamaial (Ishmael) shabah (carried) away captive all the shaarayath (residue) of the im (nation / people) who were in Matzapah (Mizpah), even the malak (king) banawath (daughters), and all the im (nation / people) who shaar (remained) in Matzapah (Mizpah), whom Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) paqad (visit) committed to Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam); Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) shabah (carried) them away captive, and departed to ibar (pass over/through) over to the banay (children) of Ammon.

But when Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces) who were with him, shamai (hearken / hear) of all the rai (evil) that Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) ishah (make) done,

Then they laqach (take / seize) all the anashayam (men), and yalak (went) to lacham (fight) with Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), and matzaa (found) him by the rab (great) mayam (Waters) that are in Gabaiwan (Gibeon).

Now it happened that, when all the im (nation / people) who were with Yashamaial (Ishmael) raah (see) Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces) who were with him, then they were shamach (glad).

So all the im (nation / people) who Yashamaial (Ishmael) had shabah (carried) away captive from Matzapah (Mizpah) shawab (turn back / repent) sabab (about) and yalak (came) back, and went to Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah).
But Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) malat (escaped) from Yawachanan (Johanan) with shamanah (eight) banay (men), and yalak (went) to the banay (children) of Ammon.

Then laqach (take / seize) Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces) who were with him, all the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (nation / people) whom he had shawab (turn back / repent) from Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah), from Matzapah (Mizpah), achar (other) that he had nakah (killed) Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of malachamah (war), and the nashayam (women), and the tap (children), and the sarasayam (eunuchs), whom he had shawab (turn back / repent) back from Gabaiwan (Gibeon):
And they departed, and lived in Geruth Kamaham (Chimham), which is by Bayath-Lacham (Bethlehem), to yalak (go) to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt),

Panayam (face) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans); for they were yaraa (fear / be afraid) of them, because Yashamaial (Ishmael) the ban (son) of Nathanayah (Nethaniah) had nakah (killed) Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), whom the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) paqad (visit) governor over the aratz (Earth/land).

Then all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces), and Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and Yazanayah (Jezaniah) the ban (son) of Hawashaiyah (Hoshaiah), and all the im (nation / people) from the qatan (small / young / least) even to the greatest, nagash (came) near,

And amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), Please let our thachanah (supplication) be napal (fall / be cast down) panayam (face) you, and palal (pray) for us to Yahawah your Alahayam, even for all this shaarayath (remnant); for we are shaar (left) but a mait (few) of many, as your iyan (eye) do raah (see) us:
That Yahawah your Alahayam may show us the darak (way) in which we should yalak (walk), and the thing that we should ishah (make).

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) amar (spoke) to them, I have shamai (hearken / hear) you; behold, I will palal (pray) to Yahawah your Alahayam according to your dabar (word / matter); and it shall happen that whatever thing Yahawah shall inah (answer / respond) you, I will nagad (declare) it to you; I will manai (keep) nothing back from you.

Then they amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), Yahawah be a amath (truth) and aman (believe / have faith) id (until / as far as) among us, if we don't ishah (make) according to all the dabar (word / matter) with which Yahawah your Alahayam shall shalach (send) you to us.

Whether it be tawab (good / proper function), or whether it be rai (evil), we will shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam, to whom we shalach (send) you; that it may be yatab (well) with us, when we shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah our Alahayam.
It happened qatz (after) ishar (ten) yamayam (days), that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah).

Then qaraa (called) he Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces) who were with him, and all the im (nation / people) from the qatan (small / young / least) even to the greatest,
And amar (spoke) to them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to whom you shalach (send) me to napal (fall / be cast down) your thachanah (supplication) panayam (face) him:

If you will still live in this aratz (Earth/land), then will I banah (build) you, and not haras (pull) you down, and I will natai (plant) you, and not nathash (pluck) you up; for I grieve over the rai (distress) that I ishah (make) brought on you.

Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), of whom you are yaraa (afraid); don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid) of him, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah: for I am with you to yashai (salvation) you, and to natzal (deliver) you from his yad (hand).
I will nathan (give) you racham (show mercy / love), that he may have racham (show mercy / love) on you, and cause you to shawab (turn back / repent) to your own adamah (land).
But if you amar (spoke), We will not yashab (inhabit/dwell) in this aratz (Earth/land); so that you don't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam,

Amar (spoke), No; but we will bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), where we shall raah (see) no malachamah (war), nor shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn), nor raib (have) hunger of lacham (bread); and there will we yashab (inhabit/dwell):

Now therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, O shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah): Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), If you indeed shawam (place / establish / appoint) your panayam (face) to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt), and bawaa (come) to live there;

Then it shall happen, that the charab (sword), which you yaraa (fear / be afraid), shall nashag (overtake) you there in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the raib (famine), about which you are daag (afraid), shall dabaq (follow) close achar (other) you there in Matzarayam (Egypt); and there you shall mawath (death).

So shall it be with all the anashayam (men) who shawam (place / establish / appoint) their panay (faces) to bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there: they shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter); and none of them shall sharayad (remain) or palayat (escape) from the rai (evil) that I will bawaa (come) on them.

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): As my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) and my chamah (wrath) has been nathak (poured) forth on the yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), so shall my chamah (wrath) be nathak (poured) forth on you, when you shall bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt); and you shall be an object of horror, and an shamah (astonishment), and a qalalah (curse), and a charapah (reproach); and you shall raah (see) this maqawam (place) no more.

Yahawah has dabar (word / matter) concerning you, shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), Don't you bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt): yadai (know) yadai (certainly) that I have iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to you this yawam (day).

For you have dealt deceitfully against your own napash (soul); for you shalach (send) me to Yahawah your Alahayam, amar (spoke), palal (pray) for us to Yahawah our Alahayam; and according to all that Yahawah our Alahayam shall amar (spoke), so nagad (declare) to us, and we will ishah (make) it:

And I have this yawam (day) nagad (declared) it to you; but you have not shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam in anything for which he has shalach (send) me to you.

Now therefore yadai (know) yadai (certainly) that you shall mawath (death) by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter), in the maqawam (place) where you chapatz (desire) to bawaa (come) to live there.

It happened that, when Yaramayah (Jeremiah) kalah (complete / finish) made an end of dabar (word / matter) to all the im (nation / people) all the dabaray (words) of Yahawah their Alahayam, with which Yahawah their Alahayam had shalach (send) him to them, even all these dabaray (words),

Then amar (spoke) Izarayah (Azariah) the ban (son) of Hawashaiyah (Hoshaiah), and Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the zad (proud) ban (son), amar (spoke) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah), You dabar (word / matter) falsely: Yahawah our Alahayam has not shalach (send) you to amar (spoke), You shall not bawaa (come) into Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there;

But Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah) sawath (sets) you on against us, to nathan (give) us into the yad (hand) of the Kashaday (Chaldeans), that they may put us to mawath (death), and galah (carry) us away captive to Babal (Babylon).

So Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces), and all the im (nation / people), didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah).

But Yawachanan (Johanan) the ban (son) of Qarach (Kareah), and all the sharay (captains) of the chayalayam (forces), laqach (take / seize) all the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), who were shawab (turn back / repent) from all the gawayam (nations) where they had been nadach (driven), to live in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah);

The gabarayam (men), and the nashayam (women), and the tap (children), and the malak (king) banawath (daughters), and every napash (soul) who Nabawazaraadan (Nebuzaradan) the rab (captain) of the tabach (guard) had yanach (left) with Gadalayah (Gedaliah) the ban (son) of Achayaqam (Ahikam), the ban (son) of Shapan (Shaphan); and Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), and Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah);

And they bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); for they didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah: and they bawaa (come) to Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes).
Then came the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) in Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes), amar (spoke),

Laqach (take / seize) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) abanayam (stones) in your yad (hand), and taman (hide) them in mortar in the brick malaban (work), which is at the entry of Paraih (Pharaoh's) bayath (house) in Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes), in the iyan (eye) of the gadalawath (men) of Yahawaday (Judah);

And amar (spoke) them, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Behold, I will shalach (send) and laqach (take / seize) Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) the malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), my ibad (servant), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) his kasaa (throne) on these abanayam (stones) that I have taman (hidden); and he shall natah (spread) his shaparawar (royal) pavilion over them.

He shall bawaa (come), and shall nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); such as are for mawath (death) shall be put to mawath (death), and such as are for shabay (captivity) to shabay (captivity), and such as are for the charab (sword) to the charab (sword).

I will yatzath (kindle) a ash (fire) in the bathay (houses) of the Alahayam of Matzarayam (Egypt); and he shall sharap (burn) them, and shabah (carry) them away captive: and he shall itah (array) himself with the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), as a raih (shepherd) itah (puts) on his bagad (garment); and he shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from there in shalawam (peace / safety).

He shall also shabar (break) the matzabawath (pillars) of Bayath-Shamash (Beth Shemesh), that is in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt); and the bathay (houses) of the Alahayam of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall he sharap (burn) with ash (fire).

The dabar (word / matter) that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) concerning all the Yahawaday (Jews) who lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), who lived at Magadawal (Migdol), and at Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes), and at Nap (Memphis), and in the aratz (Earth/land) of Patharawas (Pathros), amar (spoke),

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): You raah (see) seen all the rai (evil) that I bawaa (come) brought on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and on all the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah); and behold, this yawam (day) they are a desolation, and no man yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein,

Panayam (face) of their rai (wickedness) which they ishah (make) committed to provoke me to kais (anger), in that they yalak (went) to qatar (burn) incense, to ibad (servant) other Alahayam, that they didn't yadai (know), neither they, nor you, nor your ab (father).

However I shalach (send) to you all my ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets), shakam (rising) up early and shalach (send) them, amar (spoke), Oh, don't ishah (make) this thawaibah (abominable) thing that I shanaa (hate).
But they didn't shamai (hearken / hear), nor natah (inclined) their azan (ear) to shawab (turn back / repent) from their rai (wickedness), to qatar (burn) no incense to other Alahayam.

Therefore my chamah (wrath) and my ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) was nathak (poured) forth, and was bair (kindled) in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah) and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and they are charabah (wasted) and shamamah (desolate), as it is this yawam (day).

Therefore now thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Why ishah (make) you commit gadawal (very great/important/mighty) rai (evil) against your own napash (soul), to karath (cut) off from yourselves ayash (man / husband) and ayashah (woman / wife), iwalal (infant) and yanaq (nursing) child out of the midst of Yahawadah (Judah), to yathar (leave) yourselves none shaarayath (remaining);

In that you provoke me to kais (anger) with the maishay (works) of your yad (hand), qatar (burning) incense to other Alahayam in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), where you bawaa (come) gone to live; that you may be karath (cut) off, and that you may be a qalalah (curse) and a charapah (reproach) among all the gawayay (nations) of the aratz (Earth/land)?

Have you shakach (forgotten) the rai (wickedness) of your ab (father), and the rai (wickedness) of the malakay (kings) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the rai (wickedness) of their wives, and your own rai (wickedness), and the rai (wickedness) of your wives which they ishah (make) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)?

They are not dakaa (humbled) even to this yawam (day), neither have they yaraa (fear / be afraid), nor halak (move) in my thawarah (instruction), nor in my chaqah (statutes), that I nathan (give) panayam (face) you and panayam (face) your ab (father).

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): Behold, I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) my panayam (face) against you for rai (evil), even to karath (cut) off all Yahawadah (Judah).

I will laqach (take / seize) the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), that have shawam (place / establish / appoint) their panayam (face) to bawaa (come) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there, and they shall thamam (all) be consumed; in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall they napal (fall / be cast down); they shall be thamam (consumed) by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine); they shall mawath (death), from the qatan (small / young / least) even to the greatest, by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine); and they shall be an object of horror, an shamah (astonishment), and a qalalah (curse), and a charapah (reproach).

For I will paqad (visit) those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), as I paqad (visit) punished Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), by the charab (sword), by the raib (famine), and by the dabar (word / matter);

So that none of the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) gone into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there, shall palayat (escape) or be sharayad (left), to shawab (turn back / repent) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), to which they have a napash (soul) to shawab (turn back / repent) to yashab (inhabit/dwell) there: for none shall shawab (turn back / repent) save such as shall palayat (escape).

Then all the anashayam (men) who yadai (knew) that their wives qatar (burned) incense to other Alahayam, and all the nashayam (women) who imad (stood) by, a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qahal (assembly), even all the im (nation / people) who lived in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), in Patharawas (Pathros), inah (answer / respond) Yaramayah (Jeremiah), amar (spoke),
As for the dabar (word / matter) that you have dabar (word / matter) to us in the sham (name) of Yahawah, we will not shamai (hearken / hear) to you.

But we will ishah (make) ishah (make) every dabar (word / matter) that is yatzaa (go out / come out) forth out of our pah (mouth), to qatar (burn) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and to nasak (pour) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to her, as we ishah (make) done, we and our ab (father), our malak (king) and our shar (prince / ruler), in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); for then shabai (had) we plenty of lacham (food), and were tawab (good / proper function), and raah (see) no rai (evil).

But since we chadal (left) off qatar (burning) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and nasak (pouring) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to her, we have chasar (wanted) thamam (all) things, and have been consumed by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine).

When we qatar (burned) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and nasak (poured) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to her, ishah (make) we make her kawanayam (cakes) to itzab (worship) her, and nasak (pour) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to her, balaiday (without) our ayash (man / husband)?

Then Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people), to the gabarayam (men), and to the nashayam (women), even to all the im (nation / people) who had given him an dabar (word / matter), amar (spoke),

The qatar (incense) that you qatar (burned) in the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), and in the chatzawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), you and your ab (father), your malak (king) and your shar (prince / ruler), and the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), didn't Yahawah zakar (remember) them, and didn't it ilah (go up / offer) into his lab (heart)?

So that Yahawah yakal (could) no longer nashaa (lift), panayam (face) of the rai (evil) of your mailal (doings), and panayam (face) of the thawaibath (abominations) which you ishah (make) committed; therefore your aratz (Earth/land) has become a desolation, and an shamah (astonishment), and a qalalah (curse), without yashab (inhabit/dwell), as it is this yawam (day).

Panayam (face) you have qatar (burned) incense, and because you have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, and have not shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, nor halak (move) in his thawarah (instruction), nor in his chaqah (statutes), nor in his idawath (testimonies); therefore this rai (evil) has qaraa (called) to you, as it is this yawam (day).

Moreover Yaramayah (Jeremiah) amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people), and to all the nashayam (women), shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all Yahawadah (Judah) who are in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke), You and your wives have both dabar (word / matter) with your pah (mouths), and with your yad (hand) malaa (have) fulfilled it, amar (spoke), We will ishah (make) ishah (make) our nadar (vow) that we have nadar (make vow), to qatar (burn) incense to the malakath (queen) of the sky, and to nasak (pour) out drink nasakayam (offerings) to her: qawam (rise up) then your nadar (vow), and ishah (make) your nadar (vow).

Therefore shamai (hearken / hear) the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah, all Yahawadah (Judah) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt): Behold, I have shabai (swear / take oath) by my gadawal (very great/important/mighty) sham (name), amar (spoke) Yahawah, that my sham (name) shall no more be qaraa (called) in the pah (mouth) of any ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) in all the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), amar (spoke), As the Adanay Yahawah chay (life).

Behold, I shaqad (watch) over them for rai (evil), and not for tawab (good / proper function); and all the ayash (man / husband) of Yahawadah (Judah) who are in the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall be thamam (consumed) by the charab (sword) and by the raib (famine), until they are all gone.

Those who palayat (escape) the charab (sword) shall shawab (turn back / repent) out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) into the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah), math (few) in masapar (number); and all the shaarayath (remnant) of Yahawadah (Judah), who bawaa (come) gone into the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt) to live there, shall yadai (know) whose dabar (word / matter) shall qawam (rise up), mine, or theirs.

This shall be the awath (sign / mark / miracle) to you, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that I will paqad (visit) you in this maqawam (place), that you may yadai (know) that my dabar (word / matter) shall qawam (rise up) qawam (rise up) against you for rai (evil):

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, Behold, I will nathan (give) Paraihachaparai (Pharaoh Hophra) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) into the yad (hand) of his ayab (enemy), and into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) his napash (soul); as I nathan (give) Tzadaqayah (Zedekiah) malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah) into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), who was his ayab (enemy), and baqash (sought) his napash (soul).

The dabar (word / matter) that Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) dabar (word / matter) to Barawak (Baruch) the ban (son) of Narayah (Neriah), when he kathab (write) these dabarayam (words) in a sapar (book / scribed document) at the pah (mouth) of Yaramayah (Jeremiah), in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke),
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah, the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), to you, Barawak (Baruch):
You amar (spoke), away (woe) is me now! For Yahawah has yasap (added) yagawan (sorrow) to my makaab (pain); I am yagai (weary) with my anachah (groaning), and I matzaa (find) no manawachah (rest).

You shall amar (spoke) him, Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, that which I have banah (build) will I haras (break) down, and that which I have natai (planted) I will nathash (pluck) up; and this in the whole aratz (Earth/land).

Do you baqash (seek) gadawal (very great/important/mighty) things for yourself? Don't baqash (seek) them; for, behold, I will bawaa (come) rai (evil) on all bashar (flesh), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; but your napash (soul) will I nathan (give) to you for a shalal (prey) in all maqamawath (places) where you yalak (go).
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) concerning the gawayam (nations).

Of Matzarayam (Egypt): concerning the chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) of Paraihanakah (Pharaoh Necoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt), which was by the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates) in Karakamayash (Carchemish), which Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) nakah (struck) in the rabayaiy (fourth) shanah (year) of Yahawayaqayam (Jehoiakim) the ban (son) of Yaashayah (Josiah), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).
Irak (prepare) the magan (shield) and tzanah (shield), and nagash (draw) near to malachamah (battle)!

Asar (harness) the sawasayam (horses), and ilah (go up / offer) up, you horsemen, and yatzab (stand) forth with your kawabaiyam (helmets); maraq (furbish) the ramachayam (spears), labash (put) on the coats of mail.

Why raah (see) I seen it? They are chath (dismayed) and are sawag (turned) backward; and their gabawar (mighty) ones are kathath (beaten) down, and have nawas (fled) manawas (apace), and don't panah (turn) back: magawar (terror) is on sabayab (surrounding) side, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

Don't let the qal (swift) nawas (flee) away, nor the gabawar (mighty) man malat (escape); in the tzapawan (north) by the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates) have they kashal (stumble / stagger) and napal (fall / be cast down).
Who is this who ilah (go up / offer) up like the Nile, whose mayam (Waters) gaish (toss) themselves like the naharawath (rivers)?

Matzarayam (Egypt) ilah (go up / offer) up like the Nile, and his mayam (Waters) gaish (toss) themselves like the naharawath (rivers): and he amar (spoke), I will ilah (go up / offer) up, I will kasah (cover) the aratz (Earth/land); I will abad (destroy / perish) iyar (cities) and its yashabay (inhabitants).

Ilah (go up / offer) up, you sawasayam (horses); and halal (praise), you rakab (chariots); and let the gabawar (mighty) men yatzaa (go out / come out) forth: Kawash (Cush) and Pawat (Put), who thapash (handle) the magan (shield); and the Lawaday (Ludim), who thapash (handle) and darak (bend) the qashath (bow).

For that yawam (day) is of the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), a yawam (day) of naqamah (vengeance), that he may naqam (avenge) him of his tzar (oppressor / distressor): and the charab (sword) shall akal (eat) and be shabai (satiate), and shall rawah (drink) its fill of their dam (blood); for the Adanay, Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), has a zabach (sacrifice) in the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land) by the nahar (river) Parath (Euphrates).

Ilah (go up / offer) up into Galaid (Gilead), and laqach (take / seize) tzaray (balm), bathawalah (virgin) banath (daughter) of Matzarayam (Egypt): in shawaa (vanity) do you use many rapaawath (medicines); there is no thailah (healing) for you.

The gawayam (nations) have shamai (hearken / hear) of your qalawan (shame), and the aratz (Earth/land) is full of your tzawachah (cry); for the gabawar (mighty) gabawar (man) has kashal (stumble / stagger) against the gabawar (mighty), they are napal (fall / be cast down) shanayam (two) of them yachad (together).

The dabar (word / matter) that Yahawah dabar (word / matter) to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), how that Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon) should bawaa (come) and nakah (strike) the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt).

Nagad (declare) in Matzarayam (Egypt), and shamai (hearken / hear) in Magadawal (Migdol), and shamai (hearken / hear) in Nap (Memphis) and in Thachapanachas (Tahpanhes): amar (spoke), yatzab (stand) forth, and kawan (prepare); for the charab (sword) has akal (eat) around you.
Why are your abayar (strong) ones sachap (swept) away? They didn't imad (stand), because Yahawah pushed them.

He rabah (made) many to kashal (stumble / stagger), yes, they napal (fall / be cast down) ayash (man / husband) on rai (neigbor/another person): and they amar (spoke), qawam (rise up), and shawab (turn back / repent) us go again to our own im (nation / people), and to the aratz (Earth/land) of our birth, from the yanah (oppressing) charab (sword).
They qaraa (called) there, Paraih (Pharaoh) malak (king) of Matzarayam (Egypt) is but a shaawan (noise); he has let the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) time ibar (pass over/through) by.

As I chay (life), naam (declares prophetically) the malak (king), whose sham (name) is Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), surely like Thabawar (Tabor) among the harayam (mountains), and like Karamal (Carmel) by the yam (sea/waters), so shall he bawaa (come).

You banath (daughter) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Matzarayam (Egypt), ishah (make) yourself to go into captivity; for Nap (Memphis) shall become a shamah (desolation), and shall be burnt up, without yashab (inhabit/dwell).
Matzarayam (Egypt) is a very beautiful igalah (heifer); but qaratz (destruction) out of the tzapawan (north) bawaa (come) come, it has come.

Also her shakayar (hired) men in the qarab (among / near) of her are like calves of the marabaq (stall); for they also are panah (turn) back, they are nawas (fled) away yachad (together), they didn't imad (stand): for the yawam (day) of their ayad (calamity) bawaa (come) come on them, the ith (time) of their paqadah (visitation).

The qawal (sound / voice) of it shall yalak (go) like the nachash (serpent); for they shall yalak (march) with an chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and bawaa (come) against her with axes, as itz (wood) cutters.
They shall karath (cut) down her yair (forest), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, though it can't be chaqar (searched); because they are more than the arabah (locusts), and are innumerable.
The banath (daughter) of Matzarayam (Egypt) shall be disappointed; she shall be nathan (give) into the yad (hand) of the im (nation / people) of the tzapawan (north).

Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), amar (spoke): Behold, I will paqad (visit) Amon of No, and Paraih (Pharaoh), and Matzarayam (Egypt), with her Alahayam, and her malak (king); even Paraih (Pharaoh), and those who batach (trust) in him:

And I will nathan (give) them into the yad (hand) of those who baqash (seek) their lives, and into the yad (hand) of Nabawakadanaatzar (Nebuchadnezzar) malak (king) of Babal (Babylon), and into the yad (hand) of his ibad (servant); and afterwards it shall be shakan (place), as in the yamay (days) of qadam (old), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

But don't you be yaraa (fear / be afraid), Yaiqab (Jacob) my ibad (servant), neither be chathath (dismayed), Yashar-Al (Israel): for, behold, I will yashai (salvation) you from rachawaq (afar), and your zarai (seed) from the aratz (Earth/land) of their shabay (captivity); and Yaiqab (Jacob) shall shawab (turn back / repent), and shall be shaqat (quiet) and at shaan (ease), and none shall make him charad (afraid).

Don't you be yaraa (fear / be afraid), O Yaiqab (Jacob) my ibad (servant), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; for I am with you: for I will ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of all the gawayam (nations) where I have nadach (driven) you; but I will not ishah (make) a kalah (complete / finish) end of you, but I will yasar (correct) you in mashapat (measure), and will in no naqah (clean/innocent) leave you naqah (clean/innocent).

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah that came to Yaramayah (Jeremiah) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) concerning the Palashathay (Philistines), before that Paraih (Pharaoh) nakah (struck) Izah (Gaza).

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: Behold, mayam (Waters) ilah (go up / offer) up out of the tzapawan (north), and shall become an shatap (overflowing) nachal (stream / river), and shall shatap (overflow) the aratz (Earth/land) and malaa (all) that is therein, the iyar (city) and those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein; and the adam (men) shall zaiq (cry), and all the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land) shall wail.

At the qawal (sound / voice) of the shaitah (stamping) of the parasawath (hoofs) of his abayar (strong) ones, at the raish (rushing) of his rakab (chariots), at the hamawan (rumbling) of his galagal (wheels), the abawath (fathers) don't panah (turn) back to their banayam (children) for rapayawan (feebleness) of yadayam (hands);

Because of the yawam (day) that bawaa (come) to shadad (destroy) all the Palashathay (Philistines), to karath (cut) off from Tzar (Tyre) and Tzayadawan (Sidon) every helper who sharayad (remains): for Yahawah will shadad (destroy) the Palashathay (Philistines), the shaarayath (remnant) of the ay (isle) of Kapathar (Caphtor).
Qarachah (baldness) bawaa (come) come on Izah (Gaza); Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) is damah (brought) to nothing, the shaarayath (remnant) of their imaq (valley): how long will you gadad (cut) yourself?
You charab (sword) of Yahawah, how long will it be laa (NOT) you be shaqat (quiet)? Asap (put) up yourself into your thair (razor); ragai (rest), and be still.
How can you be shaqat (quiet), since Yahawah has given you a tzawah (command)? Against Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), and against the seashore, there has he yaid (appointed) it.

Of Mawaab (Moab). Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel): haway (Alas/Woe!) To Nabaw (Nebo)! For it is laid shadad (waste); Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim) is disappointed, it is lakad (taken); mashagab (misgab) is put to yabash (dry land) and broken down.

The thahalah (praise) of Mawaab (Moab) is no more; in Chashabawan (Heshbon) they have chashab (devised) rai (evil) against her: yalak (come), and let us karath (cut) her off from being a gaway (heathen / nation). You also, Madaman (Madmen), shall be brought to silence: the charab (sword) shall yalak (pursue) you.
The qawal (sound / voice) of a qawal (sound / voice) from Charanayam (Horonaim), shad (desolation) and gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shad (destruction)!
Mawaab (Moab) is shabar (destroyed); her tzaiyar (little) ones have caused a zaiq (cry) to be shamai (hearken / hear).

For by the mailah (ascent) of Lawachayath (Luhith) with continual bakay (weeping) shall they ilah (go up / offer) up; for at the descent of Charanayam (Horonaim) they have shamai (hearken / hear) the distress of the tzaiqah (cry) of shabar (destruction).
Nawas (flee), malat (save) your lives, and be like the heath in the madabar (wilderness).

For, because you have batach (trusted) in your maishah (works) and in your awatzar (treasures), you also shall be lakad (taken): and Kamawash (Chemosh) shall yatzaa (go out / come out) forth into gawalah (captivity), his kahan (priest) and his shar (prince / ruler) yachad (together).

The shadad (destroyer) shall bawaa (come) on every iyar (city), and no iyar (city) shall malat (escape); the imaq (valley) also shall abad (destroy / perish), and the mayashawar (plain) shall be destroyed; as Yahawah has amar (spoke).

Nathan (give) tzayatz (wings) to Mawaab (Moab), that she may fly and yatzaa (go out / come out) her away: and her iyar (cities) shall become a shamah (desolation), without any to yashab (inhabit/dwell) therein.
Arar (cursed) is he who ishah (make) the malaakah (work) of Yahawah negligently; and arar (cursed) is he who manai (keeps) back his charab (sword) from dam (blood).

Mawaab (Moab) has been at shaan (ease) from his naiwar (youth), and he shaqat (has) settled on his shamar (keep/guard), and has not been rawaq (emptied) from kalay (vessel) to kalay (vessel), neither has he halak (move) into gawalah (captivity): therefore his taim (taste) imad (remains) in him, and his rayach (smell) is not mawar (changed).

Therefore, behold, the yamayam (days) bawaa (come), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, that I will shalach (send) to him those who pour off, and they shall pour him off; and they shall rawaq (empty) his kalay (vessels), and napatz (break) their nabal (bottles) in pieces.
Mawaab (Moab) shall be bawash (ashamed) of Kamawash (Chemosh), as the bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel) was bawash (ashamed) of Bayath-Al (Bethel) their mabatach (confidence).
How do you amar (spoke), We are gabawar (mighty) chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), and valiant gabawarayam (men) for the malachamah (war)?

Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste), and they are ilah (go up / offer) up into his iyar (cities), and his mabachar (chosen) bachawar (young) men are yarad (gone) down to the tabach (slaughter), naam (declares prophetically) the malak (king), whose sham (name) is Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
The ayad (calamity) of Mawaab (Moab) is qarawab (near) to bawaa (come), and his rai (affliction) hurries maad (fast).

All you who are around him, nawad (bemoan) him, and all you who yadai (know) his sham (name); amar (spoke), How is the iz (strength / might / refuge) matah (staff / rod / tribe) shabar (broken), the thapaarah (beautiful) maqal (rod)!

You banath (daughter) who yashabay (dwells) in Dayabawan (Dibon), yarad (come) down from your kabawad (glory), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in tzamaa (thirst); for the shadad (destroyer) of Mawaab (Moab) has ilah (go up / offer) up against you, he has shachath (destroyed) your strongholds.

Yashab (inhabit/dwell) of Irawair (Aroer), imad (stand) by the darak (way), and tzapah (watchman / keep watch): shaal (ask) him who nawas (flees), and her who malat (escapes); amar (spoke), What hayah (came to pass) been done?
Mawaab (Moab) is disappointed; for it is broken down: wail and zaiq (cry); nagad (tell) it by the Aranawan (Arnon), that Mawaab (Moab) is laid shadad (waste).
Mashapat (judgment) bawaa (come) come on the mayashawar (plain) aratz (Earth/land), on Chalawan (Holon), and on Yahatz (Jahzah), and on Mawapaith (Mephaath),
And on Dayabawan (Dibon), and on Nabaw (Nebo), and on Bayathadabalathayam (Beth Diblathaim),
And on Qarayathayam (Kiriathaim), and on Bayathagamawal (Beth Gamul), and on Bayathabailamaiwan (Beth Meon),
And on Qarayawath (Kerioth), and on Batzarah (Bozrah), and on all the iray (cities) of the aratz (Earth/land) of Mawaab (Moab), rachawaq (far) or qarawab (near).
The qaran (horn) of Mawaab (Moab) is gadai (cut) off, and his zarawai (arm) is shabar (broken), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Shakar (make) him drunken; for he gadal (magnified) himself against Yahawah: and Mawaab (Moab) shall sapaq (wallow) in his qaa (vomit), and he also shall be in shachawaq (laughter/joking matter).
For wasn't Yashar-Al (Israel) a shachawaq (laughter/joking matter) to you? Was he matzaa (found) among thieves? For as often as you dabar (word / matter) of him, you nawad (shake) your head.

You yashabay (inhabitants) of Mawaab (Moab), izab (leave) the irayam (cities), and yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the salai (rock); and be like the yawanah (dove) that qanan (makes) her nest over the pah (mouth) of the abyss.
