They kashal (stumble / stagger) on their gawayah (corpse),

Because of the rab (multitude) of the prostitution of the alluring prostitute, the bailah (mistress) of kashap (witchcraft), who makar (sells) gawayam (nations) through her prostitution, and mashapachawath (families) through her kashap (witchcraft).

"Behold, I am against you," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "and I will lift your shawal (skirts) over your panayam (face). I will show the gawayam (nations) your mair (nakedness), and the mamalakawath (kingdoms) your qalawan (shame).
I will shalak (throw) shaqawatz (abominable) filth on you, and nabal (make) you vile, and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) you a spectacle.

It will happen that all those who raah (see) at you will nadad (flee) from you, and amar (spoke), ‘Nayanawah (Nineveh) is laid shadad (waste)! Who will nawad (mourn) for her?' Ayan (NO ONE) will I baqash (seek) comforters for you?"

Are you yatab (better) than No - Amon, who was situated among the yaarayam (rivers), who had the mayam (Waters) around her; whose chayal (rampart) was the yam (sea/waters), and her chawamah (wall) was of the yam (sea/waters)?
Kawash (Cush) and Matzarayam (Egypt) were her boundless itzamah (strength). Pawat (Put) and Libya were her helpers.

Yet was she carried away. She halak (move) into shabay (captivity). Her young iwalal (children) also were ratash (dashed) in pieces at the raash (head) of all the chawatzawath (streets), and they yadad (cast) gawaral (lots) for her honorable men, and all her gadawal (very great/important/mighty) men were rathaq (bound) in zaqayam (chains).
You also will be shakar (drunken). You will be ilam (hidden). You also will baqash (seek) a stronghold because of the ayab (enemy).
All your fortresses will be like thaan (fig) trees with the first-ripe figs: if they are nawai (shaken), they napal (fall / be cast down) into the pah (mouth) of the eater.

Behold, your troops in your qarab (among / near) are nashayam (women). The shairay (gates) of your aratz (Earth/land) are pathach (set) wide pathach (open) to your ayab (enemy). The ash (fire) has akal (eat) your barayach (bars).
Shaab (draw) mayam (Waters) for the matzawar (siege). Chazaq (strengthen) your fortresses. Bawaa (come) into the tayat (clay), and ramas (tread) the mortar. Make the brick kiln chazaq (strong).
There the ash (fire) will akal (eat) you. The charab (sword) will karath (cut) you off. It will akal (eat) you like the grasshopper. Multiply like grasshoppers. Multiply like the arabah (locust).
You rabah (have) increased your rakal (merchants) more than the kawakabay (stars) of the skies. The grasshopper pashat (strips), and iwap (flying) away.

Your guards are like the arabah (locusts), and your officials like the swarms of locusts, which settle on the gadarawath (walls) on a qarah (cold) yawam (day), but when the shamash (sun) appears, they nadad (flee) away, and their maqawam (place) is not yadai (known) ay (where) they are.

Your raih (shepherds) nawam (slumber), malak (king) of Ashawar (Assyria). Your adayar (nobles) lie down. Your im (nation / people) are pawash (scattered) on the harayam (mountains), and there is no one to qabatz (gather) them.

There is no kahah (healing) your wound, for your injury is fatal. All who shamai (hearken / hear) the shamai (report) of you thaqai (blow / sound alarm) their kap (hands) over you; for who hasn't felt your endless cruelty?
The oracle which Chabaqawaq (Habakkuk) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) chazah (saw).
Yahawah, how long will I shawai (cry), and you will not shamai (hearken / hear)? I zaiq (cry) out to you "chamas (violence)!" And will you not yashai (salvation)?
Why do you show me awan (iniquity), and nabat (look) at perversity? For shad (destruction) and chamas (violence) are before me. There is rayab (strife), and madawan (contention) nashaa (lift) up.

Therefore the thawarah (instruction) is paralyzed, and mashapat (justice) never yatzaa (go out / come out) forth; for the rashai (wicked) surround the tzadayaq (righteous); therefore mashapat (justice) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth perverted.

"Raah (see) among the gawayam (nations), watch, and thamah (wonder) thamah (marvelously); for I am pail (working) a pail (work) in your yawam (day), which you will not aman (believe / have faith) though it is sapar (book) you.

For, behold, I qawam (rise up) up the Kashaday (Chaldeans), that mar (bitter) and mahar (hasty) gaway (heathen / nation), that halak (move) through the marachab (breadth) of the aratz (Earth/land), to yarash (possess) mashakan (dwelling) places that are not theirs.
They are feared and yaraa (fear / be afraid). Their mashapat (judgment) and their shaath (dignity) yatzaa (go out / come out) from themselves.

Their sawas (horses) also are qalal (swifter) than namarayam (leopards), and are more chadad (fierce) than the irab (evening) wolves. Their horsemen press proudly on. Yes, their horsemen bawaa (come) from rachawaq (afar). They iwap (flying) as an nashar (eagle) that hurries to akal (eat).
All of them bawaa (come) for chamas (violence). Their hordes panayam (face) the desert. He asap (gathers) shabay (prisoners) like chawal (sand).
Yes, he qalas (scoffs) at malakayam (kings), and razanayam (princes) are a derision to him. He shachaq (laughs) at every stronghold, for he builds up an earthen ramp, and lakad (takes) it.
Then he sweeps by like the rawach (spirit / wind), and ibar (pass over/through) on. He is indeed asham (guilty), whose kach (strength / mighty / power) is his Alawah."

Aren't you from qadam (everlasting), Yahawah my Alahayam, my qadawash (holy) One? We will not mawath (death). Yahawah, you have shawam (place / establish / appoint) him for mashapat (judgment). You, tzawar (rock), have yasad (established) him to punish.

You who have purer iyanayam (eyes) than to raah (see) rai (evil), and who cannot nabat (look) on perversity, why do you tolerate those who bagad (deal) treacherously, and charash (keep) silent when the rashai (wicked) balai (swallows) up the man who is more tzadayaq (righteous) than he,
And ishah (make) adam (men) like the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), like the ramash (creeping) things, that mashal (rule/have dominion) no ruler over them?
He ilah (go up / offer) up all of them with the chakah (hook). He catches them in his charam (net), and asap (gathers) them in his dragnet. Therefore he shamach (rejoices) and is gayal (glad).
Therefore he zabach (sacrifices) to his charam (net), and qatar (burns) incense to his dragnet, because by them his chalaq (life) is luxurious, and his food is barayaa (good).
Will he therefore continually rawaq (empty) his charam (net), and harag (kill) the gawayam (nations) without chamal (mercy)?

I will imad (stand) at my mashamarath (duty / watch), and yatzab (set) myself on the ramparts, and will raah (see) out to raah (see) what he will dabar (word / matter) to me, and what I will shawab (turn back / repent) concerning my complaint.
Yahawah inah (answer / respond) me, "kathab (write) the chazawan (vision), and make it baar (plain) on tablets, that he who rawatz (runs) may qaraa (called) it.

For the chazawan (vision) is yet for the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) time, and it hurries toward the qatz (end), and won't prove false. Though it takes time, wait for it; because it will bawaa (come) bawaa (come). It won't achar (other).
Behold, his napash (soul) is puffed up. It is not yashar (upright) in him, but the tzadayaq (righteous) will chayah (live) by his amawanah (faith).

Yes, moreover, yayan (wine) is bagad (treacherous). A yahayar (haughty) gabar (man) who doesn't stay at nawah (habitation), who enlarges his napash (soul) as shaawal (Sheol / afterlife), and he is like mawath (death), and can't be shabai (satisfied), but asap (gathers) to himself all gawayam (nations), and qabatz (heaps) to himself all imayam (peoples).

Won't all these nashaa (lift) up a mashal (parable) against him, and a malayatzah (taunting) chayadah (proverb) amar (spoke) him, and say, ‘haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who rabah (increases) that which is not his, and who enriches himself by extortion! How long?'
Won't your debtors qawam (rise up) up pathai (suddenly), and wake up those who make you zawai (tremble), and you will be their victim?

Because you have plundered many gawayam (nations), all the yathar (remnant) of the imayam (peoples) will plunder you, because of adam (men's) dam (blood), and for the chamas (violence) done to the aratz (Earth/land), to the qarayah (city / town) and to all who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in it.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who batzai (gets) an rai (evil) batzai (gain) for his bayath (house), that he may shawam (place / establish / appoint) his qan (nest) on marawam (high), that he may be natzal (delivered) from the kap (hand) of rai (evil)!
You have yaitz (devised) bashath (shame) to your bayath (house), by qatzah (end / extremity / border) off many imayam (peoples), and have chataa (sinned) against your napash (soul).
For the aban (stone) will zaiq (cry) out of the qayar (wall), and the beam out of the woodwork will inah (answer / respond) it.
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who banah (build) a iyar (town) with dam (blood), and establishes a qarayah (city / town) by iwal (iniquity)!
Behold, isn't it of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) that the imayam (peoples) yagai (labor) for the ash (fire), and the laamayam (nations) yaip (weary) themselves for rayaq (vanity)?
For the aratz (Earth/land) will be malaa (filled) with the yadai (knowledge) of the kabawad (glory) of Yahawah, as the mayam (Waters) kasah (cover) the yam (sea/waters).
"Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who gives his neighbor shaqah (drink), pouring your inflaming chamath (wine) until they are shakar (drunk), so that you may gaze at their naked bodies!

You are shabai (filled) with qalawan (shame), and not kabawad (glory). You will also shathah (drinks), and be exposed! The kawas (cup) of Yahawah right yamayan (right hand) will sabab (come) around to you, and disgrace will cover your kabawad (glory).

For the chamas (violence) done to Labanawan (Lebanon) will kasah (overwhelm) you, and the shad (destruction) of the animals, which made them chathath (afraid); because of adam (men's) dam (blood), and for the chamas (violence) done to the aratz (Earth/land), to every qarayah (city / town) and to those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in them.

"What value does the engraved pasal (image) have, that its yatzar (maker) has engraved it; the masakah (molten) image, even the teacher of shaqar (lies), that he who yatzar (fashions) its form batach (trusts) in it, to ishah (make) mute alayalayam (idols)?

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To him who amar (spoke) to the itz (wood), ‘qawatz (awake)!' Or to the mute aban (stone), ‘Arise!' Shall this yarah (teach)? Behold, it is overlaid with zahab (gold) and kasap (silver), and there is no rawach (spirit / wind) at all in its qarab (among / near).
But Yahawah is in his qadash (set apart / make holy) hayakal (temple). Let all the aratz (Earth/land) be hasah (silent) panayam (face) him!"
A thapalah (prayer) of Chabaqawaq (Habakkuk), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), Shagayawan (set) to victorious music.

Yahawah, I have shamai (hearken / hear) of your shamai (fame). I stand in awe of your pail (deeds), Yahawah. Renew your pail (work) in the qarab (among / near) of the shanayam (years). In the qarab (among / near) of the shanayam (years) yadai (make) it known. In ragaz (wrath), you zakar (remember) racham (show mercy / love).

Alawah bawaa (come) from Thayaman (Teman), the qadawash (holy) One from har (mountain) Paaran (Paran). Salah (selah). His glory kasah (covered) the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and his thahalah (praise) malaa (filled) the aratz (Earth/land).
His splendor is like the sunrise. Rays shine from his yad (hand), where his iz (strength / might / refuge) is hidden.
Dabar (word / matter) yalak (went) panayam (face) him, and pestilence followed his ragal (feet / foot).

He imad (stood), and shook the aratz (Earth/land). He raah (see), and made the gawayam (nations) tremble. The ancient hararay (mountains) were crumbled. The age-old gabaiwath (hills) collapsed. His halayakawath (ways) are iwalam (forever).
I raah (see) the ahalay (tents) of Kawashan (Cushan) in awan (affliction). The dwellings of the aratz (Earth/land) of Madayan (Midian) ragaz (trembled).

Was Yahawah charah (hot with anger) with the naharayam (rivers)? Was your ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) against the naharayam (rivers), or your ibarah (wrath) against the yam (sea/waters), that you rakab (rode) on your sawas (horses), on your marakabah (chariots) of yashawaih (salvation)?
You uncovered your qashath (bow). You called for your shabawaih (sworn) arrows. Salah (selah). You split the aratz (Earth/land) with naharawath (rivers).

The harayam (mountains) raah (see) you, and were afraid. The zaram (storm) of mayam (Waters) ibar (pass over/through) by. The thahawam (depths) roared and nashaa (lift) up its yad (hand) on rawam (will lift up).

The shamash (sun) and yarach (moon) imad (stood) still in the sky, at the awar (light) of your chatz (arrows) as they halak (move), at the nagah (shining) of your baraq (glittering) chanayath (spear).
You tzaid (marched) through the aratz (Earth/land) in zaim (wrath). You dawash (threshed) the gawayam (nations) in ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).

You yatzaa (go out / come out) forth for the yashai (salvation) of your im (nation / people), for the yashai (salvation) of your mashayach (anointed one). You crushed the raash (head) of the bayath (house) of rashai (wickedness). You stripped them tzawaar (head) to yasawad (foot). Salah (selah).
You naqab (pierced) the raash (head) of his warriors with their own spears. They sair (came) as a whirlwind to pawatz (scatter) me, gloating as if to akal (eat) the wretched in masathar (secret).
You trampled the yam (sea/waters) with your sawas (horses), churning rab (mighty) mayam (Waters).

I shamai (hearken / hear), and my batan (body) ragaz (trembled). My shapah (lips) tzalal (quivered) at the qawal (sound / voice). Raqab (rottenness) bawaa (come) into my itzam (bones), and I ragaz (tremble) in my place, because I must wait quietly for the yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble), for the ilah (go up / offer) up of the im (nation / people) who gawad (invade) us.

For though the thaan (fig) tree doesn't parach (flourish), nor yabawal (fruit) be in the gapanayam (vines); the maishah (labor) of the zayath (olive) kachash (fails), the shadamawath (fields) ishah (make) no akal (food); the tzaan (flocks) are gazar (cut) off from the makalaah (fold), and there is no baqar (morning) in the rapathayam (stalls):
Yet I will ilaz (rejoice) in Yahawah. I will be gayal (joyful) in the Alahayam of my yashai (salvation)!

Yahawah, the Adanay, is my chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor). He shawam (place / establish / appoint) my ragal (feet / foot) like deer's feet, and enables me to darak (go) in bamah (high) places. For the music director, on my nagayanah (stringed) instruments.

The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah which came to Tzapanayah (Zephaniah), the ban (son) of Kawashay (Cushi), the ban (son) of Gadalayah (Gedaliah), the ban (son) of Amarayah (Amariah), the ban (son) of Chazaqayah (Hezekiah), in the yamay (days) of Yaashayah (Josiah), the ban (son) of Amawan (Amon), malak (king) of Yahawadah (Judah).
I will asap (utterly) sweep away everything off of the surface of the panayam (face), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

I will sweep away adam (man) and animal. I will sweep away the iwap (flying) of the sky, the dag (fish) of the yam (sea/waters), and the heaps of rubble with the rashai (wicked). I will karath (cut) off adam (man) from the surface of the adamah (earth), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

I will natah (stretch) out my yad (hand) against Yahawadah (Judah), and against all the yawashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). I will karath (cut) off the shaar (remnant) of Bail (Baal) from this maqawam (place): the sham (name) of the idolatrous and pagan kahanayam (priests),
Those who shachah (worship) the tzabaa (troop) of the sky on the housetops, those who shachah (worship) and shabai (swear / take oath) by Yahawah and also shabai (swear / take oath) by Malcam,
Those who have sawag (turned) back from following Yahawah, and those who haven't baqash (sought) Yahawah nor darash (inquired) after him.

Be hasah (silent) at the panayam (face) of the Adanay Yahawah, for the yawam (day) of Yahawah is at qarawab (hand). For Yahawah has kawan (prepared) a zabach (sacrifice). He has qadash (set apart / make holy) his qaraa (called).

It will happen in the yawam (day) of Yahawah zabach (sacrifice), that I will paqad (visit) the sharayam (princes), the malak (king) banay (sons), and all those who are labash (clothed) with foreign clothing.

In that yawam (day), I will paqad (visit) all those who dalag (leap) over the mapathan (threshold), who malaa (fill) their adawan (master / lord) bayath (house) with chamas (violence) and maramah (deceit).

In that yawam (day), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, there will be the qawal (sound / voice) of a tzaiqah (cry) from the dag (fish) shair (gate), a wailing from the mashanah (second) quarter, and a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) shabar (crashing) from the gabaiwath (hills).
Wail, you yashabay (inhabitants) of makathash (maktesh), for all the im (nation / people) of Kanain (Canaan) are damah (undone)! All those who were loaded with kasap (silver) are karath (cut) off.

It will happen at that ith (time), that I will chapash (search) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with narawath (lamps), and I will paqad (visit) the anashayam (men) who are qapaa (settled) on their shamar (keep/guard), who amar (spoke) in their labab (heart), "Yahawah will not do yatab (good), neither will he do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil)."

Their wealth will become a mashasah (spoil), and their bathayam (houses) a shamamah (desolation). Yes, they will banah (build) bathayam (houses), but won't yashab (inhabit/dwell) them. They will natai (plant) karamayam (vineyards), but won't shathah (drinks) their yayan (wine).

The gadawal (very great/important/mighty) yawam (day) of Yahawah is qarawab (near). It is qarawab (near), and hurries maad (greatly), the qawal (sound / voice) of the yawam (day) of Yahawah. The gabawar (mighty) man tzarach (cries) there bitterly.

That yawam (day) is a yawam (day) of ibarah (wrath), a yawam (day) of matzawaqah (distress) and tzarah (anguish), a yawam (day) of tzarah (trouble) and ruin, a yawam (day) of chashak (darkness) and gloom, a yawam (day) of inan (cloud) and blackness,
A yawam (day) of the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn) and tharawaih (alarm), against the batzar (fortified) irayam (cities), and against the gabah (high) battlements.

I will tzarar (bring) distress on adam (men), that they will halak (move) like iwar (blind) men, because they have chataa (sinned) against Yahawah, and their dam (blood) will be shapak (poured) out like ipar (dust), and their lachawam (flesh) like galal (dung).

Neither their kasap (silver) nor their zahab (gold) will be yakal (able) to natzal (deliver) them in the yawam (day) of Yahawah ibarah (wrath), but the whole aratz (Earth/land) will be akal (eat) by the ash (fire) of his qanaah (jealousy); for he will ishah (make) an end, yes, a terrible kalah (complete / finish), of all those who yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the aratz (Earth/land).
Qashash (gather) yourselves together, yes, qashash (gather) together, you gaway (heathen / nation) that has no shame,

Before the chaq (statute) yalad (birth / begot) when the yawam (day) passes as the matz (chaff), laa (NOT) the charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) of Yahawah bawaa (come) on you, before the yawam (day) of Yahawah ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) bawaa (come) on you.

Baqash (seek) Yahawah, all you inaw (humble) of the aratz (Earth/land), who have kept his mashapat (ordinances). Baqash (seek) tzadaq (righteous / just / fair). Baqash (seek) inawah (humility). It awalay (perhaps) be that you will be sathar (hidden) in the yawam (day) of Yahawah ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting).
For Izah (Gaza) will be forsaken, and Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) a shamamah (desolation). They will garash (drive) out Ashadawad (Ashdod) at noonday, and Iqarawan (Ekron) will be iqar (rooted) up.

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the yashabay (inhabitants) of the yam (sea/waters) chabal (coast), the gaway (heathen / nation) of the Karathay (Cherethites)! The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah is against you, Kanain (Canaan), the aratz (Earth/land) of the Palashathay (Philistines). I will abad (destroy / perish) you, that there will be no yashab (inhabit/dwell).
The yam (sea/waters) chabal (coast) will be pastures, with karath (cottages) for raiyam (shepherds) and folds for tzaan (flocks).

The chabal (coast) will be for the shaarayath (remnant) of the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah). They will find pasture. In the bathay (houses) of Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon), they will rabatz (lie) down in the irab (evening), for Yahawah, their Alahayam, will paqad (visit) them, and shawab (turn back / repent) them.

I have shamai (hearken / hear) the charapah (reproach) of Mawaab (Moab), and the insults of the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon), with which they have charap (reproached) my im (nation / people), and gadal (magnified) themselves against their gabawal (border/boundary).

Therefore as I chay (life), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), the Alahayam of Yashar-Al (Israel), surely Mawaab (Moab) will be as Sadam (Sodom), and the banay (children) of Imawan (Ammon) as Imarah (Gomorrah), a mamashaq (possession) of charawal (nettles), and salt makarah (pits), and a perpetual shamamah (desolation). The shaarayath (remnant) of my im (nation / people) will plunder them, and the survivors of my gaway (heathen / nation) will nachal (inherit) them.
This they will have for their gaawan (pride), because they have charap (reproached) and gadal (magnified) themselves against the im (nation / people) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

Yahawah will be awesome to them, for he will razah (famish) all the Alahayam of the aratz (Earth/land). Men will shachah (worship) him, everyone from his maqawam (place), even all the shores of the gawayam (nations).
You Cushites also, you will be chalal (killed) by my charab (sword).

He will natah (stretch) out his yad (hand) against the tzapawan (north), abad (destroy / perish) Ashawar (Assyria), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Nayanawah (Nineveh) a shamamah (desolation), as tzayah (dry) as the madabar (wilderness).

Idarayam (herds) will rabatz (lie) down in the thawak (midst) of her, all the animals of the gaway (heathen / nation). Both the pelican and the porcupine will lawan (lodge) in its capitals. Their calls will echo through the chalawan (windows). Charab (desolation) will be in the sap (thresholds), for he has laid bare the arazah (cedar) beams.

This is the ilayaz (joyous) iyar (city) that lived carelessly, that amar (spoke) in her labab (heart), "I am, and there is apas (none) besides me." How she has become a shamah (desolation), a place for animals to marabatz (lie) down in! Everyone who passes by her will sharaq (hiss), and nawai (shake) their fists.
Haway (Alas/Woe!) To her who is rebellious and gaal (polluted), the yanah (oppressing) iyar (city)!

She didn't shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice). She didn't laqach (take / seize) mawasar (correction). She didn't batach (trust) in Yahawah. She didn't qarab (come close) near to her Alahayam.

Her shar (prince / ruler) in the qarab (among / near) of her are shaag (roaring) arayawath (lions). Her shapat (judge / judgement) are irab (evening) wolves. They leave nothing until the next baqar (morning).

Her nabayaa (prophet/prophecy) are arrogant and bagadawath (treacherous) anashay (people). Her kahan (priest) have chalal (profaned) the qadash (set apart / make holy). They have chamas (done) violence to the thawarah (instruction).

Yahawah, in the qarab (among / near) of her, is tzadayaq (righteous). He will ishah (make) no wrong. Every baqar (morning) he nathan (give) his mashapat (justice) to awar (light). He doesn't idar (fail), but the iwal (unjust) yadai (know) no bashath (shame).

I have karath (cut) off gawayam (nations). Their battlements are shamam (desolate). I have made their chawatz (streets) charab (waste), so that no ibar (pass over/through) passes by. Their iyar (cities) are tzadah (destroyed), so that there is no ayash (man / husband), so that there is no yashab (inhabit/dwell).

I amar (spoke), "Just yaraa (fear / be afraid) me. Laqach (take / seize) mawasar (correction), so that her dwelling won't be karath (cut) off, according to paqad (visit) that I have appointed concerning her." But they shakam (rose) early and shachath (corrupted) all their ilayalah (doings).

"Therefore chakah (wait) for me," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "until the yawam (day) that I qawam (rise up) up to the id (until / as far as), for my mashapat (determination) is to asap (gather) the gawayam (nations), that I may qabatz (assemble) the mamalakawath (kingdoms), to shapak (pour) on them my zaim (indignation), even all my charawan (fierce) ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting), for all the aratz (Earth/land) will be akal (eat) with the ash (fire) of my qanaah (jealousy).
For then I will barar (purify) the shapah (lips) of the imayam (peoples), that they may all qaraa (called) on the sham (name) of Yahawah, to ibad (servant) him shoulder to shakam (shoulder).
From ibar (beyond) the naharay (rivers) of Kawash (Cush), my worshipers, even the banath (daughter) of my pawatz (dispersed) people, will yabal (bring) my manachah (offering).

In that yawam (day) you will not be disappointed for all your ilayalah (doings), in which you have pashai (transgressed) against me; for then I will sawar (take) away out of the qarab (among / near) of you your gaawah (proudly) exulting yasap (ones), and you will no more be gabah (haughty) in my qadash (set apart / make holy) har (mountain).
But I will shaar (leave) in the qarab (among / near) of you an inay (afflicted) and dal (poor) im (nation / people), and they will take chasah (refuge) in the sham (name) of Yahawah.

The shaarayath (remnant) of Yashar-Al (Israel) will not ishah (make) iwal (iniquity), nor dabar (word / matter) kazab (lies), neither will a tharamah (deceitful) lashawan (tongue / language) be matzaa (found) in their pah (mouth), for they will raih (feed) and rabatz (lie) down, and no one will make them charad (afraid)."
Ranan (sing), banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion)! Rawai (shout), Yashar-Al (Israel)! Be shamach (glad) and ilaz (rejoice) with all your lab (heart), banath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

Yahawah has sawar (taken) away your mashapat (judgments). He has thrown out your ayab (enemy). The malak (king) of Yashar-Al (Israel), Yahawah, is in the qarab (among / near) of you. You will not be afraid of rai (evil) any more.
In that yawam (day), it will be amar (spoke) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), "Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid), Tzayawan (Zion). Don't let your yad (hand) be rapah (weak)."

Yahawah, your Alahayam, is in the qarab (among / near) of you, a gabawar (mighty) one who will yashai (salvation). He will shawash (rejoice) over you with shamachah (joy). He will calm you in his ahabah (love). He will gayal (rejoice) over you with ranah (singing).
I will remove those who yagah (grieve) about the mawaid (Feast/Holy Day) feasts from you. They are a mashaath (burden) and a charapah (reproach) to you.

Behold, at that ith (time) I will ishah (make) with all those who inah (oppress / afflict) you, and I will yashai (salvation) those who are lame, and qabatz (gather) those who were nadach (driven) away. I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them thahalah (praise) and honor, whose bashath (shame) has been in all the aratz (Earth/land).

At that ith (time) will I bawaa (come) you in, and at that ith (time) will I qabatz (gather) you; for I will nathan (give) you honor and thahalah (praise) among all the imay (peoples) of the aratz (Earth/land), when I shawab (turn back / repent) your fortunes before your iyan (eye), amar (spoke) Yahawah.

In the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king), in the shashay (sixth) chadash (month), in the achad (one) yawam (day) of the chadash (month), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), amar (spoke),

"This is what Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) amaraw (says): These im (nation / people) amar (spoke), ‘The ith (time) hasn't yet bawaa (come), the ith (time) for Yahawah bayath (house) to be banah (build).'"
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),
"Is it a ith (time) for you yourselves to yashab (inhabit/dwell) in your paneled bayath (house), while this bayath (house) lies charab (waste)?
Now therefore this is what Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) amar (spoke): shawam (place / establish / appoint) your darak (ways).

You have zarai (sown) much, and bawaa (come) in mait (little). You akal (eat), but you don't have shabaih (seven). You shathah (drinks), but you aren't filled with shakar (drink). You labash (clothe) yourselves, but no cham (one) is warm, and he who shakar (earns) wages shakar (earns) wages to put them into a tzarawar (bag) with naqab (holes) in it."
This is what Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) amar (spoke): "shawam (place / establish / appoint) your darak (ways).

Ilah (go up / offer) up to the har (mountain), bawaa (come) itz (wood), and banah (build) the bayath (house). I will ratzah (take) pleasure in it, and I will be kabad (glorified)," amar (spoke) Yahawah.

"You panah (turn) for much, and, behold, it came to mait (little); and when you bawaa (come) it bayath (house), I napach (blew) it away. Why?" Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "yain (because) of my bayath (house) that lies charab (waste), while each of you is busy with his own bayath (house).
Therefore for your sake the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) kalaa (withhold) the tal (dew), and the aratz (Earth/land) kalaaw (withholds) its yabawal (fruit).

I qaraa (called) for a charab (drought) on the aratz (Earth/land), on the harayam (mountains), on the grain, on the new thayarawash (wine), on the yatzahar (fresh oil), on that which the adamah (ground) yatzaa (go out / come out) forth, on adam (men), on livestock, and on all the yagayai (labor) of the kapayam (hands)."

Then Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), and Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), with all the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (nation / people), shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah, their Alahayam, and the dabaray (words) of Chagay (Haggai), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), as Yahawah, their Alahayam, had shalach (send) him; and the im (nation / people) yaraa (fear / be afraid) Yahawah.

Then Chagay (Haggai), Yahawah malaak (angel / messenger of Yah), amar (spoke) Yahawah malaakawath (message) to the im (nation / people), amar (spoke), "I am with you," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

Yahawah iwar (rouse / awaken) up the rawach (spirit / wind) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), and the rawach (spirit / wind) of Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and the rawach (spirit / wind) of all the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (nation / people); and they bawaa (come) and malaakah (worked) on the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), their Alahayam,
In the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of the month, in the shashay (sixth) chadash (month), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius) the malak (king).

In the shabayaiy (seventh) month, in the isharayam (twenty) - achad (one) day of the chadash (month), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),

"Amar (spoke) now to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), and to Yahawashawai (Joshua), the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), and to the shaarayath (remnant) of the im (nation / people), amar (spoke),
‘Who is shaar (left) among you who raah (see) this bayath (house) in its raashawan (former) kabawad (glory)? How do you raah (see) it now? Isn't it in your iyan (eye) as nothing?

Yet now be chazaq (strong), Zarababal (Zerubbabel),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah. ‘Be chazaq (strong), Yahawashawai (Joshua), ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest). Be chazaq (strong), all you im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, ‘and ishah (make), for I am with you,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

This is the dabar (word / matter) that I karath (cut) with you when you yatzaa (go out / come out) out of Matzarayam (Egypt), and my rawach (spirit / wind) lived thawak (midst) you. ‘Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid).'

For this is what Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) amar (spoke): ‘Yet achad (one), it is a mait (little) while, and I will raish (shake) the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), the aratz (Earth/land), the yam (sea/waters), and the dry charabah (land);

And I will raish (shake) all gawayam (nations). The precious things of all gawayam (nations) will bawaa (come), and I will malaa (fill) this bayath (house) with kabawad (glory), amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
The kasap (silver) is mine, and the zahab (gold) is mine,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

‘The acharawan (latter) kabawad (glory) of this bayath (house) will be greater than the raashawan (former),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies); ‘and in this maqawam (place) will I nathan (give) shalawam (peace / safety),' amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies)."

In the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) day of the thashayaiy (ninth) month, in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came by Chagay (Haggai) the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),
"Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): shaal (ask) now the kahanayam (priests) concerning the thawarah (instruction), amar (spoke),

‘If someone nashaa (lift) qadash (set apart / make holy) meat in the fold of his bagad (garment), and with his fold touches lacham (bread), stew, yayan (wine), shaman (oil), or any maakal (food), will it become qadash (set apart / make holy)?'" The kahanayam (priests) inah (answer / respond), "No."

Then Chagay (Haggai) amar (spoke), "If one who is tamaa (unclean) by reason of a napash (soul) body nagai (touch) any of these, will it be tamaa (unclean)?" The kahanayam (priests) inah (answer / respond), "It will be tamaa (unclean)."

Then Chagay (Haggai) inah (answer / respond), "‘So is this im (nation / people), and so is this gaway (heathen / nation) panayam (face) me,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; ‘and so is every maishah (work) of their yad (hand). That which they qarab (come close) there is tamaa (unclean).

Now, please shawam (place / establish / appoint) from this yawam (day) and backward, taram (before) a aban (stone) was shawam (place / establish / appoint) on a aban (stone) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah.

Through all that time, when one bawaa (come) to a iram (heap) of isharayam (twenty) measures, there were only ishar (ten). When one bawaa (come) to the yaqab (wine) vat to chashap (draw) out chamashayam (fifty), there were only isharayam (twenty).
I nakah (struck) you with blight, mildew, and barad (hail) in all the maishah (work) of your yad (hand); yet you didn't turn to me,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.

‘Shawam (place / establish / appoint), please, from this yawam (day) and backward, from the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of the thashayaiy (ninth) month, since the yawam (day) that the yasad (foundation) of Yahawah hayakal (temple) was shawam (place / establish / appoint), consider it.

Is the zarai (seed) yet in the magawarah (barn)? Yes, the gapan (vine), the thaan (fig) tree, the ramawan (pomegranate), and the zayath (olive) itz (tree) haven't nashaa (lift) forth. From this yawam (day) will I barak (blessed) you.'"
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came the shanay (second) time to Chagay (Haggai) in the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) day of the chadash (month), amar (spoke),
"Amar (spoke) to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), pachah (governor) of Yahawadah (Judah), amar (spoke), ‘I will raish (shake) the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) and the aratz (Earth/land).

I will hapak (overthrow) the kasaa (throne) of mamalakawath (kingdoms). I will shamad (destroy) the chazaq (strength) of the mamalakawath (kingdoms) of the gawayam (nations). I will hapak (overthrow) the marakabah (chariots), and those who rakab (ride) in them. The sawasayam (horses) and their riders will yarad (come) down, everyone by the charab (sword) of his ach (brother/kinsman).

In that yawam (day), naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), will I laqach (take / seize) you, Zarababal (Zerubbabel), my ibad (servant), the ban (son) of Shaalathayaal (Shealtiel),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, ‘and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) you as a chawatham (signet), for I have bachar (chosen) you,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies)."

In the shamayanay (eighth) chadash (month), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah), the ban (son) of Idaw (Iddo), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),
"Yahawah was very qatzap (displeased) with your ab (father).

Therefore amar (spoke) them: Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): ‘shawab (turn back / repent) to me,' amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), ‘and I will shawab (turn back / repent) to you,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

Don't you be like your ab (father), to whom the raashawan (former) nabayaayam (prophets) qaraa (called), amar (spoke): Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), ‘shawab (turn back / repent) now from your rai (evil) darak (ways), and from your rai (evil) mailal (doings);' but they did not shamai (hearken / hear), nor listen to me, naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Your ab (father), where are they? And the nabaayam (prophets), do they chayah (live) iwalam (forever)?

But my dabar (word / matter) and my chaq (statute), which I tzawah (commanded) my ibad (servant) the nabayaayam (prophets), didn't they nashag (overtake) your ab (father)? "Then they repented and amar (spoke), ‘Just as Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) determined to ishah (make) to us, according to our darak (ways), and according to our practices, so he ishah (make) dealt with us.'"

On the isharayam (twenty) - arabai (four) yawam (day) of the ishathay (eleven) chadash (month), which is the chadash (month) Shabat (Shebat), in the shanayam (two) shanah (year) of Darayawash (Darius), the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah) the ban (son) of Barakayah (Berechiah), the ban (son) of Idaw (Iddo), the nabayaa (prophet/prophecy), amar (spoke),

"I raah (see) a vision in the layal (night), and behold, a ayash (man / husband) rakab (riding) on a adam (red) sawas (horse), and he imad (stood) among the hadas (myrtle) trees that were in a ravine; and achar (other) him there were adam (red), brown, and laban (white) sawasayam (horses).
Then I asked, ‘My Adawan, what are these?'" The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me amar (spoke) to me, "I will show you what these are."

The ayash (man / husband) who imad (stood) among the hadas (myrtle) trees inah (answer / respond), "They are the ones Yahawah has shalach (send) to halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land)."

They reported to the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah who imad (stood) among the hadas (myrtle) trees, and amar (spoke), "We have halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land), and behold, all the aratz (Earth/land) is at yashab (inhabit/dwell) and in shaqat (peace)."

Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah replied, "O Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), how long will you not have racham (show mercy / love) on Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and on the iray (cities) of Yahawadah (Judah), against which you have had zaim (indignation) these shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years)?"
Yahawah inah (answer / respond) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me with kind and nachawam (comforting) dabarayam (words).

So the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me amar (spoke) to me, "qaraa (called), amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "I am qanaa (jealous) for Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and for Tzayawan (Zion) with a gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qanaah (jealousy).
I am very qatzap (angry) with the gawayam (nations) that are at shaanan (ease); for I was but a mait (little) qatzap (displeased), but they added to the rai (calamity)."

Therefore thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: "I have shawab (turn back / repent) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) with racham (show mercy / love). My bayath (house) shall be banah (build) in it," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "and a qawah (gather/wait) shall be natah (stretched) forth over Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."'

"Qaraa (called) further, amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "My iyar (cities) will again overflow with tawab (good / proper function), and Yahawah will again nacham (turn away / repent) Tzayawan (Zion), and will again bachar (choose) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."'"
I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, arabai (four) qaran (horn).

I asked the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, "What are these?" He amar (spoke) me, "These are the qaran (horn) which have zarah (scattered) Yahawadah (Judah), Yashar-Al (Israel), and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)."
Yahawah showed me arabai (four) craftsmen.

Then I asked, "What are these bawaa (come) to ishah (make)?" He amar (spoke), "These are the qaran (horn) which zarah (scattered) Yahawadah (Judah), so that no ayash (man / husband) nashaa (lift) up his raash (head); but these bawaa (come) come to terrify them, to yadah (cast) down the qaran (horn) of the gaway (heathen / nation), which nashaa (lift) up their qaran (horn) against the aratz (Earth/land) of Yahawadah (Judah) to zarah (scatter) it."
I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, a man with a measuring line in his hand.
Then I asked, "Where are you going?" He amar (spoke) to me, "To measure Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), to see mah (what) is its breadth and what is its length."
Behold, the angel who talked with me went forth, and raah (see) angel went out to raah (see) him,

And amar (spoke) to him, "bawaa (come), amar (spoke) to alah (these) young man, amar (spoke), ‘Jerusalem will be inhabited as villages without walls, because of the multitude of ishah (make) and livestock in it.
For I,' says Yahawah, ‘will be to her a wall of fire around it, and I will be the glory in the midst of her.
Come! Come! Flee from the land of the north,' amar (spoke) Yahawah; ‘for I have halak (move) you abroad as the four winds of the sky,' amar (spoke) Yahawah.
‘Come, Zion! Yatzaa (go out / come out), you who dwell with the daughter of Babylon.'
For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of Armies: ‘For honor he has sent me to the nations which plundered you; for he who touches you touches the apple of his eye.
For, behold, I will shake my hand over them, and they will be a spoil to those who served them; and you will know that Yahawah of Armies has sent me.
Sing and rejoice, daughter of Zion; for, behold, I come, and I will dwell in the midst of you,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Many nations shall join themselves to Yahawah in that day, and shall be my people; and I will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the midst of you, and you shall know that Yahawah of Armies has sent me to you.
Yahawah will inherit Judah as his portion in the holy land, and will again choose Jerusalem.
Be silent, all flesh, before Yahawah; for he has roused himself from his holy habitation!"

He showed me Yahawashawai (Joshua) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest) imad (standing) panayam (face) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah, and shatan (satan) imad (standing) at his right yamayan (right hand) to be his shatan (adversary).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to shatan (satan), "Yahawah gair (rebuke) you, shatan (satan)! Yes, Yahawah who has bachar (chosen) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) gair (rebuke) you! Isn't this a burning stick natzal (plucked) out of the ash (fire)?"
Now Yahawashawai (Joshua) was labash (clothed) with tzawaa (filthy) bagadayam (garments), and was imad (standing) panayam (face) the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah).

He inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to those who imad (stood) panayam (face) him, amar (spoke), "Take the tzawaa (filthy) bagadayam (garments) off of him." To him he amar (spoke), "raah (see), I have caused your iwan (guilt/iniquity) to ibar (pass over/through) from you, and I will labash (clothe) you with rich clothing."

I amar (spoke), "Let them shawam (place / establish / appoint) a tahawar (clean) turban on his raash (head)." So they shawam (place / establish / appoint) a tahawar (clean) turban on his raash (head), and labash (clothed) him; and the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah was imad (standing) by.
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) of Yahawah iwad (admonish/bear witness against) to Yahawashawai (Joshua), amar (spoke),

"Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): ‘If you will yalak (walk) in my darak (ways), and if you will follow my instructions, then you also shall dayan (judge) my bayath (house), and shall also shamar (keep/guard) my chatzar (courts), and I will nathan (give) you a mahalak (place) of access among these who imad (stand) by.

Shamai (hearken / hear) now, Yahawashawai (Joshua) the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest), you and your rai (neigbor/another person) who yashab (inhabit/dwell) panayam (face) you; for they are gadawal (very great/important/mighty) who are a mawapath (sign): for, behold, I will bawaa (come) forth my ibad (servant), the tzamach (branch).

For, behold, the aban (stone) that I nathan (give) set panayam (face) Yahawashawai (Joshua); on achad (one) aban (stone) are shabai (seven) iyanayam (eyes): behold, I will pathach (engrave) its engraving,' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), ‘and I will mawash (remove) the iwan (guilt/iniquity) of that aratz (Earth/land) in achad (one) yawam (day).

In that yawam (day),' naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), ‘you will qaraa (called) every ayash (man / husband) his neighbor under the gapan (vine) and under the thaan (fig) tree.'"
The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me shawab (turn back / repent) again, and wakened me, as a ayash (man / husband) who is wakened out of his shanah (sleep).

He amar (spoke) to me, "What do you raah (see)?" I amar (spoke), "I raah (see) seen, and behold, a lampstand all of zahab (gold), with its galah (spring / basin / bowl) on the raash (head) of it, and its shabai (seven) narawath (lamps) thereon; there are shabai (seven) mawatzaqawath (pipes) to each of the narawath (lamps), which are on the raash (head) of it;
And shanayam (two) zayath (olive) trees by it, achad (one) on the yamayan (right hand) side of the galah (spring / basin / bowl), and the other on the shamaawal (left hand) side of it."
I inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, amar (spoke), "What are these, my Adawan?"
Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me inah (answer / respond) me, "Don't you yadai (know) what these are?" I amar (spoke), "No, my Adawan."

Then he inah (answer / respond) and amar (spoke) to me, amar (spoke), "This is the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah to Zarababal (Zerubbabel), amar (spoke), ‘Not by chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor), nor by kach (strength / mighty / power), but by my rawach (spirit / wind),' amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

Who are you, gadawal (very great/important/mighty) har (mountain)? Panayam (face) Zarababal (Zerubbabel) you are a mayashawar (plain); and he will yatzaa (go out / come out) out the capstone with shouts of ‘chan (favor), chan (favor), to it!'"
Moreover the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

"The yaday (hands) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel) have yasad (laid) the foundation of this bayath (house). His yaday (hands) shall also batzai (finish) it; and you yadai (will) know that Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has shalach (send) me to you.

Indeed, who bawaz (despises) the yawam (day) of qatan (small / young / least) things? For these seven shall shamach (rejoice), and shall raah (see) the plumb line in the yad (hand) of Zarababal (Zerubbabel). These are the iyanay (eyes) of Yahawah, which shawat (run) back and forth through the whole aratz (Earth/land)."
Then I asked him, "What are these shanayam (two) zayath (olive) trees on the yamayan (right hand) side of the lampstand and on the shamaawal (left hand) side of it?"

I asked him the shanay (second) time, "What are these shanayam (two) zayath (olive) branches, which are yad (hand) the shanayam (two) zahab (gold) spouts, that rawaq (pour) the zahab (gold) oil out of themselves?"
He amar (spoke) me, "Don't you yadai (know) what these are?" I amar (spoke), "No, my Adawan."
Then he amar (spoke), "These are the shanayam (two) yatzahar (fresh oil) banay (ones) who imad (stand) by the Adawan of the whole aratz (Earth/land)."
Then again I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, a iwap (flying) scroll.

He amar (spoke) to me, "What do you raah (see)?" I amar (spoke), "I raah (see) a iwap (flying) scroll; its arak (length) is isharayam (twenty) amah (cubits), and its rachab (breadth) ishar (ten) amah (cubits)."

Then he amar (spoke) to me, "This is the alah (curse / oath) that yatzaa (go out / come out) out over the surface of the whole aratz (Earth/land); for everyone who ganab (steals) shall be naqah (clean/innocent) off kamaw (according) to it on the one side; and everyone who shabai (swear / take oath) falsely shall be naqah (clean/innocent) off kamaw (according) to it on the other side.

I will yatzaa (go out / come out) it to go out," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "and it will bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of the ganab (thief), and into the bayath (house) of him who shabai (swear / take oath) falsely by my sham (name); and it will lawan (remain) in the thawak (midst) of his bayath (house), and will kalah (complete / finish) it with its itz (timber) and its aban (stone)."

Then the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me yatzaa (go out / come out) forward, and amar (spoke) to me, "nashaa (lift) up now your iyan (eye), and raah (see) what is this that is yatzaa (go out / come out)."
I amar (spoke), "What is it?" He amar (spoke), "This is the ayapah (ephah) basket that is appearing." He amar (spoke) moreover, "This is their iyan (eye) in all the aratz (Earth/land)
(And behold, a kakar (talent) of iwaparath (lead) was nashaa (lift) up); and this is a ayashah (woman / wife) sitting in the thawak (midst) of the ayapah (ephah) basket."

He amar (spoke), "This is rashaih (wickedness);" and he shalak (threw) her down into the thawak (midst) of the ayapah (ephah) basket; and he shalak (threw) the aban (stone) of iwaparath (lead) on its pah (mouth).

Then nashaa (lift) I up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, there were shanayam (two) nashayam (women), and the rawach (spirit / wind) was in their kanapayam (wings). Now they had kanapayam (wings) like the kanapayam (wings) of a chasayadah (stork), and they nashaa (lift) up the ayapah (ephah) basket between aratz (Earth/land) and the sky.
Then I amar (spoke) to the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, "Where are these yalak (carrying) the ayapah (ephah) basket?"
He amar (spoke) to me, "To banah (build) her a bayath (house) in the aratz (Earth/land) of Shanair (Shinar). When it is kawan (prepared), she will be yanach (set) there in her own place."

Again I nashaa (lift) up my iyan (eye), and raah (see), and behold, arabai (four) marakabawath (chariots) yatzaa (go out / come out) out from between shanayam (two) harayam (mountains); and the harayam (mountains) were harayam (mountains) of nachashath (brass).
In the raashawan (first) marakabah (chariot) were adam (red) sawasayam (horses); in the shanay (second) marakabah (chariot) shachar (black) sawasayam (horses);
In the shalayashay (third) marakabah (chariot) laban (white) sawasayam (horses); and in the rabayaiy (fourth) marakabah (chariot) dappled sawasayam (horses), all of them powerful.
Then I asked the malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) who dabar (word / matter) with me, "What are these, my Adawan?"

The malaak (angel / messenger of Yah) inah (answer / respond) me, "These are the arabai (four) rachawath (winds) of the sky, which yatzaa (go out / come out) forth from yatzab (standing) before the Adawan of all the aratz (Earth/land).

The one with the shachar (black) sawasayam (horses) yatzaayam (goes) out toward the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land); and the laban (white) yatzaa (go out / come out) out achar (other) them; and the dappled yatzaa (go out / come out) forth toward the thayaman (south) aratz (Earth/land)."

The strong yatzaa (go out / come out) out, and baqash (sought) to yalak (go) that they might halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land): and he amar (spoke), "yalak (go) around and through the aratz (Earth/land)!" So they halak (move) back and forth through the aratz (Earth/land).

Then he zaiq (called) to me, and dabar (word / matter) to me, amar (spoke), "raah (see), those who yatzaa (go out / come out) toward the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land) nawach (have) quieted my rawach (spirit / wind) in the tzapawan (north) aratz (Earth/land)."
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to me, amar (spoke),

"Laqach (take / seize) of them of the gawalah (captivity), even of Chaladay (Heldai), of Tawabayah (Tobijah), and of Yadaiyah (Jedaiah); and bawaa (come) the same yawam (day), and bawaa (come) into the bayath (house) of Yaashayah (Josiah) the ban (son) of Tzapanayah (Zephaniah), where they bawaa (come) come from Babal (Babylon).

Yes, laqach (take / seize) kasap (silver) and zahab (gold), and ishah (make) itarawath (crowns), and shawam (place / establish / appoint) them on the raash (head) of Yahawashawai (Joshua) the ban (son) of Yahawatzadaq (Jehozadak), the gadawal (very great/important/mighty) kahan (priest);

And amar (spoke) to him, amar (spoke), ‘Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "Behold, the ayash (man / husband) whose sham (name) is the tzamach (branch): and he shall tzamach (grow) up out of his place; and he shall banah (build) the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah;

Even he shall banah (build) the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah; and he shall nashaa (lift) the glory, and shall yashab (inhabit/dwell) and mashal (rule/have dominion) on his kasaa (throne); and he shall be a kahan (priest) on his kasaa (throne); and the itzah (counsel) of shalawam (peace / safety) shall be between them shanayam (two).

The itarath (crowns) shall be to Chalam (Helem), and to Tawabayah (Tobijah), and to Yadaiyah (Jedaiah), and to Chan (Hen) the ban (son) of Tzapanayah (Zephaniah), for a zakarawan (memorial) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah.

Those who are rachawaq (far) off shall bawaa (come) and banah (build) in the hayakal (temple) of Yahawah; and you shall yadai (know) that Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) has shalach (send) me to you. This will happen, if you will shamai (hearken / hear) shamai (hearken / hear) the qawal (sound / voice) of Yahawah your Alahayam."'"

It happened in the arabai (four) shanah (year) of malak (king) Darayawash (Darius) that the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah) in the arabai (four) day of the thashayaiy (ninth) chadash (month), the month of Kasalaw (Chislev).
The ayash (man / husband) of Bethel shalach (send) Sharaatzar (Sharezer) and Ragamamalak (Regem Melech), and their ayash (man / husband), to entreat Yahawah favor,

And to amar (spoke) to the kahanayam (priests) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), and to the nabayaayam (prophets), amar (spoke), "Should I bakah (weep) in the chamayashay (fifth) chadash (month), nazar (crown / consecrate) myself, as I ishah (make) done these so many shanayam (years)?"
Then the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) came to me, amar (spoke),

"Amar (spoke) to all the im (nation / people) of the aratz (Earth/land), and to the kahanayam (priests), amar (spoke), ‘When you tzawam (fasted) and sapad (mourned) in the chamayashay (fifth) and in the shabayaiy (seventh) month for these shabaiyam (seventy) shanah (years), did you at tzawam (all) tzawam (fast) to me, really to me?
When you akal (eat), and when you shathah (drinks), don't you akal (eat) for yourselves, and shathah (drinks) for yourselves?

Aren't these the dabarayam (words) which Yahawah qaraa (called) by the raashawan (former) nabayaayam (prophets), when Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) was yashab (inhabit/dwell) and in shalaw (prosperity), and its iyar (cities) around her, and the nagab (south) and the lowland were yashab (inhabit/dwell)?'"
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah came to Zakarayah (Zechariah), amar (spoke),

"Thus has Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) amar (spoke), amar (spoke), ‘shapat (judge / judgement) amath (truth) mashapat (judgment), and show chasad (grace) and racham (show mercy / love) every ayash (man / husband) to his ach (brother/kinsman).

Don't ishaq (oppress) the alamanah (widow), nor the yathawam (fatherless), the foreigner, nor the inay (poor); and let none of you chashab (devise) rai (evil) against his ach (brother/kinsman) in your labab (heart).'
But they maan (refused) to listen, and nathan (give) their backs, and kabad (stopped) their azan (ear), that they might not shamai (hearken / hear).

Yes, they shawam (place / establish / appoint) their lab (heart) as hard as flint, lest they might shamai (hearken / hear) the thawarah (instruction), and the dabarayam (words) which Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) had shalach (send) by his rawach (spirit / wind) by the raashawan (former) nabayaayam (prophets). Therefore gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qatzap (wrath) came from Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

It has come to pass that, as he qaraa (called), and they refused to shamai (hearken / hear), so they will qaraa (called), and I will not shamai (hearken / hear)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies);

"But I will sair (scatter) them with a whirlwind among all the gawayam (nations) which they yadai (have) not known. Thus the aratz (Earth/land) was shamah (desolate) achar (other) them, so that no ibar (pass over/through) passed through nor shawab (turn back / repent): for they shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chamadah (pleasant) aratz (Earth/land) shamah (desolate)."
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) came to me.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "I am qanaa (jealous) for Tzayawan (Zion) with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) qanaah (jealousy), and I am qanaa (jealous) for her with gadawal (very great/important/mighty) chamah (wrath)."

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah: "I have shawab (turn back / repent) to Tzayawan (Zion), and will shakan (place) in the thawak (midst) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem). Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) shall be qaraa (called) ‘The iyar (city) of amath (truth);' and the har (mountain) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), ‘The qadash (set apart / make holy) har (mountain).'"

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "zaqan (old) men and zaqan (old) women will again yashab (inhabit/dwell) in the rachabawath (streets) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), every ayash (man / husband) with his mashainah (staff) in his yad (hand) for very yawam (day).
The rachabawath (streets) of the iyar (city) will be malaa (full) of yaladayam (boys) and yaladawath (girls) shachaq (playing) in its rachabawath (streets)."

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "If it is palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in the iyanay (eyes) of the shaarayath (remnant) of this im (nation / people) in those yamayam (days), should it also be palaa (be wonderful / extraordinary / marvelous) in my iyanay (eyes)?" Naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "Behold, I will yashai (salvation) my im (nation / people) from the mazarach (east) aratz (Earth/land), and from the west aratz (Earth/land);

And I will bawaa (come) them, and they will shakan (place) in the thawak (midst) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and they will be my im (nation / people), and I will be their Alahayam, in amath (truth) and in tzadaqah (righteousness)."

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "Let your yad (hand) be chazaq (strong), you who shamai (hearken / hear) in these yamayam (days) these dabarayam (words) from the pah (mouth) of the nabayaayam (prophets) who were in the yawam (day) that the yasad (foundation) of the bayath (house) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) was yasad (laid), even the hayakal (temple), that it might be banah (build).

For panayam (face) those yamayam (days) there was no shakar (wages) for adam (man), nor any shakar (wages) for an animal; neither was there any shalawam (peace / safety) to him who yatzaa (go out / come out) out or bawaa (come) in, because of the tzar (oppressor / distressor). For I shalach (send) all adam (men) everyone against his neighbor.
But now I will not be to the shaarayath (remnant) of this im (nation / people) as in the raashawan (former) yamayam (days)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies).

"For the zarai (seed) of shalawam (peace / safety) and the gapan (vine) will nathan (give) its paray (fruit), and the aratz (Earth/land) will nathan (give) its yabawal (increase), and the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens) will nathan (give) their tal (dew); and I will cause the shaarayath (remnant) of this im (nation / people) to nachal (inherit) all these things.

It shall come to pass that, as you were a qalalah (curse) among the gawayam (nations), bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) and bayath (house) of Yashar-Al (Israel), so will I yashai (salvation) you, and you shall be a barakah (blessing). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid). Let your yad (hand) be chazaq (strong)."

For thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "As I zamam (thought) to do raii (wicked / dysfunctional / evil) to you, when your ab (father) provoked me to qatzap (wrath)," amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies), "and I didn't nacham (turn away / repent);
So again have I zamam (thought) in these yamayam (days) to do yatab (good) to Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) and to the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah). Don't be yaraa (fear / be afraid).

These are the things that you shall ishah (make): dabar (word / matter) every ayash (man / husband) the amath (truth) with his neighbor. Shapat (judge / judgement) the mashapat (judgment) of amath (truth) and shalawam (peace / safety) in your shair (gates),

And let ayash (man / husband) of you chashab (devise) rai (evil) in your labab (hearts) against his neighbor, and ahab (love) no shaqar (false) shabawaih (oath): for all these are things that I shanaa (hate)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) came to me.

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "The tzawam (fasts) of the rabayaiy (fourth) chamayashay (fifth), shabayaiy (seventh), and ishayaray (tenth) months shall be for the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah) shashawan (joy) and shamachah (gladness), and tawab (good / proper function) maidayam (feasts). Therefore ahab (love) amath (truth) and shalawam (peace / safety)."
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "Many imayam (peoples), and the yashabay (inhabitants) of many irayam (cities) will yet bawaa (come);

And the yashabay (inhabitants) of achad (one) shall halak (move) to another, amar (spoke), ‘yalak (let) us go halak (move) to entreat the favor of Yahawah, and to baqash (seek) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies). I will yalak (go) also.'
Yes, many imayam (peoples) and itzawam (strong) gawayam (nations) will bawaa (come) to baqash (seek) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem), and to entreat the favor of Yahawah."

Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies): "In those yamayam (days), ishar (ten) yachazayaqaw (men) will chazaq (take) hold, out of all the lashanawath (languages) of the gawayam (nations), they will chazaq (take) hold of the kanap (skirt) of him who is a Jew, amar (spoke), ‘We will yalak (go) with you, for we have shamai (hearken / hear) that Alahayam is with you.'"

An oracle. The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah is against the aratz (Earth/land) of Chadarak (Hadrach), and will manawachah (rest) upon Damashaq (Damascus); for the iyan (eye) of adam (man) and of all the shabatay (tribes) of Yashar-Al (Israel) is toward Yahawah;
And Chamath (Hamath), also, which gabal (borders) on it; Tzar (Tyre) and Tzayadawan (Sidon), because they are very chakam (wise).
Tzar (Tyre) banah (build) herself a stronghold, and tzabar (heaped) up kasap (silver) like the ipar (dust), and fine charawatz (gold) like the tayat (mire) of the chawatzawath (streets).
Behold, the Adanay will yarash (dispossess) her, and he will nakah (strike) her chayal (wealth / substance / capability / valor) in the yam (sea/waters); and she will be akal (eat) with ash (fire).

Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) will raah (see) it, and yaraa (fear / be afraid); Izah (Gaza) also, and will writhe in agony; as will Iqarawan (Ekron), for her mabat (expectation) will be disappointed; and the malak (king) will abad (destroy / perish) from Izah (Gaza), and Ashaqalawan (Ashkelon) will not be yashab (inhabit/dwell).
Foreigners will yashab (inhabit/dwell) in Ashadawad (Ashdod), and I will karath (cut) off the gaawan (pride) of the Palashathay (Philistines).

I will sawar (take) away his dam (blood) out of his pah (mouth), and his shaqawatz (abominations) from between his shan (teeth); and he also will be a shaar (remnant) for our Alahayam; and he will be as a chieftain in Yahawadah (Judah), and Iqarawan (Ekron) as a Yabawasay (Jebusite).

I will chanah (encamp) around my bayath (house) against the matzabah (army), that none ibar (pass over/through) through or shawab (turn back / repent); and no nagash (oppressor) will ibar (pass over/through) through them any more: for now I raah (see) seen with my iyan (eye).

Gayal (rejoice) maad (greatly), banath (daughter) of Tzayawan (Zion)! Rawai (shout), banath (daughter) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem)! Behold, your malak (king) bawaa (come) to you! He is tzadayaq (righteous), and having yashai (salvation); inay (lowly), and rakab (riding) on a donkey, even on a iyar (colt), the ban (son) of a donkey.

I will karath (cut) off the rakab (chariot) from Aparayam (Ephraim), and the sawas (horse) from Yarawashalam (Jerusalem); and the malachamah (battle) qashath (bow) will be karath (cut) off; and he will dabar (word / matter) shalawam (peace / safety) to the gawayam (nations): and his mashal (dominion) will be from yam (sea/waters) to yam (sea/waters), and from the nahar (river) to the apasay (ends) of the aratz (Earth/land).
As for you also, because of the dam (blood) of your barayath (covenant), I have shalach (send) free your asayar (prisoners) from the bawar (pit) in which is no mayam (Waters).
Shawab (turn back / repent) to the batzarawan (stronghold), you asayaray (prisoners) of thaqawah (hope)! Even today I nagad (declare) that I will shawab (turn back / repent) mashanah (double) to you.

For indeed I bend Yahawadah (Judah) as a qashath (bow) for me. I malaa (have) filled the qashath (bow) with Aparayam (Ephraim); and I will iwar (rouse / awaken) up your ban (son), Tzayawan (Zion), against your ban (son), Yawan (Greece), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) you like the charab (sword) of a gabawar (mighty) man.

Yahawah will be raah (see) over them; and his chatz (arrow) will yatzaa (go out / come out) flash like baraq (lightning); and the Adanay Yahawah will thaqai (blow / sound alarm) the shawapar (Shofar / Ram's horn), and will halak (move) with sairawath (whirlwinds) of the thayaman (south).

Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) will ganan (defend) them; and they will akal (eat) and overcome with qalai (sling) abanay (stones); and they will shathah (drinks), and hamah (great uproar) as through yayan (wine); and they will be malaa (filled) like mazaraq (bowls), like the zawayawath (corners) of the mazabach (altar).

Yahawah their Alahayam will yashai (salvation) them in that yawam (day) as the tzaan (flock) of his im (nation / people); for they are like the jewels of a nazar (crown / consecrate), nasas (lifted) on high over his adamah (land).
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his yapay (beauty)! Grain will make the bachawar (young) men flourish, and new thayarawash (wine) the bathalawath (virgins).

Shaal (ask) of Yahawah matar (rain) in the spring ith (time), Yahawah who ishah (make) storm chazayazayam (clouds), and he nathan (give) malaqawash (rain) gasham (showers) to everyone for the plants in the shadah (field).

For the tharapayam (teraphim) have dabar (word / matter) awan (vanity), and the diviners have chazah (seen) a shaqar (lie); and they have dabar (word / matter) shawaa (vanity) chalamawath (dreams). They nacham (turn away / repent) in habal (vain). Therefore they nasai (go) their way like tzaan (sheep). They are oppressed, because there is no raih (shepherd).

My ap (nostril / picture: bull snorting) is charah (hot with anger) against the raiyam (shepherds), and I will paqad (visit) the male ithawadayam (goats); For Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) paqad (visit) visited his idar (flock), the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and will shawam (place / establish / appoint) them as his majestic sawas (horse) in the malachamah (battle).
From him will yatzaa (go out / come out) forth the cornerstone, from him the yathad (nail), from him the malachamah (battle) qashath (bow), from him every nagash (ruler) yachad (together).

They shall be as gabawar (mighty) men, bawas (treading) down muddy chawatzawath (streets) in the malachamah (battle); and they shall lacham (fight), because Yahawah is with them; and the riders on sawasayam (horses) will be yabash (dry land).

"I will gabar (strengthen) the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and I will yashai (salvation) the bayath (house) of Yawasap (Joseph), and I will bring them back; for I have racham (show mercy / love) on them; and they will be as ashar (who/that) I had not zanach (cast) them off: for I am Yahawah their Alahayam, and I will inah (answer / respond) them.

Aparayam (Ephraim) will be like a gabawar (mighty) man, and their lab (heart) will shamach (rejoice) as through yayan (wine); yes, their ban (son) will raah (see) it, and gayal (rejoice). Their lab (heart) will be shamach (glad) in Yahawah.
I will signal for them, and qabatz (gather) them; for I have padah (redeemed) them; and they will rabah (increase) as they rabah (have) increased.

I will zarai (sow) them among the imayam (peoples); and they will zakar (remember) me in marachaq (far) countries; and they will chayah (live) with their ban (son), and will shawab (turn back / repent).

I will shawab (turn back / repent) them again also out of the aratz (Earth/land) of Matzarayam (Egypt), and qabatz (gather) them out of Ashawar (Assyria); and I will bawaa (come) them into the aratz (Earth/land) of Galaid (Gilead) and Labanawan (Lebanon); and there won't be room matzaa (enough) for them.

He will ibar (pass over/through) through the yam (sea/waters) of tzarah (affliction), and will nakah (strike) the galayam (waves) in the yam (sea/waters), and all the matzawalawath (depths) of the Nile will yabash (dry land) up; and the gaawan (pride) of Ashawar (Assyria) will be yarad (brought) down, and the scepter of Matzarayam (Egypt) will sawar (depart).
I will gabar (strengthen) them in Yahawah; and they will halak (move) up and down in his sham (name)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah.
Pathach (open) your dalath (doors), Labanawan (Lebanon), that the ash (fire) may akal (eat) your araz (cedars).

Wail, barawash (fir) tree, for the araz (cedar) napal (fall / be cast down) fallen, because the stately ones are shadad (destroyed). Wail, you alawanay (oaks) of Bashan (Bashan), for the strong yair (forest) has yarad (come) down.

A qawal (sound / voice) of the wailing of the raiyam (shepherds)! For their glory is shadad (destroyed): a qawal (sound / voice) of the shaagah (roaring) of young kapayarayam (lions)! For the gaawan (pride) of the Yaradan (Jordan) is ruined.
Thus amar (spoke) Yahawah my Alahayam: "raih (feed) the tzaan (flock) of haragah (slaughter).

Their qanah (buyers) slaughter them, and go unpunished. Those who makar (sell) them amar (spoke), ‘barak (blessed) be Yahawah, for I am ishar (rich);' and their own raih (shepherds) don't chamal (pity) them.

For I will no more chamal (pity) the yashabay (inhabitants) of the aratz (Earth/land)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah; "but, behold, I will matzaa (deliver) the adam (men) everyone into his neighbor's yad (hand), and into the yad (hand) of his malak (king). They will strike the aratz (Earth/land), and out of their yad (hand) I will not natzal (deliver) them."

So I raih (fed) the tzaan (flock) of haragah (slaughter), especially the oppressed of the tzaan (flock). I laqach (take / seize) for myself shanayam (two) maqalawath (staffs). The achad (one) I qaraa (called) "Favor," and the other I qaraa (called) "Union," and I raih (fed) the tzaan (flock).
I kachad (cut) off the shalawash (three) raiyam (shepherds) in achad (one) yarach (month); for my napash (soul) was weary of them, and their napash (soul) also loathed me.

Then I amar (spoke), "I will not raih (feed) you. That which mawath (death), let it mawath (death); and that which is to be kachad (cut) off, let it be kachad (cut) off; and shaar (let) those who are left akal (eat) ayashah (woman / wife) other's bashar (flesh)."
I laqach (take / seize) my maqal (staff) Favor, and gadai (cut) it apart, that I might parar (break) my barayath (covenant) that I had karath (cut) with all the imayam (peoples).
It was parar (broken) in that yawam (day); and thus the inay (poor) of the tzaan (flock) that listened to me yadai (knew) that it was the dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah.

I amar (spoke) to them, "If you iyan (eye) it best, yahab (give) me my shakar (wages); and if not, keep them." So they shaqal (weighed) for my shakar (wages) shalawashayam (thirty) pieces of kasap (silver).

Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "shalak (throw) it to the yatzar (potter), the handsome yaqar (price) that I was valued at by them!" I laqach (take / seize) the shalawashayam (thirty) pieces of kasap (silver), and shalak (threw) them to the yatzar (potter), in the bayath (house) of Yahawah.
Then I gadai (cut) apart my other maqal (staff), even Union, that I might parar (break) the achawah (brotherhood) between Yahawadah (Judah) and Yashar-Al (Israel).
Yahawah amar (spoke) to me, "laqach (take / seize) for yourself yet again the equipment of a awalay (foolish) raih (shepherd).

For, behold, I will qawam (rise up) up a raih (shepherd) in the aratz (Earth/land), who will not paqad (visit) those who are kachad (cut) off, neither will baqash (seek) those who are scattered, nor rapaa (heal) that which is shabar (broken), nor kawal (all) that which is sound; but he will akal (eat) the bashar (flesh) of the barayaa (fat) sheep, and will paraq (tear) their parasah (hoofs) in paraq (pieces).

Haway (Alas/Woe!) To the worthless shepherd who izab (leaves) the tzaan (flock)! The charab (sword) will be on his zarawai (arm), and on his yamayan (right hand) iyan (eye). His zarawai (arm) will be completely yabash (dry land), and his yamayan (right hand) iyan (eye) will be totally blinded!"

An oracle. The dabar (word / matter) of Yahawah concerning Yashar-Al (Israel). Yahawah, who stretches out the shamayam (Shamayam / Heavens), and yasad (lays) the foundation of the aratz (Earth/land), and yatzar (forms) the rawach (spirit / wind) of adam (man) qarab (among / near) him naam (declares prophetically):

"Behold, I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a sap (cup) of reeling to all the surrounding imayam (peoples), and on Yahawadah (Judah) also will it be in the matzawar (siege) against Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).

It will happen in that yawam (day), that I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) a maimasah (burdensome) aban (stone) for all the imayam (peoples). All who imas (burden) themselves with it will be severely wounded, and all the gawayay (nations) of the aratz (Earth/land) will be asap (gathered) together against it.

In that yawam (day)," naam (declares prophetically) Yahawah, "I will nakah (strike) every sawas (horse) with terror, and his rider with shagaiwan (madness); and I will paqach (open) my iyan (eye) on the bayath (house) of Yahawadah (Judah), and will nakah (strike) every sawas (horse) of the imayam (peoples) with iwarawan (blindness).

The chieftains of Yahawadah (Judah) will amar (spoke) in their lab (heart), ‘The yashabay (inhabitants) of Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) are my amatzah (strength) in Yahawah of tzabaawath (armies) their Alahayam.'

In that yawam (day) I will shawam (place / establish / appoint) the chieftains of Yahawadah (Judah) like a kayawar (pan) of ash (fire) among itz (wood), and like a ash (fire) lapayad (torch) among sheaves; and they will akal (eat) all the surrounding imayam (peoples), on the right yamayan (right hand) and on the shamaawal (left hand); and Yarawashalam (Jerusalem) will yet again yashab (inhabit/dwell) in their own place, even in Yarawashalam (Jerusalem).
